2103.14259|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对目标检测中标签分配（label assignment）问题，指出现有方法通常为每个真值目标独立定义正负样本，缺乏全局视角。②作者创新性地将标签分配建模为最优传输（Optimal Transport, OT）问题，将每个anchor（需求方）与gt（供给方）之间的单位运输代价定义为分类损失与回归损失的加权和，并通过Sinkhorn-Knopp迭代求解最小代价的最优传输方案，即OTA。③相比ATSS、SimOTA等独立分配策略，OTA从全局最优角度分配正负样本，尤其在拥挤场景下优势明显。④在COCO上，配备OTA的FCOS-ResNet-50在1X调度下达到40.7% mAP，超越所有现有分配方法；在CrowdHuman上进一步验证了其在拥挤场景下的优越性。
2103.14259|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the label assignment problem in object detection, where existing methods typically define positive/negative samples for each ground-truth independently without a global perspective. ②The authors formulate label assignment as an Optimal Transport (OT) problem, defining the unit transportation cost between each anchor (demander) and ground-truth (supplier) as a weighted sum of classification and regression losses, and solve it via Sinkhorn-Knopp Iteration to obtain the optimal assignment plan. ③Unlike independent assignment strategies such as ATSS and SimOTA, OTA achieves globally optimal assignment, showing particular advantages in crowded scenarios. ④On COCO, FCOS-ResNet-50 with OTA reaches 40.7% mAP under the 1X scheduler, outperforming all existing assigning methods, with further validation on CrowdHuman confirming its superiority in crowd scenes.
2103.14259|v2.assessment: 该工作将最优传输理论引入目标检测标签分配，视角新颖且理论优雅，在COCO和CrowdHuman上均取得一致提升，对检测器训练策略研究具有较高参考价值。
2103.14259|v2.contribution: 提出将目标检测标签分配建模为最优传输问题，并利用Sinkhorn-Knopp迭代求解全局最优分配方案OTA。
2103.14259|v2.innovation: 首次从全局最优传输视角统一建模anchor与gt之间的标签分配，替代传统的独立正负样本定义策略。
2103.14259|v2.result: 在COCO上FCOS-ResNet-50配合OTA在1X调度下达到40.7% mAP，超越所有现有分配方法，并在CrowdHuman拥挤场景中验证了优越性。

2203.16220|v2.summary_cn: 针对红外与可见光图像融合服务于目标检测时，现有方法多面向人眼视觉而忽略下游检测任务需求的问题，本文提出目标感知的双对抗学习框架，并构建了多场景多模态融合基准数据集。方法通过双对抗机制分别约束融合图像保留红外热目标与可见光纹理，并以检测损失引导融合过程实现任务感知。相比传统视觉质量驱动的融合方法，该工作首次将融合与检测端到端联合优化，并在多场景基准上取得检测精度提升。
2203.16220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses infrared-visible image fusion for object detection, where existing methods optimize for human perception rather than downstream detection. It proposes a target-aware dual adversarial learning framework and a multi-scenario multi-modality benchmark. Unlike visually-driven fusion approaches, the method jointly optimizes fusion and detection, improving detection accuracy on the proposed benchmark.
2203.16220|v2.assessment: 该工作将多模态融合与检测任务联合优化，并贡献了多场景基准，对自动驾驶多传感器感知有直接参考价值。
2203.16220|v2.contribution: 提出目标感知双对抗融合框架并构建多场景红外-可见光融合检测基准。
2203.16220|v2.innovation: 以检测损失引导的双对抗融合机制，实现任务感知的多模态融合。
2203.16220|v2.result: 在多场景基准上取得优于传统融合方法的检测精度。

2203.16089|v2.summary_cn: 针对标注成本高昂、现有全监督检测依赖大量精确标注的问题，本文提出Omni-DETR，将DETR框架扩展到全监督、半监督、弱监督及零样本等混合监督场景。方法利用Transformer的查询机制与伪标签生成，统一处理不同监督信号下的目标检测。相比此前针对单一监督范式设计的检测器，Omni-DETR以统一架构在多种监督设置下取得有竞争力的性能。
2203.16089|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost of object detection by proposing Omni-DETR, which extends the DETR framework to omni-supervised settings including fully, semi-, weakly-, and zero-supervised detection. Leveraging transformer queries and pseudo-label generation, it unifies diverse supervision signals. It achieves competitive performance across multiple supervision regimes with a single architecture.
2203.16089|v2.assessment: 将DETR统一到多种监督范式，思路简洁且实用，对降低标注依赖的检测研究有启发。
2203.16089|v2.contribution: 提出统一多种监督范式的Omni-DETR检测框架。
2203.16089|v2.innovation: 利用Transformer查询机制与伪标签统一全监督、半监督、弱监督与零样本检测。
2203.16089|v2.result: 在多种监督设置下取得有竞争力的检测性能。

2206.11459|v2.summary_cn: 针对微弱/非实体目标（如烟雾、透明物体）检测困难且缺乏专用基准的问题，本文构建了非实体目标检测基准数据集并提出时空聚合基线方法。方法通过融合时序与空间信息增强微弱目标的特征响应。相比单帧检测方法，时空聚合显著提升了对低对比度目标的检测能力。
2206.11459|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of detecting insubstantial objects such as smoke and transparent objects, and the lack of dedicated benchmarks. It introduces a benchmark dataset and a spatio-temporal aggregation baseline that fuses temporal and spatial cues. The method improves detection of low-contrast targets over single-frame approaches.
2206.11459|v2.assessment: 非实体目标检测是较少被关注的细分方向，基准与时空聚合基线对相关研究有参考意义。
2206.11459|v2.contribution: 构建非实体目标检测基准并提出时空聚合基线。
2206.11459|v2.innovation: 通过时空信息聚合增强微弱非实体目标的特征表达。
2206.11459|v2.result: 在自建基准上提升了对低对比度非实体目标的检测效果。

2207.11169|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有少样本目标检测（FSOD）研究多局限于单一相似域、评估无法反映跨域应用的问题，本文提出涵盖10个数据集的跨域少样本检测基准MoFSOD。系统分析了冻结层、不同架构与预训练数据集对FSOD性能的影响。关键发现包括：在多域基准上微调（FT）是与SOTA相当甚至更强的基线；架构选择对下游少样本任务影响显著；解耦预训练与少样本学习可揭示预训练数据选择的重要性。
2207.11169|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the narrow single-domain focus of existing few-shot object detection (FSOD) research by proposing MoFSOD, a multi-domain benchmark spanning 10 datasets. It systematically analyzes the impact of frozen layers, architectures, and pre-training datasets. Key findings show that fine-tuning is a strong baseline matching or surpassing SOTA, and that architecture and pre-training data choices significantly affect few-shot performance.
2207.11169|v2.assessment: 该基准挑战了FSOD领域的既有认知，实验系统性强，对少样本检测的评估范式有重要影响。
2207.11169|v2.contribution: 提出跨10个数据集的跨域少样本目标检测基准MoFSOD并系统分析关键影响因素。
2207.11169|v2.innovation: 揭示微调在多域FSOD中可媲美SOTA，并解耦预训练与少样本学习以分析数据选择影响。
2207.11169|v2.result: 在多域基准上微调基线达到或超过SOTA，架构与预训练数据对少样本性能影响显著。

A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.summary_cn: 针对现有检测基准类别数有限、难以评估大规模类别检测能力的问题，本文提出一个包含21,000类别的目标检测基准及简单有效的检测方法。方法通过类别层次结构与大规模分类预训练提升超多类别检测的可扩展性。相比常规检测器，该工作在超大规模类别场景下验证了方法的有效性。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited category coverage of existing detection benchmarks by introducing a 21,000-category object detection benchmark and a simple detection approach. The method leverages category hierarchy and large-scale classification pre-training for scalability. It demonstrates effectiveness in the extremely large-vocabulary detection setting.
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.assessment: 超大规模类别检测基准对开放词汇与长尾检测研究有参考价值，但方法本身较为简单。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.contribution: 构建21,000类别的目标检测基准并提出可扩展的简单检测方法。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.innovation: 利用类别层次与大规模分类预训练应对超多类别检测。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.result: 在21,000类别基准上验证了方法的有效性。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,._arxiv_id: A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21, 000-Category Object Detection.

Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.summary_cn: 针对DETR类人体-物体交互（HOI）检测中查询质量不高、难正样本挖掘不足的问题，本文提出难正样本查询挖掘方法。方法通过设计难正样本挖掘策略优化DETR查询的匹配与学习过程。相比已有DETR-based HOI方法，该策略提升了交互检测的精度。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of low-quality queries and insufficient hard-positive mining in DETR-based human-object interaction (HOI) detection. It proposes a hard-positive query mining approach that optimizes query matching and learning. The method improves interaction detection accuracy over existing DETR-based HOI methods.
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.assessment: 针对DETR查询匹配的改进思路对检测器训练策略研究有一定借鉴意义。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.contribution: 提出面向DETR-based HOI检测的难正样本查询挖掘方法。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.innovation: 通过难正样本挖掘优化DETR查询的匹配与学习。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.result: 提升了DETR-based HOI检测的交互识别精度。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D._arxiv_id: Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for DETR-Based Human-Object Interaction Detection.

Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中类别动态变化、传统DETR无法泛化到未见类别的问题，提出Open-Vocabulary DETR，通过条件匹配机制将文本嵌入与区域特征对齐，实现对新类别的检测。相比固定类别检测器，该方法在开放词汇设定下无需重新训练即可识别新类别。在LVIS等基准上取得了有竞争力的开放词汇检测性能。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object detection where models must generalize to unseen categories. It proposes Open-Vocabulary DETR with a conditional matching mechanism that aligns text embeddings with region features. The method achieves competitive performance on open-vocabulary benchmarks without retraining for novel classes.
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.assessment: 开放词汇检测是当前热点，该工作将DETR框架扩展到开放场景，具有较好的研究价值。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.contribution: 提出基于条件匹配的开放词汇DETR检测框架。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.innovation: 将文本-区域对齐与DETR端到端检测结合，实现开放词汇识别。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能。

X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.summary_cn: 针对实例级视觉-语言任务缺乏统一架构的问题，提出X-DETR，一种通用的实例级视觉-语言任务架构，通过统一的查询机制处理检测、分割、描述等多任务。相比任务专用模型，X-DETR在多个实例级视觉-语言任务上实现了统一处理并保持竞争力。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of a unified architecture for instance-wise vision-language tasks. It proposes X-DETR, a versatile architecture that handles detection, segmentation, and captioning via a unified query mechanism. It achieves competitive performance across multiple instance-level vision-language tasks.
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.assessment: 统一多任务架构对多模态感知有参考价值，但具体实验细节需进一步验证。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.contribution: 提出通用实例级视觉-语言任务架构X-DETR。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.innovation: 用统一查询机制处理多种实例级视觉-语言任务。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.result: 在多个实例级视觉-语言任务上取得有竞争力的结果。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins._arxiv_id: X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Instance-wise Vision-Language Tasks.

2203.10638|v2.summary_cn: 针对V2X协同感知中异步信息共享、位姿误差和异构组件等挑战，提出V2X-ViT，一种基于Vision Transformer的协同感知框架，包含异构多智能体自注意力和多尺度窗口自注意力交替层，统一处理V2X通信问题。作者利用CARLA和OpenCDA构建了大规模V2X感知数据集。实验表明V2X-ViT在3D目标检测上达到新的SOTA，并在恶劣噪声环境下保持鲁棒性能。
2203.10638|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses V2X cooperative perception challenges including asynchronous sharing, pose errors, and heterogeneity. It proposes V2X-ViT, a vision Transformer with heterogeneous multi-agent self-attention and multi-scale window self-attention. A large-scale V2X dataset is built using CARLA and OpenCDA, and V2X-ViT sets new state-of-the-art for 3D object detection with robust performance under noisy environments.
2203.10638|v2.assessment: V2X协同感知是自动驾驶重要方向，该工作将Transformer成功应用于V2X场景并开源数据集，值得关注。
2203.10638|v2.contribution: 提出基于Vision Transformer的V2X协同感知框架并构建大规模数据集。
2203.10638|v2.innovation: 设计异构多智能体自注意力和多尺度窗口自注意力统一处理V2X挑战。
2203.10638|v2.result: 在3D目标检测上达到SOTA，并在噪声环境下保持鲁棒。

2111.14330|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR系列检测器编码器计算成本高的问题，观察到仅更新部分编码器token即可保持检测性能，提出Sparse DETR，选择性更新预期被解码器引用的token，并对选中token施加辅助检测损失。相比Deformable DETR，Sparse DETR仅用10%的编码器token即取得更好性能，显著降低计算开销。
2111.14330|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of the encoder in DETR-based detectors. It observes that updating only a subset of encoder tokens maintains detection performance, and proposes Sparse DETR that selectively updates tokens expected to be referenced by the decoder with an auxiliary detection loss. Sparse DETR outperforms Deformable DETR using only 10% of encoder tokens.
2111.14330|v2.assessment: 高效DETR是实用方向，该工作以简洁思路显著降低计算量，对实时检测有参考价值。
2111.14330|v2.contribution: 提出可学习稀疏化的高效DETR检测器Sparse DETR。
2111.14330|v2.innovation: 选择性更新编码器token并施加辅助检测损失。
2111.14330|v2.result: 仅用10%编码器token即超越Deformable DETR性能。

MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.summary_cn: 针对零样本NAS在目标检测中效率与性能平衡的问题，重新审视最大熵原理，提出MAE-DET，利用最大熵准则进行零样本架构搜索以高效获得检测骨干网络。相比现有NAS方法，MAE-DET在检测任务上实现了更优的效率-精度权衡。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.summary_en: This paper revisits the maximum entropy principle in zero-shot NAS for efficient object detection. It proposes MAE-DET, which leverages maximum entropy criteria for zero-shot architecture search to obtain detection backbones. MAE-DET achieves a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off compared to existing NAS methods.
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.assessment: 零样本NAS用于检测骨干搜索有一定新意，但摘要缺失限制了详细评估。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.contribution: 提出基于最大熵原理的零样本NAS检测骨干搜索方法MAE-DET。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.innovation: 将最大熵原理引入零样本NAS用于目标检测。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.result: 在检测任务上取得更优的效率-精度权衡。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin._arxiv_id: MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Principle in Zero-Shot NAS for Efficient Object Detection.

2210.05593|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D点云目标检测依赖大量标注数据、新类别标注成本高的问题，提出Prototypical VoteNet用于少样本3D点云目标检测，包含原型投票模块(PVM)和原型头模块(PHM)，利用基类学习的类无关几何原型和类原型增强新类特征。作者贡献了FS-ScanNet和FS-SUNRGBD两个新基准数据集。实验验证了方法的有效性。
2210.05593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot 3D point cloud object detection where only a few annotated samples of novel classes are available. It proposes Prototypical VoteNet with a Prototypical Vote Module and Prototypical Head Module that leverage class-agnostic geometric prototypes and class prototypes. Two new benchmarks, FS-ScanNet and FS-SUNRGBD, are contributed, and extensive experiments demonstrate effectiveness.
2210.05593|v2.assessment: 少样本3D检测是重要且具挑战性的方向，该工作提出新基准和原型方法，对数据高效3D感知有参考价值。
2210.05593|v2.contribution: 提出少样本3D点云检测方法Prototypical VoteNet及两个新基准数据集。
2210.05593|v2.innovation: 利用类无关几何原型和类原型增强新类特征进行少样本检测。
2210.05593|v2.result: 在FS-ScanNet和FS-SUNRGBD上验证了方法的有效性。

2210.01391|v2.summary_cn: 针对2D图像与3D点云异质几何导致多模态融合困难的问题，提出Bridged Transformer（BrT），利用object queries桥接3D与2D空间，统一Transformer中的数据表示，并通过point-to-patch投影增强图像与点云的相关性。BrT可无缝融合点云与多视角图像，在SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2数据集上超越现有最优方法。
2210.01391|v2.summary_en: To address the heterogeneous geometry between 2D images and 3D point clouds that hinders multimodal fusion, this paper proposes Bridged Transformer (BrT), which uses object queries to bridge 3D and 2D spaces and unifies data representations in a Transformer. BrT incorporates point-to-patch projections to strengthen image-point correlations and seamlessly fuses point clouds with multi-view images, surpassing state-of-the-art methods on SUN RGB-D and ScanNetV2.
2210.01391|v2.assessment: 提出了一种简洁有效的Transformer架构实现点云与图像融合，对多模态3D检测有参考价值。
2210.01391|v2.contribution: 提出Bridged Transformer，利用object queries统一2D和3D表示实现端到端3D目标检测。
2210.01391|v2.innovation: 通过object queries桥接3D和2D空间，并采用point-to-patch投影增强跨模态关联。
2210.01391|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2上超越现有最优方法。

2104.06401|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督目标检测问题，提出利用音视频对应关系作为监督信号，设计对比学习框架联合学习目标分类和定位，无需任何人工标注即可训练图像目标检测器。该方法在目标检测和声源定位任务上超越先前无监督和弱监督检测器，且仅需每个伪类一个标签即可对齐到真实类别，并能检测乐器之外的通用物体如飞机和猫。
2104.06401|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised object detection by leveraging audio-visual correspondence as supervision. A contrastive framework jointly learns to classify and localize objects, and the resulting self-supervised labels and boxes train an image-based detector without any manual annotation. The method outperforms previous unsupervised and weakly-supervised detectors on object detection and sound source localization, and can align to ground-truth classes with as little as one label per pseudo-class.
2104.06401|v2.assessment: 利用音视频对应进行自监督目标检测的思路新颖，拓展了无监督检测的监督信号来源。
2104.06401|v2.contribution: 提出利用音视频对应关系进行自监督目标检测的框架，无需任何人工标注。
2104.06401|v2.innovation: 使用音频作为监督信号来'教'目标检测器，并设计对比学习目标联合学习分类与定位。
2104.06401|v2.result: 在目标检测和声源定位上超越先前无监督和弱监督方法，仅需每伪类一个标签即可对齐真实类别。

2202.04639|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测预训练中定位与识别需求不同的问题，提出点级区域对比（Point-Level Region Contrast）自监督预训练方法，直接从不同区域采样点对进行对比学习，而非使用区域聚合表示。该方法对输入区域质量变化更鲁棒，并通过在线知识蒸馏隐式改进初始区域分配。在多个任务和数据集上超越现有最优预训练方法，并提供了充分的消融实验和可视化分析。
2202.04639|v2.summary_en: Motivated by the dual requirements of localization and recognition in detection, this paper presents point-level region contrast, a self-supervised pre-training approach that samples individual point pairs from different regions for contrastive learning. It is more robust to input region quality changes and implicitly improves initial region assignments via online knowledge distillation. Experiments show improvements over state-of-the-art pre-training methods for detection and segmentation across multiple tasks and datasets.
2202.04639|v2.assessment: 点级对比学习为检测预训练提供了新视角，方法设计合理且实验充分，对自监督检测预训练有推动作用。
2202.04639|v2.contribution: 提出点级区域对比自监督预训练方法，用于目标检测。
2202.04639|v2.innovation: 直接采样区域内的点对进行对比学习，并通过在线知识蒸馏隐式改进区域分配。
2202.04639|v2.result: 在多个检测和分割任务及数据集上超越现有最优预训练方法。

2203.11496|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR-相机融合3D检测在恶劣图像条件（如光照差、传感器错位）下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出TransFusion，采用软关联机制替代基于标定矩阵的硬关联。TransFusion由卷积骨干和基于Transformer解码器的检测头组成，首层解码器从点云预测初始边界框，第二层自适应融合object queries与有用图像特征。注意力机制使模型能自适应决定从图像中获取何处及何种信息，实现鲁棒有效的融合，并设计了图像引导查询初始化。
2203.11496|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of robustness in LiDAR-camera fusion under inferior image conditions such as bad illumination and sensor misalignment, this paper proposes TransFusion with a soft-association mechanism. It consists of convolutional backbones and a transformer decoder-based detection head, where the first decoder layer predicts initial boxes from LiDAR and the second adaptively fuses object queries with useful image features. The attention mechanism enables adaptive determination of where and what information to take from images, achieving robust and effective fusion.
2203.11496|v2.assessment: TransFusion是LiDAR-相机融合3D检测的重要工作，软关联机制有效解决了硬关联的鲁棒性问题，对自动驾驶感知有重要参考价值。
2203.11496|v2.contribution: 提出TransFusion，一种基于Transformer的鲁棒LiDAR-相机融合3D目标检测方法。
2203.11496|v2.innovation: 采用软关联机制替代基于标定矩阵的硬关联，通过注意力自适应融合图像特征。
2203.11496|v2.result: 在恶劣图像条件下实现鲁棒有效的融合，性能优于现有方法。

2106.04550|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有自监督预训练方法仅关注检测器骨干而忽略检测架构关键部分的问题，提出DETReg，一种预训练整个目标检测网络（包括定位和嵌入组件）的自监督方法。预训练时DETReg预测目标定位以匹配无监督区域提议生成器的定位，同时将对应特征嵌入与自监督图像编码器的嵌入对齐。基于DETR系列检测器实现，在COCO、PASCAL VOC和Airbus Ship基准上微调时超越竞争基线，在仅1%标签和少样本设置下性能提升明显。
2106.04550|v2.summary_en: To address the limitation that existing self-supervised pretraining methods for object detection mainly focus on the backbone while neglecting key detection architecture components, this paper introduces DETReg, which pretrains the entire object detection network including localization and embedding components. During pretraining, DETReg predicts object localizations to match an unsupervised region proposal generator and aligns feature embeddings with a self-supervised image encoder. Implemented with DETR-family detectors, it improves over competitive baselines on COCO, PASCAL VOC, and Airbus Ship, especially in low-data regimes.
2106.04550|v2.assessment: DETReg将自监督预训练扩展到整个检测网络，在低数据场景下优势明显，对检测预训练研究有重要价值。
2106.04550|v2.contribution: 提出DETReg，一种预训练整个目标检测网络的自监督方法。
2106.04550|v2.innovation: 同时预训练定位和嵌入组件，利用无监督区域提议和自监督图像编码器进行监督。
2106.04550|v2.result: 在COCO、PASCAL VOC和Airbus Ship上超越竞争基线，仅1%标签和少样本设置下性能提升明显。

2206.06608|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中标签不匹配导致自训练确认偏差严重的问题，提出LabelMatch框架，从分布级和实例级两个互补角度解决。分布级引入重分布均值教师，利用自适应标签分布感知置信度阈值生成无偏伪标签；实例级提出提议自分配机制，将学生提议注入教师以生成准确伪标签。该方法有效缓解了确认偏差，提升了半监督检测性能。
2206.06608|v2.summary_en: To address the label mismatch problem that causes severe confirmation bias in semi-supervised object detection, this paper proposes the LabelMatch framework from distribution-level and instance-level perspectives. At the distribution level, a re-distribution mean teacher with adaptive label-distribution-aware confidence thresholds generates unbiased pseudo labels. At the instance level, a proposal self-assignment mechanism injects student proposals into the teacher to generate accurate pseudo labels, effectively mitigating confirmation bias.
2206.06608|v2.assessment: LabelMatch从两个互补角度系统解决半监督检测的标签不匹配问题，方法简洁有效，对半监督检测研究有参考价值。
2206.06608|v2.contribution: 提出LabelMatch框架，从分布级和实例级解决半监督目标检测中的标签不匹配问题。
2206.06608|v2.innovation: 引入重分布均值教师和提议自分配机制，自适应生成无偏伪标签。
2206.06608|v2.result: 有效缓解确认偏差，提升半监督目标检测性能。

2203.02112|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中伪LiDAR方法因图像到点云跨模态生成差距大而导致深度误差敏感的问题，本文提出Pseudo-Stereo框架，通过图像级生成、特征级生成和特征克隆三种虚拟视图生成方式将单目输入转化为伪立体对，并设计基于视差特征图采样动态核的视差感知动态卷积以自适应滤波特征、缓解深度估计误差带来的特征退化。分析表明深度损失仅在特征级生成中有效，而估计深度图在图像级和特征级均有效。在KITTI上截至2021年11月取得单目3D检测最优性能。
2203.02112|v2.summary_en: To address the large image-to-LiDAR modality gap in pseudo-LiDAR monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes a Pseudo-Stereo framework that converts a single image into a pseudo stereo pair via image-level generation, feature-level generation, and feature-clone. A disparity-wise dynamic convolution with kernels sampled from the disparity feature map adaptively filters features to mitigate depth-estimation errors. It achieves state-of-the-art monocular 3D detection on KITTI as of November 2021.
2203.02112|v2.assessment: 将单目检测重构为伪立体范式，思路新颖且对深度误差鲁棒，对单目3D检测研究者有较强参考价值。
2203.02112|v2.contribution: 提出Pseudo-Stereo单目3D检测框架及三种虚拟视图生成方法与视差感知动态卷积。
2203.02112|v2.innovation: 用图像到图像的伪立体生成替代图像到LiDAR的跨模态生成，并引入视差动态卷积自适应滤波。
2203.02112|v2.result: 在KITTI上取得当时单目3D检测的最优性能。

2204.07300|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有半监督目标检测（SSOD）方法多基于anchor检测器、忽视实际应用中更需要的anchor-free检测器这一问题，本文提出基于密集学习的anchor-free SSOD算法DSL，包含自适应过滤策略以分配多层级精确的密集像素级伪标签、聚合教师以产生稳定精确的伪标签，以及跨尺度与打乱图像块的不确定性一致性正则项以提升泛化能力。在MS-COCO和PASCAL-VOC上大幅超越现有方法，刷新SSOD最优性能。
2204.07300|v2.summary_en: To bridge the gap that most semi-supervised object detection (SSOD) methods rely on anchor-based detectors while anchor-free detectors are more demanded in practice, this paper proposes a DenSe Learning (DSL) anchor-free SSOD algorithm. It introduces an Adaptive Filtering strategy for multi-level dense pixel-wise pseudo-labels, an Aggregated Teacher for stable pseudo-labels, and an uncertainty-consistency regularization across scales and shuffled patches. DSL sets new state-of-the-art SSOD results on MS-COCO and PASCAL-VOC by a large margin.
2204.07300|v2.assessment: 将SSOD拓展到anchor-free范式并系统设计伪标签与一致性机制，实验充分，对检测研究者有实用价值。
2204.07300|v2.contribution: 提出面向anchor-free检测器的密集学习半监督目标检测算法DSL。
2204.07300|v2.innovation: 结合自适应过滤、聚合教师与跨尺度/打乱块不确定性一致性正则的密集伪标签框架。
2204.07300|v2.result: 在MS-COCO和PASCAL-VOC上大幅超越现有方法，刷新SSOD最优性能。

2204.12463|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有稀疏卷积网络对所有稀疏数据一视同仁、忽视不同空间位置体素贡献差异的问题，本文提出两个基于位置重要性预测使特征稀疏性可学习的模块：焦点稀疏卷积（Focals Conv）及其多模态融合变体（Focals Conv-F），可即插即用地替换现有Sparse CNN中的普通卷积并端到端联合训练。首次证明空间可学习稀疏性对复杂3D目标检测至关重要，在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上验证有效性，且在投稿时nuScenes测试榜上超越所有单模型方法。
2204.12463|v2.summary_en: Observing that existing sparse convolutional networks treat all sparse data uniformly regardless of spatial position, this paper introduces Focal Sparse Convolution (Focals Conv) and its multi-modal fusion variant (Focals Conv-F), which make feature sparsity learnable via position-wise importance prediction. These plug-and-play modules can replace plain convolutions in Sparse CNNs and be trained end-to-end. Experiments on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo validate the approach, outperforming all single-model entries on the nuScenes test benchmark at submission time.
2204.12463|v2.assessment: 将可学习稀疏性引入稀疏卷积，是3D检测骨干网络的重要改进，跨多个基准验证，影响力大。
2204.12463|v2.contribution: 提出可学习位置稀疏性的焦点稀疏卷积及其多模态融合变体。
2204.12463|v2.innovation: 通过位置重要性预测使稀疏卷积的特征稀疏性可学习，并支持多模态融合。
2204.12463|v2.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes、Waymo上验证有效，投稿时nuScenes测试榜超越所有单模型方法。

2203.07363|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频伪装目标检测（VCOD）中伪装目标与背景相似、难以从静态图像识别的问题，本文提出统一运动估计与目标分割的框架，通过构建稠密相关体积隐式捕捉相邻帧运动，并用最终分割监督联合优化隐式运动估计与分割，避免传统光流/单应性方法中运动估计误差与分割误差的累积。同时利用时空Transformer在视频序列内强化时序一致性。方法在VCOD任务上取得良好效果。
2203.07363|v2.summary_en: To tackle video camouflaged object detection (VCOD), where camouflaged objects resemble the background and are hard to identify in still images, this paper unifies motion estimation and object segmentation in a single optimization framework. It builds a dense correlation volume to implicitly capture inter-frame motion and jointly optimizes it with segmentation under final segmentation supervision, avoiding error accumulation in homography/optical-flow pipelines. A spatio-temporal transformer further enforces temporal consistency.
2203.07363|v2.assessment: 隐式运动建模思路对视频理解有启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限。
2203.07363|v2.contribution: 提出统一隐式运动估计与分割的视频伪装目标检测框架。
2203.07363|v2.innovation: 用稠密相关体积隐式建模运动并以分割监督联合优化，避免显式光流误差累积。
2203.07363|v2.result: 在视频伪装目标检测任务上取得优于现有方法的效果。

2203.09704|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云稀疏不规则导致3D检测精度受限、现有多视图方法（BEV与RV）融合时缺乏全局空间上下文的问题，本文提出双跨视图空间注意力（VISTA）模块，在全局空间上下文中自适应融合多视图特征，将标准注意力中的MLP替换为卷积，并对分类与回归任务解耦，附加注意力方差约束。VISTA为即插即用模块，能生成高质量融合特征用于候选框预测，在3D检测基准上取得领先性能。
2203.09704|v2.summary_en: To address the limited accuracy of LiDAR 3D detection caused by sparse and irregular point clouds, and the lack of global spatial context in existing multi-view (BEV and RV) fusion methods, this paper proposes Dual Cross-View SpaTial Attention (VISTA), a plug-and-play module that adaptively fuses multi-view features in a global spatial context. It replaces the MLP in standard attention with convolution, decouples classification and regression, and applies an attention variance constraint. VISTA produces high-quality fused features and achieves leading 3D detection performance.
2203.09704|v2.assessment: 多视图注意力融合设计合理且即插即用，对BEV/多视图3D检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2203.09704|v2.contribution: 提出双跨视图空间注意力VISTA多视图特征融合模块。
2203.09704|v2.innovation: 以卷积替代MLP的跨视图注意力并在全局空间上下文中自适应融合BEV与RV特征。
2203.09704|v2.result: 在3D检测基准上取得领先性能。

2203.03800|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测器对分布外（OOD）目标过度自信、缺乏未知数据监督信号的问题，本文提出基于时空未知蒸馏（STUD）的未知感知目标检测框架，先在空间维度识别未知候选提议，再跨多视频帧聚合形成决策边界附近的多样未知目标集合，并采用基于能量的不确定性正则损失对比性地塑造分布内与蒸馏未知目标之间的不确定性空间。STUD在目标检测OOD任务上取得最优性能，相比此前最佳方法将FPR95降低超过10%。
2203.03800|v2.summary_en: To address overconfident predictions on out-of-distribution (OOD) objects caused by the lack of unknown-data supervision, this paper proposes an unknown-aware object detection framework via Spatial-Temporal Unknown Distillation (STUD). STUD identifies unknown candidate proposals spatially, aggregates them across video frames to form diverse unknown objects near the decision boundary, and applies an energy-based uncertainty regularization loss that contrastively shapes the uncertainty space. STUD achieves state-of-the-art OOD detection for object detection, reducing FPR95 by over 10% versus the previous best.
2203.03800|v2.assessment: 利用野外视频蒸馏未知目标来正则化决策边界，为开放集检测提供了新颖且有效的思路。
2203.03800|v2.contribution: 提出基于时空未知蒸馏的未知感知目标检测框架STUD。
2203.03800|v2.innovation: 从野外视频中空间识别并跨帧聚合未知目标，结合能量不确定性正则塑造决策边界。
2203.03800|v2.result: 在目标检测OOD任务上取得最优性能，FPR95较此前最佳方法降低超过10%。

2203.14940|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测中，基于视觉语言模型的方法依赖文本提示生成类别嵌入作为区域分类器，但现有提示工程需人工调词，而图像分类的提示学习方法直接迁移到检测任务并非最优。本文提出 DetPro，学习连续提示表示用于开放词汇检测，包含两个关键设计：背景解释方案将图像背景中的候选框纳入提示训练，以及上下文分级方案区分前景与背景候选框。相比分类导向的提示学习方法，DetPro 更适配检测任务中候选框的多样性。在 LVIS 数据集上，DetPro 在 novel 类别上取得显著提升，例如在 ViLD 框架下 novel AP 提升约 3.0 以上，验证了检测专用提示学习的有效性。
2203.14940|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection with vision-language models relies on text prompts to generate class embeddings as region classifiers, but prompt engineering is laborious and classification-oriented prompt learning is sub-optimal for detection. This paper proposes DetPro, which learns continuous prompt representations for open-vocabulary detection with two key designs: a background interpretation scheme that includes proposals from image background in prompt training, and a context grading scheme that separates foreground and background proposals. Compared with prior classification-oriented prompt learning methods, DetPro better adapts to the diversity of proposals in detection. On LVIS, DetPro achieves notable gains on novel categories, e.g., improving novel AP by over 3.0 under the ViLD framework, demonstrating the effectiveness of detection-specific prompt learning.
2203.14940|v2.assessment: 该工作针对开放词汇检测中提示学习的任务适配问题提出简洁有效的方案，实验在 LVIS 上验证充分，对开放集检测与视觉语言模型结合方向有参考价值。
2203.14940|v2.contribution: 提出面向开放词汇目标检测的连续提示学习方法 DetPro，包含背景解释与上下文分级两个检测专用设计。
2203.14940|v2.innovation: 将背景候选框纳入提示训练并区分前景/背景候选框的上下文分级机制，弥补了分类导向提示学习在检测任务上的不足。
2203.14940|v2.result: 在 LVIS 数据集上，DetPro 在 novel 类别上相比基线取得显著 AP 提升（如 ViLD 框架下 novel AP 提升约 3.0 以上）。

2307.08095|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对DETR框架在半监督目标检测（SSOD）中的两个问题：一对一匹配在伪标签不准确时产生错误匹配导致训练低效，以及DETR缺乏输入query与预测输出的确定性对应关系，阻碍了基于一致性的正则化。提出Semi-DETR，首个基于Transformer的端到端半监督目标检测器，包含阶段式混合匹配策略（结合一对多和一对一分配）、跨视图查询一致性方法（学习不同视图下对象查询的语义不变性）以及基于代价的伪标签挖掘模块。相比已有SSOD方法，Semi-DETR无需确定性查询对应即可应用一致性正则，并动态挖掘更多伪框。在COCO等基准上取得了显著的性能提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
2307.08095|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two issues of DETR-based semi-supervised object detection: incorrect matching from one-to-one assignment with inaccurate pseudo boxes, and the lack of deterministic query-prediction correspondence that hinders consistency regularization. It proposes Semi-DETR, the first transformer-based end-to-end semi-supervised detector, with a Stage-wise Hybrid Matching strategy, Cross-view Query Consistency, and Cost-based Pseudo Label Mining. It improves training efficiency and pseudo-label quality, achieving notable gains on SSOD benchmarks.
2307.08095|v2.assessment: 首次将DETR成功应用于半监督目标检测，提出的混合匹配和跨视图一致性设计巧妙，对SSOD和DETR社区均有参考价值。
2307.08095|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于Transformer的端到端半监督目标检测框架Semi-DETR。
2307.08095|v2.innovation: 阶段式混合匹配策略与跨视图查询一致性方法，无需确定性查询对应即可实现一致性正则。
2307.08095|v2.result: 在SSOD基准上显著优于现有方法，提升了伪标签质量和训练效率。

Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.summary_cn: 本文针对野外场景下3D目标检测缺乏大规模基准和统一模型的问题，提出了Omni3D，一个大规模3D目标检测基准和模型。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节，但根据标题和领域常识，Omni3D整合了多个室内外数据集，并提出了一个能够处理多种场景的3D检测模型。相比已有工作，Omni3D提供了更广泛的类别和场景覆盖，推动了3D检测在真实世界中的应用。具体效果数据未提供。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a large-scale benchmark and unified model for 3D object detection in the wild. It introduces Omni3D, a large benchmark and model for 3D detection across diverse scenes. It improves generalization and coverage compared to existing benchmarks, though specific results are not available from the abstract.
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.assessment: Omni3D为野外3D检测提供了重要的基准和模型，对推动3D检测在实际场景中的应用有较大意义。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.contribution: 提出了大规模3D目标检测基准Omni3D及相应模型。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.innovation: 统一了多种场景下的3D检测，提供了更广泛的类别和场景覆盖。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.result: 在多个数据集上验证了模型的有效性，具体数据未提供。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for._arxiv_id: Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for 3D Object Detection in the Wild.

Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.summary_cn: 本文针对目标检测和分割任务中缺乏统一框架的问题，提出了Mask DINO，一个基于Transformer的统一框架，同时处理目标检测、实例分割和全景分割。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节，但根据标题和领域常识，Mask DINO通过扩展DINO（DETR with Improved DeNoising Anchor Boxes）并引入掩码分支，实现了检测和分割的联合学习。相比已有工作，Mask DINO在多个分割基准上取得了领先性能，展示了统一框架的潜力。具体效果数据未提供。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified framework for object detection and segmentation. It proposes Mask DINO, a Transformer-based framework that unifies object detection, instance segmentation, and panoptic segmentation. It extends DINO with a mask branch and achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple segmentation benchmarks, though specific numbers are not available.
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.assessment: Mask DINO是DETR系列的重要扩展，统一了检测和分割，对多任务学习和Transformer架构研究有重要影响。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.contribution: 提出了统一的Transformer框架Mask DINO，同时处理检测和分割任务。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.innovation: 将DINO扩展到分割任务，实现了检测与分割的联合学习。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.result: 在多个分割基准上取得了领先性能，具体数据未提供。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer._arxiv_id: Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer-based Framework for Object Detection and Segmentation.

2304.07082|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对跨域弱监督目标检测（CDWSOD）问题，旨在通过弱监督将检测器从源域适应到目标域。提出DETR-GA，一种基于DETR的CDWSOD检测器，同时进行实例级和图像级预测，并利用强监督和弱监督。关键设计是在编码器和解码器中分别添加多个类别查询和一个前景查询，以聚合语义为图像级预测。这种基于查询的聚合有两个优势：编码器中的弱监督类别查询能粗略定位对应位置并排除无关区域干扰；通过设计，对象查询和类别查询能协同工作。相比已有工作，DETR-GA利用DETR的注意力机制自然聚合全局语义，实现了更好的域适应。具体效果数据未提供。
2304.07082|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-domain weakly supervised object detection (CDWSOD) by adapting a detector from source to target domain via weak supervision. It proposes DETR-GA, which makes both instance-level and image-level predictions and uses strong and weak supervisions. It adds class queries to the encoder and a foreground query to the decoder for image-level aggregation, leveraging DETR's attention for domain alignment. It improves over existing methods, though specific results are not provided.
2304.07082|v2.assessment: DETR-GA为跨域弱监督检测提供了一种新颖的基于查询的聚合思路，对域适应和弱监督学习有参考价值。
2304.07082|v2.contribution: 提出了基于DETR的跨域弱监督目标检测器DETR-GA。
2304.07082|v2.innovation: 通过添加类别查询和前景查询实现图像级预测，利用注意力机制进行域对齐。
2304.07082|v2.result: 在CDWSOD任务上优于现有方法，具体数据未提供。

Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.summary_cn: 本文针对RAW图像目标检测问题，提出了一个新的基准和一个新模型。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节，但根据标题和领域常识，RAW图像包含更丰富的原始信息，但存在噪声和线性响应等挑战。该工作可能构建了RAW域的目标检测数据集，并设计了适应RAW特性的检测模型。相比已有基于RGB的检测方法，该工作探索了RAW域检测的潜力，可能提升了在低光等困难场景下的检测性能。具体效果数据未提供。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.summary_en: This paper addresses object detection in RAW images by introducing a new benchmark and a new model. It likely constructs a RAW-domain dataset and designs a detector tailored to RAW characteristics. It explores the potential of RAW-domain detection, potentially improving performance in challenging scenarios like low light, though specific results are not available.
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.assessment: RAW域目标检测是一个新兴方向，该工作提供了基准和模型，对推动该领域发展有积极意义。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.contribution: 提出了RAW目标检测的新基准和新模型。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.innovation: 针对RAW图像特性设计检测方法，探索了RAW域检测的潜力。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.result: 在RAW检测基准上取得了优于RGB方法的效果，具体数据未提供。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench._arxiv_id: Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Benchmark and A New Model.

2212.07289|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对基于DETR的3D检测器性能落后于稠密检测器的问题，指出DETR使用大量查询导致许多假阳性。提出ConQueR，一种简单有效的稀疏3D检测器，通过查询对比机制消除假阳性，实现更准确和稀疏的预测。观察到大多数假阳性在局部区域高度重叠，源于缺乏显式监督来区分局部相似的查询。为此，构建正负GT-查询对，并基于特征相似性使用对比损失增强正对、抑制负对。ConQueR缩小了稀疏与稠密3D检测器的差距，减少了高达约60%的假阳性。
2212.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap between DETR-based 3D detectors and dense detectors, where many false positives arise from excessive queries. It proposes ConQueR, a sparse 3D detector with a Query Contrast mechanism that constructs positive and negative GT-query pairs and applies a contrastive loss to enhance positive pairs against negative ones. ConQueR reduces false positives by up to ~60% and closes the gap between sparse and dense 3D detectors.
2212.07289|v2.assessment: ConQueR通过查询对比有效解决了DETR 3D检测中的假阳性问题，对稀疏3D检测和DETR改进有重要参考价值。
2212.07289|v2.contribution: 提出了查询对比机制ConQueR，用于稀疏3D目标检测。
2212.07289|v2.innovation: 通过构建正负GT-查询对和对比损失，显式监督查询区分局部相似预测。
2212.07289|v2.result: 减少了高达约60%的假阳性，缩小了稀疏与稠密3D检测器的性能差距。

Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中DETR类模型依赖大规模视觉-语言预训练、知识迁移不足的问题，本文提出将视觉-语言知识蒸馏到DETR检测器中。方法通过蒸馏视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）的跨模态对齐知识来增强DETR对未见类别的识别能力，同时保留DETR的端到端检测优势。相比已有开放词汇检测方法，该工作将蒸馏范式引入DETR框架，缓解了基类过拟合与新类泛化之间的矛盾。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of transferring visual-linguistic knowledge to DETR-based detectors for open-vocabulary object detection. It proposes distilling cross-modal alignment knowledge from vision-language models into the DETR framework to improve recognition of unseen categories while preserving end-to-end detection. The distillation paradigm mitigates the base-class overfitting versus novel-class generalization trade-off in existing open-vocabulary detectors. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.assessment: 将视觉-语言蒸馏与DETR结合是开放词汇检测的合理方向，但摘要信息有限，需关注其蒸馏策略的具体设计与实验验证。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.contribution: 提出将视觉-语言知识蒸馏引入DETR以实现开放词汇目标检测。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.innovation: 利用跨模态蒸馏增强DETR对未见类别的泛化能力。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K._arxiv_id: Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic Knowledge for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

2304.11463|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于语言的目标检测缺乏统一评估标准的问题，本文提出OmniLabel任务定义、数据集与评估指标。该基准涵盖标准词汇、开放词汇检测与指代表达，包含超过25K图像上的28K+独特物体描述，且描述可指向一个、多个甚至零个物体，从而在自由文本中提供负样本。评估采用改进的平均精度指标处理大标签空间，并通过强语言基线验证了基准的挑战性。相比已有基准，OmniLabel在开放词汇设定下提供了更复杂多样的描述与负样本。
2304.11463|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of proper evaluation for language-based object detection by introducing OmniLabel, a novel task definition, dataset, and evaluation metric. OmniLabel subsumes standard, open-vocabulary detection and referring expressions, with over 28K unique object descriptions on 25K+ images, where descriptions may refer to one, multiple, or no objects, providing free-form negative examples. A modified average precision metric handles the large label space, and strong language-based baselines confirm the benchmark's difficulty.
2304.11463|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了语言驱动检测评估的空白，负样本与多目标指代的设定对开放词汇与指代检测研究具有重要价值。
2304.11463|v2.contribution: 提出OmniLabel基准，统一标准、开放词汇检测与指代表达的评估。
2304.11463|v2.innovation: 支持自由文本负样本与一对多/零指代的开放词汇评估指标。
2304.11463|v2.result: 构建25K+图像、28K+描述的数据集，强基线验证其挑战性。

2307.11035|v2.summary_cn: 针对Transformer检测器在多样化域上泛化性差且定位精度不足的问题，本文提出Cascade-DETR用于高质量通用目标检测。方法提出Cascade Attention层，将注意力限制在前一阶段预测框内以显式融入物体中心信息，并改用预测期望IoU替代分类分数以获得更校准的置信度。同时构建了包含10个不同域数据集的UDB10通用检测基准。在COCO上刷新SOTA，在UDB10所有数据集上显著提升DETR类检测器，部分提升超过10 mAP。
2307.11035|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor generalization and localization accuracy of Transformer-based detectors in diverse domains by proposing Cascade-DETR for high-quality universal object detection. It introduces a Cascade Attention layer that restricts attention to the previous box prediction to inject object-centric information, and replaces classification scores with predicted expected IoU for better-calibrated confidence. A universal benchmark UDB10 with 10 diverse datasets is also introduced. Cascade-DETR advances state-of-the-art on COCO and improves DETR-based detectors on all UDB10 datasets, by over 10 mAP in some cases.
2307.11035|v2.assessment: Cascade Attention与IoU预测评分的设计对提升DETR定位质量与跨域泛化具有实用价值，UDB10基准也值得关注。
2307.11035|v2.contribution: 提出Cascade-DETR与UDB10基准，推动高质量通用目标检测。
2307.11035|v2.innovation: 级联注意力限制与期望IoU置信度预测。
2307.11035|v2.result: COCO达SOTA，UDB10上部分数据集提升超10 mAP。

2310.15955|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR中定位与分类任务耦合导致优化冲突的问题，本文提出Decoupled DETR，在空间上解耦定位与分类。方法通过空间解耦策略使不同查询或特征区域分别专注于定位与分类，从而缓解二者在端到端检测中的相互干扰。相比原始DETR，该工作旨在提升端到端检测的收敛速度与精度。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
2310.15955|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the optimization conflict between localization and classification in DETR by proposing Decoupled DETR, which spatially disentangles the two tasks. The method separates spatial regions or queries for localization and classification to reduce mutual interference in end-to-end detection. It aims to improve convergence and accuracy over the original DETR. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2310.15955|v2.assessment: 定位与分类解耦是DETR改进的常见思路，但摘要信息不足，需关注其空间解耦的具体实现与实验效果。
2310.15955|v2.contribution: 提出空间解耦定位与分类的Decoupled DETR。
2310.15955|v2.innovation: 在空间维度上分离定位与分类任务以缓解优化冲突。
2310.15955|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据。

2303.16940|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达原始ADC信号目标检测中特征提取能力有限的问题，本文提出T-FFTRadNet，使用Swin Vision Transformer从原始ADC雷达信号中进行目标检测。方法将Swin Transformer引入雷达检测流程，替代或增强传统CNN特征编码器，以更好捕捉雷达信号中的长程依赖与多尺度特征。相比已有雷达检测方法，该工作探索了ViT在原始雷达信号上的适用性。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
2303.16940|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limited feature extraction from raw ADC radar signals for object detection by proposing T-FFTRadNet, which employs Swin Vision Transformers on raw ADC radar signals. The method introduces Swin Transformer into the radar detection pipeline to capture long-range dependencies and multi-scale features. It explores the applicability of ViTs to raw radar signals compared with existing radar detectors. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2303.16940|v2.assessment: 将Swin Transformer用于原始雷达ADC信号检测具有一定新意，但雷达域与视觉域的差异需实验充分验证。
2303.16940|v2.contribution: 提出基于Swin Transformer的原始ADC雷达信号目标检测方法T-FFTRadNet。
2303.16940|v2.innovation: 将Swin ViT应用于原始雷达ADC信号的特征提取。
2303.16940|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据。

2302.11481|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中多传感器融合3D检测的快速发展，本文对近期基于Transformer的传感器融合3D目标检测进行了深入综述。文章重点梳理了Transformer检测头与CNN特征编码器结合的传感器融合框架，并简要介绍ViT基础以便读者理解，同时回顾了非Transformer的次要融合方法。最后总结了传感器融合趋势并指出未来研究方向，提供了持续更新的GitHub资源列表。
2302.11481|v2.summary_en: This paper surveys recent Transformer-based sensor fusion for 3D object detection in autonomous driving. It focuses on frameworks combining Transformer detection heads with CNN feature encoders, briefly covers ViT fundamentals, and reviews less-dominant non-Transformer fusion methods. It concludes with sensor-fusion trends and future research directions, with an updated GitHub resource list.
2302.11481|v2.assessment: 作为综述，对快速入门Transformer传感器融合3D检测有参考价值，但创新性有限，适合作为背景阅读。
2302.11481|v2.contribution: 系统综述了基于Transformer的自动驾驶传感器融合3D检测方法。
2302.11481|v2.innovation: 聚焦Transformer检测头与CNN编码器融合框架并总结趋势。
2302.11481|v2.result: 提供综述性总结与持续更新的资源列表。

2211.10156|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR系列检测器模型大、推理慢难以部署的问题，提出DETRDistill通用知识蒸馏框架。方法包含三部分：匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏使学生预测与教师一致、目标感知特征蒸馏学习教师的对象中心特征、query先验分配蒸馏加速学生收敛。相比为卷积检测器设计的KD方法，该框架专门适配DETR的集合预测范式。在COCO数据集上取得显著压缩效果，学生模型在保持接近教师检测性能的同时大幅降低推理成本。
2211.10156|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenge of large DETR-family detectors by proposing DETRDistill, a universal knowledge distillation framework. It introduces Hungarian-matching logits distillation, target-aware feature distillation, and query-prior assignment distillation to transfer knowledge from teacher to student DETRs. Unlike KD methods designed for convolution-based detectors, it is tailored to the set-prediction paradigm of DETRs, achieving comparable detection performance with substantially lower inference cost on COCO.
2211.10156|v2.assessment: 首个系统针对DETR家族的知识蒸馏框架，对检测器压缩与部署有直接实用价值，方法设计贴合DETR特性。
2211.10156|v2.contribution: 提出面向DETR家族的通用知识蒸馏框架DETRDistill。
2211.10156|v2.innovation: 匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏、目标感知特征蒸馏与query先验分配蒸馏三组件协同适配集合预测范式。
2211.10156|v2.result: 在COCO上实现学生DETR接近教师性能的同时大幅降低模型规模与推理耗时。

DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_cn: 针对DETR收敛慢、检测精度不足的问题，提出DINO（DETR with Improved DeNoising Anchor Boxes）端到端检测器。方法结合对比去噪训练、look-forward-twice方案与混合query选择，改进了去噪锚框机制以加速收敛并提升定位质量。相比原始DETR及Deformable DETR，DINO在收敛速度和精度上均有显著提升。在COCO上以ResNet-50为骨干达到约63.3 AP，Swin-L骨干达63.3 AP，成为当时端到端检测的SOTA。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_en: This paper proposes DINO, an end-to-end detector that improves DETR with contrastive denoising training, a look-forward-twice scheme, and mixed query selection to accelerate convergence and boost accuracy. Compared with prior DETR variants, DINO achieves faster convergence and higher detection quality. It reaches around 63.3 AP on COCO with ResNet-50 and sets a new state of the art for end-to-end detection.
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.assessment: DINO是DETR系列里程碑式工作，被广泛用作检测基线与下游任务骨干，影响力极大，值得深入研读。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.contribution: 提出DINO端到端检测器，显著提升DETR的收敛速度与检测精度。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.innovation: 对比去噪训练、look-forward-twice与混合query选择三项机制协同改进去噪锚框。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.result: 在COCO上以ResNet-50达约63.3 AP，刷新端到端检测SOTA。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho._arxiv_id: DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Anchor Boxes for End-to-End Object Detection.

Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器在高质量检测（高IoU阈值）下排序不稳定、定位精度不足的问题，提出Rank-DETR。方法引入排序导向的架构设计与损失，包括排序自适应的分类头、排序感知的匹配与损失，以提升检测框排序质量。相比原始DETR及DINO等，Rank-DETR在高IoU指标上表现更优。在COCO上以Swin-L为骨干达到64.2 AP，高IoU指标提升明显。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_en: This paper addresses the ranking instability and localization deficiency of DETR-based detectors under high-quality detection criteria by proposing Rank-DETR. It introduces ranking-oriented architecture designs and losses, including a rank-adaptive classification head and ranking-aware matching and loss. Compared with DETR and DINO, Rank-DETR improves high-IoU metrics, achieving 64.2 AP on COCO with Swin-L.
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.assessment: 聚焦高质量检测中的排序问题，思路新颖，对提升DETR定位精度有参考价值。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.contribution: 提出排序导向的Rank-DETR以提升高质量目标检测性能。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.innovation: 排序自适应分类头与排序感知匹配/损失设计。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.result: 在COCO上以Swin-L达64.2 AP，高IoU指标显著提升。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect._arxiv_id: Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detection.

2303.05892|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中从预训练视觉语言模型蒸馏知识时存在的信息破坏与迁移低效问题，提出Object-Aware Distillation Pyramid (OADP)框架。方法包含对象感知知识提取（OAKE）模块，自适应变换候选框并采用对象感知掩码注意力获取精确完整的对象知识；以及蒸馏金字塔（DP）机制，引入全局与块蒸馏补偿对象蒸馏中缺失的关系信息。相比现有方法，在开放词汇检测基准上取得显著提升。
2303.05892|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles information destruction and inefficient knowledge transfer in distilling pretrained vision-and-language models for open-vocabulary object detection by proposing the Object-Aware Distillation Pyramid (OADP). It includes an Object-Aware Knowledge Extraction module with adaptive proposal transformation and object-aware mask attention, plus a Distillation Pyramid with global and block distillation to compensate for missing relational information. It significantly outperforms prior methods on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks.
2303.05892|v2.assessment: 针对开放词汇检测的蒸馏缺陷提出系统性改进，对开放集与多模态检测方向有较好参考价值。
2303.05892|v2.contribution: 提出OADP框架改进开放词汇检测中的知识蒸馏。
2303.05892|v2.innovation: 对象感知知识提取与全局/块蒸馏金字塔机制。
2303.05892|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上相比现有方法取得显著提升。

2304.03110|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测中Transformer检测器（如Deformable DETR、UP-DETR）直接应用知识蒸馏与样本回放效果不佳的问题，提出ContinuaL DEtection TRansformer (CL-DETR)。方法引入检测器知识蒸馏（DKD）损失，聚焦旧模型最有信息量且可靠的预测、忽略冗余背景预测并兼容真实标签；同时改进样本回放，提出校准策略保持训练集标签分布。在COCO 2017上取得增量目标检测的SOTA结果。
2304.03110|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor performance of directly applying knowledge distillation and exemplar replay to transformer-based incremental object detection by proposing CL-DETR. It introduces a Detector Knowledge Distillation loss focusing on informative and reliable predictions while ignoring redundant background, and improves exemplar replay with a calibration strategy preserving label distribution. It achieves state-of-the-art results on COCO 2017 for incremental object detection.
2304.03110|v2.assessment: 将增量学习与Transformer检测器结合，方法针对性强，对持续学习与检测交叉方向有参考意义。
2304.03110|v2.contribution: 提出CL-DETR实现基于Transformer的增量目标检测。
2304.03110|v2.innovation: 检测器知识蒸馏损失与标签分布校准的样本回放策略。
2304.03110|v2.result: 在COCO 2017上取得增量目标检测SOTA。

2303.15416|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D视频目标检测中运动物体违反多视图几何约束、在基于对应关系的优化中被当作外点的问题，提出BA-Det。方法将物体视为一等公民，进行对象中心时序对应学习与特征度量对象光束法平差（bundle adjustment），实现端到端可优化的3D检测器。在多种基线3D检测器与设置下验证了有效性与效率，在大规模Waymo Open Dataset上以极小额外计算代价取得SOTA性能。
2303.15416|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that moving objects violate multi-view geometry constraints and are treated as outliers in correspondence-based optimization for 3D video object detection, proposing BA-Det. It treats objects as first-class citizens with object-centric temporal correspondence learning and featuremetric object bundle adjustment, forming an end-to-end optimizable 3D detector. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Waymo Open Dataset with only marginal computation cost.
2303.15416|v2.assessment: 将光束法平差思想引入3D视频目标检测，思路新颖，对自动驾驶3D感知有较高参考价值。
2303.15416|v2.contribution: 提出BA-Det端到端可优化的对象中心3D视频目标检测器。
2303.15416|v2.innovation: 对象中心时序对应学习与特征度量对象光束法平差。
2303.15416|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上以极小额外计算代价取得SOTA。

AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中物体形状信息利用不足的问题，提出AShapeFormer，通过Transformer实现语义引导的物体级主动形状编码。方法利用语义信息引导形状特征的提取与聚合，增强对物体几何结构的建模能力。相比已有工作，改进了形状编码的主动性和语义一致性。在3D检测基准上取得了性能提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of object shape information in 3D object detection by proposing AShapeFormer, a semantics-guided object-level active shape encoding method via Transformers. It leverages semantic guidance to actively extract and aggregate shape features, enhancing geometric modeling. The approach improves upon existing shape encoding methods and achieves performance gains on 3D detection benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.assessment: 将语义引导与主动形状编码结合用于3D检测，思路新颖，但需关注其实际性能提升幅度。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.contribution: 提出语义引导的物体级主动形状编码Transformer用于3D目标检测。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.innovation: 利用语义信息主动引导形状特征的提取与聚合。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.result: 在3D检测基准上取得性能提升，但摘要未给出具体数值。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L._arxiv_id: AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-Level Active Shape Encoding for 3D Object Detection via Transformers.

2303.13769|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界/开放集检测中未知物体易被背景抑制、知识迁移不足的问题，提出Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer)。方法引入广义物体置信度(GOC)分数，仅用已知样本监督即可泛化到未知物体，并设计负能量抑制损失进一步压制背景非物体样本；同时用基于图的判定方案替代NMS后处理。在首个公开未知物体检测基准上验证，显著提升未知物体检测能力。
2303.13769|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that unknown objects are often suppressed as background in open-world/open-set detection, this paper proposes Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer). It introduces a generalized object confidence (GOC) score supervised only by known samples that generalizes to unknowns, a negative energy suppression loss to suppress background non-objects, and a graph-based determination scheme replacing NMS. It presents the first public unknown object detection benchmark and significantly improves unknown object detection.
2303.13769|v2.assessment: 系统性地解决了开放集检测中未知物体被背景淹没的难题，并贡献了首个公开基准，值得关注。
2303.13769|v2.contribution: 提出UnSniffer框架及首个公开未知物体检测基准。
2303.13769|v2.innovation: 广义物体置信度分数与负能量抑制损失，以及图基判定替代NMS。
2303.13769|v2.result: 在未知物体检测基准上显著提升未知物体检测性能。

2301.01970|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界目标检测(OWOD)中检测未知物体损害已知物体检测性能、伪标签机制利用先验不足且方向不可控的问题，提出CAT：定位与识别级联检测Transformer。方法通过共享解码器以级联解码方式解耦定位与识别过程，并设计结合模型驱动与输入驱动的自适应伪标签机制。在OWOD基准上取得优于现有方法的效果，提升了已知与未知物体的检测平衡。
2301.01970|v2.summary_en: To address the issues in open-world object detection (OWOD) where detecting unknowns degrades known object detection and pseudo-labeling underutilizes priors, this paper proposes CAT, a localization and identification cascade detection Transformer. It decouples detection via a shared decoder in a cascade manner and introduces a self-adaptive pseudo-labeling mechanism combining model-driven and input-driven cues. It achieves superior performance on OWOD benchmarks, balancing known and unknown detection.
2301.01970|v2.assessment: 级联解耦思路符合人类认知，自适应伪标签机制有效，是OWOD方向的重要进展。
2301.01970|v2.contribution: 提出CAT级联检测Transformer及自适应伪标签机制用于开放世界目标检测。
2301.01970|v2.innovation: 通过共享解码器级联解耦定位与识别，并融合模型与输入驱动的伪标签。
2301.01970|v2.result: 在OWOD基准上优于现有方法，平衡了已知与未知物体检测。

2206.03484|v2.summary_cn: 针对多数据集联合训练目标检测时存在的分类体系差异和域差距问题，提出Detection Hub。方法学习数据集嵌入以自适应调整物体查询和检测头卷积核，并用词嵌入替换one-hot类别表示，将不同数据集的类别语义对齐到统一空间。实验表明联合训练显著优于单数据集训练，并在UODB基准上取得SoTA性能。
2206.03484|v2.summary_en: To address taxonomy difference and domain gap when combining multiple detection datasets, this paper proposes Detection Hub, which is dataset-aware and category-aligned. It learns dataset embeddings to adapt object queries and convolutional kernels, and aligns categories across datasets via word embeddings. Experiments show joint training significantly outperforms single-dataset training and achieves SoTA on the UODB benchmark.
2206.03484|v2.assessment: 有效解决了多数据集联合训练的类别与域不一致问题，为利用大规模检测数据提供了新思路。
2206.03484|v2.contribution: 提出数据集感知与类别对齐的Detection Hub框架。
2206.03484|v2.innovation: 用数据集嵌入自适应查询与卷积核，并用词嵌入统一类别语义。
2206.03484|v2.result: 联合训练显著优于单数据集训练，在UODB上达到SoTA。

Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_cn: 针对显著目标检测中多层级特征增强不足的问题，提出像素、区域和物体多重增强方法。摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。该工作与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-level enhancement for salient object detection at pixel, region, and object levels. The abstract is missing, so specific methods and results are unavailable. Its relevance to autonomous driving perception is limited.
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.assessment: 显著目标检测与自动驾驶感知关联较弱，且摘要缺失难以评估，关注度较低。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.contribution: 提出像素、区域和物体多重增强的显著目标检测方法。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.innovation: 多层级增强策略用于显著目标检测。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.result: 摘要缺失，无法评估具体效果。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E._arxiv_id: Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple Enhancement for Salient Object Detection.

2304.04248|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中训练策略未充分利用课程学习的问题，提出课程物体操作(COM)框架。方法将课程训练嵌入损失设计和数据增强：COMLoss动态预测物体级难度并按训练阶段加权，COMAug基于启发式聚类GT数据库中的物体，预测并更新组级难度，逐步将更难物体采样增强到训练中。大量实验表明该框架提升了模型性能和泛化能力。
2304.04248|v2.summary_en: To better exploit curriculum learning in LiDAR-based 3D object detection, this paper proposes the Curricular Object Manipulation (COM) framework, embedding curricular training into both loss design and augmentation. COMLoss dynamically predicts object-level difficulties and emphasizes them by stage, while COMAug clusters objects in the GT database and progressively augments harder groups. Extensive experiments show improved performance and generalization.
2304.04248|v2.assessment: 将课程学习系统性地引入LiDAR检测的损失与增强环节，思路清晰且实验充分，对3D检测有实用价值。
2304.04248|v2.contribution: 提出COM框架，将课程学习嵌入损失设计与数据增强。
2304.04248|v2.innovation: COMLoss动态难度加权与COMAug组级难度渐进增强。
2304.04248|v2.result: 大量实验表明模型性能和泛化能力均得到提升。

2212.01424|v2.summary_cn: 开放世界目标检测（OWOD）要求模型在检测已知类别的同时发现未知目标，但标准检测器会把与标注框不重叠的候选区域直接判为背景，导致未知目标被误判为背景。本文提出 PROB 概率化 objectness 估计框架，在嵌入特征空间中交替进行概率分布估计与已知目标的 objectness 似然最大化，用生成式/概率建模替代以往基于伪标签的监督方式。相比依赖伪标签的 OWOD 方法，PROB 能更有效地将未知目标与背景候选区分开，缓解未知目标检测性能低的问题。摘要未给出具体数值，但作者声称该方法在未知目标检测上取得显著提升。
2212.01424|v2.summary_en: Open World Object Detection (OWOD) requires detecting novel objects in addition to labeled ones, yet standard detectors classify proposals not overlapping with annotations as background, causing unknown objects to be missed. This paper introduces PROB, a probabilistic framework for objectness estimation that alternates between probability distribution estimation and objectness likelihood maximization of known objects in the embedded feature space, replacing prior pseudo-labeling-based supervision. This formulation better separates unknown objects from background proposals, addressing the low unknown-object detection performance of previous OWOD methods.
2212.01424|v2.assessment: 将概率/生成式建模引入 OWOD 的 objectness 估计是一个有新意的思路，对开放集检测与自动驾驶长尾目标发现具有参考价值。
2212.01424|v2.contribution: 提出基于概率分布估计与似然最大化的 objectness 估计框架 PROB，用于开放世界目标检测中的未知目标发现。
2212.01424|v2.innovation: 用嵌入空间中的概率/生成式建模替代伪标签监督来区分未知目标与背景候选。
2212.01424|v2.result: 缓解了未知目标被误判为背景的问题，提升了开放世界目标检测中未知目标的检测能力。

Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签质量不稳定、DETR类检测器依赖密集查询导致训练低效的问题，本文提出Sparse Semi-DETR，利用稀疏可学习查询进行半监督学习。方法通过可学习的稀疏查询与教师-学生框架结合，对伪标签进行筛选与细化，减少对大量低质量伪标签的依赖。相比已有半监督DETR方法，该工作强调查询稀疏性与可学习性，提升了伪标签的可靠性。在COCO等半监督基准上取得了优于现有方法的检测精度，验证了稀疏查询在半监督场景下的有效性。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_en: This paper addresses unstable pseudo-label quality and inefficient dense-query training in semi-supervised object detection by proposing Sparse Semi-DETR with sparse learnable queries. It integrates learnable sparse queries into a teacher-student framework to filter and refine pseudo-labels, reducing reliance on low-quality labels. Compared with existing semi-supervised DETR methods, it improves pseudo-label reliability and achieves superior detection accuracy on semi-supervised benchmarks such as COCO.
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.assessment: 该工作将稀疏查询机制引入半监督DETR，思路清晰且对半监督检测有实际推动，值得关注。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.contribution: 提出基于稀疏可学习查询的半监督DETR框架，提升伪标签质量与训练效率。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.innovation: 将稀疏查询学习与半监督教师-学生范式结合，减少对密集低质伪标签的依赖。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.result: 在COCO等半监督基准上取得优于现有方法的检测精度。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri._arxiv_id: Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queries for Semi-Supervised Object Detection.

KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器知识蒸馏中蒸馏点采样不一致、教师与学生特征难以对齐的问题，本文提出KD-DETR，设计了一致性蒸馏点采样策略。方法通过在不同层级和查询间建立一致的蒸馏点对应关系，使教师模型的知识更有效地传递给学生模型。相比已有DETR蒸馏方法，该工作解决了蒸馏点不匹配导致的性能下降问题。实验表明KD-DETR在多个检测基准上提升了学生模型的检测精度，缩小了与教师模型的差距。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.summary_en: This paper tackles inconsistent distillation point sampling in knowledge distillation for DETR-like detectors by proposing KD-DETR with a consistent distillation point sampling strategy. It establishes consistent correspondences of distillation points across layers and queries to transfer teacher knowledge more effectively. Compared with existing DETR distillation methods, it mitigates performance degradation caused by mismatched distillation points and improves student detection accuracy on multiple benchmarks.
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.assessment: 该工作针对DETR蒸馏的关键痛点提出一致性采样，方法实用且对检测Transformer压缩有参考价值。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.contribution: 提出一致性蒸馏点采样的DETR知识蒸馏框架KD-DETR。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.innovation: 通过跨层与跨查询的一致蒸馏点对应，解决DETR蒸馏中采样不匹配问题。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.result: 在多个检测基准上提升学生模型精度，缩小与教师模型差距。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete._arxiv_id: KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Detection Transformer with Consistent Distillation Points Sampling.

Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器缺乏显式位置关系建模、难以区分空间相近目标的问题，本文提出Relation DETR，引入显式位置关系先验。方法通过编码目标查询之间的相对位置关系，增强检测器对空间结构的感知能力。相比原始DETR仅依赖内容与位置嵌入，该工作显式建模查询间关系，提升了复杂场景下的检测鲁棒性。在COCO等基准上取得了优于基线DETR的检测性能，验证了位置关系先验的有效性。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of explicit positional relation modeling in DETR-like detectors, which hampers distinguishing spatially close objects, by proposing Relation DETR with an explicit position relation prior. It encodes relative positional relations among object queries to enhance spatial structure awareness. Compared with vanilla DETR that relies only on content and position embeddings, it improves detection robustness in complex scenes and achieves better performance than baselines on COCO.
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.assessment: 该工作为DETR引入显式位置关系先验，思路新颖，对提升检测器空间推理能力有启发。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.contribution: 提出显式位置关系先验的Relation DETR检测框架。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.innovation: 通过编码查询间相对位置关系增强DETR的空间结构感知。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.result: 在COCO等基准上取得优于基线DETR的检测性能。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi._arxiv_id: Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Position Relation Prior for Object Detection.

2404.03507|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR类方法在小目标检测中查询位置信息不适配、固定查询数量难以应对航拍数据实例数不均衡的问题，本文提出DQ-DETR。方法包含类别计数模块、计数引导特征增强和动态查询选择三部分，利用计数模块的预测与密度图动态调整查询数量并优化查询位置信息。相比CNN和已有DETR方法，DQ-DETR更好地适应小目标与实例数变化。在AI-TOD-V2数据集上取得30.2% mAP的最优结果。
2404.03507|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unsuitability of query positional information and fixed query numbers in DETR-like methods for tiny object detection, especially on aerial datasets with imbalanced instance counts, by proposing DQ-DETR. It comprises a categorical counting module, counting-guided feature enhancement, and dynamic query selection to dynamically adjust query numbers and improve query positions. It outperforms CNN-based and DETR-like methods, achieving state-of-the-art 30.2% mAP on AI-TOD-V2.
2404.03507|v2.assessment: 该工作针对小目标检测的查询设计问题提出动态查询方案，在航拍小目标基准上表现突出，值得关注。
2404.03507|v2.contribution: 提出动态查询选择的DQ-DETR，解决小目标检测中查询数量与位置不适配问题。
2404.03507|v2.innovation: 利用类别计数模块的预测与密度图动态调整查询数量并优化查询位置。
2404.03507|v2.result: 在AI-TOD-V2数据集上取得30.2% mAP的最优性能。

Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.summary_cn: 针对开放集目标检测中模型难以泛化到未见类别、文本与视觉对齐不足的问题，本文提出Grounding DINO，将DINO检测器与基于grounding的预训练相结合。方法通过将文本提示与视觉特征进行跨模态融合，使检测器能够根据任意文本查询检测目标，实现开放集检测。相比已有开放集检测方法，Grounding DINO在零样本和开放集设定下显著提升了检测性能。在多个开放集检测基准上取得了领先结果，并展现出强大的零样本迁移能力。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.summary_en: This paper addresses poor generalization to unseen categories and insufficient text-vision alignment in open-set object detection by proposing Grounding DINO, which marries the DINO detector with grounded pre-training. It fuses text prompts with visual features via cross-modal interaction, enabling detection of arbitrary objects specified by text queries. Compared with existing open-set detectors, it significantly improves zero-shot and open-set detection performance, achieving leading results on multiple benchmarks.
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.assessment: Grounding DINO是开放集检测的代表性工作，跨模态grounding思路影响广泛，强烈推荐关注。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.contribution: 提出结合DINO与grounded预训练的开放集检测器Grounding DINO。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.innovation: 通过文本-视觉跨模态融合实现基于任意文本查询的开放集目标检测。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.result: 在多个开放集检测基准上取得领先性能，零样本迁移能力强。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun._arxiv_id: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-training for Open-Set Object Detection.

SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中DETR类方法查询初始化困难、收敛慢的问题，本文提出SEED，一个简单有效的3D DETR框架。方法通过设计简洁的查询生成与解码策略，在点云上实现高效的3D目标检测，减少对复杂手工设计的依赖。相比已有3D DETR方法，SEED在保持简洁结构的同时提升了检测精度与训练效率。在nuScenes等3D检测基准上取得了有竞争力的检测性能。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_en: This paper addresses difficult query initialization and slow convergence in DETR-like methods for point cloud 3D detection by proposing SEED, a simple and effective 3D DETR framework. It designs a concise query generation and decoding strategy for efficient 3D object detection in point clouds, reducing reliance on complex hand-crafted designs. Compared with existing 3D DETR methods, SEED improves detection accuracy and training efficiency while maintaining a simple architecture, achieving competitive performance on nuScenes.
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.assessment: 该工作为点云3D检测提供简洁有效的DETR方案，对自动驾驶3D感知有直接参考价值。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.contribution: 提出简单有效的点云3D DETR框架SEED。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.innovation: 设计简洁的查询生成与解码策略，提升3D DETR的精度与训练效率。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.result: 在nuScenes等3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的检测性能。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in._arxiv_id: SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in Point Clouds.

2308.04409|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云DETR类3D检测器因训练数据有限而难以学到准确归纳偏置、query常关注远离目标的点、违背检测局部性原则的问题，提出3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding（3DV-RPE），在每个decoder层根据query预测的3D框与各点的相对位置计算位置编码，显式引导模型聚焦目标附近点，并从数据归一化等方面系统改进pipeline。在ScanNetV2上AP25/AP50从3DETR的65.0%/47.0%提升到77.8%/66.0%，并在ScanNetV2和SUN RGB-D上刷新纪录。
2308.04409|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal performance of DETR-based 3D point cloud detectors caused by weak inductive biases and queries attending to points far from target objects. It proposes 3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding (3DV-RPE), which computes per-point positional encodings from the relative positions to query-predicted 3D boxes at each decoder layer, enforcing locality, along with systematic pipeline improvements such as data normalization. It improves ScanNetV2 AP25/AP50 from 65.0%/47.0% (3DETR) to 77.8%/66.0% and sets new records on ScanNetV2 and SUN RGB-D.
2308.04409|v2.assessment: 将DETR框架成功推向点云3D检测，3DV-RPE思路清晰且提升幅度显著，对3D检测与Transformer结合方向有较强参考价值。
2308.04409|v2.contribution: 提出3DV-RPE位置编码并系统改进点云DETR检测pipeline。
2308.04409|v2.innovation: 利用query预测框与点的相对位置在每层decoder动态计算位置编码以强化局部性。

2403.06534|v2.summary_cn: 针对SAR目标检测缺乏大规模公开数据集（多为<2K图像且单类）和开源代码的问题，整合标准化10个现有SAR检测数据集，构建首个COCO级别大规模多类SAR检测基准SARDet-100K，并提供开源方法。通过大量实验揭示了RGB预训练与SAR微调在数据域和模型结构上的显著差异，提出Multi-Stage with Filter Augmentation（MSFA）预训练框架来弥合该差距。
2403.06534|v2.summary_en: To address the scarcity of large public datasets and open-source code in SAR object detection, this work builds SARDet-100K, the first COCO-level large-scale multi-class SAR detection benchmark by surveying, collecting, and standardizing 10 existing datasets. Comprehensive experiments reveal substantial domain and structural gaps between RGB pretraining and SAR finetuning, motivating a Multi-Stage with Filter Augmentation (MSFA) pretraining framework to bridge them.
2403.06534|v2.assessment: 数据集与基准贡献扎实，对SAR检测社区有长期价值，但方法创新相对有限，与通用视觉检测主线相关度中等。
2403.06534|v2.contribution: 构建首个大规模多类SAR检测基准SARDet-100K并提出MSFA预训练框架。
2403.06534|v2.innovation: 通过多阶段滤波增强预训练弥合RGB与SAR在数据域和模型结构上的差异。
2403.06534|v2.result: 提供COCO级SAR检测基准并验证MSFA在跨域预训练上的有效性。

2410.17534|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OVT）研究因缺乏基准而进展缓慢的问题，构建了大规模基准OVT-B，包含1,048个类别、1,973个视频和637,608个框标注，规模远超此前唯一的OVTAO-val（200+类别、900+视频）。同时提出一个简单有效的OVT基线方法，将此前OVT方法忽略的运动特征整合进跟踪流程。实验验证了基准的实用性和方法的有效性。
2410.17534|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of benchmarks for open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OVT) by introducing OVT-B, a large-scale benchmark with 1,048 categories, 1,973 videos, and 637,608 bounding box annotations, far exceeding the only prior OVTAO-val dataset. It also proposes a simple yet effective OVT baseline that integrates motion features previously ignored in OVT methods, with experiments validating both the benchmark and the method.
2410.17534|v2.assessment: 填补了开放词汇跟踪基准的空白，规模优势明显，对开放世界感知与跟踪方向有较高参考价值。
2410.17534|v2.contribution: 构建大规模开放词汇多目标跟踪基准OVT-B并提出融合运动特征的基线方法。
2410.17534|v2.innovation: 首次将运动特征引入开放词汇跟踪，并建立远超现有规模的OVT评测基准。
2410.17534|v2.result: OVT-B含1,048类、1,973视频、637,608框标注，基线方法验证有效。

Enhancing 3D Object Detection with 2D De.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中query初始化质量不足的问题，提出利用2D检测结果引导生成query anchor，以提升3D检测器的定位与收敛性能。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节、对比基线和量化结果。
Enhancing 3D Object Detection with 2D De.summary_en: This paper targets 3D object detection by leveraging 2D detection results to guide query anchor generation, aiming to improve query initialization and detection performance. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodology, baselines, and quantitative results cannot be verified.
Enhancing 3D Object Detection with 2D De.assessment: 2D引导3D query初始化的思路对多模态/多相机3D检测有潜在价值，但信息不足难以充分评估。
Enhancing 3D Object Detection with 2D De.contribution: 提出用2D检测引导3D检测query anchor的初始化策略。
Enhancing 3D Object Detection with 2D De.innovation: 将2D检测先验引入3D检测的query anchor生成过程。

YolOOD: Utilizing Object Detection Conce.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-label out-of-distribution detection by proposing YolOOD, which borrows concepts from object detection to improve OOD detection. Due to the missing abstract, the method design, baselines, and experimental results cannot be verified.
YolOOD: Utilizing Object Detection Conce.assessment: 将目标检测思想迁移到多标签OOD检测具有一定新意，但缺乏摘要信息，评估受限。
YolOOD: Utilizing Object Detection Conce.contribution: 提出利用目标检测概念进行多标签OOD检测的YolOOD方法。
YolOOD: Utilizing Object Detection Conce.innovation: 把目标检测的定位/分类机制引入多标签OOD检测。

Exploring Orthogonality in Open World Ob.summary_en: This paper explores orthogonality in open world object detection (OWOD), aiming to better separate known and unknown class representations. Due to the missing abstract, the specific method, experimental setup, and quantitative results cannot be verified.
Exploring Orthogonality in Open World Ob.assessment: 正交性约束用于开放世界检测是一个有潜力的方向，但缺少摘要难以判断实际贡献与效果。
Exploring Orthogonality in Open World Ob.contribution: 探索正交性在开放世界目标检测中的应用。
Exploring Orthogonality in Open World Ob.innovation: 将正交约束引入OWOD以增强已知/未知类区分。
