2403.10191|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中依赖固定类别或大量标注的问题，提出生成式区域-语言预训练方法，通过生成式模型建立区域与语言的关联。相比已有开放集检测方法，该方法无需人工定义类别，能检测任意文本描述的对象。在多个开放词汇检测基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，展示了生成式预训练在开放世界感知中的潜力。
2403.10191|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-ended object detection by proposing a generative region-language pretraining approach that associates regions with free-form language. Unlike prior open-set detectors relying on fixed vocabularies, it enables detection of arbitrary objects described by text. Experiments on open-vocabulary benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance and the potential of generative pretraining for open-world perception.
2403.10191|v2.assessment: 开放词汇检测是自动驾驶感知扩展类别的重要方向，该工作将生成式预训练引入区域-语言对齐，思路新颖，值得关注。
2403.10191|v2.contribution: 提出生成式区域-语言预训练框架，实现开放端目标检测。
2403.10191|v2.innovation: 利用生成式模型建立区域与自由文本的关联，摆脱固定类别限制。
2403.10191|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能。

2403.05061|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点云稀疏、噪声大导致基于雷达的3D目标检测性能远低于LiDAR的问题，提出RadarDistill，通过知识蒸馏将LiDAR特征中的几何与语义信息迁移到雷达检测网络。相比直接训练雷达检测器，该方法在特征层面进行跨模态蒸馏，显著缩小了雷达与LiDAR检测的性能差距。在nuScenes等基准上，雷达检测性能获得大幅提升，接近LiDAR水平。
2403.05061|v2.summary_en: To address the performance gap between radar-based and LiDAR-based 3D detection caused by sparse and noisy radar points, this paper proposes RadarDistill, which transfers geometric and semantic knowledge from LiDAR features to a radar detection network via knowledge distillation. Cross-modal feature-level distillation substantially narrows the gap, yielding large improvements on nuScenes and approaching LiDAR-level performance.
2403.05061|v2.assessment: 雷达与LiDAR的跨模态蒸馏是低成本感知的重要路线，该工作方法直接有效，实验提升明显，对多模态感知研究者有参考价值。
2403.05061|v2.contribution: 提出RadarDistill，通过LiDAR特征蒸馏提升雷达3D检测性能。
2403.05061|v2.innovation: 在特征层面进行跨模态知识蒸馏，缩小雷达与LiDAR检测差距。
2403.05061|v2.result: 在nuScenes上雷达检测性能大幅提升，接近LiDAR水平。

GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_cn: 针对目标检测模型在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性问题，提出GLOW全局布局感知攻击方法，通过优化图像中目标的全局空间布局来生成对抗样本。相比传统逐像素扰动攻击，该方法从布局层面攻击检测器，更符合真实场景且扰动更自然。实验表明该攻击能有效降低多种检测器的性能，揭示了检测器对全局布局的敏感性。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_en: This paper proposes GLOW, a global layout-aware attack on object detection that optimizes the global spatial layout of objects to generate adversarial examples. Unlike pixel-wise perturbations, it attacks detectors at the layout level, producing more natural and realistic attacks. Experiments show effective degradation of multiple detectors, revealing their sensitivity to global layout.
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.assessment: 从全局布局角度研究检测器对抗鲁棒性，视角独特，对自动驾驶感知安全性研究有启发。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.contribution: 提出全局布局感知的对抗攻击方法GLOW。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.innovation: 通过优化目标全局空间布局而非逐像素扰动来攻击检测器。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.result: 有效降低多种检测器性能，揭示布局敏感性。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj._arxiv_id: GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Object Detection.

2404.18150|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达目标检测中真实标注数据稀缺、合成数据与真实数据存在域差距的问题，提出RadSimReal仿真框架，生成高质量的合成雷达数据以弥合仿真与真实的鸿沟。相比已有仿真方法，该框架更真实地建模雷达物理特性，使在合成数据上训练的检测器能更好迁移到真实数据。实验表明利用该仿真数据可显著提升雷达检测性能，缩小合成-真实差距。
2404.18150|v2.summary_en: To tackle the scarcity of real radar annotations and the synthetic-to-real domain gap in radar object detection, this paper presents RadSimReal, a simulation framework generating high-fidelity synthetic radar data. By more faithfully modeling radar physics, detectors trained on synthetic data transfer better to real data, substantially improving radar detection and narrowing the sim-to-real gap.
2404.18150|v2.assessment: 雷达仿真数据生成对缓解标注稀缺意义重大，该工作物理建模扎实，对雷达感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2404.18150|v2.contribution: 提出RadSimReal雷达仿真框架，弥合合成与真实数据差距。
2404.18150|v2.innovation: 更真实地建模雷达物理特性以生成高质量合成雷达数据。
2404.18150|v2.result: 利用合成数据显著提升雷达检测性能，缩小sim-to-real差距。

Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_cn: 针对恶劣天气条件下LiDAR性能下降、单一模态鲁棒性不足的问题，提出LiDAR与4D雷达融合的3D目标检测方法，利用4D雷达在雨雾等天气下的穿透优势补偿LiDAR退化。相比单一LiDAR或雷达方案，该方法通过多模态融合在多种天气条件下保持稳定检测性能。实验表明融合方案在恶劣天气下显著优于单模态基线，提升了检测鲁棒性。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_en: To address LiDAR degradation and limited single-modality robustness in adverse weather, this paper proposes a LiDAR and 4D radar fusion method for 3D object detection, leveraging 4D radar's penetration advantage to compensate for LiDAR degradation. Multi-modal fusion maintains stable detection across weather conditions, significantly outperforming single-modality baselines and improving robustness.
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.assessment: 恶劣天气鲁棒性是自动驾驶落地的关键挑战，LiDAR与4D雷达融合方案实用性强，对多模态感知研究者价值高。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.contribution: 提出LiDAR与4D雷达融合的鲁棒3D检测方法。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.innovation: 利用4D雷达穿透优势补偿恶劣天气下LiDAR退化。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.result: 在多种恶劣天气下显著优于单模态基线。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with._arxiv_id: Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with LiDAR and 4D Radar Fusion in Various Weather Conditions.

2304.05370|v2.summary_cn: 针对边缘设备上目标检测模型的延迟攻击问题，提出Overload方法，通过注入特定扰动使检测器计算量激增、推理延迟大幅上升。相比传统攻击关注精度下降，该工作聚焦于延迟这一实时系统关键指标，揭示了检测器在边缘部署下的安全漏洞。实验表明该攻击能显著增加多种检测器在边缘设备上的推理时间，影响实时性。
2304.05370|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Overload, a latency attack on object detection for edge devices that injects perturbations to drastically increase computational cost and inference latency. Unlike attacks targeting accuracy, it focuses on latency, a critical metric for real-time systems, exposing security vulnerabilities in edge deployment. Experiments show significant inference-time increases across detectors on edge devices.
2304.05370|v2.assessment: 从延迟角度研究检测器安全，对自动驾驶边缘部署的实时性保障有警示意义，但相关度相对偏窄。
2304.05370|v2.contribution: 提出针对边缘设备检测器的延迟攻击方法Overload。
2304.05370|v2.innovation: 聚焦推理延迟而非精度，揭示实时检测系统的安全漏洞。
2304.05370|v2.result: 显著增加多种检测器在边缘设备上的推理时间。

Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_cn: 针对无人机多模态（RGB-红外等）目标检测中模态间空间错位导致特征融合退化的问题，论文提出一种弱错位自适应的特征对齐方法。方法通过可学习的对齐模块在弱监督信号下估计并补偿模态间的局部偏移，使融合特征在空间上保持一致。相比依赖严格配准或忽略错位的已有方法，该工作显式建模弱错位并自适应校正。在无人机多模态检测基准上取得一致的精度提升，验证了对齐对融合检测的有效性。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses spatial misalignment between modalities in UAV-based multimodal object detection, which degrades feature fusion. It proposes a weakly misalignment-free adaptive feature alignment module that estimates and compensates local cross-modal offsets under weak supervision. Compared with methods assuming strict registration or ignoring misalignment, it explicitly models and corrects weak misalignment, yielding consistent accuracy gains on UAV multimodal detection benchmarks.
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.assessment: 面向无人机多模态检测的实际痛点，弱错位对齐思路对多传感器融合研究有参考价值。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.contribution: 提出弱错位自适应的多模态特征对齐框架，缓解无人机场景下模态空间错位问题。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.innovation: 以弱监督方式显式建模并自适应补偿模态间局部空间错位。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.result: 在无人机多模态检测基准上取得一致的检测精度提升。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur._arxiv_id: Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Feature Alignment for UAVs-Based Multimodal Object Detection.

2401.17270|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中依赖大量标注、难以实时部署的问题，论文提出 YOLO-World，将 YOLO 检测器与视觉-语言预训练结合实现实时开放词汇检测。方法通过可重参数化的视觉-语言路径聚合与提示-检测范式，在推理时无需文本编码器即可高效检测任意类别。相比此前开放词汇检测器速度慢、需在线文本编码的局限，该方法在保持实时性的同时具备强零样本能力。在 LVIS 上达到 35.4 AP，在 V100 上约 52 FPS，零样本性能优于许多更大模型。
2401.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency and annotation dependence of open-vocabulary object detection by proposing YOLO-World, which couples a YOLO detector with vision-language pretraining for real-time detection. It introduces a re-parameterizable vision-language PAN and a prompt-then-detect paradigm that removes the need for an online text encoder at inference. It achieves 35.4 AP on LVIS at ~52 FPS on a V100, outperforming many larger open-vocabulary detectors in zero-shot settings.
2401.17270|v2.assessment: 把开放词汇能力带入实时 YOLO 框架，对自动驾驶开放类别感知与部署极具吸引力。
2401.17270|v2.contribution: 提出实时开放词汇检测器 YOLO-World，实现高效零样本任意类别检测。
2401.17270|v2.innovation: 可重参数化视觉-语言路径聚合与提示-检测范式，推理时无需文本编码器。
2401.17270|v2.result: LVIS 上 35.4 AP，V100 上约 52 FPS，零样本性能领先。

Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_cn: 针对单域泛化目标检测中模型在未见域上性能下降的问题，论文聚焦于数据多样性与特征对齐两个关键因素。方法通过多样化的风格/纹理增强提升训练域覆盖，并引入对齐机制缩小域间特征分布差异。相比仅依赖单一增强或对齐策略的已有工作，该框架将多样化与对齐协同优化。在多个跨域检测基准上取得优于基线的泛化性能，验证了两者结合的必要性。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_en: This paper targets single domain-generalized object detection, where models degrade on unseen domains, focusing on diversification and alignment. It combines diversified style/texture augmentation to broaden training coverage with an alignment mechanism to reduce inter-domain feature discrepancy. Compared with methods using only augmentation or alignment, it jointly optimizes both, achieving improved cross-domain generalization on multiple benchmarks.
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.assessment: 对域泛化检测的多样性-对齐协同分析清晰，对自动驾驶跨域部署有借鉴意义。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.contribution: 提出结合多样化增强与特征对齐的单域泛化目标检测框架。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.innovation: 将数据多样化与域对齐协同优化以提升单域泛化能力。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.result: 在多个跨域检测基准上取得优于基线的泛化性能。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje._arxiv_id: Improving Single Domain-Generalized Object Detection: A Focus on Diversification and Alignment.

D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_cn: 针对 RGB-热红外域自适应目标检测中跨模态域差距导致性能下降的问题，论文提出 D3T（Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher），采用双域教师沿 RGB-热红外间隙进行之字形知识迁移。方法通过两个分别面向 RGB 与热红外的教师网络交替指导学生模型，缓解模态间分布差异。相比单教师或单向迁移方法，之字形双域蒸馏更充分地利用两模态互补信息。在 RGB-T 域自适应检测基准上取得优于已有方法的精度。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_en: This paper addresses the RGB-thermal domain gap in domain-adaptive object detection by proposing D3T, a Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher that zigzags knowledge transfer across the RGB-thermal gap. Two modality-specific teachers alternately supervise the student to mitigate cross-modal distribution shift. Compared with single-teacher or unidirectional transfer, the zigzag dual-domain distillation better exploits complementary modality information, achieving superior accuracy on RGB-T domain-adaptive detection benchmarks.
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.assessment: 双域教师之字形蒸馏为多模态域自适应检测提供了新颖的迁移范式。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.contribution: 提出 D3T 双域教师之字形知识迁移框架用于 RGB-T 域自适应检测。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.innovation: 以双域教师交替指导的之字形蒸馏跨越 RGB-热红外模态间隙。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.result: 在 RGB-T 域自适应检测基准上精度优于已有方法。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig._arxiv_id: D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zigzagging Across RGB-Thermal Gap for Domain-Adaptive Object Detection.

Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_cn: 针对目标检测在昼夜域差异下性能显著下降的问题，论文提出零样本昼夜域自适应方法以提升夜间检测。方法在无夜间标注的情况下，通过图像翻译与域自适应策略将白天知识迁移到夜间域。相比需要夜间标注或成对数据的已有方法，该工作实现零样本跨昼夜适应。在昼夜检测基准上显著提升夜间检测精度，缩小了昼夜性能差距。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_en: This paper tackles the severe day-night domain gap in object detection by proposing a zero-shot day-night domain adaptation method. Without nighttime annotations, it transfers daytime knowledge to the night domain via image translation and domain adaptation. Unlike methods requiring nighttime labels or paired data, it achieves zero-shot cross-day-night adaptation, substantially improving nighttime detection and narrowing the day-night performance gap.
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.assessment: 零样本昼夜自适应对自动驾驶全天候感知具有直接实用价值。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.contribution: 提出无需夜间标注的零样本昼夜域自适应目标检测方法。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.innovation: 利用图像翻译与域自适应实现零样本跨昼夜知识迁移。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.result: 显著提升夜间检测精度并缩小昼夜性能差距。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot._arxiv_id: Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot Day-Night Domain Adaptation.

InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中真实标注数据稀缺、长尾类别样本不足的问题，论文提出 InstaGen，通过在合成数据集上训练来增强检测器。方法利用文本到图像扩散模型生成带实例掩码的合成图像，并将其用于检测器训练以补充真实数据。相比仅用真实数据或简单复制粘贴增强的方法，InstaGen 生成的合成样本提供更丰富的类别与场景多样性。在 LVIS 等基准上提升了稀有类别与整体检测性能，验证了合成数据对检测的有效补充。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of real annotated data and long-tail categories in object detection by proposing InstaGen, which enhances detectors via training on synthetic data. It leverages text-to-image diffusion models to generate synthetic images with instance masks for detector training. Compared with real-data-only or simple copy-paste augmentation, InstaGen provides richer category and scene diversity, improving rare-category and overall detection performance on benchmarks such as LVIS.
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.assessment: 将扩散模型合成数据用于检测训练，对数据稀缺与长尾问题有实用价值。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.contribution: 提出 InstaGen，利用扩散模型生成带掩码合成数据增强目标检测器。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.innovation: 以文本到图像扩散生成实例级合成数据补充检测训练。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.result: 在 LVIS 等基准上提升稀有类别与整体检测性能。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by._arxiv_id: InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by Training on Synthetic Dataset.

Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_cn: 该论文针对少样本目标检测（FSOD）中标注数据稀缺的问题，探索如何利用基础模型（如 CLIP、DINO 等）的通用表征能力来提升检测性能。方法上，作者提出将基础模型的视觉-语言对齐能力与检测框架结合，通过冻结或轻量微调基础模型来缓解少样本场景下的过拟合。相比传统 FSOD 方法依赖元学习或复杂微调策略，该工作更强调基础模型提供的零样本/少样本迁移能力。摘要未提供具体实验数据，需进一步阅读全文确认在 PASCAL VOC 和 COCO 少样本基准上的提升幅度。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot object detection (FSOD) by leveraging foundation models to overcome the scarcity of annotated data. It proposes to integrate the visual-linguistic alignment capabilities of foundation models with detection frameworks, using frozen or lightly fine-tuned backbones to mitigate overfitting in low-data regimes. Compared with conventional meta-learning or complex fine-tuning strategies, the approach emphasizes the transferability of foundation models for zero-/few-shot detection, though specific benchmark numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.assessment: 将基础模型引入少样本检测是当前热点方向，思路合理，但需关注其在实际自动驾驶长尾场景中的泛化性与推理成本。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.contribution: 提出了一种利用基础模型通用表征进行少样本目标检测的框架。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.innovation: 将视觉-语言基础模型的迁移能力系统性地引入 FSOD 任务，减少对大量标注样本的依赖。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，需全文验证其在标准 FSOD 基准上的表现。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundation Models.

2503.01463|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有 DETR 类模型普遍采用的级联解码器架构限制 object query 只能沿级联方向更新、难以充分利用图像特征的问题，本文提出并行 Multi-time Inquiries (MI) 解码器机制，使 object query 能学习更全面的信息。基于 MI 构建的 MI-DETR 在 COCO 上于不同 backbone 和训练 epoch 设置下均超越现有 DETR 类模型，在 ResNet-50 下相比代表性模型 DINO 和 SOTA 模型 Relation-DETR 分别提升 +2.3 AP 和 +0.6 AP。诊断与可视化实验进一步验证了 MI 的有效性、合理性与可解释性。
2503.01463|v2.summary_en: This paper analyzes the limitation of cascaded decoder architectures in DETR-like models, where object queries can only be updated along the cascade direction and thus learn limited information from image features. It proposes a parallel Multi-time Inquiries (MI) decoder mechanism that enables queries to aggregate more comprehensive information. MI-DETR outperforms all existing DETR-like models on COCO across backbones and training schedules, achieving +2.3 AP over DINO and +0.6 AP over Relation-DETR with ResNet-50, supported by diagnostic and visualization analyses.
2503.01463|v2.assessment: 对 DETR 解码器结构提出简洁有效的并行查询机制，在 COCO 上取得一致提升，对检测架构研究有直接参考价值。
2503.01463|v2.contribution: 提出并行 Multi-time Inquiries 解码器架构，突破级联解码器对 object query 信息更新的方向性限制。
2503.01463|v2.innovation: 将 object query 的更新从级联串行改为并行多轮询问，使查询能更充分利用图像特征。
2503.01463|v2.result: 在 COCO 上 ResNet-50 backbone 下较 DINO 提升 +2.3 AP、较 Relation-DETR 提升 +0.6 AP。

2412.06647|v2.summary_cn: 针对事件流目标检测中现有 SNN、Transformer 与 CNN 检测器分别存在性能受限、计算开销大或局部感受野有限的问题，本文提出基于 MoE 热传导的检测算法，用 stem 网络嵌入事件数据，经 MoE-HCO 块（多专家模块模拟事件流热传导）处理，再用 IoU-based query selection 提取 token 送入检测头。同时发布基于 Prophesee EVK4-HD 采集的 EvDET200K 事件检测基准数据集，在精度与计算效率间取得良好平衡。
2412.06647|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of existing event-based detectors (restricted performance of SNNs, high cost of Transformers, limited receptive fields of CNNs), this paper proposes a Mixture-of-Experts heat-conduction-based detector. It uses a stem network for event embedding, MoE-HCO blocks with multiple experts mimicking heat conduction, and an IoU-based query selection module feeding a detection head. It also introduces EvDET200K, a new benchmark captured with a Prophesee EVK4-HD camera, balancing accuracy and computational efficiency.
2412.06647|v2.assessment: 将 MoE 与热传导建模引入事件相机检测，并配套大规模数据集，对事件感知与检测交叉方向有参考意义。
2412.06647|v2.contribution: 提出 MoE 热传导检测算法并发布 EvDET200K 事件相机目标检测基准数据集。
2412.06647|v2.innovation: 用多专家模块模拟事件流中的热传导过程，并结合 IoU-based query selection 实现精度与效率平衡。
2412.06647|v2.result: 在精度与计算效率之间取得良好平衡，并提供基于 Prophesee EVK4-HD 的大规模事件检测数据集。

2510.13620|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有 UAV 可见光-红外目标检测数据集成像条件覆盖不足、难以反映真实世界复杂性的问题，本文构建高多样性数据集 ATR-UMOD，覆盖 80m-300m 高度、0°-75° 角度及全天候全年的丰富天气与光照条件，并为每对 RGB-IR 图像标注 6 个条件属性。方法上提出 prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF)，将成像条件编码为文本 prompt，通过任务特定的 soft-gating 变换自适应重分配多模态贡献，并用 prompt-guided condition-decoupling 模块保证可用性。
2510.13620|v2.summary_en: Existing UAV RGB-IR detection datasets insufficiently capture real-world imaging diversity. This paper introduces ATR-UMOD, a high-diversity dataset spanning 80-300m altitudes, 0-75° angles, and all-day/all-year weather and illumination, with 6 condition attributes annotated per RGB-IR pair. It proposes prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF), which encodes imaging conditions as text prompts and uses task-specific soft-gating to adaptively reweight multimodal contributions, with a prompt-guided condition-decoupling module for robustness.
2510.13620|v2.assessment: 数据集多样性突出且引入条件 prompt 引导融合，对多模态感知与 UAV 检测研究有较高实用价值。
2510.13620|v2.contribution: 构建高多样性 UAV RGB-IR 检测数据集 ATR-UMOD 并提出 prompt 引导的条件感知动态融合方法 PCDF。
2510.13620|v2.innovation: 将成像条件编码为文本 prompt，通过 soft-gating 变换建模条件与多模态贡献之间的关系。
2510.13620|v2.result: 在覆盖多高度、多角度、多天气光照条件的数据集上验证了条件感知融合的有效性。

2506.23575|v2.summary_cn: 针对反无人机任务中小目标检测因目标尺寸小、背景复杂而困难，且现有事件相机数据集规模小、目标大、背景单一不适合小目标检测的问题，本文提出首个大规模高多样性事件小目标检测基准 EV-UAV，含 147 个序列、超 230 万事件级标注，目标平均仅 6.8×5.4 像素，覆盖城市杂乱与极端光照场景。基于小运动目标在时空事件点云中形成连续曲线的观察，提出 EV-SpSegNet 稀疏分割网络作为基线。
2506.23575|v2.summary_en: Small object detection for anti-UAV is challenging due to tiny targets and cluttered backgrounds, while existing event-based datasets are small-scale with large targets and limited backgrounds. This paper introduces EV-UAV, the first large-scale, highly diverse event-based small object detection benchmark with 147 sequences, over 2.3 million event-level annotations, and targets averaging 6.8×5.4 pixels. Observing that small moving targets form continuous curves in spatiotemporal event point clouds, it proposes EV-SpSegNet as a sparse segmentation baseline.
2506.23575|v2.assessment: 填补事件相机小目标检测基准空白，数据规模与目标尺寸挑战性强，对事件感知与反无人机研究有重要价值。
2506.23575|v2.contribution: 发布首个大规模事件小目标检测基准 EV-UAV 并提出 EV-SpSegNet 基线。
2506.23575|v2.innovation: 利用小运动目标在时空事件点云中形成连续曲线的特性设计稀疏分割网络。
2506.23575|v2.result: 构建含 147 序列、230 万+ 事件级标注、平均目标 6.8×5.4 像素的基准并给出基线性能。

Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅从标题判断，本文针对实时开放词汇目标检测中模型容量与推理效率的平衡问题，提出 Dynamic-DINO，将细粒度 Mixture of Experts 微调引入实时开放词汇检测框架。其思路应是在 DINO 类开放词汇检测器上通过细粒度 MoE 调优提升多类别与开放场景下的检测能力，同时保持实时性。具体方法细节、改进幅度与实验数据因摘要缺失无法确认。
Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex.summary_en: With the abstract unavailable, the title indicates this work addresses real-time open-vocabulary object detection by introducing fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts tuning into a DINO-style detector, termed Dynamic-DINO. The approach likely aims to improve open-vocabulary detection capacity while preserving real-time inference. Specific methodology, improvements, and experimental results cannot be verified due to the missing abstract.
Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex.assessment: 开放词汇检测与 MoE 微调结合的方向有潜力，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法细节与实验充分度，需查阅原文。
Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex.contribution: 提出面向实时开放词汇目标检测的细粒度 Mixture of Experts 微调方法 Dynamic-DINO。
Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex.innovation: 将细粒度 MoE 调优引入实时开放词汇检测框架以平衡容量与效率。
Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex._arxiv_id: Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Experts Tuning for Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Sup.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅从标题判断，本文针对 DETR 类模型在半监督目标检测中伪标签质量与教师-学生框架利用不足的问题，提出 STEP-DETR，引入 Super Teacher 与伪标签引导的文本查询机制。其思路应是通过更强的教师模型生成高质量伪标签，并用文本查询引导 DETR 解码器利用伪标签信息，从而提升半监督检测性能。具体方法、改进幅度与实验数据因摘要缺失无法确认。
STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Sup.summary_en: With the abstract unavailable, the title suggests this work targets semi-supervised object detection with DETR-based models, proposing STEP-DETR with a Super Teacher and pseudo-label-guided text queries. The approach likely leverages a stronger teacher to produce higher-quality pseudo-labels and uses text queries to guide the DETR decoder. Specific methodology, gains, and experimental results cannot be verified due to the missing abstract.
STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Sup.assessment: 半监督 DETR 检测与文本查询结合的方向较新颖，但摘要缺失使方法质量与实验充分度无法评估，需查阅原文。
STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Sup.contribution: 提出结合 Super Teacher 与伪标签引导文本查询的 DETR 半监督目标检测框架 STEP-DETR。
STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Sup.innovation: 用伪标签引导的文本查询增强 DETR 在半监督设定下对伪标签信息的利用。

When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_cn: 针对小样本目标检测（FSOD）中ViT特征对像素级差异不敏感的问题，论文提出PiDiViT，将像素差异模式（Pixel Difference Patterns）引入ViT架构以增强局部判别能力。方法通过显式建模相邻像素差异并与ViT token交互，弥补ViT在少样本场景下对细粒度纹理和边缘的感知不足。相比已有基于CNN或纯ViT的FSOD方法，PiDiViT在保持ViT全局建模优势的同时提升了局部敏感度。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，但思路对少样本检测的骨干设计有参考价值。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_en: This paper addresses the insensitivity of ViT features to pixel-level differences in few-shot object detection (FSOD). It proposes PiDiViT, which integrates pixel difference patterns into the ViT architecture to enhance local discriminability. Compared with existing CNN- or ViT-based FSOD methods, PiDiViT preserves global modeling while improving sensitivity to fine-grained textures and edges. The abstract lacks quantitative results, but the idea is relevant for backbone design in few-shot detection.
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.assessment: 将像素差异先验注入ViT以提升少样本检测的局部判别力，思路新颖，但需关注其实际精度提升与计算开销。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.contribution: 提出PiDiViT，将像素差异模式与ViT结合用于小样本目标检测。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.innovation: 在ViT中显式建模像素差异模式以增强局部细粒度感知。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，效果需进一步验证。

DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_cn: 针对跨域小样本目标检测（CD-FSOD）中模型在新域上需重训练的问题，论文提出一种无需重训练的混合框架，将DETR与视觉基础模型（Vision Foundation Models）结合。方法利用基础模型的开放词汇/零样本能力与DETR的检测结构，在跨域少样本场景下直接适配而无需微调。相比需要域内重训练或大量标注的已有方法，该框架强调即插即用与免重训练。摘要未提供具体数值，但免重训练特性对实际部署有吸引力。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_en: This paper targets cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD) where models typically require retraining on new domains. It proposes a retraining-free mixture of DETR and vision foundation models, leveraging the open-vocabulary/zero-shot capabilities of foundation models with DETR's detection structure. Compared with methods requiring in-domain retraining or heavy annotation, the framework emphasizes plug-and-play adaptation. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, but the retraining-free property is practically appealing.
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.assessment: 免重训练的DETR与基础模型混合方案对跨域少样本检测部署有实用价值，但需验证其精度与泛化边界。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.contribution: 提出一种无需重训练的DETR与视觉基础模型混合框架用于跨域小样本检测。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.innovation: 利用基础模型开放词汇能力实现免重训练的跨域少样本适配。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，免重训练特性为主要卖点。

2505.20612|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM在预训练分布外的类别、任务和成像模态上泛化差的问题，论文提出Roboflow100-VL，一个包含100个多模态目标检测数据集的大规模基准，覆盖VLM预训练中罕见的概念。作者主张通过包含少量视觉示例和丰富文本描述的标注指令将VLM对齐到新概念，并在零样本、少样本、半监督和全监督设置下评估SOTA模型。实验发现GroundingDINO和Qwen2.5-VL在挑战性医学影像数据集上零样本精度不足2%，凸显少样本概念对齐的必要性，并分享了CVPR 2025 Foundational FSOD竞赛的洞见。
2505.20612|v2.summary_en: To address VLMs' poor generalization to out-of-distribution classes, tasks, and imaging modalities, this paper introduces Roboflow100-VL, a large-scale benchmark of 100 multi-modal object detection datasets covering concepts rare in VLM pre-training. The authors advocate aligning VLMs to new concepts via annotation instructions with few visual examples and rich textual descriptions, and evaluate state-of-the-art models in zero-shot, few-shot, semi-supervised, and fully-supervised settings. Notably, GroundingDINO and Qwen2.5-VL achieve less than 2% zero-shot accuracy on challenging medical imaging datasets, underscoring the need for few-shot concept alignment, with insights from the CVPR 2025 Foundational FSOD competition.
2505.20612|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了VLM在开放域检测评估上的空白，零样本<2%的结果对社区有强警示意义，值得关注。
2505.20612|v2.contribution: 构建Roboflow100-VL大规模多模态检测基准并系统评估VLM在多种数据设置下的泛化能力。
2505.20612|v2.innovation: 提出以少量视觉示例加丰富文本描述的指令对齐新概念，并覆盖100个多域数据集。
2505.20612|v2.result: GroundingDINO与Qwen2.5-VL在医学影像上零样本精度不足2%，证明少样本概念对齐的必要性。

2503.18430|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模词汇目标检测中分类器的正梯度稀释（稀有正类学习信号不足）和难负梯度稀释（判别梯度被大量易负样本淹没）问题，论文提出CQ-DINO，将分类重构为物体查询与可学习类别查询之间的对比任务。方法引入图像引导的查询选择，通过交叉注意力自适应检索每张图top-K相关类别以减少负空间，从而重平衡梯度分布并隐式挖掘难例。CQ-DINO还能在结构化数据集（如V3Det）中整合显式层级类别关系，或在通用数据集（如COCO）中通过自注意力学习隐式类别关联。实验表明其在挑战性基准上取得优越性能。
2503.18430|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies positive gradient dilution (rare positives receive insufficient learning signals) and hard negative gradient dilution (discriminative gradients overwhelmed by easy negatives) in classification-based detectors for vast-vocabulary object detection. It proposes CQ-DINO, which reformulates classification as a contrastive task between object queries and learnable category queries, with image-guided query selection retrieving top-K relevant categories per image via cross-attention to rebalance gradients and implicitly mine hard examples. CQ-DINO integrates explicit hierarchical category relationships on structured datasets (e.g., V3Det) or learns implicit correlations via self-attention on generic datasets (e.g., COCO), achieving superior performance on challenging benchmarks.
2503.18430|v2.assessment: 从梯度稀释角度剖析大规模词汇检测的痛点，类别查询对比学习方案设计合理，对开放词汇检测有借鉴意义。
2503.18430|v2.contribution: 提出CQ-DINO，以类别查询对比学习缓解大规模词汇检测中的梯度稀释问题。
2503.18430|v2.innovation: 将分类重构为物体查询与可学习类别查询的对比任务，并用图像引导查询选择减少负空间。
2503.18430|v2.result: 在挑战性大规模词汇检测基准上取得优越性能。

2411.17761|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界3D感知缺乏全面基准与鲁棒通用方法的问题，论文提出OpenAD，首个面向3D目标检测的真实开放世界自动驾驶基准。OpenAD基于结合多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的corner case发现与标注流水线，在五个自动驾驶感知数据集的2000个场景中以统一格式标注corner case物体，并设计评估方法对多种开放世界与专用2D/3D模型进行评测。作者进一步提出视觉中心的3D开放世界检测基线，并引入融合通用与专用模型的集成方法以缓解现有开放世界方法精度偏低的问题，同时在EvalAI上举办在线挑战。
2411.17761|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of comprehensive open-world 3D perception benchmarks and robust generalizable methods, this paper introduces OpenAD, the first real open-world autonomous driving benchmark for 3D object detection. Built on a corner-case discovery and annotation pipeline integrating a multimodal large language model (MLLM), OpenAD annotates corner-case objects in a unified format across five autonomous driving perception datasets with 2000 scenarios, and devises evaluation methodologies for various open-world and specialized 2D/3D models. The authors propose a vision-centric 3D open-world detection baseline and an ensemble method fusing general and specialized models to mitigate low precision of existing open-world methods, hosting an online challenge on EvalAI.
2411.17761|v2.assessment: 首个真实开放世界3D检测基准，结合MLLM标注corner case并给出基线与集成方案，对自动驾驶开放世界感知研究极具价值。
2411.17761|v2.contribution: 构建OpenAD开放世界自动驾驶3D检测基准，并提出视觉中心基线与通用-专用模型集成方法。
2411.17761|v2.innovation: 利用MLLM驱动的corner case发现与标注流水线，统一五个数据集的2000个场景标注。
2411.17761|v2.result: 提供首个真实开放世界3D检测基准与在线挑战，集成方法缓解了现有开放世界方法精度偏低的问题。

2501.16665|v2.summary_cn: 针对X射线图像中物体重叠导致的前景-背景特征耦合问题，论文提出类别语义先验对比学习（CSPCL）机制，用于基于Deformable DETR的违禁品检测器。方法将分类器感知的类别原型与内容查询对齐，以修正和补充分类所需的缺失语义信息，从而增强模型对前景特征的敏感度。为此设计了CSP损失，包含类内截断吸引（ITA）损失和类间自适应排斥（IAR）损失，其中ITA利用类别原型吸引类内内容查询并通过梯度截断保留类内多样性，IAR按原型间相似度自适应排斥类间查询。摘要未给出具体数值，但CSP损失优于经典对比损失。
2501.16665|v2.summary_en: To address foreground-background feature coupling caused by overlapping objects in X-ray images, this paper proposes a Category Semantic Prior Contrastive Learning (CSPCL) mechanism for Deformable DETR-based prohibited item detectors. CSPCL aligns class prototypes perceived by the classifier with content queries to correct and supplement missing semantic information for classification, enhancing sensitivity to foreground features. It designs a CSP loss comprising Intra-Class Truncated Attraction (ITA) and Inter-Class Adaptive Repulsion (IAR) losses, where ITA attracts intra-class content queries via class prototypes while preserving diversity through gradient truncation, and IAR adaptively repels inter-class queries scaled by prototype-prototype similarity. The CSP loss outperforms classic contrastive losses.
2501.16665|v2.assessment: 面向X射线违禁品检测的领域特定方法，CSP损失设计细致，对重叠场景下的特征解耦有参考价值，但领域较窄。
2501.16665|v2.contribution: 提出CSPCL机制与CSP损失，用于Deformable DETR的X射线违禁品检测。
2501.16665|v2.innovation: 通过类别原型与内容查询对齐，并设计ITA与IAR损失缓解前景-背景特征耦合。
2501.16665|v2.result: CSP损失优于经典对比损失，摘要未给出具体检测精度数值。

Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界目标检测中新颖物体检测的问题，提出了一种统一的物体性建模方法。方法通过建模物体性（objectness）来统一处理已知和未知类别的检测，可能利用视觉语言模型或自监督特征来泛化到新类别。相比已有封闭集检测器，该方法在开放世界设定下能更好地发现和定位未见过的物体。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方向对自动驾驶中处理未知障碍物具有重要意义。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.summary_en: This paper addresses novel object detection in open-world settings by proposing a unified objectness modeling approach. The method models objectness to unify detection of known and unknown categories, potentially leveraging vision-language models or self-supervised features for generalization. Compared to closed-set detectors, it better discovers and localizes unseen objects, which is crucial for autonomous driving to handle unknown obstacles.
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.assessment: 开放世界检测是自动驾驶感知的关键挑战，该工作提出的统一物体性建模思路新颖，值得关注。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.contribution: 提出开放世界物体性建模框架，统一新颖物体检测。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.innovation: 将物体性建模作为开放世界检测的统一表示。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在开放世界设定下具有潜力。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N._arxiv_id: Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies Novel Object Detection.

2503.15293|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测模型的后门攻击问题，提出了测试时后门检测方法TRACE。方法基于两个观察：中毒样本在不同背景下检测结果更一致，而干净样本在不同焦点信息下检测一致性更高。TRACE对测试样本进行前景和背景变换，通过计算变换一致性来检测中毒样本。相比现有防御方法，TRACE能更好地应对目标检测中复杂的攻击效果（如幽灵物体或物体消失），但摘要未提供具体检测指标。
2503.15293|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses backdoor attacks in object detection models by proposing TRACE, a test-time poisoned sample detection method. Based on two observations—poisoned samples show more consistent detections across backgrounds, while clean samples show higher consistency under different focal information—TRACE applies foreground and background transformations and computes transformation consistency. It better handles complex attack effects like ghost or vanishing objects compared to existing defenses, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
2503.15293|v2.assessment: 目标检测后门防御是安全关键领域的重要问题，TRACE利用变换一致性提供了新思路。
2503.15293|v2.contribution: 提出基于变换一致性的测试时后门检测方法TRACE。
2503.15293|v2.innovation: 利用前景/背景变换下检测一致性差异检测中毒样本。
2503.15293|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体检测指标，但方法针对目标检测特有挑战设计。

ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.summary_cn: 该论文针对旋转目标检测问题，提出了旋转等变扩散模型ReDiffDet。方法将扩散模型与旋转等变性结合，用于定向目标检测，可能通过扩散过程生成旋转等变的特征表示。相比传统非等变检测器，ReDiffDet能更好地处理任意方向的目标，提升旋转不变性和检测精度。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但旋转等变扩散模型在遥感、自动驾驶等领域有广泛应用前景。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.summary_en: This paper addresses oriented object detection by proposing ReDiffDet, a rotation-equivariant diffusion model. The method integrates diffusion models with rotation equivariance for oriented object detection, potentially generating rotation-equivariant feature representations through the diffusion process. Compared to non-equivariant detectors, ReDiffDet better handles arbitrarily oriented objects, improving rotation invariance and detection accuracy. Specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract.
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.assessment: 旋转等变与扩散模型的结合在定向目标检测中具有创新性，对自动驾驶中的旋转物体检测有参考价值。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.contribution: 提出旋转等变扩散模型ReDiffDet用于定向目标检测。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.innovation: 将扩散模型与旋转等变性结合，提升定向检测性能。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在旋转目标检测上具有潜力。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio._arxiv_id: ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusion Model for Oriented Object Detection.

SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应目标检测问题，提出了语义熵引导的域感知注意力方法SEEN-DA。方法利用语义熵来引导注意力机制，使模型关注域不变特征，从而提升跨域检测性能。相比现有域自适应方法，SEEN-DA通过语义熵量化不确定性，更有效地对齐源域和目标域的特征分布。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方法在自动驾驶等跨域场景中具有应用价值。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.summary_en: This paper addresses domain adaptive object detection by proposing SEEN-DA, a semantic entropy guided domain-aware attention method. The approach uses semantic entropy to guide attention, focusing on domain-invariant features to improve cross-domain detection. Compared to existing domain adaptation methods, SEEN-DA quantifies uncertainty via semantic entropy to better align source and target feature distributions. Specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract.
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.assessment: 域自适应检测对自动驾驶在不同环境下的部署至关重要，语义熵引导的注意力机制提供了新思路。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.contribution: 提出语义熵引导的域感知注意力方法SEEN-DA。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.innovation: 利用语义熵量化不确定性以引导域不变特征学习。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在跨域检测上具有潜力。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-._arxiv_id: SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-aware Attention for Domain Adaptive Object Detection.

Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.summary_cn: 该论文针对增量目标检测问题，提出了学习内生注意力的方法。方法通过设计内生注意力机制，使模型在学习新类别时能够关注与旧类别相关的特征，从而缓解灾难性遗忘。相比现有增量检测方法，该方法通过注意力机制更好地平衡新旧类别的学习，提升增量检测性能。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但增量学习对自动驾驶中持续适应新场景具有重要意义。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.summary_en: This paper addresses incremental object detection by proposing a method to learn endogenous attention. The approach designs an endogenous attention mechanism that focuses on features relevant to old classes when learning new ones, mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Compared to existing incremental detection methods, it better balances learning of new and old classes via attention, improving incremental detection performance. Specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract.
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.assessment: 增量目标检测是自动驾驶持续学习的关键，内生注意力机制为缓解遗忘提供了新视角。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.contribution: 提出学习内生注意力的增量目标检测方法。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.innovation: 通过内生注意力机制平衡新旧类别学习，缓解遗忘。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在增量检测上具有潜力。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm._arxiv_id: Learning Endogenous Attention for Incremental Object Detection.

2502.04268|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点监督定向目标检测问题，提出了Point2RBox-v2，利用实例间的空间布局进行学习。方法包含三个核心原则：高斯重叠损失学习实例上界，Voronoi分水岭损失学习下界，一致性损失学习尺寸/旋转变化，并辅以边缘损失和复制粘贴等技术。相比已有方法，这是首个探索实例间空间布局用于点监督定向检测的工作，在DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M上达到62.61%/86.15%/34.71%的精度，尤其在密集场景中表现优异。
2502.04268|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses point-supervised oriented object detection by proposing Point2RBox-v2, which leverages spatial layout among instances. The method introduces three principles: Gaussian overlap loss for instance upper bound, Voronoi watershed loss for lower bound, and consistency loss for size/rotation variation, supplemented by edge loss and copy-paste. As the first to explore instance spatial layout for point-supervised OOD, it achieves 62.61%/86.15%/34.71% on DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M, excelling in densely packed scenes.
2502.04268|v2.assessment: 该工作首次利用实例间空间布局进行点监督定向检测，在多个数据集上取得优异性能，对自动驾驶中的密集目标检测有重要参考价值。
2502.04268|v2.contribution: 提出Point2RBox-v2，首次利用实例间空间布局进行点监督定向目标检测。
2502.04268|v2.innovation: 结合高斯重叠损失、Voronoi分水岭损失和一致性损失，学习实例空间布局。

2503.12009|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中Transformer框架将3D体素序列化为1D序列时破坏空间结构、且因体素数量大而分组导致感受野受限的问题，本文提出Unified Mamba（UniMamba），将3D卷积与状态空间模型（SSM）以多头方式融合，实现高效的局部与全局空间上下文聚合。其核心UniMamba块包含空间局部性建模、互补Z-order序列化和局部-全局序列聚合器，其中空间局部性建模模块用3D子流形卷积捕获动态空间结构。相比Transformer方法，该方法在保持全局依赖建模的同时避免了序列化带来的结构破坏和二次复杂度问题。摘要未给出具体数据集上的数值结果，但声称在LiDAR 3D检测上实现了高效且同时的局部-全局聚合。
2503.12009|v2.summary_en: To address the destruction of 3D voxel spatial structure during serialization and the limited receptive field caused by grouping in Transformer-based LiDAR 3D detection, this paper proposes Unified Mamba (UniMamba), which seamlessly integrates 3D convolution and State Space Models in a multi-head manner for efficient local and global spatial context aggregation. The UniMamba block consists of spatial locality modeling, complementary Z-order serialization, and a local-global sequential aggregator, where 3D submanifold convolution captures dynamic spatial structure. Compared with Transformer-based methods, it avoids structural destruction and quadratic complexity while maintaining global dependency modeling. No specific numerical results are reported in the abstract.
2503.12009|v2.assessment: 将Mamba/SSM引入LiDAR 3D检测是一个有前景的方向，UniMamba在局部-全局聚合上的设计思路清晰，值得关注其在nuScenes等基准上的实际表现。
2503.12009|v2.contribution: 提出UniMamba，将3D卷积与SSM以多头方式统一，实现LiDAR 3D检测中高效的局部-全局空间上下文聚合。
2503.12009|v2.innovation: 设计包含空间局部性建模、互补Z-order序列化和局部-全局序列聚合器的UniMamba块，用3D子流形卷积捕获动态空间结构。
2503.12009|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称在LiDAR 3D检测上实现高效且同时的局部与全局聚合。

2410.11774|v2.summary_cn: 针对真实数据集长尾分布导致稀有类别检测困难的问题，现有重加权和重采样方法仅利用类别频率统计而忽略类别在图像空间中的分布信息。本文提出FRActal CALibration（FRACAL），一种无需训练的后校准方法，利用分形维数估计类别在图像空间中分布的均匀程度，并在推理时用分形维数反向降低均匀间隔类别预测的概率，从而在频繁/稀有类别和均匀/稀疏间隔类别两个维度上实现平衡。FRACAL可即插即用地结合一阶段sigmoid检测器和两阶段实例分割模型，显著提升稀有类别性能（摘要提到提升幅度但未给出完整数值）。
2410.11774|v2.summary_en: To address long-tailed object detection where rare categories are hard to detect, existing re-weighting and re-sampling methods rely only on class frequency statistics and ignore the spatial distribution of classes in images. This paper proposes FRActal CALibration (FRACAL), a training-free post-calibration method that uses fractal dimension to estimate how uniformly classes are distributed in image space and inversely downweights probabilities of uniformly spaced class predictions during inference, balancing frequent vs. rare and uniformly vs. sparsely spaced classes. FRACAL can be combined with off-the-shelf one-stage sigmoid detectors and two-stage instance segmentation models, boosting rare class performance (exact numbers truncated in the abstract).
2410.11774|v2.assessment: 从图像空间分布角度切入长尾检测是一个新颖视角，FRACAL作为免训练后处理方法实用性强，值得在长尾检测场景中尝试。
2410.11774|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的后校准方法FRACAL，利用分形维数建模类别在图像空间中的分布以缓解长尾检测问题。
2410.11774|v2.innovation: 首次用分形维数估计类别在图像空间分布的均匀性，并据此在推理时调整类别预测概率。
2410.11774|v2.result: 可即插即用于多种检测/分割模型，显著提升稀有类别性能（摘要中具体数值被截断）。

2502.19630|v2.summary_cn: 现有 3D 目标检测依赖 LiDAR 与相机的固定帧率同步数据，受限于传感器延迟与带宽，无法在帧间间隔内输出检测结果，难以满足自动驾驶对低延迟的需求。本文首次将异步事件相机引入 3D 目标检测，利用其高时间分辨率与低带宽特性，在同步数据缺失的帧间时刻通过事件相机回溯前一帧的 3D 信息，实现高速检测。作者还构建了首个事件相机 3D 检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD，提供 100 FPS 的 3D 真值框，建立了事件 3D 检测器的首个基准。该工作为突破帧率限制的时序 3D 感知提供了新范式与评测平台。
2502.19630|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D object detectors rely on synchronized fixed-frame-rate LiDAR and camera data, which suffer from latency and bandwidth limits and cannot produce detections during inter-frame intervals. This paper introduces asynchronous event cameras into 3D object detection for the first time, exploiting their high temporal resolution and low bandwidth to retrieve previous 3D information and enable high-speed detection when synchronized data is unavailable. The authors also release DSEC-3DOD, the first event-based 3D detection dataset with ground-truth 3D boxes at 100 FPS, establishing the first benchmark for event-based 3D detectors.
2502.19630|v2.assessment: 首次将事件相机用于 3D 目标检测并配套发布 100 FPS 真值数据集，为突破固定帧率传感器时序瓶颈提供了新思路与基准，值得时序感知方向的研究者关注。
2502.19630|v2.contribution: 首次将异步事件相机引入 3D 目标检测，并提出首个事件 3D 检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD 与基准。
2502.19630|v2.innovation: 利用事件相机高时间分辨率在帧间间隔内回溯 3D 信息，实现超越同步帧率的检测。
2502.19630|v2.result: 构建了含 100 FPS 3D 真值框的 DSEC-3DOD 数据集，建立了事件 3D 检测的首个评测基准。

IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.summary_en: This paper addresses stereo-based 3D object detection by proposing IDA-3D, which incorporates instance-depth awareness into the detection pipeline. It jointly optimizes instance-level depth estimation and 3D bounding box regression to improve localization from stereo images. Compared to prior stereo 3D detectors, it explicitly models per-instance depth rather than relying on global disparity maps, achieving competitive results on KITTI.

2001.10692|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D检测中稀疏、缺乏颜色和噪声等问题，提出ImVoteNet，通过融合图像2D投票和点云3D投票来增强检测。方法上从图像中提取几何和语义特征，利用相机参数提升到3D空间，并设计多塔训练方案促进2D-3D特征融合。相比已有方法，在SUN RGB-D数据集上mAP提升了5.7，显著优于仅用点云的VoteNet。
2001.10692|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of point clouds (sparsity, lack of color, noise) by proposing ImVoteNet, which fuses 2D image votes with 3D point cloud votes for RGB-D 3D detection. It extracts geometric and semantic features from images, lifts them to 3D using camera parameters, and employs a multi-tower training scheme for better fusion. It advances state-of-the-art on SUN RGB-D by 5.7 mAP over VoteNet.
2001.10692|v2.assessment: 该工作有效融合图像与点云信息，在RGB-D 3D检测上取得显著提升，对多模态3D检测有重要参考价值。
2001.10692|v2.contribution: 提出融合2D图像投票与3D点云投票的ImVoteNet检测框架。
2001.10692|v2.innovation: 显式提取图像几何与语义特征并提升到3D，结合多塔训练增强融合。

2004.03080|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对伪LiDAR（PL）方法中深度估计与3D检测网络需分开训练的问题，提出基于可微Change of Representation（CoR）模块的端到端框架。方法上允许整个PL流程端到端训练，兼容现有深度估计和3D检测网络。相比分开训练，结合PointRCNN在KITTI图像3D检测排行榜上取得当时最高成绩，持续优于PL基线。
2004.03080|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the separate training of depth estimation and 3D detection networks in pseudo-LiDAR (PL) pipelines by introducing differentiable Change of Representation (CoR) modules for end-to-end training. The framework is compatible with state-of-the-art networks for both tasks. Combined with PointRCNN, it consistently improves over PL and achieved the highest entry on the KITTI image-based 3D detection leaderboard at submission time.
2004.03080|v2.assessment: 该工作实现了伪LiDAR流程的端到端训练，显著提升了图像3D检测性能，对低成本自动驾驶感知有重要意义。
2004.03080|v2.contribution: 提出可微CoR模块实现伪LiDAR端到端训练。
2004.03080|v2.innovation: 通过可微表示变换模块连接深度估计与3D检测，支持端到端优化。
2004.03080|v2.result: 在KITTI图像3D检测排行榜上取得当时最高成绩。

1912.13192|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D检测中体素CNN和PointNet各自局限，提出PV-RCNN框架，深度融合体素CNN和基于PointNet的集合抽象。方法上通过体素集合抽象模块提取关键点，并设计RoI-grid池化从关键点抽象提案特征。相比传统池化，RoI-grid特征点编码更丰富上下文，在KITTI和Waymo Open数据集上取得领先性能。
1912.13192|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes PV-RCNN, a 3D detection framework that deeply integrates 3D voxel CNN and PointNet-based set abstraction to learn discriminative point cloud features. It summarizes scenes into keypoints via voxel set abstraction and uses RoI-grid pooling to abstract proposal-specific features. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on both KITTI and Waymo Open datasets.
1912.13192|v2.assessment: PV-RCNN是3D检测领域的里程碑工作，融合体素与点云方法，性能卓越，对后续研究影响深远。
1912.13192|v2.contribution: 提出深度融合体素CNN与PointNet的PV-RCNN 3D检测框架。
1912.13192|v2.innovation: 体素集合抽象与RoI-grid池化，实现高效且上下文丰富的特征提取。
1912.13192|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo Open上取得领先性能。

2003.01251|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR点云3D检测，提出图神经网络Point-GNN，将点云编码为固定半径近邻图。方法上设计自动配准机制减少平移方差，并采用框合并与评分操作准确组合多顶点检测。在KITTI基准上，仅用点云即达到领先精度，甚至超越融合算法，展示了图神经网络在3D检测中的潜力。
2003.01251|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Point-GNN, a graph neural network for LiDAR point cloud 3D object detection. It encodes the point cloud as a fixed-radius near-neighbor graph, introduces an auto-registration mechanism to reduce translation variance, and designs box merging and scoring to combine detections. On KITTI, it achieves leading accuracy using point cloud alone, even surpassing fusion-based methods.
2003.01251|v2.assessment: Point-GNN为3D检测提供了新思路，图神经网络的应用展示了点云检测的潜力，性能优异。
2003.01251|v2.contribution: 提出基于图神经网络的Point-GNN 3D检测方法。
2003.01251|v2.innovation: 自动配准机制和框合并评分操作，提升图网络检测精度。
2003.01251|v2.result: 在KITTI上仅用点云达到领先精度，超越融合方法。

2004.03572|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对双目图像3D检测中全局视差图计算昂贵且未利用类别先验的问题，提出Disp R-CNN，设计实例视差估计网络iDispNet，仅预测感兴趣物体像素的视差并学习类别特定形状先验。方法上利用统计形状模型生成密集视差伪真值，无需LiDAR点云。在KITTI上，即使训练时无LiDAR真值，平均精度仍超越先前最优方法20%。
2004.03572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses stereo 3D detection by proposing Disp R-CNN, which uses an instance disparity estimation network (iDispNet) to predict disparity only for object pixels and learns category-specific shape priors. It generates dense disparity pseudo-ground-truth via a statistical shape model without LiDAR. On KITTI, it outperforms previous state-of-the-art by 20% in average precision even without LiDAR ground-truth during training.
2004.03572|v2.assessment: 该工作通过实例视差估计和形状先验，显著提升了双目3D检测精度，且减少了对LiDAR的依赖，具有实用价值。
2004.03572|v2.contribution: 提出基于实例视差估计和形状先验的Disp R-CNN双目3D检测系统。
2004.03572|v2.innovation: 仅预测物体像素视差并利用统计形状模型生成伪真值，无需LiDAR。
2004.03572|v2.result: 在KITTI上平均精度超越先前最优20%。

1911.10150|v2.summary_cn: 针对激光雷达与相机融合方法在主要基准上反而落后于纯激光雷达方法的问题，本文提出PointPainting顺序融合方法：将激光雷达点投影到图像语义分割输出上，把类别分数附加到每个点上，从而可直接输入任意纯激光雷达检测器。在KITTI和nuScenes上，PointRCNN、VoxelNet和PointPillars三种方法均获得大幅提升，其中PointRCNN的Painting版本在KITTI BEV检测任务上刷新了SOTA。消融实验还分析了语义分割质量与格式的影响，并展示了通过流水线最小化延迟。
1911.10150|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap that lidar-only methods outperform fusion methods on major benchmarks by proposing PointPainting, a sequential fusion approach that projects lidar points into image semantic segmentation outputs and appends class scores to each point. The painted point cloud can be fed into any lidar-only detector, yielding large improvements on PointRCNN, VoxelNet, and PointPillars on KITTI and nuScenes, with the painted PointRCNN setting a new state of the art on KITTI BEV detection. Ablations study the impact of segmentation quality and format, and demonstrate latency minimization via pipelining.
1911.10150|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的融合接口显著提升多种激光雷达检测器，是相机-激光雷达融合的重要基线，值得关注。
1911.10150|v2.contribution: 提出PointPainting顺序融合方法，将图像语义分割分数附加到激光雷达点上以增强任意纯激光雷达检测器。
1911.10150|v2.innovation: 通过将语义分割输出投影到点云并附加类别分数，实现与检测器无关的即插即用融合。
1911.10150|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上大幅提升PointRCNN、VoxelNet和PointPillars，PointRCNN的Painting版本在KITTI BEV检测上达到新SOTA。

2004.01389|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有激光雷达3D检测器多聚焦单帧、忽略连续点云帧时空信息的问题，本文提出端到端在线3D视频目标检测器，包含空间特征编码与时空特征聚合两部分。空间部分提出Pillar Message Passing Network（PMPNet），通过迭代消息传递自适应聚合邻域信息以扩大感受野；时空部分提出Attentive Spatiotemporal Transformer GRU（AST-GRU），在ConvGRU上加入注意力记忆门控，含空间Transformer注意力（STA）与时间Transformer注意力（TTA）分别强调前景与对齐动态目标。实验表明该3D视频检测器取得有效提升（摘要截断，具体数值未给出）。
2004.01389|v2.summary_en: To exploit spatiotemporal information in consecutive point cloud frames, this paper proposes an end-to-end online 3D video object detector with a spatial feature encoding component and a spatiotemporal aggregation component. The former introduces a Pillar Message Passing Network (PMPNet) that iteratively aggregates neighbor information to enlarge the receptive field, while the latter proposes an Attentive Spatiotemporal Transformer GRU (AST-GRU) with spatial and temporal transformer attention modules to emphasize foreground objects and align dynamic objects. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed 3D video detector.
2004.01389|v2.assessment: 将消息传递与时空Transformer注意力引入在线3D视频检测，思路清晰，对多帧点云检测有参考价值。
2004.01389|v2.contribution: 提出端到端在线3D视频目标检测器，包含PMPNet空间编码与AST-GRU时空聚合。
2004.01389|v2.innovation: 用迭代消息传递扩大柱特征感受野，并以空间/时间Transformer注意力增强ConvGRU的前景强调与动态对齐。
2004.01389|v2.result: 实验表明所提3D视频检测器取得有效性能提升（摘要截断，具体数值未给出）。

1912.11803|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测依赖大规模高质量标注、标注昂贵的问题，本文提出SESS自集成半监督3D目标检测框架。方法设计了全面的扰动方案以增强网络在无标注和新数据上的泛化，并提出三种一致性损失，强制两组预测3D候选框之间保持一致，从而学习物体的结构与语义不变性。在SUN RGB-D和ScanNet上验证了归纳与直推两种半监督设置下的有效性，仅用50%标注数据即达到与SOTA全监督方法相当的性能。
1912.11803|v2.summary_en: To alleviate the reliance on large-scale high-quality 3D annotations, this paper proposes SESS, a self-ensembling semi-supervised 3D object detection framework. It designs a thorough perturbation scheme to improve generalization on unlabeled and unseen data, and introduces three consistency losses enforcing consistency between two sets of predicted 3D proposals to learn structural and semantic invariances. Experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScanNet show that SESS with only 50% labeled data achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art fully-supervised methods.
1912.11803|v2.assessment: 较早将自集成半监督学习引入3D检测，50%标注即接近全监督性能，对降低标注成本有实际意义。
1912.11803|v2.contribution: 提出SESS自集成半监督3D目标检测框架，用扰动方案与一致性损失利用无标注数据。
1912.11803|v2.innovation: 设计全面扰动方案与三种针对3D候选框的一致性损失，学习物体的结构与语义不变性。
1912.11803|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScanNet上，仅用50%标注数据即达到与SOTA全监督方法相当的性能。

1903.11027|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中目标检测与跟踪需要同时包含相机与测距传感器数据的大规模数据集的问题，本文提出nuScenes数据集，是首个包含完整自动驾驶传感器套件的数据集：6个相机、5个雷达和1个激光雷达，均具360度视场。nuScenes包含1000个场景，每个20秒，对23个类别和8个属性进行完整3D框标注，标注量是KITTI的7倍、图像数是其100倍。论文定义了新的3D检测与跟踪指标，提供数据集分析以及激光雷达和图像检测/跟踪基线。
1903.11027|v2.summary_en: To address the need for large-scale datasets containing both cameras and range sensors for autonomous driving detection and tracking, this paper presents nuScenes, the first dataset with a full autonomous vehicle sensor suite: 6 cameras, 5 radars, and 1 lidar, all with 360-degree field of view. nuScenes comprises 1000 scenes of 20s each, fully annotated with 3D bounding boxes for 23 classes and 8 attributes, with 7x as many annotations and 100x as many images as KITTI. It defines novel 3D detection and tracking metrics and provides dataset analysis plus lidar and image based baselines.
1903.11027|v2.assessment: nuScenes已成为多模态自动驾驶感知的核心基准，其传感器配置与标注规模极大推动了3D检测与跟踪研究。
1903.11027|v2.contribution: 发布nuScenes——首个包含6相机、5雷达、1激光雷达完整传感器套件的大规模自动驾驶多模态数据集。
1903.11027|v2.innovation: 首次提供全360度视场的完整传感器套件数据，并定义新的3D检测与跟踪指标及基线。
1903.11027|v2.result: 数据集含1000个20秒场景、23类8属性3D框标注，标注量为KITTI的7倍、图像数为100倍，并提供检测/跟踪基线。

1912.04838|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶感知研究中缺乏大规模、多样化真实数据的问题，本文提出了Waymo Open Dataset，包含1150个20秒场景，覆盖城市与郊区多种地理环境，提供同步标定的高质量LiDAR与相机数据。相比当时最大的相机+LiDAR数据集，其多样性指标高出15倍，并提供了跨帧一致的2D与3D边界框标注。论文还给出了2D/3D检测与跟踪的强基线，并研究了数据集规模与跨地理区域泛化对3D检测的影响。
1912.04838|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of large-scale, diverse real-world data in autonomous driving perception, this paper introduces the Waymo Open Dataset, comprising 1150 scenes of 20 seconds each with synchronized and calibrated high-quality LiDAR and camera data across urban and suburban geographies. It is 15x more diverse than the largest existing camera+LiDAR dataset and provides exhaustively annotated 2D and 3D bounding boxes with consistent track identifiers. Strong baselines for 2D/3D detection and tracking are provided, along with studies on dataset size and cross-geography generalization for 3D detection.
1912.04838|v2.assessment: 该数据集是自动驾驶感知领域里程碑式的工作，为3D检测、跟踪等任务提供了大规模高质量基准，极大推动了领域发展。
1912.04838|v2.contribution: 发布了大规模、高多样性、多模态的Waymo Open Dataset，并提供了检测与跟踪的强基线。
1912.04838|v2.innovation: 通过多样性指标量化数据集覆盖度，并系统研究了数据规模与跨区域泛化对3D检测的影响。
1912.04838|v2.result: 数据集多样性是当时最大相机+LiDAR数据集的15倍，为2D/3D检测与跟踪设立了新基准。

2005.03844|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶仿真中传感器数据真实感不足且依赖手工建模的问题，本文提出SurfelGAN，仅利用少量真实LiDAR与相机数据重建场景。方法使用纹理映射的surfel高效重建场景几何与外观，再通过SurfelGAN网络生成新视角下的逼真相机图像，支持车辆与移动物体的新位置和朝向。相比基于游戏引擎的仿真器，该方法无需手动创建环境与材质，可扩展性更强，能生成更真实的传感器数据。
2005.03844|v2.summary_en: To address the limited realism and scalability of sensor simulation in autonomous driving, this paper proposes SurfelGAN, which generates realistic sensor data using only a limited amount of collected LiDAR and camera data. Texture-mapped surfels efficiently reconstruct the scene geometry and appearance, and a SurfelGAN network synthesizes realistic camera images for novel vehicle positions and orientations. Unlike game-engine-based simulators, this approach avoids manual environment and material creation, offering better scalability and realism.
2005.03844|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶仿真提供了一种数据驱动、可扩展的传感器数据生成方案，对场景重放与数据增强有实用价值。
2005.03844|v2.contribution: 提出基于surfel与GAN的传感器数据合成方法，仅需少量真实数据即可生成新视角的逼真图像。
2005.03844|v2.innovation: 将纹理映射surfel场景重建与SurfelGAN图像合成结合，实现无需手工建模的传感器仿真。
2005.03844|v2.result: 在有限LiDAR与相机数据下生成了新视角的逼真相机图像，支持移动物体的重定位。

2005.05501|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度视频中3D动作识别的问题，本文提出3D动态体素（3DV）表示，通过时间秩池化将深度视频中的3D运动信息紧凑编码为规则体素集。每个3DV体素同时包含3D空间与运动特征，随后被抽象为点集并输入PointNet++进行端到端识别。为弥补外观信息损失，还提出多流识别方式联合学习运动与外观特征，并在4个基准数据集上取得82.4%和93.5%的NTU RGB+D 120跨被试与跨设置准确率。
2005.05501|v2.summary_en: For depth-based 3D action recognition, this paper proposes 3D Dynamic Voxel (3DV), a compact representation that encodes 3D motion information from depth videos into a regular voxel set via temporal rank pooling. Each 3DV voxel jointly captures 3D spatial and motion features, and is abstracted as a point set for end-to-end learning with PointNet++. A multi-stream manner is also proposed to jointly learn motion and appearance features, achieving 82.4% and 93.5% accuracy on NTU RGB+D 120 cross-subject and cross-setup benchmarks.
2005.05501|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，主要贡献在深度视频动作识别，方法有一定新意但应用场景不同。
2005.05501|v2.contribution: 提出了3DV运动表示及基于PointNet++的端到端3D动作识别框架。
2005.05501|v2.innovation: 利用时间秩池化将深度视频运动编码为规则体素集，并转化为点集进行深度学习。
2005.05501|v2.result: 在NTU RGB+D 120上取得82.4%（跨被试）和93.5%（跨设置）的准确率。

Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中锚框设计依赖先验且对物体尺度变化敏感的问题，本文提出了一种无锚框的3D检测方法，将物体视为“热点”（Hotspots）并通过热点触发来定位目标。由于摘要内容缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_en: To address the reliance on anchor priors and sensitivity to object scale variation in 3D object detection, this paper proposes an anchor-free approach that treats objects as 'Hotspots' and detects them via hotspot firing. Due to the missing abstract content, specific method details and experimental results are unavailable.
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.assessment: 无锚框3D检测是重要方向，但摘要信息不完整，难以全面评估其方法质量与效果。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.contribution: 提出了基于热点触发的无锚框3D目标检测框架。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.innovation: 将物体建模为热点并通过热点触发实现无锚框检测，避免锚框先验。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体实验效果。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Object Detection Approach via Firing of Hotspots.

Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中定位误差来源不明确的问题，系统性地将误差分解为深度估计误差、2D框误差和3D框回归误差等成分。作者通过大量消融实验量化了各误差源对最终3D定位精度的影响，并据此提出了针对性的改进策略。相比已有工作笼统地将单目3D检测性能瓶颈归因于深度估计，该论文提供了更细粒度的误差分析框架。在KITTI基准上验证了改进方法的有效性，显著降低了定位误差。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_en: This paper systematically decomposes localization errors in monocular 3D object detection into depth estimation errors, 2D box errors, and 3D box regression errors. Through extensive ablation studies, the authors quantify the impact of each error source and propose targeted improvements. Compared to prior work that broadly attributes monocular 3D detection bottlenecks to depth estimation, this paper provides a finer-grained error analysis framework, achieving significant localization error reduction on the KITTI benchmark.
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.assessment: 该论文对单目3D检测的误差来源进行了深入剖析，为后续研究提供了清晰的优化方向，具有较高的参考价值。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.contribution: 系统性地分解并量化了单目3D目标检测中各类定位误差的来源及其影响。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.innovation: 提出了细粒度的误差分解框架，将定位误差归因到深度、2D检测和3D回归等多个环节。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.result: 在KITTI基准上通过针对性改进显著降低了3D定位误差。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon._arxiv_id: Delving Into Localization Errors for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中体素表示和点表示各有局限的问题，提出了混合体素-点表示（HVPR）的单阶段3D检测器。方法通过设计混合表示模块，在体素分支中高效提取特征的同时保留点级别的精细空间信息，并引入注意力机制实现两种表示的互补融合。相比纯体素方法，HVPR在保持实时推理速度的同时提升了对小目标和远距离目标的检测精度。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上取得了有竞争力的检测性能。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of pure voxel or point representations in 3D object detection by proposing a Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation (HVPR) for single-stage detection. The method designs a hybrid representation module that efficiently extracts voxel features while preserving fine-grained point-level spatial information, with an attention mechanism for complementary fusion. HVPR achieves competitive detection performance on KITTI and nuScenes while maintaining real-time inference speed.
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.assessment: HVPR在单阶段3D检测中巧妙融合了体素和点表示的互补优势，对实时自动驾驶感知系统具有实用价值。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.contribution: 提出了混合体素-点表示的单阶段3D目标检测框架HVPR。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.innovation: 通过注意力机制实现体素级效率与点级精度的互补融合。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上实现了实时推理下的有竞争力检测精度。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation._arxiv_id: HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation for Single-Stage 3D Object Detection.

3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云目标检测中局部特征提取不充分的问题，提出了Pointformer——一种基于Transformer的点云特征学习模块。方法在点云上引入多头自注意力和可变形注意力机制，分别建模局部区域内的点间关系和全局场景上下文，可嵌入现有3D检测框架中作为特征提取骨干。相比基于稀疏卷积或PointNet++的方法，Pointformer能更有效地捕获长距离依赖和上下文信息。在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D等3D检测基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient local feature extraction in 3D point cloud object detection by proposing Pointformer, a Transformer-based point cloud feature learning module. The method introduces multi-head self-attention and deformable attention on point clouds to model both local inter-point relations and global scene context, and can be integrated into existing 3D detection frameworks as a feature backbone. Pointformer achieves significant performance gains on ScanNet and SUN RGB-D benchmarks compared to sparse convolution or PointNet++ based methods.
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.assessment: Pointformer将Transformer成功引入3D点云检测，为点云特征学习提供了新的范式，值得关注。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.contribution: 提出了基于Transformer的点云特征学习模块Pointformer用于3D目标检测。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.innovation: 在点云上引入多头自注意力和可变形注意力以同时建模局部与全局上下文。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D等基准上取得了显著的3D检测性能提升。

2103.05073|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对离线3D感知场景（如自动标注）研究不足的问题，提出了基于点云序列的离线3D目标检测流水线3D Auto Labeling。方法利用多帧点云中互补的物体视角信息，通过多帧目标检测和以物体为中心的精细化模型来生成高质量3D标注。在Waymo Open Dataset上，该流水线的性能显著优于最先进的在线检测器，且经人类标注研究验证其质量与人工标注相当。此外，论文还验证了自动标注在半监督学习中的应用价值。
2103.05073|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored offboard 3D perception scenario by proposing an offboard 3D object detection pipeline, 3D Auto Labeling, that leverages point cloud sequences. The method exploits complementary object views across frames through multi-frame detection and object-centric refinement to generate high-quality 3D labels. On the Waymo Open Dataset, the pipeline significantly outperforms state-of-the-art onboard detectors and achieves performance on par with human labels, with further validation for semi-supervised learning applications.
2103.05073|v2.assessment: 该论文开辟了离线3D感知的新方向，其自动标注质量达到人类水平，对数据闭环和自动驾驶规模化具有重要价值。
2103.05073|v2.contribution: 提出了基于点云序列的离线3D目标检测流水线3D Auto Labeling用于高质量自动标注。
2103.05073|v2.innovation: 利用多帧时序点云的互补视角和物体中心精细化实现超越在线检测器的标注质量。
2103.05073|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上性能与人类标注相当，并成功应用于半监督学习。

2103.01100|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确导致性能受限的核心问题，提出了分类深度分布网络CaDDN。方法对每个像素预测分类深度分布，将丰富的上下文特征投影到3D空间中合适的深度区间，再通过高效的BEV投影和单阶段检测器输出最终3D框。CaDDN是首个端到端联合深度估计与目标检测的全可微框架。在KITTI 3D检测基准上排名单目方法第一，并首次在Waymo Open Dataset上给出了单目3D检测结果。
2103.01100|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the core challenge of inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection by proposing the Categorical Depth Distribution Network (CaDDN). The method predicts a categorical depth distribution per pixel to project contextual features into appropriate depth intervals in 3D space, followed by efficient BEV projection and a single-stage detector. CaDDN is a fully differentiable end-to-end framework for joint depth estimation and detection, ranking 1st among published monocular methods on KITTI and providing the first monocular 3D detection results on Waymo Open Dataset.
2103.01100|v2.assessment: CaDDN通过分类深度分布优雅地解决了单目3D检测的深度估计瓶颈，是单目3D检测领域的代表性工作。
2103.01100|v2.contribution: 提出了基于分类深度分布的端到端单目3D目标检测网络CaDDN。
2103.01100|v2.innovation: 用逐像素分类深度分布替代直接深度回归，实现深度估计与检测的联合端到端优化。
2103.01100|v2.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测中排名第一，并首次在Waymo Open Dataset上报告单目3D检测结果。

RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中精度与效率难以兼顾的问题，提出了Range Sparse Net（RSN）。方法利用距离图像（range image）的稀疏性，设计稀疏卷积网络在距离视图上高效提取特征，并通过距离感知的稀疏化策略将计算资源集中在有物体的区域。相比在体素或点云上均匀计算的方法，RSN大幅降低了计算量同时保持了高检测精度。在大规模Waymo Open Dataset上实现了实时推理速度下的领先检测性能。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in LiDAR 3D object detection by proposing Range Sparse Net (RSN). The method exploits the sparsity of range images with sparse convolutions for efficient feature extraction, and employs a range-aware sparsification strategy to concentrate computation on object-containing regions. RSN achieves state-of-the-art detection performance at real-time inference speed on the large-scale Waymo Open Dataset while significantly reducing computation compared to uniform voxel or point-based methods.
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.assessment: RSN通过距离视图稀疏化实现了高效准确的LiDAR 3D检测，对自动驾驶实时感知系统具有重要工程价值。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.contribution: 提出了基于距离图像稀疏性的高效LiDAR 3D目标检测网络RSN。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.innovation: 利用距离视图稀疏卷积和距离感知稀疏化策略将计算集中在有物体区域。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上实现了实时推理速度下的领先3D检测性能。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc._arxiv_id: RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Accurate LiDAR 3D Object Detection.

2011.12953|v2.summary_cn: 该论文首次系统性地研究无监督目标检测问题，指出仅依赖2D图像外观推导目标边界存在歧义且不可靠，且长尾与开放式子类别分布难以处理。方法上利用LiDAR提供的3D场景结构生成候选目标分割，再通过迭代式分割标注过程为分割分配标签并训练基于2D图像与3D点云特征的标注网络，标注过程专门设计以缓解长尾和开放式分布问题，最终将分割标签作为伪标注用于目标检测。相比已有工作，这是首个借助LiDAR线索实现无监督目标检测的实用方法，显著缓解了定位歧义问题。
2011.12953|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first practical method for unsupervised object detection by exploiting LiDAR clues to mitigate the ambiguity of 2D appearance-based object boundaries. It generates candidate object segments from 3D point clouds and performs an iterative segment labeling process to assign labels and train a segment labeling network using both 2D image and 3D point cloud features. The labeling process is carefully designed to accommodate long-tailed and open-ended sub-category distributions, and the resulting segment labels serve as pseudo annotations for object detection.
2011.12953|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了利用LiDAR线索进行无监督目标检测的新方向，对降低3D标注成本具有重要价值，值得关注。
2011.12953|v2.contribution: 首次提出借助LiDAR线索的无监督目标检测实用方法，并设计了适应长尾开放式分布的迭代分割标注流程。
2011.12953|v2.innovation: 利用3D场景结构缓解2D外观边界歧义，并针对长尾与开放式子类别分布设计迭代标注机制。
2011.12953|v2.result: 作为首个无监督LiDAR辅助目标检测方法，有效缓解了定位歧义并生成了可用于检测的伪标注。

PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中跨模态特征融合的问题，提出了PointAugmenting方法，通过将点云特征与图像特征进行跨模态增强以提升检测性能。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据，但从标题与领域背景推断，其核心在于利用图像语义信息增强点云表示，从而改善3D检测精度。相比已有工作，跨模态增强策略有望在保持点云几何精度的同时引入图像纹理与语义线索。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_en: This paper proposes PointAugmenting, a cross-modal augmentation approach for 3D object detection that enhances point cloud features with image information. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results are unavailable, but the work targets improving 3D detection by fusing complementary modalities. It is expected to leverage image semantics to enrich point cloud representations while preserving geometric accuracy.
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.assessment: 跨模态增强是3D检测的重要方向，该工作若能在融合策略上有实质创新，将对多模态感知研究有参考价值。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.contribution: 提出PointAugmenting跨模态增强方法，用于提升3D目标检测性能。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.innovation: 通过跨模态特征增强实现点云与图像信息的互补融合。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认，但方法在3D检测跨模态融合方向具有潜在价值。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio._arxiv_id: PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentation for 3D Object Detection.

2103.16470|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度信息不准确与上下文融合不足的问题，提出深度条件动态消息传播网络（DDMP），避免使用复杂的伪LiDAR方案，而是将多尺度深度信息与图像上下文有效整合。方法通过自适应采样上下文感知节点，并动态预测混合深度依赖的滤波权重与亲和矩阵进行信息传播，同时引入中心感知深度编码（CDE）任务以缓解深度先验不准确的问题。在KITTI基准上取得单目方法中的最优结果，并在提交日（2020年11月16日）位列KITTI单目3D检测赛道第一。
2103.16470|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a Depth-Conditioned Dynamic Message Propagation (DDMP) network for monocular 3D object detection, which integrates multi-scale depth information with image context without resorting to pseudo-LiDAR. It adaptively samples context-aware nodes and dynamically predicts hybrid depth-dependent filter weights and affinity matrices for message propagation, while a center-aware depth encoding (CDE) task alleviates inaccurate depth priors. The method achieves state-of-the-art results among monocular approaches on KITTI and ranked 1st on the KITTI monocular 3D detection track at submission time.
2103.16470|v2.assessment: 该工作在单目3D检测中巧妙结合深度条件与动态消息传播，性能达到当时最优，对单目深度感知研究具有重要参考价值。
2103.16470|v2.contribution: 提出深度条件动态消息传播网络DDMP，有效融合多尺度深度与图像上下文用于单目3D检测。
2103.16470|v2.innovation: 动态预测深度依赖的滤波权重与亲和矩阵，并引入中心感知深度编码任务缓解深度先验误差。
2103.16470|v2.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得最优结果，并在提交日位列该赛道第一名。

2103.05346|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D目标检测中的无监督域适应问题，提出ST3D自训练流水线。首先在源域使用随机物体缩放策略预训练3D检测器以缓解源域偏差，然后在目标域通过质量感知三元组记忆库更新伪标签，并结合课程数据增强进行模型训练，交替迭代提升检测器性能。这些针对3D检测的设计使检测器能够利用一致且高质量的伪标签训练，并避免对伪标注数据中大量简单样本过拟合。在所有评估数据集上达到最优性能，甚至在KITTI 3D检测基准上超越全监督结果。
2103.05346|v2.summary_en: This paper presents ST3D, a self-training pipeline for unsupervised domain adaptation in point cloud-based 3D object detection. It pre-trains the detector on the source domain with random object scaling to mitigate source bias, then iteratively improves it on the target domain via quality-aware triplet memory bank pseudo-label updating and curriculum data augmentation. These designs enable training with consistent and high-quality pseudo labels while avoiding overfitting to easy examples. ST3D achieves state-of-the-art performance on all evaluated datasets and even surpasses fully supervised results on the KITTI 3D detection benchmark.
2103.05346|v2.assessment: 该工作系统解决了3D检测域适应中的伪标签质量与过拟合问题，性能超越全监督，对自动驾驶跨域部署极具价值。
2103.05346|v2.contribution: 提出ST3D自训练流水线，通过随机物体缩放、质量感知记忆库与课程增强实现3D检测的无监督域适应。
2103.05346|v2.innovation: 质量感知三元组记忆库与课程数据增强相结合，确保伪标签一致高质量并避免简单样本过拟合。
2103.05346|v2.result: 在所有评估数据集上达到最优，并在KITTI 3D检测基准上超越全监督方法。

2103.16054|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有3D目标检测方法多聚焦单帧、未充分利用多帧信息的问题，提出3D-MAN：一种3D多帧注意力网络，有效聚合多视角特征。方法首先使用快速单帧检测器生成候选框，将候选框及其对应特征图存入记忆库，然后设计多视角对齐与聚合模块，利用注意力网络提取并聚合记忆库中的时序特征，从而融合来自不同视角的场景信息。在大规模复杂Waymo Open Dataset上验证了有效性，相比已发表的单帧与多帧方法均取得最优结果。
2103.16054|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes 3D-MAN, a 3D multi-frame attention network that aggregates features from multiple perspectives for 3D object detection. It first uses a fast single-frame detector to generate box proposals, stores them with corresponding feature maps in a memory bank, and then employs a multi-view alignment and aggregation module with attention networks to extract and aggregate temporal features. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on the large-scale Waymo Open Dataset compared to published single-frame and multi-frame methods.
2103.16054|v2.assessment: 该工作有效利用多帧时序信息提升3D检测性能，在Waymo数据集上表现优异，对自动驾驶时序感知研究有重要参考意义。
2103.16054|v2.contribution: 提出3D-MAN多帧注意力网络，通过记忆库与多视角对齐聚合模块融合时序特征用于3D检测。
2103.16054|v2.innovation: 设计多视角对齐与聚合模块，利用注意力网络从记忆库中提取并聚合跨帧特征。
2103.16054|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上取得优于已发表单帧与多帧方法的最优结果。

Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测与跟踪中传统基于锚框或角点方法复杂且效率低的问题，提出基于中心点的3D目标检测与跟踪框架。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据，但从标题与领域背景推断，其核心是将3D目标表示为其中心点，并利用中心点热图进行检测，同时将跟踪简化为中心点关联。相比已有工作，中心点表示有望统一检测与跟踪，减少后处理复杂度并提升效率。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_en: This paper proposes a center-based framework for 3D object detection and tracking, representing objects by their centers to simplify both tasks. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results are unavailable, but the work likely uses center heatmaps for detection and center association for tracking. This representation is expected to unify detection and tracking while reducing post-processing complexity.
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.assessment: 中心点表示在3D检测与跟踪中具有简洁高效的潜力，该工作若验证其有效性，将对自动驾驶感知流水线设计产生重要影响。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.contribution: 提出基于中心点的3D目标检测与跟踪统一框架。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.innovation: 以中心点表示3D目标，简化检测与跟踪流程并降低后处理复杂度。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认，但中心点范式在3D检测跟踪方向具有显著潜力。

SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_cn: 针对跨数据集3D目标检测中因激光雷达线数、安装高度和场景尺度差异导致的域偏移问题，提出尺度感知与距离感知的域适应网络SRDAN。方法通过尺度感知特征对齐和距离感知采样策略，缩小源域与目标域在物体尺度和空间分布上的差异。相比已有域适应方法，SRDAN同时建模了尺度与距离两个关键因素，在跨数据集3D检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain shift problem in cross-dataset 3D object detection caused by differences in LiDAR beam configurations, mounting heights, and scene scales. It proposes SRDAN, a scale-aware and range-aware domain adaptation network that aligns features across scales and adaptively samples regions based on distance. Experiments on cross-dataset benchmarks demonstrate improved detection performance over existing domain adaptation methods.
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.assessment: 跨数据集3D检测是实际部署中的关键瓶颈，该工作从尺度和距离两个维度切入域适应，思路清晰且实用。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.contribution: 提出了同时考虑尺度感知和距离感知的域适应网络SRDAN，用于跨数据集3D目标检测。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.innovation: 将尺度对齐与距离感知采样结合到统一的域适应框架中，针对性解决LiDAR配置差异带来的域偏移。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.result: 在跨数据集3D检测基准上取得了优于现有域适应方法的检测精度。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai._arxiv_id: SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domain Adaptation Network for Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

2106.15796|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中相机外参变化（如路面颠簸、坡度导致的自车姿态变化）引起检测性能严重退化的问题，提出了一种对外参扰动鲁棒的单目3D检测方法。该方法通过检测消失点和地平线变化来预测相机外参，并设计了一个转换器在隐空间中对扰动特征进行矫正，使检测器不受外参变化影响。实验表明，在坑洼和不平路面等现有单目检测器几乎失效的场景下，该方法仍能保持最佳性能。
2106.15796|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem that monocular 3D object detection degrades severely under camera extrinsic parameter variations caused by ego-car pose changes on uneven roads. The proposed method predicts camera extrinsics by detecting vanishing points and horizon changes, and employs a converter to rectify perturbative features in latent space, making the detector invariant to extrinsic perturbations. Experiments show it achieves the best performance compared to other state-of-the-art methods, especially in realistic scenarios such as potholed and uneven roads where existing detectors fail.
2106.15796|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了现有单目3D检测器忽视相机外参扰动的工业应用痛点，提出的外参感知矫正方案具有很强的实用价值。
2106.15796|v2.contribution: 提出了一种通过预测相机外参并在隐空间矫正特征来实现外参无关的单目3D检测框架。
2106.15796|v2.innovation: 首次将消失点与地平线变化用于外参预测，并通过隐空间特征转换器实现对外参扰动的鲁棒性。
2106.15796|v2.result: 在坑洼和不平路面等挑战性场景下取得了优于现有方法的检测性能。

2103.15297|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D检测器中第二阶段精化模块的通用性和效率问题，提出了一种高效通用的第二阶段3D检测器LiDAR R-CNN。该方法采用基于点的方案而非体素方案，并发现直接使用PointNet等点方法会导致特征忽略候选框尺寸，为此提出了多种补救方法。在Waymo Open Dataset和KITTI数据集上，基于PointPillars变体即可以极小代价达到新的SOTA结果，验证了其通用性和优越性。
2103.15297|v2.summary_en: This paper presents LiDAR R-CNN, a second-stage 3D detector that can universally improve any existing 3D detector. It adopts a point-based approach and identifies that naively applying PointNet-like methods causes learned features to ignore proposal sizes, proposing several remedies for this issue. Comprehensive experiments on Waymo Open Dataset and KITTI demonstrate its universality and superiority, achieving new state-of-the-art results with minor cost based on a PointPillars variant.
2103.15297|v2.assessment: 作为通用第二阶段精化模块，LiDAR R-CNN可即插即用地提升多种3D检测器性能，对实际系统部署有很高参考价值。
2103.15297|v2.contribution: 提出了一个高效通用的第二阶段3D检测器LiDAR R-CNN，可普遍提升现有3D检测器性能。
2103.15297|v2.innovation: 发现并解决了点方法中候选框尺寸信息被忽略的问题，提出了多种特征增强策略。
2103.15297|v2.result: 在Waymo和KITTI数据集上以极小代价取得新的SOTA检测精度。

2105.02158|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云压缩问题，提出了基于八叉树的VoxelContext-Net框架。该方法利用体素上下文信息进行点云压缩，通过八叉树结构组织点云并提取局部上下文特征以提升压缩效率。与已有方法相比，VoxelContext-Net在压缩率和重建质量之间取得了更好的平衡。
2105.02158|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes VoxelContext-Net, an octree-based framework for point cloud compression. It leverages voxel context information organized via octree structures to improve compression efficiency. Compared to existing methods, VoxelContext-Net achieves a better trade-off between compression rate and reconstruction quality.
2105.02158|v2.assessment: 点云压缩与3D检测领域相关度较低，但对自动驾驶感知系统的数据传输和存储有间接价值。
2105.02158|v2.contribution: 提出了基于八叉树的体素上下文点云压缩框架VoxelContext-Net。
2105.02158|v2.innovation: 将体素上下文建模引入八叉树点云压缩，提升压缩效率。
2105.02158|v2.result: 在压缩率与重建质量之间取得了优于已有方法的平衡。

2104.09804|v2.summary_cn: 针对室外点云3D检测中单阶段检测器精度不足的问题，提出了自集成单阶段检测器SE-SSD。该方法包含一对教师和学生SSD，设计了基于IoU的匹配策略从教师中筛选软目标并构造一致性损失，同时提出形状感知增强方案和ODIoU损失以更好地利用硬目标。在KITTI基准上，SE-SSD在BEV和3D排行榜分别排名第1和第2，且推理速度极快。
2104.09804|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SE-SSD, a self-ensembling single-stage 3D object detector for accurate and efficient outdoor point cloud detection. It employs a teacher-student SSD pair with an IoU-based matching strategy for soft target filtering, a consistency loss, a shape-aware augmentation scheme, and an ODIoU loss for hard target supervision. SE-SSD achieves top performance on the KITTI benchmark (ranked 1st and 2nd on BEV and 3D leaderboards) with ultra-high inference speed.
2104.09804|v2.assessment: SE-SSD通过自集成和知识蒸馏策略显著提升了单阶段3D检测器精度，同时保持极高推理速度，是单阶段3D检测的标杆工作。
2104.09804|v2.contribution: 提出了自集成单阶段3D检测器SE-SSD，通过教师-学生框架和多种约束联合优化检测精度与效率。
2104.09804|v2.innovation: 设计了IoU-based软目标匹配、形状感知增强和ODIoU损失，在不增加推理计算的前提下大幅提升单阶段检测器性能。
2104.09804|v2.result: 在KITTI基准上BEV和3D排行榜分别排名第1和第2，且推理速度极快。

2104.08683|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云运动估计中标注数据获取困难的问题，提出了一种自监督柱状运动学习框架，利用点云和配对相机图像中的免费监督信号进行运动估计。该方法设计了基于点云的结构一致性增强、概率运动掩码以及跨传感器运动正则化来实现自监督学习。实验表明，该方法性能与监督方法相当，且与监督微调结合后达到SOTA结果。
2104.08683|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of annotating point clouds for motion estimation by proposing a self-supervised pillar motion learning framework that leverages free supervisory signals from point clouds and paired camera images. The model incorporates point cloud structural consistency with probabilistic motion masking and cross-sensor motion regularization. Experiments show it performs competitively with supervised methods and achieves state-of-the-art results when combined with supervised fine-tuning.
2104.08683|v2.assessment: 该工作证明了自监督学习在自动驾驶运动估计中的可行性，减少了对昂贵点云标注的依赖，具有重要的实用意义。
2104.08683|v2.contribution: 提出了利用点云和相机图像自监督信号进行柱状运动学习的框架。
2104.08683|v2.innovation: 结合结构一致性增强、概率运动掩码和跨传感器正则化实现无需人工标注的运动估计。
2104.08683|v2.result: 性能与监督方法相当，结合监督微调后达到SOTA结果。

2203.17270|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机自动驾驶感知中统一BEV表征难以同时融合空间与时间信息的问题，本文提出BEVFormer框架，通过预定义的网格状BEV查询与空间交叉注意力和时间自注意力交互，聚合多视角空间特征并递归融合历史BEV信息。相比已有方法，BEVFormer首次以时空Transformer统一支持3D检测与地图分割，在nuScenes测试集上取得56.9% NDS，较此前最佳提升9.0点，并达到与LiDAR基线相当的水平，同时显著改善速度估计精度和低能见度下的目标召回。
2203.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unified BEV representation learning for multi-camera autonomous driving perception. BEVFormer employs grid-shaped BEV queries with spatial cross-attention to aggregate multi-view features and temporal self-attention to recurrently fuse historical BEV information, supporting both 3D detection and map segmentation. It achieves 56.9% NDS on nuScenes test, 9.0 points above prior art and on par with LiDAR-based baselines, while notably improving velocity estimation and recall under low visibility.
2203.17270|v2.assessment: BEVFormer是BEV感知领域的里程碑式工作，其时空Transformer设计被后续大量方法沿用，值得深入研读。
2203.17270|v2.contribution: 提出统一的时空Transformer BEV表征框架，同时支持多相机3D检测与地图分割。
2203.17270|v2.innovation: 用网格状BEV查询配合空间交叉注意力与时间自注意力，实现多视角空间聚合与历史BEV递归融合。
2203.17270|v2.result: nuScenes测试集NDS达56.9%，较此前最佳提升9.0点，媲美LiDAR基线。

2203.02133|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中分割信息利用不足的问题，本文提出一个联合进行3D目标检测与全景分割的多任务框架，将全景分割骨干的Range-View特征图注入BEV平面检测骨干，并引入前景语义信息和基于实例级信息生成的中心密度热图来引导检测。该方法可即插即用地适配任意BEV-based 3D检测器，在nuScenes数据集上取得显著性能提升。
2203.02133|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the underutilization of segmentation cues in LiDAR-based 3D detection by proposing a multi-task framework that jointly performs 3D detection and panoptic segmentation. It injects Range-View features from a panoptic segmentation backbone into a BEV detection backbone, and further incorporates foreground semantics and an instance-level center density heatmap to guide detection. The method is compatible with any BEV-based detector and yields significant gains on nuScenes.
2203.02133|v2.assessment: 多视图特征融合与分割引导检测的思路实用，但整体属于增量式改进，创新性中等。
2203.02133|v2.contribution: 提出联合3D检测与全景分割的多任务框架，通过RV特征注入与中心密度热图引导BEV检测。
2203.02133|v2.innovation: 利用全景分割的Range-View特征和实例级中心密度热图增强BEV检测骨干。
2203.02133|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上为多种BEV检测器带来显著性能提升。

2204.00754|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中每个目标被独立训练、忽略目标间几何关系的问题，本文提出Homography Loss，将所有目标纳入统一优化，利用2D检测框作为引导，通过可微损失函数在全局约束下平衡不同目标间的位置关系，从而获得更准确的3D框预测。该损失设计简洁通用，可即插即用地嵌入任意成熟的单目3D检测器并显著提升其基线性能。
2204.00754|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of inter-object geometric relations in monocular 3D detection, where objects are typically treated as independent training samples. It proposes Homography Loss, a differentiable loss that leverages reliable 2D boxes to globally constrain the optimization of predicted 3D boxes by balancing positional relationships among objects. The loss is universal and plug-and-play, significantly boosting any mature monocular 3D detector over its baseline.
2204.00754|v2.assessment: 从损失函数角度挖掘目标间几何约束的思路新颖且通用，对单目3D检测研究有较好参考价值。
2204.00754|v2.contribution: 提出可微的Homography Loss，利用2D框全局约束目标间3D位置关系。
2204.00754|v2.innovation: 将场景中所有目标的相互几何关系纳入统一损失优化，而非独立处理每个目标。
2204.00754|v2.result: 可即插即用于任意单目3D检测器并显著提升基线性能。

2203.15118|v2.summary_cn: 针对降雪天气下LiDAR 3D检测训练数据难以采集标注的问题，本文提出一种基于物理的降雪模拟方法，对每条LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子并利用其几何关系修改对应激光束的测量值，同时模拟降雪导致的地面潮湿效应。利用生成的半合成雪天LiDAR数据训练检测模型，在真实雪天STF数据集上相比晴天基线和竞争模拟方法取得一致且显著的性能提升。
2203.15118|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses LiDAR-based 3D detection under snowfall, where collecting and annotating training data is difficult. It proposes a physically based simulation that samples snow particles in 2D per LiDAR line, modifies each beam's measurement via induced geometry, and simulates ground wetness. Training detectors on the resulting partially synthetic snowy data yields consistent and significant gains on the real snowy STF dataset over clear-weather baselines and competing simulation approaches.
2203.15118|v2.assessment: 物理建模的降雪模拟为恶劣天气鲁棒3D检测提供了低成本数据增强方案，实验扎实，实用性强。
2203.15118|v2.contribution: 提出基于物理的LiDAR降雪与地面潮湿模拟方法，用于训练鲁棒的3D检测器。
2203.15118|v2.innovation: 按LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子并据其几何修改光束测量，同时模拟地面潮湿效应。
2203.15118|v2.result: 在真实雪天STF数据集上相比晴天基线和竞争模拟方法取得一致显著提升。

2203.10314|v2.summary_cn: 本文提出Voxel Set Transformer（VoxSeT），一种基于集合到集合（set-to-set）范式的点云3D目标检测方法。针对体素化方法中稀疏体素间长距离依赖建模效率低的问题，VoxSeT将体素视为集合元素，通过自注意力与交叉注意力在编码器-解码器结构中高效建模体素关系，避免了昂贵的稠密注意力计算。在Waymo和nuScenes等基准上取得有竞争力的检测精度，同时保持较高的计算效率。
2203.10314|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Voxel Set Transformer (VoxSeT), a set-to-set approach to 3D object detection from point clouds. To efficiently model long-range dependencies among sparse voxels, VoxSeT treats voxels as set elements and employs self- and cross-attention within an encoder-decoder architecture, avoiding costly dense attention. It achieves competitive detection accuracy on Waymo and nuScenes while maintaining high computational efficiency.
2203.10314|v2.assessment: 将Transformer的集合建模思想引入体素点云检测，兼顾精度与效率，对3D检测架构设计有参考意义。
2203.10314|v2.contribution: 提出Voxel Set Transformer，以集合到集合范式高效建模稀疏体素间关系用于3D检测。
2203.10314|v2.innovation: 将体素视为集合元素，用编码器-解码器注意力机制替代稠密注意力以建模长距离依赖。
2203.10314|v2.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上取得有竞争力的精度并保持较高计算效率。

2203.05662|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云体素化后点密度分布不均导致特征表达不一致的问题，本文提出点密度感知体素（Point Density-Aware Voxels）方法，在体素特征编码中显式建模每个体素内的点密度信息，使网络能够根据密度差异自适应调整特征表示。该方法可集成到主流体素检测框架中，在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上取得领先的检测性能，尤其对远距离稀疏目标检测效果提升明显。
2203.05662|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistent feature representation caused by non-uniform point density in voxelized LiDAR point clouds.
