It proposes Point Density-Aware Voxels, which explicitly models point density within each voxel during feature encoding, enabling the network to adaptively adjust representations based on density variations. Integrated into mainstream voxel-based detectors, it achieves leading performance on Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes, with notable gains for distant sparse objects.
2203.05662|v2.assessment: 点密度感知是LiDAR检测中被长期忽视但影响显著的因素，该工作切入角度精准，实验充分。
2203.05662|v2.contribution: 提出点密度感知体素编码方法，显式建模体素内点密度以自适应调整特征表示。
2203.05662|v2.innovation: 在体素特征编码中引入点密度信息，缓解点云密度不均带来的特征表达不一致问题。
2203.05662|v2.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上取得领先性能，远距离稀疏目标检测提升明显。

Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_cn: 该论文研究多LiDAR传感器布局对自动驾驶3D目标检测性能的影响。作者通过在不同车辆位置配置多个LiDAR并采集数据，系统评估了传感器数量、位置及遮挡对检测精度的影响。相比已有单LiDAR或固定布局研究，本文首次量化了多LiDAR布局的优化空间。实验表明合理的多LiDAR布局能显著提升检测性能，为自动驾驶感知系统设计提供了实用指导。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_en: This paper investigates how multi-LiDAR placement affects 3D object detection for autonomous driving. The authors systematically evaluate different sensor configurations and quantify the impact of placement on detection accuracy. Results show that optimized multi-LiDAR layouts significantly improve detection performance, offering practical guidelines for perception system design.
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.assessment: 为多LiDAR系统设计提供了实证依据，对自动驾驶感知硬件选型有参考价值。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.contribution: 系统量化了多LiDAR布局对3D检测性能的影响。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.innovation: 首次通过实验揭示传感器布局与检测精度的关系。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.result: 合理布局可显著提升检测性能。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR._arxiv_id: Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR Placement on Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

2203.10981|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准且引入额外计算负担的问题，本文提出MonoDTR，一种端到端深度感知Transformer网络。其核心包括深度感知特征增强模块（DFE）和深度感知Transformer模块（DTR），并引入深度位置编码（DPE）替代传统像素位置编码。在KITTI数据集上，该方法超越了此前最优的单目方法，且模块可即插即用。
2203.10981|v2.summary_en: To address inaccurate depth priors and extra computation in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes MonoDTR, an end-to-end depth-aware transformer network with a Depth-Aware Feature Enhancement module and a Depth-Aware Transformer module. It introduces depth positional encoding and achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, with plug-and-play modules.
2203.10981|v2.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，在不增加推理负担的前提下有效利用深度信息，对单目3D检测有重要推动。
2203.10981|v2.contribution: 提出端到端深度感知Transformer网络MonoDTR。
2203.10981|v2.innovation: 深度感知特征增强与深度位置编码的即插即用设计。
2203.10981|v2.result: 在KITTI上超越此前最优单目方法。

3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中的域泛化问题，提出3D-VField方法，通过对点云进行对抗性增强来提升模型在未见域上的泛化能力。作者设计了一种可变形点云生成策略，模拟不同传感器和场景下的点云分布变化。相比传统数据增强，该方法在多个跨域基准上显著提升了检测性能，增强了模型鲁棒性。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_en: This paper addresses domain generalization in 3D object detection by proposing 3D-VField, an adversarial point cloud augmentation method. It generates deformed point clouds to simulate domain shifts and improves cross-domain detection performance. Experiments show significant robustness gains over standard augmentation.
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.assessment: 对抗增强思路新颖，有效缓解了3D检测的域偏移问题，对实际部署有重要意义。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.contribution: 提出对抗性点云增强方法3D-VField。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.innovation: 利用可变形点云模拟域偏移以提升泛化。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.result: 在跨域基准上显著提升检测鲁棒性。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P._arxiv_id: 3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of Point Clouds for Domain Generalization in 3D Object Detection.

2205.14882|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测与跟踪分离导致误差无法传递的问题，本文提出Time3D，首次实现端到端联合训练单目3D检测与3D跟踪。核心是时空信息流模块，利用Transformer的自注意力聚合空间特征、交叉注意力建模时序关联，并引入时序一致性损失将3D运动建模融入学习。在KITTI跟踪基准上取得了领先性能。
2205.14882|v2.summary_en: To enable error propagation between monocular 3D detection and tracking, this paper proposes Time3D, an end-to-end joint training framework. It introduces a spatial-temporal information flow module with self- and cross-attention, plus a temporal consistency loss. It achieves leading performance on KITTI tracking benchmarks.
2205.14882|v2.assessment: 端到端联合检测与跟踪的思路有效，时空注意力设计合理，对单目3D跟踪有重要贡献。
2205.14882|v2.contribution: 提出端到端联合单目3D检测与跟踪框架Time3D。
2205.14882|v2.innovation: 时空信息流模块与时序一致性损失。
2205.14882|v2.result: 在KITTI跟踪基准上取得领先性能。

2205.15938|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态3D检测中体素特征融合不充分的问题，提出Voxel Field Fusion方法，在体素场中融合LiDAR点云与相机图像特征。作者设计了体素场表示与跨模态融合模块，有效对齐并互补两种模态信息。在nuScenes等基准上，该方法优于现有融合方案，提升了3D检测精度。
2205.15938|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Voxel Field Fusion to better fuse LiDAR and camera features for 3D detection. It introduces a voxel field representation and cross-modal fusion module to align and complement modalities. Experiments on nuScenes show improved detection accuracy over existing fusion methods.
2205.15938|v2.assessment: 体素场融合思路清晰，有效提升了多模态3D检测性能，对BEV感知有参考价值。
2205.15938|v2.contribution: 提出体素场融合方法Voxel Field Fusion。
2205.15938|v2.innovation: 在体素场中实现跨模态特征对齐与融合。
2205.15938|v2.result: 在nuScenes上优于现有融合方案。

2205.09373|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度线索利用不充分导致可靠性差的问题，本文提出一种充分利用深度线索的方法，通过多源深度估计与不确定性建模提升检测可靠性。作者设计了深度多样性融合策略，结合不同深度预测的优势。在KITTI上，该方法显著提升了检测精度与鲁棒性，尤其在远距离目标上表现突出。
2205.09373|v2.summary_en: To improve reliability in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes fully exploiting depth clues via multi-source depth estimation and uncertainty modeling. A depth diversity fusion strategy combines complementary depth predictions. Experiments on KITTI show significant gains in accuracy and robustness, especially for distant objects.
2205.09373|v2.assessment: 深度线索的多样化利用有效提升了单目3D检测的可靠性，对实际应用有重要价值。
2205.09373|v2.contribution: 提出充分利用深度线索的可靠单目3D检测方法。
2205.09373|v2.innovation: 深度多样性融合与不确定性建模。
2205.09373|v2.result: 在KITTI上显著提升精度与鲁棒性。

2203.08195|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中激光雷达点云与相机图像融合不充分、现有方法仅在BEV或单阶段做简单拼接的问题，本文提出DeepFusion框架，通过InverseAug和LearnableAlign两个模块在数据增强与特征对齐层面实现点云与图像特征的深度交互。相比PointPillars等仅用点云或简单concat融合的方法，DeepFusion在nuScenes和Waymo上显著提升。在Waymo验证集上，DeepFusion相比PointPillars基线在mAP上提升约6.7%，达到当时单模型领先水平。
2203.08195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient lidar-camera fusion in multi-modal 3D detection, where prior methods merely concatenate features in BEV or single-stage pipelines. It proposes DeepFusion with InverseAug and LearnableAlign to deeply align point and image features across augmentation and feature levels. On Waymo and nuScenes, it improves over PointPillars by ~6.7% mAP, achieving state-of-the-art single-model performance.
2203.08195|v2.assessment: 多模态融合是自动驾驶感知的核心方向，该工作提出的对齐机制简洁有效，实验充分，值得作为融合基线参考。
2203.08195|v2.contribution: 提出DeepFusion框架，通过InverseAug与LearnableAlign实现点云与图像特征的深度对齐融合。
2203.08195|v2.innovation: 在数据增强与特征层面同时解决几何与语义对齐问题，而非简单特征拼接。
2203.08195|v2.result: 在Waymo验证集上相比PointPillars基线mAP提升约6.7%，达到单模型领先水平。

2203.08563|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计与语义信息耦合不足、几何约束弱的问题，本文提出MonoJSG，构建联合语义与几何的代价体（cost volume），将语义分割特征与几何深度先验融合以回归3D框。相比M3D-RPN、MonoDLE等仅依赖几何或语义单方面线索的方法，MonoJSG在KITTI上取得提升。在KITTI test集上，MonoJSG在Car类别上AP3D达到约17.2%，优于同期单目方法。
2203.08563|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles weak coupling of depth and semantics in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoJSG, which builds a joint semantic and geometric cost volume to regress 3D boxes. Compared with geometry-only or semantics-only methods like M3D-RPN and MonoDLE, it improves on KITTI. It achieves ~17.2% AP3D on KITTI test Car, outperforming contemporaneous monocular methods.
2203.08563|v2.assessment: 联合语义与几何代价体的思路对单目3D检测有启发，实验在KITTI上验证有效，值得关注。
2203.08563|v2.contribution: 提出MonoJSG，构建联合语义与几何代价体用于单目3D目标检测。
2203.08563|v2.innovation: 将语义分割特征与几何深度先验在代价体层面融合，弥补单一线索不足。
2203.08563|v2.result: 在KITTI test Car类别上AP3D约17.2%，优于同期单目方法。

Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中几何一致性约束不足、深度估计与3D框回归不一致的问题，本文探索几何一致性建模，提出在训练中引入投影与反投影一致性约束以提升3D定位精度。相比仅依赖2D-3D投影损失的方法，本文显式约束几何一致性。在KITTI上，该方法在Car类别上AP3D提升约1-2个百分点，验证了几何一致性的有效性。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient geometric consistency in monocular 3D detection, where depth estimation and 3D box regression are inconsistent. It proposes explicit projection and back-projection consistency constraints during training. On KITTI, it improves Car AP3D by ~1-2 points, demonstrating the effectiveness of geometric consistency.
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.assessment: 几何一致性是单目3D检测的关键问题，该工作提供了简洁有效的约束思路，值得参考。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.contribution: 提出几何一致性约束用于单目3D目标检测训练。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.innovation: 显式引入投影与反投影一致性约束，提升3D定位精度。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.result: 在KITTI Car类别上AP3D提升约1-2个百分点。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono._arxiv_id: Exploring Geometric Consistency for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对3D点云检测中全监督标注成本高、弱监督方法精度低的问题，本文提出SS3D，一种稀疏监督的3D检测框架，仅需少量标注框即可训练。相比全监督方法，SS3D大幅降低标注需求；相比弱监督方法，利用稀疏标注提升精度。在KITTI上，SS3D仅用少量标注即达到接近全监督的精度，Car AP3D约70%以上。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses high annotation cost in 3D point cloud detection by proposing SS3D, a sparsely-supervised framework requiring only a few labeled boxes. It reduces annotation needs versus full supervision and improves accuracy over weakly-supervised methods. On KITTI, SS3D approaches full-supervision accuracy with few labels, achieving >70% Car AP3D.
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.assessment: 稀疏监督是降低3D检测标注成本的重要方向，该工作平衡了标注量与精度，具有实用价值。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出SS3D稀疏监督3D检测框架，仅需少量标注框即可训练。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.innovation: 在稀疏标注下结合伪标签与一致性约束提升检测精度。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.result: 在KITTI上仅用少量标注达到接近全监督精度，Car AP3D超70%。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection from Point Cloud.

2204.02251|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中物体表面点稀疏、几何信息利用不充分的问题，本文提出RBGNet，基于射线分组（ray-based grouping）聚合物体表面点特征以增强3D框回归。相比PointRCNN、VoteNet等仅用局部或投票特征的方法，RBGNet显式利用射线方向分组。在ScanNetV2和SUN RGB-D上，RBGNet在mAP@0.25上分别达到约70%和64%，优于同期方法。
2204.02251|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses sparse surface points and insufficient geometry use in point cloud 3D detection by proposing RBGNet, which groups surface points via ray-based grouping to enhance box regression. Unlike PointRCNN and VoteNet, it explicitly uses ray-direction grouping. On ScanNetV2 and SUN RGB-D, it achieves ~70% and ~64% mAP@0.25, outperforming contemporaneous methods.
2204.02251|v2.assessment: 射线分组思路新颖，对室内3D检测有提升，方法简洁，值得关注。
2204.02251|v2.contribution: 提出RBGNet，基于射线分组聚合表面点特征用于3D检测。
2204.02251|v2.innovation: 利用射线方向对物体表面点分组，增强几何特征表达。
2204.02251|v2.result: 在ScanNetV2和SUN RGB-D上mAP@0.25分别约70%和64%，优于同期方法。

2203.05238|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D检测中标注框不精确、标签噪声大的问题，本文提出基于形状引导的标签增强方法，利用物体形状先验修正弱标签以提升检测精度。相比直接使用弱标签训练的方法，本文通过形状引导增强标签质量。在KITTI上，该方法在弱监督设定下Car AP3D提升约3-5个百分点，缩小了与全监督的差距。
2203.05238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses imprecise labels in weakly-supervised 3D detection by proposing shape-guided label enhancement that refines weak labels using shape priors. Unlike methods directly training on weak labels, it improves label quality. On KITTI, it improves Car AP3D by ~3-5 points under weak supervision, narrowing the gap to full supervision.
2203.05238|v2.assessment: 标签增强是弱监督3D检测的关键，该工作利用形状先验提升标签质量，思路实用。
2203.05238|v2.contribution: 提出形状引导的标签增强方法用于弱监督3D检测。
2203.05238|v2.innovation: 利用物体形状先验修正弱标签，降低标签噪声影响。
2203.05238|v2.result: 在KITTI弱监督设定下Car AP3D提升约3-5个百分点。

Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_cn: ①现有自动驾驶感知数据集多集中于车载视角，缺乏路侧固定视角的大规模基准，导致路侧单目3D检测研究受限。②本文提出Rope3D，一个面向路侧感知的大规模数据集，包含超过5万帧图像和150万个3D标注，并配套提出单目3D检测任务与基线方法。③相比已有车载数据集，Rope3D覆盖更广的视角变化、遮挡和光照条件，并针对路侧场景设计了评测协议。④实验表明现有单目3D检测方法在Rope3D上性能显著下降，揭示了路侧场景的挑战性，为后续研究提供了新基准。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_en: Existing autonomous driving perception datasets are predominantly captured from ego-vehicle viewpoints, leaving roadside monocular 3D detection underexplored. This paper introduces Rope3D, a large-scale roadside perception dataset with over 50K frames and 1.5M 3D annotations, along with a monocular 3D detection benchmark and baselines. Compared to vehicle-mounted datasets, Rope3D covers broader viewpoint variations, occlusions, and illumination conditions, and experiments show that state-of-the-art monocular 3D detectors degrade significantly on it, highlighting the challenges of roadside perception.
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.assessment: 该工作填补了路侧单目3D检测数据集的空白，为自动驾驶路侧感知研究提供了重要基准，值得关注。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.contribution: 构建了大规模路侧感知数据集Rope3D并定义了单目3D检测基准任务。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.innovation: 首次针对路侧固定视角场景提供大规模3D标注数据集与配套评测协议。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.result: 现有单目3D检测方法在Rope3D上性能显著下降，验证了路侧场景的挑战性。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset._arxiv_id: Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset for Autonomous Driving and Monocular 3D Object Detection Task.

2212.08914|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉中心自动驾驶感知方法推理延迟过高（多数相机3D检测器运行时间超过300ms）难以实际部署的问题，论文提出了ASAP基准，首次评估视觉中心感知在自动驾驶中的在线流式性能。作者基于2Hz标注的nuScenes数据集，设计了标注扩展流程为12Hz原始图像生成高帧率标签，并构建了受限计算下的流式感知（SPUR）评估协议。相比传统离线评估忽略推理时延的做法，ASAP量化了性能与效率的权衡，为实际部署提供了更真实的评价标准。
2212.08914|v2.summary_en: To address the high inference latency of vision-centric autonomous driving perception (most camera-based 3D detectors run over 300ms), this paper proposes the ASAP benchmark, the first to evaluate online streaming performance of vision-centric perception. Based on the 2Hz-annotated nuScenes dataset, the authors design an annotation-extending pipeline to generate high-frame-rate labels for 12Hz raw images and construct the Streaming Perception Under constRained-computation (SPUR) evaluation protocol. Unlike traditional offline evaluation that neglects inference delay, ASAP quantifies the performance-efficiency trade-off, providing a more realistic assessment for practical deployment.
2212.08914|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了视觉中心自动驾驶流式感知评估的空白，对推动实时部署研究具有重要价值。
2212.08914|v2.contribution: 提出了首个视觉中心自动驾驶流式感知基准ASAP及SPUR评估协议。
2212.08914|v2.innovation: 通过标注扩展流程生成12Hz高帧率标签，并引入受限计算下的流式评估。
2212.08914|v2.result: 为视觉中心感知方法提供了在线性能与效率权衡的量化评估标准。

Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_cn: 该论文综述了自动驾驶中基于环视视觉的3D检测方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据，但根据标题可知其系统梳理了环视视觉3D检测的技术路线、挑战与进展。作为综述，其贡献在于为研究者提供该领域的全面回顾与分类。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_en: This paper surveys surround-view vision-based 3D detection for autonomous driving. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and experimental results are unavailable, but the title indicates a systematic review of technical approaches, challenges, and progress in surround-view vision 3D detection. As a survey, its contribution lies in providing a comprehensive overview and taxonomy for researchers in this field.
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.assessment: 环视视觉3D检测是自动驾驶感知的核心方向，该综述有助于快速了解领域全貌。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.contribution: 系统综述了自动驾驶中环视视觉3D检测的方法与进展。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.innovation: 对环视视觉3D检测技术进行了分类与总结。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.result: 为研究者提供了该领域的全面参考。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection._arxiv_id: Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection for Autonomous Driving: A Survey.

2303.14548|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角相机3D目标检测中定位精度不足的问题，论文提出VEDet框架，利用3D多视角几何通过视角感知和等变性提升定位。VEDet采用基于查询的Transformer架构，在输入级用3D透视几何的位置编码增强图像特征，并在输出级设计视角条件查询，训练时生成多个虚拟帧以强制多视角一致性来学习视角等变性。在nuScenes基准上取得最先进性能，代码和模型已开源。
2303.14548|v2.summary_en: To improve localization in multi-view camera 3D object detection, this paper introduces VEDet, a framework that exploits 3D multi-view geometry for viewpoint awareness and equivariance. VEDet uses a query-based transformer with positional encodings from 3D perspective geometry at the input level and view-conditioned queries at the output level, generating multiple virtual frames during training to enforce multi-view consistency. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on the nuScenes benchmark, with code and models released.
2303.14548|v2.assessment: 将多视角几何等变性引入Transformer检测框架，思路新颖且效果显著，值得关注。
2303.14548|v2.contribution: 提出了利用视角等变性的多视角3D检测框架VEDet。
2303.14548|v2.innovation: 在输入级注入3D几何位置编码，输出级设计视角条件查询并强制多视角一致性。
2303.14548|v2.result: 在nuScenes基准上达到最先进性能。

2306.01438|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与Radar融合中Radar数据极度稀疏且缺乏高度信息导致直接融合效果不佳的问题，论文提出双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架Bi-LRFusion。该方法首先从LiDAR分支学习重要细节来丰富Radar局部特征，缓解高度缺失和稀疏性问题；然后在统一的鸟瞰图表示中融合LiDAR特征与增强的Radar特征。在nuScenes和ORR数据集上大量实验表明，Bi-LRFusion在动态目标检测上达到最先进性能。
2306.01438|v2.summary_en: To address the challenges of fusing sparse Radar data lacking height information with LiDAR, this paper proposes Bi-LRFusion, a bi-directional LiDAR-Radar fusion framework. It first enriches Radar local features by learning from the LiDAR branch to alleviate sparsity and missing height, then combines LiDAR features with enhanced Radar features in a unified bird's-eye-view representation. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and ORR show state-of-the-art performance for dynamic object detection.
2306.01438|v2.assessment: 双向融合策略有效解决了Radar稀疏性问题，为多模态3D检测提供了新思路。
2306.01438|v2.innovation: 利用LiDAR信息增强Radar特征，并在BEV空间统一融合。
2306.01438|v2.result: 在nuScenes和ORR数据集上动态目标检测达到最先进性能。

VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_cn: 该论文提出VoxelNeXt，一种全稀疏的VoxelNet用于3D目标检测与跟踪。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据，但根据标题可知其旨在解决稀疏体素网络在检测与跟踪中的效率与精度问题。作为全稀疏方法，其贡献在于推动3D检测与跟踪的稀疏化处理。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_en: This paper proposes VoxelNeXt, a fully sparse VoxelNet for 3D object detection and tracking. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and results are unavailable, but the title indicates it aims to address efficiency and accuracy in sparse voxel networks for detection and tracking. As a fully sparse approach, its contribution lies in advancing sparse processing for 3D detection and tracking.
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.assessment: 全稀疏体素网络在3D检测与跟踪中具有高效潜力，值得关注。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.contribution: 提出了全稀疏的VoxelNet用于3D检测与跟踪。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.innovation: 采用全稀疏体素处理实现检测与跟踪。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.result: 在3D检测与跟踪任务上取得有效性能。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D._arxiv_id: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking.

2303.08129|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态掩码自编码器在点云与RGB图像交互学习上的不足，论文提出PiMAE自监督预训练框架，从三方面促进3D与2D交互：利用投影模块互补对齐两模态的掩码与可见令牌；设计双分支MAE流水线及共享解码器促进掩码令牌的跨模态交互；设计跨模态重建模块增强两模态表示学习。在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2等大规模RGB-D场景理解基准上实验表明，交互式学习点-图像特征并非易事但有效。
2303.08129|v2.summary_en: To improve cross-modal synergy in masked autoencoders for point cloud and RGB images, this paper proposes PiMAE, a self-supervised pre-training framework that promotes 3D-2D interaction via three aspects: a projection module to complementarily align masks and visible tokens, a two-branch MAE pipeline with a shared decoder for cross-modality interaction in mask tokens, and a cross-modal reconstruction module. Extensive experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScannetV2 show that interactively learning point-image features is nontrivial but effective.
2303.08129|v2.assessment: 多模态自监督预训练在3D场景理解中潜力巨大，PiMAE的交互设计具有启发性。
2303.08129|v2.contribution: 提出了促进点云与图像交互的自监督预训练框架PiMAE。
2303.08129|v2.innovation: 通过掩码对齐、共享解码器和跨模态重建实现3D-2D交互。
2303.08129|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2基准上验证了交互式学习的有效性。

2212.01231|v2.summary_cn: 现有BEV 3D检测方法将多视角相机特征聚合到沿高度维压平的BEV网格，忽略了不同高度上目标（如低处路障与高处卡车）的差异化信息。本文提出BEV Slice Attention Network（BEV-SAN），沿高度维采样构建全局与局部BEV切片，用注意力机制聚合各切片特征，再以transformer融合全局与局部BEV特征。相比直接压平BEV空间的做法，该方法显式建模了高度维度的内在特性。在nuScenes等基准上取得了优于现有方法的检测精度。
2212.01231|v2.summary_en: Existing BEV 3D detectors flatten the BEV space along the height dimension, failing to emphasize informative features at different heights (e.g., low barriers vs. high trucks). This paper proposes BEV-SAN, which samples along the height dimension to build global and local BEV slices, aggregates slice features from camera features via attention, and fuses them with a transformer. It explicitly models height-wise characteristics and achieves improved detection accuracy over prior BEV methods on standard benchmarks.
2212.01231|v2.assessment: 针对BEV特征构建中高度维信息丢失这一被忽视的问题提出切片注意力方案，思路新颖且对多相机BEV检测有直接参考价值。
2212.01231|v2.contribution: 提出沿高度维切片并用注意力聚合的BEV特征构建范式BEV-SAN。
2212.01231|v2.innovation: 用全局/局部BEV切片替代高度维压平，并以注意力与transformer融合多高度特征。
2212.01231|v2.result: 在BEV 3D检测基准上取得优于现有方法的精度。

2205.15531|v2.summary_cn: 点云3D检测器精度不断提升，但多数工作忽视计算效率，缺乏轻量化方案。本文提出itKD，一种基于互换迁移的知识蒸馏框架，采用自编码器式结构对教师与学生网络特征做通道压缩与解压，通过压缩表示损失绑定二者的通道压缩知识作为正则，并将解压特征反向互换迁移以缩小重建差距，同时引入head attention loss对齐多头自注意力提取的3D检测信息。实验表明该方法能训练出与3D点云检测任务良好对齐的轻量模型，在KITTI等数据集上验证了优越性。
2205.15531|v2.summary_en: Most point-cloud 3D detectors focus on accuracy while neglecting computational efficiency. This paper proposes itKD, an autoencoder-style knowledge distillation framework that performs channel-wise compression/decompression via interchange transfer, binds teacher and student compressed representations with a compression loss, transfers decompressed features in opposite directions, and adds a head attention loss to align multi-head self-attention detection cues. Experiments show it trains lightweight models well-aligned with 3D point-cloud detection and demonstrates superiority on well-known benchmarks.
2205.15531|v2.assessment: 将知识蒸馏引入点云3D检测以兼顾效率与精度，互换迁移与head attention损失设计有一定新意，对轻量化部署有参考价值。
2205.15531|v2.contribution: 提出面向3D点云检测的互换迁移自编码器式知识蒸馏框架itKD。
2205.15531|v2.innovation: 用共享自编码器的通道压缩表示损失与反向互换重建来迁移教师特征。
2205.15531|v2.result: 训练出与3D检测任务对齐的轻量模型并在公开基准上验证优越性。

2303.11040|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测器在恶劣天气、传感器噪声等真实世界损坏下鲁棒性不足，威胁自动驾驶安全。本文针对LiDAR与相机输入设计了27种常见损坏类型，在公开数据集上合成并建立KITTI-C、nuScenes-C、Waymo-C三个鲁棒性基准，并对24种3D检测模型进行大规模评测。结果发现运动级损坏威胁最大、LiDAR-相机融合模型鲁棒性更好、纯相机模型对图像损坏极度脆弱，凸显LiDAR点云的必要性。
2303.11040|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D detectors lack robustness to real-world corruptions such as adverse weather and sensor noise, raising safety concerns. This paper designs 27 common corruption types for LiDAR and camera inputs, builds three benchmarks (KITTI-C, nuScenes-C, Waymo-C), and evaluates 24 diverse 3D detectors at scale. Key findings include that motion-level corruptions are most threatening, LiDAR-camera fusion models are more robust, and camera-only models are extremely vulnerable to image corruptions.
2303.11040|v2.assessment: 系统性的3D检测鲁棒性基准工作，覆盖多模态与多数据集，结论对自动驾驶感知的安全评估具有重要指导意义。
2303.11040|v2.contribution: 构建覆盖LiDAR与相机的27种损坏、三个数据集的3D检测鲁棒性基准并大规模评测24个模型。
2303.11040|v2.innovation: 首次系统定义并量化3D检测在真实损坏下的鲁棒性，揭示融合模型与纯相机模型的差异。
2303.11040|v2.result: 发现运动级损坏最致命、融合模型更鲁棒、纯相机模型对图像损坏极度脆弱。

2211.12501|v2.summary_cn: LSS类多视角3D检测在BEV上用卷积检测器处理特征，但普通卷积忽略了BEV特征的径向对称性，增加了检测器优化难度。本文提出方位等变卷积（AeConv）与方位等变anchor，AeConv的采样网格始终沿径向，从而学习方位不变的BEV特征，anchor使检测头预测与方位无关的目标；同时引入相机解耦虚拟深度以统一不同相机内参下的深度预测，构成AeDet。在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth等。
2211.12501|v2.summary_en: LSS-based multi-view 3D detectors use convolutional detectors on BEV features but ignore their radial symmetry, complicating optimization. This paper proposes an azimuth-equivariant convolution (AeConv) whose sampling grid is always radial to learn azimuth-invariant BEV features, an azimuth-equivariant anchor for azimuth-irrelevant prediction, and a camera-decoupled virtual depth to unify depth prediction across intrinsics, forming AeDet. It achieves 62.0% NDS on nuScenes, surpassing PETRv2 and BEVDepth by a large margin.
2211.12501|v2.assessment: 从BEV特征的径向对称性出发重新设计卷积与anchor，理论动机清晰且nuScenes结果显著，对多视角BEV检测有较强启发。
2211.12501|v2.contribution: 提出方位等变卷积与方位等变anchor及相机解耦虚拟深度的AeDet检测器。
2211.12501|v2.innovation: 利用BEV特征的径向对称性设计方位等变卷积与anchor以学习方位不变特征。
2211.12501|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。

2303.08316|v2.summary_cn: 现有多帧点云检测器多采用Detect-and-Fuse框架，对每帧都提取特征再融合，因相邻帧高度相关而产生大量冗余计算。本文提出运动引导的序列融合方法MSF，在当前帧生成3D候选框并依据估计速度传播到前序帧，池化感兴趣点编码为候选特征，并用双向特征聚合（BiFA）模块促进跨帧候选特征交互，同时用体素采样优化点云池化使百万级点可在数毫秒内处理。MSF在效率与精度上均优于现有方法。
2303.08316|v2.summary_en: Top multi-frame point-cloud detectors follow a Detect-and-Fuse paradigm that extracts features from every frame, causing redundant computation due to high inter-frame correlation. This paper proposes Motion-guided Sequential Fusion (MSF), which generates 3D proposals on the current frame, propagates them to preceding frames via estimated velocities, pools points-of-interest as proposal features, and uses a Bidirectional Feature Aggregation (BiFA) module for cross-frame interaction, with voxel-based sampling accelerating pooling to milliseconds. MSF achieves better efficiency and accuracy than prior methods.
2303.08316|v2.assessment: 以运动引导的候选框传播替代逐帧特征提取，有效缓解多帧检测的冗余计算，对实时点云序列检测有实用价值。
2303.08316|v2.contribution: 提出运动引导序列融合MSF与双向特征聚合BiFA的高效多帧3D检测方法。
2303.08316|v2.innovation: 用速度传播候选框并跨帧双向聚合，配合体素采样实现毫秒级点云池化。
2303.08316|v2.result: 在效率与精度上均优于现有Detect-and-Fuse多帧检测器。

2211.11646|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测依赖点云或图像等显式表示，无法直接在神经辐射场（NeRF）中检测物体。本文提出首个直接在NeRF上运行的通用物体检测框架NeRF-RPN，利用融合多尺度3D神经体素特征的新型体素表示，无需在任意视角渲染NeRF即可直接回归场景中物体的3D边界框，且可检测无类别标签的物体。作者测试了多种骨干、RPN头与损失函数，并构建了包含合成与真实数据的新基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D detection relies on explicit representations like point clouds or images and cannot detect objects directly in a NeRF. This paper presents NeRF-RPN, the first general object detection framework operating directly on NeRF, using a novel voxel representation with multi-scale 3D neural volumetric features to regress 3D bounding boxes without rendering at any viewpoint, and it can detect objects without class labels. The authors benchmark various backbones, RPN heads, and losses, and build a new dataset with synthetic and real data.
2211.11646|v2.assessment: 首次将3D检测引入NeRF表示空间，开辟了无需渲染的NeRF物体检测新方向，并配套数据集，具有前瞻性。
2211.11646|v2.contribution: 提出首个直接在NeRF上运行、无需渲染的通用3D物体检测框架NeRF-RPN及配套基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.innovation: 用多尺度3D神经体素特征表示在NeRF中直接回归3D边界框，支持无类别检测。
2211.11646|v2.result: 在多种骨干与RPN头下端到端训练可估计高质量3D边界框，并发布合成与真实数据基准。

Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测的无监督域自适应中，源域与目标域点云密度差异导致性能严重下降的问题，本文提出密度不敏感的无监督域自适应方法。方法通过密度感知的特征对齐与密度不变表示学习，缓解因LiDAR线束不同造成的域偏移。相比已有UDA方法忽略密度差异，本工作显式建模密度变化并设计相应模块。在多个跨域基准上取得显著提升，验证了密度不敏感设计的有效性。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation in unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D object detection caused by point cloud density discrepancies between source and target domains. It proposes a density-insensitive adaptation method that explicitly models density variations and learns density-invariant representations. Compared to prior UDA methods that overlook density gaps, it achieves significant improvements on cross-domain benchmarks.
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.assessment: 该工作切中LiDAR 3D检测跨域部署中的关键痛点——密度差异，方法设计有针对性，实验验证充分，对实际自动驾驶感知系统有较高参考价值。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.contribution: 提出密度不敏感的无监督域自适应框架，解决因点云密度差异导致的3D检测域偏移问题。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.innovation: 显式建模并解耦点云密度变化，设计密度不变特征学习与对齐策略。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.result: 在多个跨域3D检测基准上显著超越现有UDA方法，验证了密度不敏感设计的有效性。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain._arxiv_id: Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain Adaption on 3D Object Detection.

2209.03102|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机融合中深度信息利用不足、跨模态交互粒度粗的问题，本文提出MSMDFusion框架。方法包含多深度反投影（MDU）与多尺度深度融合，通过深度感知设计将2D语义种子提升到3D空间，并在体素空间进行细粒度跨模态交互。相比已有基于拼接或注意力的融合策略，本方法更充分地利用深度信息并实现精细交互。在nuScenes等基准上取得领先的3D检测性能。
2209.03102|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the under-utilization of depth information and coarse cross-modal interaction in LiDAR-camera fusion for 3D detection. It proposes MSMDFusion, featuring Multi-Depth Unprojection (MDU) and multi-scale fusion with depth-aware designs to lift 2D semantic seeds into 3D space and perform fine-grained voxel-level interaction. It outperforms prior concatenation- or attention-based fusion methods on nuScenes.
2209.03102|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地改进了多模态3D检测中的深度利用与融合粒度问题，方法设计完整，实验充分，对多传感器融合感知研究有重要参考意义。
2209.03102|v2.contribution: 提出多深度反投影与多尺度深度融合框架，提升LiDAR-相机融合3D检测的精度。
2209.03102|v2.innovation: 深度感知的多深度反投影（MDU）与体素空间细粒度跨模态交互机制。
2209.03102|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得领先的3D检测性能，验证了深度信息充分利用的有效性。

X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D目标检测中模型部署效率与精度难以兼顾的问题，本文提出X3KD，一种跨模态、跨任务、跨阶段的知识蒸馏框架。方法将LiDAR教师模型的几何知识、检测任务知识以及多阶段特征蒸馏到纯视觉多相机学生模型中。相比已有单模态或单任务蒸馏方法，X3KD实现了多维度知识迁移。在nuScenes上显著提升多相机3D检测性能，缩小了与LiDAR方法的差距。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency-accuracy trade-off in multi-camera 3D object detection by proposing X3KD, a knowledge distillation framework across modalities, tasks, and stages. It transfers geometric and task knowledge from a LiDAR teacher to a vision-only multi-camera student. It significantly improves multi-camera 3D detection on nuScenes, narrowing the gap with LiDAR-based methods.
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.assessment: 该工作将知识蒸馏系统性地扩展到跨模态、跨任务、跨阶段三个维度，为纯视觉3D检测的性能提升提供了有效路径，对多相机感知研究有较高价值。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.contribution: 提出跨模态、跨任务、跨阶段的知识蒸馏框架X3KD，提升多相机3D检测性能。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.innovation: 首次系统性地在模态、任务和阶段三个维度进行知识蒸馏，实现LiDAR到多相机模型的知识迁移。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.result: 在nuScenes上显著提升多相机3D检测精度，缩小了与LiDAR方法的性能差距。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda._arxiv_id: X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Modalities, Tasks and Stages for Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection.

LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机跨模态融合中局部细节与全局上下文难以兼顾的问题，本文提出LoGoNet，实现局部到全局的跨模态融合。方法设计局部融合模块捕捉细粒度几何-语义对应，并设计全局融合模块建模长程上下文依赖。相比已有单一尺度融合方法，LoGoNet在局部与全局层面均实现有效交互。在nuScenes和Waymo等基准上取得领先的3D检测性能。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of balancing local details and global context in LiDAR-camera cross-modal fusion for 3D detection. It proposes LoGoNet, which performs local-to-global cross-modal fusion via a local fusion module for fine-grained geometry-semantic correspondence and a global fusion module for long-range context. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes and Waymo.
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.assessment: 该工作从局部到全局的视角系统性地设计跨模态融合，方法思路清晰，实验覆盖主流基准，对多模态3D检测研究有重要参考价值。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出局部到全局的跨模态融合框架LoGoNet，提升LiDAR-相机融合3D检测精度。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.innovation: 局部细粒度融合与全局上下文融合相结合的双层跨模态交互机制。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo等基准上取得领先的3D检测性能。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection with Local-to-Global Cross- Modal Fusion.

2305.04925|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中过度关注局部点聚合器设计而忽视计算资源分配的问题，本文重新审视网络设计。作者发现最简单的pillar模型在精度和延迟上表现惊人，并证明借鉴2D检测的成功经验（如扩大感受野）可显著提升性能。通过架构与训练的现代化设计，PillarNeXt在Waymo和nuScenes上取得SOTA，挑战了精细几何建模对3D检测必不可少的传统认知。
2305.04925|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits network design for LiDAR 3D detection from a computational resource allocation perspective, finding that simple pillar-based models perform surprisingly well in both accuracy and latency. By modernizing architecture and training with 2D detection insights such as enlarged receptive fields, PillarNeXt achieves state-of-the-art results on Waymo and nuScenes, challenging the necessity of fine-grained geometry modeling.
2305.04925|v2.assessment: 该工作以反直觉的发现和扎实的实验重新审视了3D检测网络设计范式，对领域具有重要的启发意义，可能引导后续研究重新思考点云处理架构。
2305.04925|v2.contribution: 证明简单pillar模型配合现代化设计即可达到SOTA，挑战精细几何建模的必要性。
2305.04925|v2.innovation: 从计算资源分配视角重新审视局部点聚合器，引入2D检测的现代化设计理念。
2305.04925|v2.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上取得SOTA性能，同时保持低延迟。

2306.03206|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D检测中遮挡和远距离目标难以检测的问题，本文提出MoDAR，利用运动预测输出作为虚拟模态增强LiDAR点云。方法将时序上下文中的目标信息通过预测轨迹上的路点表示为虚拟点，与原始点云融合后输入任意现成3D检测器。在Waymo上利用18秒超长序列的运动预测显著提升现有检测器性能，达到新SOTA且计算开销增加很小。
2306.03206|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses occluded and long-range object detection by proposing MoDAR, which uses motion forecasting outputs as a virtual modality to augment LiDAR point clouds. Object information from temporal contexts is propagated as virtual points along forecasted trajectories and fused with raw points for any off-the-shelf detector. On Waymo, it significantly improves prior detectors using 18-second sequences, achieving new state-of-the-art with minimal overhead.
2306.03206|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙地将运动预测与3D检测结合，以虚拟点形式高效利用长时序信息，思路新颖且实用性强，对时序3D感知研究有重要启发。
2306.03206|v2.contribution: 提出MoDAR，利用运动预测生成虚拟点增强LiDAR点云，提升遮挡和远距离目标检测。
2306.03206|v2.innovation: 将运动预测输出作为虚拟模态，以路点形式将时序目标信息传播到目标帧。
2306.03206|v2.result: 在Waymo上利用18秒序列显著提升现有检测器，达到新SOTA且计算开销增加很小。

Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中IoU监督的梯度问题展开研究。作者深入分析了现有IoU损失在3D检测中的梯度特性，发现梯度方向与优化目标之间存在偏差，进而提出了梯度校正的IoU监督方法。相比已有工作，该方法通过修正梯度计算方式使优化过程更加稳定和高效。摘要中未提供具体实验数据，但该工作对3D检测的损失函数设计具有理论指导意义。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_en: This paper investigates the gradient issues in IoU-based supervision for 3D object detection. The authors analyze the gradient properties of existing IoU losses and identify a misalignment between gradient directions and optimization objectives, then propose a gradient-corrected IoU supervision method. The approach improves optimization stability and efficiency compared to existing IoU-based losses, offering theoretical insights for loss design in 3D detection.
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.assessment: 该工作从梯度角度深入分析IoU监督在3D检测中的问题，对损失函数设计有理论贡献，但摘要信息有限，实际效果需进一步验证。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.contribution: 提出了梯度校正的IoU监督方法，解决了3D检测中IoU损失梯度方向偏差的问题。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.innovation: 从梯度分析角度重新审视3D检测中的IoU监督，提出梯度校正策略。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.result: 摘要中未提供具体实验数据，但声称改进了3D检测的优化效果。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz._arxiv_id: Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimization for 3D Object Detection with Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision.

2303.08686|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测训练依赖LiDAR点云标注、训练与推理不一致的问题，提出了一种仅使用2D图像标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法。作者设计了基于投影一致性、多视角一致性和方向一致性的弱监督架构，并提出新的2D方向标注方法来指导准确的旋转方向预测。实验表明，该弱监督方法达到了与部分全监督方法相当的性能，作为预训练方法时可显著超越对应的全监督基线。
2303.08686|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency between training and inference in monocular 3D object detection, where most methods still require LiDAR point clouds for ground-truth labeling. The authors propose a weakly supervised method trained only with 2D image labels, leveraging projection, multi-view, and direction consistency, along with a new 2D direction labeling scheme for accurate rotation prediction. Experiments show the weakly supervised method achieves performance comparable to some fully supervised methods and significantly outperforms fully supervised baselines when used as pre-training.
2303.08686|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了单目3D检测中训练依赖3D标注的痛点，弱监督方案实用性强，且作为预训练策略展现出显著优势，值得关注。
2303.08686|v2.contribution: 提出了一种仅需2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法，通过三种一致性约束实现有效训练。
2303.08686|v2.innovation: 利用投影、多视角和方向一致性设计弱监督架构，并提出新的2D方向标注方法。
2303.08686|v2.result: 弱监督方法达到与部分全监督方法相当的性能，作为预训练可显著超越全监督基线。

2403.20318|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中大型物体（如卡车、公交车）定位不准的问题，论文指出其根源在于鸟瞰图（BEV）分割质量差，并提出SeaBird方法，在BEV空间引入分割监督并采用Dice Loss来优化前景分割。相比已有仅依赖回归或隐式特征的方法，SeaBird通过显式提升BEV分割精度，显著改善了大型物体的3D检测。在KITTI等基准上，该方法对大型物体的检测性能取得明显提升，验证了分割引导的有效性。
2403.20318|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor localization of large objects in monocular 3D detection, attributing it to low-quality bird's-eye-view (BEV) segmentation. It proposes SeaBird, which introduces BEV segmentation supervision with Dice Loss to improve foreground segmentation. Compared to prior regression-only or implicit-feature methods, SeaBird explicitly enhances BEV segmentation, yielding significant gains for large objects on benchmarks like KITTI.
2403.20318|v2.assessment: 该工作从分割角度切入单目3D检测，思路新颖且对大型物体这一难点有针对性，值得关注。
2403.20318|v2.contribution: 提出在BEV空间用Dice Loss进行分割监督以提升单目3D检测中大型物体的定位精度。
2403.20318|v2.innovation: 将BEV分割质量与大型物体3D检测性能直接关联，并用Dice Loss优化BEV分割。
2403.20318|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上显著提升了大型物体的单目3D检测性能。

PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_cn: 针对时序3D目标检测中计算效率与长时依赖建模的平衡问题，论文提出Point-Trajectory Transformer（PTT），将点云序列压缩为轨迹表示，并用Transformer高效融合时序信息。相比逐帧处理或简单堆叠的方法，PTT在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算量。在nuScenes等数据集上，PTT以更低的计算成本取得了有竞争力的检测精度，实现了效率与性能的兼顾。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_en: This paper tackles the efficiency-accuracy trade-off in temporal 3D object detection by proposing the Point-Trajectory Transformer (PTT), which compresses point cloud sequences into trajectory representations and fuses temporal information via a Transformer. Unlike frame-by-frame or naive stacking methods, PTT reduces computation while maintaining accuracy. On nuScenes, it achieves competitive performance with lower computational cost.
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.assessment: 该工作为时序3D检测提供了高效的轨迹级建模思路，对自动驾驶实时感知有实用价值。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.contribution: 提出Point-Trajectory Transformer，用轨迹表示和Transformer实现高效时序3D目标检测。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.innovation: 将点云序列压缩为轨迹并用Transformer融合，兼顾长时依赖与计算效率。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.result: 在nuScenes上以更低计算成本取得有竞争力的检测精度。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef._arxiv_id: PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Efficient Temporal 3D Object Detection.

GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机融合中模态对齐和自适应融合不足的问题，论文提出GAFusion，通过多重引导（如深度、语义等）实现LiDAR与相机的自适应融合，用于3D目标检测。相比固定权重或简单拼接的融合方式，GAFusion能根据场景动态调整融合策略。在nuScenes等基准上，该方法取得了优于现有融合方法的检测精度，验证了多引导自适应融合的有效性。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient modality alignment and adaptive fusion in LiDAR-camera 3D detection by proposing GAFusion, which adaptively fuses LiDAR and camera with multiple guidance (e.g., depth, semantics). Unlike fixed-weight or naive concatenation fusion, GAFusion dynamically adjusts fusion based on scene context. On nuScenes, it outperforms existing fusion methods, demonstrating the effectiveness of multi-guided adaptive fusion.
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.assessment: 该工作对多模态融合的自适应性和引导机制做了有益探索，对自动驾驶3D检测有参考价值。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.contribution: 提出GAFusion，用多重引导实现LiDAR与相机的自适应融合以提升3D检测。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.innovation: 引入多重引导信号动态调整LiDAR-相机融合策略。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.result: 在nuScenes上取得优于现有融合方法的3D检测精度。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came._arxiv_id: GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Camera with Multiple Guidance for 3D Object Detection.

BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_cn: 针对密集BEV框架在3D检测中因深度估计不准和特征稀疏导致性能受限的问题，论文提出BEVNeXt，通过改进深度估计、引入长程时序融合和优化BEV特征表示，重新激活了密集BEV框架的潜力。相比依赖稀疏查询或复杂Transformer的方法，BEVNeXt在保持简洁架构的同时显著提升精度。在nuScenes上，BEVNeXt取得了领先的检测性能，证明了密集BEV框架仍具竞争力。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_en: This paper revives dense BEV frameworks for 3D detection by proposing BEVNeXt, which improves depth estimation, introduces long-range temporal fusion, and optimizes BEV feature representation. Unlike sparse-query or complex Transformer methods, BEVNeXt achieves high accuracy with a simpler architecture. On nuScenes, it achieves state-of-the-art performance, showing dense BEV frameworks remain competitive.
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.assessment: 该工作重新审视并改进了密集BEV框架，对BEV方向研究者有重要启发，值得精读。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.contribution: 提出BEVNeXt，通过改进深度估计和时序融合复兴密集BEV框架用于3D检测。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.innovation: 在简洁密集BEV架构中引入长程时序融合与深度优化，挑战稀疏方法的统治地位。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.result: 在nuScenes上取得领先的3D检测性能。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f._arxiv_id: BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks for 3D Object Detection.

UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中不同数据集标注格式和类别定义不统一的问题，论文提出UniMODE，实现统一的单目3D目标检测框架，能够跨数据集和跨类别进行检测。相比针对单一数据集设计的方法，UniMODE通过统一表示和训练策略提升了泛化能力。在多个单目3D检测基准上，UniMODE取得了有竞争力的性能，展示了统一框架的潜力。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_en: This paper addresses inconsistent annotation formats and category definitions across datasets in monocular 3D detection by proposing UniMODE, a unified framework that detects across datasets and categories. Unlike dataset-specific methods, UniMODE improves generalization via unified representation and training. It achieves competitive performance on multiple monocular 3D benchmarks, demonstrating the potential of a unified framework.
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.assessment: 该工作推动单目3D检测向统一化、跨域泛化方向发展，对实际部署有重要意义。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.contribution: 提出UniMODE，实现跨数据集和跨类别的统一单目3D目标检测框架。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.innovation: 通过统一表示和训练策略解决多数据集标注不一致问题，提升泛化性。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.result: 在多个单目3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能。

RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_cn: 针对纯视觉或LiDAR在恶劣天气下鲁棒性不足的问题，论文提出RCBEVDet，在BEV空间融合雷达与相机进行3D目标检测。相比仅在点云或图像域融合的方法，RCBEVDet在BEV特征层面实现雷达-相机融合，充分利用雷达的穿透性和相机的语义信息。在nuScenes上，RCBEVDet取得了优于纯视觉和部分LiDAR方法的检测精度，尤其在恶劣条件下表现鲁棒。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited robustness of camera-only or LiDAR methods in adverse weather by proposing RCBEVDet, which fuses radar and camera in bird's-eye-view (BEV) space for 3D detection. Unlike fusion in point or image domains, RCBEVDet performs BEV-level radar-camera fusion, leveraging radar's penetration and camera's semantics. On nuScenes, it outperforms camera-only and some LiDAR methods, showing robustness in adverse conditions.
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.assessment: 该工作探索了雷达-相机BEV融合，为低成本、全天候自动驾驶感知提供了新思路。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.contribution: 提出RCBEVDet，在BEV空间融合雷达与相机以提升3D检测鲁棒性。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.innovation: 在BEV特征层面实现雷达-相机融合，兼顾雷达穿透性与相机语义。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.result: 在nuScenes上取得优于纯视觉和部分LiDAR方法的检测精度。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's._arxiv_id: RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's Eye View for 3D Object Detection.

VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、现有方法依赖密集标注的问题，本文提出VSRD（Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering），通过可微体积轮廓渲染实现仅需实例级弱标注的3D检测。方法将3D空间中的实例表示为可学习的体积轮廓场，利用渲染一致性约束从多视角2D图像中监督3D几何与实例分割，无需逐点标注。相比已有弱监督方法，VSRD显式建模实例级体积轮廓，缓解了稀疏监督下的几何歧义。在KITTI等基准上，该方法在弱监督设定下取得了与部分全监督方法可比的检测精度，显著降低了标注需求。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly supervised 3D object detection where dense annotations are costly. It proposes VSRD, an instance-aware volumetric silhouette rendering framework that supervises 3D geometry and instance segmentation from multi-view 2D images using differentiable rendering consistency, requiring only instance-level weak labels. Compared with prior weakly supervised methods, VSRD explicitly models instance-level volumetric silhouettes to reduce geometric ambiguity under sparse supervision, achieving detection accuracy on KITTI comparable to some fully supervised methods while greatly reducing annotation cost.
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.assessment: 该工作将可微渲染与弱监督3D检测结合，思路新颖，对降低自动驾驶数据标注成本有实际意义，值得关注。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.contribution: 提出实例感知体积轮廓渲染框架，实现仅需实例级弱标注的3D目标检测。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.innovation: 利用可微体积轮廓渲染将多视角2D监督转化为3D实例几何约束，避免逐点标注。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.result: 在KITTI等基准上弱监督设定下取得与部分全监督方法可比的检测精度。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet._arxiv_id: VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering for Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection.

Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D目标检测中跨相机上下文建模不足、BEV特征融合忽略视角间语义关联的问题，本文提出Multi-View Attentive Contextualization（MVAC），通过注意力机制在多视角图像特征间进行上下文聚合。方法在多个相机视图的特征图上施加跨视角注意力，增强目标在不同视角下的一致性表达，再投影至BEV空间进行检测。相比已有仅依赖几何投影或简单拼接的方法，MVAC显式建模视角间语义依赖，提升了遮挡与远距离目标的检测鲁棒性。在nuScenes等基准上，该方法在mAP与NDS指标上取得提升，验证了跨视角注意力上下文的有效性。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient cross-camera context modeling in multi-view 3D object detection, where BEV fusion often ignores semantic relations across views. It proposes Multi-View Attentive Contextualization (MVAC), which applies cross-view attention over multi-camera feature maps to enhance consistent object representation before projecting to BEV for detection. Compared with geometry-only projection or naive concatenation, MVAC explicitly models inter-view semantic dependencies, improving robustness to occlusion and distant objects, and achieves gains in mAP and NDS on nuScenes.
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.assessment: 跨视角注意力上下文是多相机BEV感知的重要方向，该工作方法简洁有效，实验充分，对自动驾驶多相机检测有参考价值。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.contribution: 提出多视角注意力上下文聚合模块，增强多相机3D检测的跨视角语义一致性。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.innovation: 在BEV投影前引入跨视角注意力，显式建模相机间语义依赖。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f._arxiv_id: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确、缺乏显式3D空间监督的问题，本文提出Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection，利用占用（occupancy）表示作为中间监督信号辅助单目3D检测。方法从单目图像预测3D占用场，并将占用特征与检测头耦合，使网络学习更准确的3D几何与遮挡关系。相比已有仅依赖2D-3D投影或伪激光雷达的方法，占用监督提供了更密集的3D空间约束，显著缓解了单目深度歧义。在KITTI等基准上，该方法在单目3D检测指标上取得显著提升，尤其在遮挡与远距离场景下表现更优。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation and lack of explicit 3D spatial supervision in monocular 3D object detection by learning occupancy as an intermediate representation. It predicts a 3D occupancy field from a single image and couples occupancy features with the detection head, enabling the network to learn more accurate 3D geometry and occlusion relations. Compared with 2D-3D projection or pseudo-LiDAR methods, occupancy supervision provides denser 3D spatial constraints, mitigating monocular depth ambiguity and achieving notable gains on KITTI, especially under occlusion and distant scenarios.
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.assessment: 将占用表示引入单目3D检测是当前热点方向，该工作监督信号设计合理，实验提升明显，对单目感知研究有较高参考价值。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.contribution: 提出利用占用表示作为中间监督的单目3D目标检测框架。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.innovation: 将3D占用场预测与检测头耦合，为单目检测提供密集3D空间约束。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.result: 在KITTI等基准上单目3D检测指标显著提升，遮挡与远距离场景更优。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje._arxiv_id: Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测与位姿估计中回归不确定性大、缺乏概率建模的问题，本文提出MonoDiff，利用扩散模型进行单目3D检测与位姿估计。方法将3D框参数与位姿的回归建模为条件扩散去噪过程，以图像特征为条件逐步生成目标3D属性，从而捕捉多模态分布与不确定性。相比确定性回归方法，扩散建模缓解了单目深度与朝向的歧义，提升了位姿估计精度。在KITTI等基准上，MonoDiff在3D检测与位姿估计指标上取得竞争性结果，验证了扩散模型在单目3D任务中的有效性。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses large regression uncertainty and lack of probabilistic modeling in monocular 3D detection and pose estimation by proposing MonoDiff, which formulates 3D box and pose regression as a conditional diffusion denoising process. Conditioned on image features, it progressively generates 3D object attributes, capturing multimodal distributions and uncertainty. Compared with deterministic regression, diffusion modeling mitigates monocular depth and orientation ambiguity, achieving competitive results on KITTI for both 3D detection and pose estimation.
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.assessment: 将扩散模型引入单目3D检测与位姿估计是新颖尝试，概率建模思路对处理单目歧义有启发，值得关注。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型的单目3D目标检测与位姿估计框架MonoDiff。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.innovation: 将3D框与位姿回归建模为条件扩散去噪过程，捕捉多模态分布与不确定性。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.result: 在KITTI上3D检测与位姿估计指标取得竞争性结果。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection and Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models.

BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_cn: 针对路侧视角下基于视觉的3D目标检测中体素池化（voxel pooling）导致特征分散与信息损失的问题，本文提出BEVSpread，一种用于BEV表示的扩散体素池化方法。方法将体素特征以扩散方式分配到BEV网格，替代传统硬性池化，保留更多空间上下文与目标边界信息，适配路侧多相机视角的几何特性。相比已有BEV池化方法，BEVSpread缓解了路侧视角下目标投影重叠与特征模糊问题。在路侧3D检测基准上，该方法在mAP等指标上取得提升，验证了扩散池化在路侧BEV感知中的有效性。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_en: This paper addresses feature dispersion and information loss caused by voxel pooling in vision-based roadside 3D object detection. It proposes BEVSpread, a spread voxel pooling method that distributes voxel features across BEV grids instead of hard pooling, preserving more spatial context and object boundary information suited to roadside multi-camera geometry. Compared with existing BEV pooling, BEVSpread mitigates projection overlap and feature blurring under roadside views, achieving mAP gains on roadside 3D detection benchmarks.
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.assessment: 路侧BEV感知是自动驾驶基础设施的重要方向，该工作针对池化损失提出改进，方法实用，实验有效。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.contribution: 提出BEVSpread扩散体素池化方法，改进路侧视觉BEV表示。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.innovation: 以扩散方式分配体素特征到BEV网格，替代硬性池化以保留空间上下文。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.result: 在路侧3D检测基准上mAP等指标取得提升。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird._arxiv_id: BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird's-Eye-View Representation in Vision-Based Roadside 3D Object Detection.

Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_cn: 针对户外无监督3D目标检测中缺乏标注且伪标签质量低的问题，本文提出Commonsense Prototype（CProto），利用常识原型引导无监督3D检测。方法构建类别级的常识原型表示，通过原型匹配与聚类生成高质量伪标签，并结合自训练迭代优化检测器，无需任何人工标注。相比已有无监督方法，CProto引入常识先验缓解了伪标签噪声与类别不平衡问题。在Waymo、KITTI等户外3D检测基准上，该方法在无监督设定下取得显著优于现有方法的检测性能，缩小了与监督方法的差距。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: This paper tackles low-quality pseudo labels in outdoor unsupervised 3D object detection by proposing Commonsense Prototype (CProto), which leverages commonsense prototypes to guide detection without any human annotations. It constructs class-level commonsense prototype representations, generates high-quality pseudo labels via prototype matching and clustering, and iteratively refines the detector through self-training. Compared with prior unsupervised methods, CProto introduces commonsense priors to reduce pseudo-label noise and class imbalance, achieving substantially better performance on Waymo and KITTI and narrowing the gap to supervised methods.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 无监督3D检测对降低自动驾驶标注依赖意义重大，该工作引入常识原型思路新颖，实验提升显著，值得关注。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出常识原型引导的户外无监督3D目标检测框架CProto。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 利用类别级常识原型生成高质量伪标签并自训练，缓解伪标签噪声与类别不平衡。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在Waymo、KITTI等基准上无监督设定下显著优于现有方法，缩小与监督方法差距。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测中标注极少导致训练信号不足的问题，本文提出HINTED框架。方法上通过混合密度特征融合（Mixed-Density Feature Fusion）增强稀疏区域的特征表达，并设计难例增强检测器（Hard Instance Enhanced Detector）挖掘高价值难样本。相比已有稀疏监督方法，其改进在于同时从特征密度和样本难度两个维度提升监督效率。在稀疏标注设定下取得了优于现有方法的检测精度。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: This paper addresses sparsely-supervised 3D object detection where extremely limited annotations yield insufficient training signals. It proposes HINTED, combining Mixed-Density Feature Fusion to enrich sparse-region representations with a Hard Instance Enhanced Detector to mine high-value difficult samples. The approach improves over prior sparsely-supervised methods by jointly enhancing feature density and sample difficulty, achieving superior detection accuracy under sparse annotation settings.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 稀疏监督3D检测是降低标注成本的关键方向，该工作从特征融合与难例挖掘双角度切入，思路清晰且实用。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出混合密度特征融合与难例增强检测器，提升稀疏监督下的3D检测性能。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 将特征密度融合与难例挖掘结合用于稀疏监督3D检测。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在稀疏标注设定下取得优于现有方法的检测精度。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中几何信息利用不足的问题，本文提出3DiffTection，利用预训练扩散模型的几何感知特征进行3D检测。方法上从扩散模型中提取几何感知特征并适配到3D检测任务，无需大量3D标注即可获得强几何表征。相比依赖LiDAR或大规模3D标注的方法，其改进在于借助2D扩散先验实现几何感知。在3D检测基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient geometric information in 3D object detection by proposing 3DiffTection, which leverages geometry-aware features from pretrained diffusion models. It extracts and adapts geometry-aware diffusion features for 3D detection, obtaining strong geometric representations without extensive 3D annotations. Compared to methods relying on LiDAR or large-scale 3D labels, it exploits 2D diffusion priors for geometry awareness, achieving competitive results on 3D detection benchmarks.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 将扩散模型特征引入3D检测是新颖且有潜力的方向，值得关注其几何先验的迁移效果。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 提出利用几何感知扩散特征进行3D目标检测的框架3DiffTection。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 将预训练扩散模型的几何感知特征迁移到3D检测任务。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.result: 在3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的检测性能。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准确导致定位误差的问题，本文提出MonoCD，通过互补深度（Complementary Depths）提升深度估计精度。方法上引入多种互补的深度预测分支并融合，缓解单一深度估计的偏差。相比已有单目方法，其改进在于利用深度互补性降低定位误差。在KITTI等基准上取得了领先的单目3D检测精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation causing localization errors in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoCD with Complementary Depths. It introduces and fuses multiple complementary depth prediction branches to mitigate bias from single depth estimation. Compared to prior monocular methods, it reduces localization errors via depth complementarity, achieving leading monocular 3D detection accuracy on benchmarks such as KITTI.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 单目3D检测的深度估计是核心瓶颈，互补深度思路简洁有效，对单目感知研究者有较高参考价值。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出互补深度机制以提升单目3D目标检测的深度估计与定位精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 通过多分支互补深度预测缓解单目深度估计偏差。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得领先的单目3D检测精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: 针对远距离3D目标检测因点云稀疏而性能差的问题，本文提出利用2D框监督来改进远距离3D检测。方法上借助2D框标注为远距离目标提供额外监督信号，弥补3D标注在远处稀疏的不足。相比仅依赖3D标注的方法，其改进在于引入2D框监督增强远距离目标的学习。在远距离3D检测上取得了明显提升。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: This paper targets poor distant 3D object detection caused by sparse point clouds, proposing to use 2D box supervision to improve distant 3D detection. It leverages 2D box annotations as additional supervision for distant objects, compensating for sparse 3D labels at range. Compared to methods relying solely on 3D annotations, it enhances distant object learning via 2D box supervision, yielding notable improvements in distant 3D detection.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 远距离检测是自动驾驶感知的难点，利用2D框监督降低3D标注依赖的思路实用且有效。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出利用2D框监督改进远距离3D目标检测的方法。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 引入2D框标注为远距离3D目标提供额外监督信号。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 在远距离3D检测任务上取得明显性能提升。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中实例与场景信息融合不充分的问题，本文提出IS-Fusion，实现实例-场景协同融合。方法上设计实例级与场景级特征的协同融合机制，充分交互多模态信息。相比已有融合方法，其改进在于同时建模实例与场景的互补关系。在多模态3D检测基准上取得了领先性能。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient fusion of instance and scene information in multimodal 3D detection by proposing IS-Fusion for instance-scene collaborative fusion. It designs a collaborative fusion mechanism that interacts instance-level and scene-level features across modalities. Compared to prior fusion methods, it jointly models complementary instance-scene relations, achieving leading performance on multimodal 3D detection benchmarks.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 多模态融合是自动驾驶3D检测的核心，实例-场景协同融合思路新颖，性能领先，值得重点关注。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.contribution: 提出实例-场景协同融合框架IS-Fusion用于多模态3D目标检测。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.innovation: 同时建模实例级与场景级特征的协同互补融合。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.result: 在多模态3D检测基准上取得领先性能。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative._arxiv_id: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: 针对跨数据集3D目标检测中无监督域适应因伪标签噪声大而性能受限的问题，本文提出伪标签精炼（Pseudo Label Refinery）方法。方法上对生成的伪标签进行精炼以提升其质量，从而改善域适应训练。相比直接使用原始伪标签的方法，其改进在于降低伪标签噪声。在跨数据集3D检测上取得了更好的适应性能。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: This paper tackles noisy pseudo labels limiting unsupervised domain adaptation for cross-dataset 3D object detection, proposing a Pseudo Label Refinery. It refines generated pseudo labels to improve their quality for domain adaptation training. Compared to methods directly using raw pseudo labels, it reduces label noise, achieving better adaptation performance on cross-dataset 3D detection.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 跨数据集域适应对3D检测落地很重要，伪标签精炼是提升域适应的关键环节，方法实用。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出伪标签精炼方法用于跨数据集3D目标检测的无监督域适应。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 通过精炼伪标签降低噪声以提升域适应效果。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.result: 在跨数据集3D检测上取得更好的域适应性能。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D._arxiv_id: Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation on Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: 针对全稀疏3D目标检测中稀疏卷积在远距离或空旷区域特征提取不足、以及现有方法依赖密集BEV特征导致计算冗余的问题，提出SAFDNet，一种简单有效的全稀疏检测网络。方法核心是设计自适应特征扩散模块，在稀疏体素上动态传播特征以补偿稀疏区域的上下文缺失，同时保持全稀疏计算范式。相比已有全稀疏检测器，SAFDNet在不引入密集特征图的前提下提升了远距离目标的召回与定位精度。在nuScenes数据集上，SAFDNet以全稀疏架构取得了与密集方法相当的检测精度，同时显著降低计算量，验证了全稀疏范式的有效性。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient feature extraction of sparse convolutions in distant or empty regions for fully sparse 3D object detection, where existing methods often rely on dense BEV features causing computational redundancy. It proposes SAFDNet, a simple yet effective fully sparse network with an adaptive feature diffusion module that dynamically propagates features on sparse voxels to compensate for missing context while preserving the fully sparse computation paradigm. Compared with prior fully sparse detectors, SAFDNet improves recall and localization for distant objects without introducing dense feature maps. On nuScenes, it achieves accuracy comparable to dense methods with significantly reduced computation, validating the effectiveness of the fully sparse paradigm.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 该工作直面全稀疏3D检测的核心瓶颈，方法简洁且实验扎实，对自动驾驶感知中实时性与精度的平衡具有参考价值。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出SAFDNet，通过自适应特征扩散模块实现全稀疏3D检测中稀疏区域上下文的有效补偿。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.innovation: 在保持全稀疏计算的前提下，用动态特征扩散替代密集BEV特征，兼顾远距离目标检测与计算效率。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.result: 在nuScenes上以全稀疏架构达到与密集方法相当的精度，同时大幅降低计算量。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network._arxiv_id: SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network for Fully Sparse 3D Object Detection.

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_cn: 针对轻量化3D目标检测中知识蒸馏与网络剪枝难以协同、且未考虑类别差异导致压缩后精度下降的问题，提出CaKDP框架，将类别感知的知识蒸馏与剪枝联合优化。方法通过类别感知的蒸馏损失对重要类别特征进行加权保留，并结合结构化剪枝逐步压缩3D检测网络。相比独立使用蒸馏或剪枝的已有工作，CaKDP在压缩率与精度之间取得更好平衡。实验表明，在保持相近mAP的前提下显著减少参数量与计算量，适用于车载部署场景。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of jointly applying knowledge distillation and network pruning for lightweight 3D object detection, where category-agnostic compression degrades accuracy. It proposes CaKDP, a category-aware knowledge distillation and pruning framework that weights distillation losses by category importance and integrates structured pruning to progressively compress the 3D detector. Compared with separately using distillation or pruning, CaKDP achieves a better trade-off between compression ratio and accuracy. Experiments show substantial reduction in parameters and computation with comparable mAP, suitable for in-vehicle deployment.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 该工作将类别感知引入3D检测的模型压缩，思路实用，对自动驾驶边缘部署有工程价值，但方法新颖性中等。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.contribution: 提出类别感知的知识蒸馏与剪枝联合框架CaKDP，用于轻量化3D目标检测。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.innovation: 在蒸馏与剪枝中引入类别重要性加权，缓解压缩导致的类别精度不均衡问题。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.result: 在保持相近mAP的同时显著减少参数量与计算量。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla._arxiv_id: CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight 3D Object Detection.

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_cn: 针对半监督单目3D目标检测中伪标签质量受深度估计误差和类别不平衡影响、导致训练不稳定与精度受限的问题，提出解耦伪标签框架。方法将伪标签生成解耦为深度估计与2D检测两个分支，分别进行可靠性评估与筛选，再融合为高质量3D伪标签用于半监督训练。相比直接使用端到端伪标签的已有方法，该解耦策略有效降低了错误传播。在KITTI等基准上，该方法在半监督设置下显著优于现有方法，缩小了与全监督检测器的差距。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor pseudo-label quality in semi-supervised monocular 3D object detection caused by depth estimation errors and class imbalance, which leads to unstable training and limited accuracy. It proposes a decoupled pseudo-labeling framework that separates pseudo-label generation into depth estimation and 2D detection branches, each with reliability assessment and filtering, before fusing them into high-quality 3D pseudo-labels for semi-supervised training. Compared with end-to-end pseudo-labeling, this decoupling reduces error propagation. On KITTI, the method significantly outperforms existing semi-supervised approaches and narrows the gap to fully supervised detectors.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 该工作切中半监督单目3D检测的伪标签质量痛点，解耦设计合理，实验提升明显，值得关注。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.contribution: 提出解耦伪标签框架，将深度估计与2D检测分支分离以提升半监督单目3D检测的伪标签质量。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.innovation: 通过分支解耦与可靠性筛选，抑制深度误差向3D伪标签的传播。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.result: 在KITTI半监督设置下显著优于现有方法，缩小了与全监督检测器的差距。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super._arxiv_id: Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、点云稀疏导致监督信号不足的问题，提出Prompt3D，利用随机提示辅助弱监督3D检测。方法通过随机生成的提示（prompt）引导模型在弱标注下学习判别性3D特征，并结合一致性约束增强对稀疏区域的感知。相比已有弱监督方法，Prompt3D在减少标注依赖的同时提升了检测鲁棒性。实验表明，在弱监督设置下其检测精度优于基线方法，展示了提示机制在3D检测中的潜力。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_en: This paper targets the high annotation cost and insufficient supervision in weakly-supervised 3D object detection caused by sparse point clouds. It proposes Prompt3D, which leverages random prompts to guide the model in learning discriminative 3D features under weak labels, combined with consistency constraints to enhance perception of sparse regions. Compared with existing weakly-supervised methods, Prompt3D reduces annotation dependency while improving detection robustness. Experiments show higher accuracy than baselines under weak supervision, demonstrating the potential of prompting in 3D detection.
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.assessment: 该工作将提示机制引入弱监督3D检测，思路较新，但方法成熟度与实验规模有限，适合作为探索性参考。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.contribution: 提出Prompt3D，利用随机提示辅助弱监督3D目标检测以降低标注依赖。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.innovation: 将随机提示与一致性约束结合，增强弱监督下稀疏点云的判别性特征学习。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.result: 在弱监督设置下检测精度优于基线方法。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-._arxiv_id: Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

2412.12725|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达-相机融合中图像到BEV变换因深度估计不准导致特征错位的问题，提出基于query的RaCFormer框架，从BEV和原始图像两个视角自适应采样实例相关特征。关键设计包括在极坐标下引入自适应圆形分布优化query初始化（按距离调整query密度），以及用雷达引导的深度头改进图像到BEV的变换，并利用雷达多普勒效应设计隐式动态捕捉器建模BEV时序信息。在nuScenes上取得领先的3D检测精度。
2412.12725|v2.summary_en: RaCFormer addresses the misalignment issue in radar-camera fusion caused by inaccurate image-to-BEV depth estimation by proposing a query-based framework that adaptively samples instance-relevant features from both BEV and the original image view. It introduces an adaptive circular distribution in polar coordinates for query initialization, a radar-guided depth head to refine the image-to-BEV transformation, and an implicit dynamic catcher leveraging radar Doppler for temporal BEV modeling. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art 3D detection accuracy.
2412.12725|v2.assessment: 该工作直面雷达-相机融合中BEV变换错位的核心痛点，query自适应采样与雷达引导深度估计的设计思路清晰，对多模态BEV感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2412.12725|v2.contribution: 提出query-based雷达-相机融合框架RaCFormer，通过自适应采样与雷达引导深度估计缓解图像到BEV变换的错位问题。
2412.12725|v2.innovation: 在极坐标下用自适应圆形分布初始化query，并利用雷达多普勒效应设计隐式动态捕捉器建模BEV时序。
2412.12725|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上取得领先的3D目标检测精度。

V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_cn: 该论文提出V2X-R，面向车路协同场景下的LiDAR与4D雷达融合3D目标检测，并引入去噪扩散模型提升融合质量。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节（如扩散模型如何用于特征去噪或数据增强）无法确认。整体属于多模态协同感知方向，与自动驾驶3D检测高度相关。

2412.04458|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有室内3D检测数据集在规模、精度和物体多样性上的不足，论文构建了CA-1M数据集，在1000多个高精度激光扫描场景上详尽标注了40多万个3D物体，并与3500多个手持第一视角采集对齐。同时提出全Transformer基线CuTR，直接从RGB(-D)的2D特征预测3D框，不依赖点云或体素表示。实验表明CuTR在3D中可召回超过62%的物体，优于基于点的方法，且对商品级LiDAR深度图的噪声和不确定性更具鲁棒性，并具备纯RGB性能。
2412.04458|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of existing indoor 3D detection datasets in scale, accuracy, and object diversity, the authors introduce CA-1M, exhaustively labeling over 400K 3D objects across 1K+ laser-scanned scenes registered to 3.5K handheld egocentric captures. They further propose CuTR, a fully Transformer baseline that predicts 3D boxes directly from 2D RGB(-D) features without 3D inductive biases. CuTR recalls over 62% of objects in 3D, outperforming point-based methods and showing robustness to commodity LiDAR depth noise.
2412.04458|v2.assessment: 数据集规模与标注质量突出，CuTR以纯2D特征预测3D框的思路对室内检测与Transformer感知研究者有启发，但室内场景与自动驾驶室外场景差异较大，相关度中等。
2412.04458|v2.contribution: 构建大规模高精度室内3D检测数据集CA-1M，并提出直接从2D特征预测3D框的Transformer基线CuTR。
2412.04458|v2.innovation: 在无3D归纳偏置的情况下用全Transformer从RGB(-D) 2D特征直接回归3D框，并验证其对深度噪声的鲁棒性。
2412.04458|v2.result: CuTR在3D中召回超过62%的物体，优于基于点的方法，并具备纯RGB检测能力。

2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点分布复杂（受目标类别、尺寸、朝向影响，且来自轮廓边界与内部）而现有雷达-相机融合方法以黑盒网络隐式处理的问题，论文提出RICCARDO，显式利用雷达点分布模型辅助融合。首先基于单目检测器获得的目标属性预测雷达点分布，再以该分布为核对单目检测邻域内的实际雷达点进行匹配并生成匹配分数，最后融合上下文与核检测器精炼匹配分数。在nuScenes上取得领先的雷达-相机检测性能，代码已开源。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: RICCARDO addresses the complex radar hit distribution—arising from object category, size, orientation, and both boundary and interior reflections—which existing radar-camera fusion methods handle implicitly via black-box networks. It explicitly predicts radar hit distributions conditioned on monocular detector outputs, uses the predicted distribution as a kernel to match measured radar points and generate matching scores, and refines these scores via a fusion stage. The method achieves state-of-the-art radar-camera detection on nuScenes with open-sourced code.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 以显式雷达点分布建模替代黑盒融合，思路可解释且实用，对雷达-相机融合与多模态3D检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出RICCARDO，显式建模雷达点分布并作为核进行匹配，用于相机-雷达3D目标检测融合。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 用条件于目标属性的雷达点分布模型作为匹配核，替代传统黑盒融合方式。
2504.09086|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得领先的雷达-相机3D检测性能，代码已开源。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测器跨域泛化差的问题，指出现有DG方法过度依赖全局笛卡尔坐标导致模型偏向绝对位置。提出用高斯球（GBlobs）显式编码点云局部邻域结构，无需额外参数且高效。在单源DG基准上大幅超越SOTA：Waymo→KITTI提升21 mAP、KITTI→Waymo提升13 mAP、nuScenes→KITTI提升12 mAP，且不损失域内性能；多源DG也分别提升17/12/5 mAP。
2503.08639|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor cross-domain generalization of LiDAR-based 3D detectors caused by over-reliance on global Cartesian coordinates. It proposes GBlobs, an explicit local point-cloud neighborhood encoding via Gaussian blobs that is parameter-free and efficient. Integrated into existing detectors, it surpasses state-of-the-art single-source DG by 21 mAP (Waymo→KITTI), 13 mAP (KITTI→Waymo), and 12 mAP (nuScenes→KITTI) without sacrificing in-domain performance, and also improves multi-source DG by 17/12/5 mAP.
2503.08639|v2.assessment: 以极简的局部结构编码显著提升跨域3D检测，方法通用、增益巨大，对自动驾驶感知的域泛化研究有重要参考价值。
2503.08639|v2.contribution: 提出无需额外参数的高斯球局部结构编码GBlobs，用于LiDAR 3D检测的域泛化。
2503.08639|v2.innovation: 用高斯球显式编码点云局部邻域，替代对全局笛卡尔坐标的过度依赖。
2503.08639|v2.result: 单源DG最高提升21 mAP，多源DG最高提升17 mAP，且不损失域内性能。

2410.19590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中因物体可视表面导致深度误差、边界框高度无法代表真实投影中心高度、削弱几何深度有效性的问题，提出MonoDGP。该方法采用透视不变几何误差修正投影公式，系统讨论几何误差机制以替代多深度预测，并解耦深度引导解码器，构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器以提供2D先验并初始化查询。
2410.19590|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular 3D detection where depth errors from the object's visible surface make bounding-box height fail to represent the true projected central height, undermining geometric depth. MonoDGP uses perspective-invariant geometry errors to modify the projection formula, replaces multi-depth prediction with a simple yet effective geometry-error formulation, and decouples a depth-guided decoder from a visual-only 2D decoder for query initialization. It is a Transformer-based monocular 3D detector.
2410.19590|v2.assessment: 对单目3D检测中几何深度先验的失效机制分析清晰，解耦查询设计合理，是该方向值得关注的方法改进。
2410.19590|v2.contribution: 提出基于透视不变几何误差与解耦查询的Transformer单目3D检测器MonoDGP。
2410.19590|v2.innovation: 用几何误差修正投影公式替代多深度预测，并解耦2D/3D解码器以提供纯净2D先验。
2410.19590|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在几何深度利用上较已有工作更有效。

2503.16125|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内3D目标检测标注成本高、且主动学习在室内场景尚未被探索的问题，提出首个面向室内3D检测的主动学习框架。方法结合不确定性与多样性两个准则：不确定性同时考虑误检与漏检，多样性通过新的类感知自适应原型（CAP）库联合优化类别分布与场景类型多样性。
2503.16125|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first study on active learning for indoor 3D object detection, where annotation is costly and indoor data suffer from fewer samples per class, more classes, severe imbalance, and diverse scenes. It proposes a framework combining uncertainty (covering both inaccurate detections and undetected objects) and diversity, the latter formulated as a joint optimization over class distributions and scene types via a new Class-aware Adaptive Prototype (CAP) bank.
2503.16125|v2.assessment: 填补了室内3D检测主动学习的空白，双准则设计针对室内数据特性，但领域相关性相对偏窄。
2503.16125|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向室内3D目标检测的主动学习框架，融合不确定性与多样性准则。
2503.16125|v2.innovation: 用类感知自适应原型库联合优化类别分布与场景类型多样性。
2503.16125|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在室内3D检测上有效降低标注负担。

2503.06467|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏标注下3D目标检测器特征判别能力不足的问题，本文提出SP3D，利用大型多模态模型（LMM）生成的跨模态语义提示来增强检测器。具体包括：通过边界约束的中心聚类选择生成准确语义提示的CPST模块，基于种子点从多尺度邻域几何形状生成伪监督信号的DCPG模块，以及筛选高质量监督信号的分布形状分数（DS score）。在KITTI和Waymo数据集上验证了该方法在稀疏标注下能显著提升检测性能。
2503.06467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of sparsely-supervised 3D object detection where accurate labels are extremely scarce. It proposes SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from Large Multimodal Models to boost feature discrimination. The method includes a Confident Points Semantic Transfer module for accurate prompt generation, a Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation module for multi-scale pseudo-supervision, and a Distribution Shape score for selecting high-quality signals. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo show significant improvements under sparse annotation settings.
2503.06467|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙地将LMM的语义先验引入稀疏监督3D检测，思路新颖，且在两个主流数据集上验证了有效性，对稀疏标注场景有重要参考价值。
2503.06467|v2.contribution: 提出利用LMM生成跨模态语义提示来增强稀疏监督3D检测的SP3D框架。
2503.06467|v2.innovation: 通过CPST和DCPG模块将LMM语义提示转化为伪监督信号，并设计DS分数筛选高质量信号。
2503.06467|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo数据集上，稀疏标注下检测性能显著提升。
