Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应动作识别中跨模态知识利用不足的问题，提出在特征对齐之前先进行跨模态交互的框架。方法通过显式建模模态间的互补信息，在源域和目标域之间传递知识，缓解域偏移对动作识别的影响。相比传统先对齐后融合的策略，该工作强调交互先于对齐，提升了跨域场景下的识别鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体数据集上的数值结果，但思路对多模态视频理解有参考价值。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.summary_en: This paper addresses domain adaptive action recognition by proposing a cross-modal interaction-before-alignment framework. It explicitly models complementary information across modalities to transfer knowledge between source and target domains, mitigating domain shift. Unlike conventional align-then-fuse pipelines, the method improves robustness in cross-domain scenarios, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.assessment: 对视频理解与域自适应交叉方向有一定启发，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.contribution: 提出先交互后对齐的跨模态域自适应动作识别框架。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.innovation: 将跨模态知识交互置于特征对齐之前以增强域迁移。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在域自适应动作识别上取得改进。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-._arxiv_id: Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-Modal Knowledge for Domain Adaptive Action Recognition.

2204.04588|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP式视觉-语言对比学习无法有效处理网络图文数据中噪声多对多对应关系的问题，提出基于渐进自蒸馏与软图文对齐的训练框架。方法在每个minibatch中对部分图文动态生成软对齐目标，并用其更新参数，从而更高效地从噪声数据中学习鲁棒表示。在14个基准数据集上，该方法在零样本分类、线性探测迁移和图文检索上均持续优于CLIP，且不增加计算开销；在ImageNet鲁棒性测试中，对自然分布偏移的有效鲁棒性也优于ImageNet训练模型和CLIP本身。
2204.04588|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the noisy many-to-many correspondences in web-harvested image-text data that limit CLIP-style contrastive learning. It introduces progressive self-distillation with soft image-text alignments, dynamically generating soft targets for a subset of each minibatch to update parameters. Across 14 benchmarks, it consistently outperforms CLIP in zero-shot classification, linear probe transfer, and retrieval without extra compute, and shows better effective robustness to natural distribution shifts.
2204.04588|v2.assessment: 对多模态预训练与鲁棒表示学习有明确贡献，方法通用且实验充分，值得关注。
2204.04588|v2.contribution: 提出渐进自蒸馏与软对齐的跨模态对比学习框架。
2204.04588|v2.innovation: 利用自蒸馏动态生成软图文对齐目标以处理噪声对应。
2204.04588|v2.result: 在14个数据集上零样本分类、线性探测和检索均优于CLIP，且鲁棒性更强。

Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态3D目标检测中稀疏点云与稠密图像特征融合困难的问题，提出可变形特征聚合方法。通过可变形注意力机制自适应地对齐和聚合跨模态特征，缓解投影带来的信息损失与空间错位。相比固定投影或简单拼接的融合策略，该方法能更灵活地捕捉动态场景中的多模态互补信息。摘要未给出具体数值，但思路对自动驾驶3D检测有直接参考价值。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-modal 3D object detection by proposing deformable feature aggregation to fuse sparse point clouds with dense image features. The method uses deformable attention to adaptively align and aggregate cross-modal features, mitigating projection-induced information loss and spatial misalignment. It offers a flexible alternative to fixed projection or naive concatenation, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.assessment: 面向自动驾驶多模态3D检测的核心问题，方法设计合理，与用户方向高度相关。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.contribution: 提出用于动态多模态3D检测的可变形特征聚合方法。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.innovation: 利用可变形注意力自适应对齐跨模态特征以缓解投影损失。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称能提升多模态3D检测性能。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam._arxiv_id: Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynamic Multi-modal 3D Object Detection.

Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态目标检测中不同模态预测不一致的问题，提出概率集成方法。通过将各模态的检测输出建模为概率分布并进行集成，提升检测的鲁棒性和准确性。相比简单的分数平均或投票，概率集成能更好地处理模态间的置信度差异与不确定性。摘要未提供具体数据集和数值，但方法对RGB-热成像等自动驾驶多模态检测有参考意义。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.summary_en: This paper tackles inconsistent predictions across modalities in multi-modal object detection by proposing probabilistic ensembling. It models each modality's detection outputs as probability distributions and integrates them to improve robustness and accuracy. Compared to simple score averaging or voting, it better handles confidence discrepancies and uncertainty, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.assessment: 多模态检测的集成思路有实用价值，但与BEV/3D检测的直接关联有限。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.contribution: 提出用于多模态目标检测的概率集成方法。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.innovation: 将模态输出建模为概率分布进行集成以处理不确定性。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称能提升多模态检测鲁棒性。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil._arxiv_id: Multimodal Object Detection via Probabilistic Ensembling.

2210.09615|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态3D目标检测中稀疏点云与稠密像素跨模态融合易造成信息损失的问题，提出同质多模态特征融合与交互方法HMFI。方法首先设计图像体素提升模块IVLM将2D图像特征提升到3D空间生成同质图像体素特征，然后通过基于自注意力的查询融合机制QFM融合体素化点云与不同区域的图像特征，并进一步提出体素特征交互模块VFIM。相比投影到2D或直接融合稀疏点云与稠密像素的已有方法，该同质化策略避免了投影信息损失，从而提升检测性能。
2210.09615|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses information loss in cross-modal fusion between sparse point clouds and dense pixels for multi-modal 3D detection by proposing HMFI. It designs an image voxel lifter module (IVLM) to lift 2D image features into 3D space, a self-attention-based query fusion mechanism (QFM) to fuse voxelized point cloud and image features, and a voxel feature interaction module (VFIM). The homogeneous representation avoids projective information loss, leading to improved detection performance.
2210.09615|v2.assessment: 直接面向自动驾驶多模态3D检测，同质化融合思路清晰，与用户方向高度契合。
2210.09615|v2.contribution: 提出同质多模态特征融合与交互方法HMFI用于3D目标检测。
2210.09615|v2.innovation: 通过将图像特征提升到LiDAR 3D空间构建同质结构以避免投影信息损失。
2210.09615|v2.result: 摘要声称相比已有融合方法避免了信息损失并提升检测性能。

Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态3D目标检测中特征增强不足的问题，提出利用局部自注意力增强多模态特征的方法。通过在局部区域内建模模态内与模态间的依赖关系，提升特征表达能力，进而改善3D检测精度。相比全局注意力或简单卷积融合，局部自注意力在计算效率与感受野之间取得平衡。摘要未提供具体数值，但方法对自动驾驶多模态3D检测有参考价值。
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.summary_en: This paper enhances multi-modal features for 3D object detection using local self-attention. It models intra- and inter-modal dependencies within local regions to improve feature representation and detection accuracy. Compared to global attention or simple convolutional fusion, local self-attention balances computational efficiency and receptive field, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.assessment: 面向多模态3D检测的特征增强，思路合理，与用户方向相关。
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.contribution: 提出利用局部自注意力增强多模态特征的3D检测方法。
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.innovation: 在局部区域内建模模态内与模态间依赖以增强特征。
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称能提升3D检测性能。
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc._arxiv_id: Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Local Self-attention for 3D Object Detection.

2207.09805|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D标注依赖大量人工、现有自动标注器受点云稀疏性制约的问题，提出端到端多模态Transformer自动标注器MTrans，利用LiDAR与图像从弱2D框生成精确3D框。方法通过基于2D图像信息生成新3D点来稠密化稀疏点云，并以多任务设计同时进行前景/背景分割、点云稠密化和3D框回归。相比SOTA自动标注器，在KITTI moderate和hard上3D AP分别提升4.48%和4.03%，扩展用于3D检测时在KITTI hard上达到89.45% AP。
2207.09805|v2.summary_en: To reduce the human effort in LiDAR 3D annotation and overcome point cloud sparsity, this paper proposes MTrans, an end-to-end multimodal transformer autolabeler that generates precise 3D boxes from weak 2D boxes using both LiDAR and images. It densifies sparse point clouds by generating new 3D points from 2D image information and jointly performs foreground/background segmentation, densification, and 3D box regression in a multi-task design. It outperforms the state-of-the-art autolabeler by 4.48% and 4.03% 3D AP on KITTI moderate and hard, and reaches 89.45% AP on KITTI hard when extended to 3D detection.
2207.09805|v2.assessment: 多模态自动标注是降低3D检测数据成本的关键方向，该工作将点云稠密化与多任务Transformer结合，效果提升明显，值得关注。
2207.09805|v2.contribution: 提出利用图像稠密化LiDAR点云的多模态Transformer自动标注框架MTrans。
2207.09805|v2.innovation: 通过2D图像信息生成新3D点以缓解点云稀疏性，并统一多任务完成分割、稠密化与3D框回归。
2207.09805|v2.result: 在KITTI moderate/hard上3D AP分别提升4.48%/4.03%，扩展检测在hard上达89.45% AP。

2203.09510|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标识别中2D与3D模态各自独立、未利用多模态互补性的问题，提出DetMatch，一个联合2D和3D模态半监督学习的灵活框架。方法通过识别在两个传感器中均被检测到的物体来生成更干净、更鲁棒的伪标签，抑制单模态错误传播，并利用RGB图像的丰富语义纠正错误的3D类别预测、改进3D框定位。在KITTI和Waymo数据集上，该方法优于强半监督基线，并观察到更高质量的伪标签。
2203.09510|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of multi-modal fusion in semi-supervised object recognition, this paper proposes DetMatch, a flexible framework for joint semi-supervised learning on 2D and 3D modalities. By identifying objects detected in both sensors, it generates cleaner and more robust pseudo-labels that suppress single-modality error propagation, and leverages RGB semantics to rectify 3D class predictions and improve 3D box localization. On KITTI and Waymo, it improves upon strong semi-supervised baselines and yields higher-quality pseudo-labels.
2203.09510|v2.assessment: 将多模态融合引入半监督2D/3D检测，思路清晰且实验扎实，对降低标注依赖有实际价值。
2203.09510|v2.contribution: 提出联合2D与3D模态的半监督检测框架DetMatch，通过跨模态一致性生成更优伪标签。
2203.09510|v2.innovation: 利用双传感器共同检测结果筛选伪标签，并用RGB语义纠正3D类别与定位。
2203.09510|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上超越强半监督基线，伪标签质量更高。

2203.09855|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景3D相机常产生360°深度但存在缺失数据的问题，形式化全景深度补全（PDC）任务，目标是从稀疏深度和全景RGB图像恢复稠密全景深度。提出多模态掩码预训练M^3PT，在预训练时用共享随机掩码同时遮盖全景RGB图像和稀疏深度的patch，并重建被掩码区域的稀疏深度。首次证明掩码预训练在多模态视觉任务中有效，且预训练与微调之间无架构差异，不同于MAE丢弃解码器的做法。
2203.09855|v2.summary_en: This paper formulates panoramic depth completion (PDC) to recover dense 360° depth from sparse depth and panoramic RGB images. It proposes M^3PT, a multi-modal masked pre-training approach that simultaneously masks patches of panoramic RGB and sparse depth with a shared random mask and reconstructs the masked sparse depth. It is the first to show the effectiveness of masked pre-training in a multi-modal vision task, with no architectural difference between pre-training and fine-tuning, unlike MAE.
2203.09855|v2.assessment: 将掩码预训练拓展到多模态深度补全，任务较新，但与应用领域（自动驾驶BEV/3D检测）关联度中等。
2203.09855|v2.contribution: 提出多模态掩码预训练方法M^3PT用于全景深度补全。
2203.09855|v2.innovation: 使用共享随机掩码同时遮盖RGB与稀疏深度并重建深度，且预训练与微调架构一致。
2203.09855|v2.result: 首次验证掩码预训练在多模态视觉任务中的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2203.14395|v2.summary_cn: 针对纯图像-文本对比预训练因双流架构仅做全局对齐而忽略细粒度对齐的问题，提出单流架构在全局、细粒度patch-token和概念/语义多个层次对齐图像与语言。方法包含两个新任务：对称跨模态重建（XMM）和伪标签关键词预测（PSL），XMM通过跨模态信息重建被掩码的token以增强细粒度对齐，PSL利用注意力选择关键词并用动量编码器推荐图像中存在但标题缺失的关键词，训练视觉编码器预测其存在以学习语义概念。
2203.14395|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of fine-grained alignment in dual-stream contrastive vision-language pretraining, this paper proposes a single-stream architecture that aligns images and language at global, patch-token, and conceptual/semantic levels. It introduces two tasks: symmetric cross-modality reconstruction (XMM), which reconstructs masked tokens using cross-modal information, and pseudo-labeled key word prediction (PSL), which uses attention to select keywords and a momentum encoder to recommend missing but image-present keywords for semantic grounding.
2203.14395|v2.assessment: 多层级对齐的单流VLM预训练思路新颖，对视觉-语言理解有推动，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2203.14395|v2.contribution: 提出单流多层级对齐的视觉-语言预训练框架，包含XMM和PSL两个任务。
2203.14395|v2.innovation: 通过跨模态掩码重建与伪标签关键词预测实现全局、patch级和语义级对齐。
2203.14395|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值，但声称在细粒度对齐上优于双流对比方法。

2111.05759|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言导航（VLN）中现有Transformer方法用固定长度向量表示时序上下文、难以捕捉长期时序信息的问题，提出变长记忆多模态Transformer（MTVM）。方法通过记忆库直接存储先前激活来跟踪导航轨迹，并引入记忆感知一致性损失，结合随机掩码指令学习更好的时序上下文联合表示。
2111.05759|v2.summary_en: To address the limitation of fixed-length temporal context in Transformer-based Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN), this paper introduces Multimodal Transformer with Variable-length Memory (MTVM), which explicitly models temporal context by storing previous activations in a memory bank. It further proposes a memory-aware consistency loss with randomly masked instructions to learn better joint representations of temporal context.
2111.05759|v2.assessment: 变长记忆机制对VLN的长期时序建模有改进，但任务与自动驾驶感知/3D检测领域相关度较低。
2111.05759|v2.contribution: 提出变长记忆多模态Transformer MTVM用于视觉-语言导航。
2111.05759|v2.innovation: 用记忆库显式存储历史激活并引入记忆感知一致性损失。
2111.05759|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称能更好捕捉长期时序上下文。

2210.17322|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言预训练（VLP）模型在流式图像-文本数据上持续学习时出现的灾难性遗忘问题。作者提出伪文本回放（pseudo text replay），基于记忆中的训练图像生成困难负样本文本，既保留已学知识又提升对比损失中负样本的多样性；同时提出图像与文本间的多模态知识蒸馏，对齐新旧模型的实例级预测。在Conceptual Caption数据集的实例增量和类增量划分上进行增量预训练，实验表明该方法能有效缓解遗忘并保持零样本泛化能力。
2210.17322|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual vision-language pretraining (VLP) with sequential image-text data. It introduces pseudo text replay that generates hard negative texts conditioned on in-memory training images, preserving learned knowledge and increasing negative sample diversity, along with multi-modal knowledge distillation to align instance-wise predictions between old and new models. Incremental pretraining on instance and class incremental splits of Conceptual Caption demonstrates improved retention and zero-shot generalization.
2210.17322|v2.assessment: 将生成式回放与多模态蒸馏结合解决VLP持续学习遗忘，思路新颖且实验设计合理，对多模态持续学习方向有参考价值。
2210.17322|v2.contribution: 提出伪文本回放与多模态知识蒸馏相结合的持续视觉-语言预训练框架。
2210.17322|v2.innovation: 利用生成式困难负样本文本回放替代真实数据回放，并跨模态对齐新旧模型预测。
2210.17322|v2.result: 在Conceptual Caption增量划分上有效缓解遗忘，保持零样本下游任务性能。

2306.14182|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多模态模型结构固定、难以应对输入模态多样性导致的模态不匹配问题。提出Switch-BERT，通过引入可学习的逐层和跨层交互，从一组注意力模式中动态优化注意力，并能关注不同深度的输出，从而缓解模态不匹配。在视觉问答、图文检索和指代表达理解任务上，Switch-BERT相比ViLBERT、UNITER等固定结构模型能持续取得更好或相当的性能。
2306.14182|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles modality mismatch in multimodal learning caused by fixed model structures and diverse input modalities. It proposes Switch-BERT, which extends BERT with learnable layer-wise and cross-layer interactions, optimizing attention from a set of attention modes and attending to outputs from various depths. Experiments on VQA, image-text retrieval, and referring expression comprehension show consistently better or comparable performance than ViLBERT and UNITER.
2306.14182|v2.assessment: 动态注意力切换机制对多模态交互建模有一定新意，但整体属于对现有BERT架构的改进，性能提升幅度有限。
2306.14182|v2.contribution: 提出可切换注意力与输入的多模态交互学习模型Switch-BERT。
2306.14182|v2.innovation: 通过可学习的逐层与跨层注意力模式选择，动态关注不同深度特征以缓解模态不匹配。
2306.14182|v2.result: 在VQA、图文检索和指代表达理解上取得优于或媲美ViLBERT/UNITER的性能。

2204.08058|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频-音频-文本多模态理解与生成缺乏丰富且可控数据集的问题。作者基于开源平台游戏CoinRun进行大幅修改，引入音频和新交互，训练不同目标的RL智能体与13个物体和角色交互，自动采集375K个3.2秒视频片段并由人工标注文本描述，同时从游戏引擎提取语义图和模板文本。在视频-音频-文本检索和生成任务上对代表性方法进行了基准测试。
2204.08058|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of rich and controllable datasets for video-audio-text multimodal understanding and generation. It presents MUGEN, a large-scale dataset collected from a modified CoinRun platform with audio and new interactions, where RL agents interact with 13 objects to automatically extract 375K video clips (3.2s each) with human text descriptions and engine-derived annotations. Representative approaches are benchmarked on video-audio-text retrieval and generation tasks.
2204.08058|v2.assessment: 数据集构建扎实且标注丰富，为多模态视频理解与生成提供了可控的测试平台，但任务与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
2204.08058|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模视频-音频-文本多模态理解与生成数据集MUGEN及基准。
2204.08058|v2.innovation: 利用游戏引擎自动生成精确语义标注与模板文本，结合人工描述实现窄而丰富的多模态数据。
2204.08058|v2.result: 提供375K视频片段及多任务基准，推动视频-音频-文本检索与生成研究。

2301.06782|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶场景下新视角合成与隐式场景重建缺乏大规模多模态基准的问题，本文构建了一个大规模室外多模态数据集并给出评测基准。数据集包含多传感器（相机/LiDAR等）同步采集数据，支持NVS与隐式重建任务的统一评测。相比已有室内或小规模室外数据集，其规模与模态覆盖更贴近真实自动驾驶感知需求。摘要未给出具体数值指标，主要贡献在于数据与基准本身。
2301.06782|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale multi-modal benchmarks for novel view synthesis and implicit scene reconstruction in outdoor autonomous driving scenarios. It introduces a large-scale outdoor multi-modal dataset together with a benchmark supporting unified evaluation of NVS and implicit reconstruction. Compared with existing indoor or small-scale outdoor datasets, it better reflects real-world autonomous driving sensing conditions. The abstract reports no quantitative results; the main contribution is the dataset and benchmark.
2301.06782|v2.assessment: 对做BEV/占据栅格/神经渲染交叉方向的研究者有数据价值，但方法创新有限，需关注其模态同步与标注质量。
2301.06782|v2.contribution: 构建了面向室外自动驾驶的大规模多模态数据集与NVS/隐式重建评测基准。
2301.06782|v2.innovation: 将多模态室外数据与隐式场景重建/NVS任务统一到同一基准下评测。
2301.06782|v2.result: 提供了大规模多模态数据与基准，摘要未给出具体量化指标。

A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.summary_cn: 针对现有全局实例跟踪（GIT）基准在复杂时空与因果推理上不足的问题，本文提出多模态全局实例跟踪基准MGIT。该基准引入多模态线索与更复杂的时空/因果关联设定，用于更真实地评估跟踪器在长时程目标定位中的能力。相比已有GIT数据集，MGIT在场景复杂度与关系推理维度上有提升。摘要未提供具体性能数据。
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.summary_en: This paper targets the limitations of existing Global Instance Tracking benchmarks in handling complex spatio-temporal and causal reasoning. It proposes MGIT, a multi-modal benchmark for global instance tracking that incorporates multi-modal cues and more challenging spatio-temporal/causal relations. Compared with prior GIT datasets, MGIT increases scenario complexity and relational reasoning requirements. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.assessment: 对跟踪与视频理解方向有参考价值，但偏基准类工作，与3D感知主线相关度中等。
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.contribution: 提出了面向复杂时空与因果关系的多模态全局实例跟踪基准MGIT。
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.innovation: 将多模态信息与因果/时空关系推理引入全局实例跟踪评测。
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.result: 提供了更具挑战性的跟踪基准，摘要未给出具体量化结果。
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B._arxiv_id: A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking Benchmark (MGIT): Better Locating Target in Complex Spatio-temporal and Causal Relationship.

2303.02314|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于虚拟点（深度补全融合RGB与LiDAR）的3D检测中虚拟点过密导致冗余计算、以及深度补全噪声降低精度的问题，本文提出VirConvNet骨干与VirConv算子。VirConv包含StVD（随机体素丢弃）以减少近处冗余体素计算，以及NRConv（抗噪子流形卷积）在2D图像与3D LiDAR空间联合编码体素特征以抑制噪声。基于此构建了VirConv-L（早融合）、VirConv-T（变换精化）与VirConv-S（伪标签半监督）三条流水线。在KITTI car 3D检测上取得领先性能（摘要截断未给出完整数值）。
2303.02314|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles redundant computation from dense virtual points and precision degradation from noisy depth completion in virtual-point-based multimodal 3D detection. It proposes VirConvNet with the VirConv operator, comprising Stochastic Voxel Discard (StVD) to drop redundant nearby voxels and Noise-Resistant Submanifold Convolution (NRConv) that encodes voxel features jointly in 2D image and 3D LiDAR space. Three pipelines are built: VirConv-L (early fusion), VirConv-T (transformed refinement), and VirConv-S (semi-supervised pseudo-labeling). It achieves leading results on the KITTI car 3D detection benchmark.
2303.02314|v2.assessment: 多模态3D检测的实用型工作，StVD与NRConv分别针对效率与噪声两个核心痛点，工程价值高，值得复现。
2303.02314|v2.contribution: 提出VirConv算子与VirConvNet骨干，并给出L/T/S三条多模态3D检测流水线。
2303.02314|v2.innovation: 用随机体素丢弃降冗余计算、用2D-3D联合编码的子流形卷积抗深度补全噪声。
2303.02314|v2.result: 在KITTI car 3D检测上取得领先精度，并兼顾效率与半监督扩展。

2303.12417|v2.summary_cn: 针对Text-3D配对数据稀缺、现有VLM迁移到3D时依赖中间2D表示而丢失几何信息的问题，本文提出CLIP²，直接在真实点云上做语言-图像-点云对比预训练。方法利用2D与3D场景中天然存在的对应关系，构建良好对齐的、基于实例的text-image-point代理，并设计跨模态对比目标学习语义与实例级对齐的点云表示。在室内与室外场景上的迁移实验表明所学3D表示具有良好泛化能力（摘要截断未给出完整数值）。
2303.12417|v2.summary_en: To address the scarcity of Text-3D pairs and the geometry loss incurred by 2D-intermediate VLM adaptation, this paper proposes CLIP², which directly performs language-image-point cloud contrastive pretraining on real-world point clouds. It exploits naturally existing 2D-3D correspondences to build well-aligned, instance-based text-image-point proxies and adopts a cross-modal contrastive objective for semantic- and instance-level aligned point cloud representations. Transfer experiments on both indoor and outdoor scenarios demonstrate strong generalization of the learned 3D representation.
2303.12417|v2.assessment: 面向开放世界3D理解的预训练范式，代理对齐机制思路清晰，对开放集检测与多模态感知有启发。
2303.12417|v2.contribution: 提出CLIP²，实现真实场景下语言-图像-点云的直接对比预训练。
2303.12417|v2.innovation: 利用2D-3D天然对应构建实例级text-image-point代理并做跨模态对比对齐。
2303.12417|v2.result: 室内外迁移实验显示所学3D表示具备良好泛化与迁移能力。

3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.summary_cn: 针对点云场景图预测中缺乏跨模态空间知识积累的问题，本文提出3D空间多模态知识积累方法用于点云场景图预测。方法通过在多模态空间中积累与传播3D空间知识，增强点云中物体间关系（谓词）的推理能力。相比仅依赖点云几何特征的已有方法，引入多模态知识有助于关系预测。摘要未提供具体量化结果。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of cross-modal spatial knowledge accumulation in point cloud scene graph prediction. It proposes a 3D spatial multimodal knowledge accumulation approach that accumulates and propagates 3D spatial knowledge across modalities to enhance relation (predicate) reasoning among objects in point clouds. Compared with methods relying solely on point cloud geometric features, the multimodal knowledge improves relation prediction. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.assessment: 点云场景图与多模态知识结合的方向，对场景理解与关系推理有参考价值，但需看实验是否充分。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.contribution: 提出面向点云场景图预测的3D空间多模态知识积累方法。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.innovation: 在多模态空间中积累并传播3D空间知识以增强点云关系推理。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.result: 提升了点云场景图关系预测能力，摘要未给出具体量化指标。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula._arxiv_id: 3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumulation for Scene Graph Prediction in Point Cloud.

Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态跟踪中如何高效利用预训练知识的问题，本文提出视觉提示（Visual Prompt）多模态跟踪方法。方法将视觉提示机制引入多模态跟踪框架，通过提示学习适配RGB与其他模态（如深度/热红外）的融合特征，减少对大规模微调的依赖。相比传统全参数微调或从头训练的多模态跟踪器，提示式范式更高效且泛化性更好。摘要未给出具体数值。
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses how to efficiently exploit pretrained knowledge in multi-modal tracking by proposing a visual prompt-based multi-modal tracking approach. It introduces visual prompting into the multi-modal tracking framework, adapting fused RGB and auxiliary modality (e.g., depth/thermal) features via prompt learning and reducing reliance on large-scale fine-tuning. Compared with fully fine-tuned or from-scratch multi-modal trackers, the prompting paradigm is more efficient and generalizable. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.assessment: 把视觉提示范式迁移到多模态跟踪，思路新颖，对参数高效适配与多模态融合方向有借鉴意义。
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出视觉提示驱动的多模态跟踪框架。
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将视觉提示学习引入多模态跟踪，实现高效的知识适配与模态融合。
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.result: 在降低微调成本的同时提升了多模态跟踪的泛化能力，摘要未给出具体数值。

2303.08600|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR-only方法在小型和远处物体上分割性能差、多模态方案未充分探索的问题，论文提出MSeg3D多模态3D语义分割模型，通过联合模态内特征提取和模态间特征融合（GF-Phase、跨模态特征补全、SF-Phase）缓解模态异质性，并采用非对称数据增强。在nuScenes、Waymo和SemanticKITTI上取得SOTA，且在相机故障和多帧点云输入下表现鲁棒。
2303.08600|v2.summary_en: To address the poor segmentation of small and distant objects by LiDAR-only methods and the under-explored multi-modal solution, this paper proposes MSeg3D, a multi-modal 3D semantic segmentation model with joint intra-modal feature extraction and inter-modal feature fusion (GF-Phase, cross-modal completion, SF-Phase) to mitigate modality heterogeneity, along with asymmetric data augmentation. It achieves state-of-the-art results on nuScenes, Waymo, and SemanticKITTI, and remains robust under malfunctioning multi-camera input and multi-frame point clouds.
2303.08600|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了多模态3D分割中的三个关键难点，实验充分且结果领先，对自动驾驶感知研究具有重要参考价值。
2303.08600|v2.contribution: 提出了一个鲁棒的多模态3D语义分割框架MSeg3D，有效融合LiDAR与相机信息。
2303.08600|v2.innovation: 设计了基于几何和语义的两阶段融合模块以及跨模态特征补全，并引入非对称多模态数据增强。
2303.08600|v2.result: 在nuScenes、Waymo和SemanticKITTI上达到SOTA，并在相机故障等退化条件下保持鲁棒。

2306.03932|v2.summary_cn: 针对专业VQA任务标注数据稀缺的问题，论文提出SelTDA自训练数据增强策略，利用VLM和目标任务数据构建教师模型，仅以图像为条件生成问答伪标签，从而对未标注图像进行伪标注并微调初始VLM。实验表明该方法提升了对对抗性搜索问题、反事实样本和改写的鲁棒性，改善了域泛化，并更好地保留了数值推理能力，且无需额外标注。
2306.03932|v2.summary_en: To address the scarcity of labeled data in specialized VQA tasks, this paper introduces SelTDA, a self-taught data augmentation strategy that builds a teacher model from the VLM and target dataset to generate question-answer pseudolabels conditioned solely on images, enabling pseudolabeling of unlabeled images for finetuning. Experiments show improved robustness to adversarially searched questions, counterfactual examples, and rephrasings, better domain generalization, and greater retention of numerical reasoning skills, without additional annotations.
2306.03932|v2.assessment: 该工作为数据稀缺场景下的VLM微调提供了有效的自训练方案，实验设计全面，对多模态学习研究者有启发。
2306.03932|v2.contribution: 提出SelTDA自训练数据增强策略，利用未标注图像提升小规模VQA任务的VLM微调效果。
2306.03932|v2.innovation: 构建仅以图像为条件的教师模型生成问答伪标签，实现无需人工标注的数据增强。
2306.03932|v2.result: 在多个鲁棒性、泛化和数值推理指标上取得提升，且无需额外标注。

2303.02483|v2.summary_cn: 针对时尚领域多种异构视觉语言任务各自独立建模导致的参数低效和无法利用任务间关联的问题，论文提出FAME-ViL，通过交叉注意力适配器和任务特定适配器集成到统一V+L模型中，并采用稳定的多任务训练策略防止负迁移。在四个时尚任务上，相比独立微调节省61.5%参数，同时保持或提升性能。
2303.02483|v2.summary_en: To address parameter inefficiency and the inability to exploit inter-task relatedness caused by independently fine-tuning task-specific models for heterogeneous fashion V+L tasks, this paper proposes FAME-ViL, which integrates cross-attention adapters and task-specific adapters into a unified V+L model with a stable multi-task training strategy to prevent negative transfer. On four fashion tasks, it saves 61.5% of parameters over independent fine-tuning while maintaining or improving performance.
2303.02483|v2.assessment: 该工作在多任务视觉语言学习方面提供了高效的参数共享方案，对多模态和持续学习方向有参考意义，但领域较窄。
2303.02483|v2.contribution: 提出FAME-ViL，一个参数高效的多任务视觉语言模型，统一处理多种时尚任务。
2303.02483|v2.innovation: 结合交叉注意力适配器和任务特定适配器，并设计防止负迁移的多任务训练策略。
2303.02483|v2.result: 在四个时尚任务上节省61.5%参数，性能与独立微调相当或更优。

2303.14302|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有图像美学评估方法依赖人工评分、简化视觉美学信息的问题，论文提出从用户评论中学习图像美学，利用图像-评论对预训练图像-文本编码器-解码器模型，结合对比和生成目标学习丰富的美学语义，并设计轻量级基于排序的适配器以文本为锚学习美学排序概念。在AVA-Captions等数据集上，预训练模型在美学描述任务上优于先前工作。
2303.14302|v2.summary_en: To address the oversimplification of visual aesthetic information by human-labeled rating scores in existing image aesthetic assessment methods, this paper proposes learning image aesthetics from user comments by pretraining an image-text encoder-decoder model with image-comment pairs using contrastive and generative objectives, and a lightweight rank-based adapter that uses text as an anchor to learn aesthetic ranking. The pretrained model outperforms prior works on image aesthetic captioning over the AVA-Captions dataset.
2303.14302|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了利用用户评论进行美学评估的新范式，对多模态预训练和细粒度理解有启发，但应用领域较特定。
2303.14302|v2.contribution: 提出从用户评论中学习图像美学的视觉语言预训练方法，并设计轻量级排序适配器。
2303.14302|v2.innovation: 利用图像-评论对进行对比和生成预训练，以文本为锚学习美学排序。
2303.14302|v2.result: 在AVA-Captions数据集上美学描述任务超越先前工作。

2304.04231|v2.summary_cn: 针对监督人群计数依赖昂贵人工标注的问题，论文提出无监督框架CrowdCLIP，利用CLIP的视觉语言知识，通过构建排序文本提示和多模态排序损失匹配大小排序的人群块来指导图像编码器学习，并在测试阶段采用渐进过滤策略选择高潜力人群块并映射到语言空间。在五个挑战性数据集上，CrowdCLIP优于先前无监督方法。
2304.04231|v2.summary_en: To alleviate the reliance on costly manual labeling in supervised crowd counting, this paper proposes CrowdCLIP, an unsupervised framework that leverages CLIP's vision-language knowledge by constructing ranking text prompts and a multi-modal ranking loss to match size-sorted crowd patches for guiding the image encoder, and a progressive filtering strategy at test time to select high-potential patches and map them to language space. On five challenging datasets, CrowdCLIP outperforms previous unsupervised methods.
2304.04231|v2.assessment: 该工作首次将视觉语言模型用于人群计数，为无监督计数提供了新思路，对开放集检测和VLM应用有参考价值。
2304.04231|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于视觉语言模型的无监督人群计数框架CrowdCLIP。
2304.04231|v2.innovation: 利用排序文本提示和多模态排序损失，以及渐进过滤策略实现无监督计数。
2304.04231|v2.result: 在五个挑战性数据集上超越先前无监督方法。

2301.00182|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频识别中如何有效迁移预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）知识的问题，现有方法对VLM跨模态桥梁的利用仍不充分。本文提出BIKE框架，通过双向跨模态知识探索：一是Video Attribute Association机制，利用视频到文本的知识生成文本辅助属性以补充视频识别；二是Temporal Concept Spotting机制，以无参数方式利用文本到视频的专业知识捕捉时序显著性，增强视频表示。在Kinetics-400/600、UCF-101、HMDB-51、ActivityNet和Charades六个数据集上，该方法在通用、零样本和少样本识别场景中均达到SOTA性能。
2301.00182|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored transfer of pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) to video recognition. It proposes BIKE, a framework that exploits the cross-modal bridge bidirectionally: a Video Attribute Association mechanism generates textual auxiliary attributes from video-to-text knowledge, and a Temporal Concept Spotting mechanism captures temporal saliency in a parameter-free manner using text-to-video expertise. Extensive experiments on six video datasets (Kinetics-400/600, UCF-101, HMDB-51, ActivityNet, Charades) demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in general, zero-shot, and few-shot recognition scenarios.
2301.00182|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地挖掘了VLM在视频识别中的双向跨模态知识迁移潜力，方法设计巧妙且实验覆盖全面，对视频理解与多模态方向的研究者有较高参考价值。
2301.00182|v2.contribution: 提出BIKE框架，通过双向跨模态知识探索（视频属性关联与时序概念定位）实现VLM知识向视频识别的高效迁移。
2301.00182|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地利用VLM的跨模态桥梁进行双向知识探索，并以无参数方式捕捉时序显著性。
2301.00182|v2.result: 在六个主流视频数据集上于通用、零样本和少样本场景均取得SOTA性能。

2301.06267|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统少样本学习仅使用单一模态样本、难以充分刻画概念类别的问题，本文提出跨模态适配策略，利用CLIP等多模态基础模型将不同模态映射到同一表示空间，把不同模态的样本视为额外的少样本示例。例如将类名作为额外训练样本，将n-shot问题轻松转化为(n+1)-shot问题。该方法用极其简单的线性分类器即可达到SOTA结果，并可与其他方法（如prefix tuning）结合。
2301.06267|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of classical few-shot learning that relies on single-modality samples insufficient to characterize a concept class. It proposes a simple cross-modal adaptation strategy that treats examples from different modalities as additional few-shot examples, leveraging multimodal foundation models like CLIP that map modalities into a shared representation space. By repurposing class names as extra training samples, any n-shot problem becomes an (n+1)-shot problem, achieving state-of-the-art results with embarrassingly simple linear classifiers.
2301.06267|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的方法揭示了跨模态信息在少样本学习中的巨大价值，思路清晰且实用性强，对多模态学习与少样本识别方向有启发意义。
2301.06267|v2.contribution: 提出跨模态适配策略，将不同模态样本视为额外少样本示例，显著提升少样本视觉分类性能。
2301.06267|v2.innovation: 利用多模态基础模型的共享表示空间，将类名等跨模态信息转化为额外训练样本，方法极其简洁。
2301.06267|v2.result: 用简单线性分类器即达到SOTA，并可与其他少样本方法结合进一步提升。

Revisiting Multimodal Representation in.summary_cn: 该论文重新审视对比学习中的多模态表示，从patch和token嵌入出发，探索有限离散token的表示方式。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。该工作可能针对现有多模态对比学习中连续嵌入表示的局限性，提出基于有限离散token的表示方法以提升跨模态对齐效果。
Revisiting Multimodal Representation in.summary_en: This paper revisits multimodal representation in contrastive learning, moving from patch and token embeddings to finite discrete tokens. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results are unavailable. The work likely addresses limitations of continuous embedding representations in multimodal contrastive learning by proposing a finite discrete token-based approach to improve cross-modal alignment.
Revisiting Multimodal Representation in.assessment: 该论文涉及多模态对比学习表示的重要问题，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其具体贡献与效果，建议获取全文后进一步判断。
Revisiting Multimodal Representation in.contribution: 探索从连续patch/token嵌入到有限离散token的多模态对比学习表示方法。
Revisiting Multimodal Representation in.innovation: 提出使用有限离散token替代连续嵌入进行多模态对比学习表示。
Revisiting Multimodal Representation in.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验结果。
Revisiting Multimodal Representation in._arxiv_id: Revisiting Multimodal Representation in Contrastive Learning: From Patch and Token Embeddings to Finite Discrete Tokens.

2303.07284|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态摘要中现有方法未能利用不同模态间的时序对应关系以及忽略样本间内在相关性的问题，本文提出A2Summ，一个基于Transformer的统一多模态摘要模型，能有效对齐和关注多模态输入。同时提出两种新颖的对比损失来建模样本间和样本内相关性。在TVSum、SumMe、Daily Mail和CNN四个数据集上均取得SOTA性能，并收集了大规模多模态摘要数据集BLiSS。
2303.07284|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of existing multimodal summarization methods to leverage temporal correspondence across modalities and intrinsic correlations between samples. It proposes A2Summ, a unified transformer-based model that effectively aligns and attends to multimodal inputs, along with two novel contrastive losses modeling inter-sample and intra-sample correlations. A2Summ achieves state-of-the-art performance on TVSum, SumMe, Daily Mail, and CNN, and the authors collect a large-scale dataset BLiSS.
2303.07284|v2.assessment: 该工作在多模态摘要任务上提出了系统性的对齐与对比学习方案，并贡献了新数据集，对多模态视频理解方向有一定参考价值。
2303.07284|v2.contribution: 提出A2Summ统一多模态Transformer摘要模型及双对比损失，并构建大规模多模态摘要数据集BLiSS。
2303.07284|v2.innovation: 通过双对比损失建模样本间与样本内相关性，并有效对齐多模态时序输入。
2303.07284|v2.result: 在四个标准数据集上均取得SOTA性能，并发布了BLiSS大规模数据集。

2303.00601|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于3D点云和RGB图像的多模态工业异常检测中，现有方法直接拼接多模态特征导致特征间强干扰、损害检测性能的问题，本文提出M3DM，采用混合融合方案：首先设计基于patch级对比学习的无监督特征融合以促进不同模态特征交互；其次使用多记忆库的决策层融合避免信息丢失，并引入额外的新颖性分类器做最终决策。还提出点特征对齐操作以更好对齐点云和RGB特征。在MVTec-3D AD数据集上检测和分割精度均超越SOTA。
2303.00601|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem that existing multimodal industrial anomaly detection methods directly concatenate multimodal features, causing strong feature disturbance and degraded detection. It proposes M3DM with a hybrid fusion scheme: an unsupervised feature fusion with patch-wise contrastive learning to encourage cross-modal interaction, and a decision-layer fusion with multiple memory banks plus novelty classifiers for final decisions. A point feature alignment operation is also proposed. M3DM outperforms state-of-the-art on both detection and segmentation precision on MVTec-3D AD.
2303.00601|v2.assessment: 该工作针对多模态工业异常检测中的特征融合问题提出了有效的混合融合方案，方法设计合理，但应用场景与自动驾驶感知领域关联度较低。
2303.00601|v2.contribution: 提出M3DM混合融合多模态异常检测方法，结合patch级对比学习特征融合与多记忆库决策层融合。
2303.00601|v2.innovation: 采用混合融合策略替代简单特征拼接，并引入点特征对齐操作改善跨模态对齐。
2303.00601|v2.result: 在MVTec-3D AD数据集上检测和分割精度均超越SOTA。

Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal.summary_cn: 该论文研究多模态非刚性3D形状匹配的自监督学习方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节、创新点和实验数据。该工作可能针对非刚性3D形状匹配中标注数据稀缺的问题，探索利用自监督学习结合多模态信息来提升匹配性能。
Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal.summary_en: This paper investigates self-supervised learning for multimodal non-rigid 3D shape matching. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details, innovations, and experimental results are unavailable. The work likely addresses the scarcity of annotated data in non-rigid 3D shape matching by exploring self-supervised learning combined with multimodal information.
Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal.assessment: 该论文涉及自监督3D形状匹配，与自动驾驶感知领域关联度较低，且摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其贡献。
Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal.contribution: 探索多模态非刚性3D形状匹配的自监督学习方法。
Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal.innovation: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体创新点。
Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认实验结果。
Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal Non-Rigid 3D Shape Matching.

Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.summary_cn: 该论文针对远距离声学感知在场景理解中信息缺失的问题，提出利用长程声学波束成形与视觉模态融合的多模态场景理解框架。方法上通过声学波束成形获取远距离目标的空间与语义线索，并与视觉特征进行跨模态对齐与融合。相比纯视觉方案，其改进点在于引入声学模态以弥补远距离与遮挡场景下的感知盲区。摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果验证尚不充分。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited perception capability of vision-only systems in long-range and occluded scenarios by introducing long-range acoustic beamforming for multimodal scene understanding. It fuses acoustic spatial and semantic cues with visual features to compensate for visual blind spots. However, the abstract provides no quantitative results, leaving the empirical effectiveness unverified.
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.assessment: 选题新颖，将声学感知引入自动驾驶多模态场景理解，但摘要信息过少，缺乏实验数据支撑，实际价值有待验证。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.contribution: 提出将长程声学波束成形与视觉融合用于多模态场景理解。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.innovation: 首次探索声学模态在远距离场景理解中的互补作用。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B._arxiv_id: Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic Beamforming for Multimodal Scene Understanding.

Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.summary_cn: 该论文针对对话情感识别（ERC）任务，重新审视图神经网络在多变量、多频率和多模态设定下的建模方式。方法上提出融合多变量关系、多频率信号与多模态信息的GNN框架以捕捉对话中的复杂情感依赖。相比已有ERC方法，其改进在于同时建模多粒度与多模态交互。摘要未给出具体实验数据，效果难以评估。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.summary_en: This paper rethinks graph neural networks for emotion recognition in conversation (ERC) under multivariate, multi-frequency, and multimodal settings. It proposes a GNN framework that jointly models multivariate relations, multi-frequency signals, and multimodal cues to capture complex emotional dependencies. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域关联度低，属于情感识别方向，对视觉感知研究者参考价值有限。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.contribution: 提出多变量、多频率、多模态的GNN框架用于对话情感识别。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.innovation: 将多频率信号建模引入多模态对话情感识别的图网络。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim._arxiv_id: Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multimodal: Rethinking Graph Neural Networks for Emotion Recognition in Conversation.

2306.07646|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态表示学习中辅助模态仅在训练阶段可用的问题，通过跨模态知识蒸馏（KD）提升学生模型表示能力。方法上指出传统互信息最大化目标会导致弱教师捷径解，为此引入教师与辅助模态间的互信息项，并最小化给定学生时教师的条件熵，分别用对比学习和对抗学习优化。在三个多模态基准数据集上，该方法在视频识别、视频检索和情感分类任务上优于多种SOTA方法。
2306.07646|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multimodal representation learning where auxiliary modalities are available only at training, using cross-modal knowledge distillation. It identifies a short-cut solution in mutual information maximization that weakens the teacher, and addresses it by adding a teacher-auxiliary mutual information term and minimizing the teacher's conditional entropy given the student, optimized via contrastive and adversarial learning. Experiments on three multimodal benchmarks show improvements over state-of-the-art methods on video recognition, retrieval, and emotion classification.
2306.07646|v2.assessment: 对知识蒸馏中的捷径解问题分析到位，方法设计有理论依据，实验覆盖多任务，对多模态蒸馏研究者有参考价值。
2306.07646|v2.contribution: 提出防止弱教师捷径解的跨模态知识蒸馏目标与训练方案。
2306.07646|v2.innovation: 引入教师-辅助模态互信息与条件熵最小化来约束蒸馏过程。
2306.07646|v2.result: 在三个多模态基准上于视频识别、检索和情感分类任务超越多种SOTA方法。

SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D形状补全、重建与生成任务，提出多模态扩散模型SDFusion。方法上以符号距离场（SDF）为表示，融合文本、图像等多模态条件进行扩散生成，统一处理形状补全、重建和生成。相比已有单模态或单一任务方法，其改进在于多模态条件驱动的统一生成框架。摘要未给出具体量化指标，效果需进一步验证。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.summary_en: This paper proposes SDFusion, a multimodal diffusion model for 3D shape completion, reconstruction, and generation. It represents shapes as signed distance fields (SDF) and conditions the diffusion process on multimodal inputs such as text and images, unifying completion, reconstruction, and generation. The abstract lacks quantitative results, so empirical gains remain to be verified.
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.assessment: 多模态扩散用于3D形状生成思路清晰，与3D感知有一定关联，但偏生成任务，对检测/BEV方向直接参考有限。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.contribution: 提出基于SDF的多模态扩散框架统一3D形状补全、重建与生成。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.innovation: 将多模态条件扩散统一应用于多种3D形状任务。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion._arxiv_id: SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion, Reconstruction, and Generation.

MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.summary_cn: 多摄像头多目标跟踪（MTMC）在真实场景中缺乏大规模多模态基准，现有数据集规模小、模态单一。本文提出MTMMC，一个大规模真实世界多模态摄像头跟踪基准，包含多摄像头、多模态（RGB与热成像）数据，覆盖不同天气与光照条件。相比已有工作，MTMMC在摄像头数量、轨迹长度和场景多样性上显著提升，并提供统一的评估协议。该基准为多摄像头跟踪与多模态融合研究提供了重要测试平台。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.summary_en: Multi-camera multi-target tracking (MTMC) lacks large-scale multimodal benchmarks in real-world scenarios. This paper introduces MTMMC, a large-scale real-world multi-modal camera tracking benchmark with multiple cameras and modalities (RGB and thermal) under diverse weather and lighting conditions. It significantly improves over existing datasets in scale, trajectory length, and scene diversity, providing a unified evaluation protocol for multi-camera tracking and multimodal fusion.
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.assessment: 该基准填补了多摄像头多模态跟踪数据集的空白，对自动驾驶和监控场景下的多摄像头感知研究具有重要价值。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.contribution: 提出了大规模真实世界多模态多摄像头跟踪基准MTMMC。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.innovation: 首次在真实场景中结合RGB与热成像进行多摄像头跟踪评估。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.result: 提供了覆盖多样天气与光照条件的大规模多摄像头跟踪数据与评估协议。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo._arxiv_id: MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Modal Camera Tracking Benchmark.

MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.summary_cn: 现有多模态大模型评测多局限于通用场景，缺乏对专家级多学科推理能力的系统评估。本文提出MMMU，一个大规模多学科多模态理解与推理基准，涵盖大学水平多个学科的图像与文本联合推理任务。相比已有基准，MMMU强调专家级知识推理，题目难度高且需跨模态深度理解。该基准为评估多模态大模型在专家AGI方向的能力提供了标准化测试。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.summary_en: Existing multimodal benchmarks are limited to general scenarios and lack systematic evaluation of expert-level multi-disciplinary reasoning. This paper introduces MMMU, a massive multi-discipline multimodal understanding and reasoning benchmark covering college-level subjects requiring joint image-text reasoning. Compared to prior benchmarks, MMMU emphasizes expert-level knowledge reasoning with high difficulty and deep cross-modal understanding, providing a standardized test for evaluating multimodal LLMs toward expert AGI.
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.assessment: MMMU是评估多模态大模型专家级推理能力的重要基准，对VLM研究具有广泛影响力。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.contribution: 提出了大规模多学科多模态理解与推理基准MMMU。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.innovation: 首次系统评估多模态大模型在专家级多学科推理上的能力。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.result: 构建了覆盖大学水平多学科的高难度多模态推理评测集。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo._arxiv_id: MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI.

MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.summary_cn: 现有多模态视频理解基准多聚焦于静态图像或简单视频任务，缺乏对时序动态理解的全面评估。本文提出MVBench，一个综合多模态视频理解基准，涵盖多种时序相关任务，如动作序列、物体交互和事件顺序等。相比已有基准，MVBench强调对视频时序信息的深度理解，并系统评估了多种多模态大模型。该基准揭示了当前模型在时序理解上的不足，为视频理解研究提供了重要参考。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.summary_en: Existing multimodal video understanding benchmarks focus on static images or simple video tasks, lacking comprehensive evaluation of temporal dynamics. This paper introduces MVBench, a comprehensive multi-modal video understanding benchmark covering diverse temporal tasks such as action sequences, object interactions, and event ordering. Compared to prior benchmarks, MVBench emphasizes deep temporal understanding and systematically evaluates various multimodal LLMs, revealing current models' limitations in temporal reasoning.
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.assessment: MVBench为多模态视频理解提供了全面的时序评估框架，对视频理解与VLM研究具有重要价值。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.contribution: 提出了综合多模态视频理解基准MVBench。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.innovation: 系统覆盖多种时序相关视频理解任务并评估多模态大模型。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.result: 揭示了当前多模态模型在视频时序理解上的显著不足。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid._arxiv_id: MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Video Understanding Benchmark.

2402.17553|v2.summary_cn: 当前计算机任务自动化缺乏评估智能体生成可执行程序能力的基准，现有工作多局限于网页自动化。本文提出OmniACT，首个评估智能体生成可执行程序以完成计算机任务的 dataset 和基准，覆盖桌面应用与网页的多种任务。相比已有工作，OmniACT扩展了任务范围，包括短时和长时任务，并提供屏幕图像与自然语言任务对。该基准为多模态通用智能体研究提供了新测试平台。
2402.17553|v2.summary_en: Current computer task automation lacks benchmarks for evaluating agents' ability to generate executable programs, with existing work limited to web automation. This paper introduces OmniACT, the first dataset and benchmark for assessing agents' capability to generate executable programs for computer tasks, covering both desktop applications and web. Compared to prior work, OmniACT extends task scope to short- and long-horizon tasks with screen image and natural language task pairs, providing a new testbed for multimodal generalist agents.
2402.17553|v2.assessment: OmniACT为多模态智能体在桌面与网页自动化任务上提供了首个程序生成评估基准，具有一定前瞻性。
2402.17553|v2.contribution: 提出了首个评估智能体生成可执行程序完成计算机任务的基准OmniACT。
2402.17553|v2.innovation: 将多模态智能体评估从网页自动化扩展到桌面应用与长时任务。
2402.17553|v2.result: 构建了涵盖短时与长时任务的屏幕图像-自然语言任务对数据集。

MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.summary_cn: 多模态大语言模型在安全评估方面缺乏系统基准，现有工作多关注文本安全而忽略视觉模态风险。本文提出MM-SafetyBench，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型安全性的基准，涵盖多种视觉-文本对抗场景。相比已有工作，该基准系统覆盖了图像诱导的不安全输出，并评估了多个主流多模态模型。该基准揭示了多模态模型在视觉对抗下的安全漏洞，为安全对齐研究提供了重要工具。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.summary_en: Multimodal large language models lack systematic safety evaluation benchmarks, with existing work focusing on text safety while neglecting visual modality risks. This paper introduces MM-SafetyBench, a benchmark for evaluating the safety of multimodal LLMs across diverse visual-text adversarial scenarios. Compared to prior work, it systematically covers image-induced unsafe outputs and evaluates multiple mainstream multimodal models, revealing safety vulnerabilities under visual adversarial attacks.
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.assessment: MM-SafetyBench填补了多模态大模型安全评估的空白，对VLM安全对齐研究具有重要参考价值。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.contribution: 提出了多模态大语言模型安全性评估基准MM-SafetyBench。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.innovation: 系统评估视觉模态诱导的多模态模型不安全输出。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.result: 揭示了主流多模态模型在视觉对抗下的安全漏洞。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E._arxiv_id: MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Multimodal Large Language Models.

TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.summary_cn: 夜间车辆监控在航拍场景下缺乏多模态基准，现有数据集多针对白天或地面视角。本文提出TrafficNight，一个航拍多模态夜间车辆监控基准，包含可见光与热成像等多模态数据。相比已有工作，该基准专注于夜间航拍场景，覆盖多种交通状况与光照条件。该基准为夜间车辆检测与多模态融合研究提供了重要测试平台。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.summary_en: Nighttime vehicle surveillance in aerial scenarios lacks multimodal benchmarks, with existing datasets mostly targeting daytime or ground-level views. This paper introduces TrafficNight, an aerial multimodal benchmark for nighttime vehicle surveillance, including visible and thermal modalities. Compared to prior work, it focuses on nighttime aerial scenes with diverse traffic and lighting conditions, providing an important testbed for nighttime vehicle detection and multimodal fusion.
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.assessment: TrafficNight为夜间航拍车辆监控提供了多模态基准，对自动驾驶与监控场景下的多模态感知研究有参考价值。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.contribution: 提出了航拍多模态夜间车辆监控基准TrafficNight。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.innovation: 专注于夜间航拍场景的多模态车辆监控评估。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.result: 构建了覆盖多样交通与光照条件的夜间航拍多模态数据集。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench._arxiv_id: TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Benchmark for Nighttime Vehicle Surveillance.

2403.10943|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态意图识别中现有基准数据集规模有限、且难以处理多轮对话中自然出现的域外（out-of-scope）样本的问题，本文提出了 MIntRec2.0 大规模基准数据集。该数据集包含 1,245 段对话、15,040 个样本，采用 30 类细粒度意图分类体系，其中 9,304 个为域内样本、5,736 个为多轮语境下的域外样本，并额外标注了说话人信息以支持多方对话研究。作者还建立了支持单轮/多轮数据组织、模态特征提取、多模态融合及域内分类与域外检测的通用框架，并用经典多模态融合方法和 ChatGPT 等构建评测基线。相比已有基准，其规模更大且首次系统性地覆盖多轮对话中的域外检测问题。
2403.10943|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MIntRec2.0, a large-scale benchmark for multimodal intent recognition in multi-party conversations, addressing the limited scale of existing datasets and their inability to handle out-of-scope samples in multi-turn interactions. It contains 1,245 dialogues with 15,040 samples across 30 fine-grained intent classes, including 9,304 in-scope and 5,736 out-of-scope samples, plus speaker annotations. A general framework supporting single/multi-turn data organization, modality fusion, in-scope classification and out-of-scope detection is established with baselines built on classic fusion methods and ChatGPT.
2403.10943|v2.assessment: 属于多模态对话理解的数据集工作，与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱，但对多模态融合与开放集检测方法有参考价值。
2403.10943|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模多轮多方对话多模态意图识别与域外检测基准 MIntRec2.0。
2403.10943|v2.innovation: 首次在多轮对话场景中系统性引入并标注域外样本，并补充说话人信息。

2402.04788|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）评估缺乏与人类偏好对齐的基准这一问题，本文提出 MLLM-as-a-Judge 基准，用于评估 MLLM 在评分评估、成对比较和批量排序三类任务中的评判能力。研究发现 MLLM 在成对比较中表现出接近人类的判别力，但在评分评估和批量排序上与人类偏好存在显著偏差，且即使 GPT-4V 等先进模型仍存在偏见、幻觉响应和判断不一致等问题。该工作强调在将 MLLM 视为可靠评估器之前仍需大量改进与研究。
2402.04788|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MLLM-as-a-Judge, a benchmark assessing multimodal LLMs' ability to act as judges across Scoring Evaluation, Pair Comparison, and Batch Ranking tasks. Results show MLLMs approach human-level discernment in Pair Comparison but diverge significantly in Scoring Evaluation and Batch Ranking, with persistent biases, hallucinations, and inconsistencies even in GPT-4V. The findings highlight the need for further research before MLLMs can be trusted as reliable evaluators.
2402.04788|v2.assessment: 对多模态大模型评测方法学有直接价值，但其任务设定与自动驾驶感知相关性有限。
2402.04788|v2.contribution: 提出了评估多模态大模型作为评判者的多任务基准 MLLM-as-a-Judge。
2402.04788|v2.innovation: 将 LLM-as-a-Judge 范式扩展到多模态场景并系统揭示 MLLM 评判偏差。
2402.04788|v2.result: 揭示 MLLM 在成对比较上接近人类但在评分与排序任务上偏差显著，GPT-4V 亦存在偏见与幻觉。

2406.05862|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）高阶图像感知能力缺乏系统评测的问题，论文提出 II-Bench 图像隐含意义理解基准，覆盖抽象与复杂图像的高层语义理解。通过对多个 MLLM 的广泛实验，发现模型最高准确率仅 74.8%，而人类平均 90%、最高 98%，差距显著；模型在抽象复杂图像上表现更差，且在提示中加入情感极性线索后准确率普遍提升。该工作填补了 MLLM 高阶感知评测的空白，揭示了当前模型在高层语义与细节捕捉上的局限。
2406.05862|v2.summary_en: The paper introduces II-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating higher-order image implication understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Extensive experiments show that the best MLLM reaches only 74.8% accuracy versus 90% average and 98% peak human accuracy, with models performing worse on abstract and complex images. Adding sentiment polarity hints to prompts generally improves model accuracy, revealing deficiencies in high-level semantic understanding.
2406.05862|v2.assessment: 该基准首次系统评测 MLLM 的图像隐含意义理解能力，人机差距数据对多模态感知研究有明确参考价值。
2406.05862|v2.contribution: 提出 II-Bench 图像隐含意义理解基准并系统评测多个 MLLM 的高阶感知能力。
2406.05862|v2.innovation: 聚焦图像隐含意义这一高阶感知维度，并引入情感极性提示分析模型行为。
2406.05862|v2.result: MLLM 最高准确率 74.8%，显著低于人类平均 90%、最高 98%，抽象复杂图像上表现更差。

2406.10215|v2.summary_cn: 论文关注视觉-语言模型与儿童语言学习轨迹的相似性问题，提出 DevBench 多模态发展基准，包含词汇、句法、语义三个领域共七项语言评测任务，并配有儿童与成人的行为数据。研究在准确率和反应模式两个维度上对比模型与人类，发现模型与人类反应模式的接近程度因任务而异，任务表现越好的模型其反应模式也越接近人类。此外，对 OpenCLIP 训练过程的追踪表明训练量越大越接近成人反应模式。
2406.10215|v2.summary_en: DevBench is a multimodal developmental benchmark comprising seven language evaluation tasks across lexical, syntactic, and semantic domains, with behavioral data from children and adults. Evaluating vision-language models shows that task accuracy correlates with closeness to human response patterns, and OpenCLIP's developmental trajectory approaches adult patterns with more training. The benchmark enables direct model-human comparison beyond accuracy.
2406.10215|v2.assessment: 该工作将模型评测从准确率扩展到与人类行为模式的对比，为多模态模型的数据效率研究提供了新视角。
2406.10215|v2.contribution: 提出包含儿童与成人行为数据的多模态语言发展基准 DevBench。
2406.10215|v2.innovation: 在准确率之外引入反应模式相似度对比，并追踪 OpenCLIP 训练过程中的发展轨迹。
2406.10215|v2.result: 模型与人类反应模式的接近度因任务而异，表现越好的模型越接近人类，训练量越大越接近成人模式。

2410.08593|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有视频语料时刻检索（VCMR）仅支持粗粒度理解、难以在细粒度查询下精确定位的问题，论文提出更难的细粒度 VCMR 基准，要求从语料中定位最佳匹配时刻并区分部分匹配候选。为此提出 VERIFIED 自动视频-文本标注流水线，利用 LLM 与 LMM 结合静态与动态增强描述模块生成多样化细粒度描述，并通过细粒度感知噪声评估器微调视频基础模型以过滤幻觉标注。基于该流水线构建了更具挑战性的细粒度 VCMR 基准。
2410.08593|v2.summary_en: The paper proposes a more challenging fine-grained Video Corpus Moment Retrieval (VCMR) benchmark that requires localizing the best-matched moment among partially matched candidates. It introduces VERIFIED, an automatic video-text annotation pipeline using LLMs and LMMs with Statics and Dynamics Enhanced Captioning modules, plus a Fine-Granularity Aware Noise Evaluator to filter hallucinated annotations. The resulting benchmark enables more precise fine-grained video moment localization.
2410.08593|v2.assessment: 该工作将 VCMR 推进到细粒度理解层面，其自动标注与噪声过滤流水线对视频理解数据构建有借鉴意义。
2410.08593|v2.contribution: 提出细粒度 VCMR 基准及 VERIFIED 自动视频-文本标注流水线。
2410.08593|v2.innovation: 结合静态与动态增强描述模块生成细粒度标注，并用噪声评估器过滤 LLM 幻觉。
2410.08593|v2.result: 构建了更具挑战性的细粒度 VCMR 基准，支持在部分匹配候选中精确定位最佳时刻。

2406.14515|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统 VideoQA 基准难以覆盖完整视频内容、无法充分评估模型时序理解能力的问题，论文提出 MMBench-Video，一个面向长视频、多镜头场景的整体视频理解定量基准。该基准采用 YouTube 长视频与自由形式问题，贴近实际使用场景，所有问题按精心构建的能力分类体系人工标注，并采用 GPT-4 进行自动评估，在准确性与鲁棒性上优于早期基于 LLM 的评估方法。基于该基准对专有与开源图像/视频 LVLM 进行了全面评测。
2406.14515|v2.summary_en: MMBench-Video is a quantitative benchmark for rigorously evaluating LVLMs' video understanding, featuring lengthy YouTube videos and free-form questions that mirror practical use cases. All questions are human-annotated under a carefully constructed ability taxonomy, and GPT-4 is employed for automated assessment with superior accuracy and robustness over earlier LLM-based evaluations. Comprehensive evaluations cover both proprietary and open-source image and video LVLMs.
2406.14515|v2.assessment: 该基准针对长视频多镜头场景设计，其能力分类体系与 GPT-4 自动评估方案对视频理解评测有较高参考价值。
2406.14515|v2.contribution: 提出面向长视频多镜头整体理解的高质量视频理解基准 MMBench-Video。
2406.14515|v2.innovation: 采用自由形式问题与人工标注能力分类体系，并用 GPT-4 实现更准确鲁棒的自动评估。
2406.14515|v2.result: 在准确性与鲁棒性上优于早期 LLM 评估方法，并完成对专有与开源 LVLM 的全面评测。

2407.15754|v2.summary_cn: ①针对长上下文多模态模型缺乏评测基准的问题，现有 benchmark 难以衡量 LMM 对长视频的理解能力。②提出 LongVideoBench，包含 3,763 个网络采集的变长视频（含字幕，最长可达一小时）和 6,678 道人工标注多选题，覆盖 17 个细粒度类别，并设计了名为 referring reasoning 的新任务范式，要求模型根据问题中的指代查询检索并推理相关视频上下文。③相比已有短视频 QA 基准，该工作强调长时程、多模态交错输入下的细粒度检索与推理。④构建了目前最全面的长视频理解基准之一，为 LMM 长上下文能力提供系统评测。
2407.15754|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of public benchmarks for evaluating long-context multimodal models on long-form video understanding. It introduces LongVideoBench, comprising 3,763 web-collected videos with subtitles (up to one hour) and 6,678 human-annotated multiple-choice questions across 17 fine-grained categories, formulated under a novel referring reasoning task. Compared with existing short-video QA benchmarks, it emphasizes fine-grained retrieval and reasoning over long interleaved multimodal inputs, establishing one of the most comprehensive benchmarks for long-form video understanding.
2407.15754|v2.assessment: 长视频多模态理解是当前 VLM 研究热点，该基准填补了长上下文评测空白，对视频理解与多模态研究者有较高参考价值。
2407.15754|v2.contribution: 提出了面向长上下文交错视频-语言理解的大规模问答基准 LongVideoBench 及 referring reasoning 任务范式。
2407.15754|v2.innovation: 以指代推理任务统一建模长视频中的细粒度多模态信息检索与推理。
2407.15754|v2.result: 构建了含 3,763 个视频、6,678 道题、17 类别的长视频理解基准。

Open-World Human-Object Interaction Dete.summary_cn: ①针对开放世界中人物交互（HOI）检测在未见类别上泛化能力不足的问题。②提出基于多模态提示的方法，利用视觉-语言等多模态提示来识别开放世界中的 HOI。③相比封闭集 HOI 检测方法，借助多模态提示提升对未见交互类别的泛化。④摘要缺失，无法引用具体实验数据。
Open-World Human-Object Interaction Dete.summary_en: This paper targets open-world human-object interaction (HOI) detection, where models must generalize to unseen interaction categories. It proposes a multi-modal prompt-based approach to detect HOIs in the open world. Compared with closed-set HOI detectors, it leverages multi-modal prompts to improve generalization to novel interactions, though the abstract is unavailable so no quantitative results can be cited.
Open-World Human-Object Interaction Dete.assessment: 开放世界 HOI 检测与开放集检测方向相关，多模态提示思路有一定新意，但摘要缺失难以评估其方法细节与实验充分度。
Open-World Human-Object Interaction Dete.contribution: 提出面向开放世界人物交互检测的多模态提示方法。
Open-World Human-Object Interaction Dete.innovation: 将多模态提示引入开放世界 HOI 检测以增强对未见类别的泛化。
Open-World Human-Object Interaction Dete.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法评估。
Open-World Human-Object Interaction Dete._arxiv_id: Open-World Human-Object Interaction Detection via Multi-Modal Prompts.

Scene-adaptive and Region-aware Multi-mo.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇目标检测中模型难以适应不同场景与区域差异的问题。②提出场景自适应且区域感知的多模态提示方法，用于开放词汇目标检测。③相比固定提示的开放词汇检测方法，强调提示随场景与区域动态调整。④摘要缺失，无法引用具体实验数据。
Scene-adaptive and Region-aware Multi-mo.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object detection, focusing on the difficulty of adapting to diverse scenes and regional variations. It proposes a scene-adaptive and region-aware multi-modal prompt method. Compared with fixed-prompt open-vocabulary detectors, it dynamically adjusts prompts according to scene and region, though the abstract is unavailable so quantitative results cannot be cited.
Scene-adaptive and Region-aware Multi-mo.assessment: 开放词汇检测与开放集检测方向相关，场景自适应与区域感知提示设计有针对性，但摘要缺失限制了对其贡献的评估。
Scene-adaptive and Region-aware Multi-mo.contribution: 提出场景自适应、区域感知的多模态提示用于开放词汇目标检测。

2503.15024|v2.summary_cn: 针对AIGC时代伪造媒体多样化导致缺乏系统评估LVLM伪造检测能力基准的问题，作者提出Forensics-Bench，包含63,292道多选视觉问答，覆盖112种伪造检测类型，从伪造语义、模态、任务、类型和生成模型5个维度组织。相比已有基准，它首次大规模、多维度地评估LVLM的识别、定位与推理能力，并对22个开源LVLM及GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 Pro、Claude等3个闭源模型进行了系统评测。该工作为伪造检测与多模态理解研究提供了标准化评测平台。
2503.15024|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of a comprehensive benchmark for assessing LVLMs' forgery detection capabilities amid increasingly diverse AIGC-generated fake media, the authors present Forensics-Bench, comprising 63,292 multi-choice visual questions covering 112 forgery detection types across five perspectives: forgery semantics, modalities, tasks, types, and models. They systematically evaluate 22 open-source LVLMs and 3 proprietary models (GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Claude). This benchmark provides a standardized, multi-dimensional evaluation platform for forgery detection and multimodal understanding.
2503.15024|v2.assessment: 作为伪造检测领域的综合性LVLM评测基准，覆盖面广、评测规模大，对多模态安全研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2503.15024|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖112种伪造类型、63,292道问题的多维度LVLM伪造检测评测基准Forensics-Bench。
2503.15024|v2.innovation: 首次从伪造语义、模态、任务、类型和生成模型五个视角系统组织伪造检测评测。
2503.15024|v2.result: 对22个开源LVLM及GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 Pro、Claude进行了系统评测，揭示了现有模型在伪造检测上的能力边界。

2506.21549|v2.summary_cn: 针对工业制造中单实例3D异常检测与分割（ADS）缺乏多视角多模态基准的问题，论文提出SiM3D——首个融合多视角与多模态信息、并输出体素级Anomaly Volume的ADS基准。该基准包含用高端工业传感器与机器人采集的新数据集，覆盖8类物体共333个实例，提供12Mpx多视角图像与7M点云，并给出异常测试样本的3D分割真值，同时支持从合成训练泛化到真实测试的场景。作者将主流单视角方法适配到多视角3D ADS任务，并提出基于Anomaly Volume的新评测指标建立基线。其价值在于首次系统定义并量化了多视角多模态3D异常检测任务，为工业质检研究提供可复现的评测平台。
2506.21549|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces SiM3D, the first benchmark for multiview multimodal 3D anomaly detection and segmentation (ADS) that outputs a voxel-based Anomaly Volume, targeting single-instance industrial scenarios where only one real or synthetic object is available for training. It provides a new dataset with 12 Mpx multiview images and 7M-point clouds for 333 instances across 8 object types, plus manually annotated 3D segmentation ground truth, and uniquely addresses synthetic-to-real generalization. Prominent single-view methods are adapted as baselines and evaluated with novel metrics operating on Anomaly Volumes.
2506.21549|v2.assessment: 作为首个多视角多模态3D异常检测基准，任务定义清晰、数据采集规格高，对工业质检与3D感知交叉方向有参考价值，但与应用领域（自动驾驶BEV/检测）相关度有限。
2506.21549|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向单实例、支持合成到真实泛化的多视角多模态3D异常检测与分割基准SiM3D及配套数据集与指标。
2506.21549|v2.innovation: 首次将多视角与多模态信息融合到体素级Anomaly Volume的3D ADS任务，并引入合成训练到真实测试的泛化设定。
2506.21549|v2.result: 提供了8类333个实例的高分辨率多视角图像与点云数据及3D分割真值，并基于适配的单视角方法建立了参考基线。

2408.11817|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有LMM评测基准逐渐饱和、缺乏对下一代模型挑战性的问题，论文提出GRAB——一个面向图分析（graph analysis）的大型多模态模型基准。GRAB以合成数据为主，保证问题高质量无噪声，包含3284个问题，覆盖5类任务与23种图属性，模拟分析师读取图表均值、截距、相关性等操作。作者评测了20个LMM，最高分仅21.0%，并通过消融分析模型成功与失败的具体场景，同时发布轻量版GRAB-Lite。其贡献在于为LMM图表理解能力提供了高难度、可扩展的评测工具。
2408.11817|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces GRAB, a predominantly synthetic benchmark for graph analysis by large multimodal models (LMMs), comprising 3284 questions across 5 tasks and 23 graph properties to address the saturation of existing benchmarks. Evaluating 20 LMMs, the best model achieves only 21.0%, demonstrating substantial headroom, and ablations reveal where models succeed and fail. A lightweight GRAB-Lite is also released to facilitate future research.
2408.11817|v2.assessment: 基准设计严谨、难度充足，对LMM图表理解评测有明确价值，但与自动驾驶/3D感知方向关联较弱。
2408.11817|v2.contribution: 构建了包含3284个问题、覆盖5类任务与23种图属性的高难度图分析LMM基准GRAB及轻量版GRAB-Lite。
2408.11817|v2.innovation: 以合成方式保证无噪声高质量问题，并系统评测20个LMM揭示其在图分析上的严重不足。
2408.11817|v2.result: 最强LMM在GRAB上仅得21.0%，表明该基准对当前模型具有显著挑战性。

2406.08035|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces LVBench, a benchmark specifically designed for long video understanding, addressing the gap that existing evaluations focus on short videos under one minute while real-world applications require comprehension of videos spanning several hours. Extensive evaluations show current multimodal models still underperform on these demanding tasks, and the data and code are publicly released.
2406.08035|v2.assessment: 长视频理解是视频多模态的重要前沿，LVBench填补了小时级评测空白，对视频理解方向研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知直接关联有限。

2410.10139|v2.summary_cn: 针对交错式多模态理解与生成（模型需按任意序列产出与解读图像和文本）评测不足、现有基准在数据规模、范围与评测深度上受限、评测指标昂贵或有偏的问题，论文提出MMIE——一个大规模知识密集型基准，用于评估LVLM的交错多模态理解与生成能力。MMIE包含2万个精心筛选的多模态查询，覆盖3大类、12个领域、102个子领域（含数学、编程、物理、文学、健康、艺术等），支持交错输入输出，混合选择题与开放式问答。作者还提出基于人工标注数据微调评分模型、结合系统化评价标准的可靠自动评测指标，以降低偏差。
2410.10139|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MMIE, a large-scale knowledge-intensive benchmark for evaluating interleaved multimodal comprehension and generation in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), addressing the limited scale, scope, and evaluation depth of existing benchmarks. MMIE contains 20K curated multimodal queries spanning 3 categories, 12 fields, and 102 subfields, supporting interleaved inputs and outputs with both multiple-choice and open-ended formats. A reliable automated metric based on a scoring model fine-tuned with human annotations is proposed to reduce bias and cost.
2410.10139|v2.assessment: MMIE在数据规模与领域覆盖上较为扎实，并针对交错式评测的指标偏差问题给出方案，对多模态评测研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知方向关联较弱。
2410.10139|v2.contribution: 构建了包含2万查询、覆盖12领域102子领域的交错式多模态理解与生成基准MMIE及配套自动评测指标。
2410.10139|v2.innovation: 支持交错输入输出并混合选择题与开放式问答，同时用人工标注微调的评分模型降低自动评测偏差。
2410.10139|v2.result: 提供了大规模知识密集型交错多模态评测集与更可靠的自动评分方案（摘要未给出具体模型得分数据）。

2502.19870|v2.summary_cn: 现有 LMM 知识编辑基准多局限于简单三元组形式的实体级知识，无法反映真实世界多模态信息的复杂性。本文提出 MMKE-Bench，将编辑任务划分为视觉实体编辑、视觉语义编辑和用户特定编辑三类，并用自由形式自然语言表示和编辑知识。基准包含 33 个大类、2940 条知识和 8363 张图像，评测问题自动生成并经人工校验。作者在三种主流 LMM 上评估了五种 SOTA 知识编辑方法，揭示了现有方法在复杂视觉知识编辑上的不足。
2502.19870|v2.summary_en: Existing multimodal knowledge editing benchmarks focus on entity-level triplets and fail to capture real-world complexity. This paper introduces MMKE-Bench, covering visual entity editing, visual semantic editing, and user-specific editing with free-form natural language knowledge representation. It contains 2,940 knowledge items and 8,363 images across 33 categories, with human-verified questions, and evaluates five state-of-the-art editing methods on three LMMs.
2502.19870|v2.assessment: 为多模态知识编辑提供了更贴近真实场景的评测基准，对关注 LMM 知识更新与多模态理解的研究者有参考价值。
2502.19870|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖三类编辑任务、自由语言表示的大规模多模态知识编辑基准 MMKE-Bench。
2502.19870|v2.innovation: 用自由形式自然语言替代三元组表示知识，并引入用户特定编辑任务。
2502.19870|v2.result: 在三种 LMM 上评测五种编辑方法，暴露出现有方法在复杂视觉知识编辑上的明显短板。

2408.13257|v2.summary_cn: 现有 MLLM 基准存在数据规模小、依赖模型标注、任务难度不足（尤其受限于图像分辨率）等问题，难以衡量真实世界的挑战。本文提出 MME-RealWorld，从公开数据集和互联网收集 30 万+图像，筛选出 13366 张高质量图像，由 25 名标注员和 7 名 MLLM 专家标注出 29429 个问答对，覆盖 5 个真实场景下的 43 个子任务。该基准是迄今最大的人工标注基准，分辨率最高且聚焦真实应用，对 28 个主流 MLLM 的评测显示即使人类也感到极具挑战。
2408.13257|v2.summary_en: Existing MLLM benchmarks suffer from small scale, model-based annotations, and insufficient difficulty, especially due to limited image resolution. This paper presents MME-RealWorld, the largest manually annotated benchmark to date, with 13,366 high-resolution images and 29,429 QA pairs covering 43 subtasks across 5 real-world scenarios. Evaluation of 28 prominent MLLMs shows the benchmark is extremely challenging even for humans.
2408.13257|v2.assessment: 规模与分辨率均领先的高质量人工标注基准，对评估 MLLM 真实场景能力具有重要参考价值。
2408.13257|v2.contribution: 构建了目前最大、分辨率最高、聚焦真实应用的多模态人工标注基准 MME-RealWorld。
2408.13257|v2.innovation: 通过大规模人工标注和高分辨率图像设计出对人类也极具挑战的真实场景评测任务。
2408.13257|v2.result: 对 28 个主流 MLLM 的评测表明现有模型在该基准上表现远未饱和。

2410.08474|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型在体育场景理解与推理能力缺乏系统评测的问题，作者提出了SPORTU基准，包含纯文本的SPORTU-text（900道选择题，含人工标注解释）和视频的SPORTU-video（7类运动、1701个慢动作片段、12048个QA对），覆盖从运动识别到犯规判定与规则应用的多级推理。评测采用few-shot与CoT提示，GPT-4o在SPORTU-text上最高仅71%准确率，仍低于人类水平。该工作为体育领域的多模态推理提供了细粒度评测工具，但与自动驾驶感知研究关联较弱。
2410.08474|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of systematic evaluation of multimodal LLMs in sports understanding and reasoning, the authors introduce SPORTU, a benchmark comprising a text-only part (900 multiple-choice questions with human-annotated explanations) and a video part (1,701 slow-motion clips across 7 sports with 12,048 QA pairs) covering multi-level reasoning from recognition to foul detection and rule application. Using few-shot and CoT prompting, GPT-4o reaches only 71% accuracy on SPORTU-text, still below human performance. The benchmark offers fine-grained evaluation for sports-domain multimodal reasoning, though its relevance to autonomous driving perception is limited.
2410.08474|v2.assessment: 作为体育领域多模态推理评测基准，构建较为系统，但与自动驾驶/视觉感知核心方向关联度低，主要价值在于多模态推理评测方法论的参考。
2410.08474|v2.contribution: 提出了覆盖文本与视频、多级推理任务的体育理解多模态评测基准SPORTU。
2410.08474|v2.innovation: 将体育规则理解、犯规判定等复杂推理任务系统化纳入多模态基准，并区分纯文本与视频两种评测路径。
2410.08474|v2.result: GPT-4o在SPORTU-text上取得最高71%准确率，但仍未达到人类水平。

2410.09732|v2.summary_cn: 针对AI生成内容泛滥导致真实与合成多模态数据难以区分的问题，作者提出LOKI基准，用于评估大型多模态模型（LMM）的合成数据检测能力。LOKI覆盖视频、图像、3D、文本、音频五种模态，包含26个子类、约18K道难度分级的问题，任务形式包括粗粒度判断、选择题以及细粒度异常选择与解释。该基准同时检验LMM的感知、知识与推理能力，并评测了22个开源LMM。其价值在于为合成数据检测提供多模态统一评测，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
2410.09732|v2.summary_en: To tackle the challenge of distinguishing authentic from AI-generated multimodal data, the authors propose LOKI, a benchmark for evaluating large multimodal models (LMMs) on synthetic data detection. LOKI spans video, image, 3D, text, and audio modalities, with 18K curated questions across 26 subcategories and graded difficulty, covering coarse-grained judgment, multiple-choice, and fine-grained anomaly selection and explanation tasks. It evaluates 22 open-source LMMs, testing perception, knowledge, and reasoning, but its connection to autonomous driving perception remains limited.
2410.09732|v2.assessment: 多模态合成数据检测基准覆盖面广、任务设计细致，对理解LMM的感知与推理边界有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关性较低。
2410.09732|v2.contribution: 提出了跨五种模态、含18K问题的合成数据检测基准LOKI。
2410.09732|v2.innovation: 将合成数据检测统一到多模态、多难度、多任务形式的评测框架中，并强调可解释性判断。
2410.09732|v2.result: 对22个开源LMM进行了系统评测，揭示了其在合成数据检测上的能力差异与不足。

2601.10744|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有具身任务多为一次性任务、忽视探索过程与长期记忆利用的问题，论文提出长期记忆具身探索（LMEE）任务，并构建了包含多目标导航与基于记忆问答的数据集与基准 LMEE-Bench。方法 MemoryExplorer 通过强化学习微调多模态大语言模型，鼓励主动记忆查询，并设计多任务奖励函数。相比已有工作，其改进在于统一了探索认知与决策行为，并同时评估过程与结果。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
2601.10744|v2.summary_en: The paper identifies that existing one-shot embodied tasks overlook the exploration process and long-term memory utilization, and proposes Long-term Memory Embodied Exploration (LMEE) with a corresponding dataset and benchmark, LMEE-Bench, covering multi-goal navigation and memory-based QA.
