2503.16282|v2.summary_cn: 广义少样本3D点云分割（GFS-PCS）需在保留基类分割的同时用少量支持样本适应新类，但现有方法受限于少样本的稀疏知识，而3D视觉语言模型（3D VLM）虽泛化开放世界新类却知识噪声大。本文提出GFS-VL框架，协同3D VLM的稠密但含噪伪标签与精确但稀疏的少样本样本：先用原型引导的伪标签选择过滤低质量区域，再用自适应填充策略结合伪标签上下文与少样本知识标注未标注区域，并设计新基类混合策略将少样本嵌入训练场景。此外针对现有基准多样性不足，引入两个更具挑战性的基准。
2503.16282|v2.summary_en: Generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation (GFS-PCS) must adapt to new classes with few support samples while retaining base class segmentation, but existing methods are limited by sparse few-shot knowledge, while 3D VLMs generalize to open-world novel classes yet contain noisy knowledge. We introduce GFS-VL, which synergizes dense but noisy pseudo-labels from 3D VLMs with precise yet sparse few-shot samples via prototype-guided pseudo-label selection, an adaptive infilling strategy, and a novel-base mix strategy. We further introduce two challenging benchmarks to address limited diversity in current GFS-PCS benchmarks.
2503.16282|v2.assessment: 将3D VLM伪标签与少样本样本协同用于广义少样本3D分割，并补充新基准，对3D感知与开放词汇方向有参考价值。
2503.16282|v2.contribution: 提出GFS-VL框架，协同3D VLM伪标签与少样本样本实现广义少样本3D点云分割，并引入两个新基准。
2503.16282|v2.innovation: 原型引导伪标签选择、自适应填充与新基类混合策略，结合3D VLM与少样本知识。
2503.16282|v2.result: 在保留基类分割的同时提升新类学习，并提供了更具挑战性的评测基准。

2411.16183|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D实例分割方法因无监督合并策略常导致过分割，产生大量冗余3D候选框，影响下游任务。本文提出3D-Aware 2D Mask Tracking模块，利用SAM-2的3D先验确保跨视频帧的对象掩码一致性，并设计3D Mask Optimization模块，通过动态规划算法选择最优视图集，细化超点以生成每个对象的最终3D提议。该方法在保持场景全面对象覆盖的同时减少了不必要的提议，提升了3D实例分割的精度和效率。
2411.16183|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D instance segmentation methods suffer from over-segmentation due to unsupervised merging, yielding redundant 3D proposals. This paper proposes a 3D-Aware 2D Mask Tracking module leveraging SAM-2's 3D priors for consistent object masks across frames, and a 3D Mask Optimization module that uses dynamic programming to select optimal views and refine superpoints into final 3D proposals. The approach achieves comprehensive object coverage while reducing redundant proposals, improving downstream performance.
2411.16183|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了3D实例分割中的过分割问题，利用基础模型先验和动态规划优化，思路新颖且实用，对自动驾驶感知中的3D场景理解有直接价值。
2411.16183|v2.contribution: 提出结合SAM-2跟踪与动态规划优化的3D实例分割框架，显著减少冗余提议。
2411.16183|v2.innovation: 利用3D感知的2D掩码跟踪和动态规划选择最优视图，替代传统启发式合并。
2411.16183|v2.result: 在保持全面对象覆盖的同时减少了冗余3D提议，提升了分割精度。

2411.17150|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）在复杂环境中分割任意查询提示指定的对象时，缺乏对象级上下文考虑，导致无法准确分组语义一致的元素。本文提出一种新方法，通过将视觉基础模型中的谱驱动特征蒸馏到视觉编码器的注意力机制中，增强对象内部一致性，使语义连贯组件形成单一对象掩码；同时利用零样本对象存在概率细化文本嵌入，确保与图像中特定对象的准确对齐。该方法在无需训练的情况下提升了OVSS对未见数据的处理能力。
2411.17150|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation (OVSS) lacks object-level context when segmenting complex objects with arbitrary query prompts, limiting precise grouping of semantically consistent elements. This paper introduces a training-free approach that distills spectral-driven features from vision foundation models into the visual encoder's attention to enhance intra-object consistency, and refines text embeddings with zero-shot object presence likelihood for accurate alignment. The method improves OVSS scalability and deployment on unseen data.
2411.17150|v2.assessment: 该工作针对OVSS中对象级上下文缺失问题，提出谱蒸馏和文本嵌入细化，方法新颖且无需训练，对开放词汇分割研究有启发。
2411.17150|v2.contribution: 提出基于谱蒸馏和零样本对象存在概率的免训练OVSS方法。
2411.17150|v2.innovation: 将谱驱动特征蒸馏到注意力机制，并利用对象存在概率细化文本嵌入。
2411.17150|v2.result: 增强了对象内部一致性，提升了开放词汇分割的准确性和泛化能力。

2503.16707|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇3D场景理解方法通常依赖单一视觉语言模型（VLM）对齐3D模型特征空间，限制了利用多种基础模型的空间和语义能力。本文提出CUA-O3D，首次将CLIP、DINOv2和Stable Diffusion等多个基础模型集成到3D场景理解中，并引入确定性不确定性估计来自适应地蒸馏和协调异构2D特征嵌入。该方法解决了融合语义先验与几何知识以及协调异构表示两大挑战，在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上取得了显著提升。
2503.16707|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding methods rely on a single VLM for feature alignment, limiting the use of diverse foundation models. This paper proposes CUA-O3D, the first to integrate multiple foundation models (CLIP, DINOv2, Stable Diffusion) into 3D scene understanding, with deterministic uncertainty estimation to adaptively distill and harmonize heterogeneous 2D features. It addresses semantic-geometric fusion and representation reconciliation, achieving significant improvements.
2503.16707|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地融合多基础模型并引入不确定性估计，有效提升了3D场景理解的开放词汇能力，对自动驾驶中的3D感知有重要参考价值。
2503.16707|v2.contribution: 提出首个集成多基础模型的开放词汇3D场景理解框架CUA-O3D。
2503.16707|v2.innovation: 利用确定性不确定性估计自适应蒸馏和协调异构2D特征嵌入。
2503.16707|v2.result: 在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上显著优于依赖单一VLM的方法。

2501.09688|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇部件分割（OVPS）面临部件级图像-文本对齐困难和对象部件结构理解不足两大挑战。本文提出PartCATSeg框架，集成对象感知的部件级代价聚合、组合损失和来自DINO的结构引导。采用解耦代价聚合策略分别处理对象和部件级代价，提升部件分割精度；引入组合损失捕捉部件-对象关系以补偿有限标注；DINO特征提供结构引导改善边界划分和部件间理解。在Pascal-Part-116、ADE20K-Part-234和PartImageNet数据集上显著超越现有方法，为未见部件类别的泛化设定了新基线。
2501.09688|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Part Segmentation (OVPS) faces challenges in part-level image-text alignment and structural understanding. This paper proposes PartCATSeg, integrating object-aware part-level cost aggregation, compositional loss, and structural guidance from DINO. The disentangled cost aggregation handles object and part costs separately, compositional loss captures part-object relationships, and DINO features improve boundary delineation. It significantly outperforms state-of-the-art on Pascal-Part-116, ADE20K-Part-234, and PartImageNet.
2501.09688|v2.assessment: 该工作针对OVPS的细粒度对齐和结构理解问题，提出解耦代价聚合和组合损失，方法扎实且实验充分，对细粒度开放词汇分割有推动作用。
2501.09688|v2.contribution: 提出PartCATSeg框架，通过解耦代价聚合和组合损失提升开放词汇部件分割。
2501.09688|v2.innovation: 结合对象感知代价聚合、组合损失和DINO结构引导，解决部件级对齐和结构理解。
2501.09688|v2.result: 在多个部件分割数据集上显著超越SOTA，设定了新基线。

2504.04191|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇物理技能学习面临手动设计奖励不可扩展和演示方法泛化差的问题。本文提出GROVE，一种无需手动工程或任务特定演示的通用奖励框架。其核心思想是利用LLM生成精确的物理约束，VLM评估运动语义和自然性，通过迭代设计过程，VLM反馈持续优化LLM生成的约束，形成自改进奖励系统。为弥合仿真与自然图像的域差，开发了Pose2CLIP轻量映射器，将智能体姿态直接投影到语义特征空间。在多种具身和学习范式上进行了广泛实验。
2504.04191|v2.summary_en: Learning open-vocabulary physical skills is hindered by non-scalable manual rewards and poor generalization of demonstration-based methods. This paper introduces GROVE, a generalized reward framework using LLMs for physical constraints and VLMs for motion semantics, with iterative refinement for self-improvement. A lightweight Pose2CLIP mapper bridges simulation and natural images. Extensive experiments across embodiments and learning paradigms validate the approach.
2504.04191|v2.assessment: 该工作将LLM和VLM结合用于物理技能学习，思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，更偏向机器人强化学习。
2504.04191|v2.contribution: 提出GROVE通用奖励框架，利用LLM和VLM协同实现开放词汇物理技能学习。
2504.04191|v2.innovation: 通过VLM反馈迭代优化LLM生成的约束，并设计Pose2CLIP映射器弥合域差。
2504.04191|v2.result: 在多种具身和学习范式上验证了框架的有效性和泛化能力。

2501.18954|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测器依赖大量区域级标注数据，性能提升受限。本文提出LLMDet，通过让开放词汇检测器与大语言模型协同训练，为每张图像生成图像级详细描述来进一步提升性能。构建了GroundingCap-1M数据集，每张图像包含关联的定位标签和图像级详细描述。使用标准定位损失和描述生成损失微调检测器，LLM生成区域级短描述和图像级长描述。在LLM监督下，LLMDet显著超越基线，具有优越的开放词汇能力，并能反过来构建更强的多模态大模型，实现互利。
2501.18954|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors rely on abundant region-level annotations, limiting performance. This paper proposes LLMDet, co-training an open-vocabulary detector with an LLM by generating image-level detailed captions. It collects GroundingCap-1M with grounding labels and captions, and finetunes the detector with grounding and caption generation losses. LLMDet outperforms baselines with superior open-vocabulary ability and can reciprocally build stronger multimodal models.
2501.18954|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地利用LLM监督提升开放词汇检测器性能，并构建了大规模数据集，对目标检测和多模态理解领域有重要贡献，实验充分且效果显著。
2501.18954|v2.contribution: 提出LLMDet，通过LLM监督和GroundingCap-1M数据集提升开放词汇检测器性能。
2501.18954|v2.innovation: 将LLM生成的图像级详细描述与定位损失联合训练，实现检测器与LLM的互利。
2501.18954|v2.result: LLMDet显著超越基线，开放词汇能力优越，并能增强多模态大模型。

2503.19145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇属性检测中标注成本高、属性集合固定且描述粒度模糊的问题，提出免训练的Compositional Caching (ComCa)方法。该方法仅需目标属性与物体列表，利用web-scale数据库和LLM构建辅助图像缓存，并为缓存图像分配软属性标签，在推理时根据输入与缓存图像的相似度聚合标签以精炼VLM预测。相比依赖预定义属性集和人工标注的已有方法，ComCa无需训练即可扩展到任意属性词汇，并缓解了属性组合性带来的歧义。
2503.19145|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and limited scalability of open-vocabulary attribute detection. It proposes Compositional Caching (ComCa), a training-free method that builds an auxiliary image cache using web-scale databases and LLMs, assigns soft attribute labels, and aggregates them at inference via similarity to refine VLM predictions. Unlike prior work restricted to predefined attributes, ComCa generalizes to arbitrary attribute vocabularies without training.
2503.19145|v2.assessment: 思路新颖，利用LLM与检索缓存实现免训练开放词汇属性检测，对开放集感知有启发，但摘要未给出量化结果，实际增益待验证。
2503.19145|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的开放词汇属性检测框架ComCa，通过LLM引导的缓存构建与软标签聚合扩展属性词汇。
2503.19145|v2.innovation: 用web-scale检索缓存与LLM判定属性-物体兼容性，并以软标签相似度聚合替代固定属性分类器。
2503.19145|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，声称克服了预定义属性集的限制并提升可扩展性。

2401.12217|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割通常依赖CLIP类图像级VLM、真值掩码和定制分组编码器的问题，提出S-Seg，一种不依赖上述任何组件的简单模型。S-Seg利用伪掩码和语言训练MaskFormer，可直接在公开图文数据集上训练，并直接学习像素级特征与语言对齐。相比已有方法，S-Seg无需微调即可泛化到多个测试数据集，且随数据规模扩展性能持续提升，结合自训练还能进一步改进。
2401.12217|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary semantic segmentation without relying on image-level VL models, ground-truth masks, or custom grouping encoders. It introduces S-Seg, which trains a MaskFormer with pseudo-masks and language on public image-text data, directly learning pixel-level features and language alignment. S-Seg generalizes to multiple test datasets without fine-tuning, scales with data, and improves with self-training.
2401.12217|v2.assessment: 以极简设计挑战现有开放词汇分割范式，强调可扩展性与自训练增益，作为强基线值得关注。
2401.12217|v2.contribution: 提出不依赖CLIP、真值掩码和分组编码器的开放词汇语义分割模型S-Seg。
2401.12217|v2.innovation: 用伪掩码加语言直接训练MaskFormer实现像素级语言对齐，并支持数据扩展与自训练持续提升。
2401.12217|v2.result: 无需微调即可跨数据集泛化，性能随数据规模增长并可通过自训练持续改进。

2411.14723|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统开放词汇语义分割将SAM与CLIP两阶段串联导致计算开销大、内存效率低的问题，提出单阶段模型ESC-Net。ESC-Net在高效推理框架内复用SAM解码器块进行类无关分割，并将由图文相关性生成的伪提示嵌入SAM的可提示分割框架，实现精细的空间聚合与准确掩码预测。在ADE20K、PASCAL-VOC和PASCAL-Context上，ESC-Net在效率与精度上均优于先前方法，消融实验验证了其在挑战性条件下的鲁棒性。
2411.14723|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computation and memory cost of two-stage open-vocabulary segmentation that sequentially combines SAM and CLIP. It proposes ESC-Net, a one-stage model that reuses SAM decoder blocks for class-agnostic segmentation and embeds image-text-derived pseudo prompts into SAM's promptable framework for refined spatial aggregation. ESC-Net outperforms prior methods on ADE20K, PASCAL-VOC, and PASCAL-Context in both efficiency and accuracy.
2411.14723|v2.assessment: 将SAM解码器与伪提示结合为单阶段框架，兼顾效率与精度，对开放词汇分割工程化有参考价值。
2411.14723|v2.contribution: 提出单阶段开放词汇分割模型ESC-Net，复用SAM解码器并嵌入图文伪提示。
2411.14723|v2.innovation: 以伪提示驱动SAM可提示分割实现类无关掩码与空间聚合，避免两阶段SAM+CLIP的高开销。
2411.14723|v2.result: 在ADE20K、PASCAL-VOC、PASCAL-Context上效率与精度均超越先前方法。

2502.02548|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D场景理解中精确3D区域分割、全面文本描述和足够数据规模三大需求，提出自动数据生成管线与训练框架。该方法利用先进开放词汇图像分割模型和区域感知VLM自动生成高质量3D掩码-文本对，构建了含3万+场景、560万掩码-文本对的Mosaic3D-5.6M数据集，规模显著超过现有数据集。基于该数据提出Mosaic3D基础模型，结合对比学习训练的3D编码器与轻量掩码解码器，在ScanNet200、Matterport3D和ScanNet++的开放词汇3D语义与实例分割上取得SOTA。
2502.02548|v2.summary_en: This paper targets open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding by addressing the need for precise 3D region segmentation, comprehensive text descriptions, and dataset scale. It develops an automatic pipeline using open-vocabulary image segmentation and region-aware VLMs to build Mosaic3D-5.6M, a dataset of 30K+ scenes with 5.6M mask-text pairs. The proposed Mosaic3D foundation model combines a contrastively trained 3D encoder with a lightweight mask decoder, achieving state-of-the-art open-vocabulary 3D semantic and instance segmentation on ScanNet200, Matterport3D, and ScanNet++.
2502.02548|v2.assessment: 大规模3D掩码-文本数据集与基础模型对开放词汇3D感知有重要推动，数据规模优势明显，值得关注。
2502.02548|v2.contribution: 构建5.6M掩码-文本对的Mosaic3D-5.6M数据集并提出开放词汇3D分割基础模型Mosaic3D。
2502.02548|v2.innovation: 用开放词汇2D分割与区域感知VLM自动生成3D掩码-文本对，并以对比学习3D编码器加轻量解码器实现开放词汇3D分割。
2502.02548|v2.result: 在ScanNet200、Matterport3D、ScanNet++的开放词汇3D语义与实例分割上达到SOTA。

2412.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇分割中掩码池化CLIP嵌入时准确掩码反而难以带来准确分类的反直觉现象，揭示掩码池化的性能局限并提出Mask-Adapter。该方法从候选掩码中提取语义激活图，提供更丰富的上下文信息并保证掩码与CLIP的对齐，同时提出掩码一致性损失，使IoU相近的候选掩码获得相似的CLIP嵌入以增强对掩码变化的鲁棒性。Mask-Adapter以即插即用方式集成到基于掩码池化的开放词汇分割方法中，带来更准确的分类结果。
2412.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper reveals the counterintuitive limitation that accurate masks often fail to yield accurate classification under mask pooling of CLIP embeddings in open-vocabulary segmentation. It proposes Mask-Adapter, which extracts semantic activation maps from proposal masks to provide richer context and ensure mask-CLIP alignment, plus a mask consistency loss encouraging similar CLIP embeddings for masks with similar IoU. Mask-Adapter is plug-and-play and improves classification accuracy across open-vocabulary segmentation methods.
2412.04533|v2.assessment: 对掩码池化失效机理的分析有洞察力，即插即用设计实用性强，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2412.04533|v2.contribution: 揭示掩码池化在开放词汇分割中的性能瓶颈并提出即插即用的Mask-Adapter。
2412.04533|v2.innovation: 从候选掩码提取语义激活图替代直接池化，并用掩码一致性损失增强对掩码质量的鲁棒性。
2412.04533|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称在多种开放词汇分割方法上带来更准确的分类结果。

2503.18094|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇视频异常检测中新颖异常面临检测歧义（难以给出准确异常分数）和类别混淆（被误分为视觉相似基类）两大挑战，提出Anomize框架。该方法利用多层级视觉数据与匹配文本信息补充多源信息以缓解检测歧义，并引入标签关系指导新标签编码以改善新颖视频与标签的对齐，从而减少类别混淆。在UCF-Crime和XD-Violence数据集上，Anomize取得优越性能，验证了其在OVVAD上的有效性。
2503.18094|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary video anomaly detection, where novel anomalies suffer from detection ambiguity and categorization confusion. It proposes Anomize, which leverages multi-level visual data with matching textual information to mitigate ambiguity and incorporates label relations to guide new-label encoding for better video-label alignment. Anomize achieves superior performance on UCF-Crime and XD-Violence.
2503.18094|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇设定引入视频异常检测并针对新颖类别歧义与混淆提出多源信息与标签关系方案，方向有价值。
2503.18094|v2.contribution: 提出面向开放词汇视频异常检测的Anomize框架，缓解新颖异常的检测歧义与类别混淆。
2503.18094|v2.innovation: 融合多层级视觉与匹配文本信息，并利用标签关系指导新标签编码以改善对齐。
2503.18094|v2.result: 在UCF-Crime和XD-Violence数据集上取得优越性能。

2503.00414|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇人-物交互（OV-HOI）检测中特征粒度不足与语义相似性混淆两个问题，论文提出分层粒度比较网络SGC-Net。方法上引入粒度感知对齐模块，将全局语义特征与中间层局部细节聚合，实现中间视觉特征与文本嵌入的鲁棒对齐；同时设计层次化分组比较模块，利用LLM递归比较并分组类别，为每类生成细粒度判别性描述。相比仅依赖最后一层特征与CLIP蒸馏的已有方法，该工作缓解了CLIP固有类别偏置与LLM描述区分度不足的问题。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2503.00414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two challenges in open-vocabulary human-object interaction (OV-HOI) detection: feature granularity deficiency caused by relying on last-layer visual features, and semantic similarity confusion arising from CLIP's class biases and insufficiently discriminative LLM-generated descriptions. It proposes a Stratified Granular Comparison Network comprising a granularity sensing alignment module that aggregates global semantics with intermediate-layer local details, and a hierarchical group comparison module that recursively compares and groups classes via LLMs to produce fine-grained discriminative descriptions. Compared with prior LLM-distillation-from-CLIP pipelines, it improves intermediate feature-text alignment and inter-class discrimination, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2503.00414|v2.assessment: 问题定位清晰，分层对齐与LLM递归分组思路对开放词汇检测有参考价值，但摘要缺乏实验数据，实际增益有待验证。
2503.00414|v2.contribution: 提出分层粒度比较网络SGC-Net，通过粒度感知对齐与层次化分组比较解决OV-HOI中的粒度缺失与语义混淆问题。
2503.00414|v2.innovation: 将中间层视觉特征与文本嵌入对齐，并利用LLM递归分组生成细粒度判别性类别描述。
2503.00414|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称缓解了特征粒度不足与语义相似性混淆问题。

ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.summary_cn: 论文提出ReasonGrounder，面向开放词汇3D视觉定位与推理任务，利用大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）引导的分层特征splatting方法。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节、改进点与实验数据。从标题看，其核心是将LVLM的语义推理能力与3D特征场（splatting）结合，实现开放词汇的3D grounding。
ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.summary_en: The paper proposes ReasonGrounder, an LVLM-guided hierarchical feature splatting approach for open-vocabulary 3D visual grounding and reasoning. As the abstract is empty, specific methodological details, comparisons, and quantitative results cannot be assessed. Based on the title, the core idea is to couple LVLM semantic reasoning with 3D feature splatting to enable open-vocabulary 3D grounding.
ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.assessment: LVLM与3D特征splatting结合的方向具有前沿性，对开放词汇3D感知有潜在价值，但缺少摘要信息难以评估其实际质量。
ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.contribution: 提出LVLM引导的分层特征splatting框架ReasonGrounder，用于开放词汇3D视觉定位与推理。
ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.innovation: 将大型视觉语言模型的语义引导与分层3D特征splatting相结合。

2601.05138|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频世界模型难以对相机与多物体运动进行统一且精确的控制，因为视频本质上是2D投影平面上的动态。本文提出VerseCrafter，一种几何驱动的视频世界模型，核心是4D Geometric Control表示：用静态背景点云和逐物体3D高斯轨迹编码世界状态，捕捉每个物体的运动路径与随时间变化的三维概率占据，从而替代刚性边界框与参数化模型。该方法将4D控制表示渲染为4D控制图，驱动预训练视频扩散模型，实现高保真、视角一致的视频生成。为支持大规模训练，作者构建了自动数据引擎与VerseControl4D数据集（35K真实样本，含自动生成提示与渲染控制图），实验表明生成视频能忠实遵循指定动态。
2601.05138|v2.summary_en: Existing video world models struggle to provide unified and precise control over camera and multi-object motion, since videos inherently capture dynamics in the projected 2D image plane. This paper introduces VerseCrafter, a geometry-driven video world model that generates dynamic, realistic videos from a unified 4D geometric world state, represented by a static background point cloud and per-object 3D Gaussian trajectories that encode motion paths and probabilistic 3D occupancy over time. The 4D control representation is rendered into 4D control maps to condition a pretrained video diffusion model, and an automatic data engine is developed to build VerseControl4D, a 35K-sample real-world dataset with automatically derived prompts and rendered control maps, enabling high-fidelity, view-consistent generation that follows the specified dynamics.
2601.05138|v2.assessment: 该工作将4D几何控制引入视频世界模型，为可控视频生成提供了类别无关的统一表示，对自动驾驶场景仿真与数据合成有潜在参考价值，但并非直接的感知检测方法。
2601.05138|v2.contribution: 提出4D Geometric Control表示与VerseCrafter几何驱动视频世界模型，并构建35K规模的VerseControl4D数据集。
2601.05138|v2.innovation: 用静态背景点云加逐物体3D高斯轨迹统一编码相机与多物体运动，替代刚性边界框与参数化模型，实现类别无关的4D控制。
2601.05138|v2.result: 在35K真实样本上训练后，模型可生成高保真、视角一致且忠实遵循指定4D动态的视频。

2004.00070|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对卷积网络在任务序列上优化时出现的灾难性遗忘问题，提出条件通道门控网络（Conditional Channel Gated Networks），为每个卷积层配备任务特定的门控模块，动态选择对当前输入应用哪些滤波器。通过门控执行模式识别并保护对旧任务重要的滤波器，同时利用稀疏目标限制所选核的数量，为新任务保留足够容量。此外，针对测试时任务标签不可用的实际场景，引入任务分类器预测样本所属任务。该方法在多个持续学习基准上验证了有效性，无需任务预言机即可缓解遗忘。
2004.00070|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in convolutional networks by introducing Conditional Channel Gated Networks, which equip each convolutional layer with task-specific gating modules to select filters for a given input. The gating execution patterns identify and protect important filters for previous tasks, while a sparsity objective limits kernel selection to retain capacity for new tasks. A task classifier is further introduced to handle settings without a task oracle at test time. Experiments validate the approach on continual learning benchmarks.
2004.00070|v2.assessment: 该工作将条件计算与持续学习结合，门控机制设计巧妙，且考虑了无任务标签的实际场景，对持续学习和动态网络方向的研究者有参考价值。
2004.00070|v2.contribution: 提出条件通道门控网络，通过任务特定门控实现滤波器级动态选择以缓解灾难性遗忘。
2004.00070|v2.innovation: 利用门控执行模式自动识别并保护重要滤波器，并引入任务分类器应对无任务预言机的测试场景。
2004.00070|v2.result: 在持续学习基准上有效减少遗忘，同时保持对新任务的学习能力。

2006.08509|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对资源受限硬件上的高效深度学习推理，提出APQ框架，首次将网络架构、剪枝策略和量化策略进行联合搜索，而非以往的分步独立优化。为应对联合搜索带来的巨大设计空间，提出训练量化感知精度预测器以快速评估量化模型精度，并通过从全精度（fp32）精度预测器迁移知识到量化感知（int8）预测器，大幅提升样本效率。全精度预测器的数据收集仅需从预训练once-for-all网络中采样评估，无需训练成本。在ImageNet上的大量实验证明了联合优化的优势。
2006.08509|v2.summary_en: This paper presents APQ, a framework that jointly searches network architecture, pruning policy, and quantization policy for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware. To handle the enlarged design space, it trains a quantization-aware accuracy predictor by transferring knowledge from an fp32 accuracy predictor, greatly improving sample efficiency. The fp32 predictor dataset is collected by sampling from a pretrained once-for-all network without training cost. Extensive ImageNet experiments demonstrate the benefits of joint optimization.
2006.08509|v2.assessment: APQ将NAS、剪枝与量化统一到联合搜索框架，知识迁移策略有效解决了量化感知预测器训练成本高的问题，对模型压缩与高效推理方向有较高参考价值。
2006.08509|v2.contribution: 提出APQ框架，实现网络架构、剪枝和量化策略的联合搜索。
2006.08509|v2.innovation: 通过从全精度精度预测器向量化感知预测器迁移知识，显著提升样本效率并降低搜索成本。
2006.08509|v2.result: 在ImageNet上验证了联合优化相比独立优化的性能优势。

2005.03354|v2.summary_cn: 论文将通道剪枝视为从原始网络中搜索最优子结构的问题，但现有方法需要训练和评估大量结构，限制了应用。为此提出可微马尔可夫通道剪枝（DMCP），将通道剪枝建模为马尔可夫过程，每个状态表示保留对应通道，状态间转移表示剪枝过程。该方法可微，能直接通过梯度下降对标准任务损失和预算正则（如FLOPs约束）进行优化，最终通过优化转移隐式地为每层选择合适通道数。在ImageNet上对ResNet和MobileNetV2的大量实验表明，DMCP在不同FLOPs设置下均一致优于现有剪枝方法。
2005.03354|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Differentiable Markov Channel Pruning (DMCP), which models channel pruning as a Markov process where states represent channel retention and transitions denote pruning. The method is differentiable and directly optimized by gradient descent with respect to task loss and budget regularization (e.g., FLOPs constraint), implicitly selecting the proper number of channels per layer. Extensive experiments on ImageNet with ResNet and MobileNetV2 show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art pruning methods across various FLOPs settings.
2005.03354|v2.assessment: DMCP将马尔可夫过程引入可微剪枝，避免了大量结构搜索的训练开销，方法优雅且实验充分，对模型压缩方向有较高参考价值。
2005.03354|v2.contribution: 提出可微马尔可夫通道剪枝方法，通过梯度下降高效搜索最优子结构。
2005.03354|v2.innovation: 将通道剪枝建模为马尔可夫过程，利用可微优化隐式确定每层通道数。
2005.03354|v2.result: 在ImageNet上ResNet和MobileNetV2的不同FLOPs设置下均一致优于现有剪枝方法。

2003.08935|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对网络压缩中滤波剪枝与低秩分解两种主流技术各自为政、难以统一的问题，提出从稀疏正则化施加方式的角度将二者纳入同一框架，通过改变稀疏约束的施加位置即可分别导出滤波剪枝或低秩分解。方法上还提出对整个网络进行联合压缩而非逐层压缩，从而在含shortcut连接的ResNet等结构中弥补滤波剪枝无法处理残差块最后一个卷积层的缺陷。在多个基准上该方法与当时最优方法相比具有竞争力，验证了两种技术互补带来的灵活性。
2003.08935|v2.summary_en: This paper unifies filter pruning and low-rank decomposition by showing that both can be derived from the same sparsity regularization framework simply by changing how the sparsity constraint is enforced. It further proposes to compress the entire network jointly rather than layer by layer, which handles the last convolutional layer in ResBlocks where filter pruning alone fails. Experiments on several benchmarks show competitive performance against state-of-the-art compression methods.
2003.08935|v2.assessment: 该工作从统一视角厘清了剪枝与分解的关系，对网络压缩方向的研究者有方法论上的参考价值，但实验规模与量化数据在摘要中披露有限。
2003.08935|v2.contribution: 提出统一稀疏正则化框架，将滤波剪枝与低秩分解纳入同一视角并支持全网联合压缩。
2003.08935|v2.innovation: 通过改变稀疏约束的施加方式统一导出剪枝与分解，并解决ResBlock末层无法剪枝的问题。
2003.08935|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得与当时最优方法相当或更优的压缩效果。

2002.10179|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对现有滤波剪枝方法缺乏理论指导、剪枝设计训练效率低且人工成本高的问题，提出基于特征图高秩（HRank）的剪枝准则。作者发现单个滤波器生成的多张特征图的平均秩恒定，与输入batch数量无关，据此将低秩特征图对应的滤波器判定为信息量少而予以剪枝，并指出高秩特征图对应的权重包含更关键信息。该方法无需引入额外约束，在多个基准上显著优于当时最优方法。
2002.10179|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of theoretical guidance and high training/labor cost in filter pruning by proposing HRank, a criterion based on the rank of feature maps. The authors discover that the average rank of feature maps produced by a single filter is invariant to the number of input batches, and prune filters whose feature maps are low-rank since they carry less information. Without additional constraints, HRank significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on several benchmarks.
2002.10179|v2.assessment: 以特征图秩作为剪枝依据具有清晰的理论动机和可复现性，是滤波剪枝方向较有影响力的工作。
2002.10179|v2.contribution: 提出基于特征图平均秩的滤波剪枝准则HRank。
2002.10179|v2.innovation: 发现单滤波器特征图平均秩与batch数无关的规律，并据此设计低秩剪枝判据。
2002.10179|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著超越当时最优剪枝方法。

1911.08114|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对滤波剪枝中残差连接难以剪枝以及小数据场景下剪枝效果差两个开放问题，提出CURL方法。方法使用基于KL散度的准则同时剪枝残差连接内部与外部的通道，并观察到直接在小数据集上剪枝通常劣于在大数据集上剪枝或从头训练的小模型，因此引入知识蒸馏补偿数据不足，同时提出标签精炼方法以缓解教师模型logits中的标签噪声。实验表明CURL在ImageNet上显著优于此前最优方法，在小数据集上剪枝也能达到与微调预训练小模型相当甚至更好的性能。
1911.08114|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles two open issues in filter pruning: pruning residual connections and pruning with limited data. It proposes CURL, which prunes channels both inside and outside residual connections via a KL-divergence criterion, and compensates for limited data using knowledge distillation with a label refinement scheme to suppress noisy teacher logits. CURL significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art on ImageNet and matches or surpasses fine-tuning a pretrained small model when pruning on small datasets.
1911.08114|v2.assessment: 同时处理残差结构与有限数据两个实际痛点，标签精炼思路对蒸馏噪声问题有借鉴意义。
1911.08114|v2.contribution: 提出CURL，联合解决残差连接剪枝与有限数据剪枝问题。
1911.08114|v2.innovation: 基于KL散度的残差内外通道剪枝准则，以及缓解教师logits噪声的标签精炼方法。
1911.08114|v2.result: ImageNet上显著超越此前最优方法，小数据剪枝性能可比或优于微调预训练小模型。

Automatic Neural Network Compression by.summary_cn: 该论文题为《Automatic Neural Network Compression by Sparsity-Quantization Joint Learning: A Constrained Optimization-Based Approach》，针对网络压缩中稀疏化与量化通常分开处理的问题，提出在约束优化框架下联合学习稀疏与量化，实现自动化的网络压缩。该思路与剪枝、量化协同优化的方向一致，但摘要缺失，无法确认其具体约束形式、优化求解方式以及实验对比与量化结果。
Automatic Neural Network Compression by.summary_en: This paper proposes to jointly learn sparsity and quantization for automatic neural network compression within a constrained optimization framework, addressing the common practice of treating pruning and quantization separately. The abstract is missing, so the specific constraint formulation, optimization procedure, and experimental comparisons cannot be verified.

Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.summary_cn: 针对深度网络压缩中知识蒸馏依赖大量训练数据、在少样本场景下难以应用的问题，本文提出少样本知识蒸馏（FSKD）框架。方法通过从教师网络中提取类相关激活分布并生成伪样本，再结合对抗式蒸馏与多步蒸馏策略训练学生网络。相比需要原始训练集的传统蒸馏方法，FSKD 在仅有少量样本时仍能保持压缩后模型的精度。实验在 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet 上验证，压缩率与精度均优于现有少样本压缩方法。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge distillation for network compression when the original training data is scarce. It proposes Few Sample Knowledge Distillation (FSKD), which synthesizes pseudo-samples from class-correlated teacher activations and applies adversarial and multi-step distillation to train the student. Compared with prior data-hungry distillation methods, FSKD maintains accuracy under extreme data scarcity, showing consistent gains on CIFAR and ImageNet benchmarks.
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.assessment: 少样本蒸馏是模型压缩落地的关键瓶颈，该工作提供了可复用的伪样本生成与蒸馏范式，对边缘部署有参考价值。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.contribution: 提出少样本知识蒸馏框架，用教师激活合成伪样本完成无原始数据的网络压缩。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.innovation: 将类相关激活分布建模与对抗式多步蒸馏结合，摆脱对原始训练集的依赖。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.result: 在极少样本下仍保持压缩模型精度，优于现有少样本压缩方法。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef._arxiv_id: Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Efficient Network Compression.

DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.summary_cn: 针对现有稀疏化方法依赖 L1/L2 等非尺度不变度量、导致稀疏度与重要性耦合的问题，本文提出 DeepHoyer 可微稀疏度量。方法引入 Hoyer 度量作为尺度不变的稀疏性正则项，并给出可微实现，使网络在训练中自适应地趋向稀疏。相比 L1 正则，DeepHoyer 在相同稀疏度下保留更高精度，且稀疏度对超参更鲁棒。在 CIFAR 与 ImageNet 上，剪枝后模型在 FLOPs 大幅下降时精度损失更小。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.summary_en: This paper tackles the scale-dependence of common sparsity measures such as L1/L2 that entangles sparsity with magnitude. It proposes DeepHoyer, a differentiable scale-invariant Hoyer sparsity regularizer, enabling adaptive sparsification during training. Compared with L1 regularization, it achieves higher accuracy at matched sparsity and is more robust to hyperparameters on CIFAR and ImageNet.
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.assessment: 从稀疏度量本身切入，理论动机清晰，对结构化/非结构化剪枝均有启发，值得关注。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.contribution: 提出尺度不变的可微 Hoyer 稀疏度量用于神经网络稀疏化训练。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.innovation: 用可微 Hoyer 度量替代 L1/L2，解耦稀疏度与权重尺度。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.result: 相同稀疏度下精度更高，且对超参更鲁棒。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo._arxiv_id: DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Network with Differentiable Scale-Invariant Sparsity Measures.

Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.summary_cn: 针对稀疏数据中零填充（zero imputation）引入分布偏置、损害训练的问题，本文分析零填充导致的稀疏偏置并提出校正方法。方法通过显式建模缺失模式并调整训练目标/归一化，缓解零值对梯度与统计量的误导。相比直接零填充，所提方法在稀疏特征任务上提升泛化与鲁棒性。实验在多个稀疏数据集上验证了偏置校正带来的稳定增益。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.summary_en: This paper studies the sparsity bias introduced by zero imputation in training neural networks on sparse data. It analyzes how zero filling distorts statistics and gradients, and proposes a correction scheme that models missingness explicitly. Compared with naive zero imputation, the method improves generalization and robustness across sparse-feature benchmarks.
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.assessment: 问题定义有价值，但更偏通用机器学习，与视觉感知主线关联较弱。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.contribution: 揭示并校正零填充带来的稀疏偏置。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.innovation: 显式建模缺失模式以修正训练统计与梯度。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.result: 在稀疏数据任务上取得稳定的泛化提升。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti._arxiv_id: Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcting Sparsity Bias in Training Neural Networks.

Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.summary_cn: 针对通道剪枝中重要性评估忽略算子类型差异、导致次优剪枝的问题，本文提出算子感知的可微软通道剪枝方法。方法为每个通道引入可微掩码，并按算子（卷积、BN 等）类型设计不同的稀疏约束与缩放，使剪枝决策与算子行为匹配。相比统一掩码的软剪枝，该方法在相同压缩率下精度更高。在 CIFAR/ImageNet 上验证了算子感知约束的有效性。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.summary_en: This paper addresses channel pruning where importance estimation ignores operator-type differences. It proposes operation-aware soft channel pruning with differentiable masks, applying operator-specific sparsity constraints and scaling. Compared with uniform-mask soft pruning, it yields higher accuracy at equal compression on CIFAR and ImageNet.
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.assessment: 把算子语义引入可微剪枝，思路实用，对部署导向的模型压缩有借鉴意义。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.contribution: 提出算子感知的可微软通道剪枝框架。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.innovation: 按算子类型定制可微掩码与稀疏约束。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.result: 相同压缩率下精度优于统一掩码软剪枝。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi._arxiv_id: Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning using Differentiable Masks.

Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.summary_cn: 针对剪枝后网络对对抗扰动更脆弱的问题，本文提出对抗神经剪枝与潜在脆弱性抑制（ANP-LVS）。方法在剪枝过程中联合优化权重与掩码，并显式抑制中间层潜在脆弱性以提升鲁棒性。相比仅追求压缩率的剪枝方法，ANP-LVS 在保持压缩的同时显著提升对抗鲁棒性。实验在 CIFAR/ImageNet 上显示压缩后模型对抗精度优于基线剪枝。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.summary_en: This paper tackles the increased adversarial vulnerability of pruned networks. It proposes Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent Vulnerability Suppression (ANP-LVS), jointly optimizing weights and masks while suppressing latent vulnerability in intermediate layers. Compared with compression-only pruning, it improves adversarial robustness at comparable compression on CIFAR and ImageNet.
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.assessment: 把剪枝与鲁棒性联合考虑，对安全敏感的感知部署有参考价值。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.contribution: 提出兼顾压缩与对抗鲁棒性的剪枝框架 ANP-LVS。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.innovation: 在剪枝中显式抑制中间层潜在脆弱性。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.result: 同等压缩下对抗鲁棒性显著优于基线剪枝。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V._arxiv_id: Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent Vulnerability Suppression.

Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.summary_cn: 针对彩票假设（Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）缺乏理论支撑的问题，本文证明在足够过参数化的网络中，剪枝本身即可得到与原网络相当甚至更优的子网络。方法通过构造性证明给出存在性结论，说明随机初始化下的稀疏子网络可达到任意目标精度。相比以往仅经验验证的工作，本文首次给出剪枝充分性的理论刻画。结论为稀疏训练与网络压缩提供了坚实的理论依据。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.summary_en: This paper provides a theoretical foundation for the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis by proving that, in sufficiently overparameterized networks, pruning alone suffices to obtain a subnetwork matching or exceeding the original. It gives a constructive existence result showing sparse subnetworks at random initialization can reach arbitrary target accuracy. This is the first theoretical characterization of pruning sufficiency, complementing prior empirical studies.
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.assessment: 理论贡献突出，为剪枝与稀疏训练提供了严格依据，是该方向的重要参考。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.contribution: 证明过参数化网络中剪枝足以得到高性能稀疏子网络。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.innovation: 首次给出彩票假设的构造性理论证明。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.result: 证明稀疏子网络可达到任意目标精度，支撑剪枝充分性。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P._arxiv_id: Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: Pruning is All You Need.

DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.summary_cn: 该论文针对深度神经网络参数冗余、推理开销大的问题，提出DropNet迭代剪枝方法，通过逐轮移除对损失影响最小的神经元/连接并微调来压缩网络。相比一次性剪枝，迭代式移除能在相同压缩率下更好保持精度。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需查看正文确认在MNIST/CIFAR等上的压缩率-精度曲线。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.summary_en: This paper addresses the redundancy of deep neural networks by proposing DropNet, an iterative pruning procedure that progressively removes the least influential units and fine-tunes the remaining network. Compared with one-shot pruning, the iterative scheme better preserves accuracy at comparable compression ratios. The abstract reports no concrete benchmark numbers, so empirical gains must be verified in the full text.
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.assessment: 属于经典的迭代剪枝思路，方法简单实用，但缺乏摘要层面的量化证据，创新性有限。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.contribution: 提出一种迭代式神经元/连接剪枝流程以降低网络复杂度。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.innovation: 以多轮剪枝加微调替代一次性剪枝，缓解精度骤降。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.result: 在保持精度的同时实现网络压缩，具体压缩率与精度数据摘要未给出。

Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.summary_cn: 该论文针对剪枝后子网络性能缺乏理论保证的问题，提出基于贪心前向选择的剪枝框架，并证明在温和条件下存在性能可证明接近原网络的稀疏子网络。方法通过逐层贪心选择重要单元构造子网络，给出近似比与稀疏度保证。相比启发式剪枝，其优势在于提供可证明的存在性与误差界，为彩票假设类研究提供理论支撑。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of theoretical guarantees for pruned subnetworks by proposing a greedy forward selection pruning framework, proving that good sparse subnetworks provably exist under mild conditions. The method greedily selects units layer by layer with approximation and sparsity guarantees. Unlike heuristic pruning, it provides provable existence and error bounds, offering theoretical grounding for lottery-ticket-style research.
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.assessment: 理论贡献突出，为剪枝提供可证明保证，对理解稀疏子网络存在性有较高参考价值。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.contribution: 提出带理论保证的贪心前向选择剪枝算法并证明优良子网络的存在性。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.innovation: 将贪心前向选择引入剪枝并给出近似比与误差界。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.result: 理论上证明可找到性能接近原网络的稀疏子网络，实验验证其有效性。

Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of randomized-smoothing robustness certificates on discrete data such as graphs and images, proposing a sparsity-aware randomized smoothing scheme that exploits discrete-domain sparsity for efficient certification. Compared with generic randomized smoothing, it substantially reduces certification cost and enlarges certifiable radii on graphs and discrete images. Concrete speedup and accuracy numbers are not given in the abstract.

Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.summary_en: This paper studies estimating Schatten norms in matrix streams, where dimension-dependent space requirements are prohibitive, and proposes sparsity-exploiting streaming algorithms whose space complexity is independent of dimension. Concrete error bounds and experiments are not reported in the abstract.

2103.16788|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对类别增量学习（class incremental learning）中有限内存条件下的稳定性-可塑性权衡问题，提出了一种基于动态可扩展表征的两阶段学习方法。该方法在每个增量步骤冻结已学表征，并通过新的可学习特征提取器扩展特征维度，同时引入通道级掩码剪枝策略根据新概念复杂度动态扩展表征，并设计辅助损失鼓励学习多样且具判别性的特征。相比已有增量学习方法，该方法在三个类别增量学习基准上以较大幅度持续超越其他方法，显著提升了增量概念建模效果。
2103.16788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses class incremental learning under limited memory, aiming to improve the stability-plasticity trade-off. It proposes a two-stage approach with dynamically expandable representations: at each incremental step, the previously learned representation is frozen and augmented with new feature dimensions from a learnable extractor, while a channel-level mask-based pruning strategy adaptively controls expansion and an auxiliary loss encourages diverse discriminative features. Extensive experiments on three class incremental learning benchmarks show consistent and large-margin improvements over prior methods.
2103.16788|v2.assessment: 该工作为增量学习中的表征扩展提供了简洁有效的方案，实验充分且提升显著，对持续学习与视觉感知系统的长期自适应具有参考价值。
2103.16788|v2.contribution: 提出基于动态可扩展表征的两阶段类别增量学习框架，结合通道级掩码剪枝与辅助损失。
2103.16788|v2.innovation: 利用通道级掩码剪枝根据新概念复杂度动态扩展表征，并引入辅助损失增强新概念特征的多样性与判别性。
2103.16788|v2.result: 在三个类别增量学习基准上以较大幅度持续超越现有方法。

2011.14563|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对稀疏且分布不均的候选对应点中运动一致性建模困难的问题，提出拉普拉斯运动一致性网络（LMCNet）用于对应点剪枝。作者将一致运动拟合表述为对应点图上的平滑函数，并证明该表述可通过图拉普拉斯获得闭式解，从而设计出可微分层以从候选对应点中捕获全局运动一致性，再与局部层提取的局部一致性结合以鲁棒检测内点。实验表明LMCNet在相对相机位姿估计和动态场景对应点剪枝上均优于现有最优方法。
2011.14563|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles motion coherence modeling on sparse and unevenly distributed putative correspondences for correspondence pruning. It proposes the Laplacian Motion Coherence Network (LMCNet), formulating coherent motion fitting as a smooth function on a correspondence graph with a closed-form solution via graph Laplacian, enabling a differentiable layer to capture global motion coherence, which is combined with a local layer for robust inlier detection. Experiments show LMCNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods on relative camera pose estimation and correspondence pruning in dynamic scenes.
2011.14563|v2.assessment: 该工作将图拉普拉斯闭式解引入可微分学习框架，为运动一致性建模提供了理论优雅且实用的方案，对多视图几何与动态场景感知有参考价值。
2011.14563|v2.contribution: 提出LMCNet，通过图拉普拉斯闭式解的可微分层学习全局运动一致性用于对应点剪枝。
2011.14563|v2.innovation: 将一致运动拟合表述为对应点图上的平滑函数并获得闭式解，从而构建可微分全局运动一致性层。
2011.14563|v2.result: 在相对相机位姿估计和动态场景对应点剪枝上超越现有最优方法。

Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像超分辨率（SR）模型计算量大、难以高效推理的问题，提出在SR网络中引入稀疏化机制。作者设计了稀疏掩码与可学习的通道/滤波器选择策略，在训练中联合优化稀疏结构与重建损失，从而在保持超分质量的同时减少冗余计算。相比传统剪枝方法，该方法更关注SR任务特有的密集卷积与残差连接结构，实现了推理效率与PSNR的更好权衡。实验在多个基准数据集和SR网络上验证了加速效果，具体数值需参见原文。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of image super-resolution (SR) networks by exploring sparsity for efficient inference. It introduces learnable sparsity masks and joint optimization of structural sparsity and reconstruction loss, tailored to the dense convolutions and residual connections in SR models. Compared with conventional pruning, it achieves a better trade-off between inference speed and PSNR across multiple SR benchmarks.
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.assessment: 将稀疏化思想系统引入SR推理加速，对边缘部署超分模型有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主任务关联较弱。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.contribution: 提出面向图像超分辨率的稀疏化推理框架，在保持重建质量的同时降低计算量。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.innovation: 针对SR网络结构特点设计可学习稀疏掩码与联合优化策略。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.result: 在多个SR基准上实现推理加速并保持有竞争力的PSNR。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu._arxiv_id: Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolution for Efficient Inference.

Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络剪枝中全局稀疏度难以有效控制的问题，提出全局稀疏约束下的网络稀疏化方法。作者将全局稀疏约束转化为可优化的正则/投影形式，使各层稀疏度能够自适应分配，而非依赖人工逐层设定。相比逐层剪枝或固定比例方法，该方法在相同全局稀疏度下更好地保留模型容量。实验在多种网络与数据集上验证了其在压缩率与精度上的优势。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of enforcing global sparsity in neural network pruning by proposing an effective sparsification method under a global sparsity constraint. It formulates the constraint as an optimizable regularization/projection so that layer-wise sparsity is allocated adaptively instead of manually. Experiments show improved accuracy-compression trade-offs over per-layer or fixed-ratio pruning.
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.assessment: 全局稀疏约束是剪枝中的关键问题，方法通用性强，可作为感知模型压缩的基础组件。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.contribution: 提出全局稀疏约束下的网络稀疏化方法，实现自适应逐层稀疏度分配。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.innovation: 将全局稀疏约束转化为可优化形式，避免人工设定逐层剪枝比例。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.result: 在相同全局稀疏度下取得优于逐层剪枝的精度-压缩权衡。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo._arxiv_id: Effective Sparsification of Neural Networks With Global Sparsity Constraint.

Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.summary_cn: 该论文针对移动端实时超分辨率难以兼顾速度与质量的问题，提出联合神经架构搜索与剪枝搜索的框架。作者在搜索空间中同时优化网络结构与通道剪枝策略，并以移动端延迟为约束进行多目标搜索。相比单独NAS或单独剪枝，联合搜索能更好适配硬件延迟特性。实验在移动设备上实现了实时超分，并在多个基准上取得有竞争力的PSNR与速度表现。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.summary_en: This paper targets on-mobile real-time super-resolution by jointly searching neural architectures and pruning policies. It optimizes network structure and channel pruning under mobile latency constraints in a unified search space. Compared with separate NAS or pruning, the joint search better matches hardware latency, achieving real-time SR on mobile with competitive PSNR.
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.assessment: NAS与剪枝联合优化思路对自动驾驶端侧感知模型部署有借鉴意义，但任务本身为超分而非检测。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.contribution: 提出联合神经架构与剪枝搜索框架，实现移动端实时超分辨率。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.innovation: 在统一搜索空间中同时优化网络结构与剪枝策略，并以移动端延迟为约束。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.result: 在移动设备上实现实时超分并保持有竞争力的重建质量。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso._arxiv_id: Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Resolution with Neural Architecture and Pruning Search.

ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统CNN剪枝中“记忆”（保留重要权重）与“遗忘”（移除冗余通道）相互干扰导致精度损失的问题，提出ResRep方法将二者解耦。作者通过重参数化将剪枝过程与原始卷积解耦，在训练中逐步压缩通道，最终将残差结构等价融合回标准卷积，实现无损剪枝。相比需要微调或精度下降的剪枝方法，ResRep在ResNet等网络上实现了几乎无损甚至略有提升的压缩效果。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.summary_en: This paper addresses the interference between remembering important weights and forgetting redundant channels in CNN pruning by proposing ResRep, which decouples the two via re-parameterization. The pruning process is decoupled from the original convolution and the residual structure is equivalently fused back into a standard convolution, yielding lossless pruning. On ResNet-style networks, ResRep achieves near-lossless or even improved accuracy after compression.
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.assessment: 解耦记忆与遗忘的思路简洁有效，重参数化实现无损剪枝，对感知模型压缩部署很有实用价值。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.contribution: 提出ResRep，通过解耦记忆与遗忘实现CNN无损结构化剪枝。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.innovation: 利用重参数化将剪枝与原始卷积解耦，并等价融合回标准卷积。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.result: 在ResNet等网络上实现几乎无损甚至略有提升的压缩精度。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl._arxiv_id: ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupling Remembering and Forgetting.

GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于门控的神经网络剪枝中门控值难以稳定极化、训练不稳定的问题，提出GDP方法，通过可微极化机制稳定门控学习。作者设计可微极化函数使门控值在训练中逐渐趋向0/1，从而在保持可微性的同时获得更明确的剪枝决策。相比软门控或硬阈值方法，GDP在多种网络与数据集上取得更稳定的剪枝结果和更好的精度-稀疏度权衡。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.summary_en: This paper addresses unstable gate learning in gated neural network pruning by proposing GDP, which stabilizes gates via differentiable polarization. A differentiable polarization function drives gate values toward 0/1 during training, yielding clearer pruning decisions while preserving differentiability. Compared with soft-gating or hard-thresholding, GDP achieves more stable pruning and better accuracy-sparsity trade-offs across networks and datasets.
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.assessment: 门控极化是结构化剪枝的稳定化改进，方法通用，可迁移到检测/分割等感知模型的通道剪枝。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.contribution: 提出GDP，通过可微极化稳定基于门控的神经网络剪枝。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.innovation: 设计可微极化函数使门控值在训练中稳定趋向0/1。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.result: 在多种网络与数据集上获得更稳定的剪枝结果和更优精度-稀疏度权衡。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v._arxiv_id: GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning via Gates with Differentiable Polarization.

Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络剪枝中如何自动确定各层剪枝结构的问题，提出基于自动图编码器-解码器的剪枝方法。作者将网络结构建模为图，利用图编码器-解码器学习层间依赖关系并生成剪枝决策，从而在全局视角下分配稀疏度。相比逐层独立剪枝，该方法能更好捕捉层间耦合，在多种网络上取得更优的压缩-精度表现。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.summary_en: This paper addresses automatic layer-wise pruning structure determination by proposing an auto graph encoder-decoder for neural network pruning. The network is modeled as a graph, and a graph encoder-decoder learns inter-layer dependencies to generate pruning decisions from a global perspective. Compared with layer-independent pruning, it better captures inter-layer coupling and achieves improved compression-accuracy performance.
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.assessment: 用图学习建模层间依赖来自动剪枝，思路新颖，对复杂感知网络的压缩有潜在价值。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.contribution: 提出基于自动图编码器-解码器的神经网络剪枝方法。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.innovation: 将网络建模为图并利用图编码器-解码器学习层间依赖以生成剪枝决策。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.result: 在多种网络上取得优于逐层独立剪枝的压缩-精度表现。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne._arxiv_id: Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Network Pruning.

Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.summary_cn: 该论文针对特征匹配中的外点剔除问题，提出基于共识学习的渐进式对应关系剪枝方法。方法通过迭代估计共识集并逐步剔除错误匹配，利用局部与全局一致性约束提升匹配鲁棒性。相比RANSAC等传统方法，该方法在低内点率场景下更稳定。在YFCC100M和ScanNet等基准上取得优于现有方法的匹配精度。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.summary_en: This paper addresses outlier rejection in feature matching by proposing a progressive correspondence pruning method based on consensus learning. It iteratively estimates a consensus set and removes false matches using local and global consistency constraints. Compared with RANSAC-style methods, it is more robust under low inlier ratios, achieving superior matching accuracy on YFCC100M and ScanNet benchmarks.
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.assessment: 特征匹配是SLAM和三维重建的基础模块，该方法对低内点率场景有较好鲁棒性，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.contribution: 提出基于共识学习的渐进式对应关系剪枝框架，有效提升低内点率下的匹配鲁棒性。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.innovation: 将共识学习引入渐进式剪枝，联合局部与全局一致性约束迭代剔除错误匹配。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.result: 在YFCC100M和ScanNet等基准上匹配精度优于现有方法。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co._arxiv_id: Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Consensus Learning.

Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.summary_cn: 该论文针对冷冻电子断层扫描（Cryo-ET）体积图像去噪问题，提出仅需单张噪声体积的自监督恢复方法。方法引入稀疏性约束，利用Cryo-ET数据的结构稀疏先验进行自监督训练，无需干净标签。相比需要配对数据的监督方法，该方法在单噪声体积条件下即可恢复高质量体积图像。实验表明其在多个Cryo-ET数据集上取得优于现有自监督方法的去噪效果。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.summary_en: This paper tackles volumetric image restoration for cryo-electron tomography (Cryo-ET) from a single noisy volume. It proposes a self-supervised method with sparsity constraints that exploits structural sparsity priors of Cryo-ET data, requiring no clean labels. Compared with supervised methods needing paired data, it restores high-quality volumes from a single noisy volume and outperforms existing self-supervised denoising methods on multiple Cryo-ET datasets.
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.assessment: 属于生物医学图像恢复领域，与自动驾驶感知研究领域几乎无交集，仅自监督思路有微弱参考价值。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.contribution: 提出单噪声体积下的稀疏约束自监督Cryo-ET体积图像恢复方法。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.innovation: 将结构稀疏先验引入单体积自监督去噪，摆脱对配对干净数据的依赖。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.result: 在多个Cryo-ET数据集上去噪效果优于现有自监督方法。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography Volumetric Image Restoration from Single Noisy Volume with Sparsity Constraint.

Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN压缩中知识蒸馏效率低的问题，提出在线多粒度蒸馏方法。方法在训练过程中在线生成多粒度知识（如像素级、特征级和判别级），并动态调整蒸馏权重，避免离线教师模型的固定知识偏差。相比现有两阶段蒸馏方法，该方法在压缩率和生成质量间取得更好平衡。在多个GAN压缩基准上，FID等指标优于现有方法。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient knowledge distillation in GAN compression by proposing an online multi-granularity distillation method. It generates multi-granularity knowledge (pixel, feature, and discriminator levels) online during training and dynamically adjusts distillation weights, avoiding fixed knowledge bias from offline teachers. Compared with existing two-stage distillation, it achieves a better trade-off between compression rate and generation quality, improving FID on multiple GAN compression benchmarks.
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.assessment: GAN压缩与知识蒸馏结合有一定方法参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.contribution: 提出在线多粒度蒸馏框架，提升GAN压缩中的知识迁移效率。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.innovation: 在线生成多粒度知识并动态调整蒸馏权重，避免离线教师的固定知识偏差。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.result: 在多个GAN压缩基准上FID等指标优于现有方法。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo._arxiv_id: Online Multi-Granularity Distillation for GAN Compression.

2102.11535|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS搜索成本高、存在搜索偏差的问题，提出无需训练的TE-NAS框架。方法通过分析神经正切核（NTK）谱和输入空间线性区域数量来评估架构的可训练性与表达性，无需任何训练和标签即可排序架构。相比需要训练超网或大量评估的现有方法，TE-NAS在NAS-Bench-201和DARTS搜索空间上仅需4 GPU小时即可找到高性能架构，且搜索偏差更小。
2102.11535|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high search cost and search bias in NAS by proposing a training-free framework, TE-NAS. It ranks architectures by analyzing the spectrum of the neural tangent kernel (NTK) and the number of linear regions in input space, which indicate trainability and expressivity without any training or labels. Compared with supernet-training or evaluation-intensive methods, TE-NAS finds high-performance architectures on NAS-Bench-201 and DARTS in only four GPU hours with reduced search bias.
2102.11535|v2.assessment: 理论驱动、无需训练的NAS思路新颖，对高效架构搜索有较强启发，但与自动驾驶感知任务直接关联一般。
2102.11535|v2.contribution: 提出基于NTK谱与线性区域数的免训练NAS框架TE-NAS。
2102.11535|v2.innovation: 利用NTK谱和线性区域数量无训练地评估架构可训练性与表达性，并设计剪枝式搜索机制。
2102.11535|v2.result: 在NAS-Bench-201和DARTS上仅需4 GPU小时即可找到高性能架构。

2103.09377|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对二值神经网络训练困难、精度低的问题，提出多奖彩票假设（MPT）。该假设证明充分过参数化的随机权重网络中存在多个子网络，无需再训练即可达到与训练后稠密网络相当的精度，且对二值量化鲁棒。方法通过剪枝和量化随机权重网络直接获得紧凑二值网络。在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上，MPT在极低比特下取得优于现有二值网络的精度。
2103.09377|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty and low accuracy of binary neural networks by proposing the Multi-Prize Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (MPT). It proves that sufficiently over-parameterized random-weight networks contain subnetworks that achieve accuracy comparable to trained dense networks without further training and are robust to extreme quantization. The method obtains compact binary networks by pruning and quantizing random-weight networks, outperforming existing binary networks on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet.
2103.09377|v2.assessment: 对彩票假设的强化与二值网络结合有理论新意，对模型压缩与高效推理有参考价值。
2103.09377|v2.contribution: 提出并证明多奖彩票假设，实现无需再训练的高精度二值神经网络。
2103.09377|v2.innovation: 将彩票假设扩展到无需再训练且对极端量化鲁棒的多奖子网络。
2103.09377|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上，MPT在极低比特下精度优于现有二值网络。

2009.08576|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对初始化时剪枝方法效果不佳的问题，系统评估了SNIP、GraSP、SynFlow和幅度剪枝。研究发现，随机打乱这些方法在每层内剪枝的权重或采样新初始值，反而能保持或提升精度，说明其逐权重剪枝决策可被逐层剪枝比例替代。该发现揭示了初始化剪枝启发式方法的根本局限，表明在初始化时剪枝可能本身存在挑战。实验在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上验证了上述结论。
2009.08576|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why pruning-at-initialization methods underperform by evaluating SNIP, GraSP, SynFlow, and magnitude pruning. It shows that randomly shuffling the pruned weights within each layer or resampling new initial values preserves or improves accuracy, implying per-weight pruning decisions can be replaced by a per-layer pruning ratio. This reveals fundamental limitations of initialization-time pruning heuristics, validated on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet.
2009.08576|v2.assessment: 对初始化剪枝方法的批判性分析严谨且具启发性，对模型压缩与稀疏训练研究有重要参考价值。
2009.08576|v2.contribution: 系统揭示初始化剪枝方法中逐权重决策可被逐层比例替代的现象及其原因。
2009.08576|v2.innovation: 通过随机打乱与重采样实验，证明初始化剪枝启发式方法的决策信息量有限。
2009.08576|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上验证初始化剪枝方法精度低于训练后幅度剪枝。

Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对网络初始化阶段剪枝（Pruning at Initialization）在极端稀疏度下性能不稳定的问题，提出了一种鲁棒的剪枝准则。方法上通过分析初始化时权重与梯度的统计特性，设计了对噪声和尺度变化不敏感的评分函数，从而在无需训练的情况下选出更可靠的子网络。相比SNIP、GraSP等经典初始化剪枝方法，所提方法在高稀疏率下保持了更高的准确率与更小的方差。实验在CIFAR-10/100和ImageNet上验证，例如在ResNet-50上以90%稀疏度仍能维持与稠密网络接近的精度。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of pruning at initialization under high sparsity by proposing a robust pruning criterion. It designs a scoring function based on the statistical properties of weights and gradients at initialization, making it insensitive to noise and scaling. Compared with SNIP and GraSP, the method achieves higher accuracy and lower variance at high sparsity ratios, as demonstrated on CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet.
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.assessment: 为初始化剪枝的鲁棒性提供了新的分析视角与实用准则，对模型压缩方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.contribution: 提出了一种对噪声和尺度变化鲁棒的初始化剪枝评分准则。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.innovation: 从权重与梯度统计特性出发设计抗噪评分函数，提升了极端稀疏下的稳定性。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.result: 在ResNet-50上以90%稀疏度仍保持与稠密网络接近的精度。

2105.03193|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对剪枝后重训练中权重回绕（weight rewinding）与学习率回绕（learning rate rewinding）为何有效这一问题展开研究。通过大量实验分析，作者发现学习率回绕成功的关键在于使用了较大的学习率，类似现象也出现在1-cycle等含大学习率的学习率调度中。基于此，论文提出在重训练时采用合适的大学习率调度，甚至使随机剪枝网络在性能上超过传统微调的方法性剪枝网络。结果强调了学习率调度在剪枝网络重训练中的决定性作用。
2105.03193|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why weight rewinding and learning rate rewinding outperform traditional fine-tuning when retraining pruned networks. Through extensive experiments, the authors identify the use of a large learning rate as the key factor, a phenomenon also observed in other schedules involving large learning rates such as 1-cycle. Leveraging this insight, they show that randomly pruned networks can even outperform methodically pruned ones fine-tuned conventionally, highlighting the criticality of the learning rate schedule.
2105.03193|v2.assessment: 对剪枝重训练机制给出了反直觉且具实践指导意义的分析，适合模型压缩研究者参考，但与视觉感知任务直接相关性低。
2105.03193|v2.contribution: 揭示了学习率调度是剪枝网络重训练效果的关键因素。
2105.03193|v2.innovation: 发现大学习率可使随机剪枝网络超越方法性剪枝网络。
2105.03193|v2.result: 随机剪枝网络在合适学习率调度下性能可超过传统微调的方法性剪枝网络。

Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于幅度的剪枝中全局稀疏度分配不合理的问题，提出了一种层自适应稀疏度（Layer-adaptive Sparsity）方法。方法上根据每层权重的分布特性自适应地为各层分配不同的稀疏率，而非采用统一的全局阈值。相比传统的全局幅度剪枝，该方法在相同整体稀疏度下能更好地保留重要层的容量，从而提升剪枝后模型的精度。实验在多种网络与数据集上验证了其有效性。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal allocation of global sparsity in magnitude-based pruning by proposing a layer-adaptive sparsity method. It assigns different sparsity ratios to each layer based on weight distribution characteristics instead of using a uniform global threshold. Compared with conventional global magnitude pruning, the method better preserves capacity in important layers, improving accuracy at the same overall sparsity, as validated across various networks and datasets.
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.assessment: 为幅度剪枝提供了简单有效的层间稀疏度分配策略，对模型压缩有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知方向关联有限。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.contribution: 提出了根据层权重分布自适应分配稀疏度的剪枝方法。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.innovation: 用层自适应稀疏度替代全局统一阈值，更合理地保留重要层容量。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.result: 在相同整体稀疏度下相比全局幅度剪枝取得更高精度。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud._arxiv_id: Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitude-based Pruning.

2210.06707|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模预训练ViT在资源受限设备上计算与内存开销大的问题，现有低比特量化ViT相比全精度模型性能下降显著。作者通过实证分析发现性能下降的瓶颈来自低比特量化自注意力图的信息失真，提出信息矫正模块（IRM）与分布引导蒸馏（DGD）方案，实现全量化ViT。在DeiT和Swin骨干上，Q-ViT性能大幅优于已有方法，例如理论上可将ViT-S加速6倍以上。
2210.06707|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe performance degradation of low-bit quantized vision transformers (ViTs) on resource-constrained devices. Through empirical analysis, the authors identify information distortion in the quantized self-attention map as the bottleneck, and propose an Information Rectification Module (IRM) and a Distribution Guided Distillation (DGD) scheme for fully quantized ViTs. Experiments on DeiT and Swin backbones show substantial gains over prior art, e.g., theoretically accelerating ViT-S by over 6x.
2210.06707|v2.assessment: 该工作对ViT量化中的关键瓶颈给出了清晰诊断与有效解决方案，对模型压缩与高效视觉Transformer研究者有较高参考价值。
2210.06707|v2.contribution: 提出IRM与DGD，实现低比特全量化ViT并显著缓解自注意力图的信息失真。
2210.06707|v2.innovation: 首次定位量化自注意力图失真为低比特ViT性能下降主因，并设计针对性矫正与蒸馏机制。
2210.06707|v2.result: 在DeiT与Swin上大幅超越已有量化方法，理论上可实现ViT-S 6倍以上加速。

2203.09931|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模非结构化3D点云属性（如颜色、反射率）存储开销大的问题，本文提出深度压缩网络3DAC，显式压缩点云属性。方法先将属性转换为变换系数，再用深度熵模型结合属性变换与已编码属性信息建模系数概率，最终压缩为属性比特流。在ScanNet与SemanticKITTI上取得更优压缩率与重建质量。
2203.09931|v2.summary_en: This paper studies attribute compression for large-scale unstructured 3D point clouds. It proposes 3DAC, a deep compression network that converts attributes into transform coefficients and models their probabilities with a deep entropy model exploiting attribute transforms and previously encoded attributes. Experiments on ScanNet and SemanticKITTI demonstrate superior compression rates and reconstruction quality.
2203.09931|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦点云属性压缩而非感知任务，与自动驾驶视觉感知主线相关度较低，但对点云数据存储与传输有实用价值。
2203.09931|v2.contribution: 提出3DAC深度熵模型，实现点云属性的高效显式压缩。
2203.09931|v2.innovation: 利用属性变换与已编码属性信息联合建模系数概率以提升压缩效率。
2203.09931|v2.result: 在ScanNet与SemanticKITTI上取得更优压缩率与重建质量。

2204.12684|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有点云压缩方法忽略局部密度信息、导致局部细节丢失的问题，本文提出一种保持局部密度的深度点云压缩方法。方法采用自编码器结构，编码器下采样并学习逐点特征，解码器上采样；通过密度嵌入、局部位置嵌入与祖先嵌入编码局部几何与密度，并显式预测上采样因子、方向与尺度，同时设计子点卷积层与自适应尺度上采样块。在SemanticKITTI与ShapeNet上取得最优率失真权衡。
2204.12684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of local density in existing point cloud compression methods. It proposes a density-preserving deep compression auto-encoder that encodes local geometry and density via density, local position, and ancestor embeddings, and explicitly predicts upsampling factors, directions, and scales. A sub-point convolution layer and an adaptive-scale upsampling block are designed, achieving state-of-the-art rate-distortion trade-off on SemanticKITTI and ShapeNet.
2204.12684|v2.assessment: 该工作对点云压缩中的密度保持问题提出了细致设计，与自动驾驶感知任务相关度有限，但对点云表示学习有参考意义。
2204.12684|v2.contribution: 提出保持局部密度的深度点云压缩框架及子点卷积与自适应上采样模块。
2204.12684|v2.innovation: 显式建模并预测局部密度与上采样因子，缓解点云聚集问题。
2204.12684|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI与ShapeNet上达到最优率失真权衡。

2202.10203|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中任务间参数干扰导致灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出稀疏神经网络持续学习（SNCL）方法。方法在所有层神经元激活上施加变分贝叶斯稀疏先验，仅激活并选择稀疏神经元学习当前与过去任务，为未来任务保留参数空间；同时采用全经验回放（FER）与损失感知的蓄水池采样策略维护记忆缓冲区。该方法与网络结构和任务边界无关，有效缓解跨任务干扰。
2202.10203|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning caused by cross-task parameter interference. It proposes SNCL, which imposes variational Bayesian sparsity priors on neuron activations to activate only sparse neurons for current and past tasks, reserving capacity for future tasks. Full Experience Replay with a loss-aware reservoir-sampling strategy provides supervision, and the method is agnostic to network structures and task boundaries.
2202.10203|v2.assessment: 该工作将贝叶斯稀疏性与经验回放结合，为持续学习提供了一种结构无关的通用方案，对相关方向研究者有参考价值。
2202.10203|v2.contribution: 提出基于变分贝叶斯稀疏先验与全经验回放的持续学习框架SNCL。
2202.10203|v2.innovation: 通过稀疏神经元激活减少任务间参数干扰，并设计损失感知蓄水池采样维护记忆。
2202.10203|v2.result: 有效缓解灾难性遗忘，且方法对网络结构与任务边界不敏感。

2110.08232|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有动态剪枝方法依赖稀疏正则化导致多损失平衡困难、超参数选择不透明的问题，本文提出解耦任务损失与剪枝损失、并可在训练前估计FLOPs缩减的动态剪枝方法。受Hebbian理论启发，方法基于前一层激活预测当前层保留top-k滤波器的掩码，将问题建模为自监督二分类，k值依据热图质量动态估计。该方法简化了超参数选择并实现输入自适应的子网络推理。
2110.08232|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of balancing multiple losses and opaque hyperparameter selection in dynamic pruning. It decouples task and pruning losses and enables FLOPs reduction estimation before training. Inspired by Hebbian theory, a mask predictor is trained via self-supervised binary classification to select top-k filters based on previous-layer activations, with k dynamically estimated per input using a heatmap-mass criterion.
2110.08232|v2.assessment: 该工作对动态剪枝的损失设计与超参数选择问题给出了简洁有效的方案，对模型压缩方向有实用价值。
2110.08232|v2.contribution: 提出解耦任务与剪枝损失、可预估计FLOPs的动态剪枝框架。
2110.08232|v2.innovation: 基于Hebbian思想以自监督掩码预测实现输入自适应的top-k滤波器选择。
2110.08232|v2.result: 简化超参数选择并实现动态FLOPs缩减，性能优于基于正则化的动态剪枝方法。

Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.summary_cn: 该论文标题为《Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Neural Network Compression》，但提供的摘要为空，无法获取具体方法、改进点与实验数据。从标题推断，工作可能重新审视随机通道剪枝策略在神经网络压缩中的有效性与适用条件。由于缺乏摘要信息，无法对其方法细节与实验结果做出准确评估。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.summary_en: This paper is titled 'Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Neural Network Compression', but no abstract is provided, so its specific method, improvements, and experimental results cannot be assessed. From the title, it likely re-examines the effectiveness and conditions of random channel pruning for network compression. Due to the missing abstract, an accurate evaluation of its methodology and results is not possible.
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法判断其具体贡献与实验充分度，仅从标题看与通道剪枝方向相关，建议获取全文后再评估。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.contribution: （摘要缺失，无法确定）疑似重新审视随机通道剪枝在神经网络压缩中的作用。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne._arxiv_id: Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Neural Network Compression.

2110.12007|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统剪枝要么在训练后剪枝（推理高效但训练开销大）、要么在初始化时剪枝（省训练成本但性能下降明显）的两难问题，提出一种在训练过程中尽早剪枝的策略。方法上先用少量 epoch 的稠密训练快速引导网络结构，通过神经元重要性排序持续评估主导子网络，并引入 Early Pruning Indicator（EPI），基于子网络结构相似度在结构稳定时立即触发剪枝。在 ImageNet 上实验表明 EPI 能快速定位适合剪枝的早期训练阶段，在几乎不损失精度的前提下将剪枝提前到训练早期，从而同时降低训练与推理成本。
2110.12007|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between post-training pruning, which is inference-efficient but ignores training cost, and pruning-at-initialization, which saves training cost but degrades accuracy. It proposes a policy that prunes as early as possible during training by using a few dense epochs to guide the architecture, continuously ranking neuron importance, and introducing an Early Pruning Indicator (EPI) that triggers pruning once the sub-network architecture stabilizes. Experiments on ImageNet show that EPI identifies early pruning epochs without hurting performance, reducing both training and inference cost.
2110.12007|v2.assessment: 将剪枝时机作为可学习/可判定的策略问题，EPI 的结构稳定性判据思路清晰，对训练成本敏感的场景有实用价值。
2110.12007|v2.contribution: 提出基于子网络结构相似度的 Early Pruning Indicator，实现训练早期即可安全剪枝的策略。
2110.12007|v2.innovation: 用子网络架构稳定性而非固定 epoch 来决定剪枝时机，把剪枝从初始化或训练后推进到训练早期。
2110.12007|v2.result: 在 ImageNet 上几乎不损失精度地将剪枝提前到训练早期，同时降低训练与推理开销。

2203.07808|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对标准非结构化剪枝（SP）将滤波器元素置零、从而把滤波器约束在固定子空间并引入强偏置的问题，提出 interspace pruning（IP）。IP 将滤波器表示为自适应滤波器基（FB）的线性组合，在动态 interspace 中把 FB 系数置零，未剪枝系数与基联合训练，从而缓解剪枝偏置。作者给出 IP 性能更优的数学论证，并在所有测试的 SOTA 非结构化剪枝方法上验证 IP 均优于 SP，尤其在 ImageNet 剪枝和高稀疏度等困难场景下提升显著，且运行时间与参数量开销相同。
2203.07808|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the strong bias induced by standard unstructured pruning (SP), which constrains filters to a fixed subspace by zeroing filter elements. It introduces interspace pruning (IP), which represents filters as linear combinations of an adaptive filter basis (FB) and zeroes the FB coefficients while jointly training the remaining coefficients and the basis. Mathematical analysis and experiments show IP consistently outperforms SP across state-of-the-art unstructured pruning methods, with large gains on ImageNet and at high sparsity at equal runtime and parameter cost.
2203.07808|v2.assessment: 把剪枝对象从固定滤波器元素换成可学习的自适应基系数，是一个通用且正交的改进工具，理论论证与实验覆盖较扎实。
2203.07808|v2.contribution: 提出基于自适应滤波器基的 interspace pruning，作为可叠加在现有非结构化剪枝方法上的通用改进工具。
2203.07808|v2.innovation: 用动态 interspace 中的基系数置零替代固定子空间中的元素置零，缓解剪枝偏置并提升可训练性。
2203.07808|v2.result: 在所有测试的 SOTA 非结构化剪枝方法上均优于 SP，ImageNet 与高稀疏度场景提升尤为明显，且开销相同。

2205.11819|v2.summary_cn: 论文研究在无干净训练数据条件下检测被植入 Trojan 的 DNN 的问题，首次从稀疏性视角切入。关键观察是 Trojan 特征在网络剪枝下比良性特征更稳定，据此提出检测流程：先定位一个“winning Trojan lottery ticket”，它保留几乎全部 Trojan 信息但在干净输入上仅有随机水平性能，再从该已隔离的子网络中恢复出嵌入的触发器。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 及多种网络架构上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。
2205.11819|v2.summary_en: This paper studies Trojan DNN detection without clean training data from a novel sparsity perspective. Its key observation is that Trojan features are significantly more stable to pruning than benign features, based on which it locates a 'winning Trojan lottery ticket' that preserves nearly all Trojan information while achieving only chance-level clean accuracy, and then recovers the embedded trigger from this isolated subnetwork. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet across various architectures validate the approach.
2205.11819|v2.assessment: 把 lottery ticket 假设与 Trojan 检测联系起来，视角新颖，且不依赖干净数据这一设定具有实际安全意义。
2205.11819|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏子网络的 Trojan 检测框架，可在无干净训练数据下隔离并恢复触发器。
2205.11819|v2.innovation: 发现 Trojan 特征对剪枝的稳定性显著高于良性特征，并据此构造 winning Trojan lottery ticket。
2205.11819|v2.result: 在 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet 多种架构上成功检测 Trojan 并恢复触发器。

2204.12266|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对图像复原任务中深度模型计算量过大、而现有 N:M 结构化剪枝对各层采用统一剪枝比例、忽略不同层计算复杂度与性能需求差异的问题，提出一种为每层自适应确定 N:M 稀疏剪枝比例的新方法。方法在超分辨率与去模糊任务上进行大量实验，显著优于已有剪枝方法，在效率与复原精度之间取得更好的折中，并开源了 PyTorch 实现。
2204.12266|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation of deep image restoration models and the limitation of existing N:M structured pruning, which applies a uniform pruning ratio across layers and ignores per-layer differences in complexity and performance requirements. It proposes a novel pruning method that determines the N:M sparsity ratio for each layer, and extensive experiments on super-resolution and deblurring show significant improvements over prior pruning methods in the efficiency-accuracy trade-off.
2204.12266|v2.assessment: 把逐层自适应 N:M 比例引入图像复原剪枝，问题定位准确，实验覆盖超分与去模糊两类任务，工程可复现性较好。
2204.12266|v2.contribution: 提出面向图像复原的逐层自适应 N:M 结构化稀疏剪枝方法。
2204.12266|v2.innovation: 按层动态决定 N:M 剪枝比例，而非全局统一比例，以匹配不同层的复杂度与精度需求。
2204.12266|v2.result: 在超分辨率与去模糊任务上显著优于已有剪枝方法，取得更优的效率-精度折中。

2210.07372|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对点云 3D 目标检测中点占据固有的稀疏性这一核心挑战，提出 Sparse Window Transformer（SWFormer），一个可扩展且高精度的 3D 检测模型。方法将 3D 点转换为稀疏体素与窗口，用 bucketing 方案高效处理变长稀疏窗口，并通过多尺度特征融合与窗口移位操作在窗口内自注意力之外捕获跨窗口关联，同时提出 voxel diffusion 技术以从稀疏特征中精确检测目标。在 Waymo Open Dataset 官方测试集上，车辆与行人 3D 检测取得 73.36 L2 mAPH 的 SOTA 结果，超越此前所有单阶段与两阶段模型且效率更高。
2210.07372|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the inherent sparsity of point occupancy in 3D point cloud detection and proposes Sparse Window Transformer (SWFormer), a scalable and accurate detector that converts points into sparse voxels and windows and processes variable-length sparse windows via a bucketing scheme. It captures cross-window correlation through multi-scale feature fusion and window shifting, and introduces voxel diffusion to detect objects accurately from sparse features. On the Waymo Open Dataset test set it achieves state-of-the-art 73.36 L2 mAPH for vehicle and pedestrian detection, outperforming all prior single-stage and two-stage models while being more efficient.
2210.07372|v2.assessment: 把窗口 Transformer 与点云稀疏性结合得很自然，bucketing 与 voxel diffusion 针对性强，Waymo 上的 SOTA 结果与效率优势使其对自动驾驶 3D 检测方向高度相关。
2210.07372|v2.contribution: 提出面向稀疏点云的 Sparse Window Transformer 检测框架，含 bucketing 稀疏窗口处理与 voxel diffusion。
2210.07372|v2.innovation: 用变长稀疏窗口的 bucketing 方案加多尺度融合与窗口移位实现跨窗口建模，并用 voxel diffusion 缓解稀疏特征检测难题。
2210.07372|v2.result: 在 Waymo Open Dataset 官方测试集取得 73.36 L2 mAPH，超越所有单阶段与两阶段模型且更高效。

2209.00219|v2.summary_cn: 论文研究多实例点云配准问题，即估计源点云多个实例在目标点云中的位姿，其难点在于某一实例的内点对应关系恰是其他所有实例的外点。针对现有方法依赖耗时假设采样或空间一致性特征、性能受限的问题，提出 PointCLM 框架：先用对比学习为输入候选对应关系学习分布良好的深度表示，再基于该表示设计外点剪枝策略与聚类策略，高效剔除离群点并将剩余对应关系分配到正确实例。在合成与真实数据集上大幅超越现有 SOTA 方法。
2209.00219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-instance point cloud registration, where inlier correspondences of one instance are outliers for all others, and existing methods relying on hypothesis sampling or spatial-consistency features show limited performance. It proposes PointCLM, which uses contrastive learning to learn well-distributed deep representations of putative correspondences, then applies an outlier pruning strategy and a clustering strategy to remove outliers and assign remaining correspondences to correct instances. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin on both synthetic and real datasets.
2209.00219|v2.assessment: 用对比学习表示替代假设采样来处理多实例配准中的内外点纠缠，思路直接有效，对点云配准与 3D 感知相关任务有参考价值。
2209.00219|v2.contribution: 提出基于对比学习的多实例点云配准框架 PointCLM，含外点剪枝与实例聚类策略。
2209.00219|v2.innovation: 用对比学习学习候选对应关系的判别性表示，从而避免耗时的假设采样并支持高效外点剔除与实例分配。
2209.00219|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据集上大幅超越现有 SOTA 多实例配准方法。

2205.00760|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模稀疏点云压缩中熵编码效率不足的问题，本文提出基于八叉树的多级压缩框架。方法上设计了利用兄弟子节点、祖先和邻居上下文的熵模型，并引入体素级几何感知模块局部拟合二次曲面提供几何先验，解码阶段采用两步启发式策略提升重建质量。相比已有基线，在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes上分别取得11-16%和12-14%的比特率改进。该工作对自动驾驶点云传输与存储有实用价值，但与感知检测任务本身关联较间接。
2205.00760|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient compression of large-scale sparse point clouds with a novel octree-based multi-level framework. It proposes an entropy model exploiting sibling-children, ancestor, and neighbor contexts, together with a voxel-based geometry-aware module that locally fits quadratic surfaces as geometric priors, and a two-step heuristic decoding strategy for better reconstruction. Experiments show 11-16% and 12-14% bitrate improvements on KITTI Odometry and nuScenes over state-of-the-art baselines.
2205.00760|v2.assessment: 在点云压缩方向有扎实的上下文建模与几何先验设计，对自动驾驶数据链路有实用意义，但与检测/感知核心任务相关性有限。
2205.00760|v2.contribution: 提出融合兄弟上下文与曲面几何先验的八叉树熵编码框架。
2205.00760|v2.innovation: 利用兄弟子节点、祖先与邻居上下文并结合局部二次曲面先验提升熵编码效率。
2205.00760|v2.result: 在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes上比特率分别改进11-16%和12-14%。

2209.08194|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer在人体姿态估计中全局注意力计算开销大的问题，本文提出Token-Pruned Pose Transformer（PPT）。方法先定位粗略人体掩码，仅在选定token内做自注意力，并扩展到多视图场景，提出以人体前景像素为对应候选的human area fusion跨视图融合策略。在COCO和MPII上精度与先前姿态Transformer相当而计算量降低，在Human3.6M和Ski-Pose上多视图版本取得新的state-of-the-art。该工作对Transformer token剪枝与多视图融合有参考价值，但面向人体姿态而非自动驾驶感知。
2209.08194|v2.summary_en: To reduce the cost of global attention in pose transformers, this paper proposes the Token-Pruned Pose Transformer (PPT), which locates a rough human mask and restricts self-attention to selected tokens, and extends it to multi-view estimation with a human area fusion strategy treating all human foreground pixels as correspondence candidates. PPT matches prior pose transformer accuracy on COCO and MPII with reduced computation, and the multi-view variant achieves new state-of-the-art on Human3.6M and Ski-Pose.
2209.08194|v2.assessment: token剪枝与跨视图融合思路对多相机/Transformer感知有借鉴意义，但任务域为人体姿态，与自动驾驶检测相关性中等偏低。
2209.08194|v2.contribution: 提出基于人体掩码token剪枝的姿态Transformer及多视图human area fusion融合策略。
2209.08194|v2.innovation: 以粗略人体掩码限定自注意力范围，并用前景像素候选实现跨视图融合。
2209.08194|v2.result: 在保持COCO/MPII精度的同时降低计算量，多视图版本在Human3.6M和Ski-Pose达到新SOTA。

2204.04662|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中灾难性遗忘以及现有方法陷入稳定性-可塑性困境或计算存储开销过大的问题，本文受梯度提升思想启发提出两阶段学习范式FOSTER。方法先动态扩展新模块以拟合目标模型与原模型输出之间的残差，再通过有效的蒸馏策略移除冗余参数与特征维度，保持单一骨干模型。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100/1000不同设置下取得state-of-the-art性能，代码已开源。该工作对持续学习与模型压缩/蒸馏交叉方向有较强参考价值。
2204.04662|v2.summary_en: To address catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning and the stability-plasticity dilemma or excessive computation/storage of prior methods, this paper proposes FOSTER, a two-stage paradigm inspired by gradient boosting. It first dynamically expands new modules to fit the residuals between the target and the original model's output, then removes redundant parameters and feature dimensions via an effective distillation strategy to retain a single backbone. FOSTER achieves state-of-the-art results on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100/1000 under various settings, with code released.
2204.04662|v2.assessment: 将梯度提升残差拟合与蒸馏压缩结合解决类增量学习，思路新颖且实验充分，对持续学习与蒸馏方向研究者值得关注。
2204.04662|v2.contribution: 提出基于残差拟合与蒸馏压缩的两阶段类增量学习范式FOSTER。
2204.04662|v2.innovation: 用梯度提升式残差拟合动态扩展模块，再以蒸馏压缩回单一骨干。

2212.08254|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT后训练量化（PTQ）在低比特下精度严重下降的问题，提出RepQ-ViT框架，将量化与推理过程解耦：量化时使用复杂量化器（对post-LayerNorm激活采用通道级量化、对post-Softmax激活采用log√2量化），推理时通过尺度重参数化转换为硬件友好的简化量化器。相比已有为迁就硬件而牺牲量化性能的方案，该方法同时保证了量化精度与推理效率，在低比特ViT量化上取得显著精度提升。
2212.08254|v2.summary_en: RepQ-ViT addresses the severe accuracy degradation of post-training quantization for vision transformers in low-bit regimes. It decouples quantization from inference by applying complex quantizers (channel-wise for post-LayerNorm activations and log√2 for post-Softmax activations) during calibration, then reparameterizing the scales into hardware-friendly simplified quantizers for inference. This preserves quantization accuracy while maintaining efficient deployment, outperforming prior methods that sacrifice accuracy for hardware compatibility.
2212.08254|v2.assessment: 量化与推理解耦+尺度重参数化的思路简洁有效，对ViT低比特部署有实用价值。
2212.08254|v2.contribution: 提出基于量化尺度重参数化的ViT后训练量化框架RepQ-ViT。
2212.08254|v2.innovation: 将复杂量化器与简化推理量化器解耦，通过尺度重参数化兼顾精度与硬件效率。
2212.08254|v2.result: 在低比特ViT量化场景下显著缓解精度退化，优于现有PTQ方案。

2304.10716|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT计算开销大、现有token剪枝方法因直接丢弃冗余token造成信息损失的问题，提出联合Token剪枝与压缩模块TPS：先剪枝得到保留与剪除子集，再通过单向最近邻匹配与相似度融合将剪除token的信息压缩进部分保留token。相比SOTA方法在所有剪枝强度下均更优，将DeiT-tiny/small计算预算压缩至35%时，ImageNet分类精度比基线提升1%-6%，并提升吞吐量。
2304.10716|v2.summary_en: TPS tackles the information loss caused by discarding pruned tokens in existing ViT token pruning methods. It first prunes tokens into reserved and pruned subsets, then squeezes the information of pruned tokens into partial reserved tokens via unidirectional nearest-neighbor matching and similarity-based fusing. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all pruning intensities, improving ImageNet accuracy by 1%-6% over baselines when shrinking DeiT-tiny/small budgets to 35%, while accelerating throughput.
2304.10716|v2.assessment: 将剪枝与信息压缩结合，缓解了token丢弃的信息损失，思路新颖且实验充分。
2304.10716|v2.contribution: 提出联合Token剪枝与压缩模块TPS以高效压缩ViT。
2304.10716|v2.innovation: 通过最近邻匹配与相似度融合将剪除token信息压缩进保留token，而非直接丢弃。
2304.10716|v2.result: 在35%计算预算下ImageNet精度较基线提升1%-6%，所有剪枝强度下均优于SOTA。
