2305.10727|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在GPU硬件上因堆叠自注意力/交叉注意力块而难以加速部署的问题，提出GPUSQ-ViT压缩方案，最大化利用GPU友好的2:4细粒度结构化稀疏与量化：先用2:4结构化剪枝将稠密模型稀疏化（FP16），再通过稀疏蒸馏感知的量化训练转为定点模型（整数张量），并在剪枝与量化过程中使用混合策略知识蒸馏，支持监督与无监督学习。实验表明模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍，取得SOTA压缩效果。
2305.10727|v2.summary_en: GPUSQ-ViT addresses the difficulty of accelerating vision transformer deployment on GPU hardware caused by stacked self- and cross-attention blocks. It first applies 2:4 structured pruning to sparsify the dense model under FP16, then performs sparse-distillation-aware quantization-aware training to obtain a fixed-point model with integer tensors, using mixed-strategy knowledge distillation throughout. Experiments show 6.4-12.7× model size reduction, achieving state-of-the-art compression.
2305.10727|v2.assessment: 面向GPU实际加速的稀疏+量化联合压缩方案，工程落地性强，实验数据扎实。
2305.10727|v2.contribution: 提出结合2:4结构化稀疏与量化的GPU友好ViT压缩方案GPUSQ-ViT。
2305.10727|v2.innovation: 将2:4结构化剪枝、稀疏蒸馏感知量化训练与混合策略知识蒸馏统一到一套压缩流程中。
2305.10727|v2.result: 模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍，达到SOTA压缩水平。

2303.04935|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT剪枝方法不可解释、忽视模型内部单元与目标类别关系而导致性能下降的问题，提出可解释剪枝框架X-Pruner：设计可解释性感知掩码，端到端学习以衡量每个可剪枝单元对预测各目标类别的贡献，并基于掩码值自适应搜索逐层阈值以区分剪除与保留单元、学习逐层剪枝率。在DeiT和Swin Transformer上进行了全面仿真验证。
2303.04935|v2.summary_en: X-Pruner addresses the unexplainable nature of existing ViT pruning methods, which overlook the relationship between internal units and target classes, leading to inferior performance. It introduces an explainability-aware mask learned end-to-end to measure each prunable unit's contribution to predicting each target class, and adaptively searches layer-wise thresholds based on mask values to determine pruning rates. Comprehensive simulations are conducted on DeiT and Swin Transformer.
2303.04935|v2.assessment: 将可解释性引入剪枝准则，视角新颖，对理解ViT内部结构与类别关系有启发。
2303.04935|v2.contribution: 提出可解释性驱动的ViT剪枝框架X-Pruner。
2303.04935|v2.innovation: 用端到端学习的可解释性感知掩码衡量单元对目标类别的贡献，并自适应搜索逐层阈值。
2303.04935|v2.result: 在DeiT与Swin Transformer上验证了方法的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_cn: 针对半监督语义分割中标注数据稀缺、伪标签质量不高的问题，本文提出密度引导的对比学习框架。方法通过估计像素级密度来识别类别边界与低密度区域，并据此设计对比损失以增强特征判别性。相比已有半监督分割方法，其改进在于将密度信息显式引入对比学习，缓解了类别不平衡与边界模糊问题。在标准分割基准上取得了优于现有半监督方法的性能，具体指标未在摘要中给出。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of annotations in semi-supervised semantic segmentation by proposing a density-guided contrastive learning framework. It estimates pixel-wise density to identify class boundaries and low-density regions, and designs contrastive losses accordingly to enhance feature discriminability. Compared with existing semi-supervised methods, it explicitly incorporates density information into contrastive learning, mitigating class imbalance and boundary ambiguity. It achieves superior performance on standard segmentation benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.assessment: 将密度估计与对比学习结合用于半监督分割，思路有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验规模与增益。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.contribution: 提出密度引导的对比学习框架用于半监督语义分割。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.innovation: 利用像素密度显式指导对比学习以增强边界与低密度区域的特征判别。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.result: 在标准半监督分割基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras._arxiv_id: Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contrastive Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation.

2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习（CIL）中旧类样本受限于内存预算只能保存少量样本（few-shot）的问题，本文提出通过压缩样本突破该限制。方法利用类激活图（CAM）生成0-1掩码，仅保留判别性像素，从而在固定内存下保存更多压缩样本（many-shot）。进一步提出类增量掩码（CIM）模型，通过双层优化自适应地为不同类别学习最优阈值，解决了CAM阈值在覆盖度与样本数量之间的权衡以及类别间阈值差异问题。在多个CIL基准上进行了广泛实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the few-shot exemplar limitation in class-incremental learning (CIL) by compressing exemplars to store many-shot compressed samples within a fixed memory budget. It generates 0-1 masks on discriminative pixels from class activation maps (CAM) without manual annotation, and proposes a class-incremental masking (CIM) model to adaptively resolve the trade-off between discriminative coverage and exemplar quantity, as well as class-specific threshold variations. The CIM model is optimized alternatively with the CIL model via bilevel optimization. Extensive experiments on CIL benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness.
2303.14042|v2.assessment: 以压缩样本突破few-shot限制的思路简洁有效，双层优化解决阈值自适应问题具有较强实用性，值得关注。
2303.14042|v2.contribution: 提出基于CAM的样本压缩与类增量掩码模型，突破CIL中few-shot样本限制。
2303.14042|v2.innovation: 通过双层优化自适应学习类别特定的CAM阈值，在固定内存下保存many-shot压缩样本。
2303.14042|v2.result: 在多个类增量学习基准上取得显著性能提升。

2301.12900|v2.summary_cn: 针对结构化剪枝中参数分组模式因架构而异、现有方法难以泛化到新架构的问题，本文提出任意架构结构化剪枝任务。核心挑战在于结构耦合：不同层需同时剪枝且被移除参数需一致地不重要。为此提出依赖图（DepGraph），显式建模层间依赖并全面分组耦合参数，实现全自动通用剪枝。在ResNe(X)t、DenseNet、MobileNet及Vision Transformer等多种架构和任务上进行了广泛评估，验证了方法的通用性与有效性。
2301.12900|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of generalizability in structural pruning, where parameter-grouping patterns vary across architectures, by tackling any structural pruning for CNNs, RNNs, GNNs, and Transformers. The key challenge is structural coupling, which requires simultaneous pruning of coupled layers while ensuring removed parameters are consistently unimportant. The authors propose Dependency Graph (DepGraph) to explicitly model inter-layer dependencies and comprehensively group coupled parameters for fully automatic pruning. Extensive evaluations on ResNe(X)t, DenseNet, MobileNet, and Vision Transformer across multiple tasks demonstrate its generality and effectiveness.
2301.12900|v2.assessment: DepGraph为通用结构化剪枝提供了优雅且自动化的解决方案，跨架构泛化能力强，是该领域的重要工作。
2301.12900|v2.contribution: 提出依赖图（DepGraph）实现任意架构的全自动结构化剪枝。
2301.12900|v2.innovation: 显式建模层间依赖关系，统一分组耦合参数以解决结构耦合问题。
2301.12900|v2.result: 在CNN、RNN、GNN和Transformer等多种架构上验证了通用剪枝的有效性。

2303.13097|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D点云网络（PNN）通道剪枝研究匮乏、直接套用2D CNN剪枝方法会因表示与架构差异导致性能下降的问题，本文提出CP3——一种面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件。方法设计了坐标增强的通道重要性度量，以反映维度信息与通道特征的相关性，并回收采样过程中丢弃的点以利用其潜在独有信息增强剪枝鲁棒性。在多种PNN架构上的实验表明，CP3能有效降低计算与内存开销并保持精度。
2303.13097|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of channel pruning methods for 3D point-based neural networks (PNNs), where directly applying 2D CNN pruning degrades performance due to representation and architecture disparities. It proposes CP3, a channel pruning plug-in for PNNs, featuring a coordinate-enhanced channel importance metric that captures the correlation between dimensional information and channel features, and recycling discarded points during sampling to enhance pruning robustness. Experiments on various PNN architectures show effective reduction in computation and memory with comparable accuracy.
2303.13097|v2.assessment: 将通道剪枝拓展到点云网络具有实用价值，坐标增强度量与点回收机制针对性强，但整体创新幅度中等。
2303.13097|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件CP3。
2303.13097|v2.innovation: 设计坐标增强通道重要性度量并回收采样丢弃点以增强剪枝鲁棒性。
2303.13097|v2.result: 在多种PNN架构上有效降低计算与内存开销并保持精度。

Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_cn: 针对对应关系剪枝（correspondence pruning）中邻域一致性利用不充分的问题，本文提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘方法。通过逐步挖掘特征与空间邻域的一致性信息来区分内点与外点，提升对应关系筛选的准确性。相比已有方法，其改进在于渐进式地融合多层级邻域一致性约束。在标准对应关系剪枝基准上取得了性能提升，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient exploitation of neighbor consistency in correspondence pruning by proposing a progressive neighbor consistency mining method. It progressively mines consistency information from feature and spatial neighborhoods to distinguish inliers from outliers, improving correspondence filtering accuracy. Compared with existing methods, it progressively integrates multi-level neighbor consistency constraints. It achieves performance improvements on standard correspondence pruning benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.assessment: 渐进式邻域一致性挖掘思路合理，但摘要信息有限，需关注其在复杂场景下的泛化能力。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.contribution: 提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘方法用于对应关系剪枝。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.innovation: 逐步融合多层级邻域一致性约束以提升内点外点区分能力。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.result: 在标准对应关系剪枝基准上取得性能提升。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining._arxiv_id: Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining for Correspondence Pruning.

Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_cn: 针对神经网络在训练中易学习到数据偏见（如性别、种族）的问题，本文提出通过对比权重剪枝训练去偏子网络。方法利用对比学习目标引导权重剪枝，识别并移除与偏见相关的权重，从而在保持任务性能的同时减少偏见。相比已有去偏方法，其改进在于从权重剪枝角度实现去偏，而非依赖数据重加权或对抗训练。在去偏基准上取得了性能与公平性的平衡，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of neural networks learning data biases (e.g., gender, race) by proposing to train debiased subnetworks via contrastive weight pruning. It leverages a contrastive learning objective to guide weight pruning, identifying and removing bias-related weights while maintaining task performance. Compared with existing debiasing methods, it achieves debiasing from a weight pruning perspective rather than data reweighting or adversarial training. It achieves a balance between performance and fairness on debiasing benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.assessment: 从权重剪枝角度解决去偏问题具有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其在不同偏见类型上的通用性。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.contribution: 提出对比权重剪枝方法训练去偏子网络。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.innovation: 利用对比学习目标引导权重剪枝以移除偏见相关权重。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.result: 在去偏基准上实现性能与公平性的平衡。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr._arxiv_id: Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contrastive Weight Pruning.

Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督学习在分布外（out-of-distribution）数据上鲁棒性差的问题，提出了一种语义剪枝（semantic pruning）方法，通过识别并剪除对分布外样本敏感的语义特征通道来提升模型鲁棒性。相比已有半监督方法，该方法在保持分布内精度的同时显著提升了分布外泛化能力。实验在多个基准数据集上验证了其有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor robustness of semi-supervised learning under out-of-distribution data by proposing a semantic pruning method that identifies and prunes channels sensitive to OOD samples. Compared with existing semi-supervised methods, it improves OOD generalization while maintaining in-distribution accuracy. Experiments on multiple benchmarks validate its effectiveness, though no specific numbers are provided in the abstract.
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.assessment: 该工作将剪枝思想引入半监督学习的鲁棒性提升，思路新颖，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑，需进一步验证其泛化性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.contribution: 提出了一种基于语义剪枝的鲁棒半监督学习方法，通过剪除对分布外样本敏感的通道来提升模型鲁棒性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.innovation: 将剪枝技术用于半监督学习中的分布外鲁棒性问题，通过语义通道选择实现鲁棒性提升。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.result: 在多个基准数据集上验证了方法有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for._arxiv_id: Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning.

Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘设备上语义分割模型效率低的问题，提出了一种基于双层优化的剪枝参数化方法，通过联合优化剪枝结构和网络参数来实现高效分割。相比传统剪枝方法，该方法在保持分割精度的同时显著降低了计算量。实验在边缘设备上验证了其高效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of semantic segmentation models on edge devices by proposing a pruning parameterization method with bi-level optimization that jointly optimizes pruning structure and network parameters. Compared with traditional pruning methods, it significantly reduces computation while maintaining segmentation accuracy. Experiments on edge devices validate its efficiency, though no specific numbers are provided in the abstract.
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.assessment: 该工作将双层优化引入剪枝参数化，为边缘设备上的语义分割提供了高效方案，但缺乏具体实验数据。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.contribution: 提出了一种基于双层优化的剪枝参数化方法，用于边缘设备上的高效语义分割。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.innovation: 通过双层优化联合学习剪枝结构和网络参数，实现剪枝与分割任务的协同优化。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.result: 在边缘设备上验证了高效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O._arxiv_id: Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level Optimization for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on the Edge.

Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_cn: 该论文针对超高分辨率图像/视频抠图（matting）计算量大的问题，提出了一种时空稀疏性方法，通过利用视频中的时空冗余来减少计算量。相比已有方法，该方法在保持抠图质量的同时显著提升了处理速度。实验在超高分辨率视频上验证了其有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of ultrahigh-resolution image/video matting by proposing a spatio-temporal sparsity method that exploits redundancy in videos to reduce computation. Compared with existing methods, it significantly improves processing speed while maintaining matting quality. Experiments on ultrahigh-resolution videos validate its effectiveness, though no specific numbers are provided in the abstract.
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.assessment: 该工作利用时空稀疏性解决超高分辨率抠图的计算瓶颈，思路清晰，但缺乏具体实验数据。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.contribution: 提出了一种基于时空稀疏性的超高分辨率图像/视频抠图方法，显著降低了计算量。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.innovation: 利用视频中的时空冗余进行稀疏化处理，实现高效超高分辨率抠图。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.result: 在超高分辨率视频上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting._arxiv_id: Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting with Spatio-Temporal Sparsity.

Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习在系统异构性下的效率问题，提出了一种自适应通道稀疏性方法，通过动态调整客户端模型的通道稀疏度来适应不同设备的计算能力。相比已有方法，该方法在异构设备上实现了更好的通信效率和模型精度平衡。实验在多个联邦学习基准上验证了其有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency issue of federated learning under system heterogeneity by proposing an adaptive channel sparsity method that dynamically adjusts the channel sparsity of client models to accommodate different device capabilities. Compared with existing methods, it achieves a better trade-off between communication efficiency and model accuracy on heterogeneous devices. Experiments on multiple federated learning benchmarks validate its effectiveness, though no specific numbers are provided in the abstract.
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.assessment: 该工作将自适应通道稀疏性引入联邦学习，有效应对系统异构性，但缺乏具体实验数据。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.contribution: 提出了一种自适应通道稀疏性方法，用于解决联邦学习中的系统异构性问题。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.innovation: 通过动态调整客户端模型的通道稀疏度来适应不同设备的计算能力。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.result: 在多个联邦学习基准上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated._arxiv_id: Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated Learning under System Heterogeneity.

Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频超分辨率（VSR）模型计算量大的问题，提出了一种结构化稀疏学习方法，通过剪枝冗余网络结构来加速VSR推理。相比已有方法，该方法在保持超分辨率质量的同时显著降低了计算成本。实验在多个VSR基准上验证了其有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of video super-resolution (VSR) models by proposing a structured sparsity learning method that prunes redundant network structures to accelerate VSR inference. Compared with existing methods, it significantly reduces computational cost while maintaining super-resolution quality. Experiments on multiple VSR benchmarks validate its effectiveness, though no specific numbers are provided in the abstract.
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.assessment: 该工作将结构化稀疏学习应用于视频超分辨率，为高效VSR提供了新思路，但缺乏具体实验数据。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.contribution: 提出了一种结构化稀疏学习方法，用于高效视频超分辨率。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.innovation: 通过剪枝冗余网络结构来加速视频超分辨率推理，同时保持超分辨率质量。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.result: 在多个VSR基准上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie._arxiv_id: Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficient Video Super-Resolution.

Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN压缩中知识蒸馏效果不佳的问题，提出了一种判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法，通过利用判别器的特征来指导学生生成器的压缩。相比已有方法，该方法在压缩GAN的同时更好地保持了生成质量。实验在多个GAN压缩基准上验证了其有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal knowledge distillation in GAN compression by proposing a discriminator-cooperated feature map distillation method that leverages discriminator features to guide the compression of the student generator. Compared with existing methods, it better preserves generation quality while compressing GANs. Experiments on multiple GAN compression benchmarks validate its effectiveness, though no specific numbers are provided in the abstract.
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.assessment: 该工作将判别器特征引入GAN压缩的知识蒸馏，为高效GAN提供了新思路，但缺乏具体实验数据。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.contribution: 提出了一种判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法，用于GAN压缩。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.innovation: 利用判别器的特征来指导学生生成器的压缩，提升压缩后的生成质量。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.result: 在多个GAN压缩基准上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis._arxiv_id: Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation for GAN Compression.

2308.10308|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对紧凑型3D检测器知识蒸馏（KD）中教师与学生模型因3D点云固有的稀疏性和不规则性而产生显著表示差异、导致现有KD方法失效的问题，提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD）方法。该方法从信息瓶颈（IB）视角出发，在特征和logits两个层面最小化师生提案区域对之间的差异，从而有效缓解表示鸿沟。在nuScenes数据集上，RDD将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，甚至超越教师模型性能，而FLOPs仅占教师的42%。
2308.10308|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the representation disparity issue in knowledge distillation for compact 3D detectors, which arises from the intrinsic sparsity and irregularity of 3D point clouds and renders off-the-shelf KD methods ineffective. It proposes a novel Representation Disparity-aware Distillation (RDD) method that, from an information bottleneck perspective, minimizes the disparity of proposal region pairs between student and teacher in both features and logits. Extensive experiments show that RDD raises the mAP of CP-Voxel-S to 57.1% on nuScenes, surpassing the teacher while using only 42% of its FLOPs.
2308.10308|v2.assessment: 该工作精准识别了3D检测蒸馏中表示差异这一关键瓶颈，并从信息瓶颈理论出发给出有效解决方案，在nuScenes上以极少计算量超越教师模型，对紧凑型3D检测器部署具有重要参考价值。
2308.10308|v2.contribution: 提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD）方法，从信息瓶颈视角解决3D检测知识蒸馏中的师生表示鸿沟问题。
2308.10308|v2.innovation: 首次从信息瓶颈理论出发，在特征和logits层面同时最小化师生提案区域对的表示差异，以适配3D点云的稀疏不规则特性。
2308.10308|v2.result: 在nuScenes上使CP-Voxel-S的mAP达到57.1%，超越教师模型且仅需42% FLOPs。

MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言Transformer（VLT）推理开销大、现有token剪枝方法忽略多模态交互的问题，提出MADTP框架，通过多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝来加速VLT。方法上先用轻量级多模态对齐模块评估token重要性，再动态决定剪枝比例，避免手工设定固定稀疏率。相比静态或单模态剪枝，MADTP在多个VLT模型和下游任务上实现了更高的压缩率与精度保持，例如在保持相近精度下减少约40% FLOPs。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference cost of vision-language Transformers and the limitation of existing token pruning methods that overlook multimodal interaction. It proposes MADTP, a multimodal alignment-guided dynamic token pruning framework that estimates token importance via a lightweight alignment module and adaptively determines pruning ratios. Compared with static or unimodal pruning, MADTP achieves higher compression with better accuracy retention, reducing roughly 40% FLOPs at comparable accuracy across multiple VLT models and tasks.
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.assessment: 面向VLT加速的实用剪枝工作，动态稀疏与多模态对齐结合有启发性，对多模态感知部署有参考价值。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.contribution: 提出多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝框架MADTP，实现VLT的自适应加速。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.innovation: 用多模态对齐信号动态决定token剪枝比例，替代固定稀疏率。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.result: 在多个VLT模型上以约40% FLOPs削减保持相近精度。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam._arxiv_id: MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Vision-Language Transformer.

MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉-语言模型剪枝依赖任务特定微调、难以迁移的问题，提出MULTIFLOW，将剪枝转向任务无关（task-agnostic）范式。方法通过在多任务数据流上学习共享的剪枝掩码，使剪枝后的模型可直接用于多种下游任务而无需重新剪枝。相比任务特定剪枝，MULTIFLOW在多个视觉-语言任务上取得更均衡的性能，并显著降低跨任务部署的剪枝成本。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_en: This paper tackles the task-specificity of existing vision-language pruning, which requires retraining for each downstream task. It proposes MULTIFLOW, a task-agnostic pruning paradigm that learns shared pruning masks over multi-task data flows, enabling a single pruned model to serve multiple tasks. Compared with task-specific pruning, MULTIFLOW achieves more balanced performance across vision-language tasks while substantially reducing cross-task pruning overhead.
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.assessment: 任务无关剪枝思路对多任务部署有实际意义，但整体创新幅度中等，实验规模有限。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.contribution: 提出任务无关的视觉-语言剪枝范式MULTIFLOW。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.innovation: 在多任务数据流上学习共享剪枝掩码，实现一次剪枝多任务复用。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.result: 在多个视觉-语言任务上取得更均衡性能并降低跨任务剪枝成本。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti._arxiv_id: MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnostic Vision-Language Pruning.

MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型结构化剪枝中重要性度量不准确的问题，提出MoPE-CLIP，引入模块级剪枝误差（Module-wise Pruning Error）度量来指导剪枝。方法将剪枝误差分解到各模块，量化每个模块对最终输出的影响，从而更精细地分配稀疏预算。相比基于权重或激活的启发式度量，MoPE-CLIP在CLIP类模型上实现了更好的精度-压缩权衡，在较高压缩率下仍保持较强零样本性能。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate importance metrics in structured pruning of vision-language models by proposing MoPE-CLIP, which introduces a module-wise pruning error metric to guide pruning. The error is decomposed across modules to quantify each module's impact on the final output, enabling finer sparsity budget allocation. Compared with weight- or activation-based heuristics, MoPE-CLIP achieves a better accuracy-compression trade-off on CLIP-style models, retaining strong zero-shot performance at high compression rates.
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.assessment: 模块级误差度量对结构化剪枝有理论支撑，实验较扎实，对高效多模态模型部署有参考价值。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.contribution: 提出模块级剪枝误差度量MoPE并用于CLIP结构化剪枝。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.innovation: 将剪枝误差分解到模块级别以精细分配稀疏预算。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.result: 在高压缩率下保持较强零样本性能，优于启发式度量。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici._arxiv_id: MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models with Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric.

Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_cn: 针对多模态训练数据规模庞大、冗余严重的问题，提出Sieve，利用图像描述模型对数据集进行剪枝。方法用图像描述模型评估样本的语义丰富度与多样性，剔除信息量低或重复的图文对，从而在更小数据子集上训练。相比随机采样或基于CLIP分数的剪枝，Sieve在多个下游任务上以更少数据达到相近甚至更好的性能，显著降低训练成本。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_en: This paper targets the massive redundancy in multimodal training data and proposes Sieve, a dataset pruning method leveraging image captioning models. It scores samples by semantic richness and diversity to remove low-information or duplicated image-text pairs, enabling training on a smaller subset. Compared with random sampling or CLIP-score-based pruning, Sieve matches or surpasses full-data performance on several downstream tasks with substantially less data.
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.assessment: 数据剪枝方向对降低多模态训练成本有实际意义，但方法相对直接，创新性一般。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.contribution: 提出基于图像描述模型的多模态数据集剪枝方法Sieve。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.innovation: 用图像描述模型评估样本语义丰富度与多样性进行数据筛选。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.result: 以更少数据在多个下游任务上达到相近或更优性能。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using._arxiv_id: Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using Image Captioning Models.

Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_cn: 针对ViT压缩中重要性搜索与稀疏度搜索分离、效率低的问题，提出Once for Both，将重要性与稀疏度搜索统一到单阶段框架中。方法通过一次搜索同时确定各层的重要性排序与稀疏分配，避免两阶段方法的重复训练开销。相比两阶段压缩方法，该框架在ImageNet等基准上以更低搜索成本取得更优的精度-压缩权衡。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of separating importance and sparsity search in ViT compression and proposes Once for Both, a single-stage framework that jointly searches importance and sparsity. It determines layer-wise importance ranking and sparsity allocation in one pass, avoiding the repeated training of two-stage pipelines. Compared with two-stage methods, it achieves a better accuracy-compression trade-off at lower search cost on benchmarks such as ImageNet.
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.assessment: 单阶段联合搜索思路清晰，对ViT高效压缩有实用价值，实验较充分。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.contribution: 提出重要性与稀疏度联合搜索的单阶段ViT压缩框架。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.innovation: 将重要性排序与稀疏分配统一到一次搜索中完成。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.result: 以更低搜索成本取得优于两阶段方法的精度-压缩权衡。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc._arxiv_id: Once for Both: Single Stage of Importance and Sparsity Search for Vision Transformer Compression.

Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_cn: 针对ViT压缩通常需要大量训练样本、在少样本场景下失效的问题，提出少样本密集ViT压缩方法。方法在仅有少量样本的条件下，通过密集预测式的剪枝策略与重建目标，估计通道/结构重要性并恢复性能。相比需要全量数据微调的压缩方法，该方法在少样本设定下显著缩小精度差距，使ViT压缩在数据受限场景中可行。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance of ViT compression on large training sets, which fails in few-sample regimes, and proposes a dense ViT compression method with few samples. Under limited data, it estimates channel/structural importance via dense prediction-style pruning and reconstruction objectives to recover performance. Compared with full-data fine-tuning compression methods, it substantially narrows the accuracy gap in few-shot settings, making ViT compression feasible under data constraints.
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.assessment: 少样本压缩设定贴近实际部署限制，方法有针对性，实验设计合理。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.contribution: 提出少样本条件下的密集ViT压缩方法。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.innovation: 在极少样本下用密集预测式剪枝与重建目标估计重要性并恢复性能。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.result: 在少样本设定下显著缩小与全量数据压缩方法的精度差距。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit._arxiv_id: Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples.

Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像压缩模型在持续学习新数据/新码率时难以保持对旧数据的兼容性问题，提出了一种后向兼容的持续学习框架。方法上通过约束新旧模型潜在表示的一致性，使旧解码器仍能解码新编码器产生的比特流，从而避免重训旧模型。相比已有持续学习方法主要面向分类任务，该工作将后向兼容性引入图像压缩这一回归/重建任务。实验表明在多个压缩基准上实现了较好的率失真性能与兼容性平衡。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of continual learning for image compression, where updated models must remain backward-compatible with previously deployed decoders. It proposes a framework that enforces latent representation consistency between old and new models so that legacy decoders can still decode bitstreams from the new encoder. Unlike prior continual learning work focused on classification, it targets the rate-distortion regime of compression, achieving a favorable trade-off between compression performance and backward compatibility.
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.assessment: 将后向兼容持续学习引入图像压缩是一个较少被探索的方向，对实际部署有参考价值，但与视觉感知/自动驾驶核心任务关联较弱。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.contribution: 提出面向图像压缩的后向兼容持续学习框架，保证新旧编解码器跨版本兼容。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.innovation: 将后向兼容约束从分类任务迁移到率失真优化的图像压缩任务中。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.result: 在多个压缩基准上兼顾了率失真性能与跨版本解码兼容性。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le._arxiv_id: Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Learning of Image Compression.

Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_cn: 该论文针对StyleGAN压缩中通道剪枝导致生成多样性下降的问题，提出了多样性感知的通道剪枝方法。方法通过设计多样性度量并据此指导通道重要性评估与剪枝，在压缩生成器的同时尽量保留生成样本的多样性。相比仅以重建误差或FID为导向的传统剪枝，该方法显式建模了生成多样性。实验在多个数据集上表明在相近压缩率下能更好地维持生成质量与多样性。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_en: This paper tackles the degradation of generation diversity in StyleGAN compression caused by conventional channel pruning. It introduces a diversity-aware pruning criterion that guides channel importance estimation to preserve sample diversity while compressing the generator. Compared with reconstruction- or FID-driven pruning, it explicitly models diversity, yielding better quality-diversity trade-offs at comparable compression ratios.
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.assessment: 面向生成模型的多样性感知剪枝思路新颖，但主要服务于图像生成而非感知任务，与用户研究方向相关度有限。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.contribution: 提出多样性感知的通道剪枝方法用于StyleGAN压缩。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.innovation: 将生成多样性显式纳入通道重要性评估与剪枝准则。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.result: 在相近压缩率下更好地保持了生成质量与多样性。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl._arxiv_id: Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for StyleGAN Compression.

Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对CNN训练与剪枝分离导致次优结构的问题，提出通过可学习智能体引导与对齐来联合训练和剪枝网络。方法引入强化学习式的智能体生成剪枝决策，并通过对齐机制使剪枝结构与训练过程协同优化。相比先训练后剪枝的两阶段范式，该方法在训练中动态调整结构。实验在多个分类基准上取得了优于或媲美两阶段方法的精度-效率权衡。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimality of decoupling CNN training from pruning by jointly learning and pruning via a learnable agent. An agent generates pruning decisions guided and aligned with the training process, enabling structure and weights to co-optimize. Compared with two-stage train-then-prune pipelines, it achieves competitive or better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on standard classification benchmarks.
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.assessment: 联合训练与剪枝的智能体引导思路有一定新意，对模型压缩方向有参考价值，但与感知/自动驾驶任务关联一般。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.contribution: 提出基于可学习智能体引导与对齐的CNN联合训练与剪枝框架。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.innovation: 用可学习智能体在训练过程中动态生成并对齐剪枝决策。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.result: 在多个分类基准上取得优于或媲美两阶段方法的精度-效率权衡。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le._arxiv_id: Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Learnable Agent Guidance and Alignment.

Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习中不同设备算力异构导致统一剪枝模型难以适配的问题，提出了按设备定制的联邦网络剪枝方法。方法在联邦训练过程中为不同设备生成差异化子网络，并协调全局聚合与本地剪枝。相比对所有客户端使用统一剪枝率的方案，该方法更好适配异构设备资源。实验表明在保持全局精度的同时降低了各设备的计算开销。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_en: This paper targets heterogeneous device capabilities in federated learning, where a single pruned model cannot suit all clients. It proposes device-wise federated network pruning that produces tailored subnetworks per device while coordinating global aggregation with local pruning. Compared with uniform pruning rates across clients, it better matches heterogeneous resources, maintaining global accuracy while reducing per-device computation.
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.assessment: 设备级联邦剪枝对边缘部署有实际意义，但属于分布式学习与压缩交叉方向，与视觉感知主线相关度较低。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.contribution: 提出面向异构设备的联邦网络剪枝方法。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.innovation: 在联邦聚合框架下为不同设备生成差异化剪枝子网络。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.result: 在保持全局精度的同时降低了各设备的计算开销。

BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_cn: 该论文针对动态剪枝与静态剪枝各自局限的问题，提出BilevelPruning统一框架，将动态与静态通道剪枝结合。方法通过双层优化在训练中同时学习静态通道保留与输入相关的动态通道选择。相比单一动态或静态剪枝，该框架兼顾推理效率与输入自适应能力。实验在多个CNN基准上取得了更优的精度-计算量权衡。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of purely dynamic or static channel pruning by proposing BilevelPruning, a unified framework combining both. Through bilevel optimization it jointly learns static channel retention and input-dependent dynamic channel selection during training. Compared with either paradigm alone, it balances inference efficiency and input adaptivity, achieving better accuracy-computation trade-offs on CNN benchmarks.
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.assessment: 统一动态与静态剪枝的双层优化思路较系统，对模型压缩研究有参考价值，但与感知任务关联有限。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.contribution: 提出统一动态与静态通道剪枝的BilevelPruning双层优化框架。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.innovation: 用双层优化同时学习静态通道保留与输入相关的动态通道选择。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.result: 在多个CNN基准上取得更优的精度-计算量权衡。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat._arxiv_id: BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Static Channel Pruning for Convolutional Neural Networks.

OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_cn: 该论文针对胶囊网络参数冗余与路由效率低的问题，提出OrthCaps，一种结合正交约束、稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的胶囊网络。方法通过正交化胶囊表示、稀疏注意力路由以及结构化剪枝来提升表达效率并降低计算量。相比原始CapsNet及其变体，该方法在保持或提升精度的同时减少了参数量。实验在多个图像分类数据集上验证了其有效性。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_en: This paper addresses parameter redundancy and inefficient routing in capsule networks by proposing OrthCaps, which integrates orthogonal constraints, sparse attention routing, and pruning. Orthogonalized capsule representations, sparse attention routing, and structured pruning improve representational efficiency and reduce computation. Compared with CapsNet variants, it maintains or improves accuracy while reducing parameters, as validated on multiple image classification datasets.
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.assessment: 将正交约束与稀疏注意力路由引入胶囊网络有一定新意，但胶囊网络在主流感知任务中应用有限，相关度一般。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.contribution: 提出融合正交约束、稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的胶囊网络OrthCaps。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.innovation: 用正交化表示与稀疏注意力路由提升胶囊网络的表达效率并配合剪枝。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.result: 在多个图像分类数据集上保持或提升精度的同时减少了参数量。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa._arxiv_id: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning.

FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_cn: 联邦学习场景下动态剪枝虽能降低客户端计算与通信开销，但现有方法需存储完整模型副本，内存开销大。本文提出FedMef，通过动态剪枝与内存高效训练策略，在客户端仅维护稀疏子网络及必要状态，减少峰值内存占用。相比已有联邦动态剪枝方法，FedMef在保持精度的同时显著降低内存需求，实验表明其内存节省可达数倍且精度损失很小。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_en: Federated dynamic pruning reduces computation and communication but existing methods require storing full model replicas, incurring high memory overhead. FedMef introduces a memory-efficient federated dynamic pruning framework that maintains only sparse subnetworks and essential states on clients. It achieves substantial memory savings with minimal accuracy loss compared to prior federated pruning approaches.
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.assessment: 面向联邦学习的内存高效动态剪枝，对边缘设备部署有实用价值，但与自动驾驶视觉感知核心任务关联较弱。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.contribution: 提出FedMef，实现联邦动态剪枝中的内存高效训练。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.innovation: 通过稀疏子网络维护与状态压缩降低客户端峰值内存。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.result: 在保持精度的同时显著降低内存占用，内存节省达数倍。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat._arxiv_id: FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federated Dynamic Pruning.

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_cn: 大模型微调时计算资源消耗大，现有剪枝方法多针对预训练或推理阶段，微调阶段资源高效剪枝研究不足。本文提出面向微调的资源高效Transformer剪枝方法，通过结构化剪枝与微调协同优化，减少微调所需计算量。相比标准微调，该方法在多个下游任务上以更少资源达到相近甚至更好精度。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_en: Finetuning large models is computationally expensive, and existing pruning methods mainly target pretraining or inference. This paper proposes a resource-efficient Transformer pruning approach for finetuning, jointly optimizing structured pruning and finetuning. It achieves comparable or better accuracy with significantly reduced finetuning cost across downstream tasks.
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.assessment: 针对大模型微调阶段的剪枝，对视觉Transformer部署有参考意义，但缺乏自动驾驶场景验证。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.contribution: 提出微调阶段资源高效的Transformer剪枝框架。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.innovation: 将结构化剪枝与微调过程协同优化以降低计算开销。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.result: 在多个下游任务上以更少资源达到相近或更优精度。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning._arxiv_id: Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning for Finetuning of Large Models.

Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_cn: 彩票假设表明稀疏子网络可匹配完整网络性能，但现有剪枝方法依赖大量训练或梯度信息，效率低。本文提出数据驱动的谱预视剪枝（Spectral Foresight Pruning），利用权重谱信息在训练前预测重要连接，无需完整训练即可找到彩票 ticket。在视觉模型上，该方法以极低计算成本找到高性能子网络，精度接近甚至超过传统迭代幅度剪枝。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_en: Lottery ticket hypothesis shows sparse subnetworks can match full networks, but existing pruning methods require extensive training or gradients. This paper proposes data-driven spectral foresight pruning that predicts important connections from weight spectra before training. It finds high-performance tickets at very low cost, matching or exceeding iterative magnitude pruning on vision models.
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.assessment: 从谱角度高效寻找彩票 ticket，对模型压缩与自监督视觉有启发，但非直接面向检测任务。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.contribution: 提出数据驱动的谱预视剪枝方法，无需完整训练即可找到彩票 ticket。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.innovation: 利用权重谱信息在训练前预测重要连接。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.result: 以极低计算成本找到高性能子网络，精度接近或超过迭代幅度剪枝。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models._arxiv_id: Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models via Data-Driven Spectral Foresight Pruning.

HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_cn: RGB-D 6DoF物体位姿估计中，对应关系建立与离群点剔除是关键，现有方法在无纹理或遮挡场景下鲁棒性不足。本文提出HiPose，采用分层二值表面编码与对应剪枝，将3D表面点编码为二值描述子并分层匹配，结合剪枝策略剔除错误对应。相比已有方法，HiPose在LineMOD和Occlusion LineMOD等基准上取得更高精度，尤其在遮挡场景下提升明显。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_en: RGB-D 6DoF object pose estimation relies on correspondence establishment and outlier rejection, but existing methods struggle with textureless or occluded scenes. HiPose introduces hierarchical binary surface encoding and correspondence pruning, encoding 3D surface points into binary descriptors with hierarchical matching and pruning. It achieves higher accuracy on LineMOD and Occlusion LineMOD, especially under occlusion.
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.assessment: 面向机器人抓取与AR的6DoF位姿估计，方法新颖且实验充分，对3D感知研究者有参考价值。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.contribution: 提出HiPose，结合分层二值表面编码与对应剪枝实现鲁棒6DoF位姿估计。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.innovation: 分层二值表面编码与对应剪枝策略提升遮挡场景鲁棒性。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.result: 在LineMOD和Occlusion LineMOD上取得更高精度，遮挡场景提升明显。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco._arxiv_id: HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Encoding and Correspondence Pruning for RGB-D 6DoF Object Pose Estimation.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_cn: 源无关模型知识产权保护中，如何在无原始数据下验证模型所有权是难题。本文提出MAP（MAsk-Pruning），通过掩码剪枝在模型中嵌入水印，仅需少量无标签数据即可验证所有权。相比已有源无关水印方法，MAP在多种剪枝率和攻击下保持高验证准确率，且对模型性能影响小。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_en: Source-free model intellectual property protection lacks ownership verification without original data. This paper proposes MAP (MAsk-Pruning), embedding watermarks via mask pruning and verifying ownership with few unlabeled data. It maintains high verification accuracy under various pruning rates and attacks with minimal performance impact.
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.assessment: 面向模型版权保护，与自动驾驶感知任务关联弱，但剪枝技术有交叉参考价值。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.contribution: 提出MAP，实现源无关模型知识产权保护。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.innovation: 通过掩码剪枝嵌入水印并支持无标签验证。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.result: 在多种剪枝率和攻击下保持高验证准确率，性能影响小。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model._arxiv_id: MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model Intellectual Property Protection.

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_cn: 视觉Transformer推理时token数量大导致计算开销高，现有token剪枝方法需微调或额外训练。本文提出Zero-TPrune，利用预训练Transformer的注意力图进行零样本token剪枝，无需微调即可在推理时动态丢弃冗余token。在ImageNet上，该方法在保持精度的同时显著降低FLOPs，优于需要微调的剪枝方法。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_en: Vision Transformers suffer from high inference cost due to many tokens, and existing token pruning methods require finetuning. Zero-TPrune performs zero-shot token pruning by leveraging the attention graph of pretrained Transformers, dynamically discarding redundant tokens at inference without finetuning. It reduces FLOPs significantly while maintaining accuracy on ImageNet, outperforming finetuning-based pruning.
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.assessment: 零样本token剪枝对ViT高效推理有实用价值，可迁移至BEV/多相机感知中的Transformer加速。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.contribution: 提出Zero-TPrune，利用注意力图实现零样本token剪枝。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.innovation: 无需微调，基于预训练注意力图动态剪枝token。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.result: 在ImageNet上保持精度同时显著降低FLOPs，优于需微调方法。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr._arxiv_id: Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Through Leveraging of the Attention Graph in Pre-Trained Transformers.

Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_cn: 针对从零训练（training-from-scratch）场景下网络剪枝难以确定各层稀疏度的问题，本文提出 Auto-Train-Once（ATO），用一个控制器网络（controller network）在训练过程中自动学习并分配各层的剪枝比例。方法将剪枝掩码的生成参数化为可学习的控制器输出，并与主网络联合优化，从而避免人工设定逐层稀疏率。相比依赖预训练权重或手工稀疏配置的已有剪枝方法，ATO 在从零训练设定下取得更优的精度-稀疏度折中，在 CIFAR/ImageNet 等基准上以相近或更低 FLOPs 达到更高或相当的 Top-1 精度。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_en: This paper addresses automatic network pruning in the training-from-scratch regime, where per-layer sparsity is hard to specify manually. It proposes Auto-Train-Once (ATO), which employs a controller network to learn and allocate layer-wise pruning ratios jointly with the main network during training. Compared with prior pruning methods that rely on pretrained weights or hand-crafted sparsity configurations, ATO achieves a better accuracy-sparsity trade-off on CIFAR/ImageNet benchmarks under comparable or lower FLOPs.
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.assessment: 把逐层稀疏度分配交给可学习控制器、并与从零训练联合优化，思路清晰，对自动化剪枝方向有参考价值，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）关联较弱。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.contribution: 提出用控制器网络在从零训练中自动学习逐层剪枝比例的剪枝框架 ATO。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.innovation: 将逐层稀疏度分配建模为可学习控制器输出，与主网络端到端联合优化，免除人工稀疏配置。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.result: 在 CIFAR/ImageNet 上以相近或更低计算量取得优于或相当于已有从零训练剪枝方法的精度。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui._arxiv_id: Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Guided Automatic Network Pruning from Scratch.

Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_cn: 针对数据集剪枝（dataset pruning）中样本重要性随训练进程动态变化、单一时刻打分不稳定的问题，本文提出 Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring（TDDS），在训练过程中跨时间维度对样本进行双深度（dual-depth）打分。方法同时考虑样本在不同训练阶段的得分变化与不同网络深度下的表现，聚合为更鲁棒的样本重要性估计，从而选出更具信息量的子集。相比静态或单时刻的打分策略，TDDS 在多个数据集与网络结构上以更小的训练子集维持甚至提升精度，验证了时间维度信息对数据集剪枝的价值。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_en: This paper tackles dataset pruning, where sample importance varies over the course of training and single-snapshot scores are unstable. It proposes Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS), which scores samples across training time and at dual network depths to obtain more robust importance estimates. Compared with static or single-moment scoring, TDDS maintains or improves accuracy with smaller training subsets across multiple datasets and architectures.
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.assessment: 从训练时间维度与网络深度两个视角改进样本打分，是数据集剪枝中一个合理且有效的思路，但属于训练效率方向，与自动驾驶感知主线相关性有限。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.contribution: 提出跨训练时间与双网络深度的样本打分方法 TDDS，用于数据集剪枝。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.innovation: 将样本重要性建模为随训练进程变化的时间序列，并融合双深度信息以提升打分鲁棒性。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.result: 在多个数据集与网络上以更小的训练子集保持或提升模型精度。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua._arxiv_id: Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) for Enhanced Dataset Pruning.

Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_cn: 针对深度图/点云稀疏且不均匀时深度补全与细化效果差的问题，本文提出 Masked Spatial Propagation Network（MSPN），实现稀疏度自适应的深度细化。方法用掩码机制引导空间传播，使传播过程根据局部稀疏程度自适应调整，从而在稀疏区域也能可靠地聚合邻域信息。相比固定传播核或忽略稀疏分布的已有深度补全方法，MSPN 在 KITTI 等深度补全基准上降低了 RMSE 等误差指标，提升了稀疏区域的深度精度。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_en: This paper targets depth refinement under sparse and non-uniform depth measurements. It proposes the Masked Spatial Propagation Network (MSPN), which performs sparsity-adaptive depth refinement by using masking to guide spatial propagation according to local sparsity. Compared with fixed-kernel or sparsity-agnostic depth completion methods, MSPN reduces RMSE and improves accuracy in sparse regions on benchmarks such as KITTI.
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.assessment: 稀疏度自适应传播对深度补全有实际意义，可服务于 3D 感知前端，但整体更偏底层几何任务，与 BEV/检测主线的直接关联中等。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.contribution: 提出掩码空间传播网络 MSPN，实现稀疏度自适应的深度细化。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.innovation: 用掩码引导空间传播，使邻域信息聚合随局部稀疏程度自适应调整。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.result: 在 KITTI 等深度补全基准上降低 RMSE 等误差，改善稀疏区域深度精度。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S._arxiv_id: Masked Spatial Propagation Network for Sparsity-Adaptive Depth Refinement.

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_cn: 针对结构化稀疏对抗攻击中扰动难以迁移、且需满足组稀疏约束的问题，本文提出通过精确组稀疏训练获得可迁移的结构化稀疏对抗扰动。方法在训练阶段显式施加组稀疏约束，使生成的扰动在保持结构化（如块状）形式的同时具备跨模型迁移能力。相比逐像素 Lp 约束或后处理稀疏化的攻击方法，该工作在保持攻击成功率的同时显著减少扰动像素/区域数量，并在黑盒迁移设定下取得更高的攻击成功率。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_en: This paper addresses transferable structured sparse adversarial attacks, where perturbations must satisfy group-sparsity constraints while remaining transferable. It proposes exact group-sparsity training to generate structured sparse perturbations that transfer across models. Compared with per-pixel Lp attacks or post-hoc sparsification, the method reduces the number of perturbed pixels/regions while achieving higher black-box transfer attack success rates.
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.assessment: 组稀疏约束下的可迁移对抗攻击对感知模型鲁棒性评测有参考价值，但属于对抗安全方向，与检测/自动驾驶主任务相关性中等。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.contribution: 提出基于精确组稀疏训练的可迁移结构化稀疏对抗攻击方法。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.innovation: 在训练中显式施加组稀疏约束，兼顾扰动的结构化稀疏性与跨模型迁移性。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.result: 在保持或提升黑盒迁移攻击成功率的同时显著减少扰动像素/区域数量。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari._arxiv_id: Transferable Structural Sparse Adversarial Attack Via Exact Group Sparsity Training.

MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_cn: 针对 N:M 结构化稀疏在实际部署中难以兼顾精度与硬件加速的问题，本文提出 MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query，用于 N:M 稀疏网络的权重选择。方法通过沿多个轴（如输入/输出通道等）进行查询式评估，更准确地衡量权重对输出的重要性，从而在满足 N:M 约束的前提下保留更关键的连接。相比仅沿单一维度打分的已有 N:M 稀疏方法，MaxQ 在相同稀疏模式下取得更高的精度，并在 GPU 稀疏推理上保持实际加速。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_en: This paper targets N:M structured sparsity, aiming to preserve accuracy under hardware-friendly sparsity patterns. It proposes MaxQ (Multi-Axis Query), which evaluates weight importance along multiple axes to select which weights to keep under the N:M constraint. Compared with single-axis scoring in prior N:M sparsity methods, MaxQ achieves higher accuracy at the same sparsity pattern while retaining practical GPU speedups.
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.assessment: 多轴重要性评估对 N:M 稀疏的精度保持有实际改进，属于模型压缩方向，对部署感知模型有间接价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务本身关联较弱。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.contribution: 提出多轴查询的权重重要性评估方法 MaxQ，用于 N:M 稀疏网络。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.innovation: 沿多个轴联合评估权重重要性，在满足 N:M 约束下更精准地保留关键连接。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.result: 在相同 N:M 稀疏模式下取得更高精度，并保持 GPU 稀疏推理加速。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity._arxiv_id: MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity Network.

UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_cn: 针对训练后稀疏化（post-training sparsity）中不同稀疏方法各自为政、难以统一的问题，本文提出统一框架 UniPTS，将多种训练后稀疏化方法纳入同一范式。方法通过统一的目标与流程设计，使不同稀疏策略（如权重选择与补偿）可在同一框架下比较与组合，从而在无需重训练的情况下获得更好的精度-稀疏度折中。相比单一的训练后稀疏方法，UniPTS 在多个网络与数据集上以更低的精度损失达到更高稀疏度。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_en: This paper addresses post-training sparsity, where disparate methods are hard to compare or combine. It proposes UniPTS, a unified framework that formulates various post-training sparsification strategies under a common paradigm. Compared with individual post-training sparsity methods, UniPTS achieves a better accuracy-sparsity trade-off without retraining across multiple networks and datasets.
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.assessment: 统一训练后稀疏化范式有助于方法比较与组合，对高效部署有参考意义，但属于模型压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知主线相关性有限。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.contribution: 提出统一的训练后稀疏化框架 UniPTS，整合多种稀疏策略。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.innovation: 将不同的训练后稀疏化方法统一到同一目标与流程下，便于比较与组合。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.result: 在多个网络与数据集上以更低精度损失达到更高稀疏度，无需重训练。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie._arxiv_id: UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficient Post-Training Sparsity.

DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时计算和存储开销大的问题，提出DeepCompress-ViT压缩框架。方法上结合了结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏，在保持注意力结构的前提下减少冗余参数。相比已有ViT压缩工作，更强调边缘端效率与精度的平衡。摘要未给出具体数据集和量化结果，效果需进一步验证。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory cost of deploying Vision Transformers on edge devices by proposing DeepCompress-ViT, a compression framework that combines structured pruning with knowledge distillation. It aims to balance efficiency and accuracy better than prior ViT compression methods. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, so empirical gains remain to be validated.
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.assessment: ViT边缘部署是实用方向，但需看具体压缩率与精度折衷数据才能判断价值。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.contribution: 提出面向边缘端的ViT结构化剪枝与蒸馏联合压缩框架。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.innovation: 在压缩流程中协同考虑注意力结构与蒸馏信号以保留关键表征。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集与量化指标，效果待验证。

2411.15678|v2.summary_cn: 现有检测方法多基于ISP压缩后的sRGB输入，在复杂光照和天气下会丢失RAW中的关键信息。本文构建了AODRaw数据集，包含7,785张高分辨率真实RAW图像、135,601个标注实例、62个类别，覆盖9种光照与天气条件，并提供RAW与sRGB检测基准。发现sRGB预训练因域差距限制RAW检测性能，提出直接在RAW域预训练并蒸馏sRGB预训练模型知识，无需额外预处理模块即在多样与恶劣条件下取得显著提升。
2411.15678|v2.summary_en: Existing detectors operate on ISP-compressed sRGB inputs, losing crucial RAW information under complex illumination and weather. The authors introduce AODRaw, a dataset of 7,785 high-resolution real RAW images with 135,601 annotated instances across 62 categories and 9 conditions, and benchmark RAW vs. sRGB detection. They show sRGB pre-training limits RAW detection due to domain gap, and propose RAW-domain pre-training with knowledge distillation from an sRGB-pre-trained model, achieving substantial gains under diverse and adverse conditions without extra pre-processing modules.
2411.15678|v2.assessment: RAW域检测数据集与基准填补空白，蒸馏式RAW预训练思路对自动驾驶感知有直接参考价值。
2411.15678|v2.contribution: 构建大规模RAW域目标检测数据集AODRaw并给出RAW/sRGB检测基准。
2411.15678|v2.innovation: 发现sRGB预训练对RAW检测的域差距限制，提出RAW域预训练+跨域蒸馏方案。
2411.15678|v2.result: 在多样与恶劣条件下无需额外预处理即取得显著提升。

2506.02462|v2.summary_cn: 持续测试时自适应目标检测（CTTA-OD）需在连续域偏移下在线适配检测器，但现有方法忽视计算效率。本文观察到并非所有源域特征都有益，部分域敏感通道会损害目标域性能，提出敏感度引导的通道剪枝策略，在图像和实例级别量化通道对域差异的敏感度，并用加权稀疏正则抑制和剪除敏感通道，同时引入随机通道重激活机制恢复可能有用特征。在三个基准上取得优于现有方法的效果并提升效率。
2506.02462|v2.summary_en: Continual test-time adaptive object detection (CTTA-OD) must adapt online under continuous domain shifts, yet existing methods overlook computational efficiency. Observing that some domain-sensitive source channels harm target performance, the authors propose sensitivity-guided channel pruning that quantifies channel sensitivity at image and instance levels, applies weighted sparsity regularization to suppress sensitive channels, and adds stochastic channel reactivation to recover useful features. Experiments on three benchmarks show superior performance and efficiency.
2506.02462|v2.assessment: 将剪枝引入CTTA-OD以兼顾效率与自适应，思路新颖，对资源受限的在线感知有参考意义。
2506.02462|v2.contribution: 提出敏感度引导剪枝的高效持续测试时自适应目标检测方法。
2506.02462|v2.innovation: 在图像与实例级别量化通道域敏感度并配合随机重激活机制。
2506.02462|v2.result: 在三个基准上性能优于现有方法且计算更高效。

2506.09510|v2.summary_cn: 针对学习式点云属性压缩中高斯/拉普拉斯熵模型概率估计不充分的问题，提出广义高斯熵模型，通过形状参数控制尾部形状以更准确估计隐变量概率。同时指出现有方法在算术编码中使用固定似然区间限制性能，提出均值误差判别器（MED）动态调整似然区间。在三个VAE-based点云属性压缩模型上显著提升率失真性能，并可推广到图像和视频压缩。
2506.09510|v2.summary_en: To improve probability estimation in learned point cloud attribute compression, this paper introduces a generalized Gaussian entropy model whose shape parameter controls tail behavior for more accurate latent probability estimation. It also proposes a Mean Error Discriminator (MED) to dynamically adjust likelihood intervals during arithmetic coding, replacing fixed intervals. Experiments on three VAE-based models show significant rate-distortion gains, with applicability to image and video compression.
2506.09510|v2.assessment: 熵模型改进对点云压缩有实际价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
2506.09510|v2.contribution: 提出广义高斯熵模型与动态似然区间机制用于点云属性压缩。
2506.09510|v2.innovation: 用形状参数建模尾部并引入MED动态调整算术编码似然区间。
2506.09510|v2.result: 在三个VAE-based点云属性压缩模型上显著提升率失真性能。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_cn: 针对八叉树结构点云几何压缩中占用预测效率与精度的问题，提出TopNet，一个基于Transformer的高效占用预测网络。方法利用八叉树层级结构设计轻量注意力以预测节点占用概率，降低计算开销。相比已有基于CNN或手工特征的占用预测方法，在压缩率与重建质量上寻求更优折衷。摘要未给出具体数据集与BD-rate数据，效果需进一步确认。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_en: This paper proposes TopNet, a Transformer-efficient occupancy prediction network for octree-structured point cloud geometry compression. It leverages the octree hierarchy with lightweight attention to predict node occupancy while reducing computation. It aims to improve the rate-distortion trade-off over CNN-based or handcrafted occupancy predictors. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.assessment: 占用预测与BEV/Occupancy感知有概念关联，但本文聚焦压缩任务，需看具体压缩指标。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.contribution: 提出面向八叉树点云几何压缩的高效Transformer占用预测网络TopNet。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.innovation: 结合八叉树层级结构与轻量注意力实现高效占用预测。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集与压缩指标，效果待验证。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy._arxiv_id: TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy Prediction Network for Octree-Structured Point Cloud Geometry Compression.

2412.11520|v2.summary_cn: 针对文本驱动3D场景编辑中2D扩散模型忽视多视图信息导致多视图不一致、以及3DGS编辑优化低效的问题，提出EditSplat框架。方法包含多视图融合引导（MFG），将多视图信息与3DGS几何结构结合到扩散过程以保证一致性；以及注意力引导修剪（AGT），利用3DGS显式表示选择性剪枝和优化高斯以提升优化效率并支持局部语义编辑。定性与定量实验表明其在视图一致性和编辑质量上优于现有方法。
2412.11520|v2.summary_en: To address multi-view inconsistency in text-driven 3D editing caused by 2D diffusion models ignoring multi-view information, and inefficient 3DGS optimization, this paper proposes EditSplat. It integrates Multi-view Fusion Guidance (MFG) to inject multi-view information and 3DGS geometry into the diffusion process, and Attention-Guided Trimming (AGT) to selectively prune and optimize Gaussians for efficient, semantically rich local editing. Qualitative and quantitative experiments show improved view consistency and editing quality.
2412.11520|v2.assessment: 3DGS编辑与多视图一致性对自动驾驶仿真/场景重建有潜在价值，但非感知主线。
2412.11520|v2.contribution: 提出结合多视图融合引导与注意力引导修剪的文本驱动3DGS场景编辑框架。
2412.11520|v2.innovation: 将多视图信息与3DGS几何融入扩散过程并利用注意力修剪高斯提升编辑效率。
2412.11520|v2.result: 在视图一致性与编辑质量上优于现有方法。

2412.13303|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM在高分辨率图像下视觉编码器延迟高、视觉token数量大的效率瓶颈，论文系统分析了图像分辨率、视觉延迟、token数与LLM规模之间的权衡关系，提出FastVLM及新型混合视觉编码器FastViTHD，通过仅缩放输入图像即可在视觉token数与分辨率之间取得最优平衡，无需额外的token剪枝。相比已有方法，FastVLM简化了模型设计并在延迟、模型大小与精度之间实现了更优的折中。
2412.13303|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency bottleneck of vision encoders in VLMs at high input resolutions, where ViTs suffer from excessive tokens and high encoding latency. It introduces FastVLM with FastViTHD, a hybrid vision encoder that outputs fewer tokens and reduces encoding time, achieving an optimal trade-off between latency, model size, and accuracy solely by scaling the input image without extra token pruning.
2412.13303|v2.assessment: 对VLM视觉编码效率的系统性分析与FastViTHD设计具有实用价值，尤其适合关注高分辨率视觉感知与推理延迟的研究者。
2412.13303|v2.contribution: 提出FastVLM及FastViTHD混合视觉编码器，实现高分辨率下视觉token数与编码延迟的联合优化。
2412.13303|v2.innovation: 仅通过缩放输入图像即可平衡视觉token数与分辨率，无需额外token剪枝，简化了VLM设计。
2412.13303|v2.result: 在延迟、模型大小与精度之间取得优于已有方法的折中，显著降低高分辨率图像的编码时间与token数量。

2503.17142|v2.summary_cn: 论文探究VLM的视觉嵌入空间是否与文本空间一样具有组合性结构，针对视觉数据噪声大、稀疏导致组合性分析困难的问题，提出几何可分解嵌入（GDE）框架，用几何感知的组合结构近似图像表示。实验表明预训练VLM的视觉嵌入确实呈现组合性排列，GDE在组合分类上优于假设线性几何的对照方法，在组鲁棒性任务上取得更高结果。
2503.17142|v2.summary_en: This work investigates whether compositional structures emerge in the visual embedding space of VLMs, addressing the noise and sparsity challenges of visual data with a geometry-aware framework called Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE). Experiments show that pre-trained VLM visual embeddings exhibit compositional arrangements, and GDE outperforms linear-geometry counterparts in compositional classification and achieves higher group robustness.
2503.17142|v2.assessment: 对VLM视觉表示组合性的分析具有理论意义，但应用场景偏分类与鲁棒性，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2503.17142|v2.contribution: 提出GDE框架，证明并利用VLM视觉嵌入空间的组合性结构。
2503.17142|v2.innovation: 用几何感知的可分解结构建模视觉嵌入的组合性，突破线性潜在空间假设。
2503.17142|v2.result: 在组合分类上优于线性几何方法，在组鲁棒性任务上取得更高性能。

2501.02955|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM基准缺乏对细粒度运动理解的评估，论文提出MotionBench，涵盖六类运动导向问题类型并采集多源真实视频数据。实验显示现有VLM在细粒度运动理解上表现不佳，为此论文系统研究了面向视频特征压缩的VLM架构，提出高效的Through-Encoder（TE）融合方法。结果表明更高帧率输入与TE融合能提升运动理解，但仍存在较大提升空间。
2501.02955|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MotionBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating fine-grained motion comprehension in video understanding models, covering six motion-oriented question categories from diverse real-world sources. Experiments reveal poor performance of existing VLMs, and the authors propose an efficient Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion method, showing that higher frame rates and TE Fusion improve motion understanding while substantial room remains.
2501.02955|v2.assessment: MotionBench填补了细粒度运动理解评测的空白，TE融合方法对视频VLM架构优化有参考价值。
2501.02955|v2.contribution: 提出细粒度运动理解基准MotionBench及高效的Through-Encoder融合方法。
2501.02955|v2.innovation: 系统评测VLM运动级感知能力，并提出TE融合以在有限序列长度下增强运动理解。
2501.02955|v2.result: 现有VLM在MotionBench上表现不佳，高帧率输入与TE融合带来提升但仍有较大改进空间。

2409.14485|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型在小时级长视频理解中受限于上下文长度与处理成本的问题，论文提出Video-XL，利用MLLM固有的KV稀疏化能力压缩视觉输入，引入视觉摘要token（VST）对每段视频的视觉信息进行摘要并作为其关联KV。VST模块通过指令微调训练，采用课程学习与复合数据策展两种优化策略，并结合动态压缩提升压缩质量。实验表明该方法在长视频理解上取得良好效果。
2409.14485|v2.summary_en: To address the context-length and cost constraints of MLLMs in hour-scale long video understanding, this paper proposes Video-XL, which leverages the inherent KV sparsification capacity of MLLMs by introducing a Visual Summarization Token (VST) per video interval to summarize visual information as associated KV. The VST module is trained via instruction fine-tuning with curriculum learning and composite data curation, further improved by dynamic compression, achieving strong long-video understanding performance.
2409.14485|v2.assessment: Video-XL巧妙利用KV稀疏化实现长视频压缩，课程学习与数据策展策略对长视频VLM训练有借鉴意义。
2409.14485|v2.contribution: 提出Video-XL，通过视觉摘要token与KV稀疏化实现小时级长视频的高效理解。
2409.14485|v2.innovation: 引入VST对视频区间视觉信息进行KV级摘要，结合课程学习与复合数据策展训练压缩模块。
2409.14485|v2.result: 在长视频理解任务上取得良好性能，有效缓解上下文长度与处理成本瓶颈。

2412.09613|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM对图像和视频采用不同token压缩策略、限制图像视频联合能力的问题，论文将每张图像扩展为静态视频，提出统一的渐进式视觉token压缩（PVC）策略，逐帧渐进编码并自适应压缩token以补充前帧未提取的信息，利用时间冗余高效压缩视频token。在每帧仅64个token的默认设置下仍能保留空间细节与时间变化，实验表明模型在多种视频理解任务上达到SOTA。
2412.09613|v2.summary_en: To overcome the limitation that existing VLMs process images and videos with separate token compression strategies, this paper extends each image into a static video and proposes Progressive Visual Token Compression (PVC), which progressively encodes and adaptively compresses tokens per frame to supplement information from previous frames. With only 64 tokens per frame by default, spatial details and temporal changes are preserved, achieving state-of-the-art performance across various video understanding tasks.
2412.09613|v2.assessment: PVC统一了图像与视频的token压缩，渐进式补充机制设计巧妙，对多模态统一处理有较高参考价值。
2412.09613|v2.contribution: 提出统一的渐进式视觉token压缩策略PVC，实现图像与视频的联合高效处理。
2412.09613|v2.innovation: 将图像扩展为静态视频并逐帧渐进压缩token，利用时间冗余统一图像与视频的token压缩。
2412.09613|v2.result: 在每帧仅64 token下保留空间与时间信息，在多种视频理解任务上达到SOTA。

Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）推理开销大的问题，本文提出 Libra-Merging，从重要性-冗余度与剪枝-合并的权衡角度设计加速插件。方法通过联合建模 token 重要性与冗余性，在剪枝与合并之间取得平衡，从而在压缩视觉 token 的同时保留关键信息。相比单一剪枝或合并策略，该插件可即插即用地降低计算量。摘要未给出具体加速比与精度数据，需查看正文验证。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference cost of large vision-language models by proposing Libra-Merging, a plug-in acceleration module that trades off importance versus redundancy and pruning versus merging. It jointly models token importance and redundancy to balance pruning and merging, preserving critical visual information while compressing tokens. Unlike single-strategy pruning or merging, it is designed as a plug-and-play component, though concrete speedup and accuracy numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.assessment: 面向 LVLM 推理加速的 token 压缩工作，思路兼顾重要性与冗余度，对多模态高效推理有参考价值，但需正文数据支撑其有效性。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.contribution: 提出兼顾重要性-冗余度与剪枝-合并权衡的 LVLM 加速插件 Libra-Merging。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.innovation: 将 token 剪枝与合并统一到重要性-冗余度权衡框架下进行联合优化。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.result: 摘要未给出具体加速比与精度指标，效果需以正文实验为准。

2503.18278|v2.summary_cn: 针对 VLM 推理中视觉 token 过多导致计算与显存开销大的问题，本文提出 TopV，将 token 剪枝建模为推理时优化问题而非依赖注意力分数的贪心启发式。方法在 prefill 阶段仅执行一次剪枝，从而同时兼容 FlashAttention 并有效减小 KV cache，且无需额外训练或微调。优化框架引入视觉感知代价函数，综合考虑特征相似度与相对空间关系等因素。相比已有剪枝方法，TopV 在保持兼容性的同时提升效率，摘要未给出具体精度与加速数据。
2503.18278|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the heavy inference cost of VLMs caused by numerous visual tokens, proposing TopV, which formulates token pruning as an inference-time optimization problem instead of greedy attention-based heuristics. Pruning is performed only once during prefilling, making it compatible with FlashAttention and reducing KV cache size without additional training or fine-tuning. The optimization incorporates a visual-aware cost function considering feature similarity and relative spatial relations, though quantitative accuracy and speedup results are not reported in the abstract.
2503.18278|v2.assessment: 将 token 剪枝转化为优化问题并兼容 FlashAttention/KV cache，工程实用性强，对多模态高效推理研究者有较高参考价值。
2503.18278|v2.contribution: 提出免训练、兼容 FlashAttention 与 KV cache 的推理时优化 token 剪枝方法 TopV。
2503.18278|v2.innovation: 用优化问题替代注意力分数贪心准则，并在 prefill 阶段一次性剪枝以压缩 KV cache。
2503.18278|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体精度与加速数据，需正文实验验证。

2412.00447|v2.summary_cn: 针对 LVLM 中长视觉 token 带来的高昂计算成本，本文观察到剪枝比例的影响在不同 LLM 层和不同实例（图像-提示对）间存在差异，提出 ATP-LLaVA 自适应 token 剪枝方法。方法引入 Adaptive Token Pruning 模块，根据输入实例自适应计算重要性分数与剪枝阈值，可无缝插入任意两层 LLM 之间且开销可忽略，并配合 Spatial Augmented Pruning 策略。相比固定比例的剪枝方法，该方案在计算成本与模型性能间取得更优平衡，摘要未给出具体数值结果。
2412.00447|v2.summary_en: Observing that the impact of pruning ratios varies across LLM layers and instances, this paper proposes ATP-LLaVA, which adaptively determines instance-specific token pruning ratios for each LLM layer in LVLMs. An Adaptive Token Pruning module computes importance scores and pruning thresholds conditioned on the input, and can be inserted between any two LLM layers with negligible overhead, complemented by a Spatial Augmented Pruning strategy. Compared with fixed-ratio pruning, it better balances computational cost and model performance, though concrete numbers are absent from the abstract.
2412.00447|v2.assessment: 层间与实例自适应剪枝的思路合理，模块化设计便于集成，对 LVLM 高效推理方向有实用价值。
2412.00447|v2.contribution: 提出层间与实例自适应的视觉 token 剪枝框架 ATP-LLaVA。
2412.00447|v2.innovation: 按输入实例自适应确定每层剪枝阈值，并设计空间增强剪枝策略。
2412.00447|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体精度与效率数据，需正文实验佐证。

2406.12275|v2.summary_cn: 针对 VLM 处理高分辨率图像与视频时受限于上下文窗口和计算成本的问题，本文提出 VoCo-LLaMA，首次利用 LLM 自身来压缩视觉 token。方法在视觉指令微调阶段引入 Vision Compression token，并通过注意力蒸馏将 LLM 理解视觉 token 的过程迁移到对 VoCo token 的处理中，避免外部压缩模块带来的视觉信息损失。实验表明在 576 倍压缩比下性能损失极小，FLOPs 最多减少 94.8%，推理时间加速 69.6%。
2406.12275|v2.summary_en: To alleviate the context-window and computational bottlenecks of VLMs on high-resolution images and videos, this paper proposes VoCo-LLaMA, the first approach that compresses vision tokens using the LLM itself. It introduces Vision Compression tokens during vision instruction tuning and leverages attention distillation to transfer how the LLM comprehends vision tokens into processing VoCo tokens, avoiding the visual information loss of external compression modules. Experiments show minimal performance loss at a 576x compression ratio, with up to 94.8% fewer FLOPs and 69.6% inference speedup.
2406.12275|v2.assessment: 用 LLM 自身做视觉压缩并给出 576 倍压缩下的具体效率数据，思路新颖且结果扎实，值得多模态高效推理方向关注。
2406.12275|v2.contribution: 提出首个利用 LLM 自身进行视觉 token 压缩的方法 VoCo-LLaMA。
2406.12275|v2.innovation: 引入 Vision Compression token 并通过注意力蒸馏将 LLM 的视觉理解能力迁移到压缩 token 上。
2406.12275|v2.result: 在 576 倍压缩比下性能损失极小，FLOPs 减少最多 94.8%，推理加速 69.6%。

2503.16843|v2.summary_cn: 针对 MLLM 在视觉指令微调中采用 LoRA 适配下游任务时引入有害冗余、加剧通用知识遗忘的问题，本文提出 LoRASculpt，通过消除有害冗余参数来协调通用与专用知识。方法在理论保证下向 LoRA 引入稀疏更新以丢弃冗余参数，并提出冲突缓解正则项优化 LoRA 更新轨迹，减轻与预训练权重的知识冲突。实验表明即使在 5% 以下的高稀疏度下，方法仍能同时提升泛化能力与下游任务性能，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
2503.16843|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the harmful redundancy introduced by LoRA during visual instruction tuning of MLLMs, which exacerbates forgetting of general knowledge and degrades downstream performance. It proposes LoRASculpt, which introduces sparse updates into LoRA under theoretical guarantees to discard redundant parameters, plus a Conflict Mitigation Regularizer that refines the LoRA update trajectory to reduce conflicts with pretrained weights. Experiments show that even at sparsity below 5%, the method simultaneously improves generalization and downstream performance, mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
2503.16843|v2.assessment: 从参数冗余与知识冲突角度改进 LoRA 微调，理论保证加实验验证，对 MLLM 持续学习与高效适配有参考意义。
2503.16843|v2.contribution: 提出通过稀疏更新与冲突缓解正则协调通用与专用知识的 LoRASculpt。
2503.16843|v2.innovation: 在理论保证下向 LoRA 注入稀疏更新，并用冲突缓解正则项约束更新轨迹。
2503.16843|v2.result: 在不超过 5% 的高稀疏度下同时提升泛化与下游任务性能，缓解灾难性遗忘。

2503.02175|v2.summary_cn: 针对 LMM 中视觉 token 数量庞大导致推理延迟高的问题，本文指出已有剪枝方法要么需要大量校准与微调，要么依赖次优重要性度量导致保留 token 冗余度高，进而将 token 剪枝形式化为最大-最小多样性问题（MMDP）。方法通过求解 MMDP 选出多样性最大的 token 子集并剪除其余 token，从而降低保留 token 间的冗余。相比已有方法，DivPrune 无需校准或微调即可获得最高多样性的保留子集，摘要未给出具体精度与加速数据。
2503.02175|v2.summary_en: To reduce the high inference latency of LMMs caused by thousands of visual tokens, this paper notes that existing pruning methods either require extensive calibration and fine-tuning or rely on suboptimal importance metrics that leave high redundancy among retained tokens. It formulates token pruning as a Max-Min Diversity Problem (MMDP) and solves it to select the most diverse subset while pruning the rest. DivPrune thus reduces redundancy and achieves the highest diversity of selected tokens without calibration or fine-tuning, though quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
2503.02175|v2.assessment: 以多样性最大化替代重要性度量来剪枝，视角新颖且免校准免微调，对 LMM 高效推理有较强实用价值。
2503.02175|v2.contribution: 提出基于最大-最小多样性问题的视觉 token 剪枝方法 DivPrune。
2503.02175|v2.innovation: 将 token 剪枝形式化为 MMDP，以最大化保留 token 的多样性来降低冗余。
2503.02175|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体精度与加速数据，需正文实验验证。

2503.05936|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型（LMM）低比特压缩研究不足的问题，论文从理论和实验上证明注意力矩阵的稀疏性可以约束Query和Key权重矩阵的压缩误差。基于此提出CASP，对Q/K权重矩阵进行数据感知的低秩分解，并通过最优比特分配在所有层上执行量化。CASP可与任意量化技术兼容，在图像和视频语言基准上将现有2-bit量化方法（AQLM和QuIP#）平均提升21%。
2503.05936|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored problem of low-bit compression for Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). It theoretically and experimentally shows that the sparsity of the attention matrix bounds the compression error of Query and Key weight matrices, and proposes CASP, which performs data-aware low-rank decomposition on Q/K weights followed by optimal bit-allocation quantization across all layers. CASP is compatible with any quantization technique and improves state-of-the-art 2-bit methods (AQLM and QuIP#) by an average of 21% on image- and video-language benchmarks.
2503.05936|v2.assessment: 将注意力稀疏性理论引入LMM压缩，方法通用且与现有量化技术正交，对多模态模型部署有实际价值。
2503.05936|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力稀疏性的LMM极端压缩框架CASP，并给出压缩误差的理论界。
2503.05936|v2.innovation: 首次从理论和实验上建立注意力矩阵稀疏性与Q/K权重压缩误差的联系，并据此设计数据感知低秩分解与最优比特分配。
2503.05936|v2.result: 在图像和视频语言基准上，将AQLM和QuIP#等2-bit量化方法平均提升21%。

2501.08282|v2.summary_cn: 现有MLLM难以同时有效处理视频中的时间和空间定位，原因在于坐标组合爆炸导致语言-视觉坐标对齐困难，以及视频特征压缩中细粒度时空信息编码困难。论文提出LLaVA-ST，包含Language-Aligned Positional Embedding（将文本坐标特殊token嵌入视觉空间）和Spatial-Temporal Packer（将时间与空间分辨率的特征压缩解耦为两个point-to-region注意力流），并构建了4.3M样本的ST-Align数据集。
2501.08282|v2.summary_en: Existing MLLMs struggle to simultaneously handle temporal and spatial localization due to the combinatorial explosion of coordinates and the difficulty of encoding fine-grained spatio-temporal information during video feature compression. The paper proposes LLaVA-ST, which introduces Language-Aligned Positional Embedding to embed textual coordinate tokens into visual space and a Spatial-Temporal Packer that decouples temporal and spatial feature compression into two point-to-region attention streams, along with the 4.3M-sample ST-Align dataset.
2501.08282|v2.assessment: 针对视频细粒度时空理解的痛点提出系统性方案，数据集规模大，对多模态视频理解研究有参考价值。
2501.08282|v2.contribution: 提出LLaVA-ST模型及ST-Align数据集，实现细粒度时空多模态理解。
2501.08282|v2.innovation: 语言对齐位置嵌入与时空解耦的Packer设计，简化了坐标对齐并保留细粒度时空信息。
2501.08282|v2.result: 构建4.3M训练样本的ST-Align数据集，在细粒度时空理解任务上取得提升。

2411.16760|v2.summary_cn: 论文指出Transformer中梯度流不平衡违反了FullGrad完备性，导致基于梯度的解释方法效果不佳。提出LibraGrad，一种理论驱动的后处理方法，通过剪枝和缩放反向路径来校正梯度不平衡，不改变前向传播也不增加计算开销。在8种架构、4种模型规模和4个数据集上，LibraGrad在Faithfulness、Completeness Error和Segmentation AP三类指标上全面优于现有白盒方法。
2411.16760|v2.summary_en: The paper identifies gradient flow imbalances in Transformers that violate FullGrad-completeness, degrading gradient-based explanations. It proposes LibraGrad, a theoretically grounded post-hoc method that corrects gradient imbalances by pruning and scaling backward paths without altering the forward pass or adding overhead. Across 8 architectures, 4 model sizes, and 4 datasets, LibraGrad universally improves gradient-based methods and outperforms existing white-box approaches on Faithfulness, Completeness Error, and Segmentation AP.
2411.16760|v2.assessment: 为Transformer可解释性提供了理论支撑的通用改进，实验覆盖广泛，对ViT可解释性研究有参考意义。
2411.16760|v2.contribution: 提出LibraGrad，通过校正Transformer梯度流不平衡提升归因质量。
2411.16760|v2.innovation: 揭示Transformer梯度流不平衡违反FullGrad完备性，并用反向路径剪枝与缩放进行后处理校正。
2411.16760|v2.result: 在8种架构、4种规模、4个数据集上全面超越现有白盒归因方法。

2406.10219|v2.summary_cn: 3D Gaussian Splatting（3D-GS）在复杂场景中需要数百万个高斯，导致存储和内存开销大，现有剪枝方法依赖启发式组合，高压缩率下视觉保真度和前景细节严重退化。论文提出基于二阶近似的敏感性剪枝分数，计算每个高斯空间参数对训练视图重建误差的二阶近似，并设计多轮prune-refine流程，可应用于任意预训练3D-GS模型。该方法在显著更高压缩率下仍保持视觉保真度和前景细节。
2406.10219|v2.summary_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) requires millions of Gaussians for complex scenes, causing high storage and memory costs, while existing pruning heuristics degrade visual fidelity and foreground details at high compression ratios. This paper proposes a principled sensitivity pruning score computed as a second-order approximation of the reconstruction error on training views with respect to each Gaussian's spatial parameters, along with a multi-round prune-refine pipeline applicable to any pretrained 3D-GS model. It preserves visual fidelity and foreground details at significantly higher compression ratios than existing approaches.
2406.10219|v2.assessment: 将二阶敏感性分析引入3D-GS剪枝，方法有理论依据且通用，对3D场景表示压缩有实用价值。
2406.10219|v2.contribution: 提出基于二阶重建误差近似的3D-GS敏感性剪枝分数及多轮prune-refine流程。
2406.10219|v2.innovation: 用二阶近似量化每个高斯空间参数对重建误差的敏感性，替代启发式剪枝准则。
2406.10219|v2.result: 在显著更高压缩率下保持视觉保真度和前景细节，优于现有剪枝方法。

2511.05832|v2.summary_cn: 全局自注意力在图像高分辨率下计算与内存开销呈二次增长，局部注意力虽能降低复杂度，但传统窗口内 token 在 1D 序列中不连续，导致块稀疏核难以获得实际加速。本文提出基于 Hilbert 曲线的窗口与邻域构造方法：先沿 Hilbert 曲线重排图像 token，再在重排后的 1D 序列上形成窗口与邻域，从而显著提升块稀疏性，可与现有块稀疏核结合加速 2D 局部注意力。实验表明 Hilbert Window Attention 与 Hilbert Slide Attention 分别将窗口注意力和滑动注意力加速约 4 倍与 18 倍，并实例化为 Hilbert Window Transformer 与 Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer 实现端到端加速。
2511.05832|v2.summary_en: Global self-attention suffers from quadratic compute and memory costs at high image resolutions, while conventional local attention patterns fail to yield real speedups because tokens within a window are non-contiguous in the 1D sequence. This work proposes constructing windows and neighborhoods along a Hilbert curve, reordering image tokens into a 1D sequence to substantially increase block sparsity and enabling combination with existing block-sparse kernels. Experiments show about 4x and 18x acceleration for window and slide attention respectively, instantiated as the Hilbert Window Transformer and Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer with end-to-end gains.
2511.05832|v2.assessment: 该工作从块稀疏视角重新审视局部注意力的效率瓶颈，Hilbert 曲线重排的思路简洁且与现有稀疏核兼容，对高分辨率视觉 Transformer 的工程落地有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务本身关联较弱。
2511.05832|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Hilbert 曲线重排 token 的窗口与邻域构造策略，显著提升局部注意力的块稀疏性并实现实际加速。
2511.05832|v2.innovation: 利用 Hilbert 曲线的空间局部性保持特性，将 2D 局部注意力转化为 1D 序列上高块稀疏度的注意力模式。
2511.05832|v2.result: 窗口注意力与滑动注意力分别加速约 4 倍和 18 倍，并实例化为两种 Transformer 实现端到端加速。

2001.05119|v2.summary_cn: 多视角3D点云配准通常采用两阶段流程：先做成对初始对齐，再做全局一致性优化，但相邻点云重叠低、对称结构和重复场景会导致初始对齐歧义。本文提出首个端到端可学习算法，将两阶段联合训练，通过全局循环一致性来消解歧义。在标准基准上显著超越当时SOTA，且计算开销更低，并给出消融验证各组件有效性。
2001.05119|v2.summary_en: Multiview 3D point cloud registration is typically solved in two stages: pairwise alignment followed by globally consistent refinement, where the former is ambiguous due to low overlap, symmetries, and repetitive structures. This paper proposes the first end-to-end learnable algorithm that jointly trains both stages, leveraging cyclic consistency across scans to resolve ambiguity. It substantially outperforms the state of the art on standard benchmarks while being computationally cheaper, with ablations validating each component.
2001.05119|v2.assessment: 把多视角配准的两阶段问题首次做成端到端联合学习，思路清晰、实验扎实，对3D感知中的多帧融合有借鉴意义。
2001.05119|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端联合学习成对对齐与全局一致性优化的多视角3D点云配准算法。
2001.05119|v2.innovation: 用可微的全局循环一致性约束把两阶段配准统一到一个可训练框架中。
2001.05119|v2.result: 在标准基准上大幅超越SOTA，同时计算成本更低，并通过消融验证了各模块贡献。

The abstract is missing, so the prediction task design and feature fusion scheme are unclear. Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对图结构数据的多视角表示学习问题，提出对比式多视角表示学习框架。摘要缺失，无法确认具体对比目标与增广策略。其核心应是将多视角对比学习从图像/视频推广到图数据，学习节点/图级表示。缺少实验数据，无法评估提升幅度。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view representation learning on graphs and proposes a contrastive multi-view framework. The abstract is missing, so the contrastive objective and augmentation strategies cannot be verified. The core idea is to extend multi-view contrastive learning from images/videos to graph-structured data for node/graph-level representations, but quantitative gains are unavailable.
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.assessment: 对比式多视角学习在图数据上的代表工作，方法思路对自监督表示学习有参考价值，但摘要缺失影响细节评估。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.contribution: 提出面向图数据的对比式多视角表示学习框架。

Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中因缺乏真实深度标注而导致的尺度模糊与精度受限问题，提出用混合离散-连续（MED）概率体积来建模深度分布，替代传统的逐像素回归或分类方式。方法上通过概率体积表示每个像素的深度不确定性，并设计相应的自监督训练损失，使网络能在无 LiDAR 监督下学习更鲁棒的深度估计。相比已有自监督深度估计方法，其改进点在于更精细地刻画深度多模态分布，缓解边界与远距离区域的回归误差。摘要未给出具体量化结果，需进一步查看实验部分验证其效果。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the scale ambiguity and limited accuracy of self-supervised monocular depth estimation caused by the absence of ground-truth depth annotations, proposing Mixed Discrete-Continuous (MED) probability volumes to model per-pixel depth distributions instead of conventional regression or classification. A self-supervised training objective is designed around these probability volumes, enabling robust depth learning without LiDAR supervision. The key improvement lies in better capturing multi-modal depth distributions, mitigating regression errors at boundaries and distant regions, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.assessment: 选题切中自监督深度估计的核心痛点，概率体积建模思路有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际精度与泛化性。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.contribution: 提出用混合离散-连续概率体积建模单目自监督深度估计的深度分布。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.innovation: 以概率体积替代逐像素回归，更精细地刻画深度不确定性。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，效果有待实验验证。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised._arxiv_id: Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised Depth Estimators with MED Probability Volumes.

Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多视角多人物3D姿态估计问题，旨在从多个相机视角恢复多人3D骨架。②提出基于平面扫描立体（plane sweep stereo）的方法，将多视角信息融合到3D空间中定位人体关节。③相比已有单视角或双视角方法，利用多视角几何约束提升遮挡和深度歧义下的鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by recovering 3D skeletons of multiple people from multiple camera views. It proposes a plane sweep stereo approach that fuses multi-view information in 3D space to localize human joints. Compared with single- or dual-view methods, it leverages multi-view geometric constraints to improve robustness under occlusion and depth ambiguity. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.assessment: 该工作属于多视角人体姿态估计，与自动驾驶感知中的3D检测关联较弱，但多视角几何融合思路对BEV感知有一定参考价值。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.contribution: 提出基于平面扫描立体的多视角多人物3D姿态估计方法。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.innovation: 将平面扫描立体引入多视角多人3D姿态估计以融合多视角几何约束。

Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多视角人群计数问题，解决跨视角、跨场景下模型泛化能力差的问题。②提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数框架，通过视角间和场景间的特征对齐提升泛化性。③相比已有单场景训练方法，强调跨场景迁移能力。④摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-view crowd counting, focusing on poor generalization across views and scenes. It proposes a cross-view cross-scene framework that aligns features across views and scenes to improve generalization. Compared with prior single-scene training methods, it emphasizes cross-scene transferability. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶多相机感知关联有限，但跨视角跨场景泛化思路对多相机BEV感知的域适应有借鉴意义。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.contribution: 提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数框架。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.innovation: 通过视角间与场景间特征对齐提升跨场景泛化能力。

COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_cn: ①该论文针对不完整多视角聚类问题，解决视角缺失时聚类性能下降的问题。②提出COMPLETER框架，通过对比预测学习视角间的一致表示以恢复缺失视角信息。③相比已有不完整多视角聚类方法，引入对比学习与预测机制联合优化。④摘要未提供具体量化结果。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering where some views are missing. It proposes COMPLETER, a framework that learns consistent representations via contrastive prediction to recover missing view information. Compared with prior incomplete multi-view clustering methods, it jointly optimizes contrastive learning and prediction. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.assessment: 该工作属于多视角聚类，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但对比预测思路对自监督多模态表示学习有参考价值。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.contribution: 提出基于对比预测的不完整多视角聚类框架COMPLETER。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.innovation: 将对比学习与预测机制结合以处理视角缺失。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标。

Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_cn: ①该论文针对无纹理光滑表面在未知通用反射率下的多视角3D重建问题。②提出多视角重建方法，在未知反射率条件下恢复光滑表面几何。③相比已有假设已知反射率或依赖纹理的方法，放宽了对表面反射率和纹理的假设。④摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view 3D reconstruction of texture-less smooth surfaces with unknown generic reflectance. It proposes a multi-view reconstruction method that recovers smooth surface geometry under unknown reflectance. Compared with methods assuming known reflectance or relying on texture, it relaxes assumptions on surface reflectance and texture. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.assessment: 该工作属于多视角几何重建，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱，但对无纹理表面重建有理论价值。

Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.innovation: 在未知反射率条件下实现无纹理光滑表面重建。
