2012.02177|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视频流上的在线多视角深度预测问题，旨在高效利用时序几何信息。②提出DeepVideoMVS，在轻量编码器-解码器基础上于瓶颈层引入ConvLSTM，通过将上一时刻隐藏状态按视角变化 warp 到当前相机平面来传播时序信息。③相比已有MVS方法，创新在于考虑视角变化的隐藏状态传播，且计算与内存开销小。④在数百个室内场景中大多数指标上超越现有SOTA MVS方法，同时保持实时性能。
2012.02177|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses online multi-view depth prediction on posed video streams, aiming to efficiently exploit temporal geometry. It proposes DeepVideoMVS, which augments a lightweight cost-volume encoder-decoder with a ConvLSTM at the bottleneck, propagating the previous hidden state by warping it into the current camera plane according to viewpoint changes. The novelty lies in viewpoint-aware hidden state propagation with minimal compute and memory overhead. It outperforms state-of-the-art MVS methods on most metrics across hundreds of indoor scenes while maintaining real-time performance.
2012.02177|v2.assessment: 该工作将时序递归融合引入MVS，实时性与精度兼顾，对自动驾驶中基于视频的深度估计与BEV时序融合有较强参考价值。
2012.02177|v2.contribution: 提出考虑视角变化的ConvLSTM时序传播的在线多视角深度预测方法DeepVideoMVS。
2012.02177|v2.innovation: 通过warp隐藏状态实现视角感知的时序信息传播。
2012.02177|v2.result: 在数百个室内场景大多数指标上超越SOTA MVS方法并保持实时性能。

2011.12104|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对无监督非刚性表面配准问题，解决高自由度与缺乏标注数据的挑战。②提出RMA-Net，用逐点组合多个刚性变换表示非刚性变换，并以循环框架迭代求解，同时引入基于多视角2D深度图投影的可微损失实现端到端无监督训练。③相比已有方法，表示使解空间受约束且降低学习难度，损失无需真值监督。④在多个数据集上大幅超越此前SOTA。
2011.12104|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised non-rigid surface registration, tackling high degrees of freedom and lack of labeled data. It proposes RMA-Net, representing non-rigid transformations as point-wise combinations of rigid transformations solved iteratively in a recurrent framework, with a differentiable loss measuring 3D shape similarity on projected multi-view 2D depth images for end-to-end unsupervised training. This constrains the solution space and eases learning without ground-truth supervision. It outperforms prior state-of-the-art by a large margin on several datasets.
2011.12104|v2.assessment: 该工作属于医学/图形学非刚性配准，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱，但其多视角可微投影损失与循环迭代思路对无监督几何学习有启发。
2011.12104|v2.contribution: 提出循环多视角对齐网络RMA-Net实现无监督非刚性表面配准。
2011.12104|v2.innovation: 用逐点刚性变换组合表示非刚性变换并结合多视角深度投影可微损失。
2011.12104|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越此前SOTA。

2106.08917|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图稠密深度估计问题，论文提出可微扩散（differentiable diffusion）方法，将稀疏点优化为稠密深度图，通过可微splatting将点建模为带解析透射率的高斯，并设计高效优化流程同时优化5万+个点。相比传统图像处理和深度学习方法，该方法在光场和宽基线图像自监督设定下，对不准确稀疏点扩散得到的深度图在平均误差和离群误差上均有改善，并验证了高重建质量。
2106.08917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense depth estimation from multi-view images by optimizing a sparse set of points whose diffusion into a depth map minimizes multi-view reprojection error under RGB supervision. It introduces differentiable splatting that models points as Gaussians with analytic transmittance and an efficient routine that jointly optimizes over 50k points. Experiments show improved average and outlier depth errors over image processing and deep learning baselines, with high reconstruction quality validated on ground-truth data.
2106.08917|v2.assessment: 将可微渲染与稀疏点优化结合用于多视图深度估计，思路新颖，但整体与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测主线关联有限。
2106.08917|v2.contribution: 提出可微扩散框架，通过优化稀疏点的高斯splatting实现多视图稠密深度估计。
2106.08917|v2.innovation: 用解析透射率的高斯建模点并支持5万+点同时优化，实现端到端可微的稀疏到稠密深度扩散。
2106.08917|v2.result: 在光场和宽基线图像自监督设定下，平均误差和离群误差均优于图像处理与深度学习方法。

2103.07738|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对深度多视图聚类中表示对齐的缺陷展开研究，指出朴素对齐表示分布会导致聚类可分性下降并抑制模型对视图的优先级选择能力。为此提出一个避免表示对齐的简单基线模型，并加入对比学习组件实现选择性对齐。实验表明该基线可媲美或超越当前最优方法，对比学习组件进一步大幅提升性能。
2103.07738|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies drawbacks of naïvely aligning view representation distributions in deep multi-view clustering, showing it reduces cluster separability and inhibits view prioritization. It proposes a simple baseline that avoids representation alignment altogether and augments it with a contrastive learning component for selective alignment. Experiments show the baseline matches or exceeds state of the art, with contrastive learning improving results by a large margin.
2103.07738|v2.assessment: 属于多视图聚类方向，与自动驾驶感知/3D检测领域关联很弱，但对表示学习有一定参考价值。
2103.07738|v2.contribution: 揭示多视图聚类中表示对齐的缺陷，并提出避免对齐的基线及选择性对齐的对比学习扩展。
2103.07738|v2.innovation: 用对比学习实现选择性对齐，在避免朴素对齐弊端的同时保留视图优先级能力。
2103.07738|v2.result: 基线模型媲美或超越SOTA，加入对比学习后在多个数据集上大幅领先。

2012.01411|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率多视图立体（MVS）中3D代价体正则化计算和内存开销大的问题，论文提出PatchmatchNet，将Patchmatch算法以可学习级联形式端到端集成，并引入迭代多尺度Patchmatch及可学习的自适应传播与评估方案。在DTU、Tanks & Temples和ETH3D上取得有竞争力的性能和泛化能力，速度至少比现有最优方法快2.5倍，内存占用减半。
2012.01411|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computation and memory cost of 3D cost volume regularization in high-resolution multi-view stereo by proposing PatchmatchNet, a learnable cascade formulation of Patchmatch with iterative multi-scale processing and learned adaptive propagation/evaluation. It achieves competitive performance and generalization on DTU, Tanks & Temples, and ETH3D, while being at least 2.5× faster and using half the memory of state-of-the-art methods.
2012.01411|v2.assessment: 将经典Patchmatch与可学习级联结合，在效率与精度间取得良好平衡，对多视图深度估计和3D重建有实用价值。
2012.01411|v2.contribution: 提出可学习的级联Patchmatch网络，实现高效高分辨率多视图立体匹配。
2012.01411|v2.innovation: 首次在端到端可训练架构中引入迭代多尺度Patchmatch，并设计可学习的自适应传播与评估。
2012.01411|v2.result: 在DTU、Tanks & Temples和ETH3D上性能有竞争力，速度至少快2.5倍，内存减半。

2102.13090|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对复杂场景的新视角合成问题，提出IBRNet，通过插值稀疏邻近视图合成新视图。核心是一个包含MLP和ray transformer的网络，在连续5D位置估计辐射亮度和体密度，并从多个源视图动态提取外观信息。与逐场景优化的神经渲染方法不同，该方法学习通用的视图插值函数，可泛化到新场景，仅用多视图位姿图像监督训练，性能优于近期泛化型新视角合成方法，微调后可与单场景SOTA竞争。
2102.13090|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses novel view synthesis of complex scenes by interpolating a sparse set of nearby views. IBRNet uses an MLP and ray transformer to estimate radiance and volume density at continuous 5D locations, drawing appearance from multiple source views on the fly. Unlike per-scene neural rendering, it learns a generic view interpolation function that generalizes to novel scenes and is trained only with multi-view posed images, outperforming recent generalizable methods and matching single-scene state of the art after fine-tuning.
2102.13090|v2.assessment: 将IBR思想与神经渲染结合，泛化能力强，对多视图感知和神经渲染交叉方向有较高参考价值。
2102.13090|v2.contribution: 提出IBRNet，学习可泛化的多视图图像插值函数用于新视角合成。
2102.13090|v2.innovation: 用ray transformer从多源视图动态提取外观，实现无需逐场景优化的通用神经渲染。
2102.13090|v2.result: 优于近期泛化型新视角合成方法，微调后可与单场景SOTA竞争。

2106.06856|v2.summary_cn: 多相机多目标跟踪（MC-MOT）中的数据关联问题因光照不一致、运动模式变化和跨相机轨迹遮挡而极具挑战。本文提出动态图模型DyGLIP，将数据关联建模为图上的链接预测任务，利用动态图结构学习更好的特征表示，并能在相机切换时恢复丢失的轨迹。相比已有方法，该模型不依赖相机重叠比例，在多个实际数据集上大幅超越现有MC-MOT算法，且适用于在线场景并可扩展至增量设置。
2106.06856|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multi-camera multi-object tracking (MC-MOT), which is challenging due to inconsistent lighting, varying motion patterns, and cross-camera occlusions. It proposes DyGLIP, a dynamic graph model with link prediction that learns better feature representations and can recover lost tracks during camera transitions. The model outperforms existing MC-MOT algorithms by a large margin on several practical datasets, works regardless of camera overlap ratios, and supports online and incremental settings.
2106.06856|v2.assessment: 该工作将动态图链接预测引入多相机跟踪的数据关联，思路新颖且实用性强，对自动驾驶多相机感知中的跨相机目标关联有直接参考价值。
2106.06856|v2.contribution: 提出基于动态图链接预测的MC-MOT数据关联框架DyGLIP。
2106.06856|v2.innovation: 利用动态图结构建模轨迹关联并支持相机切换时的轨迹恢复。
2106.06856|v2.result: 在多个实际数据集上大幅超越现有MC-MOT算法，且不依赖相机重叠比例。

2104.08568|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型广基线场景（如建筑工地、体育场、公共空间）中相机网络3D位姿估计问题，传统SfM因难以匹配跨视角3D关键点而失效。本文提出利用行人作为'关键点'，借助行人重识别（re-ID）方法关联跨相机的人体检测框，将检测框对应关系转化为点对应，再用多视图几何和光束法平差求解相机位姿。该方法无需专用标定靶标，仅依赖可见行人，适用于需要频繁重新标定的场景，并在多个不同场景数据集上进行了大量实验。
2104.08568|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles wide-baseline multi-camera calibration for large environments where standard SfM fails due to difficulty in matching 3D keypoints across very different views. It proposes using person re-identification to associate human bounding boxes across cameras, converting box correspondences to point correspondences, and solving camera pose via multi-view geometry and bundle adjustment. Requiring only visible people rather than specialized targets, the method suits scenarios needing frequent recalibration and is extensively evaluated on datasets from diverse scenes.
2104.08568|v2.assessment: 将行人重识别用于广基线相机标定是一个巧妙且实用的思路，对自动驾驶和智能交通中的多相机系统部署有参考意义。
2104.08568|v2.contribution: 提出基于行人重识别的广基线多相机标定方法。
2104.08568|v2.innovation: 以行人为自然标定关键点，通过re-ID建立跨相机对应关系。
2104.08568|v2.result: 无需专用标定靶标即可求解相机位姿，在多个不同场景数据集上验证有效。

2101.01602|v2.summary_cn: 神经辐射场（NeRF）类方法能将多视角场景压缩为从视线到辐射值的映射，但一旦场景中有物体运动便失去预测能力。本文提出STaR，在多视角RGB视频中自监督地同时进行刚性运动物体的跟踪与重建，无需任何人工标注。方法通过联合优化两个神经辐射场参数和一组刚性位姿，将动态场景分解为静态背景和运动物体两部分，每部分用独立神经表示编码。在合成和真实数据集上，该方法能渲染出时空维度上均具真实感的新视角图像。
2101.01602|v2.summary_en: Neural radiance field methods lose predictive power once objects in the scene move. This paper presents STaR, a self-supervised method that jointly tracks and reconstructs rigid objects in motion from multi-view RGB videos without manual annotation. By jointly optimizing two neural radiance fields and a set of rigid poses, it decomposes a dynamic scene into static and moving parts, each with its own neural representation, achieving photorealistic novel view synthesis on both synthetic and real datasets.
2101.01602|v2.assessment: 将刚性运动建模引入神经辐射场实现自监督动态场景重建，对动态场景理解与自监督表示学习有启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2101.01602|v2.contribution: 提出自监督联合跟踪与重建刚性运动物体的神经渲染方法STaR。
2101.01602|v2.innovation: 联合优化两个神经辐射场与刚性位姿实现动态场景分解。
2101.01602|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据集上实现时空维度均真实的新视角渲染。

2110.04361|v2.summary_cn: 自监督学习在图像、音频、文本上成效显著，主要依赖数据中的空间、时间或语义结构进行增强，但表格数据缺乏此类结构，难以设计有效增强方法。本文提出SubTab框架，将表格数据的输入特征划分为多个子集，把学习任务转化为多视图表示学习问题。作者认为在自编码器框架下从特征子集重建数据比从损坏版本重建更能捕捉潜在表示，测试时通过聚合各子集隐变量的协同推理得到联合表示。实验表明SubTab达到表格数据自监督学习的先进水平。
2110.04361|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised learning has succeeded on images, audio, and text by exploiting spatial, temporal, or semantic structure for augmentation, but tabular data lacks such structure. This paper introduces SubTab, which divides input features into multiple subsets to cast tabular learning as multi-view representation learning, arguing that reconstructing data from feature subsets better captures latent representations than reconstructing corrupted versions. Experiments show SubTab achieves state-of-the-art results in tabular self-supervised learning.
2110.04361|v2.assessment: 将多视图自监督思想迁移到表格数据是一个有价值的探索，但与自动驾驶视觉感知领域关联很弱。
2110.04361|v2.contribution: 提出面向表格数据的多视图自监督表示学习框架SubTab。
2110.04361|v2.innovation: 通过特征子集划分与协同推理将表格学习转化为多视图表示学习。
2110.04361|v2.result: 在表格数据自监督学习任务上达到先进水平。

2203.14712|v2.summary_cn: 针对程序性活动理解缺乏大规模多视角数据的问题，论文构建了Assembly101数据集，包含4321段拆装101种玩具车的视频，同时采集8路静态视角与4路第一视角，并标注超10万段粗粒度、100万段细粒度动作片段及1800万3D手部姿态。作者在动作识别、预测、时序分割三个任务上建立基准，并提出错误检测这一新任务。该数据集支持对新玩具泛化、跨视角迁移、长尾分布以及姿态与外观对比等研究，为活动理解提供了新的挑战性平台。
2203.14712|v2.summary_en: Assembly101 is a large-scale multi-view procedural activity dataset comprising 4321 videos of assembling and disassembling 101 take-apart toy vehicles, with 8 static and 4 egocentric views, over 100K coarse and 1M fine-grained action segments, and 18M 3D hand poses. It benchmarks action recognition, anticipation, and temporal segmentation, and introduces a novel mistake detection task. The dataset enables studies on generalization to new toys, cross-view transfer, long-tailed distributions, and pose vs. appearance.
2203.14712|v2.assessment: 该数据集规模大、标注丰富且多视角同步，为程序性活动理解与视频理解研究提供了重要基准，值得关注。
2203.14712|v2.contribution: 构建了首个多视角程序性活动数据集Assembly101，并提供大规模细粒度标注与多任务基准。
2203.14712|v2.innovation: 首次同时采集静态与第一视角，并提出错误检测新任务及跨视角、长尾等分析维度。
2203.14712|v2.result: 提供4321段视频、100万+细粒度动作片段和1800万3D手部姿态，建立三个任务基准并揭示泛化与跨视角挑战。

SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_cn: 针对多视角相机图像3D目标检测中跨传感器信息利用不足与可扩展性问题，论文提出SpatialDETR，一种基于Transformer的鲁棒可扩展3D检测方法。该方法通过全局跨传感器注意力机制，将多视角图像特征与3D空间位置进行交互，实现端到端3D框预测。相比已有方法，其强调全局注意力与跨传感器融合，提升了检测的鲁棒性和可扩展性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法在架构上具有创新性。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_en: SpatialDETR addresses robust and scalable 3D object detection from multi-view camera images by introducing a transformer-based architecture with global cross-sensor attention. It enables end-to-end 3D box prediction by interacting multi-view image features with 3D spatial positions. The method emphasizes global attention and cross-sensor fusion to improve robustness and scalability.

2203.16317|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签与一致性训练忽视检测特性导致无标签数据学习效率低的问题，论文提出PseCo。在伪标签方面，设计噪声伪框学习（NPL），包括预测引导标签分配（PLA）和正样本一致性投票（PCV），以提升对粗糙伪框的鲁棒性和定位质量评估；在一致性训练方面，提出多视角尺度不变学习（MSL），同时考虑标签级与特征级一致性。相比已有方法，PseCo更充分地利用了检测的定位与尺度特性，在SSOD基准上取得了显著提升。
2203.16317|v2.summary_en: PseCo tackles semi-supervised object detection by improving pseudo labeling and consistency training. It introduces Noisy Pseudo box Learning (NPL) with Prediction-guided Label Assignment (PLA) and Positive-proposal Consistency Voting (PCV) to handle coarse pseudo boxes, and Multi-view Scale-invariant Learning (MSL) for both label-level and feature-level consistency. The method achieves significant improvements on SSOD benchmarks.
2203.16317|v2.assessment: 该工作深入分析了SSOD中伪标签与一致性训练的关键缺陷，提出的NPL和MSL有效且通用，值得关注。
2203.16317|v2.contribution: 提出PseCo框架，通过NPL和MSL解决半监督目标检测中伪标签噪声与尺度一致性问题。
2203.16317|v2.innovation: 结合预测引导标签分配与正样本一致性投票，并引入多视角尺度不变学习。
2203.16317|v2.result: 在SSOD基准上取得显著性能提升，有效利用无标签数据。

2203.05625|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D目标检测中3D位置信息编码不足的问题，论文提出位置嵌入变换（PETR）。PETR将3D坐标的位置信息编码到图像特征中，生成3D位置感知特征，使目标查询能够感知3D位置并执行端到端检测。在nuScenes数据集上，PETR取得50.4% NDS和44.1% mAP的最优性能，并在基准上排名第一。该方法简单而强大，可作为未来研究的基线。
2203.05625|v2.summary_en: PETR addresses multi-view 3D object detection by encoding 3D position information into image features via position embedding transformation, producing 3D position-aware features for end-to-end detection. It achieves state-of-the-art 50.4% NDS and 44.1% mAP on nuScenes, ranking first on the benchmark. The method is simple yet strong, serving as a baseline for future research.
2203.05625|v2.assessment: PETR以简洁有效的位置编码方式显著提升多视角3D检测性能，是自动驾驶感知领域的重要工作，强烈推荐。
2203.05625|v2.contribution: 提出位置嵌入变换PETR，将3D坐标位置信息编码进图像特征实现端到端多视角3D检测。

2203.03949|v2.summary_cn: 无监督多视图立体（MVS）中，非朗伯表面和遮挡导致跨视图对应关系模糊，现有方法假设对应像素具有相似光度特征而失效。本文提出 RC-MVSNet，通过神经渲染引入深度渲染一致性损失约束物体表面附近的几何特征以缓解遮挡，并引入参考视图合成损失为非朗伯表面生成一致监督。在 DTU 和 Tanks&Temples 基准上，该方法在无监督 MVS 框架中达到 SOTA，并与许多监督方法性能相当。
2203.03949|v2.summary_en: Unsupervised multi-view stereo (MVS) struggles with correspondence ambiguity caused by non-Lambertian surfaces and occlusions, as existing methods assume photometric similarity between corresponding pixels. RC-MVSNet introduces neural rendering with a depth rendering consistency loss to constrain geometry features near object surfaces and a reference view synthesis loss to provide consistent supervision for non-Lambertian surfaces. It achieves state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised MVS frameworks on DTU and Tanks&Temples, competitive with many supervised methods.
2203.03949|v2.assessment: 将神经渲染引入无监督 MVS 以解决非朗伯与遮挡问题，思路新颖且实验充分，对多视图几何感知有参考价值。
2203.03949|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经渲染的无监督 MVS 框架 RC-MVSNet，通过深度渲染一致性和参考视图合成损失解决跨视图对应模糊问题。
2203.03949|v2.innovation: 利用神经渲染的深度渲染一致性损失和参考视图合成损失，分别缓解遮挡和非朗伯表面带来的监督信号缺失。

2207.14287|v2.summary_cn: 现代 3D 视觉方法依赖将图像映射到代价体或对极约束等经典几何结构来提升匹配，但这些架构针对特定问题设计，需要大量任务特定调优且域泛化性能差。本文提出 Depth Field Networks (DeFiNe)，学习隐式多视图一致场景表示，引入一系列 3D 数据增强作为几何归纳先验以增加视图多样性，并将视图合成作为辅助任务进一步提升深度估计。该方法在立体和视频深度估计上无需显式几何约束即达到 SOTA，零样本域泛化性能大幅提升。
2207.14287|v2.summary_en: Modern 3D vision methods map image data to classical geometric structures like cost volumes or epipolar constraints, but these task-specific architectures require significant tuning and generalize poorly across domains. DeFiNe learns an implicit, multi-view consistent scene representation, introducing 3D data augmentation as a geometric inductive prior and view synthesis as an auxiliary task. It achieves state-of-the-art stereo and video depth estimation without explicit geometric constraints, with significantly improved zero-shot domain generalization.
2207.14287|v2.assessment: 以隐式场景表示替代显式几何约束，结合数据增强和视图合成辅助任务，在泛化性上有显著突破，对多视图感知有重要启发。
2207.14287|v2.contribution: 提出 Depth Field Networks (DeFiNe)，学习隐式多视图一致场景表示，无需显式几何约束即可实现 SOTA 深度估计和域泛化。
2207.14287|v2.innovation: 用隐式多视图一致场景表示替代传统代价体/对极约束，并引入 3D 数据增强和视图合成辅助任务增强泛化。
2207.14287|v2.result: 在立体和视频深度估计上达到 SOTA，零样本域泛化性能大幅提升。

2207.14067|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角图像中头发几何与外观的高保真建模问题，提出Neural Strands框架。方法上设计了基于神经头皮纹理的头发表示，在每个texel位置编码单根发丝的几何与外观，并引入基于光栅化的神经渲染框架，实现发丝级精确且抗锯齿的渲染。相比体素化方法，该表示支持直观的形状与风格控制，并首次实现从多视角设置中联合学习外观与显式头发几何。实验表明该方法在多种发型上实现了高保真、视角一致且实时的渲染效果。
2207.14067|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high-fidelity hair geometry and appearance modeling from multi-view images by proposing Neural Strands, a learning framework based on a neural scalp texture that encodes per-strand geometry and appearance at each texel. A rasterization-based neural rendering framework enables strand-accurate, anti-aliased, and view-consistent rendering with intuitive shape and style control. It is the first to jointly learn appearance and explicit hair geometry from multi-view inputs, achieving photorealistic real-time rendering across various hairstyles.
2207.14067|v2.assessment: 该工作将神经渲染与显式发丝几何结合，在头发建模这一细分方向上具有较高的技术完成度，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2207.14067|v2.contribution: 提出了基于神经头皮纹理的显式发丝表示及配套的光栅化神经渲染框架，首次实现多视角下头发外观与几何的联合学习。
2207.14067|v2.innovation: 用神经头皮纹理编码单根发丝的几何与外观，并结合光栅化实现发丝级精确、抗锯齿且支持风格控制的实时渲染。
2207.14067|v2.result: 在多种发型上实现了高保真、视角一致、实时的渲染，并支持直观的形状与风格编辑。

2208.08580|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对细粒度3D形状分割中标注数据有限的问题，提出利用2D域自监督技术来提升3D分割性能。方法上将3D形状渲染为多视角图像，在对比学习框架下构建密集对应学习任务，使学到的2D表示具有视角不变性和几何一致性。在RenderPeople和PartNet数据集上，该方法在细粒度部件分割上优于现有方案，尤其在训练视角稀疏或形状带纹理时提升更显著，表明其同时受益于2D处理和3D几何推理。
2208.08580|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles fine-grained 3D shape segmentation under limited labels by leveraging 2D self-supervision. It renders 3D shapes from multiple views and performs dense correspondence learning within a contrastive framework, yielding view-invariant and geometrically consistent 2D representations. Experiments on RenderPeople and PartNet show superior fine-grained part segmentation, with larger gains when training views are sparse or shapes are textured.
2208.08580|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙地将2D自监督对比学习迁移到3D形状分割，思路清晰且实验验证充分，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2208.08580|v2.contribution: 提出MvDeCor，通过多视角渲染与对比学习实现视角不变、几何一致的2D表示，用于细粒度3D形状分割。
2208.08580|v2.innovation: 在对比学习框架下构建多视角密集对应任务，融合2D自监督与3D几何推理以提升有限标注下的泛化能力。
2208.08580|v2.result: 在RenderPeople和PartNet上细粒度部件分割超越现有方法，在稀疏视角或带纹理形状上提升更明显。

2203.11397|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角3D重建缺乏真实世界基准数据集的问题，构建了一个包含998个日常桌面物体3D模型及847,000张真实RGB-D图像的数据集。通过半自动化方式对每张图像的相机位姿和物体位姿进行精确标注，支持形状重建、物体位姿估计、形状检索等多种3D应用。作者以多视角3D重建为主要任务验证了该数据集能填补真实世界基准的空白，并公开了标注工具和评估基线代码。
2203.11397|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real-world benchmarks for multi-view 3D reconstruction by introducing a dataset of 998 tabletop object 3D models with 847,000 real RGB-D images. Camera and object poses are semi-automatically annotated to support tasks like shape reconstruction, pose estimation, and shape retrieval. The authors demonstrate its utility for multi-view 3D reconstruction and release annotation tools and evaluation baselines.
2203.11397|v2.assessment: 该数据集为真实世界多视角3D重建提供了有价值的基准，但规模限于桌面物体，与自动驾驶场景的关联有限。
2203.11397|v2.contribution: 构建并公开了一个包含998个3D模型和847,000张真实RGB-D图像的多视角3D重建数据集及配套标注工具与基线。
2203.11397|v2.innovation: 通过半自动化标注流程为每张图像提供精确的相机与物体位姿，填补了真实世界多视角3D重建基准的空白。
2203.11397|v2.result: 数据集可有效支持多视角3D重建等任务，并提供了公开的标注工具和评估基线。

2204.07346|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于学习的多视角立体（MVS）方法中融合步骤依赖额外网络学习2D线索、忽视3D空间关联且计算开销大的问题，提出MVSTER。方法上利用极线Transformer，通过可拆卸的单目深度估计器增强2D语义，并用交叉注意力沿极线构建数据依赖的3D关联；同时采用级联结构，利用熵正则化最优传输在各阶段传播更精细的深度估计。实验表明MVSTER在DTU基准上相比MVSNet和CasMVSNet分别取得34%和14%的相对提升，同时效率显著更高。
2204.07346|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficiencies in learning-based Multi-View Stereo where fusion relies on extra networks for 2D cues while underusing 3D spatial correlations. MVSTER introduces an epipolar Transformer that enhances 2D semantics via a detachable monocular depth estimator and builds data-dependent 3D associations along epipolar lines using cross-attention. A cascade structure with entropy-regularized optimal transport propagates finer depth estimates, achieving 34% and 14% relative improvements over MVSNet and CasMVSNet on DTU with significantly higher efficiency.
2204.07346|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer与极线几何结合用于MVS，在精度和效率上均有显著提升，对3D感知相关研究有参考价值。
2204.07346|v2.contribution: 提出MVSTER，利用极线Transformer高效学习2D语义与3D空间关联，并结合级联结构与最优传输进行深度传播。
2204.07346|v2.innovation: 用交叉注意力沿极线构建数据依赖的3D关联，并以熵正则化最优传输在级联结构中传播精细深度估计。
2204.07346|v2.result: 在DTU基准上相比MVSNet和CasMVSNet分别取得34%和14%的相对提升，且效率显著更高。

2207.11406|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统多视角光度立体（MVPS）方法由多个独立阶段组成、误差累积明显的问题，提出基于隐式表示的神经逆渲染方法PS-NeRF。方法首先利用多光照图像估计每视角表面法线图，用于正则化从神经辐射场导出的法线，然后基于阴影感知的可微渲染层联合优化表面法线、空间变化BRDF和光照。在合成和真实数据集上，该方法在形状重建精度上显著优于现有MVPS和神经渲染方法，并支持新视角渲染、重光照和材质编辑。
2207.11406|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses error accumulation in traditional multi-view photometric stereo (MVPS) caused by disjoint processing stages by proposing PS-NeRF, a neural inverse rendering method based on implicit representation. It estimates per-view normal maps from multi-light images to regularize NeRF-derived normals, then jointly optimizes normals, spatially-varying BRDFs, and lights via a shadow-aware differentiable rendering layer. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show far more accurate shape reconstruction than existing MVPS and neural rendering methods, enabling novel-view rendering, relighting, and material editing.
2207.11406|v2.assessment: 该工作将神经逆渲染与光度立体结合，在形状重建精度上提升显著，但面向物体级重建，与自动驾驶场景关联有限。
2207.11406|v2.contribution: 提出PS-NeRF，基于隐式表示联合估计几何、材质和光照，实现端到端的多视角光度立体神经逆渲染。
2207.11406|v2.innovation: 用多光照法线图正则化NeRF法线，并通过阴影感知可微渲染层联合优化法线、空间变化BRDF与未知光照。
2207.11406|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据集上形状重建精度显著优于现有MVPS和神经渲染方法，并支持重光照与材质编辑。

MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_cn: 现有 amodal 实例分割数据集多聚焦于室内或自动驾驶场景，缺乏购物场景下多视角遮挡推理的大规模基准。本文提出 MUVA，一个面向购物场景的多视角 amodal 实例分割大规模基准，包含多相机视角、遮挡标注与 amodal 掩码。相比已有数据集，MUVA 在视角数量、遮挡复杂度和场景多样性上有明显提升，为遮挡推理与多视角感知研究提供了新测试平台。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_en: Existing amodal instance segmentation benchmarks mainly target indoor or driving scenes, lacking large-scale multi-view evaluation for shopping scenarios. This paper introduces MUVA, a large-scale benchmark for multi-view amodal instance segmentation in shopping environments with multi-camera views and occlusion annotations. It advances prior datasets in view diversity and occlusion complexity, offering a new testbed for occlusion reasoning and multi-view perception.
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.assessment: 对多视角遮挡推理与 amodal 感知有参考价值，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务相关度中等。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.contribution: 构建了购物场景下多视角 amodal 实例分割的大规模基准 MUVA。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.innovation: 将多视角与 amodal 分割结合并引入购物场景的复杂遮挡标注。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.result: 为多视角遮挡推理提供了新的评测平台与基线。

2304.10628|v2.summary_cn: 现有 V2V 协同感知工作假设所有车辆配备同类型传感器，限制了跨模态协作的规模与收益。本文提出 HM-ViT，首个统一的多智能体异构模态协同感知框架，可对数量与模态各异的智能体协同预测 3D 目标。方法设计异构 3D 图 Transformer，联合推理智能体间与智能体内部的交互，融合多视角图像与 LiDAR 点云特征。在 OPV2V 数据集上，HM-ViT 在异构模态 V2V 协同感知上超越 SOTA 方法。
2304.10628|v2.summary_en: Existing V2V cooperative perception assumes homogeneous sensor configurations, limiting cross-modal collaboration. This paper presents HM-ViT, the first unified multi-agent hetero-modal cooperative perception framework that predicts 3D objects for dynamic V2V collaborations with varying agent numbers and modalities. A heterogeneous 3D graph transformer jointly reasons inter- and intra-agent interactions to fuse multi-view images and LiDAR. Experiments on OPV2V show HM-ViT outperforms state-of-the-art cooperative perception methods under hetero-modal settings.
2304.10628|v2.assessment: 异构模态协同感知是自动驾驶感知的重要前沿，方法设计与实验均较扎实，值得重点关注。
2304.10628|v2.contribution: 提出首个统一的多智能体异构模态 V2V 协同感知框架 HM-ViT。
2304.10628|v2.innovation: 设计异构 3D 图 Transformer 联合建模智能体间与智能体内部交互以融合图像与点云。
2304.10628|v2.result: 在 OPV2V 上于异构模态协同感知任务中超越现有 SOTA 方法。

2304.02950|v2.summary_cn: 域偏移会显著降低目标检测模型在实际应用中的性能，已有域对抗学习（DAL）方法试图从源域解耦域不变特征，但忽略了公共特征中隐含的非因果因素。本文从因果机制出发，提出多视角对抗判别器（MAD）域泛化模型，包含随机增强源域的 Spurious Correlations Generator 与将特征映射到多潜在空间的多视角域分类器（MVDC）。通过多视角对抗训练，MAD 去除非因果因素并纯化域不变特征，在未见域目标检测上取得改进。
2304.02950|v2.summary_en: Domain shift degrades object detection in practice, and prior domain adversarial learning ignores implicit non-causal factors in common features. Inspired by causal mechanisms, this paper proposes a Multi-view Adversarial Discriminator (MAD) for domain generalization, comprising a Spurious Correlations Generator for source augmentation and a Multi-View Domain Classifier mapping features to multiple latent spaces. Multi-view adversarial training removes non-causal factors and purifies domain-invariant features, improving detection in unseen domains.
2304.02950|v2.assessment: 从因果视角切入域泛化检测，思路新颖，对鲁棒感知研究有启发。
2304.02950|v2.contribution: 提出基于多视角对抗判别的域泛化目标检测模型 MAD。
2304.02950|v2.innovation: 利用多潜在空间对抗训练去除公共特征中的非因果因素。
2304.02950|v2.result: 在未见域目标检测任务上提升了域不变特征的纯度与检测性能。

2303.13560|v2.summary_cn: 纯视觉 3D 检测因缺乏直接 3D 测量而难以精确估计深度，已有方法多通过网络结构改进（如可变形层、大感受野）来缓解。本文提出正交思路，通过多智能体协作提升纯视觉 3D 检测，即 CoCa3D，智能体间共享互补信息并选择最具信息量的线索以优化通信效率。多视角共享消息可消解单智能体深度歧义并补全遮挡与远距离区域。在 DAIR-V2X、OPV2V+、CoPerception-UAVs+ 上，AP@70 分别较此前 SOTA 提升 44.21%、30.60%、12.59%。
2303.13560|v2.summary_en: Camera-only 3D detection suffers from imprecise depth estimation due to the lack of direct 3D measurements, and prior works mainly improve network designs. This paper proposes CoCa3D, a collaborative camera-only 3D detection framework where agents share complementary information and select the most informative cues for communication efficiency. Shared messages from multiple viewpoints disambiguate single-agent depth and complement occluded and long-range regions. CoCa3D improves prior SOTA by 44.21% on DAIR-V2X, 30.60% on OPV2V+, and 12.59% on CoPerception-UAVs+ in AP@70.
2303.13560|v2.assessment: 多智能体协作让纯视觉 3D 检测逼近甚至超越 LiDAR，结果显著，是协同感知方向的重要工作。
2303.13560|v2.contribution: 提出协作式纯视觉 3D 检测框架 CoCa3D。
2303.13560|v2.innovation: 通过多智能体信息共享与信息量线索选择提升纯视觉深度估计。

Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_cn: 多视角点云配准在噪声与离群点存在时容易因初始位姿不可靠而失败。本文提出一种鲁棒的多视角点云配准方法，通过可靠的位姿图初始化与历史重加权策略提升配准鲁棒性。相比已有方法，该方法在初始化阶段更稳健，并在迭代优化中利用历史信息重加权以抑制错误对应。实验表明其在多视角配准任务上取得更优的鲁棒性与精度。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_en: Multi-view point cloud registration is prone to failure under noise and outliers due to unreliable initial poses. This paper proposes a robust multi-view registration method with reliable pose graph initialization and history reweighting. It improves initialization robustness and suppresses erroneous correspondences via history-aware reweighting during optimization. Experiments show improved robustness and accuracy in multi-view registration.
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.assessment: 对 3D 感知中的点云配准有参考价值，但与自动驾驶检测主线相关度一般。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.contribution: 提出结合可靠位姿图初始化与历史重加权的鲁棒多视角点云配准方法。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.innovation: 利用历史信息重加权提升多视角配准在噪声与离群点下的鲁棒性。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.result: 在多视角点云配准任务上取得更优的鲁棒性与精度。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio._arxiv_id: Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registration with Reliable Pose Graph Initialization and History Reweighting.

TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_cn: 视觉中心自动驾驶中，感知与预测通常被分开处理，缺乏对时序 BEV 特征的有效联合建模。本文提出 TBP-Former，学习时序鸟瞰图金字塔以联合进行感知与预测。方法构建多尺度时序 BEV 表示，在统一框架下同时完成目标检测与轨迹预测。相比已有工作，TBP-Former 更好地利用了时序与多尺度信息，在视觉中心自动驾驶的联合感知与预测任务上取得更优性能。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_en: Vision-centric autonomous driving often separates perception and prediction, lacking joint temporal BEV modeling. This paper proposes TBP-Former, which learns a temporal bird's-eye-view pyramid for joint perception and prediction. It constructs multi-scale temporal BEV representations to perform detection and trajectory prediction in a unified framework. TBP-Former better exploits temporal and multi-scale cues, achieving improved performance on joint perception and prediction.
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.assessment: 时序 BEV 金字塔联合感知与预测思路清晰，对视觉中心自动驾驶研究有较高参考价值。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.contribution: 提出用于联合感知与预测的时序 BEV 金字塔网络 TBP-Former。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.innovation: 以多尺度时序 BEV 表示统一建模检测与轨迹预测。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.result: 在视觉中心自动驾驶的联合感知与预测任务上取得更优性能。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye._arxiv_id: TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye-View Pyramid for Joint Perception and Prediction in Vision-Centric Autonomous Driving.

Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_cn: 该论文针对从多视角图像进行3D-4D视图合成的问题，提出神经像素合成方法。方法通过神经渲染与像素级组合实现新视角生成，可能利用多视角输入构建隐式或显式表示。相比已有工作，其改进点在于统一处理3D静态与4D动态场景的视图合成。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需进一步验证。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D-4D view synthesis from multi-view inputs by proposing a neural pixel composition approach. The method likely combines neural rendering with pixel-level composition to generate novel views for both static and dynamic scenes. The improvement lies in unified handling of 3D and 4D synthesis, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.assessment: 与自动驾驶多视角感知有一定关联，但更偏向图形学与视图合成，对BEV/3D检测的直接贡献有限。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.contribution: 提出神经像素合成框架用于多视角3D-4D视图合成。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.innovation: 将神经渲染与像素组合结合以统一处理静态与动态场景。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View._arxiv_id: Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View Synthesis from Multi-Views.

2303.15689|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视图聚类（IMVC）中样本缺失导致原型不对齐和表示融合错误的问题，提出跨视图部分样本与原型对齐网络（CPSPAN）。方法采用成对观测数据对齐作为代理监督信号，并设计原型对齐机制以缓解缺失视图带来的偏差。相比现有对比学习方法强制跨视图表示一致，该方法更灵活地处理视图差异。摘要未给出具体聚类精度数据。
2303.15689|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) where missing samples cause misaligned prototypes and incorrect fusion. It proposes a Cross-view Partial Sample and Prototype Alignment Network (CPSPAN) that uses pair-observed data alignment as proxy supervision and aligns prototypes across views. Unlike contrastive methods enforcing identical representations, CPSPAN allows view discrepancy, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2303.15689|v2.assessment: 属于多视图聚类方向，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但部分对齐思想对多传感器融合有参考价值。
2303.15689|v2.contribution: 提出CPSPAN网络解决不完整多视图聚类中的原型不对齐问题。
2303.15689|v2.innovation: 采用成对观测对齐作为代理监督并引入原型对齐机制。
2303.15689|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体聚类性能数据。

2304.08993|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对动态场景下多帧深度估计中多视图几何一致性被破坏的问题，提出学习融合单目与多视图线索的方法。方法将多视图和单目线索编码为代价体，通过跨线索融合（CCF）模块实现静态区域几何信息向动态区域传播，无需启发式掩码。相比依赖显式动态掩码的方法，该融合策略更充分利用两类线索的互补优势。摘要未提供具体深度误差数据，但声称在动态区域取得更优估计。
2304.08993|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-frame depth estimation in dynamic scenes where multi-view geometric consistency is violated. It proposes encoding multi-view and monocular cues as volumes and fusing them via a Cross-Cue Fusion (CCF) module, enabling geometric information from static areas to propagate to dynamic regions without heuristic masks. Unlike mask-based methods, this approach better exploits cue complementarity, though quantitative depth errors are not reported in the abstract.
2304.08993|v2.assessment: 与自动驾驶深度估计和3D感知高度相关，跨线索融合思路对动态场景BEV感知有启发。
2304.08993|v2.contribution: 提出跨线索融合模块实现单目与多视图线索的自适应融合。
2304.08993|v2.innovation: 无需显式动态掩码，通过代价体融合实现静态几何向动态区域传播。
2304.08993|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，声称在动态场景下优于掩码方法。

2208.00928|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对城市多层级多视角理解缺乏统一数据集的问题，提出OmniCity数据集。数据集包含多视角卫星图像、街景全景和单视图图像，覆盖纽约市25K地理位置的10万+像素级标注图像，并提出利用卫星标签图与视图变换关系的街景标注流水线。相比现有基准，OmniCity提供更多图像、更丰富标注类型和更多视角，并引入街景全景细粒度建筑实例分割新任务。摘要未给出具体模型性能数据。
2208.00928|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OmniCity, a dataset for omnipotent city understanding from multi-level and multi-view images. It contains over 100K pixel-wise annotated images from 25K geo-locations in New York City, including satellite, panorama, and mono-view images, with an efficient annotation pipeline leveraging satellite label maps and view transformations. Compared to existing benchmarks, it offers more images, richer annotations, and a novel fine-grained building instance segmentation task on street-level panoramas.
2208.00928|v2.assessment: 对自动驾驶城市场景理解和多视角感知有重要价值，数据集和基准可推动相关研究。
2208.00928|v2.contribution: 构建OmniCity多层级多视角城市理解数据集及基准。
2208.00928|v2.innovation: 利用卫星-街景变换关系实现高效标注并引入全景细粒度分割任务。
2208.00928|v2.result: 提供10万+标注图像和多个基准结果，摘要未列具体性能数据。

2203.06111|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图3D表面重建缺乏多传感器多模态数据的问题，提出一个大规模多传感器数据集。数据集包含来自智能手机、RealSense、Kinect、工业相机和结构光扫描仪的配准RGB与深度数据，覆盖107个场景、100个视角、14种光照条件，约140万张图像。相比现有数据集，其强调多样材质属性以挑战现有算法。摘要未提供重建算法性能对比。
2203.06111|v2.summary_en: This paper presents a large-scale multi-sensor dataset for multi-view 3D surface reconstruction. It includes registered RGB and depth data from smartphones, RealSense, Kinect, industrial cameras, and structured-light scanners, covering 107 scenes, 100 viewing directions, 14 lighting conditions, and ~1.4M images. The dataset emphasizes diverse material properties to challenge existing algorithms, though no reconstruction performance comparison is provided.
2203.06111|v2.assessment: 对3D重建和传感器融合研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶BEV/检测的直接关联有限。
2203.06111|v2.contribution: 发布多传感器大规模3D重建数据集。
2203.06111|v2.innovation: 涵盖多模态传感器和多样材质场景以挑战现有重建算法。
2203.06111|v2.result: 提供约140万张图像，摘要未给出算法性能数据。

2305.06799|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多视图聚类方法忽略所有样本结构关系的问题，提出全局与跨视图特征聚合网络（GCFAggMVC）。方法通过跨样本和跨视图特征聚合获得共识表示，并利用结构引导对比学习对齐共识表示与视图特定表示。相比逐视图聚合方法，该模块能更充分利用相似样本的互补性，并可嵌入不完整多视图聚类任务。摘要未提供具体聚类精度数据。
2305.06799|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view clustering methods that ignore structural relationships among all samples. It proposes GCFAggMVC, which obtains consensus representation via cross-sample and cross-view feature aggregation and aligns consensus with view-specific representations using structure-guided contrastive learning. Unlike view-wise aggregation, it better exploits complementarity of similar samples and can be plugged into incomplete multi-view clustering, though quantitative results are not reported.
2305.06799|v2.assessment: 属于多视图聚类方向，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但特征聚合思路对多传感器融合有间接参考。
2305.06799|v2.contribution: 提出GCFAggMVC网络实现全局与跨视图特征聚合的多视图聚类。
2305.06799|v2.innovation: 通过跨样本跨视图聚合和结构引导对比学习对齐表示。
2305.06799|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体聚类性能数据。

Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_cn: 该论文针对高分辨率新视角合成中辐射场重建质量受限的问题，提出将多视角图像超分辨率与辐射场优化进行交叉引导的联合框架。方法上通过超分辨率网络与辐射场（如NeRF类）相互提供监督信号，在优化过程中迭代提升纹理细节与几何一致性。相比先超分再重建或先重建再超分的串行方案，该交叉引导策略缓解了误差累积与视角不一致问题。摘要未给出具体量化指标，但声称在高分辨率新视角合成上取得更优的细节保真度。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited fidelity of radiance field reconstruction for high-resolution novel view synthesis by proposing a cross-guided joint optimization framework that couples multi-view image super-resolution with radiance field training. The super-resolution network and the radiance field mutually supervise each other, iteratively improving texture details and geometric consistency, which mitigates error accumulation and view inconsistency in naive sequential pipelines. The method claims improved detail fidelity for high-resolution novel view synthesis, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.assessment: 将超分与辐射场联合优化是较自然的思路，对高分辨率新视角合成有参考价值，但缺乏量化结果，需关注其实际增益与计算开销。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.contribution: 提出多视角图像超分辨率与辐射场优化的交叉引导联合框架。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.innovation: 用超分与辐射场互为监督、迭代优化的交叉引导机制替代串行处理。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.result: 声称在高分辨率新视角合成上获得更优的细节保真度，摘要未给出具体数值。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi._arxiv_id: Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fields with Multi-View Image Super-Resolution for High-Resolution Novel View Synthesis.

2304.04038|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角立体视觉中3D几何感知特征难以有效编码的问题，提出POEM方法，直接在嵌入多视角立体的3D点上重建手部网格。方法将手部网格表示为一组携带多视角图像特征、环绕手部的3D点，并设计基于点的特征融合与跨集合点注意力两种操作来聚合跨视角信息。相比以往将3D信息压缩到2D特征的做法，POEM在3D点空间直接融合多视角特征。在三个挑战性多视角数据集上手部网格重建性能超过当时最先进方法。
2304.04038|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of encoding 3D geometry-aware features in multi-view stereo by proposing POEM, which reconstructs hand meshes directly on 3D points embedded in the multi-view stereo. A hand mesh is represented as a set of 3D points that carry multi-view image features and encircle the hand, with two operations—point-based feature fusion and cross-set point attention—designed to aggregate cross-view information. Unlike prior methods that compress 3D information into 2D features, POEM fuses features directly in 3D point space, and it outperforms the state of the art on three challenging multi-view hand mesh reconstruction datasets.
2304.04038|v2.assessment: 以3D点作为跨视角特征融合媒介的思路清晰且通用，虽面向手部重建，但其点嵌入多视角立体范式对多相机3D感知有借鉴意义。
2304.04038|v2.contribution: 提出在嵌入多视角立体的3D点上直接重建手部网格的POEM方法。
2304.04038|v2.innovation: 用携带多视角特征的点集表示手部网格，并设计点特征融合与跨集合点注意力。
2304.04038|v2.result: 在三个挑战性多视角数据集上手部网格重建超过当时最先进方法。

Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角立体（MVS）在弱纹理区域匹配困难、深度估计不可靠的问题，提出自适应块变形（Adaptive Patch Deformation）策略。方法通过让匹配块在采样过程中自适应变形，以更好地贴合弱纹理或倾斜表面，从而提升匹配鲁棒性。相比固定形状窗口的传统MVS匹配代价计算，该变形机制能更灵活地适应局部几何与纹理条件。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称在弱纹理场景下提升了重建鲁棒性。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of multi-view stereo matching in textureless regions, where fixed-shape patch matching yields unreliable depth estimates, by proposing an adaptive patch deformation strategy. The matching patch is allowed to deform adaptively during sampling to better conform to textureless or slanted surfaces, improving matching robustness compared with conventional fixed-window cost computation. The abstract claims improved reconstruction robustness in textureless scenarios but provides no quantitative results.
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.assessment: 弱纹理是MVS的经典难题，自适应块变形思路合理，对自动驾驶中低纹理路面/墙面重建有潜在价值，但需量化验证其增益。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.contribution: 提出面向弱纹理场景的自适应块变形多视角立体匹配方法。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.innovation: 让匹配块在采样中自适应变形以贴合弱纹理与倾斜表面。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.result: 声称在弱纹理场景下提升重建鲁棒性，摘要未给出具体数值。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele._arxiv_id: Adaptive Patch Deformation for Textureless-Resilient Multi-View Stereo.

ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中检测与关联分离、误差累积的问题，提出ADA-Track端到端框架，通过交替执行检测与关联并引入可微分关联模块实现联合优化。相比传统两阶段方法，该方法让检测和关联相互增强，在nuScenes跟踪基准上取得领先性能，AMOTA等指标优于已有端到端方案。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_en: ADA-Track addresses the error accumulation in multi-camera 3D multi-object tracking caused by decoupled detection and association. It proposes an end-to-end framework that alternates between detection and association with a differentiable association module for joint optimization. Experiments on nuScenes show leading tracking performance, outperforming prior end-to-end methods on AMOTA.
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.assessment: 面向自动驾驶多相机3D MOT的端到端方案，交替检测-关联思路对跟踪领域研究者有较高参考价值。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.contribution: 提出交替检测与关联的端到端多相机3D多目标跟踪框架。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.innovation: 用可微分关联模块实现检测与关联的联合交替优化。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.result: 在nuScenes跟踪基准上AMOTA等指标超越已有端到端方法。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu._arxiv_id: ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Multi-Object Tracking with Alternating Detection and Association.

CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_cn: 针对多视角图像进行3D室内目标检测时特征聚合不足的问题，提出CN-RMA，将组合网络与光线行进聚合结合，从多视角图像中重建并聚合3D特征用于检测。相比已有基于代价体或BEV的方法，光线行进聚合能更精细地建模沿视线的空间信息，在室内3D检测数据集上取得有竞争力的精度。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_en: CN-RMA targets 3D indoor object detection from multi-view images, where feature aggregation is often insufficient. It combines a combined network with ray marching aggregation to reconstruct and aggregate 3D features for detection. Compared with cost-volume or BEV-based methods, the ray marching aggregation better models spatial information along viewing rays, achieving competitive accuracy on indoor 3D detection benchmarks.
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.assessment: 光线行进聚合用于多视角室内3D检测，方法思路清晰，但领域偏室内，与自动驾驶相关性中等。

CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.result: 在室内3D检测数据集上取得有竞争力的检测精度。

Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_cn: 针对无参考点云质量评估（NR-PCQA）中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出多视角融合的对比预训练方法，通过多视角渲染与对比学习获取质量感知表征。相比直接监督训练，预训练显著提升下游质量评估性能，在多个点云质量数据集上取得优于已有NR-PCQA方法的相关性指标。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of labeled data in no-reference point cloud quality assessment (NR-PCQA) by proposing a contrastive pre-training method with multi-view fusion. Multi-view rendering and contrastive learning are used to obtain quality-aware representations. Pre-training substantially improves downstream quality assessment, achieving better correlation metrics than prior NR-PCQA methods on several datasets.
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.assessment: 点云质量评估与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱，但对比预训练与多视角融合思路可借鉴。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.contribution: 提出多视角融合的对比预训练框架用于无参考点云质量评估。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.innovation: 将多视角对比预训练引入点云质量表征学习。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.result: 在多个点云质量数据集上相关性指标优于已有NR-PCQA方法。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View._arxiv_id: Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View Fusion for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment.

TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_cn: 针对帕金森病运动症状评估依赖主观量表的问题，提出TULIP多相机3D精确评估系统，利用多相机采集进行3D人体姿态与运动学量化。相比单相机或可穿戴方案，多相机3D重建提升了评估精度与可重复性，在临床受试者上验证了与专家评分的一致性。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_en: TULIP targets objective assessment of Parkinson's disease motor symptoms, which currently relies on subjective rating scales. It proposes a multi-camera 3D system that quantifies human pose and kinematics for precise evaluation. Compared with single-camera or wearable approaches, multi-camera 3D reconstruction improves accuracy and repeatability, with clinical validation showing consistency with expert ratings.
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.assessment: 医学评估应用，多相机3D重建思路有参考性，但与自动驾驶感知研究相关性低。

TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.innovation: 将多相机3D人体运动学量化用于临床运动症状评估。

SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_cn: 针对多视角多人3D姿态估计依赖大量3D标注的问题，提出SelfPose3d自监督框架，利用多视角几何一致性与可微分三角化进行自监督训练。相比需要3D真值的监督方法，该方法无需3D标注即可学习，在多个多人3D姿态数据集上接近甚至达到监督方法的精度。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_en: SelfPose3d addresses the heavy reliance on 3D annotations in multi-person multi-view 3D pose estimation by proposing a self-supervised framework. It leverages multi-view geometric consistency and differentiable triangulation for training without 3D ground truth. Experiments on several multi-person 3D pose datasets show performance approaching or matching supervised methods.
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.assessment: 自监督多视角几何一致性思路对多相机感知有借鉴意义，但与自动驾驶检测任务关联有限。

SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.innovation: 利用多视角几何一致性与可微分三角化实现自监督训练。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.result: 在多个多人3D姿态数据集上接近监督方法精度。

Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_cn: 针对实际多视角场景中视图噪声导致自监督聚类性能下降的问题，系统研究了噪声视图的副作用并提出缓解策略，通过视图可靠性加权与鲁棒融合提升聚类鲁棒性。相比忽略噪声视图的已有方法，该策略在含噪多视角聚类基准上显著提升聚类精度。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_en: This paper investigates the side effects of noisy views in practical multi-view self-supervised clustering and proposes mitigation strategies. View reliability weighting and robust fusion are introduced to improve clustering robustness. Compared with methods that ignore noisy views, the proposed strategy substantially improves clustering accuracy on noisy multi-view benchmarks.
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.assessment: 多视角噪声鲁棒性研究对多相机融合有一定启发，但主题偏聚类，与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.contribution: 系统研究并缓解多视角自监督聚类中噪声视图的副作用。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.innovation: 提出视图可靠性加权与鲁棒融合的噪声视图缓解策略。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.result: 在含噪多视角聚类基准上显著提升聚类精度。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef._arxiv_id: Investigating and Mitigating the Side Effects of Noisy Views for Self-Supervised Clustering Algorithms in Practical Multi-View Scenarios.

2407.10753|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中像素级深度监督的两个问题：LiDAR点云深度仅分布在物体表面，缺乏3D物体中心的深度信息；远距离物体细粒度深度估计困难。提出OPEN检测器，通过物体级深度编码器以像素级深度图为先验估计物体级深度，并设计物体级位置嵌入将深度信息注入Transformer解码器。相比已有像素级深度监督方法，OPEN显式建模物体中心深度，更适配DETR类3D检测器。在nuScenes等基准上取得提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
2407.10753|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two issues in multi-view 3D detection with pixel-wise depth supervision: LiDAR depth lies on object surfaces lacking 3D center depth, and fine-grained depth for distant objects is hard. It proposes OPEN, which uses an object-wise depth encoder with pixel-wise depth as prior to estimate object-wise depth, and injects it into the transformer decoder via object-wise position embedding. This object-centric depth modeling improves over pixel-wise supervision for DETR-based detectors, yielding gains on nuScenes (specific numbers not in abstract).
2407.10753|v2.assessment: 该工作切中多视角3D检测中深度监督的关键痛点，物体级位置嵌入思路新颖且与DETR框架自然契合，值得关注。
2407.10753|v2.contribution: 提出物体级位置嵌入（OPEN），将物体中心深度信息有效注入多视角3D检测的Transformer解码器。
2407.10753|v2.innovation: 用物体级深度编码器从像素级深度图估计物体中心深度，并以位置嵌入形式注入解码器。
2407.10753|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上验证了物体级深度监督对多视角3D检测的有效性（摘要未列具体数值）。

2404.12390|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在核心视觉感知能力上的评估缺失问题，提出Blink基准，将14类经典CV任务（如相对深度估计、视觉对应、取证检测、多视角推理）重构为3,807道多选题，配以单/多图和视觉提示。实验显示人类平均准确率95.70%，而最佳模型GPT-4V和Gemini仅51.26%和45.72%，仅比随机猜测高13.17%和7.63%，表明这些感知能力尚未在MLLM中涌现。分析还指出专用CV模型表现更好，为未来改进指明方向。
2404.12390|v2.summary_en: To evaluate core visual perception abilities missing in prior benchmarks, this paper introduces Blink, reformulating 14 classic CV tasks (e.g., relative depth estimation, visual correspondence, forensics, multi-view reasoning) into 3,807 multiple-choice questions with single/multiple images and visual prompting. Humans average 95.70% accuracy, while GPT-4V and Gemini reach only 51.26% and 45.72%, just 13.17% and 7.63% above random guessing, showing such perception abilities have not emerged in MLLMs. Specialist CV models perform much better, suggesting improvement pathways.
2404.12390|v2.assessment: Blink揭示了当前MLLM在底层视觉感知上的显著短板，对VLM与视觉感知交叉研究具有重要基准价值，值得关注。
2404.12390|v2.contribution: 提出Blink基准，系统评估多模态大语言模型的核心视觉感知能力。
2404.12390|v2.innovation: 将14类经典CV感知任务重构为3,807道多选题并引入视觉提示，量化MLLM的感知短板。
2404.12390|v2.result: 人类准确率95.70%，GPT-4V仅51.26%、Gemini仅45.72%，仅略高于随机猜测，表明感知能力尚未涌现。

2412.04867|v2.summary_cn: 针对微小目标异常检测缺乏大规模多视角视觉-文本基准的问题，作者构建了MANTA数据集，包含38个类别、137.3K张图像（其中8.6K张有像素级异常标注），每张图像从5个视角采集，并配套875词的陈述性知识（含what/why/how解释）和2K道建构主义学习选择题。方法上提出视觉-文本任务基线并在多种设置下进行广泛基准测试。相比已有异常检测数据集，MANTA首次同时提供多视角、像素级标注和结构化文本知识，覆盖五个典型领域。实验揭示了现有先进方法在该数据集上的挑战与有效性，为视觉-文本异常检测提供了新基准。
2412.04867|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MANTA, a large-scale multi-view and visual-text anomaly detection dataset for tiny objects, comprising 137.3K images across 38 categories with 8.6K pixel-level anomalous annotations captured from five viewpoints. It also provides declarative knowledge (875 words) and 2K constructivist learning multiple-choice questions. A baseline for visual-text tasks and extensive benchmarking experiments are conducted, highlighting challenges and efficacy of the dataset.
2412.04867|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了微小目标多视角视觉-文本异常检测的空白，对开放集检测和VLM交叉研究有参考价值，但领域相关性偏中等。
2412.04867|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向微小目标的多视角视觉-文本异常检测数据集MANTA，并提供基线评测。
2412.04867|v2.innovation: 将多视角采集、像素级异常标注与结构化文本知识（陈述性+建构性）结合于统一基准。
2412.04867|v2.result: 数据集含137.3K图像、8.6K像素级异常标注、875词知识及2K选择题，基准实验揭示了现有方法的挑战。

2411.19036|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云补全中传统方法解空间大、结果不理想，以及图像引导方法难以获取配对图像-部分点云数据的问题，作者提出PCDreamer，利用大模型中的多视角扩散先验生成目标形状的新视角图像，编码全局与局部形状线索。设计了形状融合模块从图像和点云多模态输入生成初始完整形状，并引入形状巩固模块丢弃扩散先验不一致导致的不可靠点。实验表明该方法在恢复精细细节方面具有优越性能，尤其在细粒度结构补全上表现突出。
2411.19036|v2.summary_en: This paper presents PCDreamer for point cloud completion, leveraging multi-view diffusion priors from large models to generate novel views that encode global and local shape cues. A shape fusion module produces an initial complete shape from images and point clouds, followed by a shape consolidation module to discard unreliable points from diffusion inconsistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior performance, especially in recovering fine details.
2411.19036|v2.assessment: 利用扩散先验做点云补全思路新颖，对3D生成与感知有启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关性有限。
2411.19036|v2.contribution: 提出PCDreamer，利用多视角扩散先验和形状融合/巩固模块实现高质量点云补全。
2411.19036|v2.innovation: 将大模型多视角扩散先验引入点云补全，并通过巩固模块处理扩散不一致性。
2411.19036|v2.result: 在恢复精细细节方面取得优越性能，尤其擅长细粒度形状补全。

2412.02631|v2.summary_cn: 针对文本到3D生成中多视角重建方法易产生几何伪影、可控性差，而原生3D生成模型分辨率低导致质量不足的问题，作者提出Sharp-It，一个多视角到多视角的扩散模型。该方法接收从低质量物体渲染的3D一致多视角图像，通过并行处理并在生成视角间共享特征，丰富几何细节与纹理，最终重建高质量3D模型。相比直接生成3D表示的方法，Sharp-It在质量上缩小了差距，提升了3D合成的细节丰富度与可操作性。
2412.02631|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Sharp-It, a multi-view to multi-view diffusion model that enriches geometric details and texture of low-quality 3D objects rendered as 3D-consistent multi-view images. The model operates in parallel across views with shared features, enabling high-quality 3D reconstruction. It bridges the quality gap between direct 3D generative models and multi-view reconstruction approaches.
2412.02631|v2.assessment: 3D生成与编辑方向的工作，方法设计合理，但与自动驾驶感知/检测领域相关性较低。
2412.02631|v2.contribution: 提出Sharp-It多视角到多视角扩散模型，提升3D合成与操作的质量。
2412.02631|v2.innovation: 在多视角扩散中并行处理并跨视角共享特征，实现几何细节与纹理增强。

2503.21457|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces FaceBench, a hierarchical multi-view, multi-level facial attribute VQA dataset for benchmarking face perception in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Experiments show existing MLLMs fall far short on fine-grained facial attribute understanding, while Face-LLaVA substantially outperforms them.

2501.06336|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角生成图像缺乏独立于采样过程的评估指标这一问题，本文提出MEt3R，用于衡量生成图像的多视角一致性。该方法利用DUSt3R以馈送方式从图像对获得稠密3D重建，将一视角内容warp到另一视角，再比较特征图得到对视角相关效应不变的相似度分数。作者用MEt3R评估了大量新视角与视频生成方法，包括其自研的多视角隐扩散模型。
2501.06336|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MEt3R, a metric for measuring multi-view consistency in generated images, addressing the lack of sampling-independent evaluation metrics. It uses DUSt3R to obtain dense 3D reconstructions from image pairs in a feed-forward manner, warps content across views, and compares feature maps to yield a view-invariant similarity score. MEt3R is used to evaluate a wide range of novel-view and video generation methods, including the authors' multi-view latent diffusion model.
2501.06336|v2.assessment: 涉及3D重建与多视角一致性度量，与3D感知有一定关联，但主要面向生成模型评测，对自动驾驶检测任务帮助有限。
2501.06336|v2.contribution: 提出基于DUSt3R稠密重建的多视角一致性度量指标MEt3R。
2501.06336|v2.innovation: 利用馈送式稠密3D重建与特征图比较，得到对视角相关效应不变的相似度分数。
2501.06336|v2.result: MEt3R被用于评估大量新视角与视频生成方法，验证了其作为一致性度量的有效性。

2512.19402|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对机器人操作策略泛化性受限于演示数据采集成本高的问题，尤其是空间泛化场景下重复采集代价大的痛点。作者提出 Real2Edit2Real 框架，先用多视角 RGB 观测通过度量尺度三维重建模型恢复场景几何，再在点云上做深度可靠的 3D 编辑生成新操作轨迹并几何校正机器人位姿，最后以深度为主控信号、结合动作/边缘/光线图的多条件视频生成模型合成空间增强的多视角操作视频。相比已有工作，其改进在于把 3D 可编辑性与 2D 视觉数据通过 3D 控制接口打通，从而在无需真实重复采集的情况下生成物理一致的新演示。在四个真实操作任务上验证了用生成数据训练的策略效果（摘要在此处截断，未给出具体数值）。
2512.19402|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of collecting diverse demonstrations that limits spatial generalization of robot manipulation policies. It proposes Real2Edit2Real, which reconstructs metric-scale scene geometry from multi-view RGB, performs depth-reliable 3D editing on point clouds to synthesize new trajectories with geometrically corrected robot poses, and then uses a depth-guided multi-conditional video generation model (with action, edge, and ray maps) to produce spatially augmented multi-view manipulation videos. Experiments on four real-world manipulation tasks show that policies trained on the generated data benefit, though the abstract is truncated before reporting quantitative results.
2512.19402|v2.assessment: 该工作将 3D 重建、点云编辑与多条件视频生成串联用于机器人演示数据增广，思路完整，但与自动驾驶感知/3D 检测方向关联较弱，主要价值在机器人学习数据合成。
2512.19402|v2.contribution: 提出 Real2Edit2Real 框架，通过 3D 控制接口把 3D 可编辑性与 2D 视觉数据结合，自动生成空间增强的机器人操作演示。
2512.19402|v2.innovation: 以度量尺度 3D 重建为基础做深度可靠的 3D 编辑与位姿几何校正，并用深度主控的多条件视频生成模型合成多视角演示视频。
2512.19402|v2.result: 在四个真实操作任务上验证了生成演示数据可训练出有效策略，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。

Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_cn: 该论文针对单张噪声图像的去噪问题，提出Self2Self with Dropout方法，仅利用单张含噪图像自身进行自监督训练，无需干净标签或大量外部数据。方法基于dropout采样生成多组输入-目标对，并采用Bernoulli采样与实例归一化等技巧提升去噪稳定性。相比依赖成对或大量无噪数据的监督/自监督去噪方法，它把训练数据需求压缩到单张图像，在多个基准上取得与使用大规模数据训练相当甚至更优的PSNR。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image denoising by proposing Self2Self with Dropout, a self-supervised scheme that trains solely on the noisy input image without clean labels or external data. It generates input-target pairs via dropout sampling and employs Bernoulli sampling and instance normalization to stabilize training. Compared with supervised or data-hungry self-supervised denoising, it reduces the data requirement to a single image while achieving competitive or superior PSNR on standard benchmarks.
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.assessment: 在自监督去噪方向有代表性，思路简洁有效，但与自动驾驶/3D感知主线关联较弱。

Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.result: 在多个去噪基准上以单图训练达到与大规模数据训练方法相当甚至更优的PSNR。
