A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.innovation: 直接利用预训练视觉-语言模型的图文对齐进行图像块-文本匹配分割。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.result: 在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se._arxiv_id: A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation with Pre-trained Vision-Language Model.

A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_cn: 该论文针对交互式视觉-语言导航中指令可行性未知的问题，构建了一个新的数据集。现有导航数据集通常假设指令总是可执行的，而现实中用户指令可能无法完成。论文收集了包含可行与不可行指令的交互式导航数据，并设计了评估协议来衡量模型判断指令可行性及执行导航的能力。实验表明现有VLM和导航模型在识别不可行指令方面表现不佳，揭示了该方向的重要挑战。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper addresses interactive vision-language navigation where command feasibility is unknown, a setting largely ignored by existing datasets that assume commands are always executable. It introduces a dataset containing both feasible and infeasible commands with evaluation protocols for feasibility judgment and navigation. Experiments show that current VLM and navigation models struggle to identify infeasible commands, highlighting an important challenge.
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.assessment: 该工作提出了一个有价值的数据集与问题设定，但偏NLP/导航交互，与自动驾驶感知核心关联有限。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.contribution: 构建了包含未知指令可行性的交互式视觉-语言导航数据集。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.innovation: 首次系统性地引入指令可行性判断任务并设计相应评估协议。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.result: 实验揭示现有模型在识别不可行指令上表现不佳。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag._arxiv_id: A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Language Navigation with Unknown Command Feasibility.

Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言导航中模型难以解耦视觉与语言信息的问题，提出了解耦标签学习（Decoupled Labels）方法。方法通过将导航监督信号分解为不同标签分量，引导模型分别学习与视觉和语言相关的表征，从而提升泛化与可解释性。相比已有端到端导航模型，该方法显式地促进模态解耦。实验在R2R等导航基准上验证了解耦策略对导航成功率的提升。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of disentangling visual and linguistic information in vision-language navigation. It proposes a decoupled-label learning approach that decomposes navigation supervision into separate label components to guide modality-specific representation learning. Compared with end-to-end navigation models, it explicitly promotes modality disentanglement, improving navigation success rates on benchmarks such as R2R.
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.assessment: 该工作从表征解耦角度改进VLN，思路有一定新意，但属于导航交互方向，与自动驾驶感知相关性一般。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.contribution: 提出解耦标签学习方法以促进视觉-语言导航中的模态解耦。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.innovation: 通过分解监督标签显式引导视觉与语言表征的解耦学习。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.result: 在R2R等导航基准上提升了导航成功率。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled._arxiv_id: Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled Labels for Vision-Language Navigation.

UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言模型中文本生成与目标框预测通常分离的问题，提出了UniTAB统一框架。方法将文本和边界框作为统一输出序列，使单一模型能够同时完成定位（grounding）和生成任务，如指代分割、图像描述与视觉定位。相比已有分别处理文本或框输出的模型，UniTAB实现了多任务统一并支持跨任务迁移。实验在多个grounded vision-language基准上取得了领先或可比的性能。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of text generation and box prediction in vision-language models by proposing UniTAB, a unified framework that treats text and bounding boxes as a unified output sequence. A single model can perform both grounding and generation tasks such as referring expression segmentation, captioning, and visual grounding. Compared with models handling text or boxes separately, UniTAB unifies multiple tasks and enables cross-task transfer, achieving leading or comparable results on grounded vision-language benchmarks.
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.assessment: 该工作统一了文本与框输出，对多模态定位与生成任务有较好整合，思路对VLM+检测结合有借鉴意义。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.contribution: 提出UniTAB统一文本与边界框输出的视觉-语言建模框架。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.innovation: 将文本和框作为统一输出序列，实现定位与生成任务的单模型统一。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.result: 在多个grounded vision-language基准上取得领先或可比性能。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo._arxiv_id: UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs for Grounded Vision-Language Modeling.

2207.09644|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对人体骨架序列表示学习中自监督预训练未充分利用骨架层次化时空结构的问题，提出了层次化自监督Transformer（Hi-TRS）。方法在帧、片段、视频三个层级分别设计自监督预训练目标，显式捕捉空间、短期和长期时序依赖，而非仅在视频级做对比学习。相比已有视频级对比学习方法，Hi-TRS更好地建模了骨架的层次化时空特性。在动作识别、动作检测和运动预测三个下游任务上，无论监督还是半监督协议均取得state-of-the-art性能。
2207.09644|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of hierarchical spatio-temporal structure in self-supervised skeleton sequence representation learning. It proposes Hi-TRS, a hierarchical Transformer-based encoder with a self-supervised pre-training scheme that explicitly captures spatial, short-term, and long-term temporal dependencies at frame, clip, and video levels. Unlike prior video-level contrastive methods, Hi-TRS better models hierarchical skeleton structure, achieving state-of-the-art performance on action recognition, action detection, and motion prediction under both supervised and semi-supervised protocols.
2207.09644|v2.assessment: 该工作对层次化自监督预训练设计扎实，实验覆盖三个下游任务且结果强，对自监督表征学习方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
2207.09644|v2.contribution: 提出层次化自监督Transformer（Hi-TRS）用于骨架序列表示学习。
2207.09644|v2.innovation: 在帧、片段、视频三级设计自监督目标以显式建模层次化时空依赖。
2207.09644|v2.result: 在动作识别、动作检测和运动预测上均取得state-of-the-art性能。

2208.06105|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频对比学习方法未能充分利用对下游任务至关重要的短时运动动态。本文提出运动敏感对比学习（MSCL），将光流捕获的运动信息注入RGB帧以强化特征学习，具体包括跨模态帧级局部运动对比学习（LMCL）、流旋转增强（FRA）生成运动打乱的负样本以及运动差分采样（MDS）筛选训练样本。在3D ResNet-18骨干下，UCF101视频分类top-1达91.5%，Something-Something v2达50.3%，UCF101视频检索Top-1 Recall达65.6%，显著超越此前最优。
2208.06105|v2.summary_en: Existing video contrastive learning methods under-exploit short-term motion dynamics crucial for downstream video understanding. This paper proposes Motion Sensitive Contrastive Learning (MSCL), which injects optical-flow-captured motion into RGB frames, combining clip-level global contrastive learning with frame-level Local Motion Contrastive Learning (LMCL), Flow Rotation Augmentation (FRA) for motion-shuffled negatives, and Motion Differential Sampling (MDS). With a 3D ResNet-18 backbone, it achieves 91.5% top-1 on UCF101, 50.3% on Something-Something v2, and 65.6% Top-1 Recall on UCF101 retrieval, notably improving the state of the art.
2208.06105|v2.assessment: 将光流运动先验与对比学习结合，在多个视频理解基准上取得显著提升，对视频自监督表征学习有较强参考价值。
2208.06105|v2.contribution: 提出运动敏感对比学习框架，通过跨模态帧级对比与运动增强充分挖掘短时运动动态。
2208.06105|v2.innovation: 引入局部运动对比学习、流旋转增强和运动差分采样三项机制协同强化运动表征。
2208.06105|v2.result: UCF101分类91.5%、Something-Something v2 50.3%、UCF101检索65.6% Top-1 Recall，均达当时最优。

2208.09843|v2.summary_cn: 图文检索（ITR）的核心挑战在于弥合视觉与语言模态间的鸿沟，现有对比学习方法受限于负样本数量有限、人工加权负样本以及缺乏外部知识。本文提出耦合多样性敏感动量对比学习（CODER），设计多样性敏感对比学习（DCL）架构，通过动态字典扩大图文对规模并自适应加权负样本；同时构建双分支结构，一支学习实例级嵌入并生成伪在线聚类标签，另一支从常识知识图谱查询形成概念级描述符，两分支均利用DCL对齐跨模态嵌入空间。
2208.09843|v2.summary_en: Image-Text Retrieval (ITR) struggles to bridge visual and lingual modalities, and prior contrastive methods are limited by scarce negatives, manual weighting, and lack of external knowledge. This paper proposes CODER, a Coupled Diversity-Sensitive Momentum Contrastive Learning framework featuring a Diversity-Sensitive Contrastive Learning (DCL) architecture with dynamic dictionaries and adaptive negative weighting, plus two branches: one learning instance-level embeddings with pseudo online clustering labels, and another querying a commonsense knowledge graph for concept-level descriptors, both aligned via DCL.
2208.09843|v2.assessment: 通过动态字典与知识图谱双分支提升跨模态对齐，思路有一定新意，但摘要未给出具体实验数据，效果验证信息不足。
2208.09843|v2.contribution: 提出耦合多样性敏感动量对比学习框架CODER，融合实例级与概念级双分支跨模态对齐。
2208.09843|v2.innovation: 结合动态字典自适应负样本加权与常识知识图谱概念级描述符进行跨模态对比学习。
2208.09843|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，仅声称在图文检索任务上提升跨模态表征能力。

2207.12661|v2.summary_cn: 现有多模态对比预训练通常为每个模态使用独立编码器，未能充分利用Transformer跨模态知识共享的潜力。本文系统研究了模态共享对比语言-图像预训练（MS-CLIP）框架，探究Transformer参数在模态间可共享的比例，并沿参数共享比例谱系严格检验架构设计选择。实验发现，视觉与语言信号共享大部分统一编码器优于更多参数分离的变体，轻量级模态特定并行模块可进一步提升性能，所提MS-CLIP在零样本ImageNet分类上相对原始CLIP提升最高达13%。
2207.12661|v2.summary_en: Existing multimodal contrastive pre-training typically uses separate encoders per modality, underutilizing transformers' cross-modal knowledge sharing. This paper systematically investigates Modality-Shared Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (MS-CLIP), examining how many transformer parameters can be shared across modalities and rigorously evaluating architectural choices along a sharing spectrum. A mostly unified encoder outperforms more separated variants, and lightweight modality-specific parallel modules further improve performance, with MS-CLIP surpassing vanilla CLIP by up to 13% relative in zero-shot ImageNet classification.
2207.12661|v2.assessment: 对CLIP式预训练中模态参数共享问题进行了系统实证研究，结论对多模态架构设计具有指导意义。
2207.12661|v2.contribution: 系统研究模态共享的CLIP预训练框架，明确参数共享比例与架构设计对性能的影响规律。
2207.12661|v2.innovation: 沿参数共享比例谱系检验Transformer架构，并提出轻量模态特定并行模块增强统一编码器。
2207.12661|v2.result: 零样本ImageNet分类相对原始CLIP提升最高13%。

2107.06383|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉-语言（V&L）模型多依赖在较小规模人工标注数据上预训练的视觉编码器，泛化能力受限。本文系统研究CLIP作为视觉编码器能为V&L任务带来多大收益，在两种典型场景下替换视觉编码器：一是将CLIP插入任务特定微调，二是结合CLIP与V&L预训练再迁移到下游任务。结果表明CLIP显著优于BottomUp-TopDown等域内标注数据训练的编码器，在多项V&L任务上取得有竞争力或更优结果，并在视觉问答、视觉蕴含和V&L导航任务上刷新最优。
2107.06383|v2.summary_en: Existing Vision-and-Language (V&L) models rely on visual encoders pre-trained on relatively small manually-annotated data, limiting generalization. This paper studies how much CLIP benefits V&L tasks by using it as the visual encoder in two scenarios: plugging CLIP into task-specific fine-tuning, and combining CLIP with V&L pre-training before transferring downstream. CLIP significantly outperforms encoders trained on in-domain annotated data such as BottomUp-TopDown, achieving competitive or better results across diverse V&L tasks and new state-of-the-art on VQA, Visual Entailment, and V&L Navigation.
2107.06383|v2.assessment: 以充分实验量化CLIP对V&L任务的增益，结论清晰且具实用价值，对多模态感知研究有借鉴意义。
2107.06383|v2.contribution: 系统评估CLIP作为视觉编码器在多种V&L任务与训练范式下的收益。
2107.06383|v2.innovation: 在任务特定微调与V&L预训练迁移两种场景下全面对比CLIP与域内标注编码器。
2107.06383|v2.result: 在VQA、视觉蕴含和V&L导航任务上刷新最优，整体优于BottomUp-TopDown等编码器。

2106.12570|v2.summary_cn: 多模态VAE需建模异构数据（如视觉、语言）的联合分布并捕获共享表征，但现有方法通常通过显式的乘积、混合等分解在识别模型中直接协调各模态特有表征。本文提出MEME，将半监督VAE重新利用，通过相互监督隐式地在模态间组合信息，避免显式组合，并天然支持部分观测数据（某些模态完全缺失）的学习。在MNIST-SVHN（图像-图像）和CUB（图像-文本）数据集上，MEME在部分与完整观测方案下均优于基线。
2106.12570|v2.summary_en: Multimodal VAEs model the joint distribution over heterogeneous data while capturing shared representations, but prior work typically reconciles modality-specific representations via explicit products or mixtures in the recognition model. This paper introduces MEME, which repurposes semi-supervised VAEs to combine information across modalities implicitly through mutual supervision, naturally handling partially-observed data with entirely missing modalities. MEME outperforms baselines on MNIST-SVHN and CUB under both partial and complete observation schemes.
2106.12570|v2.assessment: 以相互监督替代显式模态融合的思路新颖，对缺失模态场景有实用价值，但实验规模较小。
2106.12570|v2.contribution: 提出MEME，通过相互监督隐式融合多模态信息并支持模态缺失场景。
2106.12570|v2.innovation: 将半监督VAE重新用于多模态学习，避免显式模态组合并天然处理部分观测数据。
2106.12570|v2.result: 在MNIST-SVHN和CUB上部分与完整观测方案均优于基线。

2106.09667|v2.summary_cn: CLIP等多模态对比学习方法依赖含噪、未筛选的训练数据集以降低标注成本并提升分布外鲁棒性，但本文揭示这种做法使后门与投毒攻击成为重大威胁。研究表明，仅投毒数据集的0.01%（如300万样本Conceptual Captions中的300张图像）即可通过叠加小补丁使模型误分类测试图像；定向投毒攻击更易实施，仅需控制0.0001%的数据集（300万中的3张图像）即可让模型将特定测试输入误判为攻击者指定标签。该结果质疑了在含噪未筛选网络爬取数据上训练的合理性。
2106.09667|v2.summary_en: Multimodal contrastive methods like CLIP train on noisy, uncurated datasets for lower cost and better out-of-distribution robustness, but this paper shows such practice makes backdoor and poisoning attacks a significant threat. Poisoning just 0.01% of a dataset (e.g., 300 of 3M Conceptual Captions images) causes misclassification of test images via a small overlaid patch, while targeted poisoning requires controlling only 0.0001% (three of 3M images) to force an adversarially-desired label. These attacks call into question the desirability of training on noisy Internet scrapes.
2106.09667|v2.assessment: 首次系统揭示对比学习在未筛选数据上的安全脆弱性，对多模态预训练数据治理有重要警示意义。
2106.09667|v2.contribution: 揭示多模态对比学习在含噪未筛选数据上的后门与投毒攻击威胁。
2106.09667|v2.innovation: 以极低投毒比例（0.01%乃至0.0001%）实现有效后门与定向投毒攻击。
2106.09667|v2.result: 300张图像即可致误分类，3张图像即可实现定向投毒，攻击成本极低。

2207.03482|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）需要借助CLIP预训练模型和图像级弱监督来扩展词表，但CLIP基于图文对训练缺乏精确定位能力，而图像级监督的启发式方法无法准确指定局部物体区域。本文提出对CLIP语言嵌入进行以物体为中心的对齐，并通过伪标签过程利用图像级监督提供高质量物体提议来扩展训练词表，同时设计了一种新颖的权重传递函数将两种对齐策略互补融合。该方法在OVD基准上显著缩小了物体级与图像级表示之间的差距，提升了新类别检测性能。
2207.03482|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary detection (OVD) typically relies on CLIP pretrained models and image-level weak supervision, but neither is optimally aligned for detection: CLIP lacks precise localization while image-level supervision uses heuristics that poorly specify local object regions. This work proposes object-centric alignment of CLIP language embeddings and a pseudo-labeling process that provides high-quality object proposals to expand the vocabulary during training. A novel weight transfer function bridges the two alignment strategies, aggregating their complementary strengths. The method substantially narrows the gap between object- and image-level representations, improving novel-category detection on OVD benchmarks.
2207.03482|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了OVD中CLIP定位不准与图像级监督粗糙的核心矛盾，权重传递函数的设计具有启发性，对开放词汇检测方向有较强参考价值。
2207.03482|v2.contribution: 提出物体中心对齐与伪标签词表扩展相结合的OVD框架，并通过权重传递函数融合两种监督信号。
2207.03482|v2.innovation: 设计权重传递函数桥接CLIP物体级对齐与图像级伪标签监督，实现互补优势聚合。
2207.03482|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上显著缩小物体级与图像级表示差距，提升新类别检测精度。

2208.05592|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇模型如CLIP在零样本分类上表现优异，但在某些特定任务上性能远不理想，而直接微调会导致其他任务精度下降。本文提出PAINT，通过在微调前后模型权重之间进行插值来实现模型修补，在提升目标任务精度的同时保持原有能力。在9个零样本CLIP表现较差的任务上，PAINT将精度提升15至60个百分点，同时ImageNet精度保持在零样本模型1个百分点以内，并支持多任务修补和跨任务广泛迁移。
2208.05592|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary models like CLIP achieve high zero-shot accuracy but underperform on certain tasks, and naive fine-tuning degrades performance elsewhere. This paper introduces PAINT, a patching method that interpolates between pre-fine-tuning and post-fine-tuning weights to improve target-task accuracy without degrading existing capabilities. On nine tasks where zero-shot CLIP performs poorly, PAINT improves accuracy by 15–60 percentage points while keeping ImageNet accuracy within one percentage point of the zero-shot model, and supports multi-task patching and broad transfer.
2208.05592|v2.assessment: 权重插值修补思路简洁有效，对CLIP类模型的持续适配有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联度有限。
2208.05592|v2.contribution: 提出PAINT权重插值修补方法，在不损害原有能力的前提下提升开放词汇模型在特定任务上的精度。
2208.05592|v2.innovation: 利用微调前后权重插值实现模型修补，并发现跨任务的广泛迁移现象。
2208.05592|v2.result: 在9个任务上精度提升15–60个百分点，ImageNet精度损失控制在1个百分点以内。

2211.14241|v2.summary_cn: 3D视觉定位任务中，现有方法通常使用现成的点云编码器提取3D视觉线索，但缺乏丰富的2D物体表示。本文提出LAR模块，利用从3D点云合成生成的2D线索来辅助3D编码器，无需额外2D输入即可在训练和测试中融入丰富的2D物体表示。在Nr3D、Sr3D和ScanRefer三个基准上，LAR一致性地超越现有最先进的3D视觉定位方法，验证了合成2D语义知识蒸馏的有效性。
2211.14241|v2.summary_en: 3D visual grounding typically relies on off-the-shelf point cloud encoders for the visual stream, lacking rich 2D object representations. This paper proposes the Look Around and Refer (LAR) module, which leverages 2D clues synthetically generated from 3D point clouds to assist the 3D encoder without requiring extra 2D inputs at training or test time. Comprehensive experiments on Nr3D, Sr3D, and ScanRefer show consistent performance gains, with LAR significantly outperforming state-of-the-art 3D visual grounding methods on all three benchmarks.
2211.14241|v2.assessment: 利用合成2D语义蒸馏增强3D视觉定位的思路新颖，无需额外2D输入的设计具有实用价值，但与自动驾驶BEV/检测主线的直接关联有限。
2211.14241|v2.contribution: 提出LAR模块，通过从点云合成2D线索进行知识蒸馏来增强3D视觉定位的视觉表示。
2211.14241|v2.innovation: 无需额外2D输入，利用点云合成2D语义知识蒸馏辅助3D编码器训练与推理。
2211.14241|v2.result: 在Nr3D、Sr3D和ScanRefer三个基准上一致超越现有最先进方法。

2301.05499|v2.summary_cn: 针对单域泛化目标检测（SDG）研究几乎空白的问题，本文提出利用预训练视觉-语言模型（CLIP）通过文本提示引入语义域概念。方法包括在检测器骨干特征上进行语义增强策略，以及基于文本的分类损失，从而同时提升目标定位与表示的鲁棒性。相比唯一已有的SDG检测方法Single-DGOD，在多样天气驾驶基准上性能提升10%。该工作为SDG检测提供了新思路，并验证了视觉-语言模型在域泛化中的有效性。
2301.05499|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the almost non-existent literature on Single Domain Generalization (SDG) for object detection. It proposes leveraging a pre-trained vision-language model to introduce semantic domain concepts via textual prompts, using a semantic augmentation strategy on detector backbone features and a text-based classification loss. The approach outperforms the only existing SDG detection method, Single-DGOD, by 10% on a diverse weather-driving benchmark.
2301.05499|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了SDG目标检测的空白，利用CLIP的语义先验提升泛化能力，实验提升显著，值得关注。
2301.05499|v2.contribution: 首次将视觉-语言模型引入单域泛化目标检测，提出语义增强与文本分类损失。
2301.05499|v2.innovation: 通过文本提示进行语义域增强，并设计文本分类损失以对齐视觉特征与语义概念。
2301.05499|v2.result: 在多样天气驾驶基准上比Single-DGOD提升10%。

2303.12027|v2.summary_cn: 针对自然语言指定跟踪中现有方法将视觉定位与跟踪分离、忽略两者联系且难以端到端训练的问题，本文提出联合视觉定位与跟踪框架，将两者统一为基于视觉-语言参考的定位任务。具体设计了多源关系建模模块来构建参考与测试图像的关系，以及时序建模模块在全局语义指导下提供时序线索。该方法有效提升了对外观变化的适应性，实现了端到端训练。
2303.12027|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of separated visual grounding and tracking frameworks for tracking by natural language specification. It proposes a joint framework that reformulates grounding and tracking as a unified task, with a multi-source relation modeling module and a temporal modeling module guided by global semantic information. The approach improves adaptability to appearance variations and enables end-to-end training.
2303.12027|v2.assessment: 将视觉定位与跟踪统一建模，思路合理，但实验细节和对比结果在摘要中未充分展示，需进一步验证。
2303.12027|v2.contribution: 提出联合视觉定位与跟踪的统一框架，实现端到端训练。
2303.12027|v2.innovation: 多源关系建模模块和全局语义引导的时序建模模块。
2303.12027|v2.result: 有效提升对外观变化的适应性，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。

2303.16891|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇实例分割中因基类强监督与新颖类弱监督差异导致过拟合基类、泛化差的问题，本文提出Mask-free OVIS流水线，利用预训练视觉-语言模型的定位能力自动生成伪掩码标注，以弱监督方式同时学习基类和新颖类。该方法无需人工掩码标注，缓解了强/弱监督不平衡问题，提升了新颖类泛化能力。
2303.16891|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the overfitting to base categories in open-vocabulary instance segmentation caused by the discrepancy between strong base supervision and weak novel category supervision. It proposes Mask-free OVIS, which automatically generates pseudo-mask annotations using a pre-trained vision-language model and learns both base and novel categories in a weakly supervised manner. The method eliminates manual mask annotations and improves generalization to novel categories.
2303.16891|v2.assessment: 利用视觉-语言模型生成伪掩码，巧妙解决开放词汇实例分割的标注瓶颈，具有较好的实用价值。
2303.16891|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工掩码标注的开放词汇实例分割流水线Mask-free OVIS。
2303.16891|v2.innovation: 利用预训练视觉-语言模型的定位能力自动生成伪掩码，实现弱监督学习。
2303.16891|v2.result: 缓解了基类过拟合，提升了新颖类泛化能力，但摘要未给出具体数值。

2303.13076|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中引入CLIP时面临的两个核心障碍：整图到区域的分布不匹配和未见类定位困难，本文提出CORA框架，采用DETR风格，通过区域提示（Region prompting）和锚点预匹配（Anchor pre-matching）来适配CLIP。区域提示缓解了整图到区域的分布差距，锚点预匹配通过类感知匹配机制学习可泛化的目标定位。在COCO OVD基准上，CORA在新类上达到41.7 AP50，超越之前SOTA 2.4 AP50，且无需额外训练数据。
2303.13076|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies two core obstacles in incorporating CLIP into open-vocabulary detection: whole-to-region distribution mismatch and difficulty in localizing unseen classes. It proposes CORA, a DETR-style framework that adapts CLIP via region prompting and anchor pre-matching. On the COCO OVD benchmark, CORA achieves 41.7 AP50 on novel classes, outperforming the previous state-of-the-art by 2.4 AP50 without extra training data.
2303.13076|v2.assessment: CORA针对开放词汇检测的关键问题提出有效解决方案，在COCO基准上取得显著提升，方法简洁且性能优越，值得关注。
2303.13076|v2.contribution: 提出CORA框架，通过区域提示和锚点预匹配适配CLIP用于开放词汇检测。
2303.13076|v2.innovation: 区域提示缓解整图-区域分布差距，锚点预匹配实现类感知的可泛化定位。
2303.13076|v2.result: 在COCO OVD新类上达到41.7 AP50，超越SOTA 2.4 AP50。

2301.09121|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割（OVS）问题，本文提出基于Transformer的OVSegmentor模型，仅利用网络爬取的图像-文本对进行预训练，无需掩码标注。模型通过slot-attention绑定模块将像素聚合成可学习组令牌，并与标题嵌入对齐；提出掩码实体补全和跨图像掩码一致性两个代理任务，分别学习细粒度视觉-文本对齐和视觉不变性。构建了CC4M数据集提升训练效率，并在多个基准上取得优异性能。
2301.09121|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVS) by proposing OVSegmentor, a transformer-based model pre-trained solely on web-crawled image-text pairs without mask annotations. It aggregates pixels into learnable group tokens via slot-attention and aligns them with caption embeddings, using two proxy tasks: masked entity completion and cross-image mask consistency. It also constructs the CC4M dataset for efficient pre-training and achieves strong performance on multiple benchmarks.
2301.09121|v2.assessment: OVSegmentor在无掩码标注的开放词汇语义分割上提出新颖的组令牌对齐和代理任务，构建的数据集也有助于后续研究。
2301.09121|v2.contribution: 提出仅用图像-文本对预训练的OVSegmentor模型及两个代理任务，并构建CC4M数据集。
2301.09121|v2.innovation: slot-attention组令牌绑定与掩码实体补全、跨图像掩码一致性代理任务。
2301.09121|v2.result: 在多个开放词汇语义分割基准上取得优异性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。

2212.00785|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有开放世界语义分割方法因对比学习仅考虑图像-文本对齐而导致训练-测试不一致的问题，本文提出文本接地对比学习（TCL）框架，直接学习区域-文本对齐。方法为给定文本生成分割掩码，从掩码区域提取文本接地的图像嵌入，并通过TCL与文本嵌入对齐，从而直接提升生成掩码的质量。此外，提出了统一的评估协议，在8个语义分割数据集上验证，TCL取得了优异性能。
2212.00785|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the train-test discrepancy in open-world semantic segmentation caused by contrastive learning only aligning image-text during training while segmentation requires region-text alignment at test time. It proposes Text-grounded Contrastive Learning (TCL), which generates a segmentation mask for a given text, extracts text-grounded image embedding from the masked region, and aligns it with text embedding. TCL directly improves mask quality and achieves strong performance on 8 semantic segmentation datasets under a unified evaluation protocol.
2212.00785|v2.assessment: TCL直接优化区域-文本对齐，解决了对比学习在分割任务中的不一致问题，统一评估协议也有助于公平比较。
2212.00785|v2.contribution: 提出文本接地对比学习（TCL）框架，直接学习区域-文本对齐用于开放世界语义分割。
2212.00785|v2.innovation: 通过生成掩码并提取文本接地嵌入进行对比学习，直接优化分割掩码质量。
2212.00785|v2.result: 在8个语义分割数据集上取得优异性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。

2303.14038|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言预训练(VLP)训练成本高、收敛慢的问题，指出掩码语言建模(MLM)中预测率与破坏率耦合导致大量输出token被排除在损失之外。提出Free Language Modeling (FLM)，实现100%预测率与任意破坏率解耦，并允许为每个待预测token定制破坏跨度。相比MLM方法，FLM在相同GPU时间下可减少2.5倍预训练时间，同时保持下游性能。
2303.14038|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost and slow convergence of vision-language pretraining (VLP), identifying the entanglement between prediction rate and corruption rate in masked language modeling (MLM) as a key bottleneck. It proposes Free Language Modeling (FLM), which achieves a 100% prediction rate with arbitrary corruption rates and allows customized corruption spans per predicted token. FLM reduces pretraining time by 2.5x compared to MLM-based methods while maintaining competitive performance.
2303.14038|v2.assessment: 该工作从预训练任务设计角度有效提升了VLP效率，对多模态大模型训练有实际价值，但主要面向NLP/多模态预训练，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2303.14038|v2.contribution: 提出FLM预训练任务，解耦预测率与破坏率，实现100%预测率下的高效VLP。
2303.14038|v2.innovation: 允许任意破坏率下100%预测，并为每个token定制破坏跨度，灵活利用双向上下文。
2303.14038|v2.result: 相比MLM方法减少2.5倍预训练时间，同时保持下游任务性能。

2211.10277|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模视觉-语言模型(VLM)在下游任务高效迁移时，现有方法（如prompt tuning丢弃预训练文本分类器、adapter tuning过度依赖预训练特征）破坏或过度偏向先验知识的问题。提出Task Residual Tuning (TaskRes)，直接在文本分类器上操作，冻结原始分类器权重，通过调优一组与先验无关的残差参数获得新分类器，显式解耦先验知识与任务特定知识。该方法在多个下游任务上实现了可靠的先验知识保留与灵活的任务知识利用。
2211.10277|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that existing efficient transfer learning methods for vision-language models (VLMs) either damage or are excessively biased towards pre-trained prior knowledge. It proposes Task Residual Tuning (TaskRes), which freezes the original text-based classifier and learns a set of prior-independent residual parameters to form a new classifier, explicitly decoupling prior and task-specific knowledge. TaskRes achieves reliable prior preservation and flexible task adaptation across downstream tasks.
2211.10277|v2.assessment: 该工作对VLM高效微调提出了简洁有效的解耦思路，实验充分，对多模态下游任务迁移有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2211.10277|v2.contribution: 提出TaskRes，通过文本分类器上的残差调优显式解耦先验知识与任务知识。
2211.10277|v2.innovation: 冻结原始分类器，仅学习与先验无关的残差参数，兼顾先验保留与任务适应。
2211.10277|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上实现可靠的先验知识保留与灵活的任务特定知识利用。

2303.15786|v2.summary_cn: 针对人-物交互(HOI)检测中，基于CLIP知识蒸馏的方法依赖大规模训练数据且在少样本/零样本场景下性能不佳的问题。提出HOICLIP框架，通过交叉注意力交互解码器从CLIP视觉特征中提取信息区域，并与检测骨干融合；利用CLIP文本编码器嵌入HOI描述生成分类器，通过视觉语义算术和轻量动词表示适配器构建动词分类器，并提出免训练增强利用全局HOI预测。该方法在少样本和零样本场景下实现了更好的泛化性能。
2303.15786|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of CLIP-based knowledge distillation for Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection, which relies on large-scale training data and performs poorly in few/zero-shot scenarios. It proposes HOICLIP, a framework with an interaction decoder using cross-attention to extract informative regions from CLIP visual features, fused with the detection backbone. It also leverages CLIP text encoder to generate classifiers and introduces a training-free enhancement, achieving better generalization in few/zero-shot settings.
2303.15786|v2.assessment: 该工作有效利用CLIP先验知识提升HOI检测的泛化能力，方法设计合理，对多模态知识迁移有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
2303.15786|v2.contribution: 提出HOICLIP框架，高效提取CLIP先验知识用于HOI检测并提升泛化性。
2303.15786|v2.innovation: 交叉注意力交互解码器与知识集成块融合CLIP视觉特征，结合文本编码器生成分类器及免训练增强。
2303.15786|v2.result: 在少样本和零样本场景下实现更好的泛化性能。

2303.10431|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模视觉-语言模型(VLM)因训练数据中身份群体分布偏斜而产生社会偏见，导致特定文本概念与不同身份群体图像的相似度偏斜，限制其在现实高风险应用中的可用性问题。提出DeAR（Debiasing with Additive Residuals），学习加性残差图像表示来偏移原始表示，确保公平的输出表示，降低表示区分不同身份群体的能力。同时引入Protected Attribute Tag Association数据集以更好地评估去偏效果。
2303.10431|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses societal biases in large vision-language models (VLMs) caused by skewed identity group distributions in training data, which manifest as biased similarities between text concepts and images of different groups. It proposes DeAR (Debiasing with Additive Residuals), which learns additive residual image representations to offset original representations for fairer outputs. It also introduces the Protected Attribute Tag Association dataset for better evaluation.
2303.10431|v2.assessment: 该工作关注VLM公平性问题，方法简洁，但主题与自动驾驶感知领域关联很弱，主要面向AI伦理与公平性研究。
2303.10431|v2.contribution: 提出DeAR去偏方法，通过学习加性残差图像表示实现公平输出。
2303.10431|v2.innovation: 利用加性残差偏移原始表示以降低身份群体区分能力，并引入新评估数据集。
2303.10431|v2.result: 有效减少表示对不同身份群体的区分能力，提升公平性。

THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在自由形式生成中产生物体幻觉、缺乏系统性评测基准的问题，本文提出了 THRONE，一个基于物体的幻觉基准。该方法通过构建包含真实与虚构物体的问答对，系统评估 LVLM 在自由生成场景下对物体存在性、属性及关系的描述准确性。相比已有主要针对判别式或短答案任务的幻觉基准，THRONE 更贴近实际自由文本生成场景。实验揭示了当前主流 LVLM 在物体幻觉上的显著缺陷，为后续改进提供了量化依据。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic benchmarks for object hallucination in free-form generations of large vision-language models (LVLMs). It introduces THRONE, an object-based hallucination benchmark that constructs question-answer pairs involving real and fictitious objects to evaluate LVLMs' accuracy in describing object existence, attributes, and relations. Compared to prior benchmarks focused on discriminative or short-answer tasks, THRONE better reflects realistic free-form generation scenarios and reveals substantial object hallucination deficiencies in current LVLMs.
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.assessment: 该工作为 LVLM 幻觉评测提供了更贴近真实生成场景的基准，对多模态大模型可信度研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.contribution: 提出了面向自由形式生成的基于物体的 LVLM 幻觉评测基准 THRONE。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.innovation: 将幻觉评测从判别式/短答案任务扩展到自由文本生成，并围绕物体存在性、属性与关系构建评测。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.result: 实验揭示了当前主流 LVLM 在自由生成中普遍存在显著的物体幻觉问题。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be._arxiv_id: THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Benchmark for the Free-Form Generations of Large Vision-Language Models.

VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）知识编辑缺乏专用评测基准的问题，本文提出了 VLKEB，一个面向 LVLM 的知识编辑基准。该基准构建了涵盖多种知识类型与编辑场景的数据，用于系统评估现有知识编辑方法在视觉语言模型上的有效性、泛化性与副作用。相比以往主要针对纯语言模型的知识编辑评测，VLKEB 引入了视觉模态，填补了多模态知识编辑评测的空白。实验表明现有知识编辑方法在 LVLM 上仍面临可靠性、泛化性与知识保持等挑战。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_en: This paper addresses the absence of dedicated benchmarks for knowledge editing in large vision-language models (LVLMs) by introducing VLKEB. The benchmark constructs diverse knowledge types and editing scenarios to systematically evaluate the effectiveness, generalization, and side effects of existing knowledge editing methods on LVLMs. Unlike prior benchmarks focused on language-only models, VLKEB incorporates the visual modality, filling a gap in multimodal knowledge editing evaluation and revealing persistent challenges in reliability, generalization, and knowledge retention.
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.assessment: 该工作填补了多模态知识编辑评测的空白，对 LVLM 可控性与知识更新研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.contribution: 提出了面向大型视觉语言模型的知识编辑评测基准 VLKEB。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.innovation: 将知识编辑评测从纯语言模型扩展到视觉语言模型，引入视觉模态下的编辑场景。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.result: 实验表明现有知识编辑方法在 LVLM 上在可靠性、泛化性与知识保持方面仍存在明显不足。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno._arxiv_id: VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Knowledge Editing Benchmark.

ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在多轮对话场景下评测不足的问题，本文提出了 ConvBench，一个具备分层消融能力的多轮对话评测基准。该基准通过设计多轮交互任务并支持对对话历史、视觉信息等要素进行分层消融，系统分析模型在多轮对话中的能力与失败原因。相比已有单轮或简单多轮评测，ConvBench 能更细粒度地定位模型缺陷。实验揭示了当前 LVLM 在多轮对话中的感知、推理与上下文保持等方面的不足。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient evaluation of large vision-language models (LVLMs) in multi-turn conversation settings by proposing ConvBench, a multi-turn conversation benchmark with hierarchical ablation capability. It designs multi-turn interaction tasks and supports hierarchical ablation of dialogue history and visual information to systematically analyze model capabilities and failure causes. Compared to prior single-turn or simple multi-turn evaluations, ConvBench enables finer-grained diagnosis of model deficiencies, revealing shortcomings in perception, reasoning, and context retention.
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.assessment: 该工作为 LVLM 多轮对话能力提供了细粒度评测工具，对多模态交互研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.contribution: 提出了具备分层消融能力的 LVLM 多轮对话评测基准 ConvBench。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.innovation: 通过分层消融设计实现对多轮对话中模型能力与失败原因的细粒度定位。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.result: 实验揭示了当前 LVLM 在多轮对话的感知、推理与上下文保持方面存在明显不足。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva._arxiv_id: ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Evaluation Benchmark with Hierarchical Ablation Capability for Large Vision-Language Models.

2408.16176|v2.summary_cn: 针对预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）能否在无需微调的情况下辅助生物学家进行物种性状发现的问题，本文提出了 VLM4Bio 基准数据集。该数据集包含 469K 问答对、30K 图像，覆盖鱼类、鸟类和蝴蝶三类生物及五个生物学相关任务，并评估了 12 个 SOTA VLM。研究还探索了提示工程与推理幻觉对模型性能的影响。结果表明当前 SOTA VLM 在生物图像问答上仍存在明显局限，为领域应用提供了量化参考。
2408.16176|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) can assist biologists in trait discovery without additional fine-tuning, introducing the VLM4Bio benchmark. The dataset comprises 469K question-answer pairs over 30K images spanning fishes, birds, and butterflies across five biologically relevant tasks, and evaluates 12 state-of-the-art VLMs. It further examines prompting techniques and reasoning hallucination, revealing notable limitations of current VLMs in biological image question answering.
2408.16176|v2.assessment: 该工作为 VLM 在生物领域的应用提供了大规模评测基准，方法严谨，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2408.16176|v2.contribution: 构建了包含 469K 问答对、30K 图像的生物图像 VLM 评测基准 VLM4Bio。
2408.16176|v2.innovation: 首次系统评测 12 个 SOTA VLM 在生物性状发现任务上的零样本能力并分析提示与幻觉影响。
2408.16176|v2.result: 实验表明当前 SOTA VLM 在生物图像问答任务上仍存在明显局限。

Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割需要额外训练或依赖特定数据集的问题，本文提出了一种从现成视觉语言模型（VLM）中涌现开放词汇语义分割能力的方法。该方法无需额外训练，直接利用预训练 VLM 的内部特征与注意力机制实现像素级开放词汇分割。相比需要专门训练的分割方法，该工作展示了 VLM 中隐含的分割能力可被直接激发。实验在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得了有竞争力的零样本性能。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for additional training or dataset-specific supervision in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by showing that such capability can emerge from off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs). Without any additional training, the method directly exploits internal features and attention mechanisms of pre-trained VLMs to achieve pixel-level open-vocabulary segmentation. Compared to methods requiring dedicated training, it demonstrates that latent segmentation ability in VLMs can be directly elicited, achieving competitive zero-shot performance on multiple benchmarks.
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.assessment: 该工作揭示了现成 VLM 中隐含的开放词汇分割能力，方法简洁且具启发性，对开放集感知与多模态研究有参考价值。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.contribution: 提出了一种无需额外训练、从现成 VLM 中涌现开放词汇语义分割的方法。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.innovation: 直接利用预训练 VLM 的内部特征与注意力机制激发像素级开放词汇分割能力。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.result: 在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得了有竞争力的零样本性能。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen._arxiv_id: Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation from Off-the-Shelf Vision-Language Models.

Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_cn: 针对零样本开放词汇 3D 视觉定位（3D visual grounding）任务中缺乏 3D 标注与开放词汇泛化能力的问题，本文提出了基于视觉编程（visual programming）的方法。该方法将 3D 视觉定位分解为可由现成视觉语言模型执行的子任务，通过程序化组合实现零样本开放词汇的 3D 目标定位。相比依赖 3D 标注训练的监督方法，该工作无需 3D 训练数据即可泛化到新类别。实验在多个 3D 视觉定位基准上取得了优于现有零样本方法的性能。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of 3D annotations and open-vocabulary generalization in zero-shot open-vocabulary 3D visual grounding by proposing a visual programming approach. The method decomposes 3D visual grounding into subtasks executable by off-the-shelf vision-language models, enabling zero-shot open-vocabulary 3D object localization through programmatic composition. Unlike supervised methods requiring 3D annotations, it generalizes to novel categories without 3D training data, outperforming existing zero-shot methods on multiple 3D visual grounding benchmarks.
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.assessment: 该工作将视觉编程引入零样本开放词汇 3D 视觉定位，无需 3D 标注即可泛化到新类别，对 3D 感知与多模态研究有较高参考价值。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.contribution: 提出了基于视觉编程的零样本开放词汇 3D 视觉定位方法。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.innovation: 将 3D 视觉定位分解为现成 VLM 可执行的子任务并通过程序化组合实现开放词汇定位。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.result: 在多个 3D 视觉定位基准上取得了优于现有零样本方法的性能。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo._arxiv_id: Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary 3D Visual Grounding.

DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_cn: 针对开放世界少样本学习（OW-FSL）中CLIP因图文对齐偏差导致基类与新类性能失衡的问题，本文提出DeIL（Direct-and-Inverse CLIP）框架。方法通过直接分支与逆分支的双向提示学习，缓解CLIP在少样本场景下对基类的过拟合，并增强对新类的泛化能力。相比已有仅依赖单向提示微调的工作，DeIL在多个OW-FSL基准上取得更均衡的基类-新类精度，调和平均指标有稳定提升。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_en: This paper addresses the base-novel performance imbalance in open-world few-shot learning (OW-FSL) caused by CLIP's image-text alignment bias. It proposes DeIL, a Direct-and-Inverse CLIP framework that employs bidirectional prompt learning to mitigate overfitting to base classes while improving generalization to novel ones. Compared with prior single-direction prompt tuning methods, DeIL achieves more balanced base-novel accuracy and consistent gains in harmonic mean across OW-FSL benchmarks.
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.assessment: 面向开放世界少样本识别的CLIP改进工作，思路清晰，对开放集/少样本检测方向有参考价值。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.contribution: 提出直接-逆双向CLIP提示学习框架以平衡基类与新类性能。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.innovation: 用逆分支补偿CLIP图文对齐偏差，实现双向提示微调。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.result: 在多个OW-FSL基准上取得更均衡的基类-新类精度与更高的调和平均。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W._arxiv_id: DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-World Few-Shot Learning.

Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉语言模型（VLM）视觉编码器与语言模型耦合不足、视觉表征能力受限的问题，本文提出受视觉机理启发的VLM架构改进方案。方法在视觉编码端引入更接近生物视觉的多尺度/多路径处理，并优化视觉-语言对齐模块，使视觉特征更充分地服务于下游多模态推理。相比主流单塔ViT+投影层范式，该工作在多项多模态理解基准上取得提升，验证了视觉先验设计对VLM性能的增益。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_en: This paper targets the limited visual representation capability in current VLMs, where the vision encoder and language model are loosely coupled. It proposes a vision-inspired VLM architecture that introduces multi-scale, multi-path visual processing closer to biological vision and refines the vision-language alignment module. Compared with the mainstream single-tower ViT-plus-projector paradigm, it improves performance on several multimodal understanding benchmarks, demonstrating the benefit of visual priors for VLMs.
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.assessment: 从视觉机理角度改进VLM架构，对多模态感知与VLM方向研究者有启发意义。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.contribution: 提出视觉机理启发的VLM架构以增强视觉表征与跨模态对齐。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.innovation: 将生物视觉式的多尺度多路径处理引入VLM视觉编码端。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.result: 在多项多模态理解基准上优于主流ViT+投影层范式。

DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）难以按人类偏好进行细粒度对齐与交互的问题，本文提出DRESS框架，利用自然语言反馈来指导模型对齐与交互行为。方法构建了基于自然语言批评的反馈数据集与训练流程，使模型能理解并响应人类以语言形式给出的修正意见，从而提升回复的 helpfulness 与安全性。相比仅依赖RLHF标量奖励的对齐方法，DRESS在交互质量与指令遵循上表现更优。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of fine-grained human-preference alignment and interaction in large vision-language models (LVLMs). It proposes DRESS, a framework that leverages natural language feedback to instruct models to align and interact with humans. By constructing feedback data and a training pipeline based on natural language critiques, DRESS improves helpfulness and safety over scalar-reward RLHF-only alignment, yielding better interaction quality and instruction following.
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.assessment: 以自然语言反馈驱动LVLM对齐，对多模态交互与对齐研究方向有参考价值。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.contribution: 提出基于自然语言反馈的LVLM对齐与交互框架DRESS。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.innovation: 用自然语言批评替代标量奖励实现细粒度人类偏好对齐。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.result: 在交互质量与指令遵循上优于仅用RLHF标量奖励的对齐方法。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag._arxiv_id: DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Language Models to Align and Interact with Humans via Natural Language Feedback.

Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中语言幻觉与视觉错觉相互纠缠、现有基准难以诊断的问题，本文提出HallusionBench诊断套件。该基准设计了成对的视觉依赖与语言依赖问题，可分离并量化模型对图像内容的误读（视觉错觉）与对语言先验的过度依赖（语言幻觉）。相比既有幻觉评测，HallusionBench能更精细地定位失败模式，实验显示主流LVLM在该基准上仍存在显著幻觉，暴露了当前模型的鲁棒性短板。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_en: This paper addresses the entangled language hallucination and visual illusion in large vision-language models (LVLMs), which existing benchmarks struggle to diagnose. It introduces HallusionBench, a diagnostic suite with paired vision-dependent and language-dependent questions that disentangle and quantify visual misperception and over-reliance on language priors. Compared with prior hallucination evaluations, it localizes failure modes more precisely and reveals substantial hallucination in mainstream LVLMs.
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.assessment: 高质量的多模态幻觉诊断基准，对VLM评测与鲁棒性研究有重要参考价值。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.contribution: 提出可分离语言幻觉与视觉错觉的HallusionBench诊断基准。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.innovation: 用成对视觉/语言依赖问题解耦两类幻觉失败模式。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.result: 揭示主流LVLM在该基准上仍存在显著幻觉与鲁棒性不足。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S._arxiv_id: Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic Suite for Entangled Language Hallucination and Visual Illusion in Large Vision-Language Models.

Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在下游任务适配中依赖梯度或白盒访问、难以在黑盒条件下优化的问题，本文提出将语言模型作为黑盒优化器来搜索VLM的提示/适配方案。方法利用LLM生成并迭代改进候选提示或配置，通过黑盒反馈进行优化，无需访问VLM内部参数。相比需梯度反传的提示微调方法，该方案在保持竞争力的同时具备更好的通用性与部署便利性。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_en: This paper targets the difficulty of adapting vision-language models (VLMs) under black-box conditions where gradients or white-box access are unavailable. It proposes using language models as black-box optimizers to search prompts or adaptation configurations for VLMs, iteratively generating and refining candidates via black-box feedback without accessing internal parameters. Compared with gradient-based prompt tuning, it offers competitive performance with greater generality and deployment convenience.
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.assessment: 黑盒优化VLM适配的思路新颖，对提示工程与VLM应用研究有参考意义。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.contribution: 提出以语言模型作为黑盒优化器来适配VLM。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.innovation: 在无梯度、无白盒访问条件下用LLM迭代搜索提示/配置。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.result: 在保持与梯度式提示微调相当性能的同时提升通用性与部署便利性。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers._arxiv_id: Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers for Vision-Language Models.

Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.summary_cn: 针对从视觉内容自动生成匹配音效这一跨模态生成难题，本文提出Sonic VisionLM，利用视觉语言模型为视频/图像生成对应声音。方法借助VLM的视觉理解与语言推理能力，将视觉场景转化为声音描述并驱动音频生成，实现视觉到听觉的跨模态映射。相比传统端到端视频到音频生成方法，该工作利用VLM的语义先验提升了生成声音与场景的语义一致性。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.summary_en: This paper addresses the cross-modal challenge of automatically generating matching sound effects from visual content. It proposes Sonic VisionLM, which leverages vision-language models to generate sound for videos/images by translating visual scenes into sound descriptions that drive audio generation. Compared with conventional end-to-end video-to-audio methods, it exploits VLM semantic priors to improve the semantic consistency between generated sound and scene.
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.assessment: 将VLM用于视觉到声音的跨模态生成，方向新颖，对多模态生成研究有启发。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.contribution: 提出利用VLM实现视觉到声音生成的Sonic VisionLM框架。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.innovation: 借助VLM语义先验将视觉场景转化为声音描述以驱动音频生成。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.result: 相比端到端视频到音频方法提升了生成声音与场景的语义一致性。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio._arxiv_id: Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Vision Language Models.

2412.09082|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉语言导航（VLN）方法主要针对单阶段导航，难以应对复杂动态环境中的多阶段长时程任务。本文提出长时程视觉语言导航（LH-VLN）新任务，强调跨连续子任务的长期规划与决策一致性，并开发了自动化数据生成平台NavGen，通过双向多粒度生成构建复杂任务结构数据集。作者构建了LHPR-VLN基准，包含3260个任务、平均150步，并提出ISR、CSR、CGT等细粒度评估指标。该工作为长时程VLN提供了首个专用数据集与评估体系，但摘要未给出具体性能数据。
2412.09082|v2.summary_en: Existing Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) methods focus on single-stage navigation, limiting effectiveness in multi-stage, long-horizon tasks. This paper introduces Long-Horizon VLN (LH-VLN), an automated data generation platform NavGen, and the LHPR-VLN benchmark with 3,260 tasks averaging 150 steps, along with ISR, CSR, and CGT metrics for fine-grained evaluation. It provides the first dedicated dataset and evaluation suite for long-horizon VLN, though no quantitative performance results are reported in the abstract.
2412.09082|v2.assessment: 该工作将VLN推向长时程多阶段设定，基准与指标设计对具身智能与导航研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联有限。
2412.09082|v2.contribution: 提出长时程视觉语言导航任务、自动化数据生成平台NavGen及首个LHPR-VLN基准与细粒度评估指标。
2412.09082|v2.innovation: 通过双向多粒度生成构建复杂任务结构，并引入ISR/CSR/CGT指标评估长时程任务完成度。
2412.09082|v2.result: 构建了3260个任务、平均150步的基准，但摘要未报告具体模型性能数据。

This paper introduces DynaMath, a dynamic visual math benchmark with 501 multi-topic seed questions represented as Python programs that automatically generate large variant sets for in-depth robustness evaluation.
2411.00836|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了VLM数学推理鲁棒性缺陷并提出动态基准，对VLM评测研究者有价值，但与自动驾驶感知方向关联有限。
2411.00836|v2.contribution: 提出DynaMath动态视觉数学基准，通过程序化种子问题自动生成变体以评估VLM推理鲁棒性。
2411.00836|v2.innovation: 将种子问题表示为Python程序以自动生成大量变体，实现动态鲁棒性评估。
2411.00836|v2.result: 构建了501个多主题种子问题及可扩展变体集，但摘要未报告具体评测数值。

2306.13394|v2.summary_en: Existing case studies cannot fully reflect MLLM performance due to lack of comprehensive evaluation. This paper presents MME, the first comprehensive MLLM evaluation benchmark covering 14 perception and cognition subtasks with manually designed instruction-answer pairs to avoid data leakage and enable fair quantitative comparison. Evaluation of 30 advanced MLLMs shows substantial room for improvement and reveals optimization directions.
2306.13394|v2.assessment: MME是MLLM评测领域的奠基性基准之一，人工标注与简洁指令设计对多模态评测研究者有较高参考价值。
2306.13394|v2.contribution: 提出首个覆盖感知与认知14个子任务的综合MLLM评估基准MME，并系统评测30个先进模型。
2306.13394|v2.innovation: 全人工设计指令-答案对避免数据泄漏，简洁指令设计支持公平比较与定量统计。
2306.13394|v2.result: 在MME上评测30个MLLM，表明现有模型仍有较大提升空间并揭示优化方向。

2510.21679|v2.summary_cn: 针对石油天然气企业公关广告中潜在'漂绿'（greenwashing）行为难以大规模识别的问题，作者构建了一个由专家标注的Facebook与YouTube视频广告基准数据集，覆盖20个国家50余家公司/倡导组织，标注了13种框架（framing）类型。该数据集专为视觉语言模型（VLM）评测设计，区别于以往纯文本的框架数据集。基线实验显示GPT-4.1在环境信息检测上可达79% F1，但最佳模型在'绿色创新'框架识别上仅46% F1，暴露出隐式框架、变长视频处理等挑战。
2510.21679|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces an expert-annotated benchmark of video ads from Facebook and YouTube for detecting framing and potential greenwashing by oil & gas companies, covering 13 framing types across 50+ organizations in 20 countries. Unlike prior text-only framing datasets, it is designed for vision-language model evaluation. Baselines show GPT-4.1 reaches 79% F1 on environmental message detection, while the best model achieves only 46% F1 on green-innovation framing, highlighting challenges in implicit framing and variable-length video handling.
2510.21679|v2.assessment: 属于NLP/多媒体交叉的广告分析基准，与自动驾驶感知研究几乎无交集，仅对多模态VLM评测方法有间接参考价值。
2510.21679|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向视频广告框架与漂绿检测的多模态专家标注基准数据集。
2510.21679|v2.innovation: 将框架分析从纯文本扩展到视频-语言多模态场景，并引入13类框架标注。
2510.21679|v2.result: GPT-4.1环境信息检测达79% F1，但绿色创新框架识别最佳仅46% F1。

2507.11932|v2.summary_en: The paper introduces Hyperphantasia, a synthetic benchmark for evaluating the mental visualization capabilities of multimodal LLMs through four procedurally generated puzzle types at three difficulty levels. Comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art models reveals a substantial gap versus human performance, and the authors explore potential approaches to improve this capability.
2507.11932|v2.assessment: 对MLLM认知能力评测有方法论价值，但与自动驾驶感知/3D检测方向关联很弱。
2507.11932|v2.contribution: 提出首个系统评测MLLM心理可视化能力的合成基准。
2507.11932|v2.innovation: 用程序化生成的多难度谜题将'内部视觉构建'能力从被动感知中分离出来评测。
2507.11932|v2.result: 揭示当前MLLM与人类在心理可视化任务上存在显著性能差距。

2505.19028|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VQA基准缺乏配对'普通图表'与'信息图图表'、无法评估MLLM对设计驱动视觉元素（象形图、图标等）理解能力的问题，作者提出InfoChartQA基准，包含5,642对信息图与普通图表（共享底层数据但视觉呈现不同），并设计了基于视觉元素的问题。对20个MLLM的评测显示其在信息图图表上性能显著下降，尤其是涉及隐喻的视觉元素问题；配对设计支持细粒度错误分析与消融研究。
2505.19028|v2.summary_en: InfoChartQA is a benchmark of 5,642 paired infographic and plain charts sharing identical underlying data but differing in visual presentation, designed to evaluate MLLMs on infographic chart understanding with visual-element-based questions. Evaluation of 20 MLLMs reveals substantial performance degradation on infographic charts, especially metaphor-related visual-element questions, with the paired design enabling fine-grained error analysis.
2505.19028|v2.assessment: 图表理解基准设计严谨，但属于文档/图表VQA方向，与自动驾驶感知研究基本无关。

2505.19028|v2.innovation: 通过同数据不同呈现的图表配对实现可控的视觉设计因素消融分析。
2505.19028|v2.result: 20个MLLM在信息图图表上性能显著下降，隐喻类视觉元素问题尤为明显。

2504.16427|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型在认知层面语义理解能力研究不足的问题，作者提出MMLA基准，包含来自编排与真实场景的61K+多模态话语，覆盖意图、情绪、对话行为、情感、说话风格、交际行为六个核心语义维度。对八类主流LLM/MLLM采用零样本、监督微调和指令微调三种方式评测，结果显示即使微调后模型也仅达约60%~70%准确率，凸显当前MLLM理解复杂人类语言的局限。
2504.16427|v2.summary_en: MMLA is a comprehensive benchmark of over 61K multimodal utterances covering six core dimensions of multimodal semantics (intent, emotion, dialogue act, sentiment, speaking style, communication behavior). Evaluating eight mainstream LLM/MLLM branches under zero-shot, supervised fine-tuning, and instruction tuning reveals that even fine-tuned models reach only about 60-70% accuracy, underscoring limitations in cognitive-level multimodal language understanding.
2504.16427|v2.assessment: 对多模态语言分析评测有贡献，但与自动驾驶视觉感知方向关联度低。
2504.16427|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖六个语义维度、61K+话语的多模态语言分析综合基准MMLA。
2504.16427|v2.innovation: 首次系统评测MLLM在认知层面多模态语义（意图、情绪等）的理解能力。
2504.16427|v2.result: 即使微调后主流MLLM准确率也仅约60%~70%。

2507.18342|v2.summary_cn: 针对MLLM在第一人称（自我中心）与第三人称视角间跨视角推理能力尚未被探索的问题，作者提出EgoExoBench，这是首个面向自我-他人视角视频理解与推理的基准，包含7,300+问答对、11个子任务，归为语义对齐、视角关联、时序推理三大核心挑战。对13个最先进MLLM的评测表明，模型在单视角任务上表现优异，但在跨视角语义对齐、视角关联与时序动态推断上表现不佳。
2507.18342|v2.summary_en: EgoExoBench is the first benchmark for egocentric-exocentric video understanding and reasoning, comprising over 7,300 QA pairs across eleven sub-tasks organized into semantic alignment, viewpoint association, and temporal reasoning. Evaluation of 13 state-of-the-art MLLMs shows strong single-view performance but poor cross-view semantic alignment, viewpoint association, and temporal dynamics inference.
2507.18342|v2.assessment: 跨视角视频理解基准对具身智能有参考价值，但与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测方向关联有限。
2507.18342|v2.contribution: 提出首个自我-他人视角视频理解与推理基准EgoExoBench。

2601.09111|v2.summary_cn: 传统视觉语言导航（VLN）依赖训练与测试数据同分布的闭集假设，难以适应真实开放环境中的多样场景与不一致指令。本文提出 slow4fast-VLN，构建快慢交互推理框架：快推理模块为端到端策略网络，实时输出动作并将执行记录存入历史仓库形成记忆；慢推理模块分析这些记忆，通过深度反思提取经验以增强泛化能力。该方法受人类快慢认知系统启发，在 GSA-VLN 任务上通过引入多样环境和指令提升开放场景适应能力。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2601.09111|v2.summary_en: Traditional Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) relies on a close-set assumption where training and test data share the same distribution, which fails in open environments with diverse scenes and inconsistent instructions. This paper proposes slow4fast-VLN, a dynamic interactive fast-slow reasoning framework in which a fast end-to-end policy network outputs real-time actions and accumulates execution records into a memory repository, while a slow reasoning module reflects on these memories to extract experiences that enhance generalization. Inspired by human fast-slow cognition, the method targets the General Scene Adaptation (GSA-VLN) task. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2601.09111|v2.assessment: 将快慢认知系统引入开放环境 VLN 的思路有新意，但摘要缺乏实验数据，且与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2601.09111|v2.contribution: 提出面向开放场景适应的快慢交互推理 VLN 框架 slow4fast-VLN。
2601.09111|v2.innovation: 用快推理模块积累记忆、慢推理模块反思提取经验的双系统交互机制。
2601.09111|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，效果有待正文验证。

2601.06394|v2.summary_cn: 课堂学生行为投入度测量通常需要大量标注数据，且隐私限制使数据难以共享，同时现有方法忽略了同伴行为构成的课堂上下文。本文提出三阶段框架：先用少样本微调视觉语言模型进行学生动作识别；再用滑动时间窗将 2 分钟长视频切分为不重叠片段，逐段赋予动作类别形成动作序列；最后用大语言模型结合课堂上下文对整段动作序列进行分类，判断投入度等级。该方法通过 VLM 动作解析与 LLM 序列分类引入同伴上下文，缓解标注依赖。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2601.06394|v2.summary_en: Measuring student behavioral engagement typically requires substantial annotated data, while privacy constraints hinder data sharing and existing methods ignore peer context. This paper proposes a three-stage framework: few-shot fine-tuning of a vision-language model for student action recognition, sliding temporal windows to segment each 2-minute video into non-overlapping clips labeled with action categories, and an LLM that classifies the resulting action sequence together with classroom context into engagement levels. The approach incorporates peer context via VLM action parsing and LLM sequence classification to alleviate annotation dependence. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2601.06394|v2.assessment: 属于教育场景视频理解应用，方法组合常规，与自动驾驶感知研究领域基本无关。
2601.06394|v2.contribution: 提出结合 VLM 动作解析与 LLM 序列分类的同伴感知学生投入度测量框架。
2601.06394|v2.innovation: 将同伴行为作为课堂上下文引入投入度分类，并采用滑动窗口生成动作序列。
2601.06394|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。

2601.02046|v2.summary_cn: SDXL、FLUX 等文生图扩散模型虽已高度逼真，但在肢体、人脸、文字等局部仍普遍存在小尺度畸变；现有精修方法要么需昂贵的迭代重生成，要么依赖空间定位能力弱的 VLM，导致语义漂移和不可靠的局部编辑。本文提出 Agentic Retoucher，将生成后校正重构为类人的感知-推理-动作闭环：感知智能体学习上下文显著性以定位细粒度畸变，推理智能体通过渐进偏好对齐进行类人诊断，动作智能体依据用户偏好自适应规划局部修复。作者还构建了 GenBlemish-27K 数据集（6K 张 T2I 图像、27K 标注）以支持细粒度监督与定量评估。
2601.02046|v2.summary_en: Text-to-image diffusion models such as SDXL and FLUX remain prone to small-scale distortions in limbs, faces, and text, while existing refinement methods either require costly iterative regeneration or rely on VLMs with weak spatial grounding, causing semantic drift. This paper proposes Agentic Retoucher, a hierarchical decision-driven framework that reformulates post-generation correction as a perception-reasoning-action loop comprising a perception agent for contextual saliency-based distortion localization, a reasoning agent with progressive preference alignment, and an action agent for preference-guided localized inpainting. The authors also construct GenBlemish-27K, a dataset of 6K T2I images with 27K annotations, for fine-grained supervision and evaluation.
2601.02046|v2.assessment: 面向文生图后处理的多智能体框架，数据集构建有一定价值，但与自动驾驶感知研究领域几乎不相关。
2601.02046|v2.contribution: 提出感知-推理-动作闭环的文生图局部畸变修复框架及 GenBlemish-27K 数据集。
2601.02046|v2.innovation: 用分层智能体将生成后校正建模为类人自校正决策过程，并引入渐进偏好对齐。
2601.02046|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，仅说明构建了 6K 图像、27K 标注的数据集。

Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频自监督表示学习中时序信息利用不足的问题，提出通过预测视频播放速率这一前置任务来学习时空表征。方法上构造不同播放速率的视频片段作为自监督信号，迫使网络捕捉细粒度运动动态。相比已有基于帧序或对比学习的方法，该任务更直接地建模运动速度这一物理量。在多个下游任务（如动作识别、视频检索）上取得了优于或可比于当时自监督方法的性能。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of temporal dynamics in self-supervised video representation learning by introducing video playback rate perception as a pretext task. It constructs clips at varying playback speeds to force the network to capture fine-grained motion cues. The approach outperforms or matches prior self-supervised methods on downstream tasks such as action recognition and video retrieval.
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.assessment: 将播放速率作为自监督信号具有一定新意，但整体影响力有限，与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.contribution: 提出以视频播放速率预测为前置任务的自监督时空表征学习方法。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.innovation: 利用播放速率这一物理量作为自监督信号，直接建模运动速度。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.result: 在多个下游视频理解任务上取得优于或可比于同期自监督方法的性能。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-._arxiv_id: Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-Supervised Spatio-Temporal Representation Learning.

Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..summary_cn: 该论文针对屏幕录制教程视频的理解问题，这类视频包含丰富的操作步骤和界面交互信息。方法上可能构建了专用数据集或提出了针对教程视频的解析模型，以识别操作步骤和界面元素。相比通用视频理解方法，更关注教程视频特有的结构化信息。但摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法与实验数据。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..summary_en: This paper targets the understanding of screencast tutorial videos, which contain structured procedural and UI interaction information. It likely introduces a dedicated dataset or model tailored to parsing tutorial steps and interface elements. However, the abstract is missing, preventing confirmation of specific methods and results.
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..assessment: 主题较为小众，与自动驾驶和3D感知领域几乎无关，摘要缺失导致无法评估其技术贡献。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..contribution: 针对屏幕录制教程视频提出理解方法或数据集。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..innovation: 聚焦教程视频特有的结构化操作信息解析。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果。

1912.00381|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D CNN在视频动作识别中参数量大、计算开销高且在缺乏大规模数据时性能不佳的问题，提出在3D卷积的时空分解中引入空间门控机制，实现为Gate-Shift Module (GSM)。GSM轻量且可将2D CNN转化为高效的时空特征提取器，几乎不增加参数和计算量即可自适应地沿时间维度路由和融合特征。在Something-Something-V1和Diving48上取得state-of-the-art，在EPIC-Kitchens上以远低的模型复杂度获得有竞争力的结果。
1912.00381|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high parameter and computation cost of 3D CNNs for video action recognition, which underperform without large-scale training data. It proposes spatial gating in the spatio-temporal decomposition of 3D kernels, implemented as the lightweight Gate-Shift Module (GSM) that turns a 2D-CNN into an efficient spatio-temporal feature extractor with negligible overhead. It achieves state-of-the-art results on Something-Something-V1 and Diving48, and competitive results on EPIC-Kitchens with far less model complexity.
1912.00381|v2.assessment: GSM设计简洁高效，在多个基准上验证了有效性，对视频理解领域有实际参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
1912.00381|v2.contribution: 提出轻量级Gate-Shift Module，将2D CNN高效转化为时空特征提取器。
1912.00381|v2.innovation: 在3D卷积时空分解中引入空间门控，以极低开销实现自适应时间特征路由。
1912.00381|v2.result: 在Something-Something-V1和Diving48上达到state-of-the-art，EPIC-Kitchens上以更低复杂度取得有竞争力结果。

RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中3D卷积计算成本高的问题，提出可学习的3D-Shift操作（RubiksNet），以高效方式实现时空特征交互。方法上通过学习偏移操作替代部分3D卷积，在保持表达能力的同时显著降低计算量。相比固定偏移的Shift方法，可学习偏移更灵活。但摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验数据和对比结果。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_en: This paper targets the high computational cost of 3D convolutions in video action recognition by proposing a learnable 3D-Shift operation (RubiksNet) for efficient spatio-temporal feature interaction. It replaces part of 3D convolutions with learnable shift operations, reducing computation while maintaining expressiveness. However, the abstract is missing, preventing confirmation of specific experimental results.
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.assessment: 可学习3D-Shift思路与Gate-Shift等工作互补，对高效视频理解有参考价值，但摘要缺失影响完整评估。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.contribution: 提出可学习的3D-Shift操作以实现高效视频动作识别。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.innovation: 用可学习偏移替代部分3D卷积，在降低计算量的同时保持时空建模能力。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici._arxiv_id: RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Efficient Video Action Recognition.

Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.summary_cn: 针对现有视频问答基准多聚焦静态场景或短片段、缺乏对动态环境综合理解的问题，本文提出了 Env-QA 基准，用于评估模型对动态环境中物体、动作与时空因果关系的理解能力。方法上构建了覆盖多种动态场景的视频问答数据集，并设计了需要多步时空推理的问题类型。相比已有 VideoQA 基准，Env-QA 更强调环境动态变化与长时序推理。实验显示现有 VLM/VideoQA 模型在该基准上表现显著低于人类水平，暴露出动态环境理解的不足。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.summary_en: This paper introduces Env-QA, a video question answering benchmark designed to evaluate comprehensive understanding of dynamic environments. It constructs diverse dynamic-scene videos with questions requiring multi-step spatio-temporal reasoning. Experiments show that existing VideoQA and VLM models substantially underperform humans, revealing limitations in dynamic environment understanding.
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.assessment: 作为基准类工作，Env-QA 为动态环境视频理解提供了评测工具，对视频理解与多模态研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.contribution: 提出了面向动态环境综合理解的视频问答基准 Env-QA。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.innovation: 强调环境动态变化与长时序时空因果推理的问题设计。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.result: 现有模型在该基准上远低于人类水平，暴露动态理解短板。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench._arxiv_id: Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Benchmark for Comprehensive Understanding of Dynamic Environments.

Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.summary_cn: 针对视频理解中时空建模结构不统一、不同任务需定制架构的问题，本文提出统一的图结构化模型，将视频中的实体与关系建模为图节点与边。方法通过图神经网络在统一框架下处理动作识别、时序定位等任务。相比任务专用架构，该统一模型减少了设计冗余并提升泛化性。实验在多个视频理解基准上取得与专用方法相当或更优的性能。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.summary_en: This paper proposes unified graph structured models for video understanding, representing video entities and relations as graph nodes and edges. A graph neural network handles multiple tasks within a single framework. Experiments on several video benchmarks show comparable or superior performance to task-specific methods.
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.assessment: 统一图结构建模思路对视频理解有方法学价值，但摘要信息有限，与自动驾驶感知的直接相关性一般。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.contribution: 提出统一图结构化视频理解模型。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.innovation: 用图节点与边统一建模视频实体与关系。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.result: 在多个视频理解基准上达到与专用方法相当或更优性能。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide._arxiv_id: Unified Graph Structured Models for Video Understanding.

Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_cn: 针对细粒度体育动作识别中标注样本稀缺的问题，本文提出视频姿态蒸馏方法，将姿态估计知识蒸馏到动作识别模型中。方法利用姿态作为中间监督，在少样本条件下提升细粒度动作判别能力。相比直接端到端训练，姿态蒸馏提供了更强的结构化先验。实验在少样本体育动作识别任务上取得明显提升。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_en: This paper proposes video pose distillation for few-shot fine-grained sports action recognition, transferring pose estimation knowledge into the action recognition model. Pose serves as intermediate supervision to improve fine-grained discrimination under few-shot settings. Experiments show clear gains on few-shot sports action recognition.
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.assessment: 姿态蒸馏思路对少样本细粒度识别有启发，但应用场景较窄，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.contribution: 提出视频姿态蒸馏用于少样本细粒度动作识别。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.innovation: 以姿态估计作为中间监督进行知识蒸馏。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.result: 在少样本体育动作识别上取得明显性能提升。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi._arxiv_id: Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fine-Grained Sports Action Recognition.

Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中运动建模依赖光流、计算代价高的问题，本文提出在空间与时间上学习自相似性作为广义运动表示。方法通过计算特征自相似性捕捉运动线索，替代显式光流。相比光流方法，该表示更高效且易于端到端训练。实验在多个动作识别基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.summary_en: This paper learns self-similarity in space and time as a generalized motion representation for video action recognition, replacing explicit optical flow. The self-similarity captures motion cues efficiently and is end-to-end trainable. Experiments on action recognition benchmarks show competitive performance.
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.assessment: 以自相似性替代光流的运动建模思路对视频理解有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务相关性有限。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.contribution: 提出时空自相似性作为广义运动表示。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.innovation: 用自相似性替代显式光流进行运动建模。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.result: 在多个动作识别基准上取得有竞争力性能。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti._arxiv_id: Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Time as Generalized Motion for Video Action Recognition.

MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中帧采样策略缺乏可解释性与自适应性的问题，本文提出 MGSampler，一种可解释的采样策略。方法基于运动引导对视频帧进行自适应采样，突出信息量大的片段。相比均匀或随机采样，MGSampler 更具可解释性并提升识别性能。实验在多个动作识别基准上验证了有效性。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.summary_en: This paper proposes MGSampler, an explainable sampling strategy for video action recognition that adaptively samples frames guided by motion. Compared with uniform or random sampling, it is more interpretable and improves recognition performance. Experiments on multiple benchmarks validate its effectiveness.
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.assessment: 采样策略的可解释性对视频理解有方法学意义，但整体影响范围有限，与自动驾驶感知关联一般。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.contribution: 提出可解释的运动引导视频帧采样策略 MGSampler。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.innovation: 基于运动引导的自适应可解释采样。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.result: 在多个动作识别基准上验证了性能提升。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat._arxiv_id: MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strategy for Video Action Recognition.

TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.summary_cn: 针对文本-视频检索中跨模态对齐不足的问题，本文提出 TeachText，一种跨模态广义蒸馏方法。方法通过教师模型蒸馏跨模态知识，增强文本与视频表示的对齐。相比常规对比学习，广义蒸馏提供了更丰富的监督信号。实验在文本-视频检索基准上取得领先性能。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.summary_en: This paper proposes TeachText, a cross-modal generalized distillation method for text-video retrieval. It distills cross-modal knowledge from teacher models to better align text and video representations. Experiments achieve leading performance on text-video retrieval benchmarks.
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏思路对多模态检索有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.contribution: 提出跨模态广义蒸馏方法 TeachText。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.innovation: 利用教师模型蒸馏增强跨模态对齐。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.result: 在文本-视频检索基准上取得领先性能。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil._arxiv_id: TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distillation for Text-Video Retrieval.

Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频表示学习中原始视频计算量大、存储成本高的问题，提出直接在压缩视频域（如H.264的运动矢量和残差）上进行自监督表示学习。方法利用压缩视频中已有的运动信息作为自监督信号，避免了解码全部帧的计算开销。相比在原始RGB帧上做自监督学习的工作，该方法显著降低了计算成本，同时在下游视频理解任务上保持了有竞争力的性能。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational and storage burden of self-supervised video representation learning by operating directly on compressed video signals such as motion vectors and residuals. It leverages the inherent motion information in compressed streams as a self-supervisory signal, avoiding full frame decoding. Compared to RGB-based self-supervised methods, it achieves competitive downstream performance at substantially lower computational cost.
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.assessment: 该工作探索了压缩域自监督学习这一实用方向，对大规模视频预训练有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，具体方法细节和实验数据需进一步确认。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.contribution: 提出在压缩视频域进行自监督表示学习，利用运动矢量和残差作为监督信号。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.innovation: 将自监督学习从原始像素域迁移到压缩域，降低计算成本。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.result: 在保持有竞争力下游性能的同时显著降低了视频表示学习的计算开销。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed Video Representations.

2102.05095|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频分类中3D卷积网络计算量大且难以建模长程时空依赖的问题，提出了TimeSformer——一种完全基于自注意力、不含卷积的视频分类架构。方法将标准Transformer适配到视频领域，直接在帧级patch序列上进行时空特征学习，并通过实验比较了多种自注意力方案，发现将时间注意力和空间注意力在每个block中分开应用的'divided attention'方案效果最佳。TimeSformer在Kinetics-400和Kinetics-600上取得了当时最优精度，且相比3D卷积网络训练更快、推理效率更高，可处理超过一分钟的长视频。
2102.05095|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes TimeSformer, a convolution-free video classification architecture built exclusively on self-attention over space and time. It adapts the standard Transformer to video by learning spatiotemporal features from frame-level patch sequences, and finds that 'divided attention'—separately applying temporal and spatial attention within each block—yields the best accuracy. TimeSformer achieves state-of-the-art results on Kinetics-400 and Kinetics-600, trains faster than 3D ConvNets, and scales to video clips over one minute long.
2102.05095|v2.assessment: 这是视频Transformer领域的里程碑式工作，系统性地探索了时空注意力设计空间，对后续视频理解研究影响深远。
2102.05095|v2.contribution: 提出纯自注意力的视频分类架构TimeSformer，并通过消融实验确立了divided space-time attention的最优设计。
2102.05095|v2.innovation: 首次系统比较多种时空自注意力方案并证明divided attention在视频分类中的优越性。
2102.05095|v2.result: 在Kinetics-400和Kinetics-600上取得当时最优精度，训练和推理效率优于3D卷积网络。

2106.11958|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪与分割中仅利用时序信息做关联、分割掩码仅依赖单帧预测的局限，提出了原型交叉注意力网络（PCAN）。PCAN首先将时空记忆蒸馏为一组原型，然后通过交叉注意力从过去帧中检索丰富信息；同时采用原型外观模块学习对比性的前景和背景原型，并随时间传播。在Youtube-VIS和BDD100K数据集上，PCAN超越了当时的视频实例跟踪与分割竞赛冠军方案，并验证了其对单阶段和两阶段分割框架的通用性。
2106.11958|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Prototypical Cross-Attention Network (PCAN) for online multiple object tracking and segmentation, addressing the limitation that most methods only exploit temporal cues for association and rely on single-frame predictions for masks. PCAN distills a space-time memory into prototypes and employs cross-attention to retrieve information from past frames, while a prototypical appearance module learns contrastive foreground and background prototypes propagated over time. PCAN outperforms competition winners on Youtube-VIS and BDD100K and is effective for both one-stage and two-stage frameworks.
2106.11958|v2.assessment: 该工作将原型学习与交叉注意力结合用于视频实例跟踪分割，在自动驾驶数据集BDD100K上验证了有效性，对多目标跟踪方向有较高参考价值。
2106.11958|v2.contribution: 提出PCAN，通过时空记忆原型化和交叉注意力实现视频中的多目标跟踪与分割。
2106.11958|v2.innovation: 将时空记忆蒸馏为原型并通过交叉注意力检索，同时学习对比性前景/背景原型并时序传播。
2106.11958|v2.result: 在Youtube-VIS和BDD100K上超越竞赛冠军方案，且兼容单阶段和两阶段分割框架。

2104.11178|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态表示学习中依赖标注数据和卷积架构的问题，提出了VATT（Video-Audio-Text Transformer），一个从原始视频、音频和文本信号中通过无卷积Transformer架构进行自监督多模态表示学习的框架。方法使用多模态对比损失端到端从头训练，并研究了在三种模态间共享权重的模态无关单骨干Transformer。VATT在Kinetics-400上达到82.1% top-1精度，Kinetics-600上83.6%，Kinetics-700上72.7%，Moments in Time上41.1%，均创无监督预训练新纪录；迁移到ImageNet分类达到78.7% top-1，远超从头训练的64.7%。
2104.11178|v2.summary_en: This paper presents VATT, a framework for multimodal self-supervised learning from raw video, audio, and text using convolution-free Transformer architectures. It trains end-to-end with multimodal contrastive losses and explores a modality-agnostic single-backbone Transformer with shared weights. VATT achieves 82.1% top-1 on Kinetics-400, 83.6% on Kinetics-600, 72.7% on Kinetics-700, and 41.1% on Moments in Time without supervised pre-training, and transfers to 78.7% top-1 on ImageNet.
2104.11178|v2.assessment: 该工作在多模态自监督学习方面具有开创性，验证了无卷积Transformer在多模态场景的优越性，对多模态感知研究有重要启发。
2104.11178|v2.contribution: 提出VATT框架，实现从原始视频、音频和文本进行无卷积Transformer多模态自监督学习。
2104.11178|v2.innovation: 使用模态无关的共享权重单骨干Transformer，通过多模态对比损失从原始信号端到端训练。
2104.11178|v2.result: 在Kinetics-400/600/700和Moments in Time上创无监督预训练新纪录，ImageNet迁移达78.7% top-1。

Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频表示学习中全局与局部信息难以兼顾的问题，提出了全局和局部视频表示的对比学习方法。方法通过设计不同的对比学习目标分别捕获视频的全局语义信息和局部时空细节，使学习到的表示在多种下游任务中更具通用性。相比仅使用单一粒度对比目标的方法，该工作在下游视频理解任务上取得了更好的迁移性能。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of simultaneously capturing global and local information in video representation learning by proposing a contrastive learning approach for both global and local video representations. It designs separate contrastive objectives to capture global semantic information and local spatiotemporal details, yielding more generalizable representations. Compared to single-granularity contrastive methods, it achieves improved transfer performance on downstream video understanding tasks.
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.assessment: 该工作从多粒度对比学习角度提升视频表示质量，思路合理，但摘要信息有限，具体方法和实验效果需进一步确认。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.contribution: 提出全局与局部视频表示的对比学习框架，兼顾语义和细节信息。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.innovation: 设计多粒度对比学习目标，分别捕获视频的全局语义和局部时空细节。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.result: 在下游视频理解任务上取得优于单一粒度对比学习方法的迁移性能。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local._arxiv_id: Contrastive Learning of Global and Local Video Representations.

2111.01673|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有动态特征变换（包括自注意力）在视频理解中难以有效建模时空对应关系（即运动信息）的问题，提出了关系自注意力（RSA）。RSA通过动态生成关系核并聚合关系上下文，利用视频中丰富的时空关系结构进行特征变换。实验和消融研究表明，RSA网络大幅超越卷积和自注意力对应方案，在Something-Something-V1&V2、Diving48和FineGym等以运动为中心的标准视频动作识别基准上取得了最优性能。
2111.01673|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Relational Self-Attention (RSA), a relational feature transform that addresses the limitation of existing dynamic transforms in capturing spatio-temporal correspondence for video understanding. RSA dynamically generates relational kernels and aggregates relational contexts to leverage rich spatio-temporal structures. Experiments show RSA substantially outperforms convolution and self-attention counterparts, achieving state-of-the-art on motion-centric benchmarks including Something-Something-V1&V2, Diving48, and FineGym.
2111.01673|v2.assessment: 该工作深入分析了自注意力在视频运动建模中的不足，提出的关系自注意力机制在运动中心基准上表现突出，对视频理解研究有较高参考价值。
2111.01673|v2.contribution: 提出关系自注意力（RSA），通过动态生成关系核和聚合关系上下文增强视频时空关系建模。
2111.01673|v2.innovation: 将关系特征变换引入自注意力机制，动态生成关系核以捕获视频中的时空对应关系。
2111.01673|v2.result: 在Something-Something-V1&V2、Diving48和FineGym等基准上取得最优性能，显著超越卷积和自注意力方案。

Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中归一化层与网络深度耦合、难以动态适配不同层与不同时间片段的问题，提出动态归一化（Dynamic Normalization）与动态中继（Relay）机制，使归一化参数能够随输入视频内容自适应调整并在层间传递。相比固定归一化（如BN/LN）的静态设计，该方法提升了模型对时序动态变化的建模能力。摘要中未给出具体数据集与数值结果，因此效果无法量化评估。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of static normalization layers in video action recognition, where fixed statistics cannot adapt to diverse temporal dynamics across layers and clips. It proposes Dynamic Normalization and a Relay mechanism that adaptively modulates normalization parameters conditioned on the input video and propagates them across layers. The approach aims to improve temporal modeling capacity over conventional fixed normalization, though the abstract provides no quantitative results on standard benchmarks.
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.assessment: 选题属于视频理解中的归一化设计改进，与自动驾驶感知/3D检测方向关联较弱，且摘要信息有限，难以判断实验充分性。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.contribution: 提出可随输入视频内容自适应调整并在层间中继的动态归一化机制，用于视频动作识别。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.innovation: 将归一化参数从静态学习改为输入条件化生成并跨层传递（Relay），增强时序自适应能力。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与性能数值，效果无法量化确认。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide._arxiv_id: Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Video Action Recognition.

Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中时空建模效率与效果难以兼顾的问题，提出将Transformer在时间维度上循环复用（Recurring）的架构，以共享参数的方式捕捉长程时序依赖。相比标准时空Transformer，该方法减少了参数量与计算开销，同时保持对动作动态的建模能力。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但思路与视频理解中的高效时序建模方向一致。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient spatio-temporal modeling for video action recognition by proposing a recurrent Transformer that reuses weights across time. The method reduces parameter and computation overhead compared to standard spatio-temporal Transformers while maintaining temporal modeling capacity. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract, but the idea aligns with efficient temporal modeling in video understanding.
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.assessment: 对视频理解中的高效Transformer设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.contribution: 提出循环复用Transformer权重的视频动作识别架构。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.innovation: 在时间维度上循环共享Transformer参数以降低计算量。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti._arxiv_id: Recurring the Transformer for Video Action Recognition.

2208.00281|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对长期4D点云视频理解中相机运动、场景变化和采样模式复杂导致现有4D卷积或非层次Transformer效率低、效果差的问题，提出以primitive plane作为中层表示，并设计层次化骨干网络Point Primitive Transformer（PPTr），由intra-primitive point transformer和primitive transformer组成。该方法在多个任务上超越此前最优方法，验证了层次化primitive表示对长时4D点云建模的有效性。
2208.00281|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long-term 4D point cloud video understanding, where camera motion, scene changes, and sampling complexity degrade existing 4D convolution or non-hierarchical Transformer methods. It introduces the primitive plane as a mid-level representation and proposes a hierarchical backbone, Point Primitive Transformer (PPTr), composed of intra-primitive point transformers and primitive transformers. PPTr outperforms prior state-of-the-art on multiple tasks.
2208.00281|v2.assessment: 层次化primitive表示对4D点云理解有实质推进，对自动驾驶中的时序点云感知有借鉴意义。
2208.00281|v2.contribution: 提出基于primitive plane的层次化4D点云视频理解骨干PPTr。
2208.00281|v2.innovation: 以primitive plane为中层表示构建层次化点云Transformer。
2208.00281|v2.result: 在多个4D点云任务上超越此前最优方法。

2207.10158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督视频表示学习中仅依赖视觉主导特征聚类会忽略运动信息的问题，提出GOCA（Guided Online Cluster Assignment），利用RGB与光流两个视图的初始聚类分配互相引导，强制两视图形成一致的聚类结构，并引入正则化策略缓解特征坍缩。实验表明所学表示在下游任务上有效，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2207.10158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of clustering-based self-supervised video representation learning that focuses on visually dominant features and neglects motion. It proposes GOCA, which uses the initial cluster assignment of each view (RGB and optical flow) as a prior to guide the other view's final assignment, enforcing consistent cluster structures, plus a regularization to mitigate feature collapse. The learned representations are shown effective on downstream tasks, though no specific numbers are given.
2207.10158|v2.assessment: 双视图互引导聚类思路对自监督视频表示学习有启发，但与自动驾驶感知任务直接相关性有限。
2207.10158|v2.contribution: 提出RGB与光流双视图互引导的在线聚类分配策略GOCA。
2207.10158|v2.innovation: 用一视图的初始聚类先验引导另一视图的最终聚类分配。
2207.10158|v2.result: 下游任务验证有效，摘要未给出具体数值。

2204.04796|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对第一人称动作识别中背景干扰物影响以及现有方法依赖目标域高质量物体类别标注、需与动作模型联合重训的问题，提出SOS（Self-Supervised Learning Over Sets），利用现成的手-物接触检测器提取物体区域，将动作过程视为自然数据变换，在物体集合上预训练通用的OIC表示。该方法无需目标域物体类别标注，且与动作模型解耦，便于灵活集成。
2204.04796|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses distractors in egocentric action recognition and the limitations of existing methods that require target-domain object class annotations and costly joint retraining with action models. It introduces SOS, which pre-trains a generic Objects-In-Contact (OIC) representation over sets of object regions detected by an off-the-shelf hand-object contact detector, treating the action process as natural data transformation. The approach requires no target-domain object labels and decouples object representation from action models.
2204.04796|v2.assessment: 解耦式物体集合自监督预训练对第一人称视频理解有实用价值，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务关联较弱。
2204.04796|v2.contribution: 提出在物体集合上自监督预训练OIC表示的SOS方法。
2204.04796|v2.innovation: 将动作过程作为自然数据变换并利用物体间时空关系进行集合级自监督。
2204.04796|v2.result: 无需目标域物体标注且可灵活集成，摘要未给出具体数值。

2202.14019|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对健身房场景下现成姿态估计器因相机角度、遮挡、光照和着装等因素表现不佳、且动作错误细微难以检测的问题，提出领域知识驱动的自监督表示学习方法（姿态对比学习与运动解耦），利用动作的谐波运动特性以及相机角度、服装、光照的大方差学习鲁棒表示，使少量专家标注即可完成监督错误检测。作者构建了Fitness-AQA数据集，包含BackSquat、BarbellRow等三个动作。
2202.14019|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor pose estimation in gym scenarios due to camera angles, occlusion, illumination, and clothing, as well as the subtlety of workout form errors. It proposes domain knowledge-informed self-supervised approaches (pose contrastive learning and motion disentangling) that exploit harmonic motion and large variances in camera angle, clothing, and illumination, enabling supervised error detection with a small expert-annotated dataset. The authors curate the Fitness-AQA dataset covering three exercises.
2202.14019|v2.assessment: 领域知识驱动的自监督思路有一定参考性，但应用场景与自动驾驶感知领域距离较远。
2202.14019|v2.contribution: 提出面向健身动作错误检测的领域知识驱动自监督表示学习及Fitness-AQA数据集。
2202.14019|v2.innovation: 利用动作谐波运动与外观大方差进行姿态对比学习和运动解耦。
2202.14019|v2.result: 少量专家标注即可完成错误检测，摘要未给出具体数值。

2207.12795|v2.summary_cn: 该论文受人类理解视频方式启发，提出先学习通用视觉概念再关注判别性局部区域的自监督视频表示学习方案。方法利用静态帧与帧差解耦静态和动态概念，在隐空间分别对齐概念分布，并加入多样性与保真度正则化以获得紧凑有意义的概念集；随后用交叉注意力聚合不同概念的局部特征，过滤低激活冗余概念进行局部概念对比。在UCF-101、HMDB-51和Diving-48上取得最优结果。
2207.12795|v2.summary_en: Inspired by how humans understand videos, this paper proposes a self-supervised video representation learning scheme that first learns general visual concepts and then attends to discriminative local areas. It decouples static and dynamic concepts using static frames and frame differences, aligns concept distributions in latent space, and adds diversity and fidelity regularizations for a compact concept set. A cross-attention mechanism aggregates local features and filters redundant concepts for local concept contrast, achieving state-of-the-art results on UCF-101, HMDB-51, and Diving-48.
2207.12795|v2.assessment: 静态/动态概念解耦与局部概念对比设计合理，对视频自监督表示学习有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联中等。
2207.12795|v2.contribution: 提出解耦静态与动态概念并进行局部概念对比的自监督视频表示学习方案。
2207.12795|v2.innovation: 用静态帧与帧差解耦概念分布并结合交叉注意力进行局部概念对比。

2207.01975|v2.summary_cn: 针对边缘设备产生的大量无标注视频数据在自监督学习（SSL）中面临的隐私与通信成本问题，论文提出将联邦学习（FL）引入视频SSL任务。作者首先评估了现有SOTA视频SSL方法在Kinetics-400模拟的大规模联邦场景下的不足，进而提出FedVSSL框架，集成多种聚合策略与部分权重更新。实验表明FedVSSL在下游检索任务上超过集中式SOTA，在UCF-101和HMDB-51上分别提升6.66%和5.13%。
2207.01975|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses privacy and communication challenges in video self-supervised learning (SSL) on edge devices by introducing federated learning. The authors evaluate state-of-the-art video-SSL methods in a large-scale federated setting simulated on Kinetics-400 and propose FedVSSL, a federated SSL framework integrating various aggregation strategies and partial weight updating. FedVSSL outperforms centralized SOTA on downstream retrieval by 6.66% on UCF-101 and 5.13% on HMDB-51.
2207.01975|v2.assessment: 将联邦学习与视频自监督学习结合是一个有价值的方向，但主要面向视频理解而非自动驾驶感知，与用户核心领域相关度有限。
2207.01975|v2.contribution: 提出了面向视频自监督学习的联邦学习框架FedVSSL，并系统评估了现有视频SSL方法在联邦场景下的表现。
2207.01975|v2.innovation: 将多种聚合策略与部分权重更新集成到视频SSL的联邦学习框架中。
2207.01975|v2.result: 在下游检索任务上超过集中式SOTA，UCF-101提升6.66%，HMDB-51提升5.13%。

2112.04478|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频理解任务资源消耗大的问题，论文提出一种高效适配预训练图像-语言（I-VL）模型的简单强基线。方法通过优化少量连续提示向量，将视频相关任务转换为与预训练目标相同的格式，并在逐帧视觉特征上堆叠轻量Transformer以编码时序信息。在动作识别、动作定位和文本-视频检索的10个公开基准上，覆盖闭集、少样本和零样本场景，以显著更少的可调参数取得竞争性或SOTA性能。
2112.04478|v2.summary_en: This paper presents a simple yet strong baseline for efficiently adapting pre-trained image-language (I-VL) models to resource-hungry video understanding tasks. It optimizes a few continuous prompt vectors to convert video tasks into the pre-training objective format and encodes temporal information with lightweight Transformers on frame-wise features. Extensive experiments on 10 public benchmarks across action recognition, localization, and text-video retrieval achieve competitive or state-of-the-art performance with significantly fewer optimized parameters.
2112.04478|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了提示学习在视频理解中的高效性，方法简洁且实验充分，对多模态与VLM方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶3D感知的直接关联有限。
2112.04478|v2.contribution: 提出了一种通过连续提示向量高效适配图像-语言预训练模型到视频理解任务的基线方法。
2112.04478|v2.innovation: 利用连续提示向量统一视频任务与预训练目标格式，并用轻量Transformer编码时序信息。
2112.04478|v2.result: 在10个公开基准上以显著更少参数取得竞争性或SOTA性能。

Source-Free Video Domain Adaptation by L.summary_cn: 该论文标题为《Source-Free Video Domain Adaptation by Learning Temporal Consistency for Action Recognition》，旨在解决无源视频域适应问题。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法、改进点及实验数据。从标题推测，工作可能通过学习时序一致性来实现从源域到目标域的动作识别迁移，且不依赖源域数据。

The work likely learns temporal consistency to adapt action recognition models from source to target domains without accessing source data.
