2110.06178|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有空间卷积假设时空不变性、难以建模复杂时序动态的问题，论文提出时序自适应卷积（TAdaConv），根据每帧的局部和全局时序上下文校准卷积权重。与以往时序建模操作不同，TAdaConv在卷积核而非特征上操作，维度小一个数量级，更高效且增加模型容量。将ResNet和ConvNeXt中的2D卷积替换为TAdaConv构建TAda2D和TAdaConvNeXt，在多个视频动作识别和定位基准上达到至少相当或更优的性能。
2110.06178|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Temporally-Adaptive Convolutions (TAdaConv) for video understanding, which calibrates convolution weights for each frame based on local and global temporal context. Unlike previous temporal modeling operations, TAdaConv operates over convolution kernels rather than features, being more efficient and increasing model capacity. Replacing 2D convolutions in ResNet and ConvNeXt with TAdaConv yields TAda2D and TAdaConvNeXt, achieving at least on par or better performance on multiple video action recognition and localization benchmarks.
2110.06178|v2.assessment: TAdaConv提供了一种高效且通用的时序建模方案，方法设计巧妙且实验扎实，对视频理解领域有较高价值，但与自动驾驶3D感知的直接关联有限。
2110.06178|v2.contribution: 提出了时序自适应卷积TAdaConv，通过在卷积核上校准时序上下文来增强视频模型的时序建模能力。
2110.06178|v2.innovation: 在卷积核而非特征上进行时序自适应校准，兼顾效率与模型容量。
2110.06178|v2.result: 在多个视频动作识别和定位基准上达到至少相当或更优的性能。

2211.00833|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频类增量学习中存储代表性视频受限于内存的问题，论文提出FrameMaker，一种内存高效的视频类增量学习方法，为每个选定视频学习生成一个压缩帧。方法包含帧压缩（Frame Condensing）和实例特定提示（Instance-Specific Prompt）两个组件，前者仅保留一个压缩帧以降低内存，后者补偿丢失的时空细节。在HMDB51、UCF101和Something-Something V2上，FrameMaker仅消耗20%内存即取得优于近期先进方法的表现，在相同内存条件下显著超越现有SOTA。
2211.00833|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses memory constraints in video class-incremental learning by proposing FrameMaker, which learns to produce a condensed frame for each selected video. It comprises Frame Condensing to reduce memory by preserving one condensed frame and Instance-Specific Prompt to compensate for lost spatio-temporal details. On HMDB51, UCF101, and Something-Something V2, FrameMaker achieves better performance than recent methods while consuming only 20% memory, and significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art under the same memory budget.
2211.00833|v2.assessment: 该工作为视频类增量学习提供了高效的内存压缩方案，方法设计合理且实验充分，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关度较低。
2211.00833|v2.contribution: 提出了FrameMaker，通过帧压缩和实例特定提示实现内存高效的视频类增量学习。
2211.00833|v2.innovation: 用单个压缩帧替代完整视频存储，并通过实例特定提示补偿时空细节损失。
2211.00833|v2.result: 仅消耗20%内存即优于近期先进方法，相同内存条件下显著超越现有SOTA。

Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.summary_cn: 该论文针对时空视频定位（Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding）中静态外观信息与动态运动信息难以协同建模的问题，提出静态与动态视觉-语言流协作框架。方法上通过构建两条分别聚焦静态场景与动态动作的视觉-语言交互流，并设计跨流协作机制实现互补增强。相比已有仅依赖单一模态或简单融合的工作，该方法更充分地利用了视频中静态与动态线索的互补性。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但该思路对视频-语言理解中的多粒度建模具有参考价值。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.summary_en: This paper addresses spatio-temporal video grounding by proposing collaborative static and dynamic vision-language streams. It builds two complementary streams focusing on static appearance and dynamic motion respectively, with a cross-stream collaboration mechanism for mutual enhancement. Compared with prior single-modality or naive fusion approaches, it better exploits the complementarity of static and dynamic cues for video-language understanding.
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.assessment: 该工作对视频-语言定位中的静态/动态信息协同提供了新思路，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体实验验证。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.contribution: 提出静态与动态视觉-语言流协作框架用于时空视频定位。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.innovation: 通过双流协作机制显式解耦并融合静态外观与动态运动信息。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，需查阅全文验证效果。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-._arxiv_id: Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-Language Streams for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding.

2304.03307|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP类模型在视频分类中微调后零样本泛化能力下降、冻结骨干又导致监督性能显著降低的两难问题，提出Vita-CLIP多模态提示学习方案。方法在视觉侧设计全局视频级提示、局部帧级提示和摘要提示三种粒度，在文本侧设计提示增强文本上下文，实现单一统一训练下兼顾监督与零样本性能。相比此前需分别训练监督和零样本两个独立模型的做法，该方法在Kinetics-600上取得了最优零样本性能。
2304.03307|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the trade-off in adapting CLIP-like models for video classification, where finetuning degrades zero-shot generalization while freezing the backbone hurts supervised accuracy. It proposes Vita-CLIP, a multimodal prompt learning scheme with global video-level, local frame-level, and summary prompts on the vision side, plus text-side prompting. Under a single unified training, it achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on Kinetics-600 while maintaining competitive supervised accuracy.
2304.03307|v2.assessment: 多模态提示学习统一监督与零样本视频理解的实用方案，对VLM适配视频任务有较强参考价值。
2304.03307|v2.contribution: 提出Vita-CLIP多模态提示学习框架，统一监督与零样本视频分类。
2304.03307|v2.innovation: 视觉侧三粒度提示（全局/局部/摘要）与文本侧提示的联合设计。
2304.03307|v2.result: 在Kinetics-600上取得最优零样本性能，同时保持有竞争力的监督精度。

Discovering the Real Association: Multim.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频问答中多模态因果推理的关联发现问题，提出多模态因果推理方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节，但从标题可推断其旨在区分视频问答中的真实因果关联与虚假统计关联。相比已有仅依赖统计相关性的方法，该工作引入因果推理框架以发现真实关联。具体实验效果需查阅全文确认。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.summary_en: This paper addresses multimodal causal reasoning in video question answering, aiming to discover genuine associations rather than spurious correlations. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details are unavailable, but the title suggests a causal inference framework for multimodal video QA. Concrete experimental results require consulting the full paper.
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.assessment: 因果推理在视频问答中的应用方向有价值，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法与效果。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.contribution: 提出多模态因果推理方法用于视频问答中的真实关联发现。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.innovation: 将因果推理引入视频问答以区分真实因果与虚假相关。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果待全文确认。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim._arxiv_id: Discovering the Real Association: Multimodal Causal Reasoning in Video Question Answering.

2303.14361|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频语义分割中源数据不可访问场景下的无源域适应（SFDA）问题，指出现有SFDA方法仅利用图像级信息进行适应，在视频应用中次优。提出时空像素级（STPL）对比学习方法，显式学习时空空间中像素间的语义相关性，为目标域适应提供强自监督信号。相比仅用图像级信息的已有SFDA方法，STPL充分利用时空信息，在视频语义分割的无源域适应上取得了更优性能。
2303.14361|v2.summary_en: This paper studies source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) for video semantic segmentation, where existing SFDA methods use only image-level information and are sub-optimal for video. It proposes Spatio-Temporal Pixel-Level (STPL) contrastive learning that explicitly learns semantic correlations among pixels in spatio-temporal space, providing strong self-supervision for target domain adaptation. Compared with image-level SFDA approaches, STPL better leverages temporal information and achieves improved video adaptation performance.
2303.14361|v2.assessment: 将时空对比学习引入无源域适应视频语义分割，对自动驾驶感知中的域适应问题有参考意义。
2303.14361|v2.contribution: 提出STPL时空像素级对比学习方法用于视频语义分割的无源域适应。
2303.14361|v2.innovation: 在SFDA框架下显式利用时空像素级语义相关性进行自监督适应。
2303.14361|v2.result: 相比仅用图像级信息的SFDA方法取得更优的视频适应性能。

2304.03631|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作理解中缺乏一致且富有表达力的动作表示问题，引入Therbligs（动素）作为动作原子，提出基于规则的可组合层次化动作建模方法。方法在原子之上引入可微的规则推理以正则化逻辑一致性，且Therblig表示可增强而非替代现有架构。论文发布了EPIC Kitchens 100和50-Salads上首个以Therblig为中心的标注，在动作分割、动作预测和动作识别任务上分别取得平均10.5%/7.53%/6.5%和8.9%/6.63%/4.8%的相对提升。
2304.03631|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Therbligs as atomic units for a rule-based, compositional, and hierarchical modeling of actions, providing a consistent contact-centered representation. It introduces differentiable rule-based reasoning over these atoms to regularize logical consistency, and the Therblig representations augment rather than replace existing architectures. The authors release the first Therblig-centered annotations on EPIC Kitchens 100 and 50-Salads, achieving average relative improvements of 10.5%/7.53%/6.5% and 8.9%/6.63%/4.8% on action segmentation, anticipation, and recognition respectively.
2304.03631|v2.assessment: 以动素为原子的可组合动作建模思路新颖，且发布了有价值的标注数据集，对视频理解研究有启发。
2304.03631|v2.contribution: 引入Therbligs原子并发布首个Therblig标注数据集用于视频动作理解。
2304.03631|v2.innovation: 可微规则推理与Therblig原子表示结合，增强现有架构的动作建模能力。
2304.03631|v2.result: 在EPIC Kitchens和50-Salads上动作分割/预测/识别分别取得约10.5%/7.53%/6.5%和8.9%/6.63%/4.8%的相对提升。

System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线流式视频理解中计算资源动态变化的问题，提出系统状态感知的自适应网络。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节，但从标题可推断其根据系统状态（如计算负载）动态调整网络结构或计算量以实现在线流式视频理解。相比固定计算量的方法，该工作强调对系统状态的感知与自适应。具体实验效果需查阅全文确认。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses online streaming video understanding under dynamically varying system resources by proposing a system-status-aware adaptive network. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details are unavailable, but the title suggests dynamic adjustment of network computation based on system status. Concrete experimental results require consulting the full paper.
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.assessment: 在线流式视频理解中的自适应计算方向有实用价值，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.contribution: 提出系统状态感知的自适应网络用于在线流式视频理解。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.innovation: 根据系统状态动态调整网络计算以适应在线流式场景。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果待全文确认。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for._arxiv_id: System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for Online Streaming Video Understanding.

LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频-语言理解任务中各类下游任务（检索、问答、字幕等）通常需要独立设计架构的问题，提出将多种视频-语言理解任务统一为掩码语言建模（MLM）范式。方法上通过统一的编码器-解码器框架，将不同任务的输入输出都转化为文本序列的掩码预测，从而用单一模型处理多任务。相比此前为每个任务定制网络结构的做法，LAVENDER 在多个视频-语言基准上以统一架构取得了与任务专用模型相当甚至更优的性能。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of video-language understanding tasks, where each downstream task typically requires a task-specific architecture. It proposes LAVENDER, which unifies diverse tasks (retrieval, QA, captioning) as masked language modeling over a shared encoder-decoder. Compared with task-specific designs, LAVENDER achieves competitive or superior performance across multiple video-language benchmarks with a single unified model.
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.assessment: 统一多任务建模范式对视频-语言领域有参考价值，但与本用户聚焦的自动驾驶感知方向关联较弱。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.contribution: 提出将多种视频-语言理解任务统一为掩码语言建模的单一框架。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.innovation: 用统一的 MLM 范式替代各任务独立架构，实现跨任务知识共享。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.result: 在多个视频-语言基准上以统一模型达到与任务专用方法相当或更优的性能。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders._arxiv_id: LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Understanding as Masked Language Modeling.

2303.14526|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对长视频理解中时空依赖建模效率低的问题，指出 S4 模型对所有图像 token 一视同仁会损害效率与精度。提出 Selective S4（S5）模型，用轻量级掩码生成器自适应选择信息量大的图像 token，并借助动量更新的 S4 模型引导，避免 Transformer 中稠密自注意力计算。进一步提出长-短掩码对比机制以提升鲁棒性和时间跨度，在长视频理解任务上实现了更高效且更准确的建模。
2303.14526|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles inefficient spatiotemporal modeling in long-form video understanding, showing that treating all image tokens equally in S4 harms efficiency and accuracy. It proposes Selective S4 (S5), which uses a lightweight mask generator to adaptively select informative tokens, guided by a momentum-updated S4 model to avoid dense self-attention. A long-short masked contrastive scheme further improves robustness and temporal horizon, yielding more efficient and accurate long-form video modeling.
2303.14526|v2.assessment: 将状态空间模型与 token 选择结合用于长视频，思路新颖，对视频理解与高效序列建模有借鉴意义。
2303.14526|v2.contribution: 提出选择性结构化状态空间模型 S5，实现长视频中信息 token 的自适应选择。
2303.14526|v2.innovation: 用动量更新的 S4 引导掩码生成，避免稠密自注意力并提升长时建模鲁棒性。
2303.14526|v2.result: 在长视频理解任务上相比 S4 更高效且更准确。

2303.18230|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对教学视频中程序性理解任务标注稀缺的问题，提出从无标注视频中提取程序性知识（任务身份、步骤、下一步预测）。核心思路是用程序知识图（PKG）表示步骤及其顺序关系，节点为离散步骤、边连接顺序发生的步骤，并据此生成伪标签训练视频表示。方法结合文本程序知识库与无标注教学视频语料构建 PKG，设计四种预训练任务生成伪标签，使表示能泛化到多种程序理解任务。
2303.18230|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses scarce annotations in instructional video procedure understanding by extracting procedural knowledge (task identity, steps, next-step prediction) from unlabeled videos. It builds a Procedural Knowledge Graph (PKG) with steps as nodes and sequential edges, combining a text-based procedural knowledge base and an unlabeled video corpus to generate pseudo-labels. Four novel pretraining tasks train a video representation that generalizes to multiple procedure understanding tasks.
2303.18230|v2.assessment: 利用结构化程序知识图做自监督预训练的思路有启发性，但应用场景偏教学视频，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
2303.18230|v2.contribution: 提出基于程序知识图的教学视频自监督预训练框架。
2303.18230|v2.innovation: 用 PKG 生成伪标签，将程序性知识编码进视频表示。
2303.18230|v2.result: 在多种程序理解下游任务上验证了表示的有效泛化能力。

2303.15467|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放集动作识别（OSAR）中现有方法只关注不确定性打分而忽视特征表示的问题，基于信息瓶颈理论分析特征表示行为，提出扩大特征中的实例特异（IS）与类别特异（CS）信息。方法为原型相似学习（PSL）框架，通过保持同类内实例方差保留更多 IS 信息，并引入视频打乱学习原始与打乱样本间的时序差异以扩大 CS 信息。实验表明更丰富的语义多样性特征在相同不确定性分数下显著提升开放集性能。
2303.15467|v2.summary_en: This paper targets open-set action recognition (OSAR), arguing that existing methods focus on uncertainty scores while neglecting feature representations. Based on information bottleneck theory, it proposes to enlarge instance-specific (IS) and class-specific (CS) information via a Prototypical Similarity Learning (PSL) framework, preserving intra-class instance variance and introducing video shuffling to learn temporal distinctions. Experiments show richer semantic diversity significantly improves open-set performance under identical uncertainty scores.
2303.15467|v2.assessment: 从特征表示角度切入开放集识别，与开放集检测主题相关，对自动驾驶中的未知目标拒识有方法借鉴意义。
2303.15467|v2.contribution: 提出原型相似学习框架以扩大开放集动作识别中的实例与类别特异信息。
2303.15467|v2.innovation: 结合信息瓶颈理论与视频打乱机制，从特征表示层面提升开放集性能。
2303.15467|v2.result: 在相同不确定性分数下，更丰富语义特征显著提升开放集识别性能。

2303.16268|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督动作识别中现有方法依赖 RGB 与光流双模态或双播放速率等硬性输入偏置的问题，提出利用自监督视频表示中的时间不变与时间判别两类互补表示。方法为 TimeBalance 学生-教师框架，从时间不变和时间判别两个教师中蒸馏知识，并基于新颖的时间相似度重加权机制，根据无标注视频性质动态组合两个教师的知识。实验在半监督动作识别基准上取得优于依赖多输入流方法的性能。
2303.16268|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised action recognition, where existing methods rely on hard input biases such as RGB-optical-flow or dual playback rates. It leverages self-supervised temporally-invariant and temporally-distinctive representations, which are complementary depending on the action. The proposed TimeBalance student-teacher framework distills knowledge from both teachers and dynamically combines them via a temporal similarity-based reweighting scheme, outperforming multi-stream baselines.
2303.16268|v2.assessment: 用自监督表示替代多模态输入偏置的思路简洁有效，对视频半监督学习有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知关联一般。
2303.16268|v2.contribution: 提出 TimeBalance 学生-教师框架，动态融合时间不变与时间判别表示。
2303.16268|v2.innovation: 基于时间相似度的重加权机制动态组合双教师知识，避免硬性多流输入。
2303.16268|v2.result: 在半监督动作识别基准上优于依赖多输入流的方法。

2305.07214|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究第一人称动作识别中的多模态泛化（MMG）新问题，关注训练时存在的模态在推理时缺失或完全不相交时的系统泛化能力。定义了两种场景：缺失模态泛化和跨模态零样本泛化，并构建了包含视频、音频和 IMU 模态的新数据集 MMG-Ego4D，基于 Ego4D 由专家重新标注。在标准监督和少样本设置下评估多种模型并提出改进方法，验证了多模态泛化的挑战性。
2305.07214|v2.summary_en: This paper studies Multimodal Generalization (MMG) in egocentric action recognition, addressing generalization when modalities are missing or disjoint between training and inference. It defines two scenarios—missing-modality generalization and cross-modal zero-shot generalization—and constructs MMG-Ego4D with video, audio, and IMU modalities, re-annotated from Ego4D. It evaluates diverse models under supervised and few-shot settings and proposes improved methods, highlighting the challenge of MMG.
2305.07214|v2.assessment: 多模态缺失与跨模态泛化问题对自动驾驶多传感器融合有启发，数据集构建有贡献，但应用场景为第一人称动作识别。
2305.07214|v2.contribution: 提出多模态泛化问题并构建 MMG-Ego4D 多模态数据集。
2305.07214|v2.innovation: 定义缺失模态与跨模态零样本两种泛化场景并系统评估。
2305.07214|v2.result: 在监督与少样本设置下验证了多模态泛化的挑战性并提出改进方法。

Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别模型在测试阶段遇到分布偏移时性能下降的问题，提出了视频测试时自适应（Video Test-Time Adaptation）方法。现有测试时自适应方法多针对图像分类设计，未充分利用视频中的时序信息。本文通过设计面向视频的时序一致性约束与自适应策略，在测试阶段无需标签即可在线调整模型。实验表明该方法在多个视频动作识别基准上显著优于直接迁移的图像TTA方法，提升了模型对域偏移的鲁棒性。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of video action recognition models under distribution shifts at test time by proposing a video test-time adaptation method. Unlike image-oriented TTA approaches, it exploits temporal consistency in videos for online, label-free model adaptation. Experiments on multiple action recognition benchmarks show consistent improvements over naive image TTA baselines under domain shift.
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.assessment: 该工作将测试时自适应拓展到视频领域，对自动驾驶中视频感知模型的在线鲁棒性有参考价值，但任务本身与3D感知的直接关联有限。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.contribution: 提出了面向视频动作识别的测试时自适应框架，利用时序信息进行无标签在线模型调整。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.innovation: 将测试时自适应从图像扩展到视频，并设计时序一致性约束以充分利用视频帧间信息。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.result: 在多个视频动作识别基准的域偏移设定下，性能优于直接迁移的图像TTA方法。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re._arxiv_id: Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Recognition.

A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.summary_cn: 该论文对现有视频动作识别模型进行了大规模鲁棒性分析，系统评估了模型在多种扰动和分布偏移下的表现。作者构建了涵盖多种视频损坏类型和不同数据集的鲁棒性评测基准，揭示了当前模型在常见扰动下性能大幅下降的问题。分析发现不同架构和训练策略对鲁棒性的影响差异显著，为后续鲁棒视频理解研究提供了实证依据。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.summary_en: This paper presents a large-scale robustness analysis of video action recognition models, systematically evaluating their behavior under various perturbations and distribution shifts. It constructs a comprehensive benchmark covering multiple corruption types and datasets, revealing substantial performance drops of current models. The analysis highlights how architectures and training strategies differentially affect robustness, providing empirical guidance for future robust video understanding research.
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.assessment: 作为鲁棒性分析类工作，为视频理解模型的可靠性评估提供了有价值的基准和洞察，但方法创新有限。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.contribution: 构建了大规模视频动作识别鲁棒性评测基准并系统分析了现有模型的脆弱性。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.innovation: 首次在多种扰动和数据集上对视频动作识别模型进行系统性鲁棒性对比分析。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.result: 揭示了现有模型在常见扰动下性能显著下降，并给出不同架构鲁棒性差异的实证结论。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid._arxiv_id: A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Video Action Recognition Models.

SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中标注成本高的问题，提出了半监督视频Transformer框架SVFormer。现有半监督方法多基于CNN且未充分利用视频时序特性，SVFormer引入强增强策略与时序伪标签机制，在少量标注数据下实现高效训练。实验表明SVFormer在多个视频动作识别基准上以显著更少的标注达到甚至超越全监督方法，例如在Kinetics-400上仅用1%标注即取得有竞争力的结果。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.summary_en: This paper proposes SVFormer, a semi-supervised video transformer framework for action recognition that reduces annotation cost. It introduces strong augmentation and temporal pseudo-labeling to effectively exploit unlabeled videos, addressing limitations of CNN-based semi-supervised methods. Experiments show SVFormer achieves competitive or superior performance to fully supervised methods with only a fraction of labels, e.g., on Kinetics-400 with 1% annotations.
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.assessment: 将半监督学习与视频Transformer结合，方法设计合理且实验充分，对降低视频感知标注成本有借鉴意义。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.contribution: 提出了半监督视频Transformer框架SVFormer，显著降低视频动作识别的标注需求。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.innovation: 设计了面向视频Transformer的强增强与时序伪标签机制，充分利用无标注视频的时序信息。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.result: 在Kinetics-400等基准上仅用1%标注即达到与全监督方法相当的性能。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor._arxiv_id: SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transformer for Action Recognition.

2303.17285|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对RGB时序动作检测中双流模型依赖光流导致推理慢的问题，提出分解式跨模态蒸馏框架。方法不直接蒸馏，而是分别学习RGB与运动表征，再通过非对称训练目标将运动知识迁移到RGB分支，同时保持RGB信息完整。此外引入局部注意力融合以利用多模态互补性并保留局部判别力。实验表明该框架对骨干网络和检测头均通用，在多个基准上为RGB检测器带来一致提升。
2303.17285|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the slow inference of two-stream temporal action detection models caused by optical flow by proposing a decomposed cross-modal distillation framework. Instead of direct distillation, it separately learns RGB and motion representations and transfers motion knowledge to the RGB branch via asymmetric training objectives while preserving RGB information. A local attentive fusion module exploits multimodal complementarity. Experiments show consistent gains for RGB-based detectors across backbones and detection heads.
2303.17285|v2.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏思路清晰，分解式设计避免RGB信息损失，对多模态感知中的模态蒸馏有参考价值。
2303.17285|v2.contribution: 提出了分解式跨模态蒸馏框架，使RGB单流检测器获得运动模态知识且推理高效。
2303.17285|v2.innovation: 采用双分支非对称训练目标实现运动知识迁移，并设计局部注意力融合保留局部判别力。
2303.17285|v2.result: 在多个时序动作检测基准上为RGB检测器带来一致性能提升，且与骨干和检测头无关。

2212.04500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有掩码视频建模仅从零开始重建低层像素特征的问题，提出掩码视频蒸馏（MVD）两阶段框架。第一阶段预训练图像或视频教师模型恢复掩码块低层特征，第二阶段以教师特征为目标进行掩码特征建模。作者观察到视频教师利于时序任务、图像教师利于空间任务，据此设计时空协同教学策略。实验表明预训练的视频Transformer在多个下游任务上取得领先性能。
2212.04500|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Masked Video Distillation (MVD), a two-stage masked feature modeling framework that addresses the limitation of reconstructing only low-level pixel features in existing masked video modeling. It first pretrains image or video teachers by recovering low-level features of masked patches, then uses their features as targets for masked feature modeling. Observing that video teachers benefit temporally-heavy tasks while image teachers transfer stronger spatial representations, the authors design a spatial-temporal co-teaching strategy. Experiments show the pretrained video transformers achieve leading performance on multiple downstream tasks.
2212.04500|v2.assessment: 自监督视频表征学习的重要工作，协同教学策略有洞察力，对视频预训练和下游感知任务有实用价值。
2212.04500|v2.contribution: 提出了掩码视频蒸馏两阶段框架，利用教师特征作为掩码建模目标提升视频表征学习。
2212.04500|v2.innovation: 设计时空协同教学策略，同时从视频教师和图像教师蒸馏以兼顾时序与空间表征。
2212.04500|v2.result: 预训练的视频Transformer在多个下游视频任务上取得领先性能。

2309.04422|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中图像与视频识别任务通常由专用网络分别处理的问题，提出统一模型研究。作者设计了视频任务十项全能（VTD）挑战，涵盖分类、分割、定位和关联等十种代表性图像与视频任务。提出的VTDNet用单一结构和单套权重处理全部十项任务，通过任务分组与交互阶段交换信息，并设计课程训练、伪标签与微调（CPF）方案解决多任务联合训练的性能退化。实验表明VTDNet在十项任务上均取得有竞争力的结果。
2309.04422|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates building a unified model for major image and video recognition tasks in autonomous driving, which are typically handled by specialized networks. The authors design the Video Task Decathlon (VTD) challenge comprising ten representative tasks spanning classification, segmentation, localization, and association. Their VTDNet uses a single structure and weight set for all ten tasks, grouping similar tasks and employing task interaction stages, with a Curriculum, Pseudo-labeling, and Fine-tuning (CPF) scheme to mitigate multi-task degradation. Experiments show competitive results across all ten tasks.
2309.04422|v2.assessment: 面向自动驾驶多任务统一感知的重要工作，VTD基准与VTDNet对多任务学习和统一BEV感知研究有较高参考价值。
2309.04422|v2.contribution: 提出了自动驾驶图像与视频十任务统一的VTD挑战及单权重统一网络VTDNet。
2309.04422|v2.innovation: 设计任务分组与交互机制及CPF训练方案，实现十种异构任务的单模型统一处理。
2309.04422|v2.result: VTDNet在十项图像与视频任务上均取得有竞争力的性能，验证了统一模型可行性。

TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频异常检测中自监督隐私保护的问题，指出现有方法在利用自监督学习时可能泄露行人面部等隐私信息。作者提出TeD-SPAD方法，通过引入时序独特性（temporal distinctiveness）来指导自监督学习，在保留异常检测所需运动信息的同时抑制可识别身份的特征。相比已有自监督隐私保护方法，该方法在隐私-效用权衡上取得更好平衡，在标准异常检测基准上保持有竞争力的AUC，同时显著降低隐私泄露风险。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.summary_en: This paper addresses privacy leakage in self-supervised video anomaly detection, where learned representations may encode identifiable pedestrian information. The authors propose TeD-SPAD, which leverages temporal distinctiveness to guide self-supervised learning, preserving motion cues for anomaly detection while suppressing identity-revealing features. Compared with prior privacy-preserving methods, it achieves a better privacy-utility trade-off, maintaining competitive AUC on standard benchmarks while substantially reducing privacy leakage.
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.assessment: 该工作将隐私保护与视频异常检测结合，思路新颖，对自动驾驶中行人隐私合规有参考价值，但实验规模有限。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.contribution: 提出基于时序独特性的自监督隐私保护框架TeD-SPAD，用于视频异常检测。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.innovation: 利用时序独特性作为自监督信号，在异常检测中解耦运动信息与身份信息。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.result: 在保持异常检测AUC有竞争力的同时，显著降低了隐私泄露风险。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S._arxiv_id: TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for Self-supervised Privacy-preservation for video Anomaly Detection.

2309.01380|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于文本的视频问答任务，分析了NewsVideoQA和M4-ViteVQA两个数据集的构建方式，探究回答问题所需的视觉理解与多帧推理程度。作者使用纯文本模型BERT-QA进行实验，发现其在两个数据集上达到与原始多模态方法相当的性能，表明这些数据集存在文本捷径问题。该工作揭示了当前文本视频问答基准的缺陷，为后续数据集设计提供了警示。
2309.01380|v2.summary_en: This paper analyzes two text-based video question answering datasets, NewsVideoQA and M4-ViteVQA, examining the level of visual understanding and multi-frame reasoning required. Experiments with a text-only BERT-QA model show comparable performance to original multimodal methods on both datasets, revealing textual shortcuts in their formulation. The work highlights shortcomings in current benchmarks and provides caution for future dataset design.
2309.01380|v2.assessment: 该文属于数据集分析类工作，对视频问答基准的可靠性提出质疑，但方法创新有限，与自动驾驶感知直接关联较弱。
2309.01380|v2.contribution: 揭示NewsVideoQA和M4-ViteVQA数据集中纯文本模型即可达到多模态方法性能的文本捷径问题。
2309.01380|v2.innovation: 通过纯文本基线实验系统分析文本视频问答数据集的视觉理解需求程度。
2309.01380|v2.result: BERT-QA在两个数据集上取得与原始方法相当的性能，表明数据集存在文本捷径。

UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频理解中图像ViT直接迁移效果受限的问题，提出UniFormerV2，旨在释放图像ViT在视频任务中的潜力。方法通过将预训练图像ViT与轻量级时序建模模块结合，并采用多阶段时空融合策略，在保持图像先验的同时高效捕获视频时序信息。相比已有视频Transformer，UniFormerV2在多个视频理解基准上取得更优性能，且计算开销更低，展示了图像ViT在视频领域的可迁移性。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited transferability of image ViTs to video understanding and proposes UniFormerV2 to unlock their potential. The method integrates pretrained image ViTs with lightweight temporal modeling modules and a multi-stage spatiotemporal fusion strategy, efficiently capturing temporal information while preserving image priors. Compared with existing video transformers, UniFormerV2 achieves superior performance on multiple video understanding benchmarks with lower computational cost, demonstrating the transferability of image ViTs to video.
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.assessment: 该工作为图像ViT向视频任务迁移提供了有效方案，对自动驾驶中的视频感知骨干网络设计有借鉴意义，实验充分。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.contribution: 提出UniFormerV2，将预训练图像ViT与轻量时序模块结合，实现高效视频理解。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.innovation: 多阶段时空融合策略在保持图像先验的同时高效建模视频时序信息。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.result: 在多个视频理解基准上取得优于现有视频Transformer的性能，且计算开销更低。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of._arxiv_id: UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of Image ViTs for Video Understanding.

Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.summary_cn: 针对视频异常理解（Video Anomaly Understanding）缺乏统一评测基准的问题，本文构建了一个综合基准，从'是什么异常、为什么发生、如何演化'三个维度系统评估模型对视频异常的因果理解能力。方法上整合了异常检测、因果推理与视频问答等多类任务，并设计了细粒度标注与评价指标。相比以往仅关注异常定位或分类的工作，该基准首次将因果理解纳入评测体系。实验揭示了现有视频理解模型在因果推理上的显著不足，为后续研究提供了明确的改进方向。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for causation understanding of video anomalies. It constructs a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates models along three dimensions: what the anomaly is, why it occurs, and how it evolves, integrating anomaly detection, causal reasoning, and video QA tasks with fine-grained annotations. Compared with prior work focusing only on anomaly localization or classification, it is the first to incorporate causal understanding into the evaluation framework, revealing substantial deficiencies of existing video models in causal reasoning.
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.assessment: 该基准填补了视频异常因果理解评测的空白，对视频理解与安全感知研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.contribution: 构建了首个面向视频异常因果理解的多维度综合评测基准。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.innovation: 将'是什么、为什么、如何'的因果推理框架引入视频异常理解评测。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.result: 实验表明现有视频理解模型在异常因果推理上表现显著不足，暴露了明显的能力缺口。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe._arxiv_id: Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Causation Understanding of Video Anomaly.

A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.summary_cn: 针对点云视频理解中缺乏以人为中心的统一处理框架的问题，本文提出了一个统一框架，将人体点云视频的时空建模整合到单一架构中。方法上设计了针对点云序列的时空特征提取与人体动作/交互理解模块，统一处理动作识别、姿态估计等任务。相比以往分别针对单一任务设计专用模型的工作，该框架实现了多任务统一。实验在多个点云视频数据集上验证了框架的有效性与泛化能力。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified framework for human-centric point cloud video understanding. It proposes a unified architecture that integrates spatio-temporal modeling of human point cloud sequences, with modules for action recognition and pose estimation, handling multiple tasks within a single model. Unlike prior task-specific designs, it achieves multi-task unification and demonstrates effectiveness and generalization across several point cloud video datasets.
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.assessment: 该工作为点云视频理解提供了统一视角，对3D感知与人体理解研究者有一定启发，但与自动驾驶BEV/检测主线关联较弱。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.contribution: 提出了以人为中心的点云视频理解统一框架。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.innovation: 在单一架构中统一建模点云视频的时空特征并支持多任务。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.result: 在多个点云视频数据集上验证了框架的有效性与跨任务泛化能力。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po._arxiv_id: A Unified Framework for Human-centric Point Cloud Video Understanding.

Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..summary_cn: 针对视频异常检测中异常类别开放、无法预先枚举的问题，本文提出开放词汇视频异常检测（Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection）任务与相应方法。方法利用视觉-语言模型将异常检测从固定类别扩展到开放词汇空间，通过文本提示与视觉特征对齐实现对新奇异常的识别与描述。相比传统闭集异常检测方法，该工作显著提升了对未见异常类别的泛化能力。实验在开放词汇设定下取得了优于基线的检测与分类性能。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..summary_en: This paper tackles video anomaly detection where anomaly categories are open-ended and cannot be enumerated in advance, proposing the Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection task and method. It leverages vision-language models to align textual prompts with visual features, extending detection from fixed categories to an open vocabulary. Compared with closed-set methods, it substantially improves generalization to unseen anomaly categories, achieving superior detection and classification performance under the open-vocabulary setting.
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..assessment: 将开放词汇范式引入视频异常检测具有新意，对开放集检测与VLM应用研究者有参考价值。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..contribution: 提出开放词汇视频异常检测任务并给出基于视觉-语言模型的方法。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..innovation: 利用文本提示与视觉特征对齐实现对新奇异常的开放词汇识别。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..result: 在开放词汇设定下检测与分类性能优于闭集基线方法。

Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶安全感知中缺乏对事故因果理解的问题，本文提出以第一人称视角（ego-view）进行事故视频的溯因理解（Abductive）任务。方法构建了事故视频数据集并设计了溯因推理框架，要求模型从观测到的结果反推可能的原因，从而支持安全驾驶感知。相比仅做事故检测或预测的工作，该框架强调因果溯因与可解释性。实验表明该方法在事故原因推断上取得了有效性能，为安全驾驶感知提供了新范式。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of causal understanding of accidents in autonomous driving safety perception by proposing an abductive ego-view accident video understanding task. It constructs an accident video dataset and designs an abductive reasoning framework that infers plausible causes from observed outcomes to support safe driving perception. Unlike works limited to accident detection or prediction, it emphasizes causal abduction and interpretability, achieving effective performance in accident cause inference.
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.assessment: 将溯因推理引入自动驾驶事故理解，对安全感知与可解释性研究有较高价值，值得关注。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.contribution: 提出第一人称视角事故视频的溯因理解任务与框架。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.innovation: 从观测结果反推事故原因的溯因推理范式用于安全驾驶感知。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.result: 在事故原因推断任务上取得有效性能，为安全驾驶感知提供新范式。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders._arxiv_id: Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Understanding for Safe Driving Perception.

MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型在长视频理解中受限于上下文长度、难以记忆长期信息的问题，本文提出 MA-LMM（Memory-Augmented Large Multimodal Model）。方法引入记忆库机制，将历史视频特征压缩存储并在线更新，使模型能够处理远超上下文窗口的长视频。相比直接扩展上下文或稀疏采样的方法，该记忆增强机制在保持效率的同时提升了长期时序理解能力。实验在长视频问答与理解基准上取得了优于现有方法的结果。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of large multimodal models in long-term video understanding caused by constrained context length. It proposes MA-LMM, a memory-augmented large multimodal model that compresses and stores historical video features in a memory bank with online updates, enabling processing of videos far exceeding the context window. Compared with context extension or sparse sampling, this mechanism improves long-term temporal understanding while maintaining efficiency, achieving superior results on long-video QA and understanding benchmarks.
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.assessment: 记忆增强机制为长视频多模态理解提供了有效方案，对VLM与视频理解研究者有较高参考价值。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.contribution: 提出记忆增强的大型多模态模型 MA-LMM 用于长视频理解。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.innovation: 通过可在线更新的记忆库压缩存储历史视频特征以突破上下文限制。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.result: 在长视频问答与理解基准上性能优于现有方法。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda._arxiv_id: MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimodal Model for Long-Term Video Understanding.

TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中时间定位与时间敏感问答的需求，本文提出 TimeChat，一个时间敏感的多模态大语言模型。方法设计了时间感知的视频编码与时间戳对齐机制，使模型能够进行精确的时间定位与基于时间的事件描述。相比通用视频LLM，TimeChat在时间敏感任务上具备更强的时序推理与定位能力。实验在长视频问答与时间定位基准上取得了领先性能。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for temporal grounding and time-sensitive QA in long video understanding by proposing TimeChat, a time-sensitive multimodal large language model. It designs time-aware video encoding and timestamp alignment mechanisms enabling precise temporal localization and time-based event description. Compared with general video LLMs, TimeChat exhibits stronger temporal reasoning and grounding, achieving leading performance on long-video QA and temporal grounding benchmarks.
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.assessment: 时间敏感设计切中长视频理解的关键痛点，对多模态与视频理解研究者有较高参考价值。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.contribution: 提出时间敏感的多模态大语言模型 TimeChat 用于长视频理解。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.innovation: 通过时间戳对齐与时间感知编码增强模型的时间定位与推理能力。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.result: 在长视频问答与时间定位基准上取得领先性能。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La._arxiv_id: TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal Large Language Model for Long Video Understanding.

Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态大模型在图像与视频理解上通常需要分别设计视觉编码器、难以统一处理的问题，本文提出 Chat-UniVi，用一组动态视觉 token 统一表示图像和视频。方法通过多尺度 token 聚合与动态 token 合并，使同一组视觉 token 既能覆盖图像的空间细节，又能压缩视频的时空冗余，并直接接入 LLM 进行联合训练。相比此前图像/视频分离的架构，它在不增加视觉编码器复杂度的前提下同时支持两类输入。在图像与视频理解基准上均取得有竞争力的结果，验证了统一视觉表示的可行性。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of multimodal LLMs that require separate visual encoders for images and videos. Chat-UniVi represents both modalities with a unified set of dynamic visual tokens via multi-scale aggregation and dynamic token merging, which preserves spatial detail for images while compressing spatiotemporal redundancy for videos. It achieves competitive performance on both image and video understanding benchmarks with a single unified visual representation.
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.assessment: 统一视觉 token 表示是 MLLM 的重要工程方向，方法简洁且对多模态感知系统有参考价值。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.contribution: 提出用统一动态视觉 token 同时支持图像与视频理解的多模态大模型框架。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.innovation: 通过多尺度聚合与动态 token 合并，在单一视觉表示中兼顾图像空间细节与视频时空压缩。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.result: 在图像与视频理解基准上均取得有竞争力的表现，无需分离的视觉编码器。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio._arxiv_id: Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representation Empowers Large Language Models with Image and Video Understanding.

HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.summary_cn: 针对视频场景图生成中物体关系随时间和层级变化难以建模的问题，本文提出分层交错图（HIG）方法。方法将视频中的实体与关系组织为分层图结构，并通过交错机制在时间维度上传播与更新节点表示，从而捕捉跨帧的动态关系。相比逐帧独立或单层图建模的已有方法，HIG 更好地刻画了长时依赖与层级语义。在视频场景图生成基准上取得优于基线的结果。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.summary_en: This paper targets video scene graph generation, where object relations evolve over time and across semantic levels. It proposes a Hierarchical Interlacement Graph (HIG) that organizes entities and relations into a hierarchy and interleaves temporal propagation to capture cross-frame dynamics. It outperforms frame-independent and single-level graph baselines on video scene graph benchmarks.
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.assessment: 图结构建模视频关系有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.contribution: 提出分层交错图结构用于视频场景图生成。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.innovation: 用分层图加时间交错传播统一建模视频中的层级与动态关系。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.result: 在视频场景图生成基准上优于已有基线方法。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap._arxiv_id: HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Approach to Scene Graph Generation in Video Understanding.

A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.summary_cn: 针对第一人称视频理解中任务单一、模型难以在多任务间共享知识的问题，本文提出“技能背包”框架，将不同任务视为可组合的技能。方法通过任务特定的技能模块与共享表征，使单一模型能够处理多种第一人称视频任务，并支持技能的组合与迁移。相比单任务训练的已有方法，该框架在多任务设定下提升了泛化能力。实验在多个第一人称视频理解任务上验证了多技能组合的有效性。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the task-specific limitation of egocentric video understanding models. It proposes a 'backpack of skills' framework that treats different tasks as composable skills with shared representations, enabling a single model to handle multiple egocentric tasks and transfer skills across them. Experiments on several egocentric benchmarks show improved generalization over single-task training.
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.assessment: 多任务技能组合思路有趣，但应用场景偏第一人称视频，与车载感知距离较远。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.contribution: 提出可组合技能模块的多任务第一人称视频理解框架。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.innovation: 将不同视频任务抽象为可组合、可迁移的技能并共享表征。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.result: 在多个第一人称视频理解任务上提升了多任务泛化性能。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi._arxiv_id: A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Video Understanding with Diverse Task Perspectives.

MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中稠密 token 导致显存与计算爆炸的问题，本文提出 MovieChat，用稀疏记忆机制处理长视频。方法将稠密视觉 token 逐步聚合为稀疏记忆，并设计记忆检索与更新机制，使模型在固定预算下保留长时关键信息。相比直接截断或均匀采样的已有方法，MovieChat 在超长视频上保持了更好的时序连贯性。在长视频问答基准上取得显著提升，并支持远超训练长度的视频输入。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.summary_en: This paper tackles the memory and compute explosion of dense tokens in long-video understanding. MovieChat converts dense visual tokens into sparse memory with dedicated retrieval and update mechanisms, preserving long-range key information under a fixed budget. It substantially improves long-video QA benchmarks and supports inputs far longer than training sequences.
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.assessment: 稀疏记忆是长视频理解的关键技术路线，对长时序感知与视频问答均有借鉴意义。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.contribution: 提出基于稀疏记忆机制的长视频理解框架 MovieChat。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.innovation: 用稠密到稀疏的记忆聚合与检索更新机制在固定预算下建模超长视频。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.result: 在长视频问答基准上显著提升，并支持远超训练长度的视频输入。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me._arxiv_id: MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Memory for Long Video Understanding.

OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.summary_cn: 针对视频理解任务种类繁多、判别式模型难以统一的问题，本文提出 OmniViD，一个生成式通用视频理解框架。方法将多种视频任务统一为生成式序列建模，用同一架构处理分类、定位、问答等不同输出形式，并设计任务统一的输入输出格式。相比任务专用的判别式方法，该框架在跨任务泛化上更具优势。实验在多个视频理解基准上取得与专用方法相当或更优的结果。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of discriminative models across diverse video understanding tasks. OmniViD casts multiple video tasks into a unified generative sequence modeling framework with a shared architecture and unified input-output format. It matches or surpasses task-specific methods across several video understanding benchmarks while offering better cross-task generalization.
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.assessment: 生成式统一视频理解是当前趋势，对多任务感知与统一建模有参考价值。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.contribution: 提出统一生成式框架 OmniViD 处理多种视频理解任务。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.innovation: 将分类、定位、问答等异构视频任务统一为生成式序列建模。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.result: 在多个视频理解基准上达到与任务专用方法相当或更优的性能。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ._arxiv_id: OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Universal Video Understanding.

Compositional Video Understanding with S.summary_cn: 针对组合式视频理解中物体、动作及其时空组合关系难以显式建模的问题，本文提出基于时空结构的 Transformer 方法。方法显式构建视频中的时空结构表示，并通过 Transformer 在该结构上进行组合推理，从而区分不同组合语义。相比仅依赖整体视频特征的已有方法，该方法对组合变化更敏感。实验在组合式视频理解基准上验证了时空结构建模的有效性。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.summary_en: This paper targets compositional video understanding, where object-action compositions and their spatiotemporal relations are hard to model explicitly. It proposes a spatiotemporal structure-based Transformer that builds explicit structural representations and performs compositional reasoning over them. Experiments on compositional video benchmarks demonstrate improved sensitivity to compositional changes over holistic-feature baselines.
Compositional Video Understanding with S.assessment: 组合式理解对鲁棒感知有启发，但整体与自动驾驶检测主线关联有限。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.contribution: 提出基于时空结构的 Transformer 用于组合式视频理解。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.innovation: 显式构建时空结构表示并在其上做组合推理。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.result: 在组合式视频理解基准上优于仅用整体特征的基线方法。
Compositional Video Understanding with S._arxiv_id: Compositional Video Understanding with Spatiotemporal Structure-based Transformers.

Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中跨域泛化能力不足的问题，本文提出"先对齐再适应"（Align Before Adapt）框架，利用实体到区域的显式对齐来增强模型的泛化性。方法核心是将视频中的实体（如物体、人物）与对应区域建立对齐关系，再通过适应模块迁移到目标域。相比已有工作，该方法强调对齐先于适应，避免了直接微调导致的域偏移。在多个跨域动作识别基准上取得了优于现有方法的泛化性能。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited cross-domain generalization of video action recognition by proposing an Align-Before-Adapt framework that explicitly aligns entities to regions before domain adaptation. The method establishes entity-to-region correspondences and then transfers them via an adaptation module, avoiding domain shift caused by direct fine-tuning. It achieves improved generalization on multiple cross-domain action recognition benchmarks.
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.assessment: 该工作将实体-区域对齐引入视频动作识别泛化，思路清晰，对视频理解中的跨域问题有参考价值。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.contribution: 提出实体到区域对齐的"先对齐再适应"框架用于可泛化视频动作识别。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.innovation: 将对齐机制前置到适应之前，显式建模实体与区域对应关系以缓解域偏移。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.result: 在多个跨域动作识别基准上取得优于现有方法的泛化性能。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to._arxiv_id: Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to-Region Alignments for Generalizable Video Action Recognition.

Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.summary_cn: 针对开放式视频问答（Video QA）中标签不足的问题，本文提出排序蒸馏（Ranking Distillation）方法。核心思想是利用模型对候选答案的相对排序信息进行知识蒸馏，而非依赖完整标注。相比传统监督方法，该方法在标签稀缺条件下仍能有效训练。实验表明在标签不足的开放式视频问答任务上取得了性能提升。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient labels in open-ended video question answering by proposing a ranking distillation approach. Instead of relying on complete annotations, it distills relative ranking information among candidate answers. Experiments show improved performance under label-scarce conditions.
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.assessment: 将排序蒸馏用于标签稀缺的视频问答，方法简洁，对弱监督视频理解有借鉴意义。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.contribution: 提出排序蒸馏方法缓解开放式视频问答中的标签不足问题。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.innovation: 利用候选答案的相对排序信息进行蒸馏，替代对完整标注的依赖。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.result: 在标签不足的开放式视频问答任务上取得性能提升。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide._arxiv_id: Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Video Question Answering with Insufficient Labels.

Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.summary_cn: 针对视频问答中视觉与语言模态对齐不足的问题，本文提出语言感知的视觉语义蒸馏方法。方法通过语言信息引导视觉特征的语义蒸馏，使视觉表示更贴合问题语义。相比已有工作，该方法强调语言对视觉语义的引导作用。在视频问答基准上取得了性能改进。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient vision-language alignment in video question answering by proposing a language-aware visual semantic distillation method. Language information guides the distillation of visual features to better match question semantics. It achieves improved performance on video QA benchmarks.
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.assessment: 语言引导的视觉语义蒸馏思路合理，对多模态视频问答的特征对齐有参考价值。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.contribution: 提出语言感知的视觉语义蒸馏方法用于视频问答。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.innovation: 用语言信息引导视觉特征的语义蒸馏，强化跨模态对齐。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.result: 在视频问答基准上取得性能改进。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat._arxiv_id: Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation for Video Question Answering.

E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.summary_cn: 针对零样本时空视频定位（STVG）问题，本文提出 E3M 框架，利用期望最大化（EM）进行多模态调制。方法通过 EM 迭代优化文本与视频模态的对齐，实现无需训练样本的时空定位。相比已有零样本方法，E3M 在多模态调制上更具自适应能力。在零样本时空视频定位基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.summary_en: This paper tackles zero-shot spatio-temporal video grounding with E3M, an Expectation-Maximization multimodal modulation framework. It iteratively optimizes text-video alignment via EM without training samples. E3M achieves competitive results on zero-shot STVG benchmarks.
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.assessment: 将 EM 用于零样本时空定位的多模态调制，方法新颖，对开放域视频定位有启发。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.contribution: 提出基于 EM 多模态调制的零样本时空视频定位框架 E3M。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.innovation: 用期望最大化迭代优化文本与视频模态对齐，实现免训练时空定位。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.result: 在零样本时空视频定位基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro._arxiv_id: E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding with Expectation-Maximization Multimodal Modulation.

🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中信息冗余与上下文丢失的问题，本文提出 VideoAgent，一个记忆增强的多模态智能体。方法通过记忆机制存储和检索关键视频片段，结合多模态大模型进行推理与问答。相比直接处理整段视频的方法，VideoAgent 能更高效地聚焦关键内容。在长视频理解基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.summary_en: This paper addresses redundancy and context loss in long video understanding by proposing VideoAgent, a memory-augmented multimodal agent. It stores and retrieves key video segments via a memory mechanism and reasons with multimodal large models. VideoAgent outperforms prior methods on long-video understanding benchmarks.
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.assessment: 记忆增强智能体用于长视频理解，契合多模态大模型趋势，值得关注。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.contribution: 提出记忆增强的多模态智能体 VideoAgent 用于长视频理解。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.innovation: 通过记忆机制检索关键片段并结合多模态大模型推理，提升长视频理解效率。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.result: 在长视频理解基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo._arxiv_id: 🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimodal Agent for Video Understanding.

2407.21757|v2.summary_cn: 针对叙事视频（如电影）理解中角色、对话、剧情等丰富上下文带来的挑战，本文提出 MovieSeq，一个多模态语言模型。核心思想是将视频表示为交错的图像、剧情、视频、字幕等多模态序列，通过指令微调让语言模型以交错多模态指令与视频交互。相比仅以视频为输入的方法，MovieSeq 联合提供角色照片、姓名与对话，使模型能关联这些元素生成更全面的回答。在 LVU、MAD、Movienet、CMD、TVC、MovieQA 六个数据集、五种任务设置上验证了有效性。
2407.21757|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of narrative video understanding by introducing MovieSeq, a multimodal language model that represents videos as interleaved multimodal sequences (images, plots, videos, subtitles). Through instruction-tuning, it enables interaction with videos via interleaved multimodal instructions, jointly providing character photos, names, and dialogues. It is validated on six datasets (LVU, MAD, Movienet, CMD, TVC, MovieQA) across five task settings.
2407.21757|v2.assessment: 将视频表示为交错多模态序列并指令微调，思路系统，对叙事视频理解有较强参考价值。
2407.21757|v2.contribution: 提出将视频表示为交错多模态序列的多模态语言模型 MovieSeq。
2407.21757|v2.innovation: 通过交错多模态指令微调，联合角色照片、姓名与对话实现叙事视频理解。
2407.21757|v2.result: 在六个数据集、五种任务设置上验证了有效性。

InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.summary_cn: 针对多模态视频理解缺乏统一大规模基础模型的问题，提出InternVideo2，通过渐进式训练范式将视频编码器、跨模态对齐与LLM解码器统一扩展。方法上采用掩码视频-文本建模、跨模态对比与下一token预测的多阶段训练，并构建了大规模视频-文本语料。相比此前InternVideo等，模型在视频理解、时序定位与多模态对话上均有提升。在多个视频基准（如Kinetics、Something-Something、视频问答）上取得领先结果，展现出强泛化能力。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.summary_en: To address the lack of a unified large-scale foundation model for multimodal video understanding, InternVideo2 is proposed, scaling video encoders, cross-modal alignment, and LLM decoders via a progressive training paradigm. It employs masked video-text modeling, cross-modal contrastive learning, and next-token prediction across stages, trained on large-scale video-text corpora. Compared with prior InternVideo, it improves video understanding, temporal grounding, and multimodal dialogue, achieving leading results on multiple video benchmarks such as Kinetics, Something-Something, and video QA.
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.assessment: 该工作系统性地将视频基础模型扩展到多模态理解，训练范式与数据规模均具参考价值，是视频理解方向的重要进展。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.contribution: 提出统一的多模态视频理解基础模型InternVideo2及其渐进式训练范式。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.innovation: 将掩码视频-文本建模、跨模态对比与LLM解码统一到多阶段训练框架中。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.result: 在多个视频理解与多模态基准上取得领先性能，展现出强泛化能力。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models._arxiv_id: InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models for Multimodal Video Understanding.

2311.17893|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督视频目标分割（VOS）依赖辅助模态或迭代slot attention导致通用性差、计算开销大的问题，提出利用DINO预训练Transformer中固有的结构依赖建立时空对应关系。方法上仅用一个时空Transformer块处理逐帧DINO特征，通过自注意力建立时空依赖，再对注意力图做层次聚类生成分割掩码。相比此前依赖光流或slot attention的方法，架构更简单且无需额外模态。在无监督VOS基准上取得有竞争力的分割结果，验证了DINO注意力作为对应线索的有效性。
2311.17893|v2.summary_en: To address the limited generality and high computational cost of self-supervised video object segmentation (VOS) methods that rely on auxiliary modalities or iterative slot attention, this work leverages the inherent structural dependencies in DINO-pretrained Transformers to establish spatio-temporal correspondences. A single spatio-temporal Transformer block processes frame-wise DINO features and builds spatio-temporal dependencies via self-attention, followed by hierarchical clustering on attention maps to generate segmentation masks. Compared with prior flow- or slot-attention-based methods, it is simpler and modality-free, achieving competitive unsupervised VOS results.
2311.17893|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了DINO注意力中蕴含的物体性可作为VOS的强对应线索，方法简洁且无需额外模态，对自监督分割研究有启发意义。
2311.17893|v2.contribution: 提出一种仅依赖DINO预训练Transformer注意力进行自监督视频目标分割的简洁方法。
2311.17893|v2.innovation: 利用DINO注意力图直接建立时空对应并层次聚类生成掩码，无需辅助模态或slot attention。
2311.17893|v2.result: 在无监督VOS基准上取得有竞争力的分割性能，验证了DINO注意力的对应能力。

2407.03788|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频-文本对不完全对齐以及概念分布不均导致跨模态表示不准确、冷门概念下游性能差的问题，提出MAMA框架。方法上采用带减法角度间隔的对比目标正则化跨模态表示，并用MLP参数化的加权函数将损失值映射为样本权重以动态调整训练焦点，同时借助少量无偏元数据和大型视觉语言模型生成的视频-文本数据。相比常规对比学习，MAMA在常见视频-语言检索与下游任务上取得更优性能，尤其改善了冷门概念的表现。
2407.03788|v2.summary_en: To address imperfect video-text alignment and uneven concept distribution that degrade cross-modal representations and downstream performance on unpopular concepts, MAMA is proposed. It uses a contrastive objective with a subtractive angular margin to regularize cross-modal representations, and an MLP-parameterized weighting function mapping loss values to sample weights for dynamic focus adjustment, guided by a small amount of unbiased meta-data and augmented with video-text data from a large vision-language model. MAMA improves video-language representations and outperforms common contrastive baselines, especially on unpopular concepts.
2407.03788|v2.assessment: 该工作从数据质量与概念分布角度改进视频-语言对比学习，角度间隔与元学习加权设计有一定新意，但整体增益相对有限。
2407.03788|v2.contribution: 提出MAMA框架，通过减法角度间隔对比与元优化样本加权提升视频-语言表示。
2407.03788|v2.innovation: 将减法角度间隔对比目标与MLP参数化的元学习样本加权结合，缓解数据不对齐与概念不均衡。
2407.03788|v2.result: 在常见视频-语言基准上取得优于对比学习基线的性能，并改善冷门概念的下游表现。

2412.12075|v2.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中现有基准多依赖全局语义、缺乏对细粒度线索定位能力评估的问题，本文提出CG-Bench。该基准要求模型基于视频中的具体线索（clue）进行问答，并设计了多轮交互与线索定位的评测协议。相比已有长视频QA基准，CG-Bench更强调时序定位与因果推理，能区分模型是否真正理解长视频内容。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但基准构建规模与任务设计具有较高参考价值。
2412.12075|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces CG-Bench, a clue-grounded question answering benchmark for long video understanding. It requires models to answer questions based on specific temporal clues and supports multi-turn interactions, addressing the limitation of existing benchmarks that rely on global semantics. The benchmark emphasizes temporal grounding and causal reasoning, offering a more discriminative evaluation of long-video comprehension.
2412.12075|v2.assessment: 长视频理解评测的重要补充，线索定位设计对视频QA研究有直接推动作用。
2412.12075|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于线索定位的长视频问答基准CG-Bench。
2412.12075|v2.innovation: 将问答与视频中的细粒度时序线索显式绑定，并支持多轮交互评测。
2412.12075|v2.result: 构建了强调时序定位与因果推理的长视频QA评测协议，摘要未提供具体数值。

2502.10810|v2.summary_cn: 针对流式视频理解中缺乏多轮时序对话评测的问题，本文提出SVBench。该基准包含时序多轮对话，模拟真实流式场景下模型需在视频持续输入时进行交互式问答。相比静态视频QA，SVBench更贴近在线视频理解需求，能评估模型在时间推移中的记忆与推理能力。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但基准设计对流式视频理解研究有明确价值。
2502.10810|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SVBench, a benchmark with temporal multi-turn dialogues for streaming video understanding. It simulates real-world streaming scenarios where models must answer interactively as video frames arrive, evaluating memory and reasoning over time. The benchmark fills a gap in evaluating online video comprehension beyond static video QA.
2502.10810|v2.assessment: 流式视频理解评测的及时工作，多轮时序对话设计对在线视频应用有参考意义。
2502.10810|v2.contribution: 提出了面向流式视频理解的时序多轮对话基准SVBench。
2502.10810|v2.innovation: 将多轮对话与流式视频输入结合，评测模型的在线记忆与推理能力。
2502.10810|v2.result: 构建了模拟真实流式场景的时序多轮对话评测基准，摘要未提供具体数值。

TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对交通场景中缺乏统一时空视频理解基准的问题，本文提出TUMTraf VideoQA数据集与基准。该工作整合了交通场景中的视频问答任务，涵盖时空推理，旨在推动自动驾驶场景下的多模态视频理解。相比已有交通数据集，TUMTraf VideoQA更强调统一时空理解与问答交互。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但对自动驾驶视频理解评测有直接贡献。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper introduces TUMTraf VideoQA, a dataset and benchmark for unified spatio-temporal video understanding in traffic scenes. It integrates video question answering with spatio-temporal reasoning to advance multimodal video comprehension for autonomous driving. The benchmark addresses the lack of unified evaluation for traffic-scene video understanding.
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.assessment: 自动驾驶视频理解评测的重要资源，时空问答设计对感知与推理结合有推动作用。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.contribution: 提出了交通场景统一时空视频理解的数据集与基准TUMTraf VideoQA。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.innovation: 将视频问答与交通场景的时空推理统一到一个评测框架中。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.result: 构建了面向自动驾驶的时空视频问答基准，摘要未提供具体数值。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f._arxiv_id: TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark for Unified Spatio-Temporal Video Understanding in Traffic Scenes.

Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_cn: 针对4D点云视频理解中时空信息耦合导致计算效率低的问题，本文提出Mamba4D。该方法利用解耦的时空状态空间模型分别建模空间与时间维度，在保持高效的同时捕捉4D点云的动态变化。相比基于Transformer的方法，Mamba4D在计算复杂度上更具优势，适合长序列点云视频。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但方法设计对4D点云理解有创新性。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_en: This paper proposes Mamba4D for efficient 4D point cloud video understanding using disentangled spatial-temporal state space models. It separately models spatial and temporal dimensions to capture dynamics while maintaining efficiency. Compared to Transformer-based methods, Mamba4D offers lower computational complexity for long point cloud sequences.
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.assessment: 将状态空间模型引入4D点云视频理解，解耦时空建模思路对点云视频研究有启发。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.contribution: 提出了基于解耦时空状态空间模型的4D点云视频理解方法Mamba4D。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.innovation: 利用Mamba架构解耦空间与时间建模，提升4D点云视频理解效率。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.result: 在保持高效的同时捕捉4D点云动态，摘要未提供具体数值。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video._arxiv_id: Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video Understanding with Disentangled Spatial-Temporal State Space Models.

Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_cn: 针对预训练3D模型难以直接迁移到点云视频理解的问题，本文提出跨帧时空感知的适配方法。该方法通过跨帧时空感知模块将预训练3D模型适配到点云视频任务，减少对大规模标注数据的依赖。相比从头训练，该方法能利用预训练知识提升点云视频理解性能。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但适配思路对点云视频研究有参考价值。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_en: This paper adapts pre-trained 3D models for point cloud video understanding via cross-frame spatio-temporal perception. It introduces a cross-frame module to transfer pre-trained 3D knowledge to video tasks, reducing reliance on large-scale annotations. The approach leverages pre-training to improve point cloud video comprehension.
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.assessment: 预训练3D模型向点云视频迁移的实用工作，跨帧感知设计对点云视频研究有参考意义。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.contribution: 提出了将预训练3D模型适配到点云视频理解的跨帧时空感知方法。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.innovation: 通过跨帧时空感知模块实现预训练3D知识向点云视频任务的有效迁移。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.result: 利用预训练知识提升点云视频理解性能，摘要未提供具体数值。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point._arxiv_id: Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point Cloud Video Understanding via Cross-frame Spatio-temporal Perception.

2503.18223|v2.summary_cn: 针对野生动物行为监测中缺乏标注视频数据集的问题，本文提出MammAlps。该数据集包含瑞士国家公园9个相机陷阱的14小时以上视频与音频、2D分割图及8.5小时个体轨迹标注，并基于6135个单动物片段提出分层多模态行为识别基准。此外还提出面向生态学的多视角长期事件基准，涵盖物种、数量与气象条件识别。相比已有动物数据集，MammAlps在多模态、多视角与行为标注密度上更丰富。
2503.18223|v2.summary_en: This paper presents MammAlps, a multimodal and multi-view dataset for wildlife behavior monitoring from 9 camera traps in the Swiss National Park. It contains over 14 hours of video with audio, 2D segmentation maps, and 8.5 hours of individual tracks densely labeled for species and behavior. Two benchmarks are proposed for hierarchical multimodal behavior recognition and ecology-oriented event understanding.
2503.18223|v2.assessment: 野生动物行为监测的多模态数据集，对生态学与视频理解交叉研究有独特价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低。
2503.18223|v2.contribution: 提出了多模态多视角野生动物行为监测数据集MammAlps及两个基准。
2503.18223|v2.innovation: 结合音频、视频与参考场景分割图，构建分层行为识别与生态事件理解基准。
2503.18223|v2.result: 包含14小时以上视频与8.5小时轨迹标注，基于6135个片段建立行为识别基准。

2412.04467|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型中视觉 token 数量远超文本 token、推理开销巨大的问题，作者观察到 CLIP/SigLIP 等编码器输出的视觉 token 存在大量冗余。提出 VisionZip，一种无需训练、即插即用的方法，通过选择信息量高的 token 子集输入语言模型，并适配图像与视频理解及多轮对话场景。相比此前 SOTA 方法在几乎所有设置下至少提升 5%，prefilling 时间加速 8 倍，使 LLaVA-Next 13B 推理快于 7B 且效果更好。
2412.04467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the redundancy in visual tokens produced by encoders like CLIP and SigLIP, which inflates inference cost in vision-language models. VisionZip is a training-free, plug-and-play method that selects a compact set of informative tokens for the language model, applicable to image/video understanding and multi-turn dialogue. It surpasses the prior state of the art by at least 5% across nearly all settings and speeds up prefilling by 8x, letting LLaVA-Next 13B run faster than the 7B variant with better accuracy.
2412.04467|v2.assessment: 对多模态大模型部署效率有直接价值，方法简单通用且加速比显著，适合关注 VLM 推理优化的研究者。
2412.04467|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的视觉 token 选择方法 VisionZip，大幅压缩视觉 token 冗余。
2412.04467|v2.innovation: 利用视觉编码器 token 冗余特性做信息量驱动的 token 选择，并适配多轮对话场景。
2412.04467|v2.result: 几乎全部设置下较此前 SOTA 提升至少 5%，prefilling 加速 8 倍。

2503.21483|v2.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中 VLM 受限于上下文窗口、均匀采样在噪声场景下效率低的问题，作者提出 BOLT，一种无需额外训练、在推理时进行帧选择的策略。首先提出多源检索评测设置以更真实地评估长视频理解，发现均匀采样在噪声上下文中表现很差；随后比较多种基于 query-frame 相似度的帧选择策略，发现逆变换采样（inverse transform sampling）效果最佳。在 Video-MME 上准确率从 53.8% 提升到 56.1%，MLVU 从 58.9% 提升到 63.4%。
2503.21483|v2.summary_en: This work targets the limited context window of video-language models in long-form video understanding, where uniform frame sampling wastes capacity on irrelevant content. BOLT is a training-free inference-time frame selection method; the authors introduce a multi-source retrieval evaluation setting and compare query-frame similarity-based selection strategies, finding inverse transform sampling most effective. It raises Video-MME accuracy from 53.8% to 56.1% and MLVU from 58.9% to 63.4%.
2503.21483|v2.assessment: 免训练、即插即用的帧选择策略，对长视频 VLM 推理有实用价值，但方法创新度相对有限。
2503.21483|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的长视频帧选择方法 BOLT 及多源检索评测设置。
2503.21483|v2.innovation: 系统比较帧选择策略并发现逆变换采样在噪声上下文下最优。

2412.01095|v2.summary_cn: 针对可解释视频异常检测（VAD）中现有方法依赖专用推理模块或指令微调、带来高算力与标注开销的问题，作者提出 VERA，一种 verbalized learning 框架，使 VLM 在不修改模型参数的情况下完成 VAD。VERA 将复杂推理自动分解为对若干聚焦引导问题的反思，把这些反思问题当作可学习参数，通过 learner 与 optimizer VLM 之间数据驱动的语言交互、利用粗标注数据优化。该方法在无需参数更新和精细标注的前提下实现可解释异常检测。
2412.01095|v2.summary_en: Existing explainable video anomaly detection (VAD) approaches either add specialized reasoning modules or rely on instruction tuning, incurring heavy compute or annotation cost. VERA introduces a verbalized learning framework that lets VLMs perform VAD without modifying model parameters, decomposing complex reasoning into reflections on focused guiding questions treated as learnable parameters and optimized via verbal interactions between learner and optimizer VLMs using coarsely labeled data. It achieves explainable VAD without parameter updates or fine-grained annotation.
2412.01095|v2.assessment: 以语言化学习替代参数微调做可解释 VAD，思路新颖，但领域与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2412.01095|v2.contribution: 提出免参数更新的 verbalized learning 框架 VERA 用于可解释视频异常检测。
2412.01095|v2.innovation: 将引导问题作为可学习参数，通过 learner-optimizer VLM 语言交互优化。
2412.01095|v2.result: 在无需模型参数修改与精细标注下实现可解释 VAD。

2412.03735|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型在视频理解中幻觉问题研究不足的现状，作者观察到 MLLM 视觉编码器难以区分视觉不同但语义相似的视频对，据此提出 VidHalluc——目前最大的视频理解幻觉评测基准，包含 5,002 个配对视频，从动作、时序、场景转换三个维度评估幻觉。测试显示多数 MLLM 在这些维度上均易产生幻觉；作者进一步提出免训练的 DINO-HEAL，利用 DINOv2 的空间显著性在推理时重加权视觉特征，平均降低幻觉 3.02%。
2412.03735|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the underexplored hallucination problem of multimodal LLMs in video understanding, motivated by the observation that visual encoders fail to distinguish visually different yet semantically similar video pairs. VidHalluc is the largest benchmark for video hallucination, with 5,002 paired videos probing action, temporal sequence, and scene transition dimensions. The authors also propose DINO-HEAL, a training-free method reweighting visual features with DINOv2 spatial saliency, reducing hallucinations by 3.02% on average.
2412.03735|v2.assessment: 提供了大规模视频幻觉评测基准与免训练缓解方法，对多模态视频模型可靠性研究有参考价值。
2412.03735|v2.contribution: 构建最大视频幻觉评测基准 VidHalluc 并提出免训练缓解方法 DINO-HEAL。
2412.03735|v2.innovation: 从动作、时序、场景转换三维度系统评测视频幻觉，并用 DINOv2 显著性重加权特征。
2412.03735|v2.result: 多数 MLLM 存在显著幻觉，DINO-HEAL 平均降低幻觉 3.02%。

2411.13281|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有视频理解评测多依赖 VideoMME、LongVideoBench 等选择题基准、难以反映真实用户复杂需求且人工标注成本高的问题，作者提出 VideoAutoArena，一个受 LMSYS Chatbot Arena 启发的竞技场式基准。它通过用户模拟生成开放式、自适应问题，采用改进的 ELO 评分系统实现多 LMM 的公平持续比较，并用人工标注构建 gold standard 验证自动评判与人类判断高度一致。此外引入 fault-driven 分析以定位模型失败模式。
2411.13281|v2.summary_en: Existing video benchmarks rely on multiple-choice questions that poorly capture real user demands and are costly to annotate. VideoAutoArena is an arena-style benchmark inspired by LMSYS Chatbot Arena that uses user simulation to generate open-ended adaptive questions, with a modified ELO rating system for fair continuous comparison across LMMs. A human-annotated gold standard validates that the automated judging aligns strongly with human judgment, and a fault-driven analysis is introduced.
2411.13281|v2.assessment: 为视频 LMM 提供了可扩展的开放式评测范式，对模型评测方法学有贡献，但与感知任务关联有限。
2411.13281|v2.contribution: 提出基于用户模拟与 ELO 评分的自动化视频 LMM 竞技场基准 VideoAutoArena。
2411.13281|v2.innovation: 用用户模拟生成开放式自适应问题，并以人工 gold standard 验证自动评判一致性。
2411.13281|v2.result: 自动评判与人类判断高度一致，并支持多模型公平持续比较。

2412.10360|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频 LMM 中许多设计决策缺乏依据、训练与评测成本高昂且开放研究有限的问题，作者开展系统性研究以揭示视频理解的关键驱动因素。研究首先分析高算力开销来源，发现 Scaling Consistency——在小模型和小数据上做出的设计与训练决策可有效迁移到大模型。基于此系统探索了视频采样、架构、数据组成、训练计划等方面，例如证明训练时 fps 采样远优于均匀帧采样，并比较了最适合视频表示的视觉编码器。
2412.10360|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates what actually drives video understanding in large multimodal models, since many design decisions lack justification and research is compute-constrained. It identifies Scaling Consistency, whereby design and training decisions made on smaller models and datasets transfer effectively to larger ones. Leveraging this, the authors systematically explore video sampling, architectures, data composition, and training schedules, showing that fps sampling during training is vastly preferable to uniform frame sampling and identifying the best vision encoders for video.
2412.10360|v2.assessment: 系统性强、结论可迁移，对视频 LMM 的设计选择提供了实证指导，值得关注。
2412.10360|v2.contribution: 系统研究视频 LMM 的关键设计因素并提出 Scaling Consistency 现象。
2412.10360|v2.innovation: 发现小模型/小数据上的设计决策可迁移至大模型，并据此高效探索视频建模要素。
2412.10360|v2.result: 证明训练时 fps 采样远优于均匀帧采样，并给出最优视觉编码器等实证结论。

2504.07745|v2.summary_cn: 针对Video-LLM在细粒度视频理解（如视觉动态和细节查询）上的不足，论文提出自监督片段微调方法SF²T，利用视频固有特性进行训练，无需人工标注且规避了自然语言难以捕捉复杂时空变化的局限。同时构建了FineVidBench基准，从场景和片段两个层级系统评估Video-LLM性能。相比依赖昂贵标注数据的微调方法，SF²T以零标注成本解锁了更细粒度的理解能力。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称显著提升了细粒度视频理解表现。
2504.07745|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deficiency of Video-LLMs in fine-grained video understanding, particularly visual dynamics and detail-oriented queries. It proposes SF²T, a self-supervised fragment fine-tuning method that exploits inherent video characteristics for training without labor-intensive annotations, and introduces FineVidBench for evaluating Video-LLMs at both scene and fragment levels. The approach unlocks fine-grained understanding capabilities while circumventing the limitations of natural language in capturing complex spatiotemporal variations.
2504.07745|v2.assessment: 自监督微调思路简洁有效，配套基准对Video-LLM细粒度评估有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2504.07745|v2.contribution: 提出无需标注的自监督片段微调方法SF²T及细粒度视频理解基准FineVidBench。
2504.07745|v2.innovation: 利用视频固有特性进行自监督片段微调，规避自然语言标注在时空细节上的表达瓶颈。
2504.07745|v2.result: 显著提升Video-LLM的细粒度视频理解能力，并提供了场景与片段双层级评估基准。

When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督视频表示学习中时间对应关系建模的问题，提出驯服时间对应（Taming Temporal Correspondence）的方法。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。从标题推断，工作聚焦于如何利用未来帧与过去帧之间的时序对应关系来提升自监督视频表示学习效果。具体改进点和量化结果需查阅全文确认。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.summary_en: This paper tackles temporal correspondence modeling in self-supervised video representation learning. The title suggests a method that treats future frames as past context to tame temporal correspondence for improved representation learning. Specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be assessed due to the missing abstract.
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.assessment: 自监督视频表示学习是感知预训练的重要方向，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法与效果。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.contribution: 提出面向自监督视频表示学习的时间对应关系建模方法。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.innovation: 以未来帧作为过去上下文来驯服时序对应关系（基于标题推断）。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming._arxiv_id: When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming Temporal Correspondence for Self-supervised Video Representation Learning.

2411.11934|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目输入合成双目视频中高质量配对数据不足和时空一致性难以保持的问题，论文提出自监督双目视频合成范式SpatialDreamer，基于视频扩散模型。具体设计了基于深度的视频生成模块DVG，采用前向-后向渲染机制生成具有几何和时间先验的配对视频；在DVG生成数据上提出RefinerNet及自监督合成框架进行高效训练；并设计一致性控制模块保证时空一致性。相比直接将新视角合成技术应用于视频的现有方法，SpatialDreamer能更好处理动态场景且降低训练数据需求。
2411.11934|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses stereo video synthesis from monocular input, tackling insufficient paired training data and spatio-temporal consistency challenges. It proposes SpatialDreamer, a self-supervised paradigm based on video diffusion models, featuring a Depth-based Video Generation module (DVG) with forward-backward rendering, a RefinerNet with self-supervised training framework, and a consistency control module. Unlike existing methods that directly apply novel view synthesis to video, it better handles dynamic scenes with reduced data requirements.
2411.11934|v2.assessment: 将扩散模型与自监督策略结合解决双目视频合成，思路新颖，但与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测等核心感知任务关联有限。
2411.11934|v2.contribution: 提出基于视频扩散模型的自监督双目视频合成框架SpatialDreamer。
2411.11934|v2.innovation: 通过前向-后向渲染的深度视频生成模块与一致性控制模块实现动态场景下的自监督双目合成。
2411.11934|v2.result: 在降低训练数据需求的同时实现了更好的动态场景双目视频合成效果。

2506.01037|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于扩散的视频超分方法因固有随机性引入复杂退化和明显伪影的问题，论文提出结合自监督学习与Mamba的鲁棒真实世界VSR框架。通过Video State-Space块与3D选择性扫描模块增强全局时空注意力以保证帧间内容一致性，引入自监督ControlNet以HR特征为引导并通过对比学习提取退化不敏感特征，最后采用三阶段HR-LR混合训练策略稳定训练。在真实世界VSR基准上取得优于现有方法的感知质量。
2506.01037|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses artifacts and degradations introduced by diffusion-based video super-resolution methods due to inherent randomness. It proposes a noise-robust real-world VSR framework integrating self-supervised learning and Mamba into pre-trained latent diffusion models, with a Video State-Space block using 3D Selective Scan for spatio-temporal coherence, a self-supervised ControlNet leveraging HR features and contrastive learning for degradation-insensitive feature extraction, and a three-stage HR-LR mixed training strategy. It achieves superior perceptual quality over state-of-the-art on real-world VSR benchmarks.
2506.01037|v2.assessment: Mamba与自监督ControlNet的结合在真实世界VSR上有新意，但与自动驾驶感知任务相关性较低。
2506.01037|v2.contribution: 提出融合自监督ControlNet与时空Mamba的真实世界视频超分框架。
2506.01037|v2.innovation: 利用3D选择性扫描的Video State-Space块和对比学习驱动的自监督ControlNet降低扩散模型伪影。
2506.01037|v2.result: 在真实世界VSR基准数据集上取得优于现有方法的感知质量。

2601.04068|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本到视频扩散模型与人类偏好对齐的问题，指出现有DPO方法依赖多样本排序和任务特定critic模型，效率低且全局监督信号模糊。为此提出LocalDPO后训练框架，从真实视频构建局部化偏好对，通过随机时空掩码腐蚀真实视频并用冻结基模型仅恢复掩码区域来生成负样本，单次推理即可获得偏好对，无需外部critic或人工标注。训练时引入区域感知DPO损失，将偏好学习限制在腐蚀区域以加速收敛。在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上实验表明，LocalDPO持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性和人类偏好对齐效果。
2601.04068|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and ambiguous global supervision of existing DPO methods for aligning text-to-video diffusion models with human preferences, which rely on multi-sample ranking and task-specific critics. It proposes LocalDPO, a post-training framework that constructs localized preference pairs by corrupting real videos with random spatio-temporal masks and restoring only masked regions using a frozen base model, requiring a single inference per prompt without external critics or manual annotation. A region-aware DPO loss restricts preference learning to corrupted areas for faster convergence. Experiments on Wan2.1 and CogVideoX show consistent improvements in video fidelity, temporal coherence, and human preference alignment.
2601.04068|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一种高效的视频扩散模型偏好对齐方法，思路简洁且无需额外critic模型，但主题属于视频生成而非自动驾驶感知，与用户研究方向关联较弱。
2601.04068|v2.contribution: 提出LocalDPO框架，利用局部时空掩码构建偏好对，实现无需critic模型的视频扩散模型区域级偏好优化。
2601.04068|v2.innovation: 将偏好学习从全局视频级别细化到时空区域级别，并通过冻结基模型恢复掩码区域自动生成负样本，单次推理即可完成。
2601.04068|v2.result: 在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性和人类偏好对齐，摘要未给出具体数值。

2004.07507|v2.summary_cn: 针对含批归一化（BN）层的神经网络在持续学习中的二次惩罚方法失效问题，作者指出K-FAC近似在样本间存在依赖（如BN层导致）时不再成立。为此扩展了K-FAC方法以考虑样本间关系，并提出了BN统计参数的权重合并与重参数化方法，以及无需源任务数据的超参数选择策略。在带BN层的permuted MNIST和从ImageNet到细粒度分类的ResNet-50序列学习任务上，该方法优于基线，且完全不使用源任务数据。
2004.07507|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the invalidity of Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) for continual learning when batch normalization (BN) layers introduce inter-example dependencies. It extends K-FAC to account for such dependencies, proposes weight merging and reparameterization for BN statistics, and a hyperparameter selection method without source task data. Experiments on permuted MNIST with BN and sequential ImageNet-to-fine-grained learning with ResNet-50 show superior performance over baselines without using source task data.
2004.07507|v2.assessment: 对持续学习中的二阶优化与BN处理有理论贡献，但领域相关性偏基础，对自动驾驶感知的直接启发有限。
2004.07507|v2.contribution: 提出了考虑样本间依赖的扩展K-FAC及BN参数处理方法，实现了无需源任务数据的持续学习。
2004.07507|v2.innovation: 将K-FAC近似推广到含BN层的网络，并设计BN统计量的权重合并与重参数化。
2004.07507|v2.result: 在permuted MNIST和ImageNet到细粒度分类的序列任务上超越基线，且无需源任务数据。

2004.00440|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中深度网络因灾难性遗忘而性能骤降的问题，本文研究嵌入网络的增量学习，提出语义漂移补偿方法，无需任何样本即可估计并补偿特征漂移。该方法基于当前任务数据经历的漂移来近似旧任务的漂移。在细粒度数据集CIFAR100和ImageNet-Subset上实验表明，嵌入网络显著减轻了灾难性遗忘，且补偿方法有效。
2004.00440|v2.summary_en: This paper studies class-incremental learning for embedding networks, which naturally accommodate new classes without adding weights, and proposes a semantic drift compensation method that estimates and compensates feature drift without exemplars. The drift of previous tasks is approximated from the drift experienced by current task data. Experiments on CIFAR100 and ImageNet-Subset show that embedding networks suffer significantly less from catastrophic forgetting and the compensation is effective.
2004.00440|v2.assessment: 为无样本类增量学习提供了新视角，语义漂移补偿思路简洁有效，对持续学习在感知任务中的应用有参考价值。
2004.00440|v2.contribution: 提出无需样本的语义漂移补偿方法，用于嵌入网络的类增量学习。
2004.00440|v2.innovation: 利用当前任务数据的特征漂移来估计旧任务的漂移并进行补偿。
2004.00440|v2.result: 在CIFAR100和ImageNet-Subset上显著减轻灾难性遗忘，性能优于基线。

2002.00718|v2.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中的增量学习问题，现有方法忽略了背景类像素的语义分布偏移（因每步仅标注部分类别）。本文提出一种新的基于蒸馏的框架，显式建模背景偏移，并引入分类器参数初始化策略以防止对背景类的偏置预测。在Pascal-VOC 2012和ADE20K数据集上，该方法显著优于现有增量学习技术。
2002.00718|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses incremental learning in semantic segmentation, where existing methods fail to account for the semantic distribution shift of background pixels due to partial annotations per step. It proposes a distillation-based framework that explicitly models this shift and a novel classifier initialization strategy to prevent biased predictions toward background. Extensive evaluation on Pascal-VOC 2012 and ADE20K shows significant outperformance over state-of-the-art incremental learning methods.
2002.00718|v2.assessment: 将增量学习拓展到语义分割并解决背景偏移这一关键问题，对自动驾驶场景中的持续感知有直接借鉴意义。
2002.00718|v2.contribution: 提出显式建模背景偏移的蒸馏框架及分类器初始化策略，用于语义分割的增量学习。
2002.00718|v2.innovation: 首次在增量语义分割中考虑背景类的语义分布偏移并进行补偿。
2002.00718|v2.result: 在Pascal-VOC 2012和ADE20K上显著超越现有增量学习方法。

2003.13191|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线增量学习场景中同时面临灾难性遗忘和概念漂移（旧类新观测分布变化）的问题，本文提出一个可在线工作的增量学习框架，能同时处理新类数据和旧类新观测。通过引入改进的交叉蒸馏损失和两步学习技术解决遗忘问题。实验表明该方法优于当前最先进的在线增量学习方法。
2003.13191|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles online incremental learning where both catastrophic forgetting and concept drift (new observations of old classes) degrade performance. It proposes an online incremental learning framework handling new class data and new observations of old classes, using a modified cross-distillation loss and a two-step learning technique. Experiments show it outperforms state-of-the-art online incremental learning methods.
2003.13191|v2.assessment: 面向更现实的在线持续学习设定，同时处理新类和旧类新观测，对实际部署中的持续感知系统有参考价值。
2003.13191|v2.contribution: 提出能同时处理新类数据和旧类新观测的在线增量学习框架。
2003.13191|v2.innovation: 结合改进的交叉蒸馏损失与两步学习技术，应对在线场景下的概念漂移。
2003.13191|v2.result: 在在线增量学习基准上超越现有最先进方法。

2002.10211|v2.summary_cn: 针对多类增量学习（MCIL）中学习新类与避免遗忘旧类之间的固有矛盾，本文提出Mnemonics训练框架，将样本参数化并端到端优化，通过双层优化（模型级和样本级）进行训练。在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset和ImageNet三个基准上，使用Mnemonics样本大幅超越现有最先进方法，且发现这些样本倾向于位于不同类别的边界上。
2002.10211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off in multi-class incremental learning (MCIL) between learning new concepts and avoiding catastrophic forgetting. It proposes the Mnemonics training framework, which parameterizes exemplars and optimizes them end-to-end via bilevel optimization (model-level and exemplar-level). Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-Subset, and ImageNet show large margins over state-of-the-art, with mnemonics exemplars tending to lie on class boundaries.
2002.10211|v2.assessment: 通过可学习样本缓解遗忘，思路新颖且实验充分，对基于样本回放的持续学习方法有启发。
2002.10211|v2.contribution: 提出可端到端优化的Mnemonics样本框架，用于多类增量学习。
2002.10211|v2.innovation: 将样本参数化并通过双层优化自动学习最具代表性的样本。
2002.10211|v2.result: 在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset和ImageNet上大幅超越最先进方法。

Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.|v2.summary_cn: 本文研究小样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning）问题，即在仅有少量新类样本的情况下增量学习新类别而不遗忘旧类。摘要未提供具体方法细节和实验结果。
Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper studies few-shot class-incremental learning, where new classes are learned incrementally from only a few examples without forgetting old ones. The abstract does not provide specific method details or experimental results.
Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.|v2.assessment: 小样本类增量学习是一个有挑战性的方向，但摘要信息不足，难以评估其具体贡献。
Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.|v2.contribution: 针对小样本类增量学习问题提出解决方案（摘要未详述）。
Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.|v2.innovation: 摘要未明确说明创新点。
Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果。

1911.07053|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，尤其现有知识蒸馏（KD）虽能维持旧类判别性，却无法阻止模型将样本误判为新类。②作者观察到灾难性遗忘的关键因素是最后一层全连接（FC）层权重在增量学习中高度偏置，提出先用KD保持旧类判别性，再通过Weight Aligning（WA）在正常训练后校正FC层偏置权重以维持新旧类公平性。③相比已有工作，WA无需额外训练阶段或复杂结构，仅对FC权重做后处理校正，简单有效。④摘要未给出具体数据集数值，但声称该方法在保持旧类判别性的同时显著缓解了对新类的偏置。
1911.07053|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class incremental learning, showing that knowledge distillation (KD) alone maintains discrimination within old classes but fails to prevent bias toward new classes. The authors identify highly biased weights in the last fully connected layer as a key cause and propose Weight Aligning (WA), which corrects these biased weights after normal training while using KD to preserve old-class discrimination. Unlike prior methods, WA is a simple post-hoc correction requiring no extra training stages, effectively maintaining fairness between old and new classes.
1911.07053|v2.assessment: 该工作对增量学习中FC层偏置这一被忽视的因素给出了简洁有效的诊断与修正，方法轻量且易于集成，对持续学习研究者有直接参考价值。
1911.07053|v2.contribution: 提出Weight Aligning方法，通过校正FC层偏置权重来维持类增量学习中新旧类之间的公平性。
1911.07053|v2.innovation: 首次明确指出FC层权重偏置是KD效果被掩盖的关键原因，并给出无需额外训练的后处理校正方案。
1911.07053|v2.result: 在保持旧类判别性的同时有效缓解了对新类的偏置，显著减轻灾难性遗忘（摘要未提供具体数值）。
