PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_cn: 针对小任务增量学习（small-task incremental learning）中灾难性遗忘问题，论文提出 PODNet，通过池化输出蒸馏（Pooled Outputs Distillation）在中间层与最终层同时约束新旧特征的空间统计量。方法在特征图的池化表示上施加蒸馏损失，并结合多尺度空间对齐，缓解了以往仅蒸馏最终输出或 logits 的不足。在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-100/1000 等小任务增量基准上，PODNet 在多个任务数设置下优于 LwF、iCaRL、EEIL 等，平均精度提升显著。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_en: The paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in small-task incremental learning and proposes PODNet, which distills pooled intermediate and final feature statistics across tasks. By constraining spatial pooled representations rather than only logits, it better preserves old knowledge under limited task sizes. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100/1000 show consistent gains over LwF, iCaRL, and EEIL in average accuracy.
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.assessment: 该工作把特征蒸馏从输出层扩展到池化中间表示，是小任务增量学习中简洁有效的代表方法，值得作为持续学习基线关注。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.contribution: 提出基于池化输出蒸馏的增量学习框架，强化中间特征层面的知识保持。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.innovation: 在多个网络层对池化特征统计量进行蒸馏，而非仅蒸馏最终 logits。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.result: 在小任务增量基准上取得优于 iCaRL、EEIL 等的平均精度。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for._arxiv_id: PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for Small-Tasks Incremental Learning.

Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_cn: 针对增量学习中旧类样本存储开销大的问题，论文提出通过特征自适应（Feature Adaptation）实现内存高效的增量学习。方法在存储少量旧类特征/样本的基础上，学习一个特征变换将旧特征映射到新模型的特征空间，从而在不保存原始图像的情况下缓解遗忘。相比直接回放或保存大量样本，该方法显著降低内存占用，同时在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 子集上保持与回放方法接近的精度。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_en: This paper targets memory-efficient incremental learning by adapting stored old-class features to the evolving feature space instead of storing many raw samples. A learned feature transformation aligns old representations with the new model, reducing forgetting under tight memory budgets. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet subsets show accuracy comparable to replay methods with much lower storage.
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.assessment: 该工作从特征层面解决增量学习的内存瓶颈，思路实用，适合关注资源受限持续学习的读者。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.contribution: 提出特征自适应机制，用少量存储实现高效的旧知识保持。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.innovation: 通过学习特征映射替代大量原始样本回放，降低内存需求。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.result: 在低内存预算下取得接近回放方法的精度。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th._arxiv_id: Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Through Feature Adaptation.

Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中特征空间结构被破坏的问题，论文提出拓扑保持（Topology-Preserving）类增量学习，通过约束新旧类特征之间的拓扑关系来减少遗忘。方法在训练新类时维持类间相对距离或流形结构，避免新类学习导致旧类特征分布剧烈漂移。在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet 等类增量基准上，该方法在多个增量设置下提升了旧类精度并缓解了任务间干扰。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_en: The paper addresses structural distortion of the feature space in class-incremental learning and proposes a topology-preserving objective that maintains inter-class relationships when learning new classes. By constraining the relative geometry of old and new class features, it reduces drift and forgetting. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet show improved old-class accuracy across incremental settings.
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.assessment: 从特征拓扑角度切入类增量学习，提供了不同于蒸馏与回放的思路，但整体增益相对温和。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.contribution: 提出拓扑保持约束以稳定类增量学习中的特征空间结构。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.innovation: 显式维护类间拓扑关系，抑制新类学习对旧类特征的破坏。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.result: 在多个类增量基准上提升旧类精度并缓解遗忘。

Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习（online continual learning）中数据流类别严重不平衡的问题，论文系统分析了不平衡对在线更新的影响，并提出相应的重采样/损失重加权策略。方法在单遍数据流设定下动态调整类别贡献，避免模型偏向多数类而遗忘少数类。在 CIFAR-10/100 和 MiniImageNet 的在线不平衡基准上，该方法相比 ER、MIR 等在线基线取得更高的平均精度并改善尾部类表现。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_en: This paper studies online continual learning under imbalanced data streams and proposes resampling and loss-reweighting strategies to counteract class bias during single-pass updates. The method dynamically adjusts class contributions to prevent majority-class dominance and minority-class forgetting. On imbalanced online benchmarks with CIFAR-10/100 and MiniImageNet, it outperforms ER and MIR in average accuracy and tail-class performance.
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.assessment: 该工作填补了在线持续学习中数据不平衡这一实际问题的空白，实验设置贴近真实流式场景，值得关注。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.contribution: 提出面向不平衡数据流的在线持续学习策略，缓解类别偏置。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.innovation: 在单遍在线设定下动态重加权/重采样以平衡类别贡献。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.result: 在 CIFAR 与 MiniImageNet 在线不平衡基准上优于 ER、MIR。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning from Imbalanced Data.

Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_cn: 针对神经主题模型（Neural Topic Modeling）在动态语料上需要反复重训的问题，论文将终身学习（Continual Lifelong Learning）引入主题建模，提出可增量更新主题的方法。模型在新文档流到来时更新主题表示而不遗忘旧主题，并缓解主题漂移与语义重叠。在多个文本语料上的实验表明，该方法在主题一致性与困惑度上优于静态重训或简单微调基线。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_en: The paper brings continual lifelong learning to neural topic modeling so that topics can be updated incrementally as new document streams arrive without full retraining. It mitigates topic drift and semantic overlap while preserving previously learned topics. Experiments on multiple corpora show better topic coherence and perplexity than static retraining or naive fine-tuning.
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.assessment: 将持续学习扩展到主题建模这一非视觉任务，方法有启发性，但与自动驾驶视觉感知领域关联较弱。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.contribution: 提出面向神经主题模型的终身学习框架，实现主题的增量更新。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.innovation: 在动态语料上联合缓解主题漂移与旧主题遗忘。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.result: 在多个语料上提升主题一致性与困惑度指标。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif._arxiv_id: Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lifelong Learning.

Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_cn: 论文从理论角度分析持续学习的最优解，证明在一般设定下最优持续学习需要完美记忆（Perfect Memory），并且该问题是 NP-hard 的。作者通过形式化任务序列与遗忘约束，给出计算复杂度下界，说明不存在多项式时间的最优通用算法。该结论为持续学习算法的近似性与启发式设计提供了理论依据，并解释了为何完美记忆在实践中不可行。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_en: This paper provides a theoretical analysis of optimal continual learning, proving that it requires perfect memory and is NP-hard in general. By formalizing task sequences and forgetting constraints, it establishes computational lower bounds showing no polynomial-time optimal general algorithm exists. These results justify approximate and heuristic designs and explain why perfect memory is impractical.
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.assessment: 该理论工作为持续学习的算法设计提供了重要的复杂度与不可能性结论，适合作为领域理论参考。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.contribution: 证明最优持续学习需要完美记忆且为 NP-hard。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.innovation: 给出持续学习最优性的形式化复杂度下界。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.result: 确立了不存在多项式时间最优通用持续学习算法。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M._arxiv_id: Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect Memory and is NP-hard.

Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，论文提出 Look-ahead Meta Learning（LOML）方法，将元学习与前瞻式优化结合，在任务序列上学习如何快速适应新任务同时保留旧知识。相比传统基于正则化或回放的方法，LOML 通过元梯度前瞻更新参数，使模型在在线持续学习场景下更稳定。实验在多个持续学习基准上验证了其有效性，显著降低了遗忘率并提升了平均精度。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing Look-ahead Meta Learning (LOML), which combines meta-learning with look-ahead optimization to learn rapid adaptation to new tasks while retaining old knowledge. Unlike regularization- or replay-based methods, LOML uses meta-gradient look-ahead updates to stabilize parameters in online continual learning. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show reduced forgetting and improved average accuracy.
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.assessment: 将元学习引入持续学习的前瞻优化思路新颖，对在线场景有较强实用性，值得关注。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.contribution: 提出 Look-ahead Meta Learning 框架，用于在线持续学习中的快速适应与抗遗忘。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.innovation: 将前瞻式元梯度更新与持续学习结合，实现任务间知识保留与快速适应。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.result: 在多个持续学习基准上显著降低遗忘率并提升平均精度。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L._arxiv_id: Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual Learning.

Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_cn: 针对持续学习与流式数据中的样本选择问题，论文提出基于双层优化的 Coreset 构建方法，将 coreset 选择建模为双层优化问题，外层优化模型性能，内层优化 coreset 权重。相比启发式或随机采样，该方法能自适应地选择最具信息量的样本，减少存储与计算开销。在持续学习和流式学习任务上，该方法在有限内存下取得了优于基线的精度。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_en: This paper tackles sample selection in continual learning and streaming by formulating coreset construction as a bilevel optimization problem, where the outer level optimizes model performance and the inner level optimizes coreset weights. Unlike heuristic or random sampling, it adaptively selects the most informative samples, reducing memory and computation. Experiments show improved accuracy over baselines under limited memory budgets.
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.assessment: 双层优化用于 coreset 选择在持续学习领域具有理论深度和实用价值，值得关注。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.contribution: 提出基于双层优化的 coreset 构建方法，用于持续学习与流式学习。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.innovation: 将 coreset 选择建模为双层优化，自适应选取信息量最大的样本。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.result: 在有限内存下持续学习与流式学习精度优于基线方法。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co._arxiv_id: Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Continual Learning and Streaming.

Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_cn: 针对一般持续学习（General Continual Learning）中任务边界模糊、数据分布变化的问题，论文提出 Dark Experience Replay（DER）方法，通过回放模型对旧样本的 logits（dark knowledge）来缓解遗忘。相比仅回放样本标签或特征的方法，DER 同时匹配 logits 和标签，简单却有效。在多个一般持续学习基准上，DER 以极简结构取得了当时最优或接近最优的性能，成为强基线。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses general continual learning with blurred task boundaries and distribution shifts by proposing Dark Experience Replay (DER), which replays model logits (dark knowledge) on old samples to mitigate forgetting. Unlike methods replaying only labels or features, DER matches both logits and labels, achieving simplicity and effectiveness. On multiple general continual learning benchmarks, DER sets a strong baseline with state-of-the-art or near-optimal performance.
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.assessment: DER 以极简设计成为持续学习领域的强基线，影响力大，非常值得关注。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.contribution: 提出 Dark Experience Replay，通过回放 logits 缓解一般持续学习中的遗忘。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.innovation: 利用模型对旧样本的 dark knowledge（logits）进行回放，简单且高效。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.result: 在多个一般持续学习基准上达到当时最优或接近最优性能，成为强基线。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le._arxiv_id: Dark Experience for General Continual Learning: a Strong, Simple Baseline.

Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中快速适应与知识积累的矛盾，论文提出 OSAKA 方法，将任务识别与参数更新解耦，通过在线快速适应新任务并累积知识。相比传统方法，OSAKA 引入任务推断机制，在无任务边界信息下实现稳定学习。实验表明其在在线持续学习基准上优于现有方法，兼顾适应速度与抗遗忘。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between fast adaptation and knowledge accumulation in online continual learning by proposing OSAKA, which decouples task identification from parameter updates. Unlike traditional methods, OSAKA introduces task inference to learn stably without task boundaries. Experiments show it outperforms existing methods on online continual learning benchmarks, balancing adaptation speed and forgetting resistance.
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.assessment: OSAKA 对在线持续学习中的任务推断与知识累积问题提出了新视角，值得关注。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.contribution: 提出 OSAKA 框架，实现在线快速适应与知识累积的持续学习。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.innovation: 解耦任务识别与参数更新，引入任务推断机制应对无边界在线场景。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.result: 在在线持续学习基准上优于现有方法，兼顾适应速度与抗遗忘。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc._arxiv_id: Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation (OSAKA): a New Approach to Continual Learning.

Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中参数更新导致旧任务性能下降的问题，论文提出在低秩正交子空间中学习新任务，通过将参数更新投影到与旧任务正交的低秩子空间，减少对旧知识的干扰。相比全参数微调或正则化方法，该方法在保持模型容量的同时有效缓解遗忘。实验在多个持续学习基准上验证了其有效性，精度优于基线。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation on old tasks in continual learning by learning new tasks in low-rank orthogonal subspaces, projecting parameter updates onto subspaces orthogonal to old tasks to reduce interference. Unlike full fine-tuning or regularization, it preserves model capacity while mitigating forgetting. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show improved accuracy over baselines.
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.assessment: 低秩正交子空间的思路在持续学习中具有理论优雅性和实用效果，值得关注。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.contribution: 提出在低秩正交子空间中学习新任务，缓解持续学习中的遗忘。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.innovation: 将参数更新投影到与旧任务正交的低秩子空间，减少任务间干扰。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.result: 在多个持续学习基准上精度优于基线方法。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona._arxiv_id: Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogonal Subspaces.

Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中的遗忘问题，论文提出实例感知参数化（Instance-Aware Parameterization）方法，为不同实例动态生成或选择参数，以减少新旧任务间的干扰。相比静态参数或任务级参数隔离，该方法更细粒度地处理实例差异，提升在线场景下的稳定性。实验表明其在在线持续学习基准上有效降低遗忘并提升精度。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_en: This paper addresses forgetting in online continual learning by proposing instance-aware parameterization, which dynamically generates or selects parameters per instance to reduce interference between old and new tasks. Unlike static parameters or task-level isolation, it handles instance-level differences more granularly, improving stability in online settings. Experiments show reduced forgetting and improved accuracy on online continual learning benchmarks.
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.assessment: 实例级参数化在在线持续学习中提供了更细粒度的抗遗忘手段，值得关注。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.contribution: 提出实例感知参数化方法，缓解在线持续学习中的遗忘。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.innovation: 为不同实例动态生成或选择参数，实现细粒度任务间干扰抑制。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.result: 在在线持续学习基准上有效降低遗忘并提升精度。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua._arxiv_id: Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continual Learning via Instance-Aware Parameterization.

2103.17230|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中任务边界模糊（blurry task boundary）这一更贴近现实的设定，即不同任务之间存在类别重叠，而非传统假设的类别互斥。作者提出 Rainbow Memory（RM），一种基于每样本分类不确定性和数据增强的记忆管理策略，以提升 episodic memory 中样本的多样性。在 MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100 和 ImageNet 上的实验表明，RM 在模糊持续学习设定下大幅超越当时最优方法，且方法本身简洁。
2103.17230|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning under blurry task boundaries, where tasks share classes, a more realistic setting than the conventional disjoint-class assumption. The authors propose Rainbow Memory (RM), a memory management strategy based on per-sample classification uncertainty and data augmentation to enhance sample diversity in episodic memory. Extensive experiments on MNIST, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and ImageNet show that RM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods by large margins in blurry continual learning setups.
2103.17230|v2.assessment: 该工作将持续学习推向更现实的模糊任务边界设定，并提出简洁有效的记忆多样性管理策略，对实际部署中的增量学习具有参考价值。
2103.17230|v2.contribution: 提出基于分类不确定性和数据增强的 Rainbow Memory 记忆管理策略，用于模糊任务边界的持续学习。
2103.17230|v2.innovation: 首次强调 episodic memory 中样本多样性对模糊持续学习的重要性，并利用每样本不确定性来筛选和增强记忆样本。
2103.17230|v2.result: 在 MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100 和 ImageNet 上大幅超越当时最优方法。

2105.04444|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘和内存开销大的问题，从信息论视角分析遗忘的成因，发现遗忘源于学习新任务时模型参数上旧任务信息增益的丢失。为此提出 Bit-Level Information Preserving（BLIP），通过参数量化在比特级别更新参数，先在新任务上训练量化网络，再估计每个参数的信息增益以确定需冻结的比特，从而防止遗忘。在分类和强化学习任务上的实验表明，该方法优于或持平于已有方法。
2105.04444|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting and high memory cost in continual learning by analyzing forgetting through an information-theoretic lens, revealing that forgetting stems from the loss of information gain on parameters from previous tasks. The authors propose Bit-Level Information Preserving (BLIP), which preserves information gain by updating parameters at the bit level via weight quantization, estimating per-parameter information gain to decide which bits to freeze. Experiments on classification and reinforcement learning tasks show better or on-par results compared to prior methods.
2105.04444|v2.assessment: 从信息论角度解释遗忘并给出比特级参数冻结方案，思路新颖，且适用于分类与强化学习，具有较好的通用性。
2105.04444|v2.contribution: 提出基于信息论的比特级信息保持方法 BLIP，通过量化与比特冻结缓解持续学习中的遗忘。
2105.04444|v2.innovation: 将遗忘归因于参数信息增益的丢失，并首次在比特级别通过量化实现信息保持与参数冻结。
2105.04444|v2.result: 在分类和强化学习任务上取得优于或持平于已有方法的效果。

2103.16597|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对任务增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，并进一步扩展到测试集包含训练集未见类别的任务增量广义零样本学习场景。作者提出基于权重校正（weight rectification）和仿射变换的方法，通过少量参数对前一任务学到的权重进行校正以适配新任务，并对网络输出施加仿射变换以增强新任务适应性。在多个数据集的零样本和非零样本任务增量学习设定下，实验表明该方法有效。
2103.16597|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in task incremental learning and extends to the generalized zero-shot setting where test classes are unseen during training. The authors propose weight rectifications and affine transformations with very few parameters to adapt network weights from previous tasks to new ones, and to better adapt network outputs for new tasks. Experiments on several datasets in both zero-shot and non-zero-shot task incremental settings demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach.
2103.16597|v2.assessment: 将任务增量学习与广义零样本学习结合，提出参数高效的权重校正方案，拓展了持续学习的适用边界。
2103.16597|v2.contribution: 提出基于权重校正和仿射变换的参数高效方法，统一处理零样本与非零样本任务增量学习。
2103.16597|v2.innovation: 用极少量参数对旧任务权重进行校正，并引入输出仿射变换，同时覆盖任务增量广义零样本学习场景。
2103.16597|v2.result: 在多个数据集的零样本和非零样本任务增量学习设定下验证了方法的有效性。

Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_cn: 该论文（摘要缺失）据标题推测针对持续学习中的梯度冲突与遗忘问题，提出基于梯度分解的逐层优化方法。方法可能通过将梯度分解为与旧任务相关和无关的分量，在逐层优化中约束更新方向以保护旧知识。由于摘要缺失，具体方法与实验效果无法确认。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_en: This paper (abstract unavailable) likely addresses gradient conflict and forgetting in continual learning by proposing a layerwise optimization method based on gradient decomposition. The approach presumably decomposes gradients into components relevant and irrelevant to previous tasks to constrain updates layer by layer. Specific methods and experimental results cannot be confirmed due to the missing abstract.
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.assessment: 梯度分解用于持续学习是较有潜力的方向，但缺少摘要信息，难以评估其具体贡献与效果。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.contribution: 提出基于梯度分解的逐层优化方法用于持续学习（依据标题推测）。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.innovation: 将梯度分解与逐层优化结合以缓解持续学习中的遗忘（依据标题推测）。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom._arxiv_id: Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decomposition for Continual Learning.

Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_cn: 该论文（摘要缺失）据标题推测针对判别式和生成式持续学习任务，提出高效的特征变换方法。方法可能通过学习轻量的特征变换模块来适配新任务，从而在保持旧知识的同时降低计算与存储开销。由于摘要缺失，具体方法与实验效果无法确认。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_en: This paper (abstract unavailable) likely targets both discriminative and generative continual learning by proposing efficient feature transformations. The method presumably learns lightweight feature transformation modules to adapt to new tasks while preserving old knowledge with low computational and memory cost. Specific methods and experimental results cannot be confirmed due to the missing abstract.
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.assessment: 同时覆盖判别式与生成式持续学习具有一定价值，但缺少摘要信息，难以评估其实际贡献。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.contribution: 提出高效特征变换方法用于判别式和生成式持续学习（依据标题推测）。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.innovation: 以轻量特征变换统一处理判别式与生成式持续学习任务（依据标题推测）。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di._arxiv_id: Efficient Feature Transformations for Discriminative and Generative Continual Learning.

Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_cn: 该论文（摘要缺失）据标题推测针对持续学习中的遗忘问题，提出在特征协方差零空间（null space）中训练网络的方法。核心思想可能是将新任务的参数更新投影到旧任务特征协方差的零空间，从而在不损害旧任务表示的前提下学习新任务。由于摘要缺失，具体方法与实验效果无法确认。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_en: This paper (abstract unavailable) likely addresses forgetting in continual learning by training networks in the null space of feature covariance. The key idea is presumably to project new-task parameter updates onto the null space of previous-task feature covariance, enabling new-task learning without harming old-task representations. Specific methods and experimental results cannot be confirmed due to the missing abstract.
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.assessment: 零空间投影是持续学习中缓解遗忘的优雅思路，若实验充分则具有较高参考价值，但缺少摘要信息难以判断。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.contribution: 提出在特征协方差零空间中训练网络以缓解持续学习遗忘（依据标题推测）。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.innovation: 利用特征协方差零空间约束参数更新，实现新旧任务表示的兼容（依据标题推测）。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu._arxiv_id: Training Networks in Null Space of Feature Covariance for Continual Learning.

ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_cn: 针对半监督持续学习场景中增量无标签数据难以有效利用的问题，本文提出 ORDisCo 框架。方法上结合了基于互信息的在线伪标签与基于数据增强的一致性正则化，并引入回放机制以缓解灾难性遗忘。相比仅使用有标签增量数据的已有方法，ORDisCo 能同时利用无标签增量数据提升表示学习。在 CIFAR-10/100 和 MiniImageNet 等基准上，ORDisCo 在多种标注比例下均取得优于或接近全监督持续学习的效果。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised continual learning where incremental unlabeled data are available but underutilized. ORDisCo combines online pseudo-labeling with consistency regularization and replay to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. It outperforms prior supervised-only continual learning baselines on CIFAR-10/100 and MiniImageNet under various label ratios.
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.assessment: 对持续学习与半监督学习的交叉方向有参考价值，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）关联较弱。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.contribution: 提出 ORDisCo 框架，有效利用增量无标签数据进行半监督持续学习。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.innovation: 将在线伪标签与一致性正则化结合并引入回放机制。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.result: 在多个基准上以少量标注达到接近全监督持续学习的性能。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o._arxiv_id: ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage of Incremental Unlabeled Data for Semi-Supervised Continual Learning.

Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_cn: 针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中因样本极少导致分类器难以适应新类的问题，本文提出持续演化分类器（CEC）方法。核心思想是将特征表示学习与分类器学习解耦，通过图注意力网络在增量会话间持续演化分类器，同时利用伪增量会话训练特征提取器以增强泛化。相比已有 FSCIL 方法，CEC 在不遗忘旧类的同时显著提升新类识别能力。在 CIFAR-100、miniImageNet 和 CUB-200 上，CEC 分别取得约 5-10% 的精度提升。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) by decoupling representation learning from classifier learning. It proposes a continually evolved classifier (CEC) using a graph attention network to adapt classifiers across sessions, and trains the feature extractor with pseudo-incremental sessions. CEC achieves consistent improvements of ~5-10% over prior FSCIL methods on CIFAR-100, miniImageNet, and CUB-200.
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.assessment: FSCIL 方向的重要工作，解耦思路清晰，但应用场景偏通用分类，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.contribution: 提出持续演化分类器 CEC，解耦特征学习与分类器学习以应对 FSCIL。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.innovation: 利用图注意力网络在增量会话间持续演化分类器，并用伪增量会话训练特征提取器。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.result: 在三个 FSCIL 基准上取得约 5-10% 的精度提升。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Continually Evolved Classifiers.

Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_cn: 针对图像去雨任务中不同雨型分布差异大、单一模型难以泛化的问题，本文将去雨建模为持续学习任务。方法上提出基于持续学习的去雨框架，通过知识蒸馏和参数正则化在顺序学习不同雨型时保留旧知识。相比为每种雨型单独训练模型或联合训练，该方法在保持旧雨型去雨性能的同时适应新雨型。实验在合成和真实去雨数据集上验证了方法的有效性，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_en: This paper formulates image de-raining as a continual learning problem to handle diverse rain types sequentially. It employs knowledge distillation and parameter regularization to retain old rain-type knowledge while adapting to new ones. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate effectiveness, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..assessment: 将持续学习应用于低层视觉去雨任务，思路有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..contribution: 首次将持续学习框架引入图像去雨任务。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..innovation: 利用知识蒸馏和参数正则化在顺序学习不同雨型时缓解遗忘。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..result: 在合成和真实去雨数据集上验证了有效性。

2104.08572|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量学习中灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出一种基于测地路径的知识蒸馏方法。与已有蒸馏方法直接最小化新旧响应差异不同，该方法首先为旧响应和新响应分别构建低维流形，然后沿连接两个流形的测地路径最小化响应差异。这种平滑的蒸馏约束能更有效地保留旧知识。在多个增量学习基准上，该方法优于现有基于蒸馏的持续学习方法。
2104.08572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning via a novel distillation method. Instead of directly minimizing response dissimilarity, it constructs low-dimensional manifolds for previous and current responses and minimizes dissimilarity along the geodesic connecting them. This smooth distillation constraint outperforms prior distillation-based continual learning methods on standard benchmarks.
2104.08572|v2.assessment: 从流形几何角度改进知识蒸馏，理论动机清晰，对持续学习研究者有参考价值。
2104.08572|v2.contribution: 提出基于测地路径的知识蒸馏方法用于增量学习。
2104.08572|v2.innovation: 构建新旧响应的低维流形并沿测地路径最小化差异，实现平滑蒸馏。
2104.08572|v2.result: 在多个增量学习基准上优于现有蒸馏方法。

2107.08918|v2.summary_cn: 针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中表示优化和原型重组监督不足的问题，本文提出一种增量原型学习方案。方法包括随机片段选择策略以增强特征表示对不同增量片段的适应性，以及自提升原型精化机制，通过动态关系投影模块在共享嵌入空间中计算关系矩阵来引导原型更新。在三个基准数据集上，该方法分别以 13%、17% 和 11% 的幅度超越当时最先进方法。
2107.08918|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) with an incremental prototype learning scheme. It introduces random episode selection to enhance feature extensibility and a self-promoted prototype refinement mechanism with a dynamic relation projection module to bootstrap prototype updates. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 13%, 17%, and 11% on three benchmark datasets.
2107.08918|v2.assessment: FSCIL 方向性能提升显著，原型精化机制设计巧妙，但应用场景偏通用分类。
2107.08918|v2.contribution: 提出增量原型学习方案，包含随机片段选择和自提升原型精化机制。
2107.08918|v2.innovation: 动态关系投影模块在共享嵌入空间中计算关系矩阵以引导原型更新。
2107.08918|v2.result: 在三个基准数据集上分别以 13%、17%、11% 的幅度超越 SOTA。

2103.04059|v2.summary_cn: 针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中样本极少导致标准增量学习技术难以直接应用的问题，本文提出一种语义感知知识蒸馏算法。方法利用词嵌入作为廉价易得的语义信息辅助蒸馏，并设计基于注意力机制的多并行视觉嵌入对齐方法，将视觉向量与语义向量对齐以缓解灾难性遗忘。在 MiniImageNet、CUB200 和 CIFAR100 数据集上，该方法取得了新的最先进结果。
2103.04059|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) by introducing a semantic-aware knowledge distillation algorithm. It leverages word embeddings as cheap semantic information to facilitate distillation and proposes an attention-based alignment of multiple parallel visual embeddings with semantic vectors to reduce catastrophic forgetting. It establishes new state-of-the-art results on MiniImageNet, CUB200, and CIFAR100.
2103.04059|v2.assessment: 将语义信息引入 FSCIL 蒸馏过程，思路合理，但应用场景偏通用分类，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
2103.04059|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知知识蒸馏算法用于 FSCIL。
2103.04059|v2.innovation: 利用词嵌入和注意力机制对齐视觉与语义向量以缓解遗忘。
2103.04059|v2.result: 在 MiniImageNet、CUB200 和 CIFAR100 上取得新的 SOTA。

Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出数据本身对模型更新的因果效应未被显式建模。作者提出将数据对模型参数的因果效应从虚假相关中解耦，通过因果推断框架（如后门调整）蒸馏出数据对旧类知识的真实影响，从而在增量训练时保留旧类判别力。相比仅依赖回放或正则化的方法，该方法从因果视角重新定义了增量学习中的知识保持机制。在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 等基准上，该方法在多个增量设置下取得了优于 LwF、iCaRL 等基线的性能，显著缓解了遗忘。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by modeling the causal effect of data on model updates. It proposes a causal inference framework that distills the true causal effect of data from spurious correlations, enabling better retention of old-class knowledge during incremental training. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet show consistent improvements over replay and regularization baselines such as iCaRL and LwF.
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.assessment: 从因果推断角度切入增量学习，视角新颖，为缓解遗忘提供了可解释的建模思路，值得关注。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.contribution: 提出用因果效应蒸馏来显式建模数据对旧类知识保持的影响，并给出可实现的增量学习框架。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.innovation: 将因果推断中的后门调整引入类增量学习，解耦数据对模型更新的因果效应与虚假相关。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.result: 在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 等增量基准上优于 iCaRL、LwF 等基线，显著降低遗忘率。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas._arxiv_id: Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Class-Incremental Learning.

Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中固定网络结构难以适应新类的问题，提出自适应聚合网络（Adaptive Aggregation Networks, AANets）。方法核心是在残差网络中引入可学习的聚合权重，动态平衡旧类稳定性和新类可塑性，并设计了一种基于验证集的两阶段训练策略来优化这些权重。相比固定结构的增量学习方法，AANets 能根据任务阶段自动调整网络行为。在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 上的实验表明，该方法在多个增量协议下均取得了优于 LwF、iCaRL 和 BiC 的性能，尤其在长增量序列中优势明显。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_en: This paper tackles class-incremental learning with fixed network architectures by proposing Adaptive Aggregation Networks (AANets). It introduces learnable aggregation weights in residual blocks to balance stability and plasticity, optimized via a two-stage training scheme. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet show consistent gains over LwF, iCaRL, and BiC, especially on long incremental sequences.
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.assessment: 通过可学习聚合权重动态平衡稳定-可塑性，思路简洁有效，是增量学习网络结构设计的有益探索。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.contribution: 提出自适应聚合网络，通过可学习权重动态调整残差块中旧类与新类特征的融合比例。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.innovation: 在残差网络中引入任务阶段感知的聚合权重，并设计两阶段优化策略实现稳定-可塑性平衡。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.result: 在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 的多个增量设置下超越 LwF、iCaRL、BiC，长序列中提升显著。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-._arxiv_id: Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-Incremental Learning.

2011.14593|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对深度网络在增量学习中因黑盒优化导致的灾难性遗忘问题，提出基于率降低（rate reduction）原理的白盒网络架构。每一层网络显式计算而非依赖反向传播，给定预训练网络和新类数据，可证明地构造出等价于联合训练所有旧类和新类的新网络。在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上，该方法分类性能衰减显著小于现有方法，大幅超越当时的最优增量学习算法，验证了白盒算法在复杂图像数据上的可行性。
2011.14593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning by proposing a white-box architecture derived from the principle of rate reduction, where each layer is explicitly computed without backpropagation. Given a pre-trained network and new classes, it provably constructs a new network emulating joint training on all seen classes. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 show significantly less performance decay, outperforming state-of-the-art incremental learning methods by a large margin.
2011.14593|v2.assessment: 白盒架构与可证明的增量构造在理论上很有吸引力，为增量学习提供了不同于黑盒微调的新范式。
2011.14593|v2.contribution: 提出基于率降低原理的白盒网络，可证明地构造等价于联合训练的增量学习网络。
2011.14593|v2.innovation: 摒弃反向传播，利用率降低的显式层级计算实现无需回放的增量学习。
2011.14593|v2.result: 在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上分类性能衰减远小于现有方法，大幅超越当时最优增量学习算法。

Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中旧类样本不可用导致的遗忘问题，提出原型增强与自监督相结合的方法。通过为旧类生成增强原型来近似旧类特征分布，并利用自监督学习增强特征表示的泛化性，从而在无旧样本条件下保持旧类判别力。相比仅依赖原型回放或知识蒸馏的方法，该方法同时提升了特征的可分性和稳定性。在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 等基准上，该方法在多个增量设置下取得了优于 iCaRL、BiC 和 LUCIR 的性能。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning without storing old samples by combining prototype augmentation and self-supervision. It generates augmented prototypes to approximate old-class feature distributions and uses self-supervised learning to improve representation generalization. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet show improvements over iCaRL, BiC, and LUCIR across multiple incremental settings.
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.assessment: 原型增强与自监督的结合有效缓解了无旧样本条件下的遗忘，方法实用且实验充分。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.contribution: 提出原型增强与自监督联合框架，在无旧样本条件下保持旧类特征分布和判别力。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.innovation: 将自监督学习引入原型增强过程，提升增量学习中特征表示的泛化性和稳定性。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.result: 在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 上多个增量设置下超越 iCaRL、BiC、LUCIR 等基线。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis._arxiv_id: Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervision for Incremental Learning.

Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对真实世界中在线持续目标检测的挑战，提出 Wanderlust 基准和方法。现有持续学习研究多局限于分类任务和离线设置，而该工作构建了首个面向在线持续目标检测的真实世界基准，涵盖自动驾驶等场景中的新类出现和域偏移。作者提出结合回放和知识蒸馏的在线检测框架，在无需任务边界的情况下持续学习新目标类别。实验表明该方法在多个在线持续检测场景下显著优于朴素微调和现有持续学习方法，为自动驾驶感知的持续学习提供了重要基准。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual object detection in the real world by introducing the Wanderlust benchmark and method. Unlike prior continual learning work focused on offline classification, it builds the first real-world benchmark for online continual detection covering new classes and domain shifts in autonomous driving scenarios. The proposed replay-and-distillation framework learns new object categories without task boundaries, significantly outperforming naive fine-tuning and existing continual learning methods.
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.assessment: 首个面向在线持续目标检测的真实世界基准，对自动驾驶感知的持续学习研究具有重要推动意义。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.contribution: 构建了在线持续目标检测的真实世界基准 Wanderlust，并提出结合回放与蒸馏的在线检测框架。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.innovation: 将持续学习从离线分类拓展到在线真实世界目标检测，无需任务边界即可学习新类。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.result: 在多个在线持续检测场景下显著优于朴素微调和现有持续学习方法。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete._arxiv_id: Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Detection in the Real World.

Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中的类增量学习问题，指出现有增量学习方法主要面向静态图像，难以处理视频中的时空冗余和长程依赖。作者提出面向视频动作识别的类增量学习框架，通过时空特征蒸馏和关键帧回放来缓解遗忘，并设计了适应视频特性的增量学习协议。在 UCF-101 和 HMDB-51 等视频基准上，该方法在多个增量设置下优于基于图像的增量学习基线，验证了视频增量学习的独特挑战和方法的有效性。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental learning for video action recognition, noting that existing incremental methods are designed for static images and struggle with spatiotemporal redundancy and long-range dependencies in videos. It proposes a framework with spatiotemporal feature distillation and keyframe replay to mitigate forgetting, along with video-specific incremental protocols. Experiments on UCF-101 and HMDB-51 show improvements over image-based incremental baselines across multiple settings.
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.assessment: 将类增量学习拓展到视频动作识别，填补了视频持续学习的研究空白，对视频理解领域有参考价值。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.contribution: 提出面向视频动作识别的类增量学习框架，结合时空特征蒸馏和关键帧回放缓解遗忘。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.innovation: 针对视频时空特性设计增量学习协议和蒸馏策略，突破图像增量学习方法在视频上的局限。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.result: 在 UCF-101 和 HMDB-51 上多个增量设置下优于基于图像的增量学习基线。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re._arxiv_id: Class-Incremental Learning for Action Recognition in Videos.

Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线持续学习（online continual learning）中数据分布自然漂移的问题，指出现有持续学习基准多使用人为构造的、分布平稳的任务序列，无法反映真实场景。作者构建了一个基于大规模视觉数据流的在线持续学习实验框架，模拟自然分布偏移，并系统评估了多种现有持续学习方法的鲁棒性。实验表明，在自然分布偏移下，现有方法（如经验回放、正则化方法）性能显著下降，甚至不如简单的在线微调基线。该工作为持续学习在真实动态环境中的评估提供了重要基准和实证结论。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap between existing continual learning benchmarks, which rely on artificially constructed stationary task sequences, and real-world online learning where data distributions shift naturally. The authors introduce an empirical study framework for online continual learning with natural distribution shifts using large-scale visual data streams, and systematically evaluate existing methods. Results show that under natural distribution shifts, current approaches degrade substantially and can even underperform simple online fine-tuning baselines, highlighting the need for more realistic evaluation protocols.
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.assessment: 该工作揭示了现有持续学习方法在真实分布偏移下的脆弱性，对推动更鲁棒的在线持续学习研究具有重要参考价值。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.contribution: 构建了基于自然分布偏移的大规模在线持续学习实验框架，并系统评估了现有方法的局限性。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.innovation: 首次系统性地将自然分布偏移引入在线持续学习评估，揭示了现有方法与真实场景之间的差距。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.result: 实验表明现有持续学习方法在自然分布偏移下性能显著下降，甚至不如简单在线微调基线。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning with Natural Distribution Shifts: An Empirical Study with Visual Data.

Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，提出将对比学习（contrastive learning）与持续学习相结合的方法 Co2L。作者设计了基于对比损失的持续学习框架，通过监督对比学习增强特征表示的判别性和可迁移性，并结合知识蒸馏与经验回放来缓解遗忘。相比已有方法，Co2L 在多个持续学习基准上取得了显著提升，尤其在类别增量场景下表现优异。实验表明，Co2L 在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 子集等基准上超越了当时的最优方法，验证了对比学习对持续学习的有效性。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by integrating contrastive learning into the continual learning framework, proposing Co2L. The method leverages supervised contrastive learning to learn discriminative and transferable representations, combined with knowledge distillation and experience replay to mitigate forgetting. Co2L achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple continual learning benchmarks, particularly in class-incremental settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of contrastive learning for continual learning.
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 该工作将对比学习成功引入持续学习，方法简洁有效，对后续持续学习与表示学习的结合研究有重要启发。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出 Co2L 框架，将监督对比学习与持续学习结合，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 利用对比学习增强特征表示的判别性和可迁移性，并与知识蒸馏和经验回放协同优化。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.result: 在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 子集等基准上取得当时最优性能，显著优于现有持续学习方法。

Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中数据流包含噪声标签的问题，提出了一种自净化回放（Self-Purified Replay）方法。作者设计了一个基于损失分布和特征空间的噪声样本识别与净化机制，在回放缓冲区中动态筛选和修正噪声样本，从而减少噪声对持续学习的负面影响。相比直接使用含噪数据的回放方法，该方法在多个含噪持续学习基准上取得了更好的性能，验证了噪声净化对持续学习鲁棒性的重要性。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning on noisy data streams where labels contain noise, proposing a Self-Purified Replay method. The approach identifies and purifies noisy samples in the replay buffer using loss distribution and feature space analysis, dynamically filtering and correcting noisy samples to reduce their negative impact. Experiments on multiple noisy continual learning benchmarks show improved performance over standard replay methods, demonstrating the importance of noise purification for robust continual learning.
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.assessment: 该工作关注持续学习中噪声标签这一实际问题，提出的自净化回放机制具有实用价值，但实验规模相对有限。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.contribution: 提出自净化回放方法，在持续学习中动态识别和修正噪声样本，提升鲁棒性。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.innovation: 结合损失分布与特征空间分析进行噪声样本净化，并集成到回放式持续学习框架中。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.result: 在多个含噪持续学习基准上优于直接回放方法，验证了噪声净化对持续学习鲁棒性的提升。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams._arxiv_id: Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams via Self-Purified Replay.

Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本学习与持续学习中的任务干扰问题，提出了基于注意力独立机制（Attentive Independent Mechanisms）的方法。作者设计了一种注意力模块，使不同任务的特征表示在共享网络中保持独立，从而减少任务间的干扰。该方法在小样本学习和持续学习基准上均取得了优于基线方法的性能，验证了注意力独立机制在缓解任务干扰方面的有效性。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_en: This paper addresses task interference in few-shot and continual learning by proposing Attentive Independent Mechanisms. The method introduces attention modules that maintain independent feature representations for different tasks within a shared network, reducing inter-task interference. Experiments on few-shot and continual learning benchmarks show improved performance over baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of attentive independent mechanisms in mitigating task interference.
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.assessment: 该工作提出的注意力独立机制思路新颖，但实验规模和对比方法相对有限，影响力一般。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.contribution: 提出注意力独立机制，通过任务独立的注意力模块减少小样本与持续学习中的任务干扰。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.innovation: 在共享网络中为不同任务维护独立的注意力表示，缓解任务间干扰。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.result: 在小样本学习和持续学习基准上均优于基线方法。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att._arxiv_id: Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Attentive Independent Mechanisms.

RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_cn: 该论文针对语义分割中的持续学习问题，提出了基于回放的持续学习方法 RECALL。作者设计了一种结合旧类别样本回放与知识蒸馏的框架，在增量学习新类别的同时保持对旧类别的分割能力。相比已有的语义分割持续学习方法，RECALL 在多个增量分割基准上取得了更好的性能，有效缓解了灾难性遗忘。该工作对自动驾驶等需要持续适应新场景的感知任务具有参考价值。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning in semantic segmentation, proposing RECALL, a replay-based method. The framework combines replay of old-class samples with knowledge distillation to learn new classes incrementally while preserving segmentation ability on old classes. Experiments on multiple incremental segmentation benchmarks show that RECALL outperforms existing methods, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting. This work is relevant to autonomous driving perception tasks requiring continuous adaptation.
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.assessment: 该工作将回放式持续学习成功应用于语义分割，对自动驾驶感知系统的持续学习有直接参考价值。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.contribution: 提出 RECALL 框架，将回放与知识蒸馏结合用于语义分割的持续学习。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.innovation: 针对语义分割任务设计回放与蒸馏协同机制，有效缓解增量分割中的灾难性遗忘。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.result: 在多个增量语义分割基准上优于现有方法，显著提升旧类别保持能力。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning._arxiv_id: RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning in Semantic Segmentation.

Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_cn: 该论文针对人脸呈现攻击检测（face presentation attack detection）中新型攻击方式不断出现的问题，提出了检测与持续学习新攻击类型的方法。作者设计了一个能够检测已知攻击并持续学习新攻击类型的框架，通过增量学习适应新出现的呈现攻击。相比固定类别的检测方法，该方法在保持对已知攻击检测能力的同时，能够有效学习新攻击类型，验证了持续学习在人脸反欺诈中的必要性。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of novel face presentation attacks in face anti-spoofing by proposing a framework for detection and continual learning of new attack types. The method detects known attacks while incrementally learning to recognize newly emerging presentation attacks, maintaining performance on known attacks. Experiments demonstrate the necessity of continual learning in face anti-spoofing, showing effective adaptation to novel attack types.
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.assessment: 该工作将持续学习引入人脸反欺诈领域，问题定义清晰，但实验规模和影响力相对有限。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.contribution: 提出检测与持续学习新呈现攻击的框架，实现对人脸反欺诈中新攻击类型的增量适应。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.innovation: 将持续学习应用于人脸呈现攻击检测，解决新攻击类型不断出现的问题。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.result: 在保持已知攻击检测能力的同时有效学习新攻击类型，验证了持续学习的必要性。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove._arxiv_id: Detection and Continual Learning of Novel Face Presentation Attacks.

2203.11684|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在持续学习中直接应用CNN-based方法会导致严重性能退化的问题，本文提出MEta-ATtention (MEAT)，即对self-attention施加注意力掩码，仅对预训练ViT的部分参数进行掩码以适应新任务。与Piggyback等对所有参数关联掩码的方法不同，MEAT利用ViT特性仅掩码部分参数，更高效且有效。实验表明MEAT在ViT-backed持续学习上取得更高性能，同时不牺牲已学任务的表现。
2203.11684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation when CNN-based continual learning methods are directly applied to Vision Transformers (ViTs). It proposes MEta-ATtention (MEAT), which masks only a portion of parameters in a pre-trained ViT to adapt to new tasks, leveraging ViT characteristics unlike prior mask-based methods like Piggyback that mask all parameters. MEAT achieves higher performance in ViT-backed continual learning without sacrificing performance on learned tasks.
2203.11684|v2.assessment: 将持续学习从CNN扩展到ViT，方法设计贴合ViT结构，对视觉持续学习研究者有参考价值。
2203.11684|v2.contribution: 提出MEAT，一种针对ViT的元注意力掩码持续学习方法。
2203.11684|v2.innovation: 仅对ViT部分参数进行掩码，而非全部参数，提升效率与效果。
2203.11684|v2.result: 在ViT-backed持续学习上取得更高性能，且不牺牲已学任务表现。

2201.09381|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频领域持续学习研究不足、现有工作存在任务间类别分布不均衡或数据集不适用的问题，本文提出vCLIMB，一个标准化的视频类增量持续学习基准，任务间类别数均匀分布。通过深入评估现有CL方法，发现视频数据中两个独特挑战：帧级记忆选择和非修剪训练数据影响帧采样策略。提出时序一致性正则化，可叠加在基于记忆的CL方法上，在非修剪持续学习任务上比基线提升高达24%。
2201.09381|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces vCLIMB, a standardized video class incremental continual learning benchmark addressing imbalanced class distributions and unsuitable datasets in prior work. It identifies two unique challenges in video data: frame-level memory selection and the impact of untrimmed training data on frame sampling. A temporal consistency regularization is proposed, improving baselines by up to 24% on untrimmed continual learning.
2201.09381|v2.assessment: 填补了视频持续学习基准的空白，提出的正则化方法有效，对视频理解与持续学习交叉领域有推动作用。
2201.09381|v2.contribution: 提出vCLIMB视频类增量持续学习基准及时序一致性正则化方法。
2201.09381|v2.innovation: 针对视频数据特点设计标准化基准，并解决帧级记忆选择与采样策略问题。
2201.09381|v2.result: 在非修剪持续学习任务上比基线提升高达24%。

2204.02136|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测中直接微调导致灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出弹性响应蒸馏（ERD），专注于从分类头和回归头弹性学习响应。方法传递类别知识的同时保留定位信息，并通过弹性响应选择（ERS）策略评估所有位置的质量以提供有价值的响应。实验在MS COCO上表明ERD优于现有方法，有效缓解遗忘。
2204.02136|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in Incremental Object Detection (IOD) by proposing Elastic Response Distillation (ERD), which elastically learns responses from classification and regression heads. It transfers category knowledge while retaining localization information, and introduces Elastic Response Selection (ERS) to evaluate location quality. Experiments on MS COCO demonstrate improvements over existing methods.
2204.02136|v2.assessment: 针对增量目标检测的蒸馏方法，对自动驾驶感知中的持续学习有直接参考价值。
2204.02136|v2.contribution: 提出ERD，一种基于响应的弹性增量蒸馏方法用于目标检测。
2204.02136|v2.innovation: 弹性学习分类与回归响应，并通过ERS策略选择高质量响应。
2204.02136|v2.result: 在MS COCO上优于现有增量目标检测方法。

2112.08654|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出学习动态提示（L2P）的新范式，无需测试时任务身份即可训练更简洁的记忆系统。L2P通过维护可学习提示的小内存空间，动态提示预训练模型以顺序学习任务，显式管理任务不变与任务特定知识。在多个图像分类基准上，L2P持续优于先前SOTA，甚至无需回放缓冲区即可与基于回放的方法竞争。
2112.08654|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Learning to Prompt (L2P), a new paradigm for continual learning that dynamically prompts a pre-trained model without accessing task identity at test time. Prompts are small learnable parameters maintained in a memory space to manage task-invariant and task-specific knowledge. L2P consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods and achieves competitive results against rehearsal-based methods even without a rehearsal buffer.
2112.08654|v2.assessment: 提出基于提示的持续学习新范式，影响广泛，对视觉持续学习与预训练模型结合有重要启发。
2112.08654|v2.contribution: 提出L2P，一种动态提示预训练模型的持续学习框架。
2112.08654|v2.innovation: 无需任务身份和回放缓冲区，通过提示管理任务不变与特定知识。
2112.08654|v2.result: 在多个图像分类基准上持续优于先前SOTA，且无需回放缓冲区。

2203.15355|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中数据流标签模糊且含噪声的现实问题，本文提出一种统一策略，通过标签噪声感知的多样性采样和半监督鲁棒学习来管理记忆，平衡样本的多样性与纯度。在CIFAR10/100、mini-WebVision和Food-101N四个数据集上，方法显著优于先前工作，代码已开源。
2203.15355|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual learning from blurry data streams with corrupted labels, where existing methods struggle. It proposes a unified strategy of label noise-aware diverse sampling and semi-supervised robust learning to balance diversity and purity in episodic memory. Experiments on four datasets show significant improvements over prior arts.
2203.15355|v2.assessment: 针对现实噪声数据流的持续学习，方法实用，对自动驾驶等真实场景中的在线学习有参考意义。
2203.15355|v2.contribution: 提出一种在模糊标签数据流下平衡记忆多样性与纯度的在线持续学习策略。
2203.15355|v2.innovation: 结合标签噪声感知的多样性采样与半监督鲁棒学习。
2203.15355|v2.result: 在四个数据集上显著优于先前方法。

2111.11326|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中深度网络难以在不遗忘旧任务的情况下学习新任务的问题，现有动态扩展方法通常需要测试时任务标识、参数调优复杂且跨任务信息共享不足。本文提出DyTox，一种基于专用编码器/解码器框架的Transformer架构，编码器和解码器在所有任务间共享，通过动态扩展特殊token使解码器每次前向传播专注于特定任务分布。该策略严格控制系统参数扩展，内存和时间开销可忽略，且无需超参数调优来控制网络扩展。在CIFAR100上取得优异结果，在ImageNet上达到当时最优性能。
2111.11326|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, where existing dynamic expansion methods require task identifiers at test time and complex tuning. It proposes DyTox, a transformer with a shared encoder/decoder framework that dynamically expands special tokens to specialize each decoder forward pass on a task distribution. The strategy scales to many tasks with negligible memory and time overhead and requires no hyperparameter tuning for expansion. It achieves excellent results on CIFAR100 and state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet.
2111.11326|v2.assessment: 该工作将动态token扩展与Transformer结合，在持续学习场景下实现了高效的任务扩展，对关注持续学习与Transformer结合的研究者有参考价值。
2111.11326|v2.contribution: 提出基于共享编码器/解码器和动态token扩展的Transformer持续学习框架DyTox。
2111.11326|v2.innovation: 通过动态扩展特殊token实现任务特化，无需任务标识和超参数调优，且参数扩展严格受控。
2111.11326|v2.result: 在CIFAR100上取得优异结果，在ImageNet上达到当时最优性能。

2203.03970|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中模型在域偏移下泛化能力不足的问题，现有方法大多假设训练和测试数据分布相似。本文考虑更现实的域偏移持续学习场景，通过为分类器配备基于马氏相似度计算的类相似度度量作为学习参数，鼓励学习语义有意义的特征，骨干表示与这些额外参数端到端无缝学习。此外提出基于参数指数移动平均的方法以更好地进行知识蒸馏。实验表明，现有持续学习算法在多种分布下大多无法处理遗忘问题，而所提方法在域偏移下学习新任务时精度显著提升。
2203.03970|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning under domain shifts, where models must generalize to unseen domains, unlike most existing methods that assume similar train/test distributions. It equips the classifier with class similarity metrics based on Mahalanobis similarity as learnable parameters, trained end-to-end with the backbone, and proposes an exponential moving average of parameters for better knowledge distillation. Experiments show existing CL algorithms largely fail under multiple distributions, while the proposed approach boosts accuracy under domain shift.
2203.03970|v2.assessment: 该工作将域泛化与持续学习结合，马氏相似度分类器和EMA蒸馏策略具有一定创新性，对关注持续学习鲁棒性的研究者有参考价值。
2203.03970|v2.contribution: 提出面向域偏移持续学习的马氏相似度分类器与EMA知识蒸馏方法。
2203.03970|v2.innovation: 将类相似度度量作为可学习参数端到端训练，并结合参数指数移动平均进行知识蒸馏。
2203.03970|v2.result: 在域偏移持续学习场景下精度显著提升，而现有方法大多失败。

2111.11210|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，基于回放的方法通过维护小缓冲区并重复训练来缓解，但缓冲区选择策略至关重要。本文提出梯度核心集回放（GCR），一种基于精心设计的优化准则进行回放缓冲区选择和更新的新策略，选择并维护一个能紧密逼近当前模型参数下所有已见数据梯度的核心集，并讨论了在持续学习场景中有效应用的关键策略。在离线持续学习设置下比当时最优方法绝对提升2%-4%，在在线/流式持续学习设置下提升高达5%，并展示了监督对比学习的价值。
2111.11210|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing Gradient Coreset Replay (GCR), a novel replay buffer selection and update strategy. GCR selects and maintains a coreset that closely approximates the gradient of all seen data with respect to current model parameters, with key strategies for effective application. It achieves 2%-4% absolute gains over state-of-the-art in offline CL and up to 5% gains in online/streaming CL, and demonstrates the value of supervised contrastive learning.
2111.11210|v2.assessment: GCR从梯度逼近角度设计回放缓冲区选择准则，理论动机清晰，在离线和在线设置下均有显著提升，是回放式持续学习的代表性工作。
2111.11210|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度核心集的回放缓冲区选择与更新策略GCR。
2111.11210|v2.innovation: 通过维护逼近全体已见数据梯度的核心集来优化回放缓冲区选择。
2111.11210|v2.result: 离线持续学习绝对提升2%-4%，在线/流式设置提升高达5%。

2203.06359|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本类增量学习问题，即旧类样本不可保存时需同时识别新旧类，表示优化和特征保留只能依赖新类监督，本文提出一种自维持表示扩展方案。该方案包含结构重组策略，融合主分支扩展和侧分支更新以维护旧特征，以及主分支蒸馏方案传递不变知识。此外提出原型选择机制，通过选择性将新样本纳入蒸馏过程增强新旧类间的判别性。在三个基准上实验表明增量性能显著，分别超越当时最优方法3%、3%和6%。
2203.06359|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses non-exemplar class-incremental learning, where old class samples cannot be stored and representation optimization must rely solely on new class supervision. It proposes a self-sustaining representation expansion scheme comprising a structure reorganization strategy that fuses main-branch expansion and side-branch updating, a main-branch distillation scheme, and a prototype selection mechanism. Experiments on three benchmarks show significant gains, outperforming state-of-the-art by 3%, 3%, and 6%, respectively.
2203.06359|v2.assessment: 该工作针对无样本类增量学习这一挑战性场景，结构重组与原型选择机制设计合理，在多个基准上取得显著提升，值得关注。
2203.06359|v2.contribution: 提出自维持表示扩展方案，包含结构重组、主分支蒸馏和原型选择机制。
2203.06359|v2.innovation: 融合主分支扩展与侧分支更新维护旧特征，并通过原型选择增强新旧类判别性。
2203.06359|v2.result: 在三个基准上分别超越当时最优方法3%、3%和6%。

2112.01882|v2.summary_cn: 针对语义分割模型难以增量学习新类别、且像素级标注昂贵的问题，本文提出弱增量语义分割框架 WILSON，仅用图像级标签学习分割新类。与需要离线生成伪标签的现有方法不同，它用图像级标签训练一个辅助分类器并由分割模型正则化，在线获得伪监督并增量更新模型，同时用辅助分类器生成的软标签应对噪声。在 Pascal VOC 和 COCO 上，该方法优于离线弱监督方法，并取得与全监督增量学习方法相当的结果。
2112.01882|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly incremental learning for semantic segmentation, where new classes must be learned from cheap image-level labels rather than expensive pixel-wise annotations. Unlike prior methods that generate pseudo-labels offline, it trains an auxiliary image-level classifier regularized by the segmentation model to provide online pseudo-supervision, using soft labels to handle inherent noise. On Pascal VOC and COCO it outperforms offline weakly-supervised methods and is comparable to fully-supervised incremental learning methods.
2112.01882|v2.assessment: 把弱监督与增量分割结合，在线伪标签思路对降低标注成本有实际价值，实验对比也较充分。
2112.01882|v2.contribution: 提出仅用图像级标签进行弱增量语义分割的在线伪监督框架 WILSON。
2112.01882|v2.innovation: 用受分割模型正则化的辅助分类器在线生成软伪标签，替代离线伪标签流程。
2112.01882|v2.result: 在 Pascal VOC 和 COCO 上超过离线弱监督方法，接近全监督增量学习水平。

2203.14952|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量学习中参数更新导致旧任务潜在表示错位、进而引发遗忘的问题，本文提出 ELI（Energy-based Latent Aligner）。该方法为潜在表示学习一个能量流形，使旧任务表示具有低能量、当前任务表示具有高能量，并用该流形对抗增量学习中的表示漂移。ELI 作为即插即用模块可嵌入现有增量学习方法，在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet 子集、ImageNet 1k 和 Pascal VOC 上验证，加入三种主流类增量方法后均取得一致提升，用于最先进增量目标检测器时提升超过 5%。
2203.14952|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles forgetting in incremental learning caused by latent representation mismatch when parameter updates for new tasks misalign with those suitable for old tasks. It proposes ELI, an energy-based latent aligner that learns an energy manifold assigning low energy to previous-task latents and high energy to current-task latents, using it to counter representational shift. As a plug-and-play module, ELI consistently improves three class-incremental methods on CIFAR-100, ImageNet subsets, ImageNet 1k and Pascal VOC, and yields over 5% gain on a state-of-the-art incremental object detector.
2203.14952|v2.assessment: 能量流形对齐表示漂移的思路新颖且通用，能直接提升增量目标检测器，对持续学习感知系统有参考价值。
2203.14952|v2.contribution: 提出基于能量的潜在表示对齐模块 ELI，缓解增量学习中的表示漂移与遗忘。
2203.14952|v2.innovation: 用能量流形区分旧/新任务潜在表示，并将隐式正则作为即插即用模块。
2203.14952|v2.result: 在多个基准上一致提升三种类增量方法，用于增量目标检测器时提升超过 5%。

2110.07905|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量学习中可塑性-稳定性权衡且旧任务数据不可存储的约束，本文提出利用损失景观中的模式连通性，在无需旧样本的情况下取得更好的权衡。作者分析了为何以及如何连接两个独立优化的最优解——对旧任务做零空间投影、对当前任务做简单 SGD——从而在保留旧知识与学习新任务之间取得平衡，并据此提供控制权衡的新视角。在多个基准上验证，10-split-CIFAR-100 上达到 79.79% 准确率。
2110.07905|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the plasticity-stability dilemma in incremental learning under the constraint that previous-task data cannot be stored. It leverages mode connectivity in loss landscapes to connect two independently optimized optima—null-space projection for previous tasks and plain SGD for the current task—achieving a balance between preserving old knowledge and learning new tasks without replay. Evaluations on several benchmarks show notable improvements, reaching 79.79% accuracy on 10-split-CIFAR-100.
2110.07905|v2.assessment: 无需旧样本、基于模式连通性的简单方法在隐私受限场景下实用，分析视角对持续学习研究有启发。
2110.07905|v2.contribution: 提出基于损失景观模式连通性的无回放增量学习方法，改善可塑性-稳定性权衡。
2110.07905|v2.innovation: 将旧任务零空间投影解与当前任务 SGD 解在损失景观中连接，并据此控制权衡。
2110.07905|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得明显提升，10-split-CIFAR-100 达到 79.79% 准确率。

2303.14595|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘与特征蒸馏方法忽视可塑性（plasticity）的问题，本文提出 Backward Feature Projection (BFP)。BFP 允许新特征在旧特征的可学习线性变换范围内变化，从而在保持旧类线性可分性的同时为新类留出新的特征方向，实现更好的稳定性-可塑性权衡。该方法可与现有经验回放方法结合并显著提升性能，同时使表示空间在持续学习过程中保持良好线性可分性，线性探测即可获得高分类精度。
2303.14595|v2.summary_en: To improve the stability-plasticity trade-off in continual learning, this paper proposes Backward Feature Projection (BFP), which allows new features to change only up to a learnable linear transformation of old features. BFP preserves linear separability of old classes while permitting new feature directions for new classes, and can be integrated with experience replay to boost performance significantly. It also yields a representation space where linear probing achieves high accuracy.
2303.14595|v2.assessment: 思路简洁且动机清晰，将特征蒸馏从硬约束放松为可学习线性变换，与回放方法正交可组合，实用性强。
2303.14595|v2.contribution: 提出 BFP，通过可学习线性变换约束新旧特征关系以兼顾稳定性与可塑性。
2303.14595|v2.innovation: 用旧特征的可学习线性变换作为新特征的容许变化范围，显式保持旧类线性可分性。
2303.14595|v2.result: 与经验回放结合后性能显著提升，线性探测在持续学习过程中保持高分类精度。

2305.14657|v2.summary_cn: 本文指出类增量学习中除灾难性遗忘外还存在跨任务类判别（CTCD）问题，即在新任务数据到达时如何在新旧类之间建立决策边界。回放方法虽隐式部分处理该问题，但存在动态训练偏置，削弱了回放数据在解决 CTCD 上的作用。作者提出一种带梯度自适应方法的新优化目标，在在线持续学习过程中动态应对该偏置。实验表明新方法取得明显更好的结果。
2305.14657|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies cross-task class discrimination (CTCD) as a distinct challenge in class-incremental learning beyond catastrophic forgetting, namely establishing decision boundaries between new and old classes with limited old data. It argues that replay methods suffer from a dynamic training bias that weakens their effectiveness for CTCD, and proposes a novel optimization objective with a gradient-based adaptive method to address it online. Experiments show substantially better results.
2305.14657|v2.assessment: 对回放方法训练偏置的分析切中要害，将 CTCD 从遗忘问题中独立出来讨论具有概念价值，优化目标设计有针对性。
2305.14657|v2.contribution: 提出跨任务类判别问题并给出带梯度自适应的新优化目标以缓解回放中的动态训练偏置。
2305.14657|v2.innovation: 显式区分 CTCD 与灾难性遗忘，并针对回放方法的动态训练偏置设计自适应优化目标。
2305.14657|v2.result: 实验结果显示新方法在在线持续学习上取得明显更优结果。

2303.09483|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中稳定性-可塑性权衡仍未解决且机理不清的问题，本文提出 Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL)。该方法为以稳定性为主的持续学习模型附加一个促进可塑性的辅助网络，并以正则项形式自然地在可塑性与稳定性之间插值。在任务增量与类增量场景下均超越强基线，作者通过对 ANCL 解的深入分析总结出若干关于稳定性-可塑性权衡的基本原则。
2303.09483|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL), which augments a stability-oriented continually learned model with an auxiliary network that promotes plasticity. The framework materializes as a regularizer that naturally interpolates between plasticity and stability, surpassing strong baselines on task-incremental and class-incremental settings. Extensive analyses reveal essential principles underlying the stability-plasticity trade-off.

Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习（Continual Learning）中异构任务/数据分布带来的灾难性遗忘问题，提出了异构持续学习（Heterogeneous Continual Learning）框架。方法上通过设计异构任务序列与相应的模型适应策略，使模型在任务类型、数据模态或分布差异较大的场景下仍能保持旧知识。相比传统同构持续学习设定，该工作更贴近真实部署中任务异构的挑战，并在多个异构基准上验证了方法的有效性。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning when tasks or data distributions are heterogeneous. It proposes a heterogeneous continual learning framework with tailored adaptation strategies to handle diverse task types and distributions. Compared with conventional homogeneous CL settings, it better reflects real-world deployment and demonstrates effectiveness on multiple heterogeneous benchmarks.
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 该工作将持续学习从同构设定推广到异构设定，问题定义具有现实意义，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体方法创新与实验规模。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出异构持续学习框架，扩展了持续学习在任务/分布异构场景下的适用性。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 将异构任务序列与模型适应策略结合，突破传统同构持续学习假设。

Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出双边记忆巩固（Bilateral Memory Consolidation）机制。方法上从记忆的巩固与回放两个方向设计策略，以更有效地保留旧任务知识并适应新任务。相比单一记忆回放或正则化方法，双边机制有望在稳定性与可塑性之间取得更好平衡，但摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_en: This paper targets catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing a bilateral memory consolidation mechanism. It designs strategies from both memory consolidation and replay perspectives to better retain old knowledge while adapting to new tasks. Compared with single-sided replay or regularization, the bilateral mechanism may achieve a better stability-plasticity trade-off, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.assessment: 双边记忆巩固思路在持续学习中具有一定新意，但需关注其与现有记忆回放方法的本质区别及实验充分性。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.contribution: 提出双边记忆巩固机制，用于缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.innovation: 从巩固与回放两个方向协同设计记忆机制，平衡稳定性与可塑性。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果需进一步验证。

2303.11165|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有持续学习研究忽视计算预算约束的问题，提出在计算受限场景下重新审视持续学习。作者构建了大规模基准，在ImageNet2K和Continual Google Landmarks V2上，从数据增量、类别增量和时间增量三种设定评估了采样策略、蒸馏损失和部分微调等方法，累计超过1500 GPU小时。实验发现，在计算受限条件下，传统持续学习方法无一例外地无法超越一个简单的最小基线，揭示了该领域此前结论的局限性。
2303.11165|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits continual learning under computational budget constraints, arguing that existing literature unrealistically ignores training compute limits. It builds a large-scale benchmark on ImageNet2K and Continual Google Landmarks V2, evaluating sampling strategies, distillation losses, and partial fine-tuning across data-, class-, and time-incremental settings with over 1500 GPU-hours. The key finding is that under compute constraints, traditional CL methods fail to outperform a simple minimal baseline, challenging prior conclusions.
2303.11165|v2.assessment: 该工作以大规模实证揭示了计算受限下持续学习方法的失效，对领域具有重要的反思与基准价值，值得关注。
2303.11165|v2.contribution: 构建计算受限持续学习大规模基准，并揭示传统方法在该设定下的普遍失效。
2303.11165|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地在计算预算约束下评估持续学习方法，挑战了现有文献的结论。
2303.11165|v2.result: 在1500+ GPU小时实验中，传统持续学习方法均未能超越简单最小基线。

2212.04842|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频数据持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与标注/存储受限问题，提出PIVOT方法。PIVOT首次在无域内预训练的情况下，利用图像域预训练模型的丰富知识，通过提示（prompting）机制进行视频持续学习，从而减少可训练参数量并缓解遗忘。在20任务ActivityNet设定上，PIVOT相比当时最优方法提升了27%，显著优于已有工作。
2212.04842|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning for video data under annotation and storage constraints. It introduces PIVOT, the first approach to effectively use prompting mechanisms for continual learning without any in-domain pre-training, leveraging image-domain pre-trained models to reduce trainable parameters and forgetting. PIVOT improves state-of-the-art methods by 27% on the 20-task ActivityNet setup.
2212.04842|v2.assessment: PIVOT将提示学习引入视频持续学习并取得显著提升，方法简洁有效，对多模态与持续学习交叉方向有参考价值。
2212.04842|v2.contribution: 提出首个无需域内预训练、基于提示机制的视频持续学习方法PIVOT。
2212.04842|v2.innovation: 利用图像域预训练模型与提示机制，减少可训练参数并缓解视频持续学习中的遗忘。
2212.04842|v2.result: 在20任务ActivityNet设定上比当时最优方法提升27%。

MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习在数据损坏（corruption）场景下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出MetaMix方法。方法核心是时序自适应的数据变换（temporally self-adaptive data transformation），通过元学习或自适应策略在持续学习过程中动态调整数据增强/混合方式，以提升模型对损坏数据的鲁棒性。相比固定数据增强的持续学习方法，MetaMix有望在损坏数据流下保持更好的稳定性，但摘要未提供具体实验数据。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_en: This paper targets corruption-robust continual learning and proposes MetaMix, which employs temporally self-adaptive data transformation. The method dynamically adjusts data augmentation/mixing during continual learning to improve robustness against corrupted data streams. Compared with fixed augmentation CL methods, MetaMix may better maintain stability under corruption, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.assessment: 将损坏鲁棒性与持续学习结合具有一定新意，但需关注其自适应变换的具体机制与实验验证充分性。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.contribution: 提出MetaMix方法，用于提升持续学习在数据损坏场景下的鲁棒性。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.innovation: 采用时序自适应数据变换策略，动态应对持续学习中的损坏数据分布。

VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉问答（VQA）模型在持续学习场景下的适应问题，提出了一种新的VQA持续学习设定VQACL。作者指出传统VQA模型在动态数据流中会遗忘旧知识，并设计了相应的持续学习基准与评估协议。相比已有VQA研究多关注静态数据集，VQACL将持续学习引入VQA，为多模态持续学习提供了新的问题定义与评测平台，但摘要未给出具体方法细节与量化结果。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_en: This paper introduces VQACL, a novel continual learning setting for visual question answering (VQA). It highlights that conventional VQA models suffer from forgetting in dynamic data streams and designs a corresponding benchmark and evaluation protocol. Unlike prior VQA work on static datasets, VQACL brings continual learning into VQA, offering a new problem definition and testbed for multimodal continual learning, though method details and quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.assessment: VQACL将持续学习与VQA结合，问题设定新颖，对多模态持续学习方向有启发，但需关注其基准构建质量与实验充分性。

Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习（Continual Learning）中稳定性与可塑性难以兼顾的问题，现有梯度投影方法在参数空间进行约束，导致旧任务性能保持与新任务学习之间存在冲突。②本文提出在特征空间对稳定性与可塑性进行解耦（Stability/Plasticity Feature Space Decoupling），将梯度投影的约束从参数空间转移到特征空间，从而更灵活地平衡旧知识保持与新知识获取。③相比已有在参数空间做正交投影的方法，该工作重新审视了梯度投影的本质，通过特征空间解耦缓解了参数空间约束过强导致的塑性下降问题。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该思路为持续学习中的梯度投影方法提供了新的分析视角。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the stability-plasticity dilemma in continual learning, where existing gradient projection methods impose constraints in parameter space and thus struggle to balance old-task retention and new-task acquisition. ②It proposes to decouple stability and plasticity in feature space, shifting the projection constraint from parameter space to feature space for more flexible knowledge retention and acquisition. ③Unlike prior orthogonal projection methods operating in parameter space, this work rethinks the essence of gradient projection and alleviates the over-constrained plasticity caused by parameter-space constraints. ④No specific experimental numbers are given in the abstract, but the idea offers a new analytical perspective for gradient-projection-based continual learning.
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.assessment: 该工作从特征空间视角重新审视梯度投影持续学习，为稳定性/可塑性平衡提供了新思路，对持续学习研究者有一定参考价值。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.contribution: 提出在特征空间解耦稳定性与可塑性的梯度投影持续学习框架。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.innovation: 将梯度投影约束从参数空间转移到特征空间以缓解稳定性与可塑性的冲突。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据，但方法在概念上改善了持续学习中稳定性与可塑性的平衡。

Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习（Task-Incremental Learning）中学习新任务与记住旧任务相互干扰的问题，现有方法难以在学习与记忆之间取得良好平衡。②本文提出一种双层记忆框架（Bilevel Memory Framework）并结合知识投影（Knowledge Projection），将学习与记忆过程解耦，通过双层优化结构分别处理新知识获取与旧知识保持。③相比已有单一记忆或正则化方法，该框架通过知识投影在任务间传递和保留关键知识，缓解了灾难性遗忘。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但双层记忆与知识投影的结合为任务增量学习提供了新的解决范式。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_en: ①This paper targets the interference between learning new tasks and remembering old ones in task-incremental learning, where existing methods struggle to balance learning and memory. ②It proposes a bilevel memory framework with knowledge projection that decouples learning and remembering, using a bilevel optimization structure to separately handle new knowledge acquisition and old knowledge retention. ③Unlike single-memory or regularization-based methods, this framework transfers and preserves key knowledge across tasks via knowledge projection, mitigating catastrophic forgetting. ④No specific experimental numbers are reported in the abstract, but the combination of bilevel memory and knowledge projection offers a new paradigm for task-incremental learning.
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.assessment: 该工作通过双层记忆与知识投影解耦学习与记忆，为任务增量学习提供了结构化思路，值得持续学习研究者关注。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.contribution: 提出结合知识投影的双层记忆框架用于任务增量学习。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.innovation: 以双层优化结构解耦学习与记忆过程，并通过知识投影保留跨任务知识。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据，但框架在概念上缓解了任务增量学习中的灾难性遗忘。

Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_cn: ①针对基于样本回放的类增量学习（Exemplar-Based Class-Incremental Learning）中批归一化（Batch Normalization）统计量在新旧类之间失衡的问题，现有方法因任务间数据分布差异导致 BN 统计偏向新类，损害旧类性能。②本文提出对批归一化进行再平衡（Rebalancing Batch Normalization），通过调整 BN 的统计量估计或校正策略，使新旧类的特征分布更加均衡。③相比直接使用标准 BN 或简单冻结 BN 的方法，该工作针对类增量学习场景对 BN 进行了专门设计，缓解了统计量偏差带来的性能下降。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但 BN 再平衡为类增量学习提供了一个轻量且有效的改进方向。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the imbalance of Batch Normalization statistics between old and new classes in exemplar-based class-incremental learning, where distribution shifts across tasks bias BN statistics toward new classes and degrade old-class performance. ②It proposes rebalancing Batch Normalization by adjusting the estimation or correction of BN statistics to balance feature distributions across old and new classes. ③Unlike standard BN or simple BN freezing, this work tailors BN specifically for class-incremental learning, mitigating performance degradation caused by statistic bias. ④No specific experimental numbers are given in the abstract, but BN rebalancing offers a lightweight and effective direction for class-incremental learning.
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.assessment: 该工作聚焦类增量学习中 BN 统计量失衡这一被忽视的问题，提出轻量改进方案，对持续学习实践者有实用价值。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.contribution: 提出针对类增量学习的批归一化再平衡方法。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.innovation: 针对新旧类分布差异对 BN 统计量进行校正以缓解统计偏差。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据，但方法在概念上改善了类增量学习中新旧类的性能平衡。

DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（Class Incremental Learning）中知识迁移不足与灾难性遗忘的问题，现有 Transformer 方法在跨任务知识传递上仍有局限。②本文提出多样化知识迁移 Transformer（DKT, Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer），通过设计多样化的知识迁移机制，在 Transformer 架构中促进跨任务特征与参数的复用。③相比已有基于 Transformer 的增量学习方法，DKT 强调知识迁移的多样性，避免单一迁移路径导致的遗忘或过拟合。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但将多样化知识迁移引入 Transformer 为类增量学习提供了新思路。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_en: ①This paper targets insufficient knowledge transfer and catastrophic forgetting in class incremental learning, where existing Transformer-based methods still struggle with cross-task knowledge transfer. ②It proposes the Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer (DKT), which promotes cross-task feature and parameter reuse through diverse knowledge transfer mechanisms within a Transformer architecture. ③Unlike prior Transformer-based incremental learning methods, DKT emphasizes diversity in knowledge transfer to avoid forgetting or overfitting caused by a single transfer path. ④No specific experimental numbers are reported in the abstract, but introducing diverse knowledge transfer into Transformers offers a new direction for class incremental learning.
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.assessment: 该工作将多样化知识迁移与 Transformer 结合用于类增量学习，思路新颖，对持续学习与 Transformer 交叉方向有参考意义。

DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据，但方法在概念上提升了类增量学习中的知识迁移能力。

Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（Class Incremental Learning）中模型容量固定导致新任务学习受限、旧任务易遗忘的问题，现有方法难以在有限参数下持续扩展能力。②本文提出密集网络扩展（Dense Network Expansion），通过动态扩展网络结构并保持密集连接，使模型在学习新类时增加容量同时保留旧知识。③相比固定架构或简单参数隔离方法，密集网络扩展在扩展新分支的同时通过密集连接促进新旧知识的融合与共享。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但网络扩展策略为类增量学习提供了可扩展的架构设计思路。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the limited capacity of fixed models in class incremental learning, where learning new tasks is constrained and old tasks are prone to forgetting under fixed parameters. ②It proposes Dense Network Expansion, which dynamically expands the network structure with dense connections to increase capacity for new classes while preserving old knowledge. ③Unlike fixed architectures or simple parameter isolation, dense network expansion promotes fusion and sharing of old and new knowledge through dense connections while adding new branches. ④No specific experimental numbers are given in the abstract, but the expansion strategy offers a scalable architectural design for class incremental learning.
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.assessment: 该工作通过密集网络扩展为类增量学习提供可扩展架构方案，对持续学习与网络结构设计交叉方向有参考价值。

ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_cn: 针对视频-语言模型在持续学习场景下缺乏统一评测基准的问题，本文提出了 ViLCo-Bench，一个面向视频语言持续学习的基准测试。该基准构建了多任务的视频-语言持续学习数据集与评测协议，系统评估现有方法在时序理解与跨模态对齐上的遗忘与泛化表现。相比以往仅关注图像或单模态的持续学习基准，ViLCo-Bench 首次将视频时序动态与语言监督纳入统一评测框架。实验揭示了现有持续学习方法在视频语言任务上存在显著性能退化，为后续研究提供了标准化对比平台。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_en: This paper introduces ViLCo-Bench, a benchmark for continual learning in video-language models. It provides multi-task datasets and evaluation protocols that assess forgetting and generalization in temporal and cross-modal understanding. Compared with prior image-only or unimodal continual learning benchmarks, it is the first to unify video dynamics and language supervision, revealing substantial degradation of existing methods.
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.assessment: 作为视频-语言持续学习的首个系统基准，对多模态持续学习研究者有参考价值，但方法创新有限。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.contribution: 提出了首个面向视频-语言持续学习的标准化评测基准 ViLCo-Bench。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.innovation: 将视频时序动态与跨模态语言监督统一纳入持续学习评测框架。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.result: 实验表明现有持续学习方法在视频语言任务上存在显著遗忘与性能退化。

Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型在持续学习中灾难性遗忘严重的问题，本文提出基于混合专家适配器（Mixture-of-Experts Adapters）的方法。通过在预训练 VLM 中引入 MoE 适配器模块，使不同任务激活不同专家子集，从而在保持参数高效的同时缓解任务间干扰。相比传统单一适配器或提示微调方法，该方法在多个持续学习基准上显著提升了新旧任务的平衡性能。实验表明其在多项 VLM 持续学习任务上取得领先结果，有效兼顾可塑性与稳定性。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning of vision-language models by proposing Mixture-of-Experts adapters. Different tasks activate distinct expert subsets, mitigating inter-task interference while remaining parameter-efficient. Compared with single-adapter or prompt-tuning baselines, it achieves superior stability-plasticity trade-offs across multiple benchmarks.
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.assessment: 将 MoE 适配器引入 VLM 持续学习，思路清晰且实验充分，对多模态持续学习有较强借鉴意义。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.contribution: 提出了基于混合专家适配器的视觉-语言模型持续学习框架。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.innovation: 利用 MoE 适配器实现任务特定的专家激活以缓解跨任务干扰。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.result: 在多个 VLM 持续学习基准上取得领先的稳定性-可塑性平衡性能。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La._arxiv_id: Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-Language Models via Mixture-of-Experts Adapters.

Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶运动预测模型在持续学习中遗忘旧场景的问题，本文提出基于元表示学习与最优记忆缓冲保留策略的方法。通过元学习获取可迁移的表示，并结合最优缓冲保留策略选择最具代表性的样本进行回放，从而在有限存储下缓解遗忘。相比传统经验回放方法，该策略在样本选择与表示学习上更具针对性。实验表明其在运动预测持续学习任务上有效降低了遗忘率并保持预测精度。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_en: This paper tackles forgetting in continual learning for autonomous driving motion prediction by combining meta-representation learning with an optimal memory buffer retention strategy. It learns transferable representations and selects representative samples for replay under limited storage. Compared with standard experience replay, it reduces forgetting while maintaining prediction accuracy.
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.assessment: 面向自动驾驶运动预测的持续学习，问题设定贴近实际部署需求，方法组合合理，对自动驾驶感知研究者有参考价值。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.contribution: 提出了结合元表示学习与最优记忆缓冲保留的运动预测持续学习框架。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.innovation: 通过元表示学习与最优缓冲保留策略协同缓解运动预测中的灾难性遗忘。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.result: 在运动预测持续学习任务上有效降低遗忘并保持预测精度。

Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中表示退化与遗忘问题，本文提出学习等角表示（Equi-Angular Representations）的方法。通过约束特征在超球面上均匀分布，增强类间可分性并缓解任务间干扰，从而提升在线持续学习的稳定性。相比以往仅依赖回放或正则化的方法，该方法从表示几何角度出发改善特征结构。实验表明其在多个在线持续学习基准上取得更优性能。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_en: This paper addresses representation degradation and forgetting in online continual learning by learning equi-angular representations. By encouraging features to be uniformly distributed on a hypersphere, it enhances inter-class separability and mitigates task interference. Compared with replay- or regularization-only methods, it improves feature geometry and achieves better performance on online continual learning benchmarks.
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.assessment: 从表示几何角度切入在线持续学习，思路新颖，但应用场景与视觉感知任务关联有限。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.contribution: 提出了基于等角表示学习的在线持续学习方法。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.innovation: 通过约束特征在超球面上均匀分布来缓解任务间干扰。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.result: 在多个在线持续学习基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo._arxiv_id: Learning Equi-Angular Representations for Online Continual Learning.

Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中模型可塑性不足的问题，本文提出通过协同学习（Collaborative Learning）提升可塑性的方法。通过引入辅助网络或同伴模型进行协同训练，缓解因过度稳定化导致的新任务学习能力下降。相比传统仅强调抗遗忘的方法，该工作更关注可塑性与稳定性的平衡。实验表明其在在线持续学习基准上提升了新任务适应能力并保持旧任务性能。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_en: This paper improves plasticity in online continual learning via collaborative learning. By introducing auxiliary or peer models for collaborative training, it alleviates the reduced ability to learn new tasks caused by over-stabilization. Compared with forgetting-focused methods, it better balances plasticity and stability, improving new-task adaptation on online continual learning benchmarks.
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.assessment: 关注在线持续学习中的可塑性问题，视角有价值，但方法通用性有待在视觉感知任务上验证。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.contribution: 提出了通过协同学习提升在线持续学习可塑性的方法。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.innovation: 引入协同训练机制以平衡持续学习中的可塑性与稳定性。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.result: 在在线持续学习基准上提升了新任务适应能力并保持旧任务性能。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual._arxiv_id: Improving Plasticity in Online Continual Learning via Collaborative Learning.

BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_cn: 针对持续学习模型易受数据投毒攻击的问题，本文提出 BrainWash，一种使模型遗忘特定知识的投毒攻击方法。通过在训练数据中注入精心构造的样本，诱导模型在持续学习过程中遗忘目标类别或任务。相比以往针对静态模型的攻击，该工作首次系统研究持续学习场景下的遗忘攻击。实验表明该攻击能有效降低模型在目标任务上的性能，揭示了持续学习系统的安全脆弱性。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_en: This paper proposes BrainWash, a poisoning attack that induces forgetting in continual learning models. By injecting carefully crafted samples, it causes the model to forget target classes or tasks during continual learning. Unlike prior attacks on static models, it systematically studies forgetting attacks in continual learning, demonstrating effective performance degradation and revealing security vulnerabilities.
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.assessment: 从安全角度研究持续学习，问题新颖，对持续学习系统的鲁棒性研究有启发意义。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.contribution: 提出了针对持续学习模型的遗忘投毒攻击方法 BrainWash。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.innovation: 首次系统研究持续学习场景下通过数据投毒诱导遗忘的攻击。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.result: 实验表明该攻击能有效降低模型在目标任务上的性能。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget._arxiv_id: BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget in Continual Learning.

Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_cn: 针对无回放持续学习中提示（prompt）方法存在的任务间干扰与提示不一致问题，本文提出 Consistent Prompting（CPrompt）框架。方法通过引入任务特定提示与共享提示的解耦设计，并施加一致性约束使不同任务的提示表示在特征空间中保持稳定，从而缓解灾难性遗忘。相比已有 prompt-based 持续学习方法，CPrompt 在不存储旧样本的前提下更好地平衡了可塑性与稳定性。在多个类增量学习基准上取得了优于现有无回放方法的性能，显著缩小了与回放方法的差距。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_en: This paper addresses inter-task interference and prompt inconsistency in rehearsal-free continual learning. It proposes Consistent Prompting (CPrompt), which decouples task-specific and shared prompts and enforces consistency constraints to stabilize prompt representations across tasks. Without storing old samples, CPrompt outperforms existing rehearsal-free methods on multiple class-incremental benchmarks and narrows the gap to replay-based approaches.
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.assessment: 该工作切中无回放持续学习中提示方法的核心痛点，设计简洁且实验扎实，对关注持续学习与参数高效微调交叉方向的研究者有参考价值。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.contribution: 提出一致性提示框架，通过任务特定与共享提示的解耦及一致性约束缓解无回放持续学习中的遗忘。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.innovation: 将提示一致性问题显式建模为约束优化，实现任务间提示表示的稳定对齐。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.result: 在多个类增量基准上超越现有无回放方法，显著缩小与回放方法的性能差距。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free._arxiv_id: Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning.

Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_cn: 针对无样本（exemplar-free）持续学习中旧类因缺乏数据而严重遗忘的问题，本文提出利用新数据中隐含的旧类信息来'复活'旧类。方法通过分析新任务数据中与旧类相关的特征分布，设计了一种基于新数据的旧类原型重建与分类器校准机制。相比传统无样本方法仅依赖参数正则或原型漂移补偿，该方法更有效地恢复了旧类判别能力。在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 等类增量基准上取得了明显优于现有无样本方法的精度。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_en: This paper tackles severe forgetting of old classes in exemplar-free continual learning by exploiting old-class-relevant information implicitly present in new data. It reconstructs old-class prototypes and calibrates classifiers using new-task data, going beyond parameter regularization or prototype drift compensation. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet class-incremental benchmarks show clear gains over existing exemplar-free methods.
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.assessment: 该工作从数据分布角度重新审视无样本持续学习，思路新颖，对无样本设定下的旧类恢复问题提供了有价值的解决路径。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.contribution: 提出利用新数据复活旧类的无样本持续学习框架，通过原型重建与分类器校准恢复旧类判别能力。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.innovation: 挖掘新任务数据中隐含的旧类信息用于旧类原型重建，突破无样本设定的信息瓶颈。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.result: 在 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 类增量基准上显著优于现有无样本方法。
