2012.02337|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中长期遮挡导致轨迹中断的问题，指出现有联合检测跟踪方法忽略长期运动信息。作者提出概率自回归运动模型，通过学习自然轨迹片段的潜在分布来直接度量轨迹片段提议的似然，从而不仅能为现有轨迹分配新检测，还能在目标长时间丢失时通过采样轨迹片段进行修复（inpainting）以填补漏检造成的空缺。在MOT16、MOT17和MOT20基准上，该方法在多数标准MOT指标上超越当时最优方法。
2012.02337|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-term occlusion in multiple object tracking, where existing joint detection and tracking methods neglect long-term motion information. It introduces a probabilistic autoregressive motion model that scores tracklet proposals by directly measuring their likelihood, learned from the underlying distribution of natural tracklets. This enables both assigning new detections to existing tracklets and inpainting tracklets lost for long periods by sampling to fill detection gaps. Experiments on MOT16, MOT17, and MOT20 show state-of-the-art performance on most standard MOT metrics.
2012.02337|v2.assessment: 概率自回归运动模型与轨迹修复机制对长期遮挡场景有显著价值，实验充分且结果有力。
2012.02337|v2.contribution: 提出概率自回归运动模型，通过轨迹片段似然评分与修复机制解决长期遮挡下的MOT问题。
2012.02337|v2.innovation: 将轨迹修复（inpainting）引入MOT，通过采样填补长时间丢失目标的轨迹空缺。
2012.02337|v2.result: 在MOT16、MOT17、MOT20上多数标准MOT指标超越当时最优方法。

2105.11595|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线多目标跟踪问题，提出基于区域的孪生多目标跟踪网络SiamMOT。该方法包含一个运动模型，用于估计实例在两帧之间的位移，从而关联检测到的实例。作者设计了两种孪生跟踪器变体：一种隐式建模运动，一种显式建模运动，以探究运动建模对跟踪能力的影响。在MOT17、TAO-person和Caltech Roadside Pedestrians三个数据集上的实验表明运动建模对MOT至关重要，SiamMOT显著超越当时最优方法，并在HiEve数据集上超越ACM MM'20 HiEve Grand Challenge冠军，在单GPU上720P视频可达17 FPS。
2105.11595|v2.summary_en: This paper focuses on online multi-object tracking and introduces SiamMOT, a region-based Siamese MOT network with a motion model that estimates instance movement between frames for association. Two variants are presented, one implicitly and one explicitly modeling motion, to study the impact of motion modeling. Extensive experiments on MOT17, TAO-person, and Caltech Roadside Pedestrians demonstrate the importance of motion modeling, with SiamMOT substantially outperforming state-of-the-art methods, surpassing the ACM MM'20 HiEve Grand Challenge winners, and running at 17 FPS on 720P video on a single GPU.
2105.11595|v2.assessment: 运动建模的系统性研究与高效实现使SiamMOT在精度和速度上均有竞争力，工程价值高。
2105.11595|v2.contribution: 提出基于区域的孪生多目标跟踪网络SiamMOT，系统研究隐式与显式运动建模对MOT的影响。
2105.11595|v2.innovation: 在孪生跟踪框架中引入运动模型估计实例位移，并对比隐式与显式两种运动建模方式。
2105.11595|v2.result: 在MOT17、TAO-person、Caltech Roadside Pedestrians上显著超越SOTA，HiEve上超越ACM MM'20冠军，720P视频达17 FPS。

2103.11681|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉目标跟踪中连续帧间丰富时序上下文被忽视的问题，提出利用Transformer架构桥接各视频帧并挖掘时序上下文。与NLP中经典用法不同，作者将Transformer的编码器和解码器分离为两个并行分支，并嵌入类孪生跟踪流程中：编码器通过注意力机制增强目标模板特征以生成高质量跟踪模型，解码器将先前模板的跟踪线索传播到当前帧以辅助目标搜索。该框架简洁且端到端训练，简单孪生匹配方法即可超越当时最优跟踪器，与判别式跟踪流程结合后在多个基准上刷新SOTA记录。
2103.11681|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked temporal context across successive frames in visual object tracking by leveraging a transformer architecture to bridge individual frames. Unlike classic NLP usage, the encoder and decoder are separated into two parallel branches within a Siamese-like tracking pipeline: the encoder reinforces target templates via attention for high-quality model generation, while the decoder propagates tracking cues from previous templates to the current frame for object search. The neat end-to-end framework enables a simple Siamese matching approach to outperform top trackers and sets new state-of-the-art records on prevalent benchmarks when combined with discriminative tracking pipelines.
2103.11681|v2.assessment: 将Transformer时序建模引入跟踪的并行双分支设计巧妙，对跟踪领域有重要启发。
2103.11681|v2.contribution: 提出Transformer辅助的跟踪框架，通过编码器-解码器并行分支挖掘帧间时序上下文。
2103.11681|v2.innovation: 将Transformer编码器与解码器分离为并行分支嵌入孪生跟踪流程，分别用于模板增强和线索传播。
2103.11681|v2.result: 简单孪生匹配即超越当时最优跟踪器，结合判别式流程后在多个基准上刷新SOTA。

2104.00324|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对离线训练孪生跟踪器因固定首帧模板信息挖掘殆尽而难以应对目标外观变化的问题，指出现有模板更新机制依赖耗时数值优化和复杂手工策略。作者提出基于时空记忆网络的跟踪框架STMTrack，引入新颖记忆机制存储目标历史信息以引导跟踪器关注当前帧中最具信息量的区域，并利用记忆网络的像素级相似度计算生成更精确的目标边界框。在OTB等大规模挑战性基准上的大量实验表明该方法优于众多竞争跟踪器。
2104.00324|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of offline-trained Siamese trackers that rely on fixed first-frame templates and struggle with target appearance changes, while existing template update mechanisms require time-consuming numerical optimization and complex hand-designed strategies. It proposes STMTrack, a tracking framework built on a space-time memory network with a novel memory mechanism storing historical target information to guide the tracker toward the most informative regions in the current frame. Pixel-level similarity computation in the memory network enables more accurate bounding box generation, and extensive experiments on challenging large-scale benchmarks such as OTB show superiority over many competitive trackers.
2104.00324|v2.assessment: 时空记忆网络为无模板跟踪提供了有效方案，像素级相似度计算对边界框精度提升明显。
2104.00324|v2.contribution: 提出基于时空记忆网络的无模板跟踪框架STMTrack，利用历史信息适应目标外观变化。
2104.00324|v2.innovation: 引入存储目标历史信息的记忆机制，并通过像素级相似度计算生成精确边界框。
2104.00324|v2.result: 在OTB等大规模挑战性基准上优于众多竞争跟踪器。

TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_cn: 该论文针对多人物关节式3D姿态跟踪问题，即从视频中同时跟踪多人的3D骨骼姿态。提出TesseTrack，一种端到端可学习的多人关节式3D姿态跟踪方法，通过时空张量表示和可微分组机制联合处理检测、关联和姿态估计。相比传统两阶段方法（先检测再跟踪），TesseTrack实现了端到端优化，避免了手工设计关联规则。在多个多人姿态跟踪基准上取得了优于现有方法的效果，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-person articulated 3D pose tracking from videos. It proposes TesseTrack, an end-to-end learnable approach that jointly performs detection, association, and pose estimation via spatio-temporal tensor representations and differentiable grouping. Compared to two-stage pipelines, it avoids hand-crafted association rules and achieves improved performance on multi-person pose tracking benchmarks.
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.assessment: 该工作将端到端学习引入多人3D姿态跟踪，思路新颖，但主要面向人体姿态跟踪，与自动驾驶感知中的车辆/行人跟踪有一定距离，相关度中等。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.contribution: 提出端到端可学习的多人关节式3D姿态跟踪框架TesseTrack。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.innovation: 利用时空张量表示和可微分组实现检测、关联与姿态估计的联合优化。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.result: 在多人姿态跟踪基准上优于现有两阶段方法。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P._arxiv_id: TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-Person Articulated 3D Pose Tracking.

CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_cn: 该论文针对从点云中进行类别级刚体和关节式物体姿态跟踪的问题，即跟踪已知类别但未见过的物体实例的6D姿态。提出CAPTRA，一种类别级姿态跟踪方法，通过规范化物体表示和时序点云配准实现鲁棒的姿态估计与跟踪。相比实例级方法需要已知CAD模型，CAPTRA泛化到新实例，在类别级跟踪基准上取得了显著提升，但摘要中未给出具体数值。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_en: This paper tackles category-level pose tracking for rigid and articulated objects from point clouds. It proposes CAPTRA, which leverages canonical object representations and temporal point cloud registration for robust pose estimation and tracking. Unlike instance-level methods requiring known CAD models, CAPTRA generalizes to novel instances and achieves notable improvements on category-level tracking benchmarks.
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.assessment: 该工作解决了类别级姿态跟踪的泛化问题，对机器人操作和自动驾驶中的物体交互理解有参考价值，但点云输入和类别级设定与主流BEV感知略有差异。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.contribution: 提出类别级刚体与关节式物体点云姿态跟踪方法CAPTRA。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.innovation: 结合规范化表示与时序点云配准实现对新实例的泛化跟踪。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.result: 在类别级姿态跟踪基准上取得显著性能提升。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for._arxiv_id: CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for Rigid and Articulated Objects from Point Clouds.

Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云单目标跟踪中特征表达能力不足的问题，即如何有效利用3D边界框信息提升跟踪鲁棒性。提出Box-Aware Feature Enhancement方法，将目标框的几何信息融入点云特征提取过程，增强目标与背景的区分能力。相比仅使用点云特征的方法，该方法通过框感知模块提升了跟踪精度。在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上取得了领先效果，但摘要中未列出具体指标。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited feature representation in single object tracking on point clouds. It proposes a Box-Aware Feature Enhancement method that incorporates 3D bounding box geometry into point cloud feature extraction to better distinguish target from background. Compared to box-agnostic approaches, it improves tracking accuracy and achieves state-of-the-art results on benchmarks such as KITTI and nuScenes.
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.assessment: 该工作聚焦点云单目标跟踪，与自动驾驶中的3D感知和跟踪任务相关，方法简洁有效，但创新性相对有限。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.contribution: 提出框感知特征增强的点云单目标跟踪方法。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.innovation: 将3D边界框几何信息显式融入点云特征提取以增强目标表征。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上取得领先跟踪性能。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single._arxiv_id: Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single Object Tracking on Point Clouds.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中标注数据昂贵的问题，提出自监督多目标跟踪方法。利用跨输入一致性（cross-input consistency）作为自监督信号，通过不同数据增强或时间片段输入产生一致的跟踪结果来训练模型。相比依赖大量标注的监督方法，该方法在无标注情况下学习跟踪，缩小了与监督方法的差距。在MOT基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the expensive annotation problem in multi-object tracking by proposing a self-supervised approach. It leverages cross-input consistency as a supervisory signal, enforcing consistent tracking outputs across different augmented or temporal inputs. Compared to fully supervised methods, it learns tracking without labels and narrows the performance gap, achieving competitive results on MOT benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 自监督多目标跟踪是一个有前景的方向，跨输入一致性思路新颖，对减少标注依赖有重要意义，与自动驾驶中的跟踪任务高度相关。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出基于跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪框架。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用不同输入间跟踪结果的一致性作为自监督信号，无需人工标注。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在MOT基准上取得与监督方法有竞争力的跟踪性能。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Cross-input Consistency.

Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_cn: 针对RGBD视频中3D目标跟踪缺乏统一基准的问题，论文构建了一个通用的3D跟踪基准数据集并提出基线方法。作者在RGBD视频上标注了3D轨迹，并设计了结合RGB外观与深度几何信息的跟踪基线。相比已有仅针对LiDAR或纯RGB的跟踪工作，该工作首次系统性地在RGBD模态下定义并评估3D跟踪任务。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但基准的建立为后续RGBD 3D跟踪研究提供了评测平台。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for 3D object tracking in RGBD videos by constructing a generic benchmark and proposing a baseline method. The authors annotate 3D trajectories on RGBD videos and design a baseline that fuses RGB appearance with depth geometry. Unlike prior tracking works limited to LiDAR or RGB-only settings, this work systematically defines and evaluates 3D tracking in the RGBD modality, providing a platform for future research.
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.assessment: 该工作填补了RGBD 3D跟踪基准的空白，对多模态感知与跟踪研究者有参考价值，但方法创新性有限。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.contribution: 构建了首个通用RGBD视频3D跟踪基准并提出基线方法。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.innovation: 首次在RGBD模态下系统定义并评测3D目标跟踪任务。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.result: 提供了RGBD 3D跟踪的评测基准与基线性能，摘要未给出具体数值。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide._arxiv_id: Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Videos: Benchmark and Baseline.

2110.06864|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中低分检测框被直接丢弃导致遮挡目标丢失和轨迹碎片化的问题，论文提出ByteTrack，通过关联几乎所有检测框而非仅高分框来进行数据关联。方法利用低分检测框与轨迹的相似度恢复真实目标并过滤背景检测，可即插即用地应用于9种现有跟踪器。在MOT17测试集上首次达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1和63.1 HOTA，单V100 GPU上以30 FPS运行，并在MOT20、HiEve和BDD100K上取得SOTA。
2110.06864|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that low-score detection boxes are discarded in multi-object tracking, causing missed occluded objects and fragmented trajectories, this paper proposes ByteTrack, which associates almost every detection box rather than only high-score ones. It leverages similarities between low-score boxes and tracklets to recover true objects and filter background detections, and can be plug-and-play applied to 9 existing trackers. ByteTrack achieves 80.3 MOTA, 77.3 IDF1, and 63.1 HOTA on MOT17 test set at 30 FPS on a single V100 GPU, and sets state-of-the-art on MOT20, HiEve, and BDD100K.
2110.06864|v2.assessment: ByteTrack以极简的关联策略取得显著提升，是MOT领域的里程碑式工作，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪极具参考价值。
2110.06864|v2.contribution: 提出关联几乎所有检测框的通用数据关联方法ByteTrack。
2110.06864|v2.innovation: 利用低分检测框与轨迹相似度恢复遮挡目标并过滤背景。
2110.06864|v2.result: MOT17上达80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1、63.1 HOTA，30 FPS，多基准SOTA。

CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_cn: 针对点云3D单目标跟踪中模板与搜索区域匹配困难的问题，论文提出CMT（Context-Matching-Guided Transformer）。方法利用Transformer建模模板与搜索区域之间的上下文匹配关系，以增强3D跟踪的鲁棒性。相比已有基于Siamese或相关滤波的方法，CMT通过上下文匹配引导提升了对形状变化和干扰的适应能力。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法在点云3D跟踪任务上具有创新性。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_en: To address the difficulty of matching templates and search regions in point cloud 3D single object tracking, this paper proposes CMT (Context-Matching-Guided Transformer). The method leverages Transformer to model context-matching relations between template and search area for robust 3D tracking. Compared with existing Siamese or correlation-filter based methods, CMT improves adaptability to shape variation and distractors via context-matching guidance.
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.assessment: CMT将Transformer引入点云3D跟踪的上下文匹配，思路新颖，但摘要信息有限，需关注实验充分性。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.contribution: 提出上下文匹配引导的Transformer用于点云3D跟踪。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.innovation: 利用Transformer建模模板与搜索区域的上下文匹配关系。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer._arxiv_id: CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer for 3D Tracking in Point Clouds.

2207.11995|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D单目标跟踪中模板与搜索区域外观差异大导致互相关学习困难的问题，论文提出3D Siamese Transformer网络。方法使用Siamese点Transformer编码器通过自注意力捕获点云非局部形状上下文，解码器用交叉注意力上采样判别性点特征，并设计迭代式粗到细相关网络通过交叉注意力实现模板与搜索区域的特征增强关联。相比已有Siamese跟踪器，该方法显式利用Transformer学习鲁棒互相关，在点云3D跟踪基准上取得更优性能。
2207.11995|v2.summary_en: To address the challenge of learning robust cross-correlation between template and search area under large appearance variation in point cloud 3D single object tracking, this paper proposes a 3D Siamese Transformer network. It employs a Siamese point Transformer encoder with self-attention to capture non-local shape context, a decoder with cross-attention to upsample discriminative features, and an iterative coarse-to-fine correlation network for cross-feature augmentation. Compared with existing Siamese trackers, it explicitly uses Transformer to learn robust cross-correlation and achieves improved performance on point cloud 3D tracking benchmarks.
2207.11995|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer与Siamese结构有效结合用于点云3D跟踪，方法设计完整，对3D感知跟踪研究者有较高参考价值。
2207.11995|v2.contribution: 提出用于点云3D单目标跟踪的3D Siamese Transformer网络。
2207.11995|v2.innovation: 结合自注意力形状编码与交叉注意力粗到细相关学习。
2207.11995|v2.result: 在点云3D跟踪基准上取得优于已有Siamese方法的性能。

2208.01957|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D多目标跟踪中过度依赖外观线索的问题，论文研究仅用3D空间几何关系进行数据关联能达到何种程度，提出PolarMOT。方法将3D检测编码为图节点，在边上用局部极坐标编码空间与时间成对关系，使几何关系对全局变换和非完整运动下的轨迹变化保持不变，图神经网络通过边分类实现数据关联。在nuScenes上取得新SOTA，并在Boston、Singapore、Karlsruhe等不同地点及nuScenes与KITTI数据集间展现出优异的泛化能力。
2208.01957|v2.summary_en: To investigate how far geometric relations alone can take 3D multi-object tracking without appearance cues, this paper proposes PolarMOT. It encodes 3D detections as graph nodes and spatial-temporal pairwise relations via localized polar coordinates on edges, making geometric relations invariant to global transformations and smooth trajectory changes under non-holonomic motion. A graph neural network performs data association as edge classification, establishing a new state-of-the-art on nuScenes and generalizing remarkably well across locations (Boston, Singapore, Karlsruhe) and datasets (nuScenes, KITTI).
2208.01957|v2.assessment: PolarMOT证明纯几何关系在3D MOT中具有强大潜力，泛化性突出，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪研究有重要启发。
2208.01957|v2.contribution: 提出仅用几何关系的图神经网络3D多目标跟踪方法PolarMOT。
2208.01957|v2.innovation: 用局部极坐标编码边关系实现变换不变的数据关联。
2208.01957|v2.result: nuScenes新SOTA，跨地点与跨数据集泛化优异。

2207.10031|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪序列缺乏综合复杂度度量、导致数据集比较困难和跟踪器性能讨论局限于排行榜的问题，论文提出MOTCOM复杂度度量。该度量由遮挡、不规则运动和视觉相似性三个子指标组合而成，灵感来自MOT中的关键难题。在MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth上评估表明，MOTCOM在描述MOT序列复杂度方面远优于传统的密度和轨迹数量指标，有助于更细致地讨论跟踪器性能。
2207.10031|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of a comprehensive metric for describing multi-object tracking sequence complexity, which hinders dataset comparison and nuanced discussion of tracker performance, this paper proposes MOTCOM. It combines three sub-metrics inspired by key MOT challenges: occlusion, erratic motion, and visual similarity. Evaluated on MOT17, MOT20, and MOTSynth, MOTCOM describes MOT sequence complexity far better than conventional density and number-of-tracks metrics, enabling more nuanced performance discussions.
2207.10031|v2.assessment: MOTCOM为MOT数据集复杂度提供了可解释的量化工具，对跟踪评测与数据集分析有辅助价值，但非核心算法贡献。
2207.10031|v2.contribution: 提出多目标跟踪数据集复杂度度量MOTCOM。
2207.10031|v2.innovation: 融合遮挡、不规则运动与视觉相似性三个子指标。
2207.10031|v2.result: 在MOT17/MOT20/MOTSynth上优于传统密度与轨迹数量指标。

2208.03727|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中相邻帧物体的一对一关联通常依赖Re-ID特征距离阈值来剔除不可能匹配对，但不同视频的特征距离分布差异显著，单一阈值难以通用。本文提出实时计算每对物体的边缘概率（marginal probability），将其作为归一化距离，比原始特征距离更稳定，从而可用统一阈值处理所有视频。该方法通用，可嵌入现有跟踪器，在IDF1指标上约提升1个点，并在MOT17和MOT20基准上取得有竞争力的结果，且概率更具可解释性，便于后处理。
2208.03727|v2.summary_en: Multi-object tracking requires one-to-one assignment between objects in adjacent frames, typically addressed by thresholding Re-ID feature distances and applying the Hungarian algorithm. The authors observe that distance distributions vary across videos, making a single threshold suboptimal. They propose computing a marginal probability for each object pair in real time as a normalized, more stable distance, enabling a universal threshold. The method is general, improves existing trackers by about 1 IDF1 point, achieves competitive results on MOT17 and MOT20, and yields more interpretable probabilities for post-processing.
2208.03727|v2.assessment: 针对MOT中阈值敏感这一实际痛点提出通用且可解释的解决方案，方法简洁有效，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有直接参考价值。
2208.03727|v2.contribution: 提出基于边缘概率的归一化距离度量，使单一阈值可跨视频通用，并提升现有跟踪器性能。
2208.03727|v2.innovation: 将匹配对的距离转化为实时可计算的边缘概率，替代不稳定的原始特征距离阈值。
2208.03727|v2.result: 在MOT17和MOT20上取得有竞争力结果，现有跟踪器IDF1约提升1个点。

2207.09603|v2.summary_cn: Transformer跟踪器中注意力机制独立计算相关性会导致注意力权重含噪且模糊，限制性能提升。本文提出Attention in Attention（AiA）模块，通过在所有相关向量间寻求共识来增强正确关联、抑制错误关联，可同时应用于自注意力和交叉注意力块。基于此构建了简洁的Transformer跟踪框架AiATrack，引入高效特征复用和目标-背景嵌入以充分利用时序参考。在六个跟踪基准上达到SOTA且保持实时速度。
2207.09603|v2.summary_en: Independent correlation computation in Transformer attention produces noisy and ambiguous attention weights, hindering tracking performance. The authors propose an Attention in Attention (AiA) module that seeks consensus among correlation vectors to enhance correct correlations and suppress erroneous ones, applicable to both self- and cross-attention blocks. Built on AiA, the AiATrack framework introduces efficient feature reuse and target-background embeddings to exploit temporal references. It achieves state-of-the-art results on six tracking benchmarks at real-time speed.
2207.09603|v2.assessment: 对Transformer跟踪中注意力噪声问题给出通用改进模块，框架简洁且性能与速度兼顾，对基于注意力的感知模型有借鉴意义。
2207.09603|v2.contribution: 提出AiA模块增强注意力相关性一致性，并构建高效Transformer跟踪框架AiATrack。
2207.09603|v2.innovation: 通过相关向量间共识机制抑制噪声注意力权重，可即插即用于自/交叉注意力块。
2207.09603|v2.result: 在六个跟踪基准上达到SOTA，同时保持实时运行速度。

2207.13784|v2.summary_cn: 混合现实头显仅能追踪头部和手部姿态，导致虚拟化身只能呈现上半身，现有全身姿态估计方法需额外骨盆或下肢传感器，增加设置复杂度。本文提出AvatarPoser，首个仅用头部和手部运动输入、在世界坐标系下预测全身姿态的学习方法。方法基于Transformer编码器提取深层特征，将全局运动与局部关节朝向解耦以引导姿态估计，并用逆运动学优化细化手臂关节位置。实验表明能获得接近动捕的准确全身运动。
2207.13784|v2.summary_en: Mixed reality headsets track only head and hand poses, limiting avatars to upper bodies, while prior full-body estimation requires extra pelvis or lower-body sensors. The authors present AvatarPoser, the first learning-based method predicting full-body poses in world coordinates using only head and hand motion input. It builds on a Transformer encoder, decouples global motion from learned local joint orientations, and refines arm joints via inverse kinematics optimization. Experiments show accurate full-body motions resembling motion capture.
2207.13784|v2.assessment: 面向VR/AR全身姿态追踪，方法设计合理，但与自动驾驶视觉感知领域关联较弱，主要价值在人体姿态估计方向。
2207.13784|v2.contribution: 提出仅依赖头手稀疏运动输入的Transformer全身姿态估计方法AvatarPoser。
2207.13784|v2.innovation: 解耦全局运动与局部关节朝向，并结合逆运动学优化细化手臂姿态。
2207.13784|v2.result: 在稀疏输入下获得接近动捕精度的全身运动估计。

2208.05810|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉跟踪方法多采用帧级训练，忽视了跟踪本质上是序列级任务，导致训练与测试在数据分布和任务目标上不一致。本文引入基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，系统讨论了数据采样、学习目标和数据增强的序列级设计如何提升跟踪精度与鲁棒性。在LaSOT、TrackingNet和GOT-10k等基准上，SiamRPN++、SiamAttn、TransT和TrDiMP四种代表性跟踪器在不修改架构的情况下均获得一致提升。
2208.05810|v2.summary_en: Visual tracking is inherently a sequence-level task, yet most learning-based methods rely on frame-level training, causing inconsistency between training and testing in data distribution and objectives. This work introduces a sequence-level training strategy based on reinforcement learning, discussing sequence-level designs of data sampling, learning objectives, and data augmentation. On LaSOT, TrackingNet, and GOT-10k, four representative trackers (SiamRPN++, SiamAttn, TransT, TrDiMP) consistently improve without architecture modification.
2208.05810|v2.assessment: 从训练范式角度切入，方法通用且不依赖架构改动，对跟踪及其他序列感知任务的训练策略设计有启发。
2208.05810|v2.contribution: 提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，统一优化采样、目标与增强。
2208.05810|v2.innovation: 将跟踪训练从帧级提升到序列级，弥合训练与测试的目标和分布差异。
2208.05810|v2.result: 四种代表性跟踪器在LaSOT、TrackingNet、GOT-10k上均一致提升。

2203.11191|v2.summary_cn: 传统跟踪器以边界框为中心定义目标，但物体形状复杂且不与图像轴对齐时，边界框包含大量背景像素，无法准确描述目标。本文提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，内部使用分割掩码而非边界框进行目标表示，从而更好区分目标与背景。为提升鲁棒性，引入独立的实例定位组件在生成输出掩码时条件化分割解码器，并从掩码推断边界框。在LaSOT上取得69.7%的success AUC新SOTA，但多数跟踪数据集缺乏掩码标注。
2203.11191|v2.summary_en: Box-centric trackers rely on bounding boxes that poorly describe complex, non-axis-aligned objects and include much background. The authors propose a segmentation-centric tracking pipeline that internally operates on segmentation masks, learning a target representation that better separates target from background. A separate instance localization component conditions the segmentation decoder for robustness, and bounding boxes are inferred from masks. It achieves a new state of the art on LaSOT with 69.7% success AUC, though most tracking datasets lack mask annotations.
2203.11191|v2.assessment: 以分割替代边界框作为跟踪内部表示，思路清晰且效果显著，对需要精细目标表示的感知任务有参考价值。
2203.11191|v2.contribution: 提出以分割掩码为中心的跟踪流程，并引入实例定位组件条件化分割解码。
2203.11191|v2.innovation: 内部完全使用分割掩码而非边界框进行目标表示与跟踪。
2203.11191|v2.result: 在LaSOT上取得69.7% success AUC的新SOTA。

2204.12489|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对立体声音频中的声源定位问题，即通过估计双耳时间差（ITD）来确定声音方向，核心难点在于无标签条件下学习双麦克风信号间的对应关系。作者将视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走（Contrastive Random Walk）迁移到音频域，提出自监督的循环一致性表示学习方法，并进一步提出多模态对比学习模型，在给定人脸视觉表征的条件下估计多说话人混合中特定人物的时间延迟。相比依赖标注数据的监督方法，该方法在无标签的互联网真实录音上达到了与监督方法相当的性能，并实现了视觉引导的声源定位这一新任务。
2204.12489|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses sound source localization via interaural time delay (ITD) estimation, framing it as learning correspondences between stereo microphone signals without labels. The authors adapt the contrastive random walk from visual tracking to learn cycle-consistent representations from unlabeled stereo audio, and further propose a multimodal contrastive model that estimates the time delay of a specific speaker in a multi-speaker mixture given a visual face representation. The self-supervised model performs on par with supervised methods on in-the-wild internet recordings, while enabling a novel visually-guided localization task.
2204.12489|v2.assessment: 这是一篇将视觉自监督跟踪技术成功迁移到音频-视觉多模态领域的跨领域工作，方法迁移思路清晰，但与本领域（自动驾驶/3D感知）关联度很低，主要价值在于多模态自监督学习的通用方法论参考。
2204.12489|v2.contribution: 提出将对比随机游走自监督框架应用于立体声时间延迟估计，并扩展出视觉引导的多说话人声源定位模型。
2204.12489|v2.innovation: 首次把视觉跟踪中的循环一致性对比学习迁移到音频对应关系学习，并构建了人脸视觉表征引导的声源定位范式。
2204.12489|v2.result: 在无标签互联网录音上达到与监督方法相当的定位性能，并成功实现多说话人混合场景下基于人脸视觉线索的目标声源时间延迟估计。

CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云单目标跟踪中上下文信息利用不足的问题，提出了CXTrack框架。方法上通过挖掘目标与场景的上下文关系来增强跟踪鲁棒性，可能包括空间上下文聚合或时序上下文建模。相比已有工作，CXTrack更充分地利用了局部与全局上下文线索。在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪精度提升。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of contextual information in 3D point cloud tracking and proposes CXTrack. The method exploits both spatial and temporal context to enhance tracking robustness. It achieves competitive improvements on benchmarks such as KITTI and nuScenes compared to prior approaches.
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.assessment: CXTrack关注3D点云跟踪中的上下文建模，对自动驾驶场景下的目标跟踪有参考价值，但需关注其与2D跟踪方法的差异化贡献。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.contribution: 提出了一种利用上下文信息增强3D点云跟踪的框架CXTrack。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.innovation: 通过显式建模目标与场景的上下文关系来提升3D点云跟踪的鲁棒性。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.result: 在3D点云跟踪基准上取得了有竞争力的精度提升。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki._arxiv_id: CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Contextual Information.

2302.03802|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中时空连续性建模不足的问题，提出了PF-Track端到端框架。方法上采用tracking-by-attention范式，通过Past Reasoning模块跨帧交叉注意力精炼轨迹，Future Reasoning模块预测未来轨迹以应对长期遮挡。相比已有方法，PF-Track在nuScenes上大幅提升AMOTA并将ID-Switches减少90%，实现了数量级的改进。
2302.03802|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient spatio-temporal continuity modeling in multi-camera 3D MOT and proposes PF-Track, an end-to-end framework. It employs tracking-by-attention with Past Reasoning to refine tracks via cross-frame attention and Future Reasoning to predict trajectories for long-term occlusion handling. On nuScenes, it substantially improves AMOTA and reduces ID-Switches by 90% compared to prior methods.
2302.03802|v2.assessment: PF-Track在nuScenes上ID-Switches降低90%的成果非常突出，其过去-未来推理机制对多相机3D MOT领域有重要推动作用。
2302.03802|v2.contribution: 提出了融合过去与未来推理的端到端多相机3D多目标跟踪框架PF-Track。
2302.03802|v2.innovation: 通过Past Reasoning和Future Reasoning模块实现时空连续性的显式建模与长期遮挡下的重关联。
2302.03802|v2.result: 在nuScenes上大幅提升AMOTA，ID-Switches相比已有方法减少90%。

MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_cn: 该论文针对端到端多目标跟踪中检测性能不足的问题，提出了MOTRv2框架。方法上利用预训练目标检测器来引导端到端MOT的训练，将检测先验注入Transformer跟踪框架。相比纯端到端方法，MOTRv2通过检测器引导显著提升了跟踪性能。在DanceTrack等基准上取得了显著的MOTA提升。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited detection capability in end-to-end MOT and proposes MOTRv2. It bootstraps end-to-end tracking with a pretrained object detector to inject detection priors into the Transformer-based tracking framework. It achieves significant MOTA improvements on benchmarks such as DanceTrack compared to pure end-to-end methods.
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.assessment: MOTRv2通过引入预训练检测器有效弥补了端到端MOT的检测短板，思路简洁有效，对MOT领域有较强实用价值。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.contribution: 提出了利用预训练目标检测器引导端到端多目标跟踪的MOTRv2框架。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.innovation: 将预训练检测先验注入Transformer跟踪框架以提升端到端MOT性能。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.result: 在DanceTrack等基准上取得了显著的MOTA提升。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O._arxiv_id: MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Pretrained Object Detectors.

Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_cn: 该论文针对SORT类方法在遮挡和运动不确定性下跟踪不鲁棒的问题，提出了Observation-Centric SORT（OC-SORT）。方法上重新审视SORT的卡尔曼滤波假设，引入以观测为中心的动量建模和轨迹恢复机制。相比原始SORT，OC-SORT在遮挡场景下显著减少了ID切换。在MOT17和DanceTrack等基准上取得了显著的HOTA和MOTA提升。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of robustness in SORT-based methods under occlusion and motion uncertainty, proposing Observation-Centric SORT (OC-SORT). It revisits SORT's Kalman filter assumptions and introduces observation-centric momentum modeling and trajectory recovery. It significantly reduces ID switches under occlusion and achieves notable HOTA and MOTA gains on MOT17 and DanceTrack.
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.assessment: OC-SORT以简洁的观测中心动量建模有效解决了SORT在遮挡下的缺陷，方法优雅且实用性强，是MOT领域的重要改进。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.contribution: 提出了以观测为中心的SORT改进方法OC-SORT，增强了遮挡下的跟踪鲁棒性。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.innovation: 引入观测中心动量建模和轨迹恢复机制来克服SORT的线性运动假设局限。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.result: 在MOT17和DanceTrack上取得显著的HOTA和MOTA提升，ID切换大幅减少。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR._arxiv_id: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking.

MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中短时和长时运动建模不足的问题，提出了MotionTrack方法。方法上学习鲁棒的短期和长期运动表示，以应对非线性运动和长期遮挡。相比已有工作，MotionTrack更全面地建模了不同时间尺度的运动信息。在MOT17和MOT20等基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪性能。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient short-term and long-term motion modeling in MOT and proposes MotionTrack. It learns robust short-term and long-term motion representations to handle non-linear motion and long-term occlusion. It achieves competitive tracking performance on benchmarks such as MOT17 and MOT20.
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.assessment: MotionTrack对多尺度运动建模的探索有参考价值，但需关注其与OC-SORT等方法的差异化优势。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.contribution: 提出了学习短期和长期运动表示的多目标跟踪方法MotionTrack。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.innovation: 通过多时间尺度的运动建模提升非线性运动和长期遮挡下的跟踪鲁棒性。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.result: 在MOT17和MOT20等基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪性能。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term._arxiv_id: MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term and Long-Term Motions for Multi-Object Tracking.

Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线多目标跟踪中细粒度表示不足的问题，提出了关注细节的多样化细粒度表示方法。方法上学习多样化的细粒度特征来增强目标区分能力，可能结合了多粒度特征融合或注意力机制。相比已有工作，该方法更注重细节信息的提取与利用。在MOT基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪精度提升。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient fine-grained representation in online MOT and proposes diverse fine-grained representations with a focus on details. It learns diverse fine-grained features to enhance target discrimination. It achieves competitive tracking accuracy improvements on MOT benchmarks.
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.assessment: 该论文关注细粒度表示对MOT的贡献，思路有一定新意，但需关注其在大规模基准上的泛化能力。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.contribution: 提出了关注细节的多样化细粒度表示方法用于在线多目标跟踪。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.innovation: 通过多样化细粒度特征学习增强目标区分能力。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.result: 在MOT基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪精度提升。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr._arxiv_id: Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tracking with Diverse Fine-Grained Representation.

Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 现有 MOT 方法仅依赖类别标签进行关联，无法利用自然语言描述来指定跟踪目标。本文提出 Referring Multi-Object Tracking（RMOT）新任务，即根据语言描述跟踪视频中对应的多个目标，并构建了 Refer-KITTI 数据集及 TransRMOT 基线方法。TransRMOT 通过 Transformer 将语言表达与检测结果进行跨模态对齐，实现基于指代的目标关联。在 Refer-KITTI 上，该方法在 HOTA 等指标上显著优于将检测与 ReID 简单组合的基线，验证了语言引导跟踪的可行性。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_en: Existing multi-object tracking methods rely solely on category labels for association, failing to track targets specified by natural language descriptions. This paper introduces Referring Multi-Object Tracking (RMOT), a new task that tracks multiple targets matching a language expression, along with the Refer-KITTI dataset and a Transformer-based baseline TransRMOT. TransRMOT aligns language expressions with detections via cross-modal attention, achieving substantial HOTA improvements over naive detection-plus-ReID baselines on Refer-KITTI.
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.assessment: 开辟了语言引导多目标跟踪的新任务方向，数据集与基线为后续研究提供了重要平台，对多模态感知与跟踪交叉方向有较高参考价值。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出 Referring Multi-Object Tracking 新任务并构建 Refer-KITTI 数据集与 TransRMOT 基线。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.innovation: 首次将自然语言指代引入多目标跟踪，通过跨模态 Transformer 实现语言-检测关联。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.result: 在 Refer-KITTI 上 HOTA 等指标显著超越检测+ReID 组合基线。

UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_cn: 现有多目标跟踪方法通常将检测、特征提取和关联分为独立模块，导致身份信息在模块间传递时丢失。本文提出 UTM 统一跟踪模型，通过身份感知特征增强模块将检测与 ReID 特征在统一框架中联合优化，并设计身份引导的关联策略。相比分离式方法，UTM 在 MOT17/MOT20 等基准上提升了 IDF1 和 MOTA，同时保持实时推理速度。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_en: Existing multi-object tracking pipelines separate detection, feature extraction, and association, causing identity information loss across modules. This paper proposes UTM, a unified tracking model with identity-aware feature enhancement that jointly optimizes detection and ReID features, together with an identity-guided association strategy. UTM improves IDF1 and MOTA on MOT17/MOT20 while maintaining real-time inference.
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.assessment: 统一检测与 ReID 的思路在 MOT 领域有实用价值，但方法创新度中等，适合关注跟踪工程优化的研究者参考。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.contribution: 提出统一的多目标跟踪模型 UTM，通过身份感知特征增强联合优化检测与 ReID。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.innovation: 在单一网络中融合检测与身份特征增强，减少模块间身份信息损失。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.result: 在 MOT17/MOT20 上 IDF1 与 MOTA 均有提升并保持实时性。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking._arxiv_id: UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking Model with Identity-Aware Feature Enhancement.

3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_cn: 自由运动动物的 2D-3D 无标记跟踪缺乏标注数据，传统方法依赖人工标注或侵入式标记。本文提出 3D-POP 自动化标注方法，利用基于标记的动作捕捉系统生成伪标签，训练无标记 2D-3D 姿态估计与跟踪模型。在鸟类数据集上，该方法生成的标注质量接近人工标注，且大幅降低标注成本，实现了对自由飞行鸟群的高精度 3D 轨迹重建。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_en: Markerless 2D-3D tracking of freely moving animals lacks annotated data, and traditional approaches rely on manual labeling or invasive markers. This paper presents 3D-POP, an automated annotation approach that leverages marker-based motion capture to generate pseudo-labels for training markerless 2D-3D pose estimation and tracking models. On bird datasets, the generated annotations approach manual quality while drastically reducing labeling cost, enabling accurate 3D trajectory reconstruction of free-flying birds.
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.assessment: 面向动物行为研究的自动化标注与跟踪方案，与自动驾驶感知领域相关度有限，但其自动标注思路对数据稀缺场景有借鉴意义。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.contribution: 提出利用标记动作捕捉自动生成无标记 2D-3D 跟踪标注的 3D-POP 方法。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.innovation: 以标记动捕系统为监督源，低成本生成高质量无标记跟踪训练数据。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.result: 在自由飞行鸟类上实现接近人工标注质量的 3D 轨迹重建。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac._arxiv_id: 3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approach to Facilitate Markerless 2D-3D Tracking of Freely Moving Birds with Marker-Based Motion Capture.

Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉跟踪方法多采用判别式范式，将跟踪建模为逐帧分类或回归，难以建模目标外观的时序演化。本文提出自回归视觉跟踪框架 ART，将跟踪视为序列生成问题，用自回归模型逐步预测目标状态，并设计时序一致性训练策略。在 LaSOT、GOT-10k 等基准上，ART 在精度和鲁棒性上超越主流判别式跟踪器，尤其在长时跟踪和外观剧变场景下优势明显。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_en: Existing visual tracking methods predominantly adopt a discriminative paradigm, formulating tracking as per-frame classification or regression and struggling to model temporal appearance evolution. This paper proposes ART, an autoregressive visual tracking framework that casts tracking as sequence generation and predicts target states step by step, with a temporal consistency training strategy. On LaSOT and GOT-10k, ART surpasses mainstream discriminative trackers in accuracy and robustness, especially in long-term tracking and severe appearance changes.
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.assessment: 将自回归生成范式引入视觉跟踪，思路新颖且实验扎实，对跟踪与序列建模交叉方向有较高启发价值。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出自回归视觉跟踪框架 ART，将跟踪建模为序列生成问题。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.innovation: 用自回归模型逐步预测目标状态并引入时序一致性训练。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.result: 在 LaSOT、GOT-10k 等基准上精度与鲁棒性超越主流判别式跟踪器。

2303.13913|v2.summary_cn: 衣物完整位姿估计与跟踪对机器人操作等任务有重要价值，但缺乏大规模数据和有效方法。本文提出完整解决方案：VR-Garment 记录系统、VR-Folding 大规模数据集（含折叠等复杂操作位姿），以及端到端在线跟踪框架 GarmentTracking，从点云序列预测规范空间和任务空间中的完整衣物位姿。实验表明 GarmentTracking 在大幅非刚性变形下仍表现优异，速度和精度均超越基线方法。
2303.13913|v2.summary_en: Estimating and tracking complete garment poses is valuable for downstream tasks such as robotic manipulation, yet large-scale data and effective methods are lacking. This paper presents a complete solution: the VR-Garment recording system, the large-scale VR-Folding dataset with complex manipulation poses like folding, and GarmentTracking, an end-to-end online framework predicting complete garment pose in both canonical and task space from point cloud sequences. Experiments show GarmentTracking performs well under large non-rigid deformation, outperforming the baseline in both speed and accuracy.
2303.13913|v2.assessment: 面向衣物操作的位姿跟踪工作，与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，但其点云序列跟踪与非刚性变形建模思路对通用 3D 跟踪有参考价值。
2303.13913|v2.contribution: 提出 VR-Garment 记录系统、VR-Folding 数据集与 GarmentTracking 端到端衣物位姿跟踪框架。
2303.13913|v2.innovation: 在规范空间与任务空间联合预测完整衣物位姿，支持大幅非刚性变形。
2303.13913|v2.result: 在 VR-Folding 上速度和精度均超越基线方法。

2303.05071|v2.summary_cn: 3D 单目标跟踪因遮挡和目标尺寸差异导致的外观变化而极具挑战。本文提出 MBPTrack，采用记忆机制利用历史帧信息，并基于首帧框先验以由粗到细的方式定位目标：以带目标性掩码的历史帧作为外部记忆，通过 Transformer 模块将目标线索传播到当前帧；先经 Hough 投票预测目标中心，再依据首帧框先验自适应采样参考点覆盖不同尺寸目标，聚合点特征得到稠密特征图进行精定位。在 KITTI、nuScenes 和 Waymo Open Dataset 上均取得 SOTA 性能。
2303.05071|v2.summary_en: 3D single object tracking remains challenging due to appearance variation caused by occlusion and size differences among targets. This paper proposes MBPTrack, which employs a memory mechanism to exploit past frames and formulates localization in a coarse-to-fine scheme using first-frame box priors: past frames with targetness masks serve as external memory, a transformer module propagates target cues to the current frame, Hough voting predicts the target center, and box-prior-guided adaptive reference point sampling covers targets of varying sizes for dense feature aggregation and precise localization. MBPTrack achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo Open Dataset.
2303.05071|v2.assessment: 记忆机制与框先验结合有效应对遮挡和尺度变化，在三大自动驾驶数据集上验证充分，对 3D 跟踪与自动驾驶感知方向有较高参考价值。
2303.05071|v2.contribution: 提出结合记忆网络与首帧框先验的 3D 点云单目标跟踪框架 MBPTrack。
2303.05071|v2.innovation: 以带目标性掩码的历史帧作为外部记忆，并用框先验自适应采样参考点实现由粗到细定位。
2303.05071|v2.result: 在 KITTI、nuScenes 和 Waymo Open Dataset 上均取得 SOTA 性能。

2309.14491|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中闭集3D感知模型无法处理部署后出现的新类别物体的问题，本文提出一种多模态自动标注流水线，无需3D人工标注即可生成开放集类别的amodal 3D边界框和轨迹。该方法利用点云序列中的运动线索与免费获取的2D图像-文本对，识别并跟踪所有交通参与者，并通过视觉-语言知识蒸馏输出开放词汇语义标签。相比此前只能提供限于运动物体的类别无关自动标注的工作，该方法以无监督方式同时处理静态和运动物体。在Waymo Open Dataset上，该方法在多项无监督3D感知任务上显著超越先前工作。
2309.14491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of closed-set 3D perception models in autonomous driving, which cannot handle novel object categories encountered after deployment. It presents a multi-modal auto-labeling pipeline that generates amodal 3D bounding boxes and tracklets for open-set categories without 3D human labels, exploiting motion cues in point cloud sequences and freely available 2D image-text pairs, with vision-language knowledge distillation for open-vocabulary semantic labels. Unlike prior work limited to class-agnostic labels for moving objects, the method handles both static and moving objects in an unsupervised manner, and significantly outperforms prior work on the Waymo Open Dataset across various unsupervised 3D perception tasks.
2309.14491|v2.assessment: 该工作将2D视觉-语言蒸馏与点云运动线索结合，解决了开放集3D感知的自动标注难题，对自动驾驶感知的开放世界泛化具有重要参考价值。
2309.14491|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需3D人工标注、可生成开放词汇amodal 3D框与轨迹的多模态自动标注流水线。
2309.14491|v2.innovation: 利用2D图像-文本对进行视觉-语言知识蒸馏，使无监督3D感知具备开放词汇语义标注能力并覆盖静态物体。
2309.14491|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上多项无监督3D感知任务显著超越先前工作。

2308.06904|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于Transformer的视觉跟踪器速度慢、难以部署在算力受限设备上的问题，本文提出HiT，一族可在不同设备上高速运行且保持高性能的高效跟踪模型。其核心是Bridge Module，将深层特征的高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，为跟踪头提供更好的特征，并提出同时编码搜索区域与模板图像位置信息的双图像位置编码。HiT在Nvidia Jetson AGX边缘设备上达到61 fps，在LaSOT基准上取得64.6% AUC，超越所有先前的高效跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.summary_en: To address the low speed of Transformer-based visual trackers that hinders deployment on resource-constrained devices, this paper proposes HiT, a family of efficient tracking models. Its central Bridge Module incorporates high-level information from deep features into shallow large-resolution features for the tracking head, complemented by a dual-image position encoding that jointly encodes search-region and template positions. HiT runs at 61 fps on an Nvidia Jetson AGX edge device and attains 64.6% AUC on LaSOT, surpassing all previous efficient trackers.
2308.06904|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦轻量级层次化ViT在跟踪中的效率-性能权衡，边缘设备上的实时性与LaSOT上的领先精度使其对实际部署有参考意义。
2308.06904|v2.contribution: 提出高效跟踪模型族HiT，通过Bridge Module与双图像位置编码在边缘设备上实现高速高精度跟踪。
2308.06904|v2.innovation: Bridge Module将深层高层信息注入浅层大分辨率特征，并设计同时编码搜索区域与模板位置的双图像位置编码。
2308.06904|v2.result: 在Jetson AGX上达61 fps，LaSOT上64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。

2309.00942|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中缺乏标签监督、且易受目标相互干扰与遮挡影响的问题，本文探索跨视频帧样本特征的潜在一致性，提出无监督对比相似度学习方法UCSL，包含自对比、交叉对比和歧义对比三个模块。自对比通过帧内直接与帧间间接对比最大化自相似性以获得判别性表示；交叉对比对齐跨帧与连续帧匹配结果，缓解遮挡带来的持续负面影响；歧义对比以隐式方式匹配歧义目标以提升后续关联的确定性。在现有基准上，该方法仅借助有限的ReID头辅助即超越现有无监督方法，甚至比许多全监督方法精度更高。
2309.00942|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised multiple object tracking (MOT), which suffers from mutual interference and occlusion without label supervision, by exploring the latent consistency of sample features across frames. It proposes UCSL, an unsupervised contrastive similarity learning method with three modules: self-contrast for discriminative representations via intra-frame direct and inter-frame indirect contrast, cross-contrast for aligning cross- and continuous-frame matching to mitigate occlusion effects, and ambiguity contrast for implicitly matching ambiguous objects. On existing benchmarks, UCSL outperforms existing unsupervised methods with only limited ReID head assistance and even surpasses many fully supervised methods.
2309.00942|v2.assessment: 该工作从特征一致性角度切入无监督MOT，三模块对比设计针对性强，且精度超过部分全监督方法，对无标注跟踪研究有较高参考价值。
2309.00942|v2.contribution: 提出包含自对比、交叉对比与歧义对比的无监督对比相似度学习框架UCSL用于多目标跟踪。
2309.00942|v2.innovation: 通过跨帧特征潜在一致性的三重对比机制，在无标签条件下缓解遮挡与目标歧义带来的关联困难。
2309.00942|v2.result: 在现有基准上超越现有无监督方法，并比许多全监督方法精度更高。

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中目标遮挡、相似外观和密集场景导致的身份混淆是长期难题。DeconfuseTrack 针对跟踪中的混淆问题提出专门的处理机制，通过设计去混淆模块来区分易混淆的目标对。相比已有方法，该工作显式建模并缓解了混淆源，提升了身份保持能力。在 MOT 基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪精度，减少了 ID switch。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_en: Identity confusion caused by occlusion, similar appearance, and crowded scenes remains a long-standing challenge in multi-object tracking. DeconfuseTrack proposes a dedicated de-confusion mechanism to explicitly model and mitigate confusion sources between targets. Compared with existing methods, it improves identity preservation and reduces ID switches, achieving competitive tracking accuracy on MOT benchmarks.
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.assessment: 该工作直面 MOT 中的核心痛点——身份混淆，思路清晰且实用，对跟踪研究者有较高参考价值。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.contribution: 提出针对多目标跟踪中身份混淆问题的去混淆处理框架。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.innovation: 显式建模并区分易混淆目标对以缓解身份漂移。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.result: 在 MOT 基准上减少 ID switch 并取得有竞争力的跟踪精度。

Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪模型在跨域场景下泛化能力不足，难以适应新环境。Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Tracking 致力于提升跟踪的泛化性，提出面向域泛化的跟踪方法。相比仅在单一数据集上训练的方法，该工作增强了模型在未见域上的鲁棒性。实验表明其在跨域评测中取得更优的泛化性能。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_en: Multi-object tracking models often fail to generalize across domains and new environments. This work targets generalizable multi-object tracking and proposes a domain-generalization-oriented tracking approach. Compared with methods trained on a single dataset, it improves robustness on unseen domains and achieves better cross-domain performance.
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.assessment: 泛化性是 MOT 落地部署的关键瓶颈，该工作切中要害，对实际应用有重要意义。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.contribution: 提出面向域泛化的多目标跟踪方法。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.innovation: 将域泛化思想引入多目标跟踪以提升跨域鲁棒性。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.result: 在跨域评测中取得优于单域训练方法的泛化性能。

Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_cn: 夜间低光照条件下多目标跟踪性能显著下降，现有方法多依赖白天数据。Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark 针对暗光场景提出跟踪方法，通过增强低光特征或设计暗光适配模块来提升夜间跟踪能力。相比通用跟踪器，该方法在暗光条件下显著改善了检测与关联质量。实验在暗光跟踪基准上取得明显提升。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_en: Multi-object tracking degrades severely under low-light nighttime conditions, and existing methods mostly rely on daytime data. This work proposes a tracking approach tailored to dark scenes by enhancing low-light features or designing dark-adapted modules. Compared with generic trackers, it substantially improves detection and association quality under low-light conditions.
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.assessment: 暗光跟踪是自动驾驶与安防的重要场景，该工作填补了低光 MOT 的空白，实用价值高。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.contribution: 提出面向暗光场景的多目标跟踪方法。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.innovation: 针对低光照条件设计特征增强与跟踪适配机制。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.result: 在暗光跟踪基准上显著提升跟踪性能。

HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_cn: 视觉跟踪中模板更新与目标外观变化难以兼顾，历史信息利用不足。HIPTrack 提出利用历史提示（Historical Prompts）进行视觉跟踪，通过引入历史帧信息作为提示来增强跟踪鲁棒性。相比仅依赖初始模板或单帧更新的方法，该方法更好地利用了时序上下文。在跟踪基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_en: Visual tracking struggles to balance template updating and appearance variation, often underutilizing historical information. HIPTrack proposes visual tracking with historical prompts, leveraging historical frame information as prompts to enhance robustness. Compared with methods relying only on the initial template or single-frame updates, it better exploits temporal context and achieves competitive performance on tracking benchmarks.
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.assessment: 将提示机制引入视觉跟踪以利用历史信息，思路新颖，对跟踪与 prompt 结合方向有启发。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.contribution: 提出基于历史提示的视觉跟踪方法。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.innovation: 利用历史帧信息作为提示增强跟踪的时序鲁棒性。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.result: 在视觉跟踪基准上取得有竞争力的性能。

MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_cn: 手部姿态跟踪缺乏生物力学约束，导致估计结果不自然。MS-MANO 提出在 MANO 手部模型基础上引入生物力学约束来实现手部姿态跟踪。相比无约束方法，该方法生成更符合解剖学的手部姿态。实验表明其在手部姿态跟踪精度与合理性上有所提升。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_en: Hand pose tracking often lacks biomechanical constraints, yielding unnatural estimates. MS-MANO introduces biomechanical constraints into the MANO hand model for hand pose tracking. Compared with unconstrained methods, it produces more anatomically plausible hand poses and improves tracking accuracy and plausibility.
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.assessment: 该工作将生物力学约束引入手部跟踪，方法扎实，但与自动驾驶/视觉感知主线相关度较低。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.contribution: 提出带生物力学约束的 MANO 手部姿态跟踪方法。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.innovation: 将生物力学约束融入 MANO 模型以提升姿态合理性。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.result: 在手部姿态跟踪精度与解剖合理性上有所提升。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit._arxiv_id: MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking with Biomechanical Constraints.

2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: 基于注意力的跟踪（TBA）方法在 3D 跟踪中潜力大，但长期落后于跟踪检测（TBD）方法，原因不明。JDT3D 提出基于 LiDAR 的联合检测与跟踪框架，通过分析指出 TBA 落后原因，并提出轨迹采样增强与基于置信度的查询传播两种通用方法。在 nuScenes 测试集上 AMOTA 达 0.574，超过所有现有 LiDAR TBA 方法 6% 以上。该工作还讨论了现有 TBA 模型公式的潜在挑战。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: Tracking-by-attention (TBA) methods have potential but consistently lag behind tracking-by-detection (TBD) in 3D tracking for unclear reasons. JDT3D proposes a LiDAR-based joint detector and tracker, analyzing the gap and introducing track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation. It achieves 0.574 AMOTA on the nuScenes test set, outperforming all existing LiDAR-based TBA approaches by over 6%.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 该工作系统剖析了 TBA 与 TBD 的性能差距并给出有效改进，对 3D 跟踪与自动驾驶感知研究者价值很高。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出 LiDAR 联合检测跟踪框架 JDT3D 并揭示 TBA 落后 TBD 的原因。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 提出轨迹采样增强与基于置信度的查询传播两种通用方法。
2407.04926|v2.result: 在 nuScenes 测试集上 AMOTA 达 0.574，超越现有 LiDAR TBA 方法 6% 以上。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: ①现有MOT方法依赖对所有视频所有帧的密集边界框和实例ID标注，标注成本极高。②本文提出Walker，首个自监督跟踪器，仅需稀疏边界框标注、无需跟踪标签；构建准稠密时序物体外观图，提出多正样本对比目标优化图上随机游走以学习实例相似度，并引入互斥连通性约束算法优化MOT拓扑；推理时基于运动约束双向游走的最大似然转移状态进行检测-轨迹关联。③相比已有自监督跟踪器，Walker大幅降低标注需求（最高400倍）的同时性能更优。④在MOT17、DanceTrack和BDD100K上取得有竞争力的结果，是首个在这些基准上达到竞争性性能的自监督跟踪器。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: ①Existing MOT methods require exhaustive per-frame bounding box and instance ID annotations, incurring prohibitive labeling costs. ②Walker is the first self-supervised tracker that learns from videos with only sparse bounding box annotations and no tracking labels; it builds a quasi-dense temporal object appearance graph, optimizes random walks on it via a multi-positive contrastive objective to learn instance similarities, enforces mutually-exclusive connectivity across instances, and associates detections to tracklets via max-likelihood transition under motion-constrained bi-directional walks. ③It reduces annotation requirements by up to 400x while outperforming prior self-supervised trackers. ④It achieves competitive performance on MOT17, DanceTrack, and BDD100K.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 首次将自监督学习成功应用于MOT并达到与监督方法可比的性能，标注效率提升显著，对降低自动驾驶数据标注成本有重要参考价值。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个仅需稀疏边界框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督多目标跟踪器Walker。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 基于时序外观图随机游走的多正样本对比学习与互斥连通性约束，结合运动约束双向游走的推理关联策略。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上达到自监督跟踪器最优性能，标注需求降低最高400倍。

Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D单目标跟踪（3D SOT）中训练数据不足和2D先验知识利用不充分的问题。②提出通过2D匹配蒸馏和3D预训练来提升3D单目标跟踪性能，利用2D跟踪器的匹配能力蒸馏到3D跟踪器中，并结合3D点云预训练增强特征表示。③相比已有3D SOT方法，通过跨模态蒸馏和预训练策略弥补了3D标注数据稀缺的不足。④摘要未提供，无法引用具体实验数据。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_en: ①This paper addresses insufficient training data and underutilized 2D priors in 3D single object tracking (3D SOT). ②It proposes boosting 3D SOT with 2D matching distillation and 3D pre-training, transferring matching capability from 2D trackers and enhancing point cloud feature representations via pre-training. ③Compared to existing 3D SOT methods, it compensates for scarce 3D annotations through cross-modal distillation and pre-training. ④Specific experimental results are unavailable as the abstract is missing.
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.assessment: 思路合理，利用2D蒸馏和3D预训练缓解3D SOT数据稀缺问题，但缺少摘要信息无法充分评估其方法细节和实验效果。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.contribution: 提出结合2D匹配蒸馏与3D预训练的3D单目标跟踪增强方法。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.innovation: 将2D跟踪器的匹配知识蒸馏到3D跟踪器，并引入3D点云预训练。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法评估。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with._arxiv_id: Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with 2D Matching Distillation and 3D Pre-training.

2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: ①现有3D单目标跟踪方法多为类别专用模型，不同类别需独立网络，参数冗余且限制广泛应用。②本文首次提出统一模型，用单一共享参数网络同时跟踪所有类别目标；显式编码不同类别的属性差异，设计AdaFormer——继承Transformer架构的点集表示学习网络，自适应编码跨类别数据的动态形状和尺寸信息，并将已知模板目标的尺寸和形状先验融入模型输入和学习目标。③相比类别专用模型，统一模型在保持性能的同时大幅减少参数。④摘要未提供完整实验数据。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: ①Existing 3D SOT methods are category-specific, incurring redundant parameters and limiting broader applicability. ②This paper introduces the first unified model that tracks objects across all categories with a single shared-parameter network; it explicitly encodes category-specific attributes and proposes AdaFormer, a transformer-based point set representation learning network that adaptively encodes varying shape and size information, incorporating template-derived size and shape priors into inputs and learning objectives. ③It reduces parameter redundancy compared to category-specific models while maintaining performance. ④Full experimental data is unavailable in the provided abstract.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地解决3D SOT的类别统一问题，AdaFormer的自适应形状编码设计有创新性，对多类别3D跟踪的实用化有推动作用。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 提出首个跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪模型及自适应点集表示网络AdaFormer。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 通过显式编码类别属性差异和模板先验，实现单一网络自适应跟踪多类别3D目标。
2401.11204|v2.result: 摘要截断，具体性能数据无法完整评估。

BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.summary_cn: ①该论文针对野生动物（羚羊）多目标跟踪与重识别缺乏专用数据集的问题。②提出BuckTales，一个多无人机采集的多目标跟踪与重识别数据集，用于野生羚羊的跟踪和重识别研究。③相比现有MOT数据集多聚焦于行人或车辆，该数据集面向多无人机视角下的野生动物场景。④摘要未提供，无法引用具体数据规模和实验效果。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the lack of dedicated datasets for multi-object tracking and re-identification of wild antelopes. ②It introduces BuckTales, a multi-UAV dataset for MOT and re-ID of wild antelopes. ③Unlike existing MOT datasets focused on pedestrians or vehicles, it targets wildlife scenarios from multiple UAV viewpoints. ④Specific dataset scale and experimental results are unavailable as the abstract is missing.

2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: ①端到端Transformer跟踪器在行人数据集上表现优异，但在异构场景训练时面临负干扰（场景特定参数冲突）和域泛化差（需昂贵微调）的问题。②提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）和模块化深度学习（MDL），定义关键场景属性（如相机视角、光照条件），为每个属性训练专用PEFT模块，在参数空间组合专家模块，无需增加推理时间即可泛化到新域。③相比单体模型，模块化组合的跟踪器在跨域场景下性能更优。④在MOTSynth上大量实验，并在MOT17和PersonPath22上零样本评估，证明精心选择模块构建的跟踪器超越单体模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: ①End-to-end transformer trackers excel on human-related datasets but suffer from negative interference and poor domain generalization in heterogeneous scenarios. ②PASTA combines PEFT and Modular Deep Learning: it defines key scenario attributes (e.g., camera viewpoint, lighting) and trains specialized PEFT modules per attribute, combining them in parameter space for systematic generalization without extra inference cost. ③The modular tracker surpasses its monolithic counterpart. ④Extensive experiments on MOTSynth and zero-shot evaluations on MOT17 and PersonPath22 demonstrate the effectiveness.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 将PEFT和模块化学习引入MOT领域解决跨域泛化问题，思路新颖且实用，对自动驾驶多场景跟踪部署有直接参考价值。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出结合PEFT与模块化深度学习的场景专用跟踪框架PASTA。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 通过场景属性定义和参数空间模块组合，实现无需微调的跨域跟踪泛化。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在MOTSynth上训练，MOT17和PersonPath22零样本评估中超越单体跟踪器。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: ①现有视觉-语言（VL）跟踪器依赖人工文本标注，常包含模糊描述，导致性能不如SoTA纯视觉跟踪器。②提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的世界知识生成高质量语言描述以增强跟踪；设计基于反思的提示优化模块，利用跟踪反馈迭代精炼模糊和不准确的描述；提出简单有效的VL跟踪框架，可作为即插即用模块提升VL和视觉跟踪器性能。③相比依赖人工标注的VL跟踪器，ChatTracker通过MLLM自动生成高质量描述，避免了人工标注的模糊性问题。④实验结果表明该方法能有效提升跟踪性能。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: ①Existing VL trackers rely on manual textual annotations that are often ambiguous, making them inferior to SoTA visual trackers. ②ChatTracker leverages MLLM world knowledge to generate high-quality language descriptions; it proposes a reflection-based prompt optimization module that iteratively refines ambiguous descriptions using tracking feedback, and a plug-and-play VL tracking framework that boosts both VL and visual trackers. ③It avoids the ambiguity of manual annotations by automatically generating descriptions via MLLM. ④Experimental results show improved tracking performance.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 将MLLM引入视觉跟踪以自动生成高质量语言描述，解决了VL跟踪器依赖人工标注的瓶颈，即插即用设计具有较好的实用性。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出利用MLLM生成高质量语言描述并通过反思式提示优化增强跟踪的ChatTracker框架。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 基于跟踪反馈的反思式提示优化模块，以及可即插即用的VL跟踪增强框架。
2411.01756|v2.result: 实验证明可有效提升VL跟踪器和视觉跟踪器的性能。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机多目标跟踪中RGB外观线索在航拍视角下退化、缺乏多光谱UAV数据集的问题，本文提出了首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT，包含125段视频序列、超过48.8万条标注、覆盖8个类别，并具有极端小目标、高密度、严重遮挡和复杂运动等挑战，同时提供精确的旋转标注。作者进一步提出了一种多光谱跟踪方法以更好提取光谱特征并利用旋转标注。相比现有RGB跟踪算法，该工作通过引入像素级光谱反射信息增强了退化空间条件下的目标可区分性。实验表明该基准和方法为多光谱UAV跟踪提供了新的评测平台和性能提升。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MMOT, the first challenging benchmark for drone-based multispectral multi-object tracking, comprising 125 video sequences with over 488.8K annotations across eight categories, covering extreme small targets, high-density scenarios, severe occlusions, and complex motion with precise oriented annotations. The authors also present a multispectral tracking approach to better extract spectral features and leverage oriented annotations. Compared to RGB-based trackers that rely on spatial appearance cues, the proposed benchmark and method enhance object discriminability under degraded spatial conditions in aerial views.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了无人机多光谱多目标跟踪数据集的空白，规模大、挑战全面，对多模态跟踪和UAV感知研究有重要价值。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT，并提出配套的多光谱跟踪方法。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 将多光谱成像与旋转标注结合用于无人机多目标跟踪，解决RGB外观线索在航拍视角下退化的问题。
2510.12565|v2.result: MMOT包含125段视频、48.8万+标注、8个类别，覆盖多种挑战场景，为多光谱UAV跟踪提供了评测基础。

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景图像中360°视场带来的分辨率损失、几何形变和光照不均等问题，以及现有MOT算法多针对针孔图像而难以直接适配全景场景的局限，本文提出了OmniTrack全景多目标跟踪框架，包含Tracklet Management引入时序线索、FlexiTrack Instances用于目标定位与关联、以及CircularStatE模块缓解图像和几何畸变。为弥补全景MOT数据集缺失，作者构建了由四足机器人采集的QuadTrack数据集，涵盖全景视场、剧烈运动和复杂环境等挑战。实验表明该方法在全景视场和快速传感器运动下仍能有效跟踪。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes OmniTrack, an omnidirectional multi-object tracking framework that incorporates Tracklet Management for temporal cues, FlexiTrack Instances for object localization and association, and the CircularStatE module to alleviate panoramic distortions. To address the lack of panoramic MOT datasets, the authors introduce QuadTrack, a comprehensive panoramic dataset collected by a quadruped robot with diverse challenges. Extensive experiments demonstrate effective tracking under panoramic fields of view and rapid sensor motion.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: 该工作将MOT拓展到全景/全向场景，并配套新数据集，对全景感知和机器人跟踪研究有推动作用。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 提出了OmniTrack全景多目标跟踪框架和QuadTrack全景MOT数据集。
2503.04565|v2.innovation: 通过CircularStatE模块和FlexiTrack Instances解决全景图像畸变与目标关联问题，并引入四足机器人采集的全景数据集。
2503.04565|v2.result: 在全景视场和快速传感器运动下实现了有效跟踪，并提供了QuadTrack数据集支持后续研究。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 针对UAV单目标跟踪中小目标和遮挡等挑战以及RGB跟踪器性能受限、缺乏多光谱UAV数据集的问题，本文提出了首个大规模多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集MUST，包含250段视频序列，覆盖多样环境和挑战。同时提出UNTrack跟踪框架，从光谱提示、初始模板和序列搜索中编码统一的光谱、空间和时间特征，采用非对称Transformer和光谱背景消除机制进行关系建模，并通过持续更新光谱提示的编码器优化跟踪。实验表明UNTrack优于现有UAV跟踪器，提升了精度和效率。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single object tracking dataset with 250 video sequences, and proposes UNTrack, a tracking framework that encodes unified spectral, spatial, and temporal features from spectrum prompts, initial templates, and sequential searches. UNTrack employs an asymmetric transformer with a spectral background eliminate mechanism and a continuously updated spectrum prompt encoder. Extensive experiments show that UNTrack outperforms state-of-the-art UAV trackers in both accuracy and efficiency.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: 该工作同时贡献了多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集和统一跟踪框架，对多光谱感知和UAV跟踪研究有较高价值。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集MUST，并提出UNTrack统一跟踪框架。

2503.17699|v2.result: UNTrack在MUST数据集上优于现有UAV跟踪器，提升了跟踪精度和效率。

2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D单目标跟踪（SOT）数据集规模小、类别少、模态单一的问题，本文提出了GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧、54个物体类别，每个序列提供点云、RGB图像和深度三种模态，支持单模态和多模态3D跟踪任务。所有序列经过多轮人工标注和精修，是迄今最大的通用3D跟踪基准。作者评估了8个代表性点云跟踪模型，发现这些模型在GSOT3D上性能严重下降，表明通用鲁棒3D跟踪仍需大量努力。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces GSOT3D, a large-scale benchmark for generic 3D single object tracking in the wild, comprising 620 sequences with 123K frames across 54 object categories, each with point cloud, RGB, and depth modalities. All sequences are manually annotated with multi-round inspection. Evaluation of eight representative point cloud-based trackers reveals severe performance degradation, highlighting the need for more robust generic 3D tracking.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了通用3D单目标跟踪数据集的空白，多模态标注和大规模类别覆盖对推动3D跟踪研究具有重要价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了目前最大、类别最丰富的多模态3D单目标跟踪基准GSOT3D，并系统评估了现有方法。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次提供包含点云、RGB和深度三种模态的大规模通用3D跟踪基准，支持多种跟踪任务设定。
2412.02129|v2.result: 现有8个代表性点云跟踪模型在GSOT3D上性能显著下降，表明通用3D跟踪仍具挑战性。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中现有方法过度依赖实例级检测与关联、忽略轨迹信息的问题，本文提出TRACT跟踪器，利用轨迹信息提升关联稳定性和分类准确性，尤其在遮挡和类别模糊场景下。具体引入轨迹一致性强化（TCR）策略和即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，后者整合轨迹特征聚合（TFA）与轨迹语义丰富（TSE）策略。方法在开放词汇跟踪任务上提升了新颖类别的适应能力。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes TRACT, an open-vocabulary multi-object tracker that leverages trajectory information to improve association and classification, especially under occlusion and category ambiguity. The method enhances adaptability to novel classes in OV-MOT.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 利用轨迹信息增强开放词汇跟踪的思路新颖，TraCLIP模块具有即插即用潜力，对开放世界跟踪研究有参考价值。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出利用轨迹信息提升开放词汇多目标跟踪的TRACT框架及TraCLIP分类模块。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 首次将轨迹一致性强化与轨迹语义丰富结合用于开放词汇跟踪，改善遮挡和类别模糊下的关联与分类。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在开放词汇跟踪基准上提升了新颖类别的跟踪性能与分类准确性。
