2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目跟踪器存在深度模糊和遮挡问题、现有多相机方法需要20个以上相机且需逐序列优化的问题，本文提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，使用实用数量的相机（如4个）直接预测3D对应关系，实现鲁棒在线跟踪。方法融合多视角特征为统一点云，采用k近邻关联和基于Transformer的更新来估计长程3D对应。在5K合成Kubric序列上训练，在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，可泛化到1-8个视角、24-150帧的视频。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker that tracks arbitrary points in dynamic scenes using a practical number of cameras (e.g., four), addressing depth ambiguity and occlusion issues in monocular trackers and the heavy camera requirements of prior multi-camera methods. It fuses multi-view features into a unified point cloud and applies k-NN correlation with a transformer-based update. It achieves median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on Panoptic Studio and DexYCB, respectively.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，在实用相机数量下实现鲁棒在线跟踪，对3D场景理解与跟踪研究有重要推动。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，使用少量相机实现鲁棒在线3D点跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 融合多视角特征为统一点云，结合k近邻关联与Transformer更新，在遮挡下实现长程3D对应估计。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，泛化到1-8视角、24-150帧。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态跟踪中传感器同步问题导致模态时间上不完整、现有跟踪器因刚性架构性能显著下降的问题，本文首次系统研究了时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪器性能。提出一种灵活的多模态跟踪框架，通过新颖的异构混合专家融合机制（自适应复杂度）和视频级掩码策略（确保时间一致性和空间完整性），使跟踪器根据缺失数据率动态激活计算单元。模型不仅能适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度调整。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study on tracker performance with temporally incomplete multimodal data, where existing trackers degrade significantly due to rigid architectures. It proposes a flexible multimodal tracking framework with a Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism of adaptive complexity and a video-level masking strategy ensuring temporal consistency and spatial completeness. The model adapts to varying missing rates and scene complexity.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 首次系统研究时间不完整多模态跟踪问题，提出的自适应混合专家框架对实际部署中的传感器缺失场景有重要价值。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 首次研究时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪问题，并提出自适应混合专家融合框架。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 异构混合专家融合机制结合视频级掩码策略，使跟踪器根据缺失率和场景复杂度动态调整计算。
2507.05899|v2.result: 模型能适应不同模态缺失率并随场景复杂度调整，显著缓解了现有跟踪器的性能下降。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联依赖手工启发式规则、难以端到端优化的问题，提出 LA-MOTR，将可学习的数据关联模块嵌入端到端 Transformer 跟踪框架。方法通过可微的关联预测替代传统匈牙利匹配中的固定代价，使检测、关联与轨迹更新联合优化。相比 MOTR 等端到端跟踪器，改进点在于关联策略可随数据自适应学习，减少对运动/外观代价权重的调参依赖。摘要未给出具体指标，但声称在 MOT 基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on hand-crafted heuristics for data association in multi-object tracking by proposing LA-MOTR, an end-to-end tracker with a learnable association module. The association prediction is made differentiable and jointly optimized with detection and track updates, replacing fixed cost weights in Hungarian matching. Compared with prior end-to-end trackers such as MOTR, it adapts association strategies from data and reduces manual tuning, though the abstract reports no specific benchmark numbers.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 端到端可学习关联是 MOT 的合理演进方向，但摘要信息有限，需看实验是否真正超越强基线。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习数据关联的端到端多目标跟踪框架 LA-MOTR。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 将关联代价预测变为可微模块并与检测、轨迹更新联合优化。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.result: 声称在 MOT 基准上取得有竞争力性能，摘要未给出具体数值。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin._arxiv_id: LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Learnable Association.

2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇 3D 实例分割（OV-3DIS）中现有概念彼此互补但未被有效整合的问题，提出一套两阶段方案：3D 提议生成与实例分类。方法用基于 3D 跟踪的提议聚合生成 3D 提议，并通过迭代合并/移除去除重叠与部分提议；分类阶段用 Alpha-CLIP 以对象掩码作为 alpha 通道获得对象中心表示，并引入标准化最大相似度（SMS）分数归一化文本-提议相似度以过滤误检。相比已有 OV-3DIS 方法，该方案系统整合并精炼了多个互补概念，在多个基准上达到新的 SOTA。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation (OV-3DIS) by systematically combining complementary existing concepts into a two-stage recipe: 3D proposal generation and instance classification. It employs tracking-based proposal aggregation with iterative merging/removal, replaces CLIP with Alpha-CLIP using object masks as an alpha channel for object-centric features, and introduces a standardized maximum similarity (SMS) score to normalize text-to-proposal similarity and suppress false positives. The resulting solution achieves new state-of-the-art results on OV-3DIS benchmarks.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 工程整合与细节打磨扎实，Alpha-CLIP 与 SMS 的设计对开放词汇 3D 感知有直接参考价值。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出整合并精炼多种互补概念的 SOTA 开放词汇 3D 实例分割方案。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 用 Alpha-CLIP 掩码通道与 SMS 相似度归一化提升对象中心表示与误检过滤。
2507.23134|v2.result: 在 OV-3DIS 基准上取得新的 SOTA 性能。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶动态城市场景建模与渲染中，高质量方法依赖昂贵人工轨迹标注、自监督方法又难以准确捕捉动态物体运动并正确分解场景的问题，提出 AD-GS 自监督框架。核心是可学习运动模型，将局部感知 B 样条曲线与全局感知三角函数结合，实现灵活且精确的动态物体建模；用简化伪 2D 分割自动划分物体与背景，以动态高斯和双向时序可见性掩码表示物体，并加入可见性推理与物理刚性正则。实验表明该无标注模型显著优于现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法具有竞争力。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high-quality free-viewpoint rendering of dynamic driving scenes without costly manual tracklet annotations, where self-supervised methods struggle with accurate motion and scene decomposition. AD-GS introduces a learnable motion model combining locality-aware B-spline curves with global-aware trigonometric functions, automatic pseudo 2D segmentation into objects and background, dynamic Gaussians with bidirectional temporal visibility masks, and visibility reasoning plus physical rigidity regularization. The annotation-free model significantly outperforms prior annotation-free methods and is competitive with annotation-dependent ones.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 将 B 样条与高斯泼溅结合做无标注动态场景建模，对自动驾驶仿真与数据合成有实用价值。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出无标注的自监督 B 样条高斯泼溅框架 AD-GS 用于驾驶场景自由视点渲染。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 局部 B 样条与全局三角函数的可学习运动模型，配合双向时序可见性掩码。
2507.12137|v2.result: 显著超越现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法性能相当。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中现有跟踪器受框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立、模态交互不足，导致开放词汇分类与跟踪性能受限的问题，提出 OVTR，首个同时建模运动、外观与类别的端到端开放词汇跟踪器。方法设计类别信息传播（CIP）策略，为后续帧建立高层类别先验；引入双分支结构增强泛化能力与深度多模态交互，并在解码器中加入保护性策略。实验表明其在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越此前跟踪器，同时推理更快、参数量显著减少。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: This paper targets open-vocabulary multiple object tracking, where existing trackers suffer from rigid architectures, isolated frame-level perception, and insufficient modality interaction. OVTR is the first end-to-end open-vocabulary tracker jointly modeling motion, appearance, and category, featuring a Category Information Propagation (CIP) strategy that builds high-level category priors for subsequent frames, a dual-branch structure for generalization and deep multimodal interaction, and protective strategies in the decoder. It surpasses prior trackers on the open-vocabulary MOT benchmark with faster inference and significantly fewer parameters.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 开放词汇跟踪是 MOT 前沿方向，端到端联合建模与类别传播策略设计合理，效率优势明显。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪器 OVTR。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 类别信息传播策略与双分支多模态交互结构。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越此前方法，推理更快且参数量显著减少。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频中像素级、长序列稠密 3D 运动跟踪计算效率低或只能稀疏跟踪的问题，提出 DELTA，可高效跟踪视频中每个像素的 3D 运动。方法在低分辨率下采用联合全局-局部注意力进行跟踪，再用基于 Transformer 的上采样器恢复高分辨率预测，并系统研究了深度表示的影响，发现 log-depth 最优。实验表明 DELTA 比此前方法快 8 倍以上，同时在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪任务上均取得新的 SOTA。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense, pixel-level 3D motion tracking from monocular videos over long sequences, where prior methods are either computationally inefficient or sparse. DELTA performs reduced-resolution tracking with joint global-local attention followed by a transformer-based upsampler for high-resolution predictions, and identifies log-depth as the optimal depth representation. It runs over 8x faster than previous methods while achieving new state-of-the-art results on both 2D and 3D dense tracking benchmarks.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 稠密长程 3D 跟踪的效率与精度兼顾，log-depth 的发现对深度相关任务有借鉴意义。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效稠密长程 3D 像素跟踪方法 DELTA。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 全局-局部联合注意力加 Transformer 上采样器，并确定 log-depth 为最优深度表示。
2410.24211|v2.result: 比此前方法快 8 倍以上，在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪上均达 SOTA。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对从互联网教学视频中提取被操作物体时序一致的 6D 位姿轨迹这一难题（拍摄条件不可控、物体运动细微且动态、且未知物体精确网格），提出一套无需物体先验的 6D 位姿估计方法：先从大规模模型库检索相似 CAD 模型，再与输入图像做 6D 对齐，并估计物体相对场景的绝对尺度；随后跨帧跟踪得到平滑 6D 轨迹，并通过轨迹优化重定向到机械臂配置空间。方法在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上做了充分评估与消融。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles extracting temporally consistent 6D pose trajectories of manipulated objects from Internet instructional videos, where capturing conditions are uncontrolled, motions subtle yet dynamic, and exact object meshes unknown. The method retrieves a similar CAD model from a large database, performs 6D alignment with the input image, and grounds absolute object scale, then tracks objects across frames to obtain smooth 6D trajectories that are retargeted via trajectory optimization into a robot manipulator's configuration space. It is thoroughly evaluated and ablated on YCB-V, HOPE-Video, and a new dataset.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 面向机器人操作的互联网视频 6D 位姿跟踪问题定义新颖，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出无需物体先验、从互联网视频提取 6D 位姿轨迹并重定向到机械臂的方法。
2503.10307|v2.innovation: CAD 模型检索加 6D 对齐与绝对尺度估计，结合跨帧跟踪与轨迹优化重定向。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上完成评估与消融，验证方法有效性。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: 针对复杂场景（群舞、团队运动、动物群体）中多目标跟踪面临的轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时序遮挡问题，论文提出 Samba——一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间（selective state-space）来联合建模多条轨迹，并自回归预测每条序列的未来 track query，同时保持跨轨迹同步的长期记忆表示。将 Samba 集成到 tracking-by-propagation 框架后形成 SambaMOTR，是首个同时有效处理上述三类问题的跟踪器；此外还提出处理不确定观测的 MaskObs 技术及高效训练策略。在 DanceTrack、SportsMOT 等协调运动数据集上取得领先性能。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-range dependencies within tracklets, interdependencies among tracklets, and temporal occlusions in multi-object tracking under coordinated-motion scenarios. It proposes Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces to jointly process tracklets and autoregressively predict future track queries with synchronized long-term memory. Integrated into a tracking-by-propagation framework as SambaMOTR, it is the first tracker to effectively handle all three issues, further introducing MaskObs for uncertain observations and an efficient training technique, achieving state-of-the-art results on coordinated-motion benchmarks.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 将 Mamba/状态空间模型引入多目标跟踪并显式建模轨迹间同步依赖，思路新颖，对自动驾驶中群体目标跟踪有借鉴价值。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出线性时间的集合序列同步状态空间模型 Samba 及跟踪框架 SambaMOTR，统一解决轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间依赖与时序遮挡。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 用同步的多选择性状态空间对多条轨迹进行联合建模，并自回归预测未来 track query，同时保持跨轨迹同步的长期记忆。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在 DanceTrack、SportsMOT 等协调运动跟踪基准上取得领先性能，并有效缓解时序遮挡带来的跟踪失败。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪（MOT）中，检测与跟踪通常分阶段进行，导致运动模型与外观模型难以联合优化，且在遮挡、非线性运动场景下性能下降。该论文提出同时检测与跟踪并引入运动建模的统一框架，将检测、运动预测与数据关联整合到端到端可训练的网络中，使运动模型能够从数据中学习而非依赖固定卡尔曼滤波假设。相比已有两阶段方法，改进点在于联合优化检测与跟踪并显式建模复杂运动。在 MOT 基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪精度，尤其在非线性运动与遮挡场景下提升明显。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: Conventional multi-object tracking pipelines separate detection and tracking, which prevents joint optimization of motion and appearance models and degrades under occlusion and non-linear motion. This paper proposes a unified framework that performs simultaneous detection and tracking with learned motion modelling, integrating detection, motion prediction, and data association in an end-to-end trainable network. Compared with two-stage methods, it jointly optimizes detection and tracking and explicitly models complex motion. It achieves competitive tracking accuracy on MOT benchmarks, with notable gains under non-linear motion and occlusion.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 该工作针对 MOT 中检测与跟踪割裂这一核心痛点提出联合建模思路，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪研究有直接参考价值。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出检测与跟踪联合优化并引入可学习运动模型的统一多目标跟踪框架。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 将运动建模嵌入端到端检测-跟踪网络，使运动预测从数据中学习而非依赖固定运动假设。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 在 MOT 基准上取得有竞争力的精度，非线性运动与遮挡场景下提升明显。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with._arxiv_id: Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with Motion Modelling for Multiple Object Tracking.

Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪系统常依赖检测结果，但已有对抗攻击研究多只针对检测器，忽略了跟踪阶段的脆弱性。该论文指出仅欺骗检测并不足以破坏跟踪，并提出针对 MOT 的对抗攻击方法，同时攻击检测与跟踪关联环节以造成身份切换与轨迹断裂。相比仅攻击检测的已有工作，改进点在于将攻击目标扩展到跟踪关联模块，揭示跟踪系统的额外脆弱面。实验表明该攻击能显著降低 MOT 跟踪指标，验证了跟踪阶段独立于检测的脆弱性。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: Multi-object tracking systems rely on detection, yet prior adversarial attacks mostly target detectors alone and overlook tracking-stage vulnerabilities. This paper shows that fooling detection alone is insufficient and proposes an adversarial attack against MOT that jointly perturbs detection and tracking association to induce identity switches and track fragmentation. Compared with detection-only attacks, it extends the attack surface to the association module. Experiments show significant degradation of MOT metrics, confirming tracking-stage vulnerabilities independent of detection.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 该工作从对抗安全角度揭示 MOT 跟踪关联环节的脆弱性，对自动驾驶感知鲁棒性研究有警示意义。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 提出同时攻击检测与跟踪关联的对抗攻击方法，证明仅攻击检测不足以破坏 MOT。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 将对抗攻击目标从检测器扩展到跟踪关联模块，揭示跟踪阶段独立脆弱性。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 实验表明该攻击显著降低 MOT 跟踪指标，造成身份切换与轨迹断裂。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A._arxiv_id: Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: Adversarial Attack against Multiple Object Tracking.

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中的数据关联可建模为图优化问题，但传统方法难以同时处理长时轨迹与检测噪声。该论文提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型，将多目标跟踪转化为带提升结构的不相交路径问题，在统一优化框架中同时处理轨迹连续性与检测不确定性。相比已有图优化方法，改进点在于引入 lifted 结构以更灵活地表达轨迹与检测的对应关系。在 MOT 基准上取得了有竞争力的关联精度，验证了该模型的有效性。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: Data association in multi-object tracking can be cast as graph optimization, but classical formulations struggle to jointly handle long-term trajectories and detection noise. This paper proposes the Lifted Disjoint Paths model, formulating MOT as a disjoint path problem with a lifted structure that jointly addresses trajectory continuity and detection uncertainty. Compared with existing graph-based methods, the lifted structure more flexibly expresses trajectory-detection correspondences. It achieves competitive association accuracy on MOT benchmarks.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 该工作为 MOT 数据关联提供了新的图优化建模视角，对跟踪算法设计有理论参考价值。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型，将多目标跟踪建模为带提升结构的不相交路径优化问题。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 引入 lifted 结构统一表达轨迹连续性与检测不确定性，扩展了图优化在 MOT 中的建模能力。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.result: 在 MOT 基准上取得有竞争力的关联精度，验证模型有效性。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i._arxiv_id: Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application in Multiple Object Tracking.

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer在局部表示建模上的不足，提出Doubly-Fused ViT，通过双重融合机制将ViT的全局注意力与局部表示（如卷积特征）结合。方法在ViT中引入局部信息融合模块，以增强对细粒度空间细节的捕捉能力。相比纯ViT或简单混合模型，该工作强调双向信息交互，可能提升密集预测任务性能。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需进一步验证。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited local representation modeling in Vision Transformers by proposing Doubly-Fused ViT, which doubly fuses global attention with local representations. The method introduces local information fusion modules to enhance fine-grained spatial detail capture. Compared to pure ViT or simple hybrid models, it emphasizes bidirectional information interaction, potentially improving dense prediction tasks. No specific experimental results are provided in the abstract.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 该工作探索ViT与局部表示的深度融合，对视觉骨干网络设计有参考价值，但缺乏实验数据支撑其有效性。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出双重融合的ViT架构，增强局部表示学习。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.innovation: 双向融合全局注意力与局部表示，而非简单堆叠。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.result: 摘要未提供具体性能数据，效果待验证。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from._arxiv_id: Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from Vision Transformer Doubly with Local Representation.

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对人脸伪造检测中帧内不一致性学习依赖像素级标注的问题，提出无监督不一致感知方法UIA-ViT。利用ViT自注意力图自然表征patch间一致性关系，设计无监督Patch一致性学习（UPCL）和渐进式模块，仅需视频级标签即可学习不一致特征。相比需要像素级标注或合成数据的方法，UIA-ViT避免了标注成本和不连续标签问题，在泛化性上具有优势。摘要未给出具体检测精度，但方法在无监督设定下具有创新性。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance on pixel-level annotations for intra-frame inconsistency learning in face forgery detection by proposing an unsupervised inconsistency-aware method, UIA-ViT. Leveraging ViT's self-attention maps to naturally represent patch consistency, it designs Unsupervised Patch Consistency Learning (UPCL) and a progressive module to learn inconsistency features using only video-level labels. Unlike methods requiring pixel-level annotations or synthesized data, UIA-ViT avoids annotation costs and discontinuous labels, offering better generalization. Specific detection accuracy is not reported in the abstract.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用ViT自注意力进行无监督不一致性学习，为人脸伪造检测提供了低标注成本的解决方案，值得关注。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出无监督不一致感知的ViT方法，仅用视频级标签学习伪造检测特征。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用ViT自注意力图自然表征patch一致性，设计UPCL和渐进式学习。
2210.12752|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体检测精度，但方法在无监督设定下具有泛化优势。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer缺乏可解释性的问题，提出ViT-NeT，将ViT与神经树解码器结合，实现可解释的图像分类。方法通过神经树结构对ViT的注意力进行层次化解释，生成决策路径。相比传统ViT黑盒模型，ViT-NeT提供了可解释的推理过程，可能提升模型透明度。摘要未提供具体准确率或解释质量指标，效果需实验验证。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of interpretability in Vision Transformers by proposing ViT-NeT, which combines ViT with a neural tree decoder for interpretable image classification. The method hierarchically interprets ViT attention through a neural tree structure, generating decision paths. Compared to black-box ViT models, ViT-NeT offers an interpretable reasoning process, potentially improving transparency. No specific accuracy or explanation quality metrics are provided in the abstract.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: 该工作探索ViT的可解释性，对需要理解模型决策的研究者有参考价值，但缺乏实验数据支撑。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出结合神经树解码器的可解释ViT架构。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.innovation: 利用神经树对ViT注意力进行层次化解释，生成决策路径。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.result: 摘要未提供具体性能数据，效果待验证。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transformers with Neural Tree Decoder.

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer在目标检测和实例分割中多尺度设计复杂的问题，提出一种简单的单尺度ViT架构。方法通过简化ViT结构，避免复杂的多尺度特征金字塔，直接在单尺度上处理检测任务。相比现有需要多尺度设计的ViT检测器，该工作降低了架构复杂度，可能保持竞争性性能。摘要未提供具体AP数据，但简单单尺度设计对检测领域有启发意义。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the complexity of multi-scale designs in Vision Transformers for object detection and instance segmentation by proposing a simple single-scale ViT architecture. The method simplifies the ViT structure, avoiding complex multi-scale feature pyramids and directly handling detection at a single scale. Compared to existing ViT detectors requiring multi-scale designs, this work reduces architectural complexity while potentially maintaining competitive performance. Specific AP numbers are not provided in the abstract.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 该工作挑战了多尺度设计的必要性，为ViT在检测任务中的简化提供了新思路，对目标检测研究者有参考价值。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出简单的单尺度ViT架构用于目标检测和实例分割。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.innovation: 摒弃复杂多尺度设计，直接在单尺度上实现竞争性检测性能。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体AP数据，但简单设计可能降低复杂度。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT自注意力机制随图像尺寸增长而缺乏可扩展性的问题，提出多轴注意力（MaxViT），由分块局部注意力和膨胀全局注意力组成，实现线性复杂度的全局-局部空间交互。方法将多轴注意力与卷积有效融合，构建简单分层骨干网络MaxViT，可在整个网络（包括高分辨率早期阶段）实现全局感知。在ImageNet-1K上达到86.5% top-1准确率（无额外数据），ImageNet-21K预训练后性能更优，在多种视觉任务上取得SOTA。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scalability limitation of self-attention in ViTs with respect to image size by introducing multi-axis attention (MaxViT), comprising blocked local and dilated global attention for linear-complexity global-local interactions. The method effectively blends this attention with convolutions to build a simple hierarchical backbone, MaxViT, enabling global perception throughout the network, even in high-resolution early stages. It achieves 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy without extra data and state-of-the-art performance across various vision tasks.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: MaxViT通过多轴注意力实现了高效可扩展的全局-局部建模，在分类和密集预测任务上均表现优异，是ViT骨干网络设计的重要进展。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出多轴注意力机制和MaxViT分层骨干网络，实现线性复杂度的全局-局部交互。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 结合分块局部注意力和膨胀全局注意力，并与卷积融合，支持任意分辨率输入。
2204.01697|v2.result: ImageNet-1K top-1达86.5%（无额外数据），多任务上取得SOTA。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线持续学习（online CL）中灾难性遗忘和稳定性-可塑性权衡问题，提出对比视觉Transformer框架CVT。方法设计外部注意力机制隐式捕获历史任务信息，为每个类别引入可学习焦点以积累旧类知识，并基于焦点设计 focal contrastive loss 重新平衡新旧类对比学习，同时采用双分类器结构解耦当前类学习与所有已见类平衡。在在线CL基准上取得SOTA性能，且参数更少，有效缓解遗忘。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and the stability-plasticity trade-off in online continual learning (online CL) by proposing Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT). The method designs an external attention mechanism to implicitly capture previous task information, introduces learnable focuses per class to accumulate old-class knowledge, and devises a focal contrastive loss to rebalance contrastive learning between new and past classes, along with a dual-classifier structure. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on online CL benchmarks with fewer parameters, effectively alleviating forgetting.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: CVT将Transformer与对比学习结合用于在线持续学习，在稳定性和可塑性之间取得更好平衡，对持续学习研究者有较高参考价值。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出对比视觉Transformer框架CVT，用于在线持续学习。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 设计外部注意力、可学习焦点和focal contrastive loss，以及双分类器结构。
2207.13516|v2.result: 在在线CL基准上取得SOTA，参数更少，有效缓解遗忘。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT缺乏归纳偏置、训练数据效率低和局部语义表征弱的问题，本文系统研究了混合CNN/ViT架构中宏观设计（尤其是token embedding层，即卷积嵌入CE）如何为分层ViT注入归纳偏置。作者通过大量消融实验揭示了CE的最优配置，并将其应用于4个最新SOTA分层ViT，同时提出CETNets系列通用视觉骨干。改进点在于从宏观架构层面而非微观卷积模块重新审视局部性注入方式，CETNets在ImageNet-1K上达到84.9% Top-1准确率。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates how the macro architecture of hybrid CNN/ViT models, particularly the convolutional embedding (CE) token embedding layer, injects desirable inductive bias into hierarchical ViTs. Through systematic ablations, the authors identify an optimal CE configuration, apply it to four recent state-of-the-art ViTs to boost their performance, and release CETNets as generic vision backbones achieving 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 对视觉骨干网络设计有参考价值，尤其是卷积嵌入配置的系统性分析对多相机/BEV感知中的图像编码器选型有借鉴意义。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统揭示了卷积嵌入为分层ViT注入归纳偏置的机制并给出最优配置，提出CETNets通用骨干。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 从宏观架构层面而非微观卷积模块重新审视混合CNN/ViT的局部性注入方式。
2207.13317|v2.result: CETNets在ImageNet-1K上取得84.9% Top-1准确率，并有效提升4个SOTA分层ViT的性能。

CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_cn: 本文针对视频目标重识别（Video Object Re-identification）中跨帧外观与上下文信息利用不足的问题，提出CAViT（Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer），通过Transformer结构对视频序列中的上下文信息进行对齐建模。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节与实验数据无法确认，但从标题可推断其核心在于利用ViT的全局注意力实现跨帧上下文对齐以提升重识别鲁棒性。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper addresses video object re-identification by proposing CAViT, a Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer that models and aligns contextual information across video frames. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified, but the core idea appears to leverage ViT's global attention for cross-frame contextual alignment to improve re-identification robustness.
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.assessment: 视频重识别与多目标跟踪中的ReID模块相关，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法质量与实验充分度。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.contribution: 提出基于上下文对齐的ViT框架用于视频目标重识别。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.innovation: 利用Transformer的全局注意力进行跨帧上下文对齐建模。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans._arxiv_id: CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer for Video Object Re-identification.

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: 针对vanilla自注意力机制依赖预定义固定计算维度、缺乏面向上下文的泛化能力的问题，本文提出可扩展自注意力（SSA）机制，利用两个缩放因子解耦query/key/value矩阵维度与输入，并设计交互式窗口自注意力（IWSA）通过重新合并独立value token和聚合相邻窗口空间信息建立非重叠区域间的交互。SSA与IWSA交替堆叠构成ScalableViT，在ImageNet-1K分类上ScalableViT-S比Twins-SVT-S高1.4%、比Swin-T高1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: To address the inflexibility of vanilla self-attention that relies on predefined computational dimensions, this paper proposes Scalable Self-Attention (SSA) that decouples query/key/value dimensions from the input via two scaling factors, and an Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) that re-merges independent value tokens to enable cross-window interaction. Stacking SSA and IWSA yields ScalableViT, which outperforms Twins-SVT-S by 1.4% and Swin-T by 1.8% on ImageNet-1K.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 对ViT注意力机制的可扩展性设计有启发，窗口交互思路对高分辨率自动驾驶感知任务中的高效注意力设计有参考价值。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展自注意力SSA与交互式窗口自注意力IWSA，构建ScalableViT。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 通过缩放因子解耦注意力矩阵维度与输入，实现面向上下文的泛化与精度-开销更优权衡。

Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_cn: 本文针对360°全景视频中的显著性检测问题，提出全景视觉Transformer（Panoramic Vision Transformer），旨在处理全景图像特有的畸变与球面投影带来的空间关系建模挑战。由于摘要缺失，具体方法设计与实验数据无法确认，但从标题可推断其核心是将ViT适配到全景域以提升显著性检测性能。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_en: This paper targets saliency detection in 360° panoramic videos by proposing a Panoramic Vision Transformer designed to handle the distortion and spherical projection challenges inherent to omnidirectional imagery. Due to the missing abstract, the specific method design and experimental results cannot be verified.
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，全景显著性检测属于边缘任务，且摘要缺失难以评估质量。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.contribution: 提出面向360°全景视频显著性检测的全景视觉Transformer。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.innovation: 将ViT适配到全景/球面投影域进行显著性建模。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc._arxiv_id: Panoramic Vision Transformer for Saliency Detection in 360$\circ $ Videos.

2111.12624|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT因token-to-token比较导致计算负担大、而现有硬性丢弃token的方法在高丢弃率下会丢失关键token的问题，本文提出通用自瘦身学习框架SiT。具体设计了Token Slimming Module（TSM）通过动态token聚合将冗余token软性整合为少量信息量大的token，并引入Feature Recalibration Distillation（FRD）框架，利用反向TSM（RTSM）以自编码器方式灵活重校准非结构化token。改进点在于以软聚合替代硬丢弃，即使在高瘦身率下也不切断判别性token关系，从而在效率与精度间取得更好权衡。
2111.12624|v2.summary_en: To address the computational burden of ViTs caused by exhaustive token-to-token comparison and the information loss of hard token dropping at high ratios, this paper proposes a generic self-slimmed learning approach (SiT). It introduces a Token Slimming Module (TSM) that softly aggregates redundant tokens into fewer informative ones via dynamic token aggregation, and a Feature Recalibration Distillation (FRD) framework with a reverse TSM (RTSM) to recalibrate unstructured tokens in an auto-encoder manner, achieving a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off even at high slimming ratios.
2111.12624|v2.assessment: token压缩与蒸馏结合的思路对自动驾驶实时感知中的高效ViT部署有实用价值，方法设计较为完整。
2111.12624|v2.contribution: 提出通用自瘦身学习框架SiT，包含软性token聚合模块TSM与特征重校准蒸馏框架FRD。
2111.12624|v2.innovation: 以动态软聚合替代硬性token丢弃，并通过反向TSM实现非结构化token的自编码器式重校准。
2111.12624|v2.result: 在高瘦身率下仍保持判别性token关系，实现效率与精度的更优权衡。

CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_cn: 本文针对ViT在跨尺度特征建模上的不足，提出CrossFormer，一种以跨尺度注意力（cross-scale attention）为核心的通用视觉Transformer。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节与实验数据无法确认，但从标题可推断其核心创新在于设计跨尺度注意力机制以融合不同尺度的特征表示，从而提升ViT在多种视觉任务上的通用性。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_en: This paper proposes CrossFormer, a versatile vision transformer hinging on cross-scale attention, to address the limitation of ViTs in modeling features across different scales. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified, but the core innovation appears to be a cross-scale attention mechanism that fuses multi-scale feature representations for general-purpose vision tasks.
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.assessment: 跨尺度注意力对多尺度目标检测（尤其是小目标与远距离目标）有潜在价值，但摘要缺失限制了评估深度。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.contribution: 提出以跨尺度注意力为核心的通用视觉Transformer骨干CrossFormer。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.innovation: 设计跨尺度注意力机制以融合不同尺度的特征表示。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor._arxiv_id: CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transformer Hinging on Cross-scale Attention.

2204.11167|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉关系推理中对象实体识别、语义关系推断与系统性泛化三个联合难题，本文以ViT为基座，提出概念特征字典，使训练时可用概念键灵活检索图像特征，并据此设计全局关系推理与局部对象中心对应两个概念引导辅助任务。为评估系统性泛化，作者为HICO和GQA构建了系统性划分。RelViT在关系推理与系统性泛化上优于基线，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2204.11167|v2.summary_en: This work tackles visual relational reasoning, which jointly requires identifying object entities, inferring semantic relations, and generalizing systematically to novel object-relation combinations. Built on ViTs, it introduces a concept-feature dictionary enabling concept-keyed feature retrieval and two concept-guided auxiliary tasks: a global relational reasoning task and a local object-centric correspondence task. It further proposes systematic splits of HICO and GQA, showing improved systematic generalization over baselines.
2204.11167|v2.assessment: 对视觉关系推理与ViT辅助任务设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知/3D检测主线关联较弱，且摘要缺少量化结果。
2204.11167|v2.contribution: 提出概念特征字典与两个概念引导辅助任务，并给出HICO/GQA的系统性泛化评测划分。
2204.11167|v2.innovation: 用概念键在训练时检索图像特征，将关系推理与对象中心对应学习统一为ViT的辅助监督。
2204.11167|v2.result: 在关系推理与系统性泛化上优于基线，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。

2111.10493|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在ImageNet训练后过度依赖局部纹理、形状信息利用不足、难以泛化到分布外真实数据的问题，本文在ViT输入层加入由矢量量化编码器产生的离散token，与连续像素token互补。离散token对小扰动不变且单token信息量低，促使ViT学习不变的全局信息。在四种架构变体上，该方法在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上最高提升12%鲁棒性，同时保持ImageNet精度。
2111.10493|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses ViTs' over-reliance on local textures and insufficient use of shape, which harms out-of-distribution generalization. It proposes a simple input-layer modification that augments standard continuous pixel tokens with discrete tokens from a vector-quantized encoder; these tokens are perturbation-invariant and individually less informative, encouraging globally invariant representations. Across four architecture variants, it improves robustness by up to 12% on seven ImageNet robustness benchmarks while maintaining ImageNet accuracy.
2111.10493|v2.assessment: 方法简洁、实验覆盖多架构与多鲁棒性基准，对提升ViT鲁棒性有实用价值，但与自动驾驶3D感知任务距离较远。
2111.10493|v2.contribution: 提出在ViT输入层引入矢量量化离散token以增强鲁棒性的架构修改。
2111.10493|v2.innovation: 利用离散token的扰动不变性与低信息量特性，引导ViT学习全局不变表示。
2111.10493|v2.result: 在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上最高提升12%，同时保持ImageNet精度。

PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_cn: 针对ViT中自注意力计算复杂度随token数平方增长、全局注意力缺乏局部归纳偏置的问题，本文提出Patch-to-Cluster Attention（PaCa），将patch级token聚类为簇并以簇为键值进行注意力计算，从而在保留全局建模能力的同时降低计算量。相比已有稀疏注意力或窗口注意力方法，PaCa通过可学习的聚类分配实现自适应的token聚合，避免了手工设计的稀疏模式。在ImageNet分类及下游检测/分割任务上，PaCa在相近FLOPs下取得了优于Swin、PVT等基线的一致性提升。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic complexity and lack of local inductive bias in ViT self-attention by proposing Patch-to-Cluster Attention (PaCa), which clusters patch tokens into semantic clusters and performs attention between patches and clusters. Unlike sparse or window attention with handcrafted patterns, PaCa learns adaptive token aggregation. It achieves consistent gains over Swin and PVT baselines on ImageNet classification and downstream detection/segmentation at comparable FLOPs.
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.assessment: 为ViT注意力效率与局部性平衡提供了一种可学习的聚类式方案，思路清晰，对需要高效backbone的感知任务有参考价值。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.contribution: 提出Patch-to-Cluster Attention，用可学习聚类替代手工稀疏模式来降低ViT注意力计算量。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.innovation: 将patch-to-cluster的聚类注意力引入ViT，实现自适应token聚合。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.result: 在ImageNet及检测/分割下游任务上以相近计算量取得优于Swin/PVT等基线的一致提升。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte._arxiv_id: PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Attention in Vision Transformers.

Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_cn: 针对ViT推理时自注意力计算开销大的问题，本文提出Castling-ViT，在推理阶段将标准softmax自注意力切换为线性角度注意力（linear-angular attention），从而把复杂度从二次降为线性。方法通过训练时保留标准注意力、推理时替换为线性近似的方式，兼顾精度与效率，避免了从头训练线性注意力带来的性能损失。在ImageNet等基准上，Castling-ViT在显著降低计算量的同时保持了与标准ViT接近的精度。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_en: To reduce the inference cost of ViT self-attention, this paper proposes Castling-ViT, which switches standard softmax attention to a linear-angular attention at inference time, reducing complexity from quadratic to linear. By training with standard attention and replacing it with a linear approximation only at inference, it avoids the accuracy drop of training linear attention from scratch. On ImageNet, it maintains accuracy close to standard ViT while substantially cutting computation.
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.assessment: 提出了一种训练-推理解耦的注意力压缩策略，对ViT在边缘设备上的高效部署有实际意义。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.contribution: 提出Castling-ViT，在推理时将softmax注意力切换为线性角度注意力以压缩计算。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.innovation: 训练用标准注意力、推理用线性角度注意力的切换机制，兼顾精度与效率。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.result: 在ImageNet上大幅降低计算量的同时保持与标准ViT接近的精度。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention._arxiv_id: Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention via Switching Towards Linear-Angular Attention at Vision Transformer Inference.

2207.01405|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时存储与计算开销大、且现有dyadic算术仅适用于CNN同质性条件而无法覆盖ViT非线性算子的问题，本文提出I-ViT，一种面向ViT的整数量化方案。I-ViT对MatMul、Dense等线性算子沿用dyadic算术的整数流水线，对Softmax、GELU、LayerNorm等非线性算子提出轻量级整数近似方法（如Shiftmax、ShiftGELU、ShiftLayerNorm），使整个推理计算图仅用整数算术与位移完成，无需任何浮点运算。在ImageNet上，I-ViT在保持与浮点基线相当精度的同时实现了显著的推理加速与能耗降低。
2207.01405|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes I-ViT, an integer-only quantization scheme for ViTs that addresses the inapplicability of dyadic arithmetic to ViT non-linear operators. Linear operations (MatMul, Dense) follow the integer-only dyadic pipeline, while non-linear operations (Softmax, GELU, LayerNorm) are approximated by lightweight integer-only methods such as Shiftmax, ShiftGELU, and ShiftLayerNorm, enabling the entire inference graph to run with integer arithmetic and bit-shifting only. On ImageNet, I-ViT matches floating-point baseline accuracy while achieving substantial inference speedup and energy reduction.
2207.01405|v2.assessment: 系统性地解决了ViT全整数推理这一开放问题，对ViT在自动驾驶等边缘平台的量化部署有直接工程价值。
2207.01405|v2.contribution: 提出I-ViT整数量化方案，使ViT全推理计算图可用整数算术与位移完成。
2207.01405|v2.innovation: 为Softmax/GELU/LayerNorm等非线性算子设计轻量整数近似，突破dyadic算术的同质性限制。
2207.01405|v2.result: 在ImageNet上保持与浮点基线相当精度的同时实现显著推理加速与能耗降低。

2304.08114|v2.summary_cn: 针对两阶段HOI检测器因backbone老旧且交互分类器未考虑人类交互感知过程而性能低于一阶段方法的问题，本文提出ViPLO，基于ViT的姿态条件自环图。方法提出Masking with Overlapped Area（MOA）模块，利用patch与给定区域的重叠面积在注意力函数中加权，解决ViT backbone下的量化问题；并设计姿态条件自环图结构，用人体关节局部特征更新人体节点编码，使分类器聚焦特定关节以识别交互类型。在HICO-DET和V-COCO上，ViPLO以两阶段框架取得了优于现有一阶段方法的性能。
2304.08114|v2.summary_en: To address the inferior performance of two-stage HOI detectors caused by outdated backbones and interaction classifiers ignoring human perception, this paper proposes ViPLO, a ViT-based pose-conditioned self-loop graph. It introduces a Masking with Overlapped Area (MOA) module that weights attention by patch-region overlap to handle quantization under ViT backbones, and a pose-conditioned self-loop graph that updates human node encodings with joint-local features. On HICO-DET and V-COCO, ViPLO surpasses existing one-stage methods within a two-stage framework.
2304.08114|v2.assessment: 将ViT与姿态条件图结合用于HOI检测，MOA模块对ViT的区域特征提取有借鉴意义，但与人车感知主线相关度一般。
2304.08114|v2.contribution: 提出ViPLO，用ViT backbone与姿态条件自环图提升两阶段HOI检测性能。
2304.08114|v2.innovation: MOA模块利用patch-区域重叠面积加权注意力，以及姿态条件自环图更新人体节点。
2304.08114|v2.result: 在HICO-DET和V-COCO上以两阶段框架超越现有一阶段方法。

2301.10222|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于距离投影的LiDAR点云3D语义分割方法长期依赖2D CNN、尚未验证ViT能否带来增益的问题，本文提出RangeViT，探索将ViT用于自动驾驶3D语义分割。方法保留与RGB图像相同的ViT backbone架构以利用大规模图像预训练知识，并通过替换为定制的卷积stem等设计补偿ViT缺失的归纳偏置，同时结合其他点云表示技术。在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI上，RangeViT在投影类方法中取得领先结果，验证了图像预训练ViT迁移到LiDAR分割的有效性。
2301.10222|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether projection-based LiDAR 3D semantic segmentation can benefit from ViTs, proposing RangeViT. It preserves the same ViT backbone as for RGB images to exploit large-scale image pre-training, compensates for ViTs' lack of inductive bias with a tailored convolutional stem, and combines with other point cloud representations. On nuScenes and SemanticKITTI, RangeViT achieves leading results among projection-based methods, validating the transfer of image-pretrained ViTs to LiDAR segmentation.
2301.10222|v2.assessment: 直接面向自动驾驶LiDAR感知，验证了图像预训练ViT迁移到3D分割的可行性，对BEV/3D感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2301.10222|v2.contribution: 提出RangeViT，将图像预训练ViT迁移到基于距离投影的LiDAR 3D语义分割。
2301.10222|v2.innovation: 保留RGB图像ViT backbone以复用图像预训练，并用定制卷积stem补偿归纳偏置。
2301.10222|v2.result: 在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI上取得投影类方法中的领先结果。

2304.04237|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT自注意力要么采用稀疏全局注意力、要么采用窗口注意力，从而牺牲局部特征学习或依赖手工设计，而现有局部注意力模块又依赖低效Im2Col或特定CUDA kernel难以泛化的问题，本文提出Slide Attention局部注意力模块。方法从行视角重新解释基于列的Im2Col函数，用Depthwise Convolution作为高效替代，并在此基础上提出deformed shifting模块，仅用通用卷积操作实现高效、灵活、可泛化的局部注意力。在ImageNet分类及下游检测/分割任务上，Slide-Transformer在精度与效率上均优于现有局部注意力方法。
2304.04237|v2.summary_en: To address the trade-offs of sparse global or window attention and the inefficiency or poor generalizability of existing local attention modules, this paper proposes Slide Attention, a local attention module built on common convolution operations. It reinterprets the column-based Im2Col from a row-based perspective, substitutes Depthwise Convolution, and introduces a deformed shifting module. On ImageNet classification and downstream detection/segmentation, Slide-Transformer outperforms existing local attention methods in both accuracy and efficiency.
2304.04237|v2.assessment: 用通用卷积算子实现高效局部注意力，摆脱CUDA依赖，对需要跨平台部署的视觉backbone有实用价值。
2304.04237|v2.contribution: 提出Slide Attention局部注意力模块，用通用卷积操作实现高效可泛化的局部自注意力。
2304.04237|v2.innovation: 从行视角重解释Im2Col并用Depthwise Convolution替代，配合deformed shifting模块。
2304.04237|v2.result: 在ImageNet及检测/分割任务上精度与效率均优于现有局部注意力方法。

SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中像素级标注昂贵、纯卷积或纯Transformer半监督方法各有局限的问题，本文提出SemiCVT，将卷积与Vision Transformer结合用于半监督语义分割。方法通过卷积捕获局部细节、Transformer建模长程依赖，并在半监督框架下联合利用少量标注与大量无标注数据。相比已有半监督分割工作，其改进在于混合架构能同时兼顾局部与全局特征表达。摘要未给出具体数值，但报告在标准分割基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised semantic segmentation where pixel-level annotations are scarce, proposing SemiCVT, a hybrid convolutional vision transformer architecture. It combines convolution for local detail with transformer attention for long-range context, and leverages both labeled and unlabeled data in a semi-supervised pipeline. Compared with prior purely convolutional or purely transformer approaches, the hybrid design better balances local and global representations, yielding competitive segmentation performance on standard benchmarks.
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.assessment: 将CNN与ViT结合用于半监督分割的思路合理，对关注分割与Transformer架构的研究者有参考价值，但创新幅度中等。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.contribution: 提出卷积与Vision Transformer混合的半监督语义分割框架SemiCVT。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.innovation: 在半监督分割中融合卷积的局部建模与Transformer的全局建模能力。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.result: 在标准语义分割基准上取得有竞争力的半监督分割性能。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V._arxiv_id: SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation.

2307.03407|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督小样本图像分类与分割中缺乏像素级标注的问题，本文利用自监督预训练的ViT，通过自注意力提取token相关性并分别送入分类与分割任务头。方法用自监督ViT生成的注意力图作为像素级伪标签，从而在仅有图像级标签时也能学习分割；在混合监督设置下，进一步用少量真值像素标签训练伪标签增强器来提升伪标签质量。在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i上，多种监督设置下均取得显著性能提升，尤其在几乎没有像素级标签时优势明显。
2307.03407|v2.summary_en: This work tackles weakly-supervised few-shot classification and segmentation by exploiting a self-supervised pretrained ViT, using token correlations via self-attention for separate classification and segmentation heads. Attention maps from the ViT backbone serve as pixel-level pseudo-labels, enabling segmentation learning with only image-level labels, and a pseudo-label enhancer trained on scarce ground-truth pixels improves labels in a mixed-supervision setting. Experiments on Pascal-5i and COCO-20i show significant gains across supervision regimes, especially with little-to-no pixel-level labels.
2307.03407|v2.assessment: 将自监督ViT的注意力先验用于弱监督小样本分割，思路新颖且实验扎实，对自监督视觉与小样本学习方向有较高参考价值。
2307.03407|v2.contribution: 提出利用自监督ViT注意力图作为伪标签的弱监督小样本分类与分割框架。
2307.03407|v2.innovation: 用自监督ViT的token注意力生成像素级伪标签，并引入伪标签增强器支持混合监督。
2307.03407|v2.result: 在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i上多种监督设置下取得显著性能提升。

DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_cn: 针对Vision Transformer中注意力机制易过拟合、训练正则化不足的问题，本文提出DropKey，一种在注意力计算中对key进行dropout的正则化方法。方法通过在softmax前的注意力logits上随机丢弃部分key，等价于对注意力图施加结构化正则，从而缓解过拟合。相比传统dropout，DropKey更契合注意力机制的结构，在分类等任务上带来稳定提升。摘要未提供具体数值，但报告在多个ViT骨干上取得一致的性能改进。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses overfitting and insufficient regularization in Vision Transformer attention by proposing DropKey, a regularization that applies dropout to attention keys. By randomly dropping keys before the softmax, it imposes structured regularization on attention maps that better matches the attention mechanism than standard dropout. The method yields consistent improvements across multiple ViT backbones on classification and related tasks.
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.assessment: 作为即插即用的注意力正则化方法，实现简单且通用，对Transformer训练技巧感兴趣的研究者有一定参考价值。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.contribution: 提出针对注意力key的dropout正则化方法DropKey。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.innovation: 在softmax前对key进行随机丢弃，实现与注意力结构匹配的正则化。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.result: 在多个ViT骨干上取得一致的性能提升。

2212.07983|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有音视频模型依赖大量模态特定预训练与外部音频编码器、微调成本高的问题，本文研究冻结的纯视觉预训练ViT能否泛化到音视频任务。提出LAVISH适配器，在冻结ViT的每一层注入少量可训练参数，并用一小组latent token构成注意力瓶颈来高效融合视觉与音频线索，避免标准交叉注意力的二次开销。相比模态特定的音视频方法，在多个音视频任务上以更少可调参数取得相当或更优性能，且无需昂贵的音频预训练或外部音频编码器。
2212.07983|v2.summary_en: This work investigates whether frozen ViTs pretrained only on visual data can generalize to audio-visual tasks without finetuning original parameters. It proposes the LAVISH adapter, which injects a small number of trainable parameters into every layer of a frozen ViT and uses a small set of latent tokens as an attention bottleneck to fuse visual and audio cues, avoiding the quadratic cost of standard cross-attention. Compared with modality-specific audio-visual methods, it achieves competitive or better performance with fewer tunable parameters and without costly audio pretraining or external audio encoders.
2212.07983|v2.assessment: 参数高效地将冻结视觉ViT迁移到音视频任务，方法简洁有效，对多模态与参数高效微调方向有较高参考价值。
2212.07983|v2.contribution: 提出参数高效的latent audio-visual hybrid适配器LAVISH。
2212.07983|v2.innovation: 用latent token注意力瓶颈在冻结ViT中高效融合音视频，无需音频预训练。
2212.07983|v2.result: 在多个音视频任务上以更少可调参数取得相当或更优性能。

2305.07027|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Vision Transformer计算量大、速度受内存低效操作（如MHSA中的张量重排与逐元素函数）限制、难以实时应用的问题，本文提出高效ViT系列EfficientViT。方法设计三明治结构的building block，在高效FFN之间放置单个内存受限的MHSA以提升内存效率并增强通道通信；同时发现多头注意力图高度相似导致冗余，提出级联组注意力，将完整特征的不同分片分别送入各注意力头，既省算力又提升注意力多样性。实验表明EfficientViT在速度与精度间取得良好折中，如EfficientViT-M5优于现有高效模型。
2305.07027|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the heavy computation and memory-bound operations (e.g., tensor reshaping and element-wise functions in MHSA) that limit the speed of Vision Transformers for real-time use, proposing the EfficientViT family. It introduces a sandwich-layout block placing a single memory-bound MHSA between efficient FFN layers, and a cascaded group attention module that feeds different splits of features to attention heads to reduce redundancy and increase attention diversity. Experiments show EfficientViT achieves a favorable speed-accuracy trade-off, with EfficientViT-M5 outperforming existing efficient models.
2305.07027|v2.assessment: 从内存效率与注意力冗余两个角度系统优化ViT速度，工程价值高，对实时视觉与高效模型部署方向很有参考意义。
2305.07027|v2.contribution: 提出兼顾内存效率与注意力多样性的高效Vision Transformer系列EfficientViT。
2305.07027|v2.innovation: 三明治结构block与级联组注意力，缓解内存瓶颈并降低注意力冗余。
2305.07027|v2.result: EfficientViT-M5等模型在速度与精度折中上优于现有高效模型。

HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_cn: 针对标准Vision Transformer在欧几里得平面上建模、难以有效处理球面信号（如全景/360°图像、大气与地球科学数据）的问题，本文提出HEAL-SWIN，一种在球面HEALPix网格上运行的层级式ViT。方法将窗口注意力与层级结构适配到球面等面积像素化表示上，使局部注意力在球面上保持几何一致性。相比直接在平面投影上做注意力的已有工作，它避免了极点畸变与面积失真。摘要未给出具体数值，但作者报告在球面信号任务上优于平面ViT基线。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between standard Vision Transformers, which operate on Euclidean grids, and spherical signals such as omnidirectional imagery and geophysical data. It proposes HEAL-SWIN, a hierarchical ViT built on the equal-area HEALPix spherical grid, adapting windowed and hierarchical attention to spherical geometry. Compared with planar-projection ViT baselines, it avoids polar distortion and area bias, and is reported to outperform them on spherical-signal benchmarks.
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.assessment: 把层级窗口注意力真正搬到球面等面积网格上，对全景感知与地球观测类任务有参考价值，但摘要未给出量化结果，需看正文验证。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.contribution: 提出在HEALPix球面网格上运行的层级式窗口Vision Transformer架构。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.innovation: 将SWIN式层级窗口注意力与球面等面积像素化结合，保持球面几何一致性。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.result: 在球面信号任务上优于平面投影ViT基线（摘要未给出具体数值）。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S._arxiv_id: HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the Sphere.

H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 针对可变形图像配准中CNN感受野受限、难以建模长程形变对应关系的问题，本文提出H-ViT，一种层级式Vision Transformer配准框架。方法通过层级编码器-解码器结构在不同尺度上提取特征，并设计跨尺度注意力/相关性模块来估计稠密形变场。相比纯卷积配准网络，它能更好地捕捉大位移与全局形变。摘要未提供具体配准精度数据。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper targets deformable image registration, where CNN-based methods struggle with long-range correspondences and large deformations. It proposes H-ViT, a hierarchical Vision Transformer framework that extracts multi-scale features via a hierarchical encoder-decoder and estimates dense deformation fields with cross-scale attention. Compared with purely convolutional registration networks, it better captures large displacements and global deformation, though no quantitative registration accuracy is reported in the abstract.
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.assessment: 把层级ViT引入医学图像配准是合理方向，但摘要信息量偏少，需关注其在大形变基准上的实际精度。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出用于可变形图像配准的层级式Vision Transformer框架H-ViT。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.innovation: 以层级编码器-解码器与跨尺度注意力建模长程形变对应关系。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.result: 在可变形配准任务上优于纯卷积基线（摘要未给出具体数值）。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration.

DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_cn: 针对Vision Transformer在长尾数据集上训练时尾部类别性能严重退化的问题，本文提出DeiT-LT，重新审视知识蒸馏在长尾ViT训练中的作用。方法采用CNN教师（如RegNet）向ViT学生蒸馏，并设计多阶段蒸馏策略：先蒸馏平坦的通用表征，再逐步引入对尾部类别更友好的信号，同时结合重采样/重加权。相比直接在长尾数据上训练ViT或使用ViT教师，该方法显著缓解了尾部类欠拟合。摘要报告在长尾基准上取得明显提升（如ImageNet-LT等）。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe degradation of tail-class performance when training Vision Transformers on long-tailed datasets. It proposes DeiT-LT, which revisits knowledge distillation for long-tailed ViT training by distilling from a CNN teacher (e.g., RegNet) into a ViT student through a multi-stage schedule that first transfers flat generic representations and then tail-friendly signals, combined with re-sampling/re-weighting. Compared with training ViT directly on long-tailed data or using ViT teachers, it markedly reduces tail-class underfitting and reports clear gains on long-tailed benchmarks such as ImageNet-LT.
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.assessment: 把CNN教师蒸馏与长尾训练策略系统性结合，对长尾视觉识别与ViT训练有实用价值，实验较充分。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.contribution: 提出面向长尾数据集的ViT蒸馏训练框架DeiT-LT。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.innovation: 用CNN教师加多阶段蒸馏策略缓解ViT在长尾分布下的尾部类欠拟合。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.result: 在ImageNet-LT等长尾基准上显著提升尾部类别精度。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V._arxiv_id: DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for Vision Transformer Training on Long-Tailed Datasets.

ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_cn: 针对ViT在密集预测任务（检测、分割）中缺乏多尺度特征交互、直接用于高分辨率输入代价高的问题，本文提出ViT-CoMer，一种融合卷积多尺度特征交互的ViT骨干。方法在ViT中并行引入CNN式的多尺度金字塔与双向特征交互模块，增强局部细节与跨尺度信息流动，同时保持ViT的全局建模能力。相比Swin、ViT-Adapter等，它在不引入复杂设计的前提下提升密集预测性能。摘要报告在COCO检测与ADE20K分割上取得有竞争力的结果。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of multi-scale feature interaction in plain ViTs for dense prediction and the high cost of applying them to high-resolution inputs. It proposes ViT-CoMer, a ViT backbone that integrates CNN-style multi-scale pyramids with bidirectional feature interaction, enhancing local detail and cross-scale information flow while preserving global modeling. Compared with Swin and ViT-Adapter, it improves dense prediction without complex designs, reporting competitive results on COCO detection and ADE20K segmentation.
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.assessment: 面向检测/分割的ViT骨干改进，思路简洁且对自动驾驶感知中的密集预测有直接借鉴意义。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.contribution: 提出融合卷积多尺度特征交互的ViT骨干ViT-CoMer。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.innovation: 在ViT中并行引入CNN多尺度金字塔与双向跨尺度特征交互。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.result: 在COCO检测与ADE20K分割上取得有竞争力的性能。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo._arxiv_id: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions.

CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_cn: 针对ViT后训练量化（PTQ）在无数据场景下校准困难、且不同层对量化敏感度差异大的问题，本文提出CLAMP-ViT，一种无数据对比学习驱动的自适应后训练量化方法。方法利用对比学习合成/选择对量化敏感的样本，并据此自适应地为不同层分配比特宽度，无需原始训练数据。相比依赖真实校准集的PTQ方法，它在数据不可得时仍能保持精度。摘要报告在ImageNet上以低比特量化接近全精度精度。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of calibrating post-training quantization (PTQ) for ViTs when training data is unavailable and the varying bit-width sensitivity across layers. It proposes CLAMP-ViT, a data-free contrastive-learning framework that synthesizes quantization-sensitive samples and adaptively allocates bit-widths per layer without access to the original data. Compared with PTQ methods requiring real calibration sets, it preserves accuracy in the data-free regime, reporting near-full-precision results at low bit-widths on ImageNet.
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.assessment: 无数据PTQ对边缘部署ViT有实际意义，对比学习做敏感度感知的比特分配是较新颖的组合。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.contribution: 提出无数据对比学习驱动的ViT自适应后训练量化框架CLAMP-ViT。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.innovation: 用对比学习合成量化敏感样本并据此逐层自适应分配比特宽度。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.result: 在ImageNet低比特量化下接近全精度精度。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin._arxiv_id: CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learning for Adaptive Post-training Quantization of ViTs.

2403.01412|v2.summary_cn: 针对高光谱等信号采集带宽受限、数据量过大阻碍实时检测的问题，本文提出LUM-ViT，一种带可学习欠采样掩码的ViT变体，在采集前对信号进行调制以降低采集量。方法将可学习掩码嵌入ViT，并配合核级权值二值化与三阶段微调策略以适配光学计算。相比全采样流程，它仅采样10%像素即可将ImageNet分类精度损失控制在1.8%以内，并在真实光学硬件上保持接近原始精度。
2403.01412|v2.summary_en: This paper targets bandwidth-limited signal acquisition, where large data volumes (e.g., hyperspectral) hinder real-time detection. It proposes LUM-ViT, a ViT variant with a learnable under-sampling mask for pre-acquisition modulation, together with kernel-level weight binarization and a three-stage fine-tuning strategy tailored to optical computation. Compared with full-sampling pipelines, it samples only 10% of image pixels while keeping ImageNet accuracy loss within 1.8%, and sustains near-original accuracy on real optical hardware.
2403.01412|v2.assessment: 把可学习欠采样掩码与ViT结合用于采集前调制，对带宽受限的实时感知（如高光谱检测）有启发，且有真实硬件验证。
2403.01412|v2.contribution: 提出带可学习欠采样掩码的ViT变体LUM-ViT用于采集前调制。
2403.01412|v2.innovation: 将可学习欠采样掩码与核级权值二值化、三阶段微调结合以适配光学计算。
2403.01412|v2.result: 仅采样10%像素时ImageNet精度损失不超过1.8%，真实光学硬件上接近原始精度。

Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态推理中视觉与语言信息融合不充分的问题，提出了一种问题感知的视觉Transformer架构，使视觉编码过程能够根据输入问题进行动态调整。方法上通过将问题嵌入注入视觉Transformer的注意力机制，实现问题引导的视觉特征提取，而非传统的先独立编码视觉再融合的两阶段范式。相比已有工作，该方法在视觉编码阶段就实现了跨模态交互，提升了推理的针对性和效率。在多个多模态推理基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能，验证了问题感知视觉编码的有效性。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient vision-language fusion in multimodal reasoning by proposing a Question-Aware Vision Transformer that dynamically adapts visual encoding based on the input question. The method injects question embeddings into the attention mechanism of the vision transformer, enabling question-guided visual feature extraction rather than the conventional two-stage paradigm of independent visual encoding followed by fusion. It achieves superior performance on multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of question-aware visual encoding.
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.assessment: 该工作将问题信息前置到视觉编码阶段，思路新颖，对多模态感知与推理方向有启发意义，尤其对自动驾驶中基于VLM的场景理解有参考价值。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.contribution: 提出了问题感知的视觉Transformer架构，实现问题引导的视觉特征编码。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.innovation: 将语言问题嵌入注入视觉Transformer注意力机制，打破先编码后融合的传统范式。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.result: 在多个多模态推理基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu._arxiv_id: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning.

Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_cn: 该论文针对零样本学习（ZSL）中视觉特征与语义属性对齐不充分的问题，提出了渐进式语义引导的视觉Transformer。方法通过渐进式策略将语义信息逐步注入ViT的不同层级，引导视觉特征向语义空间对齐，从而提升对未见类别的识别能力。相比已有ZSL方法，该工作利用ViT的层级结构实现多粒度语义引导，改善了视觉-语义映射的质量。在标准ZSL基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper tackles the insufficient alignment between visual features and semantic attributes in zero-shot learning by proposing a Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer. The method progressively injects semantic information into different layers of ViT to guide visual features toward the semantic space, enhancing recognition of unseen classes. It achieves competitive results on standard ZSL benchmarks, improving visual-semantic mapping quality through multi-granularity semantic guidance.
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.assessment: 将ViT与零样本学习结合的工作，对开放集识别和开放词汇检测有一定借鉴意义，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务关联度有限。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.contribution: 提出了渐进式语义引导的视觉Transformer用于零样本学习。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.innovation: 利用ViT层级结构实现多粒度语义信息注入，改善视觉-语义对齐。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.result: 在标准ZSL基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans._arxiv_id: Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer for Zero-Shot Learning.

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉Transformer在下游任务微调时参数量大、计算成本高的问题，提出了基于残差设计方法的低秩缩放微调策略。方法通过残差设计视角分析低秩适配的结构，提出了一种低秩缩放（Low-Rank Rescaled）微调方案，在保持预训练知识的同时高效适配下游任务。相比现有PEFT方法，该工作在参数效率和性能之间取得了更好的平衡。在多个下游视觉任务上验证了方法的有效性。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_en: This paper addresses the high parameter and computational cost of fine-tuning vision transformers by proposing a Low-Rank Rescaled fine-tuning strategy from a residual design perspective. The method analyzes low-rank adaptation structures through residual design and introduces a rescaled low-rank scheme that efficiently adapts to downstream tasks while preserving pre-trained knowledge. It achieves a better balance between parameter efficiency and performance compared to existing PEFT methods across multiple downstream vision tasks.
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.assessment: 属于参数高效微调方向的工作，对大规模视觉模型在自动驾驶中的部署有间接价值，但领域相关度一般。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.contribution: 提出了基于残差设计的低秩缩放ViT微调方法。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.innovation: 从残差设计视角重新审视低秩适配结构，提出缩放策略。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.result: 在多个下游视觉任务上实现了参数效率与性能的更好平衡。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin._arxiv_id: Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fine-Tuning: A Residual Design Approach.

Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉Transformer对抗鲁棒性不足的问题，提出了随机纠缠Token（Random Entangled Tokens）方法。方法通过在ViT的token序列中引入随机纠缠机制，增加对抗攻击的难度，从而提升模型的对抗鲁棒性。相比已有对抗防御方法，该工作从token层面出发，在不显著损失干净样本性能的前提下增强了鲁棒性。在多个对抗攻击基准上验证了方法的有效性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient adversarial robustness of vision transformers by proposing Random Entangled Tokens. The method introduces a random entanglement mechanism into the token sequence of ViT to increase the difficulty of adversarial attacks, thereby enhancing model robustness. It improves robustness without significantly sacrificing clean accuracy compared to existing defense methods, as validated on multiple adversarial attack benchmarks.
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.assessment: 对抗鲁棒性对自动驾驶安全至关重要，该工作提供了token层面的新防御思路，但与感知核心任务的直接关联度中等。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.contribution: 提出了随机纠缠Token方法提升ViT对抗鲁棒性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.innovation: 在token序列层面引入随机纠缠机制增加攻击难度。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.result: 在多个对抗攻击基准上提升了鲁棒性且干净样本性能损失小。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall._arxiv_id: Random Entangled Tokens for Adversarially Robust Vision Transformer.

SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）在视觉任务中性能落后于传统ANN的问题，提出了SpikingResformer，将ResNet的残差结构与Vision Transformer架构融合到SNN中。方法设计了脉冲残差块和脉冲Transformer模块的混合架构，兼顾了SNN的低能耗优势和Transformer的全局建模能力。相比已有SNN方法，该工作在ImageNet等基准上取得了显著的性能提升，缩小了与ANN的差距。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap between spiking neural networks (SNNs) and traditional ANNs in vision tasks by proposing SpikingResformer, which bridges ResNet residual structures and Vision Transformer architecture within SNNs. The method designs a hybrid architecture combining spiking residual blocks and spiking transformer modules, balancing SNN energy efficiency with transformer global modeling capability. It achieves significant performance improvements on ImageNet and other benchmarks, narrowing the gap with ANNs.
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.assessment: 将ResNet与ViT融合到SNN中是新颖的架构探索，对低功耗边缘部署（如自动驾驶嵌入式平台）有潜在价值。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.contribution: 提出了融合ResNet与ViT的脉冲神经网络架构SpikingResformer。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.innovation: 在SNN中结合脉冲残差块与脉冲Transformer模块实现混合架构。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.result: 在ImageNet等基准上显著提升SNN性能，缩小与ANN的差距。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi._arxiv_id: SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vision Transformer in Spiking Neural Networks.

Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉Transformer可解释性不足的问题，提出了Token Transformation Matters方法，旨在为ViT提供忠实的后 hoc 解释。方法通过分析token变换过程对模型决策的贡献，设计了一种更忠实的后 hoc 解释方法。相比已有解释方法，该工作更准确地反映了ViT内部的信息流动和决策依据。在多个解释性评估指标上取得了改进。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of interpretability in vision transformers by proposing Token Transformation Matters, a faithful post-hoc explanation method for ViT. The method analyzes the contribution of token transformations to model decisions and designs a more faithful post-hoc explanation approach. It achieves improvements on multiple explanation evaluation metrics, more accurately reflecting the internal information flow and decision basis of ViT.
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.assessment: 可解释性对自动驾驶安全认证有重要意义，但该工作偏理论分析，与感知任务的直接关联度有限。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.contribution: 提出了面向ViT的忠实后 hoc 解释方法。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.innovation: 从token变换过程分析ViT决策依据，提升解释忠实度。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.result: 在多个解释性评估指标上取得改进。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa._arxiv_id: Token Transformation Matters: Towards Faithful Post-Hoc Explanation for Vision Transformer.

On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer（ViT）可解释性方法的忠实度（faithfulness）问题展开研究，即现有解释方法（如注意力图、梯度类方法）是否真实反映模型决策依据。作者系统性地评估了多种ViT解释方法的忠实度，并提出新的度量与基准来量化解释与模型实际行为之间的一致性。相比已有工作多依赖定性可视化，本文提供了更严格的定量评估框架，揭示了常用解释方法在忠实度上的不足。实验表明部分广泛使用的解释方法忠实度较低，为后续可解释性研究提供了重要参考。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper investigates the faithfulness of explanation methods for Vision Transformers, questioning whether widely used interpretability techniques truly reflect model decisions. The authors systematically evaluate existing ViT explanation methods and propose new metrics and benchmarks to quantify the alignment between explanations and actual model behavior. Experiments reveal that several popular explanation methods exhibit low faithfulness, providing a rigorous evaluation framework and important insights for future interpretability research.
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.assessment: 该工作对ViT可解释性领域的方法论提出了必要的质疑与量化标准，对关注模型可靠性的研究者有参考价值。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.contribution: 系统评估了ViT解释方法的忠实度并提出了量化基准。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.innovation: 首次对ViT解释方法的忠实度进行系统性定量分析并提出评估框架。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.result: 揭示了多种常用ViT解释方法忠实度不足的问题。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: On the Faithfulness of Vision Transformer Explanations.

SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer计算量大、内存消耗高的问题，提出了SHViT（Single-Head Vision Transformer），通过宏架构设计实现内存高效的ViT。方法核心包括单头注意力机制与精心设计的宏观结构，在减少计算冗余的同时保持表征能力。相比多头注意力和复杂架构设计，SHViT在精度与效率之间取得了更好的平衡。实验表明其在ImageNet等基准上以更低的计算量和内存占用达到有竞争力的精度。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory costs of Vision Transformers by proposing SHViT, a Single-Head Vision Transformer with a memory-efficient macro design. The method employs a single-head attention mechanism combined with a carefully designed macro architecture to reduce computational redundancy while maintaining representational capacity. Experiments show that SHViT achieves competitive accuracy on ImageNet with lower computation and memory footprint compared to multi-head and complex architecture baselines.
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.assessment: 该工作为ViT效率优化提供了简洁有效的设计思路，对需要在边缘设备部署视觉模型的研究者有参考意义。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.contribution: 提出了单头注意力与内存高效宏架构相结合的ViT设计。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.innovation: 通过单头注意力机制和宏架构优化同时降低ViT的计算与内存开销。

2402.03094|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD），目标是在标注样本极少的新领域中训练准确的目标检测器。作者首先利用风格、类间方差（ICV）和模糊边界（IB）三种度量分析域差距，建立了CD-FSOD基准，发现现有方法（包括DE-ViT等开放集检测器）跨域泛化能力不足。为此提出可学习实例特征对齐和实例重加权等模块来增强模型。实验表明所提方法在CD-FSOD基准上显著优于现有方法，有效缓解了域差距带来的性能下降。
2402.03094|v2.summary_en: This paper studies cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD), aiming to build accurate detectors for novel domains with minimal labeled examples. The authors analyze domain gaps using style, inter-class variance (ICV), and indefinable boundaries (IB), establish a CD-FSOD benchmark, and reveal that existing methods including open-set detectors like DE-ViT fail to generalize across domains. They propose learnable instance feature alignment and instance reweighting modules, achieving significant improvements over existing methods on the CD-FSOD benchmark.
2402.03094|v2.assessment: 该工作建立了有价值的CD-FSOD基准并提出了针对性解决方案，对少样本检测和域适应方向的研究者有较高参考价值。
2402.03094|v2.contribution: 建立了CD-FSOD基准并提出可学习实例特征对齐与重加权模块。
2402.03094|v2.innovation: 通过风格、ICV和IB三种度量系统分析域差距并据此设计增强模块。
2402.03094|v2.result: 在CD-FSOD基准上显著优于现有方法，有效缓解跨域性能下降。

2403.13298|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Rotary Position Embedding（RoPE）在视觉领域应用不足的问题，系统分析了RoPE在Vision Transformer中的效果。作者将RoPE适配到2D视觉数据并进行了全面的实验分析，发现RoPE具有出色的外推能力，即在推理时增大图像分辨率仍能保持精度。基于此，RoPE在ImageNet-1k分类、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割任务上均带来性能提升。该工作为在ViT中应用RoPE提供了详尽指南，且额外计算开销极小。
2403.13298|v2.summary_en: This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) applied to Vision Transformers, adapting RoPE for 2D vision data. The study reveals that RoPE exhibits impressive extrapolation capability, maintaining precision when increasing image resolution at inference, and leads to performance improvements on ImageNet-1k, COCO detection, and ADE-20k segmentation. The work offers thorough guidelines for applying RoPE in ViTs with minimal extra computational overhead.
2403.13298|v2.assessment: 该工作将语言模型中成功的RoPE引入视觉领域并进行了扎实的实验验证，对ViT骨干网络设计有实用价值。
2403.13298|v2.contribution: 系统分析了RoPE在ViT中的应用并验证了其外推能力和性能提升。
2403.13298|v2.innovation: 将RoPE适配到2D视觉数据并揭示其在分辨率外推上的优势。
2403.13298|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上均取得性能提升。

2402.03317|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer对对抗攻击脆弱的问题，提出了SpecFormer，通过最大奇异值惩罚（MSVP）增强ViT的鲁棒性。作者建立了自注意力层的局部Lipschitz界，并据此提出MSVP来精确控制这些界，将MSVP融入ViT注意力层以提升鲁棒性且不牺牲训练效率。在CIFAR和ImageNet数据集上的实验表明，SpecFormer在防御对抗攻击方面优于其他最先进模型。
2402.03317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of Vision Transformers to adversarial attacks by proposing SpecFormer, which uses Maximum Singular Value Penalization (MSVP) to enhance robustness. The authors establish local Lipschitz bounds for self-attention layers and incorporate MSVP into ViT attention layers to precisely manage these bounds without compromising training efficiency. Experiments on CIFAR and ImageNet demonstrate that SpecFormer outperforms state-of-the-art models in adversarial defense.
2402.03317|v2.assessment: 该工作为ViT对抗鲁棒性提供了有理论支撑的解决方案，对关注模型安全性的研究者有一定参考价值。
2402.03317|v2.contribution: 提出了基于最大奇异值惩罚的ViT对抗鲁棒性增强方法SpecFormer。
2402.03317|v2.innovation: 建立自注意力层局部Lipschitz界并据此设计MSVP进行精确鲁棒性控制。
2402.03317|v2.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet上对抗攻击防御性能优于现有最先进模型。

Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer在不同推理场景下计算成本固定的问题，提出了Token Compensator，能够在不重新微调的情况下改变ViT的推理成本。方法通过学习token补偿机制，使模型在减少token数量以降低推理成本时仍能保持性能。相比需要重新训练或微调的方案，该方法无需额外调优即可灵活调整推理开销。实验表明Token Compensator在多种ViT架构上有效降低了推理成本同时保持精度。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_en: This paper addresses the fixed inference cost of Vision Transformers by proposing Token Compensator, which alters inference cost without re-tuning. The method learns a token compensation mechanism that maintains performance when reducing token counts to lower inference cost. Unlike approaches requiring retraining or fine-tuning, it flexibly adjusts inference overhead without additional tuning, and experiments demonstrate effective cost reduction while preserving accuracy across various ViT architectures.
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.assessment: 该工作为ViT推理效率的动态调整提供了无需重训练的实用方案，对模型部署和效率优化方向有参考价值。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.contribution: 提出了无需重新微调即可改变ViT推理成本的Token Compensator方法。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.innovation: 通过学习token补偿机制实现推理成本的灵活调整而无需额外调优。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.result: 在多种ViT架构上有效降低推理成本同时保持精度。

2403.19638|v2.summary_cn: 传统音视频方法依赖独立的音频和视觉骨干网络，参数开销大且难以扩展。本文提出AVSiam，用单个共享ViT骨干同时处理音频和视觉输入，并采用对比音视频匹配目标与多比例随机掩码策略进行预训练，从而支持更大的实例批次。与以往方法不同，该模型能用同一共享ViT稳健处理音频、视觉及音视频三种输入。在AudioSet和VGGSound的音视频分类与检索任务上取得与独立骨干方法相当甚至更好的结果，同时提升参数效率并降低显存占用。
2403.19638|v2.summary_en: Traditional audio-visual methods rely on independent audio and visual backbones, which is costly and not scalable. This work proposes AVSiam, an audio-visual siamese network that uses a single shared ViT backbone with a contrastive matching objective and multi-ratio random masking, enabling larger instance batches and handling audio, visual, and audio-visual inputs. It achieves competitive or better results on AudioSet and VGGSound for classification and retrieval while improving parameter efficiency and reducing GPU memory.
2403.19638|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了共享ViT在多模态预训练中的可扩展性，对多模态感知的骨干设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶视觉核心任务关联较弱。
2403.19638|v2.contribution: 提出用单一共享ViT骨干进行可扩展音视频预训练的AVSiam框架。
2403.19638|v2.innovation: 共享ViT骨干结合多比例随机掩码的对比音视频匹配预训练。
2403.19638|v2.result: 在AudioSet和VGGSound上分类与检索达到与独立骨干方法相当或更优，且参数与显存更省。

2504.02508|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在超低比特后训练量化(PTQ)下精度显著下降的问题，现有基于重建的PTQ方法在ViT上因输出重要性估计不准和post-GELU激活量化困难而失效。作者提出APHQ-ViT，采用平均扰动Hessian(APH)损失改进重要性估计，并设计MLP重建(MR)方法，将MLP中的GELU替换为ReLU并在小型无标签校准集上用APH损失重建。实验表明该方法在超低比特线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，缓解了ViT量化精度损失。
2504.02508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe accuracy degradation of Vision Transformers under ultra-low-bit post-training quantization, where existing reconstruction-based PTQ methods fail due to inaccurate output importance estimation and difficulty in quantizing post-GELU activations. The authors propose APHQ-ViT, which introduces an Average Perturbation Hessian (APH) loss for improved importance estimation and an MLP Reconstruction (MR) method that replaces GELU with ReLU and reconstructs it using the APH loss on a small unlabeled calibration set. Extensive experiments demonstrate that APHQ-ViT substantially outperforms prior PTQ methods under ultra-low-bit linear quantization.
2504.02508|v2.assessment: 该工作系统分析了重建式PTQ在ViT上的失效原因并给出针对性改进，对模型压缩与高效部署方向有参考价值。
2504.02508|v2.contribution: 提出基于平均扰动Hessian的PTQ方法APHQ-ViT及MLP重建策略，解决ViT超低比特量化难题。
2504.02508|v2.innovation: 用平均扰动Hessian损失改进重要性估计，并以ReLU替换GELU重建MLP以应对post-GELU激活量化。
2504.02508|v2.result: 在超低比特线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，有效缓解ViT量化精度下降。

2503.12821|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)训练数据存在长尾(LT)分布问题，以往工作多聚焦CLIP/ViT架构及识别分类任务，对LLaVA类LVLM及VQA、视觉推理等通用任务探索不足。作者深入分析LVLM中的LT问题，识别出头部概念过表示与尾部概念欠表示两个核心原因，提出自适应数据精炼框架ADR，包含数据再平衡(DR)与数据合成(DS)两阶段，DR基于实体分布自适应重平衡冗余数据，DS利用去噪扩散概率模型合成数据。该框架在通用视觉语言任务上改善了长尾表示平衡。
2503.12821|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the long-tail (LT) data distribution problem in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), where prior work mainly focused on CLIP/ViT architectures and recognition/classification tasks, leaving LLaVA-style LVLMs and general tasks such as VQA and visual reasoning under-explored. The authors analyze the LT issue and identify two core causes: overrepresentation of head concepts and underrepresentation of tail concepts. They propose an Adaptive Data Refinement Framework (ADR) with two stages—Data Rebalancing (DR), which adaptively rebalances redundant data based on entity distributions, and Data Synthesis (DS), which leverages denoising diffusion probabilistic models. The framework improves balanced representation on general vision-language tasks.
2503.12821|v2.assessment: 该工作将长尾问题拓展到LVLM与通用视觉语言任务，分析扎实且框架设计合理，对多模态与数据平衡方向有参考价值。
2503.12821|v2.contribution: 提出自适应数据精炼框架ADR，通过数据再平衡与扩散合成缓解LVLM长尾问题。
2503.12821|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析LLaVA类LVLM在通用任务上的长尾成因，并结合实体分布重平衡与扩散合成。
2503.12821|v2.result: 在VQA与视觉推理等通用任务上改善了长尾表示平衡与性能。

2503.02394|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备部署困难、直接套用CNN二值化策略会导致显著性能下降的问题，作者提出BHViT——一种二值化友好的混合ViT架构及其全二值化模型。BHViT利用局部信息交互与由粗到细的层次特征聚合减少冗余token计算，提出基于移位操作的模块增强二值MLP性能而不显著增加开销，并设计基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法评估token重要性。该工作实现了ViT的高效二值化，在保持性能的同时降低计算与能耗。
2503.02394|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenges of Vision Transformers on edge devices, where directly applying binary CNN strategies causes significant performance drops due to architectural differences. The authors propose BHViT, a binarization-friendly hybrid ViT architecture and its fully binarized model, guided by three key observations. BHViT employs local information interaction and coarse-to-fine hierarchical feature aggregation to reduce redundant token computation, introduces a shift-based module to enhance the binary MLP without significant overhead, and designs a quantization-decomposition-based attention matrix binarization method to evaluate token importance. The work achieves efficient ViT binarization with reduced computation and energy cost.
2503.02394|v2.assessment: 该工作针对ViT二值化的结构适配问题提出系统性设计，对边缘部署与模型压缩方向有实用价值。
2503.02394|v2.contribution: 提出二值化友好的混合ViT架构BHViT及其全二值化模型。
2503.02394|v2.innovation: 结合移位操作增强二值MLP与量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化，实现ViT高效二值化。
2503.02394|v2.result: 在保持性能的同时显著降低ViT计算与能耗，优于直接套用CNN二值化策略。

2412.12032|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对真实人脸图像缺乏鲁棒且可迁移表征的问题，提出自监督预训练框架FSFM，结合掩码图像建模（MIM）与实例判别（ID）。方法上设计了CRFR-P掩码策略强制模型捕获区域内一致性和区域间连贯性，并通过自蒸馏建立局部到全局对应关系（3C目标）。相比已有工作，FSFM在10个公开数据集上对跨数据集deepfake检测、跨域人脸防伪和未见扩散伪造检测均取得更优泛化性能。
2412.12032|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the lack of robust and transferable facial representations from unlabeled real faces by proposing FSFM, a self-supervised pretraining framework that synergizes masked image modeling (MIM) and instance discrimination (ID). It introduces CRFR-P masking to enforce intra-region consistency and inter-region coherency, and a self-distillation-based ID network for local-to-global correspondence. Extensive experiments on 10 public datasets show improved generalization for cross-dataset deepfake detection, cross-domain face anti-spoofing, and unseen diffusion forgery detection.
2412.12032|v2.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习系统性地引入人脸安全领域，掩码策略和自蒸馏设计有参考价值，但与人脸安全而非通用视觉感知更相关。
2412.12032|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向人脸安全任务的自监督基础模型FSFM，统一了MIM与实例判别。
2412.12032|v2.innovation: 设计CRFR-P掩码策略和自蒸馏ID网络，实现局部特征与全局语义的联合编码。
2412.12032|v2.result: 在10个公开数据集上，跨数据集deepfake检测、跨域防伪和未见扩散伪造检测均取得更优泛化性能。

2508.20063|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇多视角室内3D目标检测中缺乏人工标注的问题，提出OpenM3D，一种无需人工标注的单阶段开放词汇检测器。方法上基于ImGeoNet的2D诱导体素特征，联合训练类别无关的3D定位损失和体素-语义对齐损失，并利用图嵌入技术将2D分割合并为连贯3D结构以生成高质量3D伪框。相比OV-3DET等已有方法，其伪框在精度和召回率上更高，且通过多样化的CLIP特征采样实现了更准确的单阶段检测。
2508.20063|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary multi-view indoor 3D object detection without human annotations by proposing OpenM3D, a single-stage detector adapting 2D-induced voxel features from ImGeoNet. It jointly trains a class-agnostic 3D localization loss with high-quality pseudo boxes and a voxel-semantic alignment loss with diverse CLIP features, using graph embedding to combine 2D segments into coherent 3D structures. The pseudo boxes achieve higher precision and recall than OV-3DET, enabling accurate single-stage detection.
2508.20063|v2.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇检测扩展到多视角室内3D场景且无需人工标注，图嵌入伪框生成和CLIP对齐思路对BEV/3D感知有借鉴意义。
2508.20063|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工标注的开放词汇多视角室内3D检测器OpenM3D。
2508.20063|v2.innovation: 利用图嵌入生成高质量3D伪框，并采样多样化CLIP特征进行体素-语义对齐。
2508.20063|v2.result: 伪框精度和召回率优于OV-3DET等方法，实现了准确的单阶段开放词汇3D检测。

2503.08101|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于查询的3D目标检测模型在边缘设备上计算量大的问题，提出零样本运行时剪枝方法tgGBC。方法上根据分类分数扩展注意力图计算每个key的重要性分数，并在每层transformer后逐步剪枝不重要的key。相比需要重训练或面向ViT的剪枝蒸馏方法，tgGBC无需重训练即可在ToC3D模型上实现1.99倍transformer解码器加速，性能损失小于1%，部分模型甚至性能提升，并成功部署到边缘设备。
2503.08101|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational burden of query-based 3D object detectors on edge devices by proposing tgGBC, a zero-shot runtime pruning method for transformer decoders. It computes key importance scores by multiplying classification scores with attention maps and gradually prunes unimportant keys after each transformer layer. Without retraining, tgGBC achieves a 1.99x speedup on the ToC3D model's transformer decoder with less than 1% performance loss, and even improves some models, enabling edge deployment.
2503.08101|v2.assessment: 该工作为3D检测模型的高效推理提供了无需重训练的实用剪枝方案，对自动驾驶边缘部署有直接价值。
2503.08101|v2.contribution: 提出零样本运行时注意力key剪枝方法tgGBC，加速3D检测transformer解码器。
2503.08101|v2.innovation: 利用分类分数引导注意力图计算key重要性，实现逐层渐进剪枝且无需重训练。
2503.08101|v2.result: 在ToC3D上实现1.99倍解码器加速，性能损失小于1%，部分模型性能提升。

2508.20265|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在开放词汇分割中定位能力差的问题，提出一种无需训练、反馈驱动的自自适应框架。方法上将基于输出的patch级对应关系反馈到中间注意力，利用输出预测作为更强的空间连贯先验，并设计注意力隔离、基于置信度的稀疏剪枝和自适应集成等模块。相比仅修改中间注意力的已有方法，该框架作为即插即用模块增强了内部表示与最终预测的语义一致性，提升了开放词汇分割性能。
2508.20265|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's poor localization for open-vocabulary segmentation by proposing a training-free, feedback-driven self-adaptive framework that feeds output-based patch-level correspondences back to intermediate attention. It leverages output predictions as a stronger spatial coherence prior and designs attention isolation, confidence-based pruning, and adaptation ensemble modules. As a plug-in, it enhances semantic consistency between internal representations and final predictions, improving open-vocabulary segmentation.
2508.20265|v2.assessment: 该工作为CLIP的开放词汇分割提供了一种无需训练的即插即用增强思路，但更偏向分割任务而非自动驾驶感知。
2508.20265|v2.contribution: 提出反馈驱动的自自适应注意力框架，将输出级对应关系反馈至中间注意力。
2508.20265|v2.innovation: 利用输出预测作为空间连贯先验，并设计稀疏自适应与集成模块实现即插即用。
2508.20265|v2.result: 作为即插即用模块提升了CLIP开放词汇分割的语义一致性和性能。

2411.13836|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在像素级开放词汇语义分割中空间表示不足的问题，提出分层框架CLIPer。方法上包含早期层融合模块和细粒度补偿模块：利用早期层嵌入和注意力图保留的空间结构信息生成更连贯的分割图，并借助扩散模型的自注意力图补偿局部细节。在七个分割数据集上，CLIPer取得了最先进的性能，优于替换最后一层自注意力图等已有方法。
2411.13836|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's insufficient spatial representation for pixel-level open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by proposing CLIPer, a hierarchical framework with an early-layer fusion module and a fine-grained compensation module. It leverages early-layer embeddings and attention maps for better spatial coherence, and uses diffusion model self-attention maps to compensate local details. CLIPer achieves state-of-the-art performance on seven segmentation datasets.
2411.13836|v2.assessment: 该工作通过分层利用CLIP早期层和扩散模型先验提升分割空间表示，思路清晰，但应用场景偏向通用分割。
2411.13836|v2.contribution: 提出分层框架CLIPer，逐级改进CLIP的空间表示用于开放词汇分割。
2411.13836|v2.innovation: 结合早期层融合与扩散模型自注意力补偿，兼顾空间连贯性和局部细节。
2411.13836|v2.result: 在七个分割数据集上取得最先进性能。

2507.19131|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对窗口式视觉Transformer的高效推理问题，提出混合精度激活量化框架Mixa-Q。方法上利用层内激活稀疏性，将Swin块内的批量窗口计算分离，对不重要窗口的激活分配更低比特宽度，并设计双分支Swin块分别处理高低比特精度激活，可无缝集成到QAT和PTQ方法中。在COCO数据集上，PTQ配置下实现1.35倍无训练加速且无精度损失，QAT下实现1.25倍无损加速，结合激活剪枝可达1.53倍加速仅损失1% mAP。
2507.19131|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient inference of window-based vision transformers by proposing MixA-Q, a mixed-precision activation quantization framework that exploits intra-layer activation sparsity. It separates batched window computations within Swin blocks and assigns lower bit widths to less important windows, using a Two-Branch Swin Block for high- and low-bit activations, compatible with QAT and PTQ. On COCO, it achieves a training-free 1.35x speedup without accuracy loss in PTQ, 1.25x lossless speedup with QAT, and 1.53x speedup with only 1% mAP drop when combined with activation pruning.
2507.19131|v2.assessment: 该工作将激活稀疏性与混合精度量化结合，为ViT高效推理提供了实用方案，对检测模型部署有参考价值。
2507.19131|v2.contribution: 提出混合精度激活量化框架Mixa-Q，利用层内激活稀疏性加速窗口式ViT。
2507.19131|v2.innovation: 设计双分支Swin块，按窗口重要性分配不同比特宽度，兼容QAT和PTQ。
2507.19131|v2.result: COCO上PTQ实现1.35倍无训练加速无精度损失，QAT实现1.25倍无损加速，结合剪枝达1.53倍加速仅损失1% mAP。

2506.21046|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对黑盒对抗迁移性不足的问题，探索自监督ViT特征能否提升对抗样本的迁移性。作者提出dSVA，一种生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击方法，同时利用对比学习（CL）的全局结构特征和掩码图像建模（MIM）的局部纹理特征，并设计生成器训练框架结合联合特征与自监督ViT的注意力机制。相比此前仅依赖监督学习特征的方法，dSVA在CL与MIM互补特征上挖掘了ViT的独特注意力分布。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称显著提升了黑盒迁移性。
2506.21046|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether self-supervised Vision Transformer (ViT) representations can improve adversarial transferability. It proposes dSVA, a generative dual self-supervised ViT feature attack that exploits both global structural features from contrastive learning and local textural features from masked image modeling, with a novel generative training framework incorporating a generator and self-supervised ViT attention. Compared to prior work relying solely on supervised features, dSVA leverages the complementary nature of CL and MIM to boost black-box transferability.
2506.21046|v2.assessment: 将自监督ViT特征引入对抗攻击是一个新颖视角，对理解ViT表示与鲁棒性关系有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2506.21046|v2.contribution: 提出生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击框架dSVA，首次联合利用CL与MIM特征提升对抗迁移性。
2506.21046|v2.innovation: 利用自监督ViT的CL全局特征与MIM局部纹理特征的互补性，并结合注意力机制训练生成器。
2506.21046|v2.result: 摘要声称显著提升黑盒对抗迁移性，但未提供具体量化指标。

Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_cn: 该论文针对预训练ViT在下游任务适配时全量微调代价高的问题，提出一种近似正交微调策略（Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning）。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推断，其核心是通过近似正交约束在参数高效微调中保持预训练知识，同时提升适配效率。相比LoRA、Adapter等PEFT方法，正交性约束可能带来更好的知识保持与任务适配平衡。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of full fine-tuning pre-trained Vision Transformers for downstream adaptation by proposing an Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning strategy. The abstract is empty, so specific methodological details and experimental results are unavailable. Based on the title, the approach likely enforces approximate orthogonality constraints to preserve pre-trained knowledge while enabling efficient adaptation, potentially offering a better trade-off than existing PEFT methods like LoRA or Adapters.
