2507.12988|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对结构化剪枝后需大量重训练甚至从头训练才能恢复精度的问题，提出Variance-Based Pruning——一种简单的一次性结构化剪枝技术，仅需极少微调。方法先收集激活统计量用于选择剪枝神经元，同时将均值激活整合回模型以保持高性能。在ImageNet-1k上，DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%的原始性能，避免了数百epoch的重训练。相比传统结构化剪枝方法，其核心改进在于利用方差信息与均值补偿实现一次性高效压缩。
2507.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the costly retraining required by structured pruning to recover accuracy, proposing Variance-Based Pruning, a simple one-shot structured pruning technique with minimal fine-tuning. It gathers activation statistics to select neurons and integrates mean activations back into the model to preserve performance. On ImageNet-1k, DeiT-Base retains over 70% of its original performance directly after pruning, avoiding hundreds of retraining epochs. The key improvement over prior structured pruning is the use of variance-based selection and mean compensation for efficient one-shot compression.
2507.12988|v2.assessment: 一次性结构化剪枝且无需大量重训练，对部署预训练大模型（包括自动驾驶中的ViT骨干）有实际工程价值，方法简洁有效。
2507.12988|v2.contribution: 提出基于方差的激活统计一次性结构化剪枝方法，结合均值补偿保持精度。
2507.12988|v2.innovation: 利用激活方差选择剪枝神经元并将均值激活整合回模型，实现极少微调下的高效压缩。
2507.12988|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1k上DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%原始性能，无需数百epoch重训练。

2407.11306|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Transformer自注意力计算复杂度高的问题，提出PADRe——一种统一的多项式注意力替代框架。PADRe利用多项式函数和近似理论，将Hyena、Mamba、SimA、Conv2Former、Castling-ViT等近期注意力变体统一为特例，其核心组件为乘法非线性（如Hadamard积），仅需线性计算和内存开销，且无需Softmax。在图像分类、2D目标检测和3D点云目标检测等任务上，PADRe作为自注意力的即插即用替代，运行速度显著更快且精度相当或更优。
2407.11306|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational complexity of self-attention in Transformers by proposing PADRe, a unifying polynomial attention drop-in replacement framework. PADRe leverages polynomial functions and approximation theory, subsuming recent variants like Hyena, Mamba, SimA, Conv2Former, and Castling-ViT as special cases. Its key components are multiplicative nonlinearities implemented via hardware-friendly Hadamard products, incurring only linear computational and memory costs without Softmax. Across image classification, 2D object detection, and 3D point cloud object detection, PADRe runs significantly faster with comparable or superior accuracy.
2407.11306|v2.assessment: 统一多种高效注意力机制的理论框架，且在2D/3D检测任务上验证，对自动驾驶中ViT骨干的加速有直接参考价值。
2407.11306|v2.contribution: 提出统一多项式注意力替代框架PADRe，将多种高效注意力变体纳入同一理论体系。
2407.11306|v2.innovation: 基于近似理论用多项式函数和Hadamard积替代Softmax注意力，实现线性复杂度且统一现有方法。
2407.11306|v2.result: 在图像分类、2D检测和3D点云检测上运行速度显著更快，精度相当或更优。

Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）与视觉Transformer结合时，传统自注意力机制在脉冲域中计算开销大、难以捕捉动态视觉显著性的问题，提出了带有扫视注意力（Saccadic Attention）的脉冲视觉Transformer（Spiking Vision Transformer）。方法上，作者将生物视觉中的扫视机制引入脉冲Transformer，设计了一种稀疏、事件驱动的注意力计算方式，仅对显著区域进行脉冲注意力交互，从而降低脉冲发放率和计算量。相比已有脉冲Transformer工作，该方法在保持脉冲神经网络低功耗优势的同时，提升了模型对动态场景中关键区域的关注能力。在分类任务上，该方法在保持或略微提升精度的同时显著降低了脉冲发放率和能耗，但摘要中未给出具体数据集和数值结果。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and difficulty of capturing dynamic visual saliency when combining spiking neural networks (SNNs) with vision transformers. It proposes a Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention, which introduces a bio-inspired saccadic mechanism to perform sparse, event-driven attention only on salient regions, reducing spike firing rates and computation. Compared with existing spiking transformers, it better preserves the low-power advantage of SNNs while improving focus on key dynamic regions, though the abstract lacks specific dataset and numerical results.
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.assessment: 该工作将生物扫视机制与脉冲Transformer结合，思路新颖，对低功耗视觉感知有潜在价值，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑，且与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.contribution: 提出了一种融合扫视注意力的脉冲视觉Transformer架构，实现了稀疏事件驱动的注意力计算。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.innovation: 将生物视觉扫视机制引入脉冲Transformer，以稀疏注意力降低脉冲发放率和计算开销。

2106.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT模型规模大、训练成本高的问题，本文首次系统探索了在ViT中端到端集成稀疏性的统一方法。方法上不训练完整ViT，而是动态提取并训练固定小参数预算的稀疏子网络，同时联合优化模型参数与连接性，并将方法从非结构化稀疏扩展到结构化稀疏（引导自注意力头的剪枝与生长），还引入可学习token选择器协同探索数据与架构稀疏。在ImageNet上，该方法在降低训练内存与推理复杂度的同时未牺牲精度，为ViT的高效训练与部署提供了新范式。
2106.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive end-to-end exploration of integrating sparsity into Vision Transformers, training dynamically extracted sparse subnetworks under a fixed small parameter budget instead of full ViTs. It jointly optimizes model parameters and connectivity, extends from unstructured to structured sparsity by guiding prune-and-grow of self-attention heads, and co-explores data and architecture sparsity via a learnable token selector. Extensive ImageNet results show reduced training memory and inference complexity without sacrificing accuracy.
2106.04533|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地将稀疏训练引入ViT，覆盖非结构化/结构化稀疏与数据稀疏，实验扎实，对高效ViT训练有较强参考价值。
2106.04533|v2.contribution: 首次在ViT中端到端统一集成模型、结构与数据稀疏性，实现训练与推理双重高效。
2106.04533|v2.innovation: 动态提取稀疏子网络并联合优化连接性，配合可学习token选择器协同探索数据与架构稀疏。
2106.04533|v2.result: 在ImageNet上降低训练内存与推理复杂度的同时保持与密集ViT相当的精度。

2111.14725|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT架构依赖人工设计的问题，本文提出用神经架构搜索自动化该过程，不仅搜索架构还搜索搜索空间本身。核心思想是利用权重共享超网计算E-T Error，引导不同搜索维度逐步演化。作者还基于空间搜索过程给出通用ViT设计指南，加深了对ViT的理解。搜索得到的S3模型在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT和ViT，并在目标检测、语义分割和VQA等下游任务上验证了通用性。
2111.14725|v2.summary_en: This paper automates Vision Transformer design via neural architecture search that searches not only the architecture but also the search space, gradually evolving search dimensions guided by E-T Error computed with a weight-sharing supernet. It provides design guidelines for general vision transformers derived from the space searching process. The searched S3 models outperform Swin, DeiT and ViT on ImageNet and generalize to object detection, semantic segmentation and VQA.
2111.14725|v2.assessment: 将NAS扩展到搜索空间本身是亮点，S3在分类与下游任务上均表现优异，对ViT架构设计有指导意义。
2111.14725|v2.contribution: 提出同时搜索架构与搜索空间的NAS方法，并给出通用ViT设计指南。
2111.14725|v2.innovation: 以权重共享超网的E-T Error引导搜索维度逐步演化，实现搜索空间的自动进化。
2111.14725|v2.result: S3在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT、ViT，并在检测、分割、VQA等任务上验证通用性。

2110.15156|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT中不连续的patch化tokenization隐式引入锯齿伪影、导致注意力图出现混叠（aliasing）的问题，本文首次分析并探索在ViT中引入抗混叠特性。提出即插即用的混叠抑制模块ARM来缓解该问题，并在多种任务和多个ViT家族上验证其有效性与泛化性。该轻量设计在多个知名结构上稳定带来明显提升，同时改善了ViT的数据效率与鲁棒性。
2110.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies and analyzes the aliasing problem in Vision Transformers caused by discontinuous patch-wise tokenization that introduces jagged artifacts into attention maps. It proposes a plug-and-play Aliasing-Reduction Module (ARM) to alleviate this issue, validated across multiple tasks and ViT families. The lightweight design consistently boosts several well-known architectures and improves data efficiency and robustness.
2110.15156|v2.assessment: 从信号处理角度切入ViT的混叠问题较新颖，ARM即插即用且泛化性好，对ViT基础结构改进有参考价值。
2110.15156|v2.contribution: 首次揭示ViT中的混叠问题并提出即插即用的抗混叠模块ARM。
2110.15156|v2.innovation: 将传统抗混叠思想引入ViT的patch tokenization与注意力图处理中。
2110.15156|v2.result: 在多个ViT家族与任务上稳定提升性能，并改善数据效率与鲁棒性。

2106.03348|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT将图像视为1D token序列、缺乏建模局部结构与尺度变化的固有归纳偏置（IB）、需依赖大规模数据和长训练周期隐式学习的问题，本文提出ViTAE，从卷积中显式引入固有归纳偏置。技术上，ViTAE使用多个不同膨胀率的卷积构成空间金字塔缩减模块，将输入下采样嵌入为具多尺度上下文的token，获得尺度不变性；每层Transformer中并行一个卷积块与多头自注意力融合后送入FFN，获得局部性。由此在多种视觉任务上以更少数据与训练成本取得强表征能力。
2106.03348|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes ViTAE, a Vision Transformer that explicitly incorporates intrinsic inductive bias from convolutions to address ViT's lack of locality and scale invariance. ViTAE uses spatial pyramid reduction modules with multiple dilation rates to embed multi-scale context into tokens, and places a convolution block in parallel with multi-head self-attention in each transformer layer for locality. This yields robust representations for objects at various scales with reduced data and training requirements.
2106.03348|v2.assessment: 将卷积的归纳偏置显式注入ViT是务实且有效的思路，多尺度与局部性设计清晰，对数据高效ViT研究有参考价值。
2106.03348|v2.contribution: 提出ViTAE，通过卷积显式引入尺度不变性与局部性归纳偏置以增强ViT。
2106.03348|v2.innovation: 用多膨胀率卷积构成空间金字塔缩减模块，并在每层并行卷积块与自注意力融合。
2106.03348|v2.result: 在多种视觉任务上以更少数据和训练成本获得强表征与稳健性能。

2106.02277|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer自注意力对序列长度二次复杂度、难以用于高分辨率密集预测的问题，本文提出GG-Transformer，受人类"扫视-凝视"行为启发，用两条并行分支分别建模长程依赖与局部上下文：Glance分支在自适应膨胀划分上做自注意力，Gaze分支处理局部窗口。相比标准ViT，该方法在保持紧凑模型规模的同时显著降低计算与内存开销，并在分类、分割、检测等密集预测任务上取得优于同期Transformer的精度-效率折衷。
2106.02277|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic complexity of self-attention that hinders vision Transformers on high-resolution dense prediction. It proposes GG-Transformer, inspired by human glance-and-gaze behavior, with two parallel branches: a Glance branch performing self-attention on adaptively dilated partitions and a Gaze branch capturing local context. The design achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than standard ViTs on classification, segmentation and detection.
2106.02277|v2.assessment: 对Transformer在密集预测任务中的效率瓶颈给出了有生物启发的解法，思路清晰，对BEV/多相机感知中高分辨率特征建模有参考价值。
2106.02277|v2.contribution: 提出Glance-and-Gaze双分支视觉Transformer，兼顾长程依赖与局部上下文并降低自注意力开销。
2106.02277|v2.innovation: 用自适应膨胀划分的Glance分支与局部Gaze分支并行模拟人类扫视-凝视识别机制。
2106.02277|v2.result: 在分类、分割与检测等密集预测任务上取得优于同期Transformer的精度-效率折衷。

HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_cn: 本文针对密集预测任务（如语义分割、姿态估计、检测）中高分辨率表示与Transformer全局建模难以兼得的问题，提出HRFormer，将高分辨率卷积结构与Transformer结合，在保持高分辨率特征图的同时引入多分辨率并行与局部窗口自注意力。相比Swin等需要上采样恢复分辨率的方案，HRFormer原生维持高分辨率表示，在COCO姿态估计与ADE20K分割等密集预测基准上以更少参数和计算量取得领先或相当精度。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_en: This paper targets dense prediction where high-resolution representation and Transformer global modeling are hard to reconcile, and proposes HRFormer, which couples high-resolution convolutions with Transformers via multi-resolution parallelism and local-window self-attention. Unlike Swin-style backbones that recover resolution by upsampling, HRFormer natively maintains high-resolution features and achieves leading or comparable accuracy with fewer parameters and FLOPs on COCO pose estimation and ADE20K segmentation.
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.assessment: 高分辨率Transformer骨干对BEV/分割类感知任务有直接借鉴意义，架构设计成熟，实验覆盖主流密集预测基准。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.contribution: 提出原生保持高分辨率表示的高效视觉Transformer骨干HRFormer。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.innovation: 将高分辨率并行卷积结构与局部窗口自注意力结合，避免上采样恢复分辨率。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.result: 在COCO姿态估计与ADE20K分割上以更少参数和计算量达到领先或相当精度。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo._arxiv_id: HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transformer for Dense Predict.

2112.13528|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对显著目标检测中潜变量先验表达能力不足的问题，提出带能量基先验的生成式视觉Transformer：将Transformer与能量基先验模型联合训练，通过基于MCMC的最大似然估计并用Langevin动力学从难解的后验与先验中采样。与将潜变量先验设为各向同性高斯分布的既有生成模型不同，能量基信息先验能更充分刻画数据潜空间，并可输出像素级不确定性图。在RGB与RGB-D显著目标检测上取得更准确的显著图与更可靠的不确定性估计。
2112.13528|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited expressiveness of latent priors in generative models for salient object detection by proposing a generative vision Transformer with an energy-based informative prior, jointly trained via MCMC-based maximum likelihood with Langevin dynamics for sampling. Unlike prior generative models assuming an isotropic Gaussian prior, it captures the latent space more expressively and yields pixel-wise uncertainty maps. Experiments on RGB and RGB-D saliency show more accurate predictions and reliable uncertainty.
2112.13528|v2.assessment: 能量基先验与Transformer结合及不确定性建模思路有新意，但任务偏显著检测，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2112.13528|v2.contribution: 提出带能量基信息先验的生成式视觉Transformer用于显著目标检测。
2112.13528|v2.innovation: 用能量基先验替代各向同性高斯先验，并通过Langevin动力学联合训练以输出像素级不确定性。
2112.13528|v2.result: 在RGB与RGB-D显著目标检测上取得更准确的显著图与更可靠的不确定性估计。

2106.05656|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对视觉自监督预训练中Transformer潜力未被充分挖掘、且既有方法仅从全局视角学习高层特征而难以迁移到关注局部特征的密集预测任务的问题，提出MST。受NLP中掩码语言建模启发，MST基于多头自注意力图动态掩码部分局部patch token而不破坏关键结构，并用全局图像解码器同时恢复被掩码与保留的token以保留空间信息。在多个数据集上的实验表明该方法对下游密集预测任务具有更好的迁移性与表征质量。
2106.05656|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underexplored potential of Transformers in visual self-supervised learning and the poor transferability of global-only representations to dense prediction. It proposes MST, which dynamically masks local patch tokens based on multi-head self-attention maps, inspired by masked language modeling, and recovers both masked and remaining tokens with a global image decoder that preserves spatial information. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate improved transferability to downstream dense prediction tasks.
2106.05656|v2.assessment: 掩码自监督与密集预测迁移的结合对自动驾驶感知预训练有实用价值，方法简洁且与后续MAE系列思路一脉相承。
2106.05656|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力图动态掩码的掩码自监督Transformer预训练框架MST。
2106.05656|v2.innovation: 利用多头自注意力图动态选择掩码token，并用全局解码器保留空间信息以适配密集预测。
2106.05656|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了对下游密集预测任务更好的迁移性与表征效果。

2303.01788|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶多任务感知缺乏统一评测基准、且现有多任务方法相比单任务基线仍有明显性能差距的问题；②论文在大规模驾驶数据集上系统评测了主流多任务学习方法，覆盖目标检测、语义分割、可行驶区域分割和车道线检测四项任务，并提出 VE-Prompt 框架，通过任务特定的视觉示例提示（visual exemplar prompting）引导模型学习高质量的任务特定表征；③相比现有多任务方法，VE-Prompt 利用视觉示例作为提示来缓解任务间干扰，提升任务特定表征质量；④摘要未给出具体数值，但指出已有方法虽在进步，与单任务基线仍存在较大差距，VE-Prompt 旨在缩小该差距。
2303.01788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for multi-task perception in autonomous driving and the persistent performance gap between existing multi-task methods and single-task baselines. It extensively evaluates popular multi-task learning methods on a large-scale driving dataset across object detection, semantic segmentation, drivable area segmentation, and lane detection, and proposes VE-Prompt, a framework that introduces visual exemplars via task-specific prompting to guide the model toward high-quality task-specific representations. The method aims to mitigate task interference and narrow the gap to single-task baselines.
2303.01788|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶多任务感知提供了较为系统的评测分析，并给出一个简洁有效的提示式多任务框架，对多任务感知研究者有参考价值。
2303.01788|v2.contribution: 构建了自动驾驶四项感知任务的统一多任务评测，并提出基于视觉示例提示的 VE-Prompt 多任务框架。
2303.01788|v2.innovation: 将任务特定的视觉示例以提示形式引入多任务学习，引导模型学习任务特定表征以缓解任务干扰。
2303.01788|v2.result: 系统分析表明现有多任务方法仍显著落后于单任务基线，VE-Prompt 被提出以缩小该性能差距。

Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中道路异常检测（road anomaly detection）问题，即识别训练集中未出现的未知障碍物（如散落货物、动物等），这类目标对行车安全至关重要但难以通过常规监督检测器覆盖。作者提出基于部分图像重建（partial image reconstruction）的方法，并引入语义分割耦合（segmentation coupling）机制，利用分割先验约束重建过程，使模型对偏离正常道路语义的区域产生高重建误差从而定位异常。相比纯重建或纯分割的已有方法，该方法通过耦合两者缓解了重建网络对异常区域也能良好重建（即泛化过强）的问题。摘要中未给出具体量化结果，需结合全文实验验证其在道路异常基准上的表现。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_en: This paper addresses road anomaly detection for autonomous driving, where the goal is to identify unknown obstacles absent from training data. The authors propose a partial image reconstruction framework coupled with semantic segmentation, using segmentation priors to constrain reconstruction so that semantically abnormal regions yield high reconstruction error. Compared with pure reconstruction or segmentation baselines, the coupling mitigates the tendency of reconstruction networks to generalize too well to anomalies. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract and require the full paper for verification.
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.assessment: 面向自动驾驶安全的长尾/开放集异常检测问题具有实际价值，分割耦合重建的思路对开放集检测研究者有参考意义，但需关注其定量实验与基准对比是否充分。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.contribution: 提出将部分图像重建与语义分割耦合的道路异常检测框架，利用分割先验约束重建以突出异常区域。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.innovation: 通过分割耦合缓解重建模型对异常区域泛化过强、重建误差不显著的问题。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，效果需依据全文实验评估。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image._arxiv_id: Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image Reconstruction with Segmentation Coupling.

OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对当前缺乏大规模、标准化评测基准来评估环视语义占用感知（surrounding semantic occupancy perception）的问题，本文提出了 OpenOccupancy 大规模基准。该基准包含密集的语义占用标注、多模态传感器数据以及统一的评测协议，并提供了强基线方法。相比已有小规模或稀疏标注的数据集，OpenOccupancy 在规模、标注密度和任务多样性上均有显著提升，为环视占用感知研究提供了标准化平台。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenOccupancy, a large-scale benchmark for surrounding semantic occupancy perception, addressing the lack of standardized evaluation platforms. It provides dense semantic occupancy annotations, multi-modal sensor data, and unified evaluation protocols with strong baselines. Compared to existing small-scale or sparsely annotated datasets, OpenOccupancy significantly advances scale, annotation density, and task diversity.
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.assessment: 作为占用感知领域的首个大规模基准，对推动该方向标准化评测和算法发展具有重要价值，值得关注。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.contribution: 提出了首个大规模环视语义占用感知基准 OpenOccupancy，包含密集标注与统一评测协议。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.innovation: 构建了大规模、多模态、密集语义占用标注的标准化评测平台。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.result: 为环视占用感知提供了标准化基准和强基线，推动了该领域的可复现研究。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f._arxiv_id: OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark for Surrounding Semantic Occupancy Perception.

2308.01471|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中感知与预测分离导致的安全隐患（检测召回受限）以及稠密占用流网格计算开销大、感受野受限的问题，本文提出了一种隐式占用流场（Implicit Occupancy Flow Fields）方法。该方法用单一神经网络隐式表示随时间变化的占用与流场，可被运动规划器在连续时空位置直接查询，避免了对无关区域的计算。相比显式占用预测方法，该架构通过增加高效模块克服了有限感受野问题，在保持感知与预测统一的同时提升了效率。
2308.01471|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the safety concerns of detection-then-forecasting pipelines and the computational cost of dense occupancy-flow grids by proposing implicit occupancy flow fields. A single neural network implicitly represents occupancy and flow over time, queryable by the motion planner at continuous spatio-temporal locations, avoiding unnecessary computation. The architecture overcomes the limited receptive field of explicit occupancy prediction methods via an efficient module, unifying perception and prediction.
2308.01471|v2.assessment: 将感知与预测统一为隐式表示并支持规划器按需查询，思路新颖，对自动驾驶端到端感知-预测-规划一体化有启发意义。
2308.01471|v2.contribution: 提出隐式占用流场，用单一网络统一感知与未来预测并支持连续时空查询。
2308.01471|v2.innovation: 以隐式神经表示替代显式稠密网格，避免无关计算并克服有限感受野。
2308.01471|v2.result: 在避免不必要计算的同时实现了感知与预测的统一，提升了效率与召回潜力。

ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_cn: 针对3D点云上采样与细化中任意尺度放大和局部几何保真度不足的问题，本文提出了 ASUR3D，利用局部占用场（Local Occupancy Fields）实现点云的任意尺度上采样与细化。该方法通过学习局部占用表示来指导点的生成与位置优化，相比固定尺度或简单插值的上采样方法，能更好地保持局部几何结构。摘要未提供具体量化结果。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_en: This paper addresses arbitrary-scale upsampling and refinement of 3D point clouds by proposing ASUR3D, which leverages local occupancy fields. The method learns local occupancy representations to guide point generation and position refinement, better preserving local geometry than fixed-scale or simple interpolation approaches. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.assessment: 将占用场用于点云上采样是一个有新意的交叉思路，但相关度与影响力相对有限，可作为参考。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.contribution: 提出基于局部占用场的3D点云任意尺度上采样与细化方法 ASUR3D。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.innovation: 利用局部占用场指导点云生成与细化，实现任意尺度上采样。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.result: 在保持局部几何结构方面优于固定尺度或插值式上采样方法。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R._arxiv_id: ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and Refinement of 3D Point Clouds using Local Occupancy Fields.

Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_cn: 针对图像匹配在遮挡区域性能下降的问题，本文提出了 Occ2Net，通过3D占用估计来增强遮挡区域的图像匹配鲁棒性。该方法估计场景的3D占用结构以推断被遮挡区域的空间关系，从而辅助匹配。相比仅依赖2D外观特征的匹配方法，Occ2Net 利用3D占用信息提升了遮挡场景下的匹配可靠性。摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_en: This paper addresses image matching degradation in occluded regions by proposing Occ2Net, which leverages 3D occupancy estimation to enhance robustness. The method estimates 3D occupancy to infer spatial relationships in occluded areas, aiding matching. Compared to 2D appearance-only matching, Occ2Net improves reliability in occluded scenes. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.assessment: 将3D占用估计引入图像匹配以解决遮挡问题，思路有一定新意，但整体影响力有限。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.contribution: 提出基于3D占用估计的遮挡区域鲁棒图像匹配方法 Occ2Net。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.innovation: 利用3D占用结构推断遮挡区域空间关系以辅助图像匹配。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.result: 在遮挡场景下提升了图像匹配的鲁棒性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on._arxiv_id: Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on 3D Occupancy Estimation for Occluded Regions.

SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D语义占用预测中缺乏稠密监督和高效多视角融合的问题，本文提出了 SurroundOcc，一种多相机3D占用预测方法。该方法通过多视角图像特征提取与3D体素化融合，并设计了稠密占用标注生成流程以提供监督。相比仅依赖稀疏LiDAR点或BEV平面的方法，SurroundOcc 能提供垂直方向的稠密结构信息，在占用预测任务上取得了显著性能提升。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-camera 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing SurroundOcc, which fuses multi-view image features into 3D voxels and introduces a dense occupancy annotation generation pipeline for supervision. Compared to methods relying on sparse LiDAR points or BEV planes, SurroundOcc provides dense structural information along the vertical direction, achieving significant performance gains in occupancy prediction.
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.assessment: 作为多相机3D占用预测的代表性工作，方法完整且影响广泛，是该方向的重要参考。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.contribution: 提出多相机3D语义占用预测方法 SurroundOcc 及稠密占用标注生成流程。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.innovation: 通过多视角融合与稠密标注生成实现垂直方向稠密结构感知。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.result: 在3D占用预测任务上取得显著性能提升，成为该方向代表性方法。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P._arxiv_id: SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

2304.05316|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于视觉的3D语义占用预测中3D体素处理计算量大、稀疏性和类别不平衡的问题，本文提出了 OccFormer，一种双路径Transformer网络。该方法将繁重的3D处理分解为沿水平面的局部和全局Transformer路径，实现长距离、动态且高效的编码；在占用解码器中通过 preserve-pooling 和 class-guided sampling 适配 Mask2Former 以缓解稀疏与类别不平衡。实验表明，OccFormer 在 SemanticKITTI 语义场景补全和 nuScenes LiDAR语义分割任务上显著优于现有方法。
2304.05316|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational cost, sparsity, and class imbalance in vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing OccFormer, a dual-path transformer. It decomposes heavy 3D processing into local and global transformer pathways along the horizontal plane for long-range, dynamic, and efficient encoding, and adapts Mask2Former with preserve-pooling and class-guided sampling to mitigate sparsity and class imbalance. Experiments show OccFormer significantly outperforms existing methods on SemanticKITTI semantic scene completion and nuScenes LiDAR semantic segmentation.
2304.05316|v2.assessment: 双路径Transformer设计有效平衡了效率与长距离建模，在多个基准上取得领先，是该方向的重要工作。
2304.05316|v2.contribution: 提出双路径Transformer网络 OccFormer 用于视觉3D语义占用预测。
2304.05316|v2.innovation: 将3D处理分解为局部与全局Transformer路径，并引入 preserve-pooling 与 class-guided sampling。
2304.05316|v2.result: 在 SemanticKITTI 语义场景补全和 nuScenes LiDAR语义分割上显著优于现有方法。

POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有 3D 语义占用预测方法依赖固定类别标注、无法识别开放词汇目标的问题，提出了 POP-3D，一种仅从图像输入进行开放词汇 3D 占用预测的方法。其核心思路是利用视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）的跨模态对齐能力，将 2D 图像特征与 3D 占用栅格关联，从而在无需 3D 文本标注的情况下实现任意类别的占用预测。相比传统闭集方法，POP-3D 在开放词汇场景下显著提升了泛化能力，在 nuScenes 等数据集上对未见类别的占用预测取得了优于基线的性能。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing 3D semantic occupancy prediction methods that rely on fixed category annotations and cannot recognize open-vocabulary objects. It proposes POP-3D, an open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction approach that operates solely from image inputs by leveraging vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) to align 2D image features with 3D occupancy grids without requiring 3D text annotations. Compared to closed-set methods, POP-3D demonstrates improved generalization to unseen categories, achieving superior performance over baselines on datasets such as nuScenes.
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇能力引入 3D 占用预测，填补了自动驾驶感知中开放场景理解的空白，对多模态与 BEV/Occupancy 交叉方向的研究者有较高参考价值。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.contribution: 提出了首个仅从图像进行开放词汇 3D 占用预测的框架 POP-3D。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.innovation: 利用视觉-语言模型跨模态对齐实现无需 3D 文本标注的开放词汇占用预测。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.result: 在 nuScenes 等数据集上对未见类别的占用预测性能优于闭集基线。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre._arxiv_id: POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction from Images.

COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_cn: 针对视觉3D占用预测中密集网格表示计算开销大、细节丢失的问题，本文提出COTR（Compact Occupancy TRansformer）。方法上通过紧凑的占用表示与Transformer结构减少冗余计算，在保持精度的同时压缩占用预测的计算量。相比已有密集网格方法，COTR在效率与精度之间取得更好平衡。摘要未提供具体数值，但整体面向自动驾驶BEV/占用感知的实际部署需求。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and detail loss of dense grid representations in vision-based 3D occupancy prediction by proposing COTR, a Compact Occupancy TRansformer. The method reduces redundant computation via a compact occupancy representation and transformer architecture, achieving a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off than dense-grid baselines. It targets practical deployment of occupancy perception in autonomous driving.
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.assessment: 面向视觉占用预测的效率问题，思路务实，对BEV/占用方向研究者有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体实验数据。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.contribution: 提出紧凑占用Transformer框架COTR，降低视觉3D占用预测的计算冗余。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.innovation: 以紧凑占用表示替代密集网格，结合Transformer实现高效占用预测。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.result: 在保持占用预测精度的同时显著降低计算开销（摘要未给出具体数值）。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for._arxiv_id: COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for Vision-Based 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2412.05154|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D检测中bbox表示无法刻画物体精细几何的问题，本文提出以object-centric occupancy作为bbox的补充表示。数据方面，构建了首个object-centric occupancy数据集（自动化流水线生成）；算法方面，提出带隐式形状解码器的占用补全网络，可处理动态尺寸的占用生成，为不完整检测结果预测完整占用体。该工作从数据与算法双视角推进了object-centric占用感知，为3D检测提供更精细的几何补充。
2412.05154|v2.summary_en: To address the inability of 3D bounding boxes to capture fine-grained object geometry, this paper introduces object-centric occupancy as a supplement to bboxes. It constructs the first object-centric occupancy dataset via an automated pipeline and proposes an occupancy completion network with an implicit shape decoder that handles dynamic-size occupancy generation. This advances object-centric occupancy perception from both data and algorithmic perspectives.
2412.05154|v2.assessment: 数据与算法双重贡献，object-centric占用补全思路新颖，对3D检测与占用感知交叉方向有较高参考价值。
2412.05154|v2.contribution: 构建首个object-centric占用数据集并提出占用补全网络，将占用作为bbox的几何补充。
2412.05154|v2.innovation: 用隐式形状解码器实现动态尺寸的object-centric占用补全，服务于3D检测。
2412.05154|v2.result: 为检测到的物体预测完整占用体，提升几何细节刻画能力（摘要未给出具体指标）。

2405.14014|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占用预测依赖LiDAR/相机、在恶劣天气下鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出RadarOcc，首次利用4D成像雷达进行3D占用预测。方法直接处理4D雷达张量以保留场景细节，通过多普勒bin描述子、旁瓣感知空间稀疏化和距离维自注意力应对数据量大与噪声问题，并设计球面特征编码与球面到笛卡尔特征聚合减少坐标变换插值误差。该工作提升了全天候占用感知的鲁棒性。
2405.14014|v2.summary_en: To improve the robustness of 3D occupancy prediction under adverse weather, this paper proposes RadarOcc, the first approach leveraging 4D imaging radar for occupancy prediction. It directly processes the 4D radar tensor with Doppler bin descriptors, sidelobe-aware spatial sparsification, and range-wise self-attention, plus spherical feature encoding and spherical-to-Cartesian aggregation to reduce interpolation errors. This enables all-weather occupancy perception.
2405.14014|v2.assessment: 将4D成像雷达引入占用预测，填补了雷达占用感知的空白，对全天候自动驾驶感知有重要意义。
2405.14014|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于4D成像雷达的3D占用预测方法RadarOcc。
2405.14014|v2.innovation: 直接处理4D雷达张量并结合多普勒描述子、旁瓣感知稀疏化与球面特征编码。
2405.14014|v2.result: 在恶劣天气下实现鲁棒的3D占用预测（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2312.03774|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统占用预测依赖密集规则网格导致计算量大且小物体空间细节丢失的问题，本文提出OctreeOcc，利用八叉树表示自适应捕捉3D信息，为不同尺寸和复杂度的物体与语义区域提供可变粒度。方法引入图像语义信息改进初始八叉树结构，并设计迭代修正机制精炼八叉树。实验表明OctreeOcc在占用预测上超越SOTA，同时相比密集网格方法降低15%-24%计算开销。
2312.03774|v2.summary_en: To address the excessive computation and loss of spatial detail for small objects in dense-grid occupancy prediction, this paper proposes OctreeOcc, which leverages octree representation to adaptively capture 3D information with variable granularity. It incorporates image semantics to improve the initial octree structure and designs an iterative rectification mechanism. OctreeOcc surpasses state-of-the-art methods while reducing computational overhead by 15%-24% compared to dense-grid approaches.
2312.03774|v2.assessment: 八叉树自适应表示思路清晰，精度与效率双优，且给出明确的15%-24%计算下降数据，对占用预测效率研究有较高价值。
2312.03774|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树查询的多粒度高效3D占用预测框架OctreeOcc。
2312.03774|v2.innovation: 用图像语义初始化八叉树并迭代修正，实现可变粒度的自适应占用表示。
2312.03774|v2.result: 超越SOTA占用预测方法，计算开销相比密集网格方法降低15%-24%。

2409.09350|v2.summary_cn: 针对主流占用预测先离散化体素再对密集网格分类、而绝大多数体素为空导致算力浪费的问题，本文提出OPUS，将占用预测重新表述为集合预测范式，无需显式空间建模或复杂稀疏化。方法采用Transformer编码器-解码器，用一组可学习查询同时预测占用位置与类别，并引入Chamfer距离损失将集合比较扩展到大规模训练，语义类别通过最近邻自适应分配。该工作为占用预测提供了简洁高效的新视角。
2409.09350|v2.summary_en: To avoid wasteful computation on the vast majority of empty voxels in dense-grid occupancy prediction, this paper proposes OPUS, which reformulates occupancy prediction as a streamlined set prediction paradigm without explicit space modeling or complex sparsification. It uses a transformer encoder-decoder with learnable queries to jointly predict occupied locations and classes, employing Chamfer distance loss to scale set-to-set comparison and nearest-neighbor semantic assignment. This offers a simple and efficient new perspective on occupancy prediction.
2409.09350|v2.assessment: 将占用预测转化为集合预测的思路新颖，规避了密集网格与稀疏化的两难，对占用预测范式研究有启发意义。
2409.09350|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏集合预测的占用预测框架OPUS，无需显式空间建模。
2409.09350|v2.innovation: 用可学习查询与Chamfer距离损失实现端到端的占用位置与类别集合预测。
2409.09350|v2.result: 以简洁的集合预测范式实现高效占用预测（摘要未给出具体数值）。

GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测中高斯表示效率与精度难以兼顾的问题，本文提出GaussianFormer-2，将场景建模为概率高斯叠加，通过概率化高斯参数与叠加渲染提升表示能力。相比GaussianFormer，方法在保持稀疏高效的同时改善了遮挡与边界区域的预测。在Occ3D-nuScenes等基准上取得领先的占用预测精度，并显著降低计算开销。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency-accuracy trade-off in 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing GaussianFormer-2, which models scenes as probabilistic Gaussian superpositions. It improves representation capability via probabilistic Gaussian parameters and superposition rendering while retaining sparse efficiency. Experiments on Occ3D-nuScenes show state-of-the-art occupancy accuracy with substantially reduced computation.
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.assessment: 面向BEV/Occupancy的高效高斯表示改进，工程与精度兼顾，值得自动驾驶感知研究者关注。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.contribution: 提出概率高斯叠加的3D占用预测框架GaussianFormer-2。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.innovation: 将高斯参数概率化并通过叠加渲染增强稀疏场景表示。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得领先占用精度并显著降低计算量。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian._arxiv_id: GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian Superposition for Efficient 3D Occupancy Prediction.

EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶语义占用预测中不确定性建模不足的问题，本文提出EvOcc，基于证据理论（Dempster-Shafer）对体素语义进行不确定性感知预测。方法将证据理论与占用网络结合，输出带置信度的语义占用，提升对遮挡与稀疏观测区域的鲁棒性。在公开占用基准上改善了语义占用精度与不确定性校准。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient uncertainty modeling in semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by proposing EvOcc, which leverages evidence theory for uncertainty-aware voxel semantics. It integrates Dempster-Shafer evidence with occupancy networks to produce confidence-aware semantic occupancy, improving robustness in occluded and sparsely observed regions. Experiments on public occupancy benchmarks show improved accuracy and uncertainty calibration.
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.assessment: 将证据理论引入占用预测，为不确定性建模提供新视角，对安全攸关的自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.contribution: 提出基于证据理论的语义占用预测方法EvOcc。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.innovation: 用Dempster-Shafer证据理论建模体素语义不确定性。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.result: 在公开占用基准上提升精度并改善不确定性校准。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A._arxiv_id: EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for Automated Driving Using Evidence Theory.

OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_cn: 针对现有占用预测方法计算复杂度高、难以兼顾长程依赖的问题，本文提出OccMamba，将状态空间模型（Mamba）引入语义占用预测。方法设计适配3D体素/BEV的Mamba结构以高效建模全局上下文，在保持线性复杂度的同时捕捉长程空间关系。在Occ3D-nuScenes等基准上取得与Transformer方法相当或更优的精度，并降低计算与显存开销。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational complexity and limited long-range modeling in occupancy prediction by introducing OccMamba, which brings state space models into semantic occupancy prediction. It designs Mamba architectures tailored to 3D voxels/BEV for efficient global context modeling with linear complexity. Experiments on Occ3D-nuScenes show accuracy comparable to or better than Transformer-based methods with reduced compute and memory.
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.assessment: 将Mamba引入占用预测的代表性工作，效率与精度平衡良好，对BEV/Occupancy方向有较强参考意义。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.contribution: 提出基于状态空间模型的语义占用预测框架OccMamba。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.innovation: 设计适配3D占用的Mamba结构以线性复杂度建模长程上下文。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上精度媲美Transformer方法且降低计算与显存。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction._arxiv_id: OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction with State Space Models.

STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_cn: 针对3D占用与场景流联合预测中时空建模冗余、稀疏表示不足的问题，本文提出STCOcc，采用稀疏时空级联更新策略。方法通过稀疏查询的级联时空交互同时预测占用与场景流，减少稠密体素计算。相比已有方法在占用与场景流基准上提升精度并提高效率。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_en: This paper targets redundant spatio-temporal modeling and inefficient sparse representation in joint 3D occupancy and scene flow prediction by proposing STCOcc, a sparse spatial-temporal cascade renovation approach. It predicts occupancy and scene flow via cascaded spatio-temporal interaction over sparse queries, reducing dense voxel computation. Experiments show improved accuracy and efficiency on occupancy and scene flow benchmarks.
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.assessment: 稀疏时空级联思路对占用与场景流联合任务有实用价值，适合关注动态场景感知的研究者。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.contribution: 提出稀疏时空级联的3D占用与场景流联合预测方法STCOcc。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.innovation: 用稀疏查询级联时空交互替代稠密体素建模。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.result: 在占用与场景流基准上提升精度并提高效率。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade._arxiv_id: STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade Renovation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction.

2412.13193|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测依赖大量标注、体素表示计算昂贵且泛化受限的问题，本文提出GaussTR，将稀疏高斯表示与基础模型对齐相结合。方法以前馈方式预测稀疏高斯集合表示3D场景，将高斯投影到2D视图并与基础模型特征对齐，实现自监督3D表示学习与开放词汇语义占用预测，无需显式标注。在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得12.27 mIoU的零样本SOTA，并减少40%训练时间。
2412.13193|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on extensive labels, costly voxel representations, and limited generalization in 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing GaussTR, which unifies sparse Gaussian modeling with foundation model alignment. It predicts sparse Gaussian sets in a feed-forward manner, splats them into 2D views, and aligns rendered features with foundation models for self-supervised 3D representation learning and open-vocabulary occupancy prediction without explicit annotations. On Occ3D-nuScenes it achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot 12.27 mIoU with 40% less training time.
2412.13193|v2.assessment: 将高斯表示与基础模型对齐用于自监督开放词汇占用，思路新颖且零样本结果突出，非常值得关注。
2412.13193|v2.contribution: 提出基础模型对齐的高斯Transformer框架GaussTR用于自监督3D空间理解。
2412.13193|v2.innovation: 用稀疏高斯投影与基础模型特征对齐实现无标注开放词汇占用预测。
2412.13193|v2.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得12.27 mIoU零样本SOTA并减少40%训练时间。

2503.19576|v2.summary_cn: 针对隐式神经表示（INR）压缩中依赖量化与熵编码方案的问题，本文提出SINR，利用INR权重向量空间中的模式进行压缩。方法在高维字典内用稀疏编码压缩权重向量空间，并发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可恢复INR权重。实验表明SINR可与现有INR压缩方法集成，并在多种配置下显著降低存储需求。
2503.19576|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dependence on quantization and entropy coding in implicit neural representation (INR) compression by proposing SINR, which exploits patterns in the vector spaces formed by INR weights. It compresses these vector spaces using high-dimensional sparse codes within a dictionary, and shows that dictionary atoms need not be learned or transmitted to recover INR weights. Experiments demonstrate that SINR integrates with existing INR compression techniques and substantially reduces storage across configurations.
2503.19576|v2.assessment: 属于INR压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知/占用预测关联较弱，但对模型压缩与表示学习研究者有一定参考。
2503.19576|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏字典编码的INR压缩算法SINR。
2503.19576|v2.innovation: 利用INR权重向量空间的稀疏编码且无需传输字典原子。
2503.19576|v2.result: 可与现有INR压缩方法集成并显著降低存储需求。

MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_cn: ①针对不同激光雷达传感器之间因线束、扫描模式差异导致的域间隙，使占用预测模型跨LiDAR泛化能力差的问题。②提出MergeOcc，通过跨传感器特征对齐与融合来桥接不同LiDAR的域间隙，实现鲁棒的3D占用预测。③相比仅在单一LiDAR上训练的方法，显式建模传感器间差异，提升跨域迁移能力。④摘要未提供具体数值，但方法在跨LiDAR设定下提升了占用预测的鲁棒性。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap between different LiDAR sensors that degrades occupancy prediction generalization. It proposes MergeOcc, which bridges cross-sensor domain gaps via feature alignment and fusion for robust 3D occupancy prediction. Compared with single-LiDAR training, it explicitly models inter-sensor discrepancies to improve cross-domain transferability.
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.assessment: 跨LiDAR域适应是占用预测落地多车型的关键问题，该工作切中实际痛点，值得关注。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.contribution: 提出MergeOcc桥接不同LiDAR域间隙以实现鲁棒占用预测。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.innovation: 显式建模并融合不同LiDAR传感器特征以消除域间隙。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.result: 在跨LiDAR设定下提升了占用预测的鲁棒性与泛化性。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between._arxiv_id: MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between Different Lidars for Robust Occupancy Prediction.

AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_cn: ①针对开放世界3D占用预测中模型难以泛化到未见类别、缺乏自适应定位能力的问题。②提出AGO（Adaptive Grounding for Open world），通过自适应grounding机制将开放词汇/开放集语义与3D占用空间对齐。③相比封闭集占用预测方法，AGO增强了对未知类别的识别与定位能力。④摘要未给出具体数值，但方法面向开放世界占用预测的泛化性提升。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_en: This paper targets open-world 3D occupancy prediction, where models struggle to generalize to unseen categories. It proposes AGO, an adaptive grounding mechanism that aligns open-vocabulary semantics with 3D occupancy space. Compared with closed-set methods, AGO improves recognition and localization of unknown categories.
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.assessment: 开放世界占用预测是新兴且重要的方向，AGO的自适应grounding思路对提升泛化性有参考价值。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.contribution: 提出面向开放世界3D占用预测的自适应grounding方法AGO。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.innovation: 将开放词汇语义自适应对齐到3D占用空间以处理未见类别。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.result: 提升了开放世界占用预测对未知类别的泛化能力。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3._arxiv_id: AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2408.11447|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督3D占用估计仍依赖传感器真值6D位姿、且体渲染耗时且效果有限的问题。②提出GaussianOcc，包含GSP模块从相邻视图投影提供尺度信息实现完全自监督，以及GSV模块从体素空间进行高斯泼溅以加速渲染。③相比依赖真值位姿和体渲染的方法，实现无需位姿的完全自监督训练并大幅提速。④训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍，性能与有监督方法相当。
2408.11447|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on ground-truth 6D poses and the inefficiency of volume rendering in self-supervised 3D occupancy estimation. It proposes GaussianOcc with a GSP module for scale-aware fully self-supervised training and a GSV module for fast Gaussian splatting from voxel space. It achieves fully self-supervised occupancy estimation with 2.7x faster training and 5x faster rendering at competitive performance.
2408.11447|v2.assessment: 完全自监督且高效的占用估计方案，结合高斯泼溅，工程与学术价值兼具，值得重点关注。
2408.11447|v2.contribution: 提出完全自监督且高效的3D占用估计方法GaussianOcc。
2408.11447|v2.innovation: 用GSP提供尺度信息实现无位姿自监督，用GSV从体素空间高斯泼溅加速渲染。
2408.11447|v2.result: 训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍，性能与有监督方法相当。

2502.07309|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D占用世界模型仍依赖昂贵3D占用标注、难以规模化的问题。②提出半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld，采用自监督预训练+全监督微调两阶段范式，预训练阶段用属性投影头生成RGB/密度/语义场并通过体渲染利用2D标签进行时序监督，并引入状态条件预测模块递归预测未来占用与自车轨迹。③相比依赖3D标注的方法，充分利用2D标签降低标注成本。④在nuScenes上验证有效性与可扩展性，取得有竞争力的性能。
2502.07309|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high cost of 3D occupancy annotations for occupancy world models. It proposes PreWorld, a semi-supervised vision-centric 3D occupancy world model with a self-supervised pre-training and fully-supervised fine-tuning paradigm, using an attribute projection head for temporal 2D supervision and a state-conditioned forecasting module for recursive future occupancy and ego-trajectory prediction. Experiments on nuScenes validate its effectiveness and scalability with competitive performance.
2502.07309|v2.assessment: 半监督世界模型降低标注依赖，对自动驾驶规划与占用预测结合有较强实用价值。
2502.07309|v2.contribution: 提出半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld。
2502.07309|v2.innovation: 两阶段训练利用2D标签时序监督，并用状态条件模块递归预测未来占用与轨迹。
2502.07309|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得有竞争力性能并验证可扩展性。

CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_cn: ①针对占用预测中多帧时序信息对齐与融合不充分的问题。②提出CSV-Occ，采用时序跨状态空间模型与中心投票机制进行多帧对齐融合以提升占用预测。③相比单帧或简单时序融合方法，通过状态空间模型建模长时序依赖并投票聚合。④摘要未提供具体数值，但方法旨在提升占用预测精度。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient multi-frame temporal alignment and fusion in occupancy prediction. It proposes CSV-Occ, which fuses multi-frame alignment via a temporal cross state space model and a central voting mechanism. Compared with single-frame or naive temporal fusion, it models long-range temporal dependencies and aggregates via voting to improve occupancy prediction.
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.assessment: 将状态空间模型引入占用预测时序融合，思路较新，但需关注实验充分性。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.contribution: 提出融合多帧对齐的占用预测方法CSV-Occ。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.innovation: 结合时序跨状态空间模型与中心投票机制进行多帧融合。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.result: 提升了占用预测的多帧时序融合精度。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo._arxiv_id: CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment for Occupancy Prediction with Temporal Cross State Space Model and Central Voting Mechanism.

ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_cn: ①针对占用预测中体素表示效率与精度难以兼顾的问题。②提出ODG，使用双重高斯（Dual Gaussians）进行占用预测，以高斯表示替代传统密集体素。③相比基于体素或体渲染的方法，双重高斯表示更高效且能更好刻画几何与语义。④摘要未提供具体数值，但方法旨在提升占用预测的效率与精度。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_en: This paper targets the efficiency-accuracy trade-off in occupancy prediction. It proposes ODG, which uses dual Gaussians to represent occupancy instead of dense voxels. Compared with voxel-based or volume-rendering methods, the dual Gaussian representation is more efficient and better captures geometry and semantics.
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.assessment: 高斯表示用于占用预测是当前热点，ODG的双重高斯设计有创新性，值得关注。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.contribution: 提出基于双重高斯的占用预测方法ODG。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.innovation: 用双重高斯表示替代密集体素以兼顾效率与精度。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.result: 提升了占用预测的效率与表示能力。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau._arxiv_id: ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians.

Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中自回归式占据预测（autoregressive occupancy prediction）的效率与精度问题，提出动态聚焦掩码（Dynamic Focused Masking）方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体技术细节，但从标题推断其核心是在自回归生成占据栅格时动态选择需要预测的区域，避免对空白或低信息量区域进行冗余计算。相比已有工作，改进点应在于将计算资源集中于动态目标与场景关键区域，从而在保持预测精度的同时降低推理开销。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of autoregressive occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by proposing Dynamic Focused Masking. The method likely dynamically selects informative regions during autoregressive generation, concentrating computation on dynamic objects and safety-critical areas rather than empty space. It aims to improve the accuracy-efficiency trade-off over dense or uniformly masked autoregressive baselines, though quantitative results cannot be verified due to the missing abstract.
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.assessment: 自回归占据预测是 Occupancy 方向的新兴范式，动态聚焦掩码思路对提升推理效率有潜在价值，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法严谨性与实验充分度，建议获取全文后再判断。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.contribution: 提出面向自回归占据预测的动态聚焦掩码机制，以区域自适应计算替代均匀预测。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.innovation: 将动态掩码策略引入自回归占据生成，聚焦高信息量区域以降低冗余计算。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.result: 摘要缺失，具体性能提升数据无法确认。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi._arxiv_id: Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressive Embodied Occupancy Prediction.

2506.10977|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 3D 语义占据预测中现有方法表示效率低的问题：稠密体素表示忽略驾驶场景稀疏性，而基于稀疏高斯的物体中心表示受椭球形状先验限制，难以建模长方体、圆柱等多样几何，需大量高斯堆叠。作者提出以超二次曲面（superquadrics）作为场景基元，构建概率超二次混合模型，将每个超二次曲面解释为带几何先验的占据概率分布，并通过概率混合计算语义，进而提出 QuadricFormer。相比高斯表示，该方法以更少基元表达复杂结构，提升表示效率与几何表达能力，具体定量结果因摘要截断未能完整引用。
2506.10977|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of 3D semantic occupancy prediction caused by dense voxel representations and the ellipsoidal shape prior of sparse Gaussian primitives, which struggles with diverse object geometries. It proposes superquadrics as scene primitives and a probabilistic superquadric mixture model that treats each primitive as an occupancy probability distribution with a geometry prior, computing semantics via probabilistic mixture. Built on this, QuadricFormer achieves efficient representation of complex structures with fewer primitives, though full quantitative results are truncated in the abstract.
2506.10977|v2.assessment: 将超二次曲面引入占据预测是对高斯基元表示的重要扩展，几何表达力与稀疏性的平衡思路清晰，对 BEV/Occupancy 方向研究者有较高参考价值。
2506.10977|v2.contribution: 提出基于超二次曲面的概率混合占据表示与 QuadricFormer 模型，实现高效 3D 语义占据预测。
2506.10977|v2.innovation: 用几何表达力更强的超二次曲面替代椭球高斯作为场景基元，并以概率混合统一建模占据与语义。
2506.10977|v2.result: 以更少基元表达复杂结构，提升表示效率，具体指标因摘要截断未完整给出。

2509.16500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶合成视频虽视觉逼真但存在细微几何畸变、导致下游 3D 检测性能显著下降的问题，首次量化了合成与真实数据在 3D 目标检测上的性能差距。作者提出 RLGF（Reinforcement Learning with Geometric Feedback），利用专用隐空间 AD 感知模型提供奖励来微调视频扩散模型，核心包括隐空间窗口优化（Latent-Space Windowing Optimization）与分层几何奖励（HGR，涵盖点-线-面对齐与场景占据一致性），并提出 GeoScores 量化畸变。在 nuScenes 上对 DiVE 等模型应用后，消失点误差降低 21%、深度误差降低 57%，3D 检测 mAP 提升 12.7%，缩小了与真实数据的差距。
2509.16500|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies and quantifies the geometric distortions in visually realistic synthetic driving videos that degrade downstream 3D object detection. It proposes RLGF, which refines video diffusion models using rewards from specialized latent-space AD perception models, comprising a Latent-Space Windowing Optimization technique and a Hierarchical Geometric Reward (HGR) system for point-line-plane alignment and scene occupancy coherence, along with GeoScores for quantifying distortions. Applied to DiVE on nuScenes, RLGF reduces vanishing point error by 21% and depth error by 57%, and improves 3D detection mAP by 12.7%.
2509.16500|v2.assessment: 该工作切中合成数据用于自动驾驶感知的关键痛点——几何保真度，用感知模型反馈强化扩散生成，闭环设计合理且提升显著，对数据生成与 3D 检测交叉方向有较强启发。
2509.16500|v2.contribution: 提出 RLGF 框架，以隐空间感知模型的分层几何奖励微调视频扩散模型，并给出 GeoScores 畸变度量。
2509.16500|v2.innovation: 将强化学习与几何反馈引入视频扩散生成，用点-线-面与占据一致性奖励直接优化下游感知可用性。
2509.16500|v2.result: 在 nuScenes 上消失点误差降 21%、深度误差降 57%，3D 检测 mAP 提升 12.7%。

2210.01917|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶运动规划中自监督表示（如ego-centric freespace）混淆了环境运动与自车运动、难以用于下游规划器的问题，本文提出以几何occupancy作为替代表示，天然解耦环境与自车运动。由于遮挡导致无法直接观测完整3D occupancy，作者利用可微raycasting将未来occupancy预测渲染为未来LiDAR扫描预测，与真值扫描对比实现自监督学习，使occupancy作为预测网络的内部表示自然涌现。该方法避免了对手工标注occupancy的依赖，在自监督occupancy预测任务上取得了优于基线方法的效果。
2210.01917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that self-supervised representations like ego-centric freespace confound environment motion with ego-vehicle motion, hindering downstream motion planning. It proposes using geometric occupancy as a natural alternative that disentangles the two motions, and employs differentiable raycasting to render future occupancy predictions into future LiDAR sweeps for self-supervised learning, allowing occupancy to emerge as an internal representation. This avoids the need for direct occupancy supervision and improves self-supervised occupancy forecasting over baselines.
2210.01917|v2.assessment: 该工作将可微渲染引入occupancy自监督预测，思路新颖且对自动驾驶规划有实际价值，值得关注。
2210.01917|v2.contribution: 提出用可微raycasting将occupancy预测渲染为LiDAR扫描以实现自监督occupancy预测的框架。
2210.01917|v2.innovation: 利用可微raycasting桥接不可直接观测的3D occupancy与可观测的LiDAR扫描，使occupancy作为内部表示涌现。
2210.01917|v2.result: 在自监督occupancy预测任务上优于基线方法，验证了该框架的有效性。

SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_cn: 该论文针对卷积占用网络（Convolutional Occupancy Networks）在三维重建中依赖准确符号（内外方向）监督、对噪声和初始化敏感的问题，提出了一种符号无关（Sign-Agnostic）的优化框架 SA-ConvONet。方法上通过设计符号无关的损失与优化策略，使网络无需显式区分内外即可学习到高质量的三维占用场，从而提升重建的鲁棒性。相比已有 ConvONet 等方法，该工作降低了对符号标注或精确初始化的依赖，在多个三维重建基准上取得了更优或相当的重建精度。该工作主要面向三维重建与占用表示，与自动驾驶中的 3D 检测、BEV 感知等任务关联较弱，但对占用场建模有一定参考价值。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_en: This paper addresses the sensitivity of Convolutional Occupancy Networks to sign (inside/outside) supervision and initialization in 3D reconstruction. It proposes SA-ConvONet, a sign-agnostic optimization framework with tailored losses that learns high-quality occupancy fields without explicit inside/outside distinction. Compared with prior ConvONet-style methods, it improves robustness and reconstruction accuracy on standard 3D benchmarks, though its relevance to autonomous driving 3D detection and BEV perception remains limited.
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.assessment: 该工作对占用场表示与三维重建的优化问题有方法层面的贡献，但与自动驾驶感知主线（3D 检测、BEV、多相机）关联有限，适合对占用建模感兴趣的研究者参考。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.contribution: 提出符号无关的卷积占用网络优化框架，降低三维重建对内外符号监督的依赖。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.innovation: 通过符号无关损失与优化策略，使占用网络无需显式区分内外即可稳定学习三维占用场。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.result: 在多个三维重建基准上取得更优或相当的重建精度，并提升了对噪声与初始化的鲁棒性。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization._arxiv_id: SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization of Convolutional Occupancy Networks.

Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_cn: 该论文针对三维表面感知图像合成中几何与外观解耦困难、新视角合成质量不足的问题，提出了生成式占用场（Generative Occupancy Fields）方法。方法上利用占用场显式建模三维几何，并结合生成式建模实现表面感知的图像合成，从而在保持几何一致性的同时提升渲染真实感。相比已有神经辐射场或隐式表面方法，该工作强调占用场与生成模型的结合，在新视角合成与三维表面感知任务上取得了更好的几何一致性与视觉质量。该工作属于三维表示与生成方向，与自动驾驶中的占用预测、3D 检测有一定概念关联，但任务目标不同。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of disentangling geometry and appearance in 3D surface-aware image synthesis. It proposes Generative Occupancy Fields, which explicitly model 3D geometry via occupancy fields and integrate generative modeling for surface-aware rendering. Compared with NeRF-style or implicit-surface methods, it improves geometric consistency and visual quality in novel view synthesis, offering conceptual links to occupancy prediction in autonomous driving but targeting a different task.
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.assessment: 该工作将占用场与生成式建模结合，对三维表示与合成有方法价值，与自动驾驶占用预测存在概念关联，但直接应用价值有限。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.contribution: 提出生成式占用场，实现表面感知的三维图像合成。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.innovation: 将占用场显式几何建模与生成式渲染结合，提升几何一致性与合成真实感。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.result: 在新视角合成任务上取得更好的几何一致性与视觉质量。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa._arxiv_id: Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surface-Aware Image Synthesis.
